如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Attention Residuals replace standard additive residual connections with learned softmax attention over previous layer outputs, enabling selective cross-layer routing. However, standard Attention Residuals still attend over cumulative hidden states in previous layers, which are highly redundant. We show that this redundancy leads to routing collapse in deeper layers: attention weights become low-contrast and closer to uniform (max weight ${\approx}$0.2), limiting the model's ability to select informative states in previous layers. This raises a key but underexplored design question: what layer-wise representations should be routed in Attention Residuals? To answer this question, we propose Delta Attention Residuals, which attend over deltas -- the change introduced by each sublayer ($\mathbf{v}_i = \mathbf{h}_{i+1} - \mathbf{h}_i$) -- instead of cumulative states. Delta representations are structurally diverse and yield higher-contrast attention distributions (max weight ${\approx}$0.6), enabling more selective and effective routing across layers. This principle applies at both per-sublayer and block granularity. Across all tested scales (220M--7.6B), Delta Attention Residuals consistently outperform both standard residuals and Attention Residuals, with 1.7--8.2\% validation perplexity gains. Delta Attention Residuals also enables converting pretrained checkpoints into Delta Attention Residuals via standard fine-tuning. Code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Cross-Subject Intracranial EEG Reconstruction from Scalp Recordings Using Multi-Scale Cross-Attention Transformers
item.author: Tien-Dat Pham, Xuan-The Tran
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究提出了一种名为CAST的跨注意力时空Transformer框架，通过两阶段迁移学习策略，利用头皮脑电图重建未见患者的颅内脑电图信号。

背景: 颅内脑电图提供高保真的神经记录，但获取这些信号需要侵入性手术。现有的非侵入性头皮脑电图重建方法大多依赖患者特定模型，存在循环依赖问题，即需要手术收集训练数据，限制了非侵入性模型的实际应用价值。

目的: 解决跨受试者颅内脑电图重建的挑战，即利用在其他个体上训练的模型来预测未见患者的颅内信号。

方法: 提出CAST机器学习框架，采用两阶段迁移学习策略：首先通过时间编码器提取三种不同分辨率的多尺度神经表示；然后利用目标受试者仅几分钟的数据对通道感知解码器进行校准，以适应不同患者的电极放置差异。

主要发现: 在两个包含1,282个颅内脑电图通道的公开数据集上进行的留一受试者交叉验证显示，CAST在重建靠近头皮表面的皮质信号方面显著优于深部皮层下活动。在高度可观察的感觉运动区域，模型在中央沟达到了高达0.864的相关系数。此外，通过通道选择策略，CAST在有效受试者上获得了0.545的平均相关系数，优于之前的受试者内基线。

结论: 无需大量患者特定训练即可从头皮脑电图重建未见受试者的皮质颅内脑电图信号，且仅需简短的校准阶段即可使模型适应新的硬件配置。

翻译: 颅内脑电图(iEEG)提供了临床和脑机接口应用所需的高保真神经记录，但获取这些信号需要侵入性手术。虽然最近的研究尝试从非侵入性头皮脑电图估计iEEG，但大多数依赖于患者特定模型，造成了循环依赖：如果需要手术来收集训练数据，那么非侵入性模型提供的实际益处有限。在本研究中，我们通过利用在其他个体上训练的模型来预测未见患者的颅内信号，解决了跨受试者iEEG重建的挑战。我们提出了CAST（跨注意力时空Transformer），一种通过两阶段迁移学习策略将头皮脑电图转换为多通道iEEG波形的机器学习框架。首先，时间编码器提取三种不同分辨率的多尺度神经表示。然后，由于患者的电极放置差异显著，通道感知解码器仅使用目标受试者几分钟的数据进行校准。我们在两个包含1,282个iEEG通道的公开数据集上使用留一受试者交叉验证评估了所提出的方法。实验结果表明，CAST在重建靠近头皮表面的皮质信号方面显著优于深部皮层下活动。在高度可观察的感觉运动区域，模型在中央沟达到了高达0.864的相关系数。此外，通过通道选择策略，CAST在有效受试者上获得了0.545的平均相关系数，优于之前的受试者内基线。这些发现表明，无需大量患者特定训练即可从头皮脑电图重建未见受试者的皮质iEEG信号，且仅需简短的校准阶段即可使模型适应新的硬件配置。

Abstract

Intracranial EEG (iEEG) provides high-fidelity neural recordings essential for clinical and brain-computer interface applications, but acquiring these signals requires invasive surgery. While recent studies have attempted to estimate iEEG from non-invasive scalp EEG, most rely on patient-specific models, creating a circular dependency: if surgery is required to collect training data, the non-invasive model offers limited practical benefit. In this study, we address the challenge of cross-subject iEEG reconstruction by predicting intracranial signals for unseen patients using models trained on other individuals. We propose CAST (Cross-Attention Spatial-Temporal Transformer), a machine learning framework that translates scalp EEG into multi-channel iEEG waveforms through a two-stage transfer learning strategy. First, a temporal encoder extracts multi-scale neural representations at three different resolutions. Then, because electrode placements vary substantially across patients, a channel-aware decoder is calibrated using only a few minutes of data from the target subject. We evaluated the proposed method using leave-one-subject-out cross-validation on two public datasets comprising 1,282 iEEG channels. Experimental results demonstrate that CAST reconstructs cortical signals located near the scalp surface substantially better than deep subcortical activity. In highly observable sensorimotor regions, the model achieved peak correlations of up to r=0.864 in the precentral gyrus. Furthermore, with a channel selection strategy, CAST obtained a mean correlation of r=0.545 on viable subjects, outperforming previous within-subject baselines. These findings indicate that cortical iEEG signals can be reconstructed for unseen subjects from scalp EEG without extensive patient-specific training, and that only a brief calibration phase is sufficient to adapt the model to new hardware configurations.

item.title: VCSEL-based PAM-4 transmission system emulator: A data-driven deep learning perspective
item.author: Stavros Deligiannidis, Nikos Argyris, Stefanos Dris, Dimitris Kalavrouziotis, Paraskevas Bakopoulos, Charis Mesaritakis, Adonis Bogris
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于双向长短期记忆网络的数据驱动框架，用于模拟高速VCSEL基4级脉冲幅度调制光互连。

背景: 传统的速率方程模型计算量大且参数调整困难。

目的: 利用实验波形学习端到端系统动力学，设计并优化短距离光链路。

方法: 采用双向长短期记忆网络，利用实验波形进行端到端系统动力学学习；通过迁移学习和权重插值扩展模型至新工作区。

主要发现: 相比独立训练，计算时间减少20倍，且归一化均方误差保持在0.04以下。

结论: 该模拟器为短距离光链路的设计和优化提供了快速且准确的工具。

翻译: 本文提出了一种基于双向长短期记忆网络的数据驱动框架，用于模拟高速VCSEL基4级脉冲幅度调制光互连。与传统速率方程模型相比，该方法计算量小且参数调整容易。通过实验波形学习端到端系统动力学，并利用迁移学习和权重插值，将模型扩展至新工作区，计算时间减少20倍，归一化均方误差保持在0.04以下。该模拟器为短距离光链路的设计和优化提供了快速且准确的工具。

Abstract

We demonstrate a data-driven framework for emulating high-speed VCSEL-based 4-level Pulse Amplitude Modulation (PAM-4) optical interconnects using bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) networks. Unlike conventional rate-equation models, which are computationally intensive and often require difficult parameter tuning, our approach utilizes experimental waveforms to learn the end-to-end system dynamics. By employing transfer learning and weight interpolation, we extend the model to new operating regimes with a 20-fold reduction in computation time compared to independent training, while maintaining normalized mean squared error below 0.04. This emulator provides a rapid, accurate tool for the design and optimization of short-reach optical links.

item.title: Hyrax: An Extensible Framework for Rapid ML Experimentation and Unsupervised Discovery in the Era of Rubin, Roman, and Euclid
item.author: Aritra Ghosh, Drew Oldag, Michael Tauraso, Andrew J. Connolly, Peter Ferguson, Derek Jones, Gourav Khullar, Argyro Sasli, Samarth Venkatesh, Gracia Wang, Maxine West, Dylan Berry, Neven Caplar, Colin Orion Chandler, Tanawan Chatchadanoraset, Michael W. Coughlin, Melissa DeLucchi, Alexandra Junell, Diego Miura, Felipe Fontinele Nunes, Wilson Beebe, Doug Branton, Sandro Campos, Liam Cunningham, Mi Dai, Jeremy Kubica, Konstantin Malanchev, Rachel Mandelbaum, Sean McGuire, Imad Pasha, Dan S. Taranu, Tianqing Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Hyrax是一个开源、模块化、GPU加速的Python框架，支持天文学机器学习全生命周期，包括数据获取、训练、推理和实验比较，具备多模态数据集支持、集成向量数据库和交互式潜在空间探索功能。

背景: NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory、Roman Space Telescope、Euclid等下一代调查将提供成像、光谱和时间域数据，这些数据规模日益增大，使得天文机器学习项目的瓶颈从模型设计转向基础设施。

目的: 展示Hyrax框架在天文学机器学习中的多功能性，通过五个代表性应用在真实调查数据上验证其能力，提供天文特定ML基础设施以实现系统性发现和快速方法迭代。

方法: Hyrax是一个开源、模块化、GPU加速的Python框架，支持全ML生命周期，包括多模态数据集支持、集成向量数据库用于相似性搜索以及交互式二维和三维潜在空间探索。

主要发现: 1. 在约40万个LSST DP1星系上进行无监督表示学习，发现新的合并和低表面亮度候选体，同时隔离成像伪影；2. 混合密度聚类识别DP1数据中的引力透镜候选体；3. 多模态早期瞬变分类；4. 监督过滤Shift-and-Stack搜索中的假阳性；5. 监督检测半解析矮星系。

结论: Hyrax提供了天文特定ML基础设施，能够支持下一代天文调查中的系统性发现和快速方法迭代。

翻译: NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin天文台、Roman空间望远镜、Euclid和其他下一代调查将提供成像、光谱和时间域数据，这些数据规模日益增大，使得天文机器学习项目的瓶颈从模型设计转向基础设施。我们介绍了Hyrax，这是一个开源、模块化、GPU加速的Python框架，支持天文学机器学习的全生命周期：从数据获取和训练到推理和实验比较，具有多模态数据集支持、集成向量数据库用于相似性搜索以及用于无监督发现的交互式二维和三维潜在空间探索功能。我们通过五个在真实调查数据上的代表性应用展示了Hyrax的多功能性：(i) 在约40万个LSST DP1星系上进行无监督表示学习，发现了新的合并和低表面亮度候选体，这些候选体在参考Euclid和暗能量调查目录中缺失，同时也隔离了成像伪影——所有这些都不需要标记训练数据；(ii) 混合密度聚类识别DP1数据中的引力透镜候选体；(iii) 利用光曲线、光谱、图像和元数据在Zwicky瞬变设施中进行多模态早期瞬变分类；(iv) 在暗能量相机黄道探索项目调查中Shift-and-Stack搜索中监督过滤假阳性；(v) 使用合成源注入在Hyper Suprime-Cam和LSST成像中监督检测半解析矮星系。这些结果共同表明，Hyrax提供了天文特定ML基础设施，能够支持下一代天文调查中的系统性发现和快速方法迭代。

Abstract

The NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory, Roman Space Telescope, Euclid, and other next-generation surveys will deliver imaging, spectroscopic, and time-domain data at scales that increasingly shift the bottleneck in astronomical machine learning (ML) projects from model design to infrastructure. We present Hyrax, an open-source, modular, GPU-enabled Python framework that supports the full ML lifecycle in astronomy: from data acquisition and training to inference and experiment comparison, with capabilities including multimodal dataset support, integrated vector databases for similarity search, and interactive two- and three-dimensional latent-space exploration for unsupervised discovery. We demonstrate Hyrax's versatility through five representative applications on real survey data: (i) unsupervised representation learning on $\sim 4\times10^5$ Rubin Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) Data Preview 1 (DP1) galaxies, surfacing new merger and low-surface-brightness candidates missing from reference Euclid and Dark Energy Survey catalogs, while also isolating imaging artifacts -- all without labeled training data; (ii) hybrid density-based clustering for identifying cluster-scale gravitational lens candidates in DP1 data; (iii) multimodal early-time transient classification in the Zwicky Transient Facility leveraging light curves, spectra, images, and metadata; (iv) supervised false-positive filtering in shift-and-stack searches for distant solar system objects in the Dark Energy Camera Ecliptic Exploration Project survey; and (v) supervised detection of semi-resolved dwarf galaxies in Hyper Suprime-Cam and LSST-like imaging using synthetic source injection. Together, these results demonstrate that Hyrax provides astronomy-specific ML infrastructure that enables systematic discovery and rapid methodological iteration across next-generation astronomical surveys.

item.title: Artifact-Bench: Evaluating MLLMs on Detecting and Assessing the Artifacts of AI-Generated Videos
item.author: Tang, Yuqi, Shi, Yang, Zhang, Zhuoran, Wang, Qixun, Bai, Xuehai, Ding, Yue, Chen, Ruizhe, Zeng, Bohan, Chen, Xinlong, Zhu, Xuanyu, Li, Bozhou, Wang, Yuran, Dai, Yifan, Tong, Chengzhuo, Liu, Xinyu, Ji, Yiyan, Wei, Yujie, Dong, Yuhao, Yan, Shilin, Wang, Fengxiang, Zhang, Yi-Fan, Wang, Haotian, Zhang, Yuanxing, Wan, Pengfei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了Artifact-Bench基准测试，旨在评估多模态大语言模型在AI生成视频瑕疵检测和分析方面的能力，发现现有模型在感知和推理上存在显著局限，且其判断与人类偏好存在显著偏差。

背景: 尽管视频生成模型在真实感上有所提升，但其输出仍存在时间不一致、结构扭曲和语义不连贯等瑕疵。现有的基准测试缺乏对瑕疵感知的系统评估和细粒度诊断推理，且多模态大语言模型对这类瑕疵的感知和推理能力尚不明确。

目的: 为了填补现有基准测试的空白，作者引入了Artifact-Bench，这是一个全面的基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型在AI生成视频瑕疵检测和分析方面的能力。

方法: 作者建立了一个三层级的真实感瑕疵分类法，涵盖照片写实、动画和CG风格视频。基于此分类法，Artifact-Bench定义了三个互补任务：真实与AI生成视频分类、成对真实感比较和细粒度瑕疵识别。

主要发现: 在19个领先的多模态大语言模型上的实验显示，它们在瑕疵感知和推理上存在显著局限，许多模型在具有挑战性的设置中接近随机甚至低于随机的表现。此外，多模态大语言模型的判断与人类感知偏好之间存在显著错位。

结论: 多模态大语言模型作为AI生成视频真实感的一般评估者的可靠性有限。

翻译: 最近的视频生成模型极大地提高了AI生成视频的真实感，然而它们的输出仍然表现出时间不一致、结构扭曲和语义不连贯等瑕疵。虽然多模态大语言模型显示出强大的视觉理解能力，但它们感知和推理这些瑕疵的能力仍然不清楚。现有的基准测试往往缺乏对瑕疵感知的系统评估和细粒度诊断推理，特别是在照片写实内容之外的多样化AI生成视频领域。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了Artifact-Bench，这是一个全面的基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型在AI生成视频瑕疵检测和分析方面的能力。我们首先建立了一个三层级的真实感瑕疵分类法，涵盖照片写实、动画和CG风格视频。基于此分类法，Artifact-Bench定义了三个互补任务：真实与AI生成视频分类、成对真实感比较和细粒度瑕疵识别。在19个领先的多模态大语言模型上的实验显示，它们在瑕疵感知和推理上存在显著局限，许多模型在具有挑战性的设置中接近随机甚至低于随机的表现。我们进一步观察到多模态大语言模型的判断与人类感知偏好之间存在显著错位，突出了它们作为AI生成视频真实感的一般评估者的可靠性有限。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决多模态大语言模型在检测和评估 AI 生成视频瑕疵方面的能力评估问题。unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 文中未提供关于作者如何思考并设计方法的具体细节，也未提及借鉴了哪些现有工作。因此，这些信息无法从提供的文本中得出。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Recent video generative models have greatly improved the realism of AI-generated videos, yet their outputs still exhibit artifacts such as temporal inconsistencies, structural distortions, and semantic incoherence. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong visual understanding capabilities, their ability to perceive and reason about such artifacts remains unclear. Existing benchmarks often lack systematic evaluation of artifact-aware perception and fine-grained diagnostic reasoning, especially across diverse AI-generated video domains beyond photorealistic content. To address this gap, we introduce Artifact-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on AI-generated video artifact detection and analysis. We first establish a three-level hierarchical taxonomy of realism artifacts, covering photorealistic, animated, and CG-style videos. Based on this taxonomy, Artifact-Bench defines three complementary tasks: real vs. AI-generated video classification, pairwise realism comparison, and fine-grained artifact identification. Experiments on 19 leading MLLMs reveal substantial limitations in artifact perception and reasoning, with many models approaching random or even below-random performance in challenging settings. We further observe significant misalignment between MLLM judgments and human perceptual preferences, highlighting their limited reliability as general evaluators for AI-generated video realism.

item.title: SAGA: A Sequence-Adaptive Generative Architecture for Multi-Horizon Probabilistic Forecasting with Adaptive Temporal Conformal Prediction
item.author: Lundström-Imanov, Gustav Olaf Yunus Laitinen-Fredriksson, Cömert, Hafize Gonca
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SAGA模型是一种基于解码器的Transformer架构，用于处理不规则表格面板序列，旨在预测长期收入分布。

背景: 现有的财政和中央银行使用的微模拟模型依赖于参数化过程，仅捕捉条件分布的一阶和二阶矩，忽略了长程非线性结构。

目的: 提出SAGA模型及其分层校准包装器，以提供具有有限样本边际覆盖保证的个人层面预测区间，并预测1至30年后的年度劳动收入。

方法: SAGA是一个解码器仅Transformer，用于不规则表格面板序列，结合了分层校准包装器。模型在1990年至2022年的纵向瑞典LISA登记数据上训练，包含214万多人和6128万多人年。

主要发现: SAGA在10年预测范围内将连续排名概率得分降低了31.9%，在20年预测范围内将平均绝对误差降低了37.7%。分层区间在名义覆盖范围内，最坏情况人口子组覆盖误差在2.4个百分点以内。重建的终身收入基尼系数为0.327，而部分观察到的真相为0.341，GKOS估计为0.378。

结论: SAGA模型在预测长期收入分布方面优于传统的参数化过程和基于表格及循环的基线模型，并提供了可靠的预测区间。

翻译: 财政和中央银行使用的微模拟模型依赖于参数化过程来捕捉条件分布的一阶和二阶矩，从而忽略了长程非线性结构。我们提出了SAGA，这是一个用于不规则表格面板序列的解码器仅Transformer，配有一个分层校准包装器，该包装器提供具有有限样本边际覆盖保证的个人层面预测区间。该模型在1990年至2022年的纵向瑞典LISA登记数据上训练，包含214万多人和6128万多人年，预测1至30年后的年度劳动收入，并通过蒙特卡洛方法将其汇总为现值终身收入分布。与标准的Guvenen, Karahan, Ozkan和Song参数化过程以及基于表格和循环的基线模型相比，SAGA在10年预测范围内将连续排名概率得分降低了31.9%，在20年预测范围内将平均绝对误差降低了37.7%。分层区间在名义覆盖范围内，最坏情况人口子组覆盖误差在2.4个百分点以内。重建的终身收入基尼系数为0.327，而部分观察到的真相为0.341，GKOS估计为0.378。已发布模型权重、校准表和合成等效数据集，以便在受保护的SCB MONA环境之外进行复制。

Abstract

Microsimulation models used by ministries of finance and central banks rely on parametric processes for lifetime earnings that capture only first and second moments of the conditional distribution and miss long-range nonlinear structure. We propose SAGA, a decoder-only transformer for irregular tabular panel sequences, paired with a split conformal calibration wrapper that delivers individual-level prediction intervals with finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees. Trained on the longitudinal Swedish LISA register over 1990 to 2022, comprising 2,143,817 individuals and 61,284,903 person-years, the model forecasts annual labor earnings at horizons of one to thirty years and aggregates them by Monte Carlo into present-discounted lifetime earnings distributions. Against the canonical Guvenen, Karahan, Ozkan, and Song parametric process and tabular and recurrent baselines, SAGA reduces continuous ranked probability score by 31.9 percent at the ten-year horizon and mean absolute error by 37.7 percent at the twenty-year horizon. Conformal intervals achieve nominal coverage to within 0.4 percentage points marginally and within 2.4 percentage points on the worst-case demographic subgroup. The reconstructed lifetime earnings Gini coefficient is 0.327 against the partially observed truth of 0.341 and the GKOS estimate of 0.378. Model weights, calibration tables, and a synthetic equivalent dataset are released for replication outside the protected SCB MONA environment.

item.title: Knowing When Not to Predict: Self Supervised Learning and Abstention for Safer DR Screening
item.author: Muskaan Chopra, Lorenz Sparrenberg, Jan H. Terheyden, Rafet Sifa
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了自监督学习（SSL）预训练时长对医疗图像模型校准置信度和基于置信度的放弃预测的影响。

背景: 自监督学习（SSL）已成为医疗图像模型预训练的标准方式，但在安全性关键任务（如糖尿病视网膜病变分级）中，仅依赖下游准确率是不够的。

目的: 考察SSL预训练时长如何影响校准置信度和基于置信度的放弃预测。

方法: 在固定微调协议下评估多个SSL检查点，并评估校准置信度、覆盖率、选择性准确率和选择性宏F1。

主要发现: SSL预训练相比从头训练能提高选择性预测性能；然而，一旦准确率饱和，选择性性能仍可能在不同检查点间显著变化，且更长的预训练并不总能提高可靠性。

结论: 强调了放弃感知评估的重要性，并建议将预训练时长视为一个重要的可靠性相关设计选择，而不仅仅是一个计算细节。

翻译: 自监督学习（SSL）现在是预训练医疗图像模型的标准方式，但性能主要仍由下游准确率来判断。对于糖尿病视网膜病变分级等安全性关键筛查任务，这还不够：模型还必须知道何时其预测不可靠，并将不确定的病例推迟进行临床审查。在这项工作中，我们研究了SSL预训练时长如何影响校准置信度和基于置信度的放弃预测。我们在固定微调协议下评估了多个SSL检查点，并评估了校准置信度、覆盖率、选择性准确率和选择性宏F1。在数据集和数据方案中，SSL预训练相比从头训练提高了选择性预测。与主要评估下游准确率或AUROC的先前SSL研究不同，我们分析了SSL预训练时长如何影响基于校准置信度的放弃预测中的置信度行为。然而，一旦准确率饱和，选择性性能仍可能在不同检查点间显著变化，且更长的预训练并不总能提高可靠性。这些结果强调了放弃感知评估的重要性，并建议将预训练时长视为一个重要的可靠性相关设计选择，而不仅仅是一个计算细节。代码可在GitHub上获取。

Abstract

Self-supervised learning (SSL) is now a standard way to pretrain medical image models, but performance is still mostly judged by downstream accuracy. For safety-critical screening tasks such as diabetic retinopathy grading, this is not enough: a model must also know when its predictions are unreliable and defer uncertain cases for clinical review. In this work, we examine how the length of SSL pretraining influences calibrated confidence and confidence-based abstention. We evaluate multiple SSL checkpoints under a fixed fine-tuning protocol and assess calibrated confidence, coverage, selective accuracy, and selective macro-F1. Across datasets and data regimes, SSL pretraining improves selective prediction compared to training from scratch. Unlike prior SSL studies that primarily evaluate downstream accuracy or AUROC, we analyze how SSL pretraining duration influences confidence behavior under calibrated confidence-based abstention. However, once accuracy saturates, selective performance can still change markedly across checkpoints, and longer pretraining does not consistently improve reliability. These results underscore the importance of abstention-aware evaluation and suggest that pretraining length should be treated as an important reliability-related design choice rather than only a computational detail. Code is available at GitHub.

item.title: Identifiable Multimodal Causal Representation Learning under Partial Latent Sharing
item.author: Manal Benhamza, Marianne Clausel, Myriam Tami
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了多模态观测数据下的因果表示学习问题，旨在通过灵活假设和无参数分布限制，建立因果潜在表示的逐组件可识别性保证。

背景: 因果表示学习旨在从高维观测数据中揭示有意义的潜在变量及其因果结构，其可识别性对于恢复数据生成过程的机制、保证表示的可解释性和鲁棒性至关重要。

目的: 本文解决了一个更具挑战性的设置，即多模态场景，其中观测数据具有潜在的部分共享结构，且每个模态由特定的因果潜在变量子集通过非线性混合函数生成。

方法: 在灵活假设下且不对潜在变量施加任何参数分布限制的情况下，建立了因果潜在表示的逐组件可识别性保证。引入了一个基于Wasserstein的模块来恢复部分共享的潜在结构，该模块因其可微性可轻松集成到各种架构中。

主要发现: 可识别性结果适用于潜在变量少于观测变量的欠定场景。在合成和真实数据集上的广泛实验验证了该方法优于最先进的方法。

结论: 本文提出的方法在多模态因果表示学习中表现出优越性，通过理论分析和实验验证证明了其有效性。

翻译: 本文研究了多模态观测数据下的因果表示学习问题，旨在通过灵活假设和无参数分布限制，建立因果潜在表示的逐组件可识别性保证。

Abstract

Causal representation learning (CRL) seeks to uncover meaningful latent variables and their corresponding causal structure from high-dimensional observational data. Although its significance, CRL identifiability remains a crucial property, as it ensures the recovery of the mechanisms behind the data generation process, and hence the interpretability and robustness of the representation. Proving identifiability in CRL is intrinsically difficult, and we address in this work an even more challenging setting: multimodality. We consider multimodal observed data with a latent partially shared structure. Each modality is generated, through non linear mixing functions, from a specific subset of causal latent variables. Under flexible assumptions and without imposing any parametric distribution on the latent variables, we establish component-wise identifiability guarantees for the causal latent representation. Our identifiability results, furthermore, apply to the undercomplete scenario where we have, for each modality, more observed than latent variables. To instantiate our theoretical analysis, we introduce a Wasserstein-based module to recover the partially shared latent structure. Due to its differentiability, the latter can be easily integrated into all types of architecture, only requiring minimal changes. Extensive experiments on synthetic and realistic datasets validate the superiority of our approach over SOTA methods.

item.title: Towards Data-Efficient Video Pre-training with Frozen Image Foundation Models
item.author: Svetlana Orlova, Niccolò Cavagnero, Gijs Dubbelman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了利用预训练的图像基础模型构建轻量级视频模型的可能性，通过冻结图像模型并仅训练时间推理模块来处理流式视频。

背景: 现有的视频基础模型通常需要在大规模视频数据集上进行预训练，导致数据量和计算成本高昂；而现代图像基础模型已提供强大的空间表示。

目的: 探索一种轻量级训练范式，即复用图像基础模型的空间表示，仅通过预训练时间推理模块来构建视频模型，从而减少对大规模视频预训练的需求。

方法: 冻结一个预训练的图像基础模型，并训练一个循环时间模块来处理流式视频，利用图像模型作为空间编码器。

主要发现: 在多个视频理解任务中，无需大规模视频预训练即可获得强大的时间性能，证明了该方法的可行性。

结论: 该研究为未来通过在冻结的图像基础模型上预训练时间模块来构建循环视频基础模型提供了动力和依据。

翻译: Video foundation models achieve strong performance across many video understanding tasks, but typically require large-scale pre-training on massive video datasets, resulting in substantial data and compute costs. In contrast, modern image foundation models already provide powerful spatial representations. This raises an important question: can competitive video models be built by reusing these spatial representations and pre-training only for temporal reasoning? We take initial steps toward exploring a lightweight training paradigm that freezes a pre-trained image foundation model and trains only a recurrent temporal module to process streaming video. By reusing an image foundation model as a spatial encoder, this approach could significantly reduce the amount of video data and compute required compared to end-to-end video pre-training. In this work, we explore the feasibility of this approach before investing in computing for video pre-training. Our empirical findings across multiple video understanding tasks suggest that strong temporal performance can emerge without large-scale video pre-training, motivating future work on recurrent video foundation models obtained by pre-training a temporal module on top of a frozen image foundation model. Code: https://github.com/tue-mps/towards-video-image-frozen .

Abstract

Video foundation models achieve strong performance across many video understanding tasks, but typically require large-scale pre-training on massive video datasets, resulting in substantial data and compute costs. In contrast, modern image foundation models already provide powerful spatial representations. This raises an important question: can competitive video models be built by reusing these spatial representations and pre-training only for temporal reasoning? We take initial steps toward exploring a lightweight training paradigm that freezes a pre-trained image foundation model and trains only a recurrent temporal module to process streaming video. By reusing an image foundation model as a spatial encoder, this approach could significantly reduce the amount of video data and compute required compared to end-to-end video pre-training. In this work, we explore the feasibility of this approach before investing in computing for video pre-training. Our empirical findings across multiple video understanding tasks suggest that strong temporal performance can emerge without large-scale video pre-training, motivating future work on recurrent video foundation models obtained by pre-training a temporal module on top of a frozen image foundation model. Code: https://github.com/tue-mps/towards-video-image-frozen .

item.title: Efficient coding along the visual hierarchy
item.author: Ananya Passi, Brian S. Robinson, Michael F. Bonner
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了生物视觉系统如何从有限经验中学习，并测试了高效编码理论是否能从有限数据中构建符合人类视觉特征层次结构。

背景: 生物视觉系统能从有限经验中学习，而深度学习模型通常依赖大量训练图像。

目的: 测试高效编码理论是否能从有限数据中构建符合人类视觉特征层次结构。

方法: 开发了一种无监督学习程序，该程序利用局部统计特性，不使用标签、任务或反向传播，将深度网络的每一层输入压缩到自然图像中的主导变化模式上。

主要发现: 该无监督程序产生的特征从边缘和颜色发展到纹理和形状；这些特征容易被人类观察者识别，并能预测人类视觉皮层中由图像诱发的fMRI反应；结合高效编码与监督微调的混合学习程序在低数据设置下能产生更好的大脑对齐和更快的类别学习。

结论: 高效编码可能塑造整个视觉层次中的表示，并有助于解释生物视觉的数据效率。

翻译: 摘要：生物视觉系统从有限经验中学习，这与依赖数百万训练图像的深度学习模型不同。是什么学习原理使其成为可能？我们测试了高效编码——即神经表征捕获自然输入统计结构的想法——是否能从有限数据中构建符合人类视觉特征层次结构。我们开发了一种无监督学习程序，其中深度网络的每一层利用仅局部统计特性，不使用标签、任务或反向传播，将其输入压缩到自然图像中的主导变化模式上。这种无监督程序产生的特征从边缘和颜色发展到纹理和形状。这种深度高效编码模型的特征很容易被人类观察者识别，并且能预测人类视觉皮层中由图像诱发的fMRI反应。此外，结合高效编码与监督微调的混合学习程序在低数据设置下能产生更好的大脑对齐和更快的类别学习。这些发现表明，高效编码可能塑造整个视觉层次中的表示，并有助于解释生物视觉的数据效率。

Abstract

Biological visual systems learn from limited experience, unlike deep learning models that rely on millions of training images. What learning principles make this possible? We tested whether efficient coding, the idea that neural representations capture the statistical structure of natural inputs, can build a hierarchy of human-aligned visual features from limited data. We developed an unsupervised learning procedure in which each layer of a deep network compresses its inputs onto the dominant modes of variation in natural images, using only local statistics and no labels, tasks, or backpropagation. This unsupervised procedure yields features that progress from edges and colors to textures and shapes. The features of this deep efficient coding model are readily recognized by human observers and are predictive of image-evoked fMRI responses in human visual cortex. Furthermore, a hybrid learning procedure that combines efficient coding with supervised fine-tuning yields better brain alignment in low-data settings and more rapid category learning. These findings suggest that efficient coding may shape representations across the entire visual hierarchy and help explain the data efficiency of biological vision.

item.title: Open-source segmentation and biometry dataset using spectrally-multiplexed whole-eye optical coherence tomography
item.author: Ruobing Qian, Catherine Fromm, Pushkar Anand, Kyle Johnson, Zach Willms, Yimin Ding, Weihan Zhang, Ali Behrooz, Mohamed El-Haddad
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Whole-eye optical coherence tomography (WEOCT) 是一种能够同时捕捉人眼前部和后部的成像技术，本文介绍了一种新的光谱复用 WEOCT 系统，通过深度学习处理和开源数据集发布，旨在解决现有系统在信噪比、成像速度和动态过程捕捉方面的局限性，并提供了高精度的眼部测量和三维重建能力。

背景: 现有的 WEOCT 系统在信噪比、成像速度和捕捉动态过程方面存在权衡，且缺乏标注的前段数据限制了相关领域的研究。

目的: 开发一种新的光谱复用 WEOCT 系统，解决现有系统的局限性，实现解剖学上准确的眼部层三维重建，并填补标注前段数据的空白。

方法: 利用两个同步的 200 kHz 扫频源（1310 nm 和 1060 nm），结合深度学习表面分割、3D 畸变校正、表面拟合和光线追踪折射校正的自动化端到端处理管道。

主要发现: 通过 300+ 参与者的用户研究和综合模体研究，系统可以同时提供角膜地形图和 3D 瞳孔中心的准确测量。

结论: 该系统实现了解剖学上准确的眼部层三维重建，并作为开源发布了包含 6,621 个处理体积的全面数据集，以促进相关领域的研究。

翻译: Whole-eye optical coherence tomography (WEOCT) 已成为一种变革性的成像方式，能够同时捕捉人眼的前部和后部。WEOCT 能够进行全面的眼前节测量，这对广泛的临床和研究应用至关重要——从人工晶状体度数计算、近视进展监测、屈光手术规划，到视觉和光学轴线的精确测量，以及为虚拟、增强和混合现实 (VR/AR/MR) 中的眼动追踪生成个性化眼模型。然而，现有的 WEOCT 系统通常在信噪比、成像速度和捕捉动态过程且无运动伪影的能力之间面临权衡。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新的光谱复用 WEOCT 系统，利用两个同步的 200 kHz 扫频源（1310 nm 和 1060 nm）。结合涉及基于深度学习的表面分割、3D 畸变校正、表面拟合和光线追踪折射校正的自动化端到端处理管道，我们的系统能够实现分层眼部解剖结构的准确 3D 重建。通过 300 多名参与者的用户研究和综合模体研究，我们证明了我们的系统可以同时提供角膜地形图和 3D 瞳孔中心的准确测量。虽然标注的视网膜 OCT 数据在开源存储库中丰富，但标注的 B 扫描或体积前段数据仍然显著有限。因此，相关领域的研究小组通常必须使用定制的成像系统来获取自己的数据。为了帮助弥合这一差距，我们作为开源发布了一个全面的数据集，包含来自 276 名独特参与者的 6,621 个处理体积，以及相应的分割和校准的 3D 前段点云。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决全眼光学相干断层扫描图像分割和生物测量缺乏开源数据集的问题。文中未明确说明该问题的重要性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

Abstract

Whole-eye optical coherence tomography (WEOCT) has emerged as a transformative imaging modality capable of simultaneously capturing the anterior and posterior segments of the human eye. WEOCT enables comprehensive ocular biometry, which is critical for a wide range of clinical and research applications-from intraocular lens power calculation, myopia progression monitoring, and refractive surgery planning to the precise measurement of the visual and optical axes and the generation of personalized eye models for eye tracking in virtual, augmented and mixed reality(VR/AR/MR). However, existing WEOCT systems often face trade-offs between signal-to-noise ratio, imaging speed, and the ability to capture dynamic processes without motion artifacts. To address these limitations, we present a novel spectrally-multiplexed WEOCT system that utilizes two synchronized 200 kHz swept sources at 1310 nm and 1060 nm. Coupled with an automated end-to-end processing pipeline involving deep learning-based surface segmentation, 3D distortion correction, surface fitting and ray-tracing refraction correction, our system enables anatomically accurate 3D reconstruction of the segmented ocular layers. Through a 300+ participant user study and comprehensive phantom studies, we demonstrate that our system can provide simultaneous accurate measurements of cornea topography and 3D pupil center. While labeled retinal OCT data is abundantly available in open-source repositories, labeled B-scan or volumetric anterior segment data remains significantly limited. Consequently, research groups working in related domains must often acquire their own data using custom imaging systems. To help bridge this gap, we are releasing as open-source a comprehensive dataset comprising 6,621 processed volumes from 276 unique participants with corresponding segmentation and calibrated 3D anterior point clouds.

item.title: Spatially Accelerated Winding Numbers for Curved Geometry
item.author: Jacob Spainhour, Brad Whitlock, Kenneth Weiss
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种针对任意 NURBS 曲线和修剪 NURBS 曲面的快速广义环绕数评估方法，通过边界体积层次结构实现亚线性复杂度。

背景: 广义环绕数是一种标量场，支持对弯曲几何体进行鲁棒性包含查询，包括非水密、重叠和嵌套边界表示。虽然查询可以轻松并行化，但在参数曲线和曲面上直接评估大型复杂模型成本高昂。

目的: 扩展对任意 NURBS 曲线在 2D 和修剪 NURBS 曲面在 3D 中的快速 GWN 评估支持，同时避免离散输入方法在边界附近引入的包含误差。

方法: 使用边界体积层次结构存储预计算矩数据，结合自适应细分策略进行预处理，在查询时对远簇使用近似，对近处 NURBS 原语使用直接评估。

主要发现: 该方法在保持查询点附近几何特征的同时实现了亚线性复杂度，通过自适应细分策略在预处理阶段创建更好的空间分区。

结论: 该方法在大量 2D 和 3D 数据集上展示了性能和准确性。

翻译: The generalized winding number (GWN) is a scalar field that supports robust containment queries on curved geometry, including non-watertight, overlapping, and nested boundary representations. While queries can be easily parallelized over samples, direct evaluation on parametric curves and surfaces remains costly for large and complex models. Fast, state-of-the-art GWN approaches leverage a spatial index to approximate the GWN, typically coupled with a Taylor expansion which approximates the GWN contribution for far clusters of geometric primitives. However, such methods operate only on discrete inputs such as triangle meshes and point clouds, and would introduce containment errors near boundaries if applied to curved input. We extend support for fast GWN evaluation over arbitrary collections of NURBS curves in 2D and trimmed NURBS patches in 3D via a Bounding Volume Hierarchy that stores efficiently precomputed moment data in the hierarchy nodes. When querying the hierarchy, approximations for far clusters are used alongside direct evaluation for nearby NURBS primitives, achieving sub-linear complexity while preserving the geometric features in the vicinity of the query point. Central to our performance improvements is an adaptive subdivision strategy for NURBS primitives during a preprocessing phase, creating better spatial partitions while retaining the same accuracy for containment decisions as a direct evaluation. We demonstrate the performance and accuracy of our approach across a large collection of 2D and 3D datasets.

Abstract

The generalized winding number (GWN) is a scalar field that supports robust containment queries on curved geometry, including non-watertight, overlapping, and nested boundary representations. While queries can be easily parallelized over samples, direct evaluation on parametric curves and surfaces remains costly for large and complex models. Fast, state-of-the-art GWN approaches leverage a spatial index to approximate the GWN, typically coupled with a Taylor expansion which approximates the GWN contribution for far clusters of geometric primitives. However, such methods operate only on discrete inputs such as triangle meshes and point clouds, and would introduce containment errors near boundaries if applied to curved input. We extend support for fast GWN evaluation over arbitrary collections of NURBS curves in 2D and trimmed NURBS patches in 3D via a Bounding Volume Hierarchy that stores efficiently precomputed moment data in the hierarchy nodes. When querying the hierarchy, approximations for far clusters are used alongside direct evaluation for nearby NURBS primitives, achieving sub-linear complexity while preserving the geometric features in the vicinity of the query point. Central to our performance improvements is an adaptive subdivision strategy for NURBS primitives during a preprocessing phase, creating better spatial partitions while retaining the same accuracy for containment decisions as a direct evaluation. We demonstrate the performance and accuracy of our approach across a large collection of 2D and 3D datasets.

item.title: Quantized Machine Learning Models for Medical Imaging in Low-Resource Healthcare Settings
item.author: Sumanth Meenan Kanneti, Aryan Shah
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种多策略压缩框架，用于在资源受限的临床环境中对脑肿瘤MRI图像进行分类。

背景: 深度学习模型在医学图像分析中表现出色，但在低资源临床环境中部署面临计算、内存和功耗限制。

目的: 构建一个多策略压缩框架，以实现脑肿瘤分类的轻量化部署。

方法: 框架包含量化感知训练、从DenseNet-101教师模型向紧凑型DenseNet-32学生模型的蒸馏，以及针对轻量级MobileNetV2骨干网络的低比特后训练量化和Float16后训练量化。

主要发现: 基于MobileNetV2的量化模型在验证集上达到82.37%的准确率，相比全精度基线82.20%无明显精度损失；模型大小从35.34 MB减少至5.76 MB，压缩比为6.14倍；各类肿瘤的诊断性能均得到保持。

结论: 轻量级量化模型能够在资源受限的医疗环境中提供临床可行的脑肿瘤筛查服务。

翻译: 摘要：深度学习模型在医学图像分析中表现出色，但在低资源临床环境中部署仍面临计算、内存和功耗限制。本文提出了一种用于脑肿瘤MRI分类的多策略压缩框架，包括量化感知训练、从DenseNet-101教师模型向紧凑型DenseNet-32学生模型的蒸馏，以及针对轻量级MobileNetV2骨干网络的低比特后训练量化和Float16后训练量化。使用包含胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体肿瘤和健康对照的多类脑肿瘤MRI数据集，我们提供了基于MobileNetV2管道的完整实验验证，通过三阶段迁移学习过程训练分类器，并利用TensorFlow Lite应用Float16量化。DenseNet基础的蒸馏和量化感知训练策略被描述为框架内的互补压缩方法，其完整的实证评估留待未来工作。基于MobileNetV2管道的实验结果显示，量化模型相比全精度基线82.20%实现了82.37%的验证准确率，模型大小从35.34 MB减少至5.76 MB，压缩比为6.14倍，且无明显精度损失。逐类评估证实量化在所有四种肿瘤类别中均保持了诊断性能。这些发现表明，轻量级量化模型能够在资源受限的医疗环境中提供临床可行的脑肿瘤筛查。

Abstract

Deep learning models have shown strong performance in medical image analysis, but deploying them in low-resource clinical environments remains difficult due to computational, memory, and power constraints. This paper presents a multi-strategy compression framework for brain tumor classification from MRI, encompassing quantization-aware training, knowledge distillation from a DenseNet-101 teacher to a compact DenseNet-32 student with low-bit post-training quantization, and Float16 post-training quantization on a lightweight MobileNetV2 backbone. Using a multi-class brain tumor MRI dataset containing glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumors, and healthy controls, we provide full experimental validation of the MobileNetV2-based pipeline, training the classifier through a three-stage transfer learning process and applying Float16 quantization via TensorFlow Lite. The DenseNet-based distillation and quantization-aware training strategies are described as complementary compression approaches within the framework, with their complete empirical evaluation reserved for future work. Experimental results on the MobileNetV2 pipeline show that the quantized model achieves 82.37 percent validation accuracy compared to the 82.20 percent full-precision baseline, reducing model size from 35.34 MB to 5.76 MB, a 6.14x compression ratio with no meaningful accuracy loss. Per-class evaluation confirms that quantization preserves diagnostic performance uniformly across all four tumor categories. These findings demonstrate that lightweight quantized models can deliver clinically viable brain tumor screening in resource-constrained healthcare settings.

item.title: HAVEN: Hierarchically Aligned Multimodal Benchmark for Unified Video Understanding
item.author: Mengqi Shi, Haopeng Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了HAVEN，这是一个用于统一视频理解的分层对齐多模态基准。

背景: 现有的多模态大模型在标准视频任务上表现良好，但在忠实总结和推理复杂叙事方面评估不足。现有总结基准在监督信号上存在碎片化问题，未能捕捉跨模态对齐的内在层级结构。

目的: 为了解决跨模态对齐的层级结构评估不足的问题，作者引入了HAVEN，这是一个分层对齐的多模态基准。

方法: HAVEN采用完全细粒度（帧、镜头、视频）和完全多模态（视频和文本）的数据集架构，包含模态之间明确的、连续的对齐。基于此统一标注范式，作者提出了一套全面的评估套件，涵盖总结、时间推理、多模态定位和显著性排名。

主要发现: 对最先进的多模态大模型进行的广泛基准测试暴露了表面级文本流畅性与 grounded 多模态理解之间的持续差距。

结论: HAVEN超越了传统的问答格式，推动了可解释的、分层的视频理解研究的发展。作者公开发布了数据集、基准套件和评估协议。

翻译: 虽然多模态大模型（MLLMs）在标准视频任务上表现出强大的性能，但它们在忠实总结和推理复杂叙事方面的能力仍被评估不足。现有的总结基准在监督信号上跨越了孤立的粒度，如关键帧、关键镜头或脱节的文本总结，未能捕捉跨模态对齐的内在层级结构。为了解决这一关键差距，我们介绍了HAVEN，这是一个用于统一视频理解的分层对齐多模态基准。HAVEN开创了完全细粒度（帧、镜头和视频）和完全多模态（视频和文本）的数据集架构，包含模态之间明确的、连续的对齐。基于这种统一的标注范式，我们提出了一套全面的评估套件，涵盖总结、时间推理、多模态定位和显著性排名。对最先进的多模态大模型进行的广泛基准测试暴露了表面级文本流畅性与 grounded 多模态理解之间的持续差距。最终，HAVEN推进了对多模态系统的评估，超越了传统的问答格式，提供了一个严格的、标准化的测试平台，以推动未来在可解释的、分层的视频理解方面的研究。我们公开发布了数据集、基准套件和评估协议。

Abstract

While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong performance on standard video tasks, their ability to faithfully summarize and reason over complex narratives remains poorly evaluated. Existing summarization benchmarks fragment supervision across isolated granularities, such as keyframes, key shots, or disjointed text summaries, failing to capture the inherently hierarchical structure of cross-modal alignment. To address this critical gap, we introduce HAVEN, a hierarchically aligned multimodal benchmark for unified video understanding. HAVEN pioneers a fully granular (frame, shot, and video levels) and fully multimodal (video and text) dataset architecture, complete with explicit, continuous alignment between modalities. Built upon this unified annotation paradigm, we propose a comprehensive evaluation suite spanning summarization, temporal reasoning, multimodal grounding, and saliency ranking. Extensive benchmarking of state-of-the-art MLLMs exposes a persistent gap between surface-level textual fluency and grounded multimodal understanding. Ultimately, HAVEN advances the evaluation of multimodal systems beyond traditional QA formats, offering a rigorous, standardized testbed to drive future research in interpretable, hierarchical video understanding. We publicly release the dataset, benchmark suite, and evaluation protocols.

item.title: FPED: A Functional-Network Prior-Guided Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Interpretable Brain Decoding
item.author: Yudan Ren, Pengcheng Shi, Zihan Ma, Xiaowei He, Xiao Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为FPED的功能网络先验引导混合专家框架，用于可解释的大脑解码。

背景: 现有的视觉图像重建方法通常将局部视觉皮层的fMRI信号简单展平为一维向量，直接映射到CLIP等潜在空间。这种范式不仅破坏了大脑固有的网络拓扑结构，导致神经科学解释性有限，而且忽略了其他分布式功能网络在处理高级视觉语义时的协同贡献。

目的: 为了解决上述局限性，该研究旨在提出一种可解释的大脑解码框架，明确建模不同的功能脑网络为专门的专家，并利用自适应路由来捕捉它们对视觉语义理解的互补贡献。

方法: FPED框架明确将不同的功能脑网络建模为专门的专家，并采用自适应路由机制。与传统的同质解码范式不同，该框架结合了基于神经生物学先验的知识，以实现结构化和可解释的网络级表示学习。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，FPED仅使用0.68B参数就实现了高度竞争的语义重建性能。学习到的路由动力学揭示了功能脑网络与模态特定语义处理之间具有生物学意义的对应关系。

结论: 该研究认为，大脑网络感知的专家建模是连接神经解码和受生物学启发的先进人工智能的可行方向。

翻译: 该研究提出了一种名为FPED的功能网络先验引导混合专家框架，用于可解释的大脑解码。现有的视觉图像重建方法通常将局部视觉皮层的fMRI信号简单展平为一维向量，直接映射到CLIP等潜在空间。这种范式不仅破坏了大脑固有的网络拓扑结构，导致神经科学解释性有限，而且忽略了其他分布式功能网络在处理高级视觉语义时的协同贡献。为了解决上述局限性，该研究旨在提出一种可解释的大脑解码框架，明确建模不同的功能脑网络为专门的专家，并利用自适应路由来捕捉它们对视觉语义理解的互补贡献。FPED框架明确将不同的功能脑网络建模为专门的专家，并采用自适应路由机制。与传统的同质解码范式不同，该框架结合了基于神经生物学先验的知识，以实现结构化和可解释的网络级表示学习。实验结果表明，FPED仅使用0.68B参数就实现了高度竞争的语义重建性能。学习到的路由动力学揭示了功能脑网络与模态特定语义处理之间具有生物学意义的对应关系。该研究认为，大脑网络感知的专家建模是连接神经解码和受生物学启发的先进人工智能的可行方向。

Abstract

Visual image reconstruction from functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) is a fundamental task in brain decoding, providing a crucial pathway for understanding human perceptual mechanisms and developing advanced brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). However, most current methods simply flatten fMRI signals from localized visual cortices into one-dimensional (1D) vectors, mapping them directly into latent spaces such as that of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP). This paradigm not only disrupts the inherent network topology of the brain-leading to limited neuroscientific interpretability-but also overlooks the synergistic contributions of other distributed functional networks in processing high-level visual semantics. To address these limitations, we propose FPED, a Functional-Network Prior-Guided Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework for interpretable brain decoding. FPED explicitly models different functional brain networks as specialized experts and employs adaptive routing to capture their complementary contributions to visual semantic understanding. Unlike conventional homogeneous decoding paradigms, our framework incorporates neurobiologically grounded priors to enable structured and interpretable network-level representation learning. Experimental results demonstrate that FPED achieves highly competitive semantic reconstruction performance with only 0.68B parameters. The learned routing dynamics reveal biologically meaningful correspondence between functional brain networks and modality-specific semantic processing, providing transparent neuroscientific interpretability. This suggests that brain network-aware expert modeling is a promising direction for bridging neural decoding and biologically inspired artificial intelligence.

item.title: Factor Augmented High-Dimensional SGD
item.author: Shubo Li, Yuefeng Han, Xiufan Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为因子增强随机梯度下降（FSGD）的新优化方法，该方法利用潜在因子表示来处理高维学习任务，能够在流数据上运行，无需离线表示学习和全数据存储，并建立了包含潜在因子估计误差的理论框架，证明了在衰减步长和小批量更新下的矩收敛性。

背景: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是现代机器学习中广泛使用的基础优化算法。

目的: 提出因子增强随机梯度下降（FSGD）方法，以解决高维学习任务中的可扩展性问题，并建立包含潜在因子估计误差的理论分析框架。

方法: FSGD利用潜在因子表示，在流数据上纯运行，无需离线表示学习和全数据存储，并采用衰减步长和小批量更新。

主要发现: 建立了第一个明确将潜在因子估计误差纳入SGD分析的理论框架，并在$extbackslash ell^s$范数下证明了矩收敛性。

结论: 为在高维机器学习系统中可靠且可扩展地使用SGD提供了新的基础。

翻译: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是一种广泛用于现代机器学习的基础优化算法。在本文中，我们提出了因子增强随机梯度下降（FSGD），这是一种利用高维学习任务中潜在因子表示的新优化方法。与依赖离线表示学习和全数据存储的标准两阶段降维方法不同，FSGD的一个关键新颖性在于它在纯流数据上运行，使其能够扩展到大规模和高维问题。此外，我们建立了第一个明确将潜在因子估计误差纳入SGD分析的理论框架，并在衰减步长和小批量更新下提供了$extbackslash ell^s$范数下的矩收敛性。我们的结果为在高维机器学习系统中可靠且可扩展地使用SGD提供了新的基础。

Abstract

Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is a fundamental optimization algorithm widely used in modern machine learning. In this paper, we propose Factor-Augmented SGD (FSGD), a new optimization method that leverages latent factor representations in high-dimensional learning tasks. Unlike standard two-stage dimension reduction approaches that rely on offline representation learning and full data storage, a key novelty of FSGD is that it operates purely on streaming data, making it scalable to large-scale and high-dimensional problems. Furthermore, we establish the first theoretical framework that explicitly incorporates latent factor estimation error into the analysis of SGD, and provide moment convergence in $\ell^s$ norm under decaying step sizes and mini-batch updates. Our results provide a new foundation for employing SGD reliably and scalably in high-dimensional machine learning systems.

item.title: DynaTok: Temporally Adaptive and Positional Bias-Aware Token Compression for Video-LLMs
item.author: Minyoung Park, Taehun Kong, Sangjun Ahn
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DynaTok是一个训练无关的、时间自适应且具有偏差感知的令牌压缩框架，旨在解决视频大语言模型中视觉令牌数量过多的问题。

背景: 视频大语言模型扩展了多模态推理能力，但提取长视频序列中的大量视觉令牌导致计算成本高昂，限制了其在现实场景中的部署。

目的: 提出一种训练无关的、时间自适应且具有偏差感知的令牌压缩框架，以分配令牌预算，提高效率并保留语义覆盖。

方法: 通过时间预算分配模块和空间预算分配模块，利用轻量级指数移动平均记忆，动态分配令牌，选择时空多样化的特征。

主要发现: 在四个代表性视频问答基准测试中，DynaTok在减少90%令牌的情况下仍能保留超过95%的基线准确率，优于最近的训练无关方法。

结论: DynaTok为高效和鲁棒的视频推理提供了原则性基础，为未来视频大语言模型实现实时流媒体视频理解铺平了道路。

翻译: 视频大语言模型的最新进展极大地扩展了多模态推理能力。然而，从长视频序列中提取的大量视觉令牌产生了高昂的计算成本，限制了其在现实场景中的部署。现有的无训练令牌压缩方法根据注意力幅度选择令牌作为语义重要性的代理，但往往忽略了位置偏差并仅依赖短期时间局部性，导致冗余的时空覆盖和低效的令牌使用。我们提出了DynaTok，一个训练无关的、时间自适应且具有偏差感知的令牌压缩框架，在时间和空间维度上分配令牌预算。通过轻量级指数移动平均记忆，时间预算分配模块动态地为冗余帧分配较少令牌，为新颖帧分配更多令牌，捕捉长期时间变化。空间预算分配模块通过使用基于激活的注意力图选择空间多样且语义重要的特征来补充这一点，同时利用空间记忆减少先前选定区域的冗余并减轻位置偏差。DynaTok与现有的视频大语言模型如LLaVA-OneVision和LLaVA-Video无缝集成且无需重新训练，并在激进的压缩下有效保留语义覆盖。在四个代表性视频问答基准测试——MVBench、LongVideoBench、MLVU和VideoMME上的实验表明，DynaTok即使在减少90%令牌的情况下仍能保留超过95%的基线准确率，超过了最近的训练无关方法。这些结果表明，DynaTok为高效和鲁棒的视频推理提供了原则性基础，为未来视频大语言模型实现实时流媒体视频理解铺平了道路。

Abstract

Recent advances in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have greatly expanded multimodal reasoning capabilities. However, the massive number of visual tokens extracted from long video sequences incurs prohibitive computational costs, limiting their deployment in real-world scenarios. Existing training-free token compression methods select tokens based on attention magnitude as a proxy for semantic importance, but often overlook positional bias and rely only on short-term temporal locality, leading to redundant spatio-temporal coverage and inefficient token usage. We present DynaTok, a training-free, temporally adaptive and bias-aware token compression framework that allocates token budgets across both temporal and spatial dimensions. Through a lightweight exponential moving average (EMA) memory, the Temporal Budget Allocation (TBA) module dynamically assigns fewer tokens to redundant frames and more to novel frames, capturing long-term temporal variation. The Spatial Budget Allocation (SBA) module complements this by selecting spatially diverse and semantically important features using activation-based attention maps, while leveraging a spatial memory to reduce redundancy from previously selected regions and mitigate positional bias. DynaTok integrates seamlessly with existing Video-LLMs such as LLaVA-OneVision and LLaVA-Video without retraining, and effectively preserves semantic coverage under aggressive compression. Experiments on four representative VideoQA benchmarks-MVBench, LongVideoBench, MLVU, and VideoMME-show that DynaTok retains over 95% of baseline accuracy even with a 90% token reduction, surpassing recent training-free approaches. These results demonstrate that DynaTok provides a principled foundation for efficient and robust video reasoning, paving the way toward real-time streaming video understanding with future Video-LLMs.

item.title: RE-VLM: Event-Augmented Vision-Language Model for Scene Understanding
item.author: Hanqing Liu, Mingjie Liu, Luoping Cui, Endian Lin, Donghong Jiang, Chuang Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为RE-VLM的双流视觉语言模型，通过结合RGB图像和事件流来提高在恶劣条件下的场景理解能力。

背景: 传统视觉语言模型在低光照、高动态范围或快速运动等恶劣条件下表现不佳，因为标准RGB图像在这些环境中会退化。

目的: 开发RE-VLM，一种首个结合RGB图像和事件流的双流视觉语言模型，以实现跨正常和挑战性条件的鲁棒场景理解。

方法: RE-VLM采用并行RGB和事件编码器，配合渐进式训练策略以对齐异构视觉特征与语言。此外，提出了一种图驱动管道，将同步的RGB-Event流转换为可验证的场景图，从中合成描述和问答对。

主要发现: 在描述和视觉问答基准测试中，RE-VLM在参数数量相当的情况下，始终优于现有的仅RGB和仅事件模型，特别是在挑战性条件下表现显著提升。

结论: 结果表明，事件增强的视觉语言模型在广泛的现实世界环境中实现了鲁棒的视觉语言理解。

翻译: 提出了一种名为RE-VLM的双流视觉语言模型，通过结合RGB图像和事件流来提高在恶劣条件下的场景理解能力。传统视觉语言模型在低光照、高动态范围或快速运动等恶劣条件下表现不佳，因为标准RGB图像在这些环境中会退化。开发RE-VLM，一种首个结合RGB图像和事件流的双流视觉语言模型，以实现跨正常和挑战性条件的鲁棒场景理解。RE-VLM采用并行RGB和事件编码器，配合渐进式训练策略以对齐异构视觉特征与语言。此外，提出了一种图驱动管道，将同步的RGB-Event流转换为可验证的场景图，从中合成描述和问答对。在描述和视觉问答基准测试中，RE-VLM在参数数量相当的情况下，始终优于现有的仅RGB和仅事件模型，特别是在挑战性条件下表现显著提升。结果表明，事件增强的视觉语言模型在广泛的现实世界环境中实现了鲁棒的视觉语言理解。

深度解读

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Conventional vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to interpret scenes captured under adverse conditions (e.g., low light, high dynamic range, or fast motion) because standard RGB images degrade in such environments. Event cameras provide a complementary modality: they asynchronously record per-pixel brightness changes with high temporal resolution and wide dynamic range, preserving motion cues where frames fail. We propose RE-VLM, the first dual-stream vision-language model that jointly leverages RGB images and event streams for robust scene understanding across both normal and challenging conditions. RE-VLM employs parallel RGB and event encoders together with a progressive training strategy that aligns heterogeneous visual features with language. To address the scarcity of RGB-Event-Text supervision, we further propose a graph-driven pipeline that converts synchronized RGB-Event streams into verifiable scene graphs, from which we synthesize captions and question-answer (QA) pairs. To develop and evaluate RE-VLM, we construct two datasets: PEOD-Chat, targeting illumination-challenged scenes, and RGBE-Chat, covering diverse scenarios. On captioning and VQA benchmarks, RE-VLM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art RGB-only and event-only models with comparable parameter counts, with particularly large gains under challenging conditions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of event-augmented VLMs in achieving robust vision-language understanding across a wide range of real-world environments. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/bupt-ai-cz/RE-VLM.

item.title: What Makes a Representation Good for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction?
item.author: Wenkang Jiang, Yuhang Liu, Yichao Cai, Erdun Gao, Jiayi Dong, Ehsan Abbasnejad, Lina Yao, Javen Qinfeng Shi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 PerturbedVAE 的框架，旨在解决单细胞扰动建模中基因表达信号不平衡的问题，通过分离扰动特异性信息和不变结构来提高预测性能。

背景: 现有的单细胞扰动建模方法在处理基因表达数据时面临挑战，因为基因表达主要包含扰动不变信息，而扰动特异性信号本质上是稀疏的。

目的: 为了解决现有方法中信号不平衡的问题，提出 PerturbedVAE 框架，以明确分离扰动特异性信息与不变结构，并恢复因果表示。

方法: PerturbedVAE 是一个通用框架，旨在解决信号不平衡问题。它明确分离了扰动特异性信息与主导的不变结构，并恢复因果表示以有效利用此类信息进行预测。此外，还提供了可识别性分析，以确定稀疏扰动效应能够被可靠恢复的条件。

主要发现: 在多个评估设置下的广泛使用的基准测试中，PerturbedVAE 实现了最先进的性能。它在分布外组合预测上取得了显著增益，并揭示了可解释的扰动反应程序。

结论: PerturbedVAE 框架能够有效分离信号，在预测任务上表现出色，特别是在处理分布外数据和揭示可解释的生物学反应程序方面具有优势。

翻译: 单细胞扰动建模对于理解和预测细胞对遗传扰动的反应至关重要。然而，现有的方法，从因果表示学习到基础模型，往往难以应对一个被忽视的挑战：基因表达主要由扰动不变信息主导，而扰动特异性信号本质上是稀疏的。因此，学习到的表示要么纠缠了不变信息和扰动特异性信息，导致虚假且不可泛化的预测器，要么完全抑制了扰动特异性信号，使其对预测无效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 PerturbedVAE，这是一个旨在解决这种信号不平衡问题的通用框架。该框架明确地将扰动特异性信息与主导的不变结构分离，并恢复因果表示以有效利用此类信息进行预测。我们进一步提供了可识别性分析，描述了稀疏扰动效应能够被可靠恢复的条件，从而阐明了框架在何种条件下可以具体指定。在实践中，PerturbedVAE 在多个评估设置下的广泛使用的基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，在分布外组合预测上取得了显著增益，并揭示了可解释的扰动反应程序。

Abstract

Single-cell perturbation modeling is fundamental for understanding and predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations. However, existing approaches, from causal representation learning to foundation models, often struggle with an overlooked challenge: gene expression is dominated by perturbation-invariant information, while perturbation-specific signals are intrinsically sparse. As a result, learned representations either entangle invariant and perturbation-specific information, leading to spurious and non-generalizable predictors, or suppress perturbation-specific signals altogether, rendering them ineffective for prediction. To address this, we propose PerturbedVAE, a general framework designed to resolve this signal imbalance. The framework explicitly separates perturbation-specific information from dominant invariant structure and recovers causal representations to effectively utilize such information for prediction. We further provide an identifiability analysis that characterizes the conditions under which sparse perturbation effects can be reliably recovered, thereby clarifying how the framework can be concretely specified under such conditions. Empirically, PerturbedVAE achieves state-of-the-art performance on a widely used benchmark across multiple evaluation settings, yielding significant gains on out-of-distribution combinatorial predictions and uncovering interpretable perturbation-response programs.

item.title: MAM-CLIP: Vision-Language Pretraining on Mammography Atlases for BI-RADS Classification
item.author: Halil Ibrahim Gulluk, Olivier Gevaert
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于多模态模型的BI-RADS评分预测方法，利用医学影像文本对进行对比学习预训练，显著提升了模型在样本稀缺情况下的性能。

背景: 尽管深度学习在预测BI-RADS评分方面显示出前景，但影像解读存在差异，且仅依赖图像标签训练的分类模型性能有限。

目的: 解决仅使用图像标签训练模型性能受限的问题，利用医学影像图谱中的文本信息提升模型对乳腺影像发现的理解能力。

方法: 构建了包含2313张乳腺影像及其对应描述的多模态模型，使用预训练的PubMedBERT作为语言组件，通过对比学习在图像-文本对上进行预训练，随后在两个数据集上微调视觉编码器。

主要发现: 在训练样本稀缺时，该方法相比未预训练模型性能提升显著（3类平均F1分数提升1%至14%）；少量图像-文本对比同等数量的标注样本更具信息量；代码和模型权重已公开。

结论: 本文提供了一种用于乳腺影像的视觉-语言模型，证实了医学影像图谱中文本信息的重要性，并公开了相关数据集和代码。

翻译: Deep learning methods have demonstrated promising results in predicting BI-RADS scores from mammography images. However, the interpretation of these images can vary, leading to discrepancies even among radiologists. Given the inherent complexity of mammograms, training classification models solely on image labels often yields limited performance. To address this challenge, we curated 2313 mammogram images and their corresponding captions from two mammography atlases. Our proposed approach employs a multi-modal model that uses a pretrained PubMedBERT as the language component. By training this model on image-text pairs with contrastive learning, we enable the vision encoder to absorb the rich information contained in the captions, thereby improving its understanding of mammography findings. We then fine-tune the vision encoder on two datasets for BI-RADS prediction, achieving superior performance compared with models trained without this pretraining, particularly when labeled samples are scarce. The improvement in the 3-class average F1 score ranges from +1% to +14%: a +1% increase with 40K training samples, and a +14% increase with 1K samples. Furthermore, our experiments reveal that 2K image-text pairs from mammography atlases can be more informative than 2K labeled samples for label prediction, with an average margin of +1.1% when more than 10K training samples are available. Overall, our work provides a vision-language model for mammography and highlights the value of textual information from mammography atlases. In addition, we publicly release preprocessed mammography images of the TEKNOFEST dataset. The training code, pre-trained model weights, data extraction scripts, and the released dataset are publicly available at: https://github.com/igulluk/MAM-CLIP

Abstract

Deep learning methods have demonstrated promising results in predicting BI-RADS scores from mammography images. However, the interpretation of these images can vary, leading to discrepancies even among radiologists. Given the inherent complexity of mammograms, training classification models solely on image labels often yields limited performance. To address this challenge, we curated 2313 mammogram images and their corresponding captions from two mammography atlases. Our proposed approach employs a multi-modal model that uses a pretrained PubMedBERT as the language component. By training this model on image-text pairs with contrastive learning, we enable the vision encoder to absorb the rich information contained in the captions, thereby improving its understanding of mammography findings. We then fine-tune the vision encoder on two datasets for BI-RADS prediction, achieving superior performance compared with models trained without this pretraining, particularly when labeled samples are scarce. The improvement in the 3-class average F1 score ranges from +1% to +14%: a +1% increase with 40K training samples, and a +14% increase with 1K samples. Furthermore, our experiments reveal that 2K image-text pairs from mammography atlases can be more informative than 2K labeled samples for label prediction, with an average margin of +1.1% when more than 10K training samples are available. Overall, our work provides a vision-language model for mammography and highlights the value of textual information from mammography atlases. In addition, we publicly release preprocessed mammography images of the TEKNOFEST dataset. The training code, pre-trained model weights, data extraction scripts, and the released dataset are publicly available at: https://github.com/igulluk/MAM-CLIP

item.title: Concept-Guided Noisy Negative Suppression for Zero-Shot Classification and Grounding of Chest X-Ray Findings
item.author: Chenyu Lian, Hong-Yu Zhou, Chun-Ka Wong, Jing Qin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CoNNS的概念引导噪声负样本抑制框架，用于解决基于胸部X光和放射学报告的视觉语言对齐中的噪声负样本问题，通过构建分层概念本体和跨患者对重标记策略来提升零样本理解性能。

背景: 基于胸部X光和放射学报告的视觉语言对齐已成为零样本分类和定位的先进范式，但标准对比学习将不同患者的X光和报告视为负对，这引入了噪声负样本，因为不同患者可能表现出相似发现，导致语义模糊和性能下降。

目的: 为了解决噪声负样本引起的语义模糊和零样本理解任务性能下降的问题，提出CoNNS框架以抑制噪声负样本。

方法: 1. 构建分层概念本体，使用大语言模型对41个关键临床概念进行结构化建模，包括存在性、属性（位置和特征）和文本（证据片段和存在陈述）；2. 实施跨患者对重标记策略，包括细粒度分解、噪声负样本过滤和硬负样本挖掘；3. 提出概念感知NCE损失以对齐视觉特征与文本并抑制噪声负样本。

主要发现: CoNNS在多粒度零样本定位任务和五个零样本分类数据集上的广泛实验中，优于现有的最先进模型。

结论: CoNNS框架通过概念引导的噪声负样本抑制机制，有效提升了基于胸部X光和放射学报告的视觉语言对齐性能，验证了其在零样本理解任务中的有效性。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为CoNNS的概念引导噪声负样本抑制框架，用于解决基于胸部X光和放射学报告的视觉语言对齐中的噪声负样本问题，通过构建分层概念本体和跨患者对重标记策略来提升零样本理解性能。

Abstract

Vision-language alignment using chest X-rays and radiology reports has emerged as an advanced paradigm for zero-shot classification and grounding of chest X-ray findings. However, standard contrastive learning typically treats radiographs and reports from different patients simply as negative pairs. This assumption introduces noisy negatives, as different patients frequently exhibit similar findings. Such noisy negatives cause semantic ambiguity and degrade performance in zero-shot understanding tasks. To address this challenge, we propose CoNNS, a concept-guided noisy-negative suppression framework. To support the negative suppression mechanism, unlike previous methods that use raw reports or templatized texts, we construct a hierarchical concept ontology using large language models. The ontology structures 41 key clinical concepts by explicitly modeling presence, attributes (location and characteristics), and texts (evidential segment and presence statement). Leveraging this ontology, we implement a cross-patient pair relabeling strategy comprising three steps: (1) Fine-Grained Breakdown to categorize pairs based on finding presence; (2) Noisy Negative Filtering to resolve semantic conflicts by removing false negatives; and (3) Hard Negative Mining to identify subtle attribute discrepancies using a lightweight language model. Finally, we propose a Concept-Aware NCE loss to align visual features with text while suppressing the identified noisy negatives. Extensive experiments across multi-granularity zero-shot grounding tasks and five zero-shot classification datasets validate that CoNNS outperforms existing state-of-the-art models. The code is available at https://github.com/DopamineLcy/conns.

item.title: PRISM: A Benchmark for Programmatic Spatial-Temporal Reasoning
item.author: Qiran Zhang, Yuheng Wang, Runde Yang, Lin Wu, Jingru Fan, Shu Yao, Jie Zhang, Tianle Zhou, Huatao Li, Ruijie Shi, Yihan Li, Chen Qian
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了PRISM基准测试，用于评估语言模型生成空间正确动画的能力，发现可执行代码与空间正确输出之间存在显著差距。

背景: 程序化视频生成通过代码提供超越像素级扩散模型的几何精度和时间连贯性，但语言模型能否产生空间正确的动画输出仍是一个开放问题。

目的: 引入PRISM基准测试，包含10,372对人类校准的指令-代码对，并提出一种漏斗式评估框架。

方法: PRISM包含10,372对人类校准的指令-代码对，覆盖英语和中文，涵盖437个主题类别。评估框架包含四个互补指标：代码级可靠性、空间推理、提示感知动态视觉复杂性和时间密度。

主要发现: 对七种主流LLM的系统评估显示，执行成功率到空间通过率的平均下降约为41%，表明可运行的代码不一定产生空间连贯的视觉输出。

结论: 程序化视频生成评估应超越可执行性，PRISM为推进空间连贯代码生成提供了原则性基准。

翻译: 通过代码进行程序化视频生成提供了超越像素级扩散模型的几何精度和时间连贯性，但严格评估语言模型能否产生空间正确的动画输出仍然是一个开放问题。我们引入了PRISM，这是一个大规模基准测试，包含10,372对人类校准的指令-代码对（比先前的程序化视频生成基准测试大20倍），基于英语和中文的现实世界知识可视化场景，跨越437个主题类别。我们进一步提出了一种漏斗式评估框架，包含四个互补指标：用于可执行性的代码级可靠性，用于整个动画序列布局正确性的空间推理，以及用于诊断动态表达和时间活动的提示感知动态视觉复杂性和时间密度。对七种主流LLM的系统评估揭示了一个惊人的执行-空间差距：从执行成功率到空间通过率的平均下降约为41%，表明可运行的代码不一定产生空间连贯的视觉输出。这些发现表明，程序化视频生成评估应超越可执行性。PRISM为推进空间连贯的代码生成提供了原则性基准。

深度解读

“PRISM：程序化时空推理的基准”。贡献：创建了一个基准测试。让我们看看具体的限制：“如果文中没有明确说明，请写 'unknown'”。“明确说明”通常意味着摘要或结论中的明确陈述。标题是元数据。我将坚持使用 "unknown" 以确保安全和严谨，因为提供的文本是二进制/元数据，而不是论文内容。*等等，让我检查一下是否有任何可读的文本。*`Title (PRISM: A Benchmark for Programmatic Spatial-Temporal Reasoning)``Author (Qiran Zhang...)``Subject (cs.AI)``License (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)``arXivID (https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19382v1)``Links: GitHub, H

Abstract

Programmatic video generation through code offers geometric precision and temporal coherence beyond pixel-level diffusion models, yet rigorously evaluating whether language models can produce spatially correct animated outputs remains an open problem. We introduce PRISM, a large-scale benchmark of 10,372 human-calibrated instruction-code pairs (20 times larger than prior programmatic video generation benchmarks), grounded in real-world knowledge visualization scenarios across English and Chinese and spanning 437 subject categories. We further propose a funnel-style evaluation framework with four complementary metrics: Code-Level Reliability for executability, Spatial Reasoning for layout correctness over full animation sequences, and Prompt-Aware Dynamic Visual Complexity (PADVC) and Temporal Density (TD) for diagnosing dynamic expression and temporal activity. Systematic evaluation of seven mainstream LLMs reveals a striking Execution-Spatial Gap: the average drop from execution success rate to spatial pass rate is approximately 41%, showing that runnable code does not necessarily yield spatially coherent visual output. These findings show that programmatic video generation evaluation should go beyond executability. PRISM provides a principled benchmark for advancing spatially coherent code generation.

item.title: LMM-Track4D: Eliciting 4D Dynamic Reasoning in LMMs via Trajectory-Grounded Dialogue
item.author: Chaoyue Li, Yongxue Xu, Jie Feng, Jiayu Ding
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的轨迹引导的多轮时空对话任务，并构建了Track4D-Bench基准测试集，以及LMM-Track4D模型来提升大模型在4D连续时空动态推理方面的能力。

背景: 尽管大型多模态模型在图像和视频理解方面能力日益增强，但在维持4D连续时空动态推理方面仍面临困难。

目的: 为了研究这一能力差距，本文提出了轨迹引导的多轮时空对话任务，并引入了Track4D-Bench基准测试集。

方法: 提出了LMM-Track4D模型，该模型结合了RTGE（光线-时间几何编码）、用于长时域动态传播的专用流式状态标记TRK，以及OSK-RA解码器，用于在遮挡和视角变化下进行稳定的4步3D状态估计。

主要发现: 在Track4D-Bench上的实验表明，LMM-Track4D模型相比强基线模型有持续改进，表明显式的动态状态建模是激发大模型4D动态推理的有用设计原则。

结论: 显式的动态状态建模对于提升大模型在4D动态推理方面的能力是有效的。

翻译: Recent large multimodal models (LMMs) have become increasingly capable on image and video understanding, yet still struggle to sustain 4D continuous spatiotemporal dynamic reasoning. To study this capability gap, we formulate trajectory-grounded multi-turn spatiotemporal dialogue, a new task in which a model must answer spatiotemporal queries while returning structured 3D target trajectories over an entire short clip or a specified segment of a longer clip, and introduce Track4D-Bench, a benchmark with 526 clip-level dialogue samples spanning 23.5k frames and 7.5k object annotations, for training and evaluation. Building on this task, we propose LMM-Track4D, which combines RTGE (Ray--Time Geometry Encoding), a dedicated streaming state token TRK for long-horizon dynamic propagation, and an Object-Slot Kinematic, Residual-Anchor (OSK-RA) decoder for stable 4-step 3D state estimation under occlusion and viewpoint variation. Experiments on Track4D-Bench show consistent improvements over strong baselines, suggesting that explicit dynamic state modeling is a useful design principle for eliciting 4D dynamic reasoning in LMMs. Our code and dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/LMM-Track4D.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决大型多模态模型在理解随时间变化的动态场景（4D）时存在的推理困难。这个问题很重要，因为现实世界中的许多场景都是动态变化的，如果模型无法准确捕捉运动轨迹和变化，将难以应用于视频监控、自动驾驶等需要动态感知的任务。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用轨迹锚定的对话来激发大型多模态模型（LMM）的4D动态推理能力。整体实现流程未知。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Recent large multimodal models (LMMs) have become increasingly capable on image and video understanding, yet still struggle to sustain 4D continuous spatiotemporal dynamic reasoning. To study this capability gap, we formulate trajectory-grounded multi-turn spatiotemporal dialogue, a new task in which a model must answer spatiotemporal queries while returning structured 3D target trajectories over an entire short clip or a specified segment of a longer clip, and introduce Track4D-Bench, a benchmark with 526 clip-level dialogue samples spanning 23.5k frames and 7.5k object annotations, for training and evaluation. Building on this task, we propose LMM-Track4D, which combines RTGE (Ray--Time Geometry Encoding), a dedicated streaming state token TRK for long-horizon dynamic propagation, and an Object-Slot Kinematic, Residual-Anchor (OSK-RA) decoder for stable 4-step 3D state estimation under occlusion and viewpoint variation. Experiments on Track4D-Bench show consistent improvements over strong baselines, suggesting that explicit dynamic state modeling is a useful design principle for eliciting 4D dynamic reasoning in LMMs. Our code and dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/LMM-Track4D.

item.title: Neuron Incidence Redistribution for Fairness in Medical Image Classification
item.author: Abin Shoby, Lyle John Palmer, Nikhil Cherian Kurian
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Neuron Incidence Redistribution (NIR) 的轻量级正则化方法，用于减少医疗图像分类模型在不同人口统计学群体间的性能差异。

背景: 深度学习模型在医疗图像分类中容易受到年龄、性别和种族等人口统计学属性差异的影响。

目的: 解决医疗人工智能模型中存在的系统性过度诊断和诊断不足问题，提高模型在不同群体间的公平性。

方法: 提出 Neuron Incidence Redistribution (NIR) 方法，这是一种轻量级正则化技术，通过惩罚预测概率加权的平均激活值在最后一层神经元中的方差来实现，且在训练时不需要人口统计学标签。

主要发现: 在 HAM10000 数据集上，NIR 方法显著降低了不同年龄组和性别组的真阳性率差异；在 Harvard OCT-RNFL 数据集上，该方法降低了不同种族和年龄组的假阳性率差异。

结论: 将潜在疾病证据分布在完整的最后一层神经元中，是改善医疗人工智能中人口统计学公平性的一个合理且有效的策略。

翻译: 摘要：深度学习模型在医疗图像分类中容易受到年龄、性别和种族等人口统计学属性差异的影响。我们识别出导致这些差异的潜在表征机制：在迁移学习模型中，正预测下的主导倒数第二层激活通道由疾病阳性样本和特权人口统计学群体（男性、老年患者）共同激活，导致过度诊断；相反，负预测下的主导通道由弱势群体（女性、年轻患者）共同激活，导致系统性诊断不足。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Neuron Incidence Redistribution (NIR)，一种轻量级正则化方法，它惩罚倒数第二层神经元中预测概率加权的平均激活值的方差，在训练时不需要人口统计学标签。在 HAM10000 上，不同年龄组的真阳性率差异从 10.81% 降至 0.93%，不同性别组的差异从 12.04% 降至 0.74%，AUC 略有提升 0.51 点。在 Harvard OCT-RNFL 上，NIR 减少了种族（从 15.68% 降至 10.66%）和年龄（从 12.69% 降至 1.80%）的假阳性率差异，证明将潜在疾病证据分布在完整的最后一层神经元中是改善医疗人工智能中人口统计学公平性的一个合理且有效的策略。

Abstract

Deep learning models for medical image classification are susceptible to subgroup performance disparities across demographic attributes such as age, gender, and race. We identify a latent representational mechanism underlying these disparities: in transfer-learned models, the dominant penultimate-layer activation channel under positive predictions is co-activated by both disease-positive samples and privileged demographic groups (male, older patients), producing over-diagnosis; conversely, the dominant channel under negative predictions is co-activated by disadvantaged groups (female, younger patients), producing systematic under-diagnosis. To address this, we propose Neuron Incidence Redistribution (NIR), a lightweight regularization method that penalizes the variance of predicted-probability-weighted mean activations across penultimate-layer neurons, requiring no demographic labels at training time. On HAM10000, TPR disparity drops from 10.81% to 0.93% across age groups and from 12.04% to 0.74% across gender, with a marginal AUC improvement of 0.51 points. On Harvard OCT-RNFL, NIR reduces FPR disparity for race (from 15.68% to 10.66%) and age (from 12.69% to 1.80%), demonstrating that distributing latent disease evidence across the full penultimate layer is a principled and effective strategy for improving demographic fairness in medical AI.

item.title: Towards Fair Benchmarking of Quantum Transfer Learning for Visual Classification
item.author: Nouhaila Innan, Saim Rehman, Muhammad Shafique
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一个受控的基准测试方法，用于评估代表性量子迁移学习方法在统一迁移学习管道下的表现。

背景: 在近期的量子机器学习约束下，由于量子比特数量有限、电路深度较浅以及昂贵的混合优化，端到端量子训练受到限制。现有的量子迁移学习结果难以比较，因为它们在数据集、预处理、骨干网络设置、量子比特预算、电路设计、优化选择和报告协议等方面存在差异。

目的: 为了解决现有量子迁移学习结果难以比较的问题，该工作提出了一个受控的基准测试方法，用于在统一的迁移学习管道下评估代表性量子迁移学习方法。

方法: 该基准测试在共享的预处理规则、冻结骨干网络设置、训练条件和报告指标下，比较了DQN-QTL、QPIE-QTL、AE-CQTL、PVCQTL和ED-QTL。评估主要关注Fashion-MNIST和Hymenoptera Ants vs Bees两个数据集，并使用CIFAR-10提供额外的配置级证据。除了预测性能外，基准测试还分析了电路大小、可训练参数、量子参数、训练时间和架构对量子比特数量和电路深度的敏感性。

主要发现: 结果没有显示单一的量子迁移学习家族在所有设置下都占主导地位；性能取决于数据集、编码策略、电路设计和计算成本。

结论: 这些发现强调了资源感知的量子迁移学习评估的必要性，并为在近期的资源约束下选择混合量子-经典迁移模型提供了指导。

翻译: 摘要：量子迁移学习（QTL）为在近期约束下的视觉量子机器学习提供了一种有前景的方法，其中有限的量子比特数量、较浅的电路深度和昂贵的混合优化限制了端到端量子训练。在这种设置下，预训练的经典骨干网络可以提取高级视觉特征，而紧凑的量子模块作为可训练的分类头。然而，现有的QTL结果很难比较，因为它们通常在数据集、预处理、骨干网络设置、量子比特预算、电路设计、优化选择和报告协议方面有所不同。这项工作提出了一个受控的基准测试方法，用于在统一的迁移学习管道下评估代表性QTL方法。该基准测试在共享的预处理规则、冻结骨干网络设置、训练条件和报告指标下比较了DQN-QTL、QPIE-QTL、AE-CQTL、PVCQTL和ED-QTL。评估主要关注Fashion-MNIST和Hymenoptera Ants vs Bees两个数据集，而CIFAR-10被用于在更难的自然图像任务上提供额外的配置级证据。除了预测性能外，基准测试还分析了电路大小、可训练参数、量子参数、训练时间和架构对量子比特数量和电路深度的敏感性。结果显示，没有单一的QTL家族在所有设置下都占主导地位：性能取决于数据集、编码策略、电路设计和计算成本。这些发现强调了资源感知的QTL评估的必要性，并为在近期的资源约束下选择混合量子-经典迁移模型提供了指导。

Abstract

Quantum Transfer Learning (QTL) offers a promising approach for visual quantum machine learning under near-term constraints, where limited qubit counts, shallow circuit depths, and costly hybrid optimization restrict end-to-end quantum training. In this setting, pretrained classical backbones can extract high-level visual features, while compact quantum modules operate as trainable classification heads. However, existing QTL results are difficult to compare because they often differ in datasets, preprocessing, backbone settings, qubit budgets, circuit designs, optimization choices, and reporting protocols. This work presents a controlled benchmarking methodology for evaluating representative QTL methods under a unified transfer-learning pipeline. The benchmark compares DQN-QTL, QPIE-QTL, AE-CQTL, PVCQTL, and ED-QTL under shared preprocessing rules, frozen-backbone settings, training conditions, and reporting metrics. The evaluation focuses on Fashion-MNIST and Hymenoptera Ants vs Bees as the two main datasets, while CIFAR-10 is used to provide additional configuration-level evidence on a harder natural-image task. Beyond predictive performance, the benchmark analyzes circuit size, trainable parameters, quantum parameters, training time, and architectural sensitivity to qubit count and circuit depth. The results show that no single QTL family dominates across all settings: performance depends on the dataset, encoding strategy, circuit design, and computational cost. These findings highlight the need for resource-aware QTL evaluation and provide guidance for selecting hybrid quantum-classical transfer models under near-term resource constraints.

item.title: CEPO: RLVR Self-Distillation using Contrastive Evidence Policy Optimization
item.author: Heakl, Ahmed, Shaker, Abdelrahman M., Mohamed, Youssef, Elbadry, Rania, Fetouh, Omar, Khan, Fahad Shahbaz, Khan, Salman
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为对比证据策略优化(CEPO)的新方法，旨在解决强化学习验证奖励(RLVR)中奖励信号分配不均的问题，通过区分关键推理步骤和填充词来提高模型性能。

背景: 在强化学习验证奖励(RLVR)中，模型产生正确解时，每个token获得的奖励信号相同，无论该token是关键推理步骤还是语法填充词。

目的: 提出对比证据策略优化(CEPO)方法，旨在通过区分关键推理步骤和填充词，更精确地分配奖励信号，从而提高模型在多模态数学推理任务上的表现。

方法: CEPO方法在每个token处提出更尖锐的问题：不仅询问正确答案是否支持该token，还询问错误答案是否反对该token。通过这种方式，满足两个条件的token被识别为真正的推理步骤，而两个条件都不满足的token被视为填充词。错误答案教师是从训练批次中已有的拒绝回放中构建的，无需额外采样成本。

主要发现: CEPO在5个多模态数学推理基准测试中，在2B和4B规模下分别实现了43.43%和60.56%的平均准确率，而GRPO在相同训练预算下分别为41.17%和57.43%。分布匹配的自蒸馏方法(如OPSD, SDPO)的表现低于未训练的基线，证实了理论预测的信息泄漏问题。

结论: CEPO继承了先前最先进方法的所有结构安全保证，同时严格提高了关键token的信用分配，且改进在填充词位置处精确消失。

翻译: 当模型在强化学习验证奖励(RLVR)下产生正确解时，每个token都会获得相同的奖励信号，无论它是决定性的推理步骤还是语法填充词。一个自然的修复方法是让模型以正确答案为条件作为教师，识别如果它知道答案，它会产生不同token的情况。先前的研究表明，这要么通过将答案泄漏到梯度中来破坏训练，要么产生无法区分决定性步骤和填充词的弱信号，因为相对于模型的基线，两者看起来同样令人惊讶。我们提出了对比证据策略优化(CEPO)，它在每个token处提出了一个更尖锐的问题：不仅仅是“正确答案是否支持这个token？”，而是“正确答案是否支持它，而错误答案是否反对它？”满足这两个条件的token是一个真正的推理步骤；两个条件都不满足的是填充词。错误答案教师是从训练批次中已有的拒绝回放中构建的，无需额外的采样成本。我们证明CEPO继承了先前最先进方法的所有结构安全保证，同时严格提高了关键token的信用分配，改进在填充词位置处精确消失。在经验上，CEPO在5个多模态数学推理基准测试中，在2B和4B规模下分别实现了43.43%和60.56%的平均准确率，而GRPO在相同训练预算下分别为41.17%和57.43%。分布匹配的自蒸馏方法(OPSD, SDPO)的表现低于未训练的基线，经验上证实了我们理论预测的信息泄漏。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

When a model produces a correct solution under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), every token receives the same reward signal regardless of whether it was a decisive reasoning step or a grammatical filler. A natural fix is to condition the model on the correct answer as a teacher, identifying tokens it would have generated differently had it known the answer. Prior work shows this either corrupts training by leaking the answer into the gradient, or produces a weak signal that cannot distinguish decisive steps from filler, since both look equally surprising relative to the model's baseline. We propose Contrastive Evidence Policy Optimization (CEPO), which asks a sharper question at every token: not just "does the correct answer favor this token?" but "does the correct answer favor it while the wrong answer disfavors it?" A token satisfying both is a genuine reasoning step; one satisfying neither is filler. The wrong-answer teacher is constructed from rejected rollouts already in the training batch, incurring no additional sampling cost. We prove CEPO inherits all structural safety guarantees of the prior state of the art while strictly sharpening credit at decisive tokens, with the improvement vanishing exactly at filler positions. Empirically, CEPO achieves 43.43% and 60.56% average accuracy across five multimodal mathematical reasoning benchmarks at 2B and 4B scale, respectively, versus 41.17% and 57.43% for GRPO under identical training budgets. Distribution-matching self-distillation methods (OPSD, SDPO) fall below the untrained baseline, empirically confirming the information leakage our theory predicts. Our code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Replacement Learning: Training Neural Networks with Fewer Parameters
item.author: Yuming Zhang, Peizhe Wang, Tianyang Han, Hengyu Shi, Junhao Su, Dongzhi Guan, Jiabin Liu, Jiaji Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: RepL通过替换而非丢弃层来减少全深度训练的冗余，在保持模型性能的同时降低了参数、内存和训练时间。

背景: 全深度反向传播是优化深度神经网络的范式，但随着模型变深，其效率下降，引入了参数冗余、激活内存成本和训练延迟。

目的: 提出Replacement Learning (RepL)训练范式，通过替换选定的块而非简单丢弃它们来减少全深度冗余。

方法: RepL为每个移除的块插入一个轻量级计算层，该层通过可学习变换合成一个代理算子，该算子由相邻前后块的参数组成，并将合成算子应用于前一个激活。

主要发现: 在CIFAR-10、SVHN、STL-10、ImageNet、COCO和CityScapes上的实验表明，RepL减少了可训练参数、GPU内存使用和训练时间，同时在分类、检测和分割任务中匹配或超越了标准端到端训练。

结论: RepL在CNN和ViT中实例化，在多个数据集和任务上展示了其通用性和兼容性，进一步在WikiText-2、迁移学习、推理吞吐量、检查点、随机深度和INT8量化上的结果也证明了这一点。

翻译: 摘要：全深度反向传播训练仍然是优化深度神经网络的范式，但随着模型变深，其效率下降。由于每个块必须在单一全局目标下执行和求导，全深度BP引入了大量的参数冗余、激活内存成本和训练延迟，尤其是当相邻层表现出高度相关的学习模式时。直接跳过或移除层可以降低成本，但往往会削弱表示能力或需要特定的架构重用设计。在本文中，我们提出了Replacement Learning (RepL)，一种训练范式，它通过替换选定的块而不是简单地丢弃它们来减少全深度冗余。对于每个移除的块，RepL插入一个轻量级计算层，该层通过可学习变换从相邻前后块的参数合成一个代理算子，并将合成算子应用于前一个激活。这样，RepL保持了局部上下文的连续性，同时避免了不必要的全层计算。我们为CNN和ViTs实例化了RepL，并定制了参数融合块来处理卷积通道、特征分辨率和Transformer子模块。在CIFAR-10、SVHN、STL-10、ImageNet、COCO和CityScapes上的广泛实验表明，RepL减少了可训练参数、GPU内存使用和训练时间，同时在分类、检测和分割任务中匹配或超越了标准端到端训练。在WikiText-2、迁移学习、推理吞吐量、检查点、随机深度和INT8量化上的附加结果进一步证明了其通用性和兼容性。

Abstract

End-to-end training with full-depth backpropagation remains the dominant paradigm for optimizing deep neural networks, but its efficiency deteriorates as models grow deeper. Since every block must be executed and differentiated under a single global objective, full-depth BP introduces substantial parameter redundancy, activation-memory cost, and training latency, especially when neighboring layers exhibit highly correlated learning patterns. Directly skipping or removing layers can reduce cost, but often weakens representation capacity or requires architecture-specific reuse designs. In this paper, we propose Replacement Learning (RepL), a training-time paradigm that reduces full-depth redundancy by replacing selected blocks rather than simply discarding them. For each removed block, RepL inserts a lightweight computing layer that synthesizes a surrogate operator from the parameters of its adjacent preceding and succeeding blocks through a learnable transformation, and applies the synthesized operator to the preceding activation. In this way, RepL preserves local contextual continuity while avoiding unnecessary full-layer computation. We instantiate RepL for CNNs and ViTs with tailored parameter-fusion blocks that handle convolutional channels, feature resolutions, and transformer submodules. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, SVHN, STL-10, ImageNet, COCO, and CityScapes show that RepL reduces trainable parameters, GPU memory usage, and training time while matching or surpassing standard end-to-end training across classification, detection, and segmentation. Additional results on WikiText-2, transfer learning, inference throughput, checkpointing, stochastic depth, and INT8 quantization further demonstrate its generality and compatibility.

item.title: EgoCoT-Bench: Benchmarking Grounded and Verifiable Operation-Centric Chain of Thought Reasoning for MLLMs
item.author: Yang Dai, Dian Jiao, Tianwei Lin, Wenqiao Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EgoCoT-Bench是一个细粒度自视角视频基准，用于验证基于操作的推理能力。

背景: 多模态大模型在自视角视频理解方面发展迅速，但现有基准在细粒度操作推理和理由验证方面存在局限。

目的: 引入EgoCoT-Bench，一个细粒度自视角基准，用于验证基于操作的推理能力，并包含逐步理由注释。

方法: 通过时空场景图引导生成框架构建基准，并由人工标注者进行完善以确保正确性、自视角相关性和细粒度质量。

主要发现: 多模态模型在自视角细粒度推理方面仍面临困难，许多模型产生答案正确但证据与答案不一致的解释。

结论: EgoCoT-Bench可作为自视角视频理解中验证推理能力的有用测试平台。

翻译: 多模态大模型的快速发展引发了人们对自视角视频理解的日益关注，特别是MLLM从第一人称视角识别细粒度手物交互、随时间跟踪物体状态变化以及在动态环境中推理操作过程的能力。然而，现有的自视角视频基准存在理由验证评估有限的问题，对细粒度操作中心推理的支持有限，很少检查模型的理由是否基于明确的时空证据。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了EgoCoT-Bench，这是一个细粒度自视角基准，用于验证基于操作的推理能力，并包含逐步理由注释。总体而言，EgoCoT-Bench包含3,172个可验证的问答对，涵盖351个自视角视频，分为四个任务组，共12个子任务组，包括感知和回顾、预测以及高层推理。该基准是通过时空场景图引导生成框架构建的，并进一步由人工标注者完善以确保正确性、自视角相关性和细粒度质量。实验结果表明，自视角细粒度推理仍然存在困难，并进一步揭示了许多多模态模型产生答案正确但证据与答案不一致的解释。我们希望EgoCoT-Bench能作为自视角视频理解中验证推理能力的有用测试平台。项目页面和补充材料可在以下网址获取：https://dstardust.github.io/EgoCoT/。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决多模态大语言模型在以自我为中心的视频理解中，缺乏基于现实且可验证的细粒度推理过程的问题。这个问题很重要，因为现有的模型难以准确理解人类操作细节，而以自我为中心的视频是现实世界交互的关键，建立可验证的基准有助于推动模型在复杂任务中的发展。
