Abstract

The rapid development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has led to growing interest in egocentric video understanding, specifically the ability for MLLMs to recognize fine-grained hand-object interactions, track object state changes over time, and reason about manipulative processes in dynamic environments from a first-person perspective. However, existing egocentric video benchmarks suffer from \textbf{limited grounded rationale evaluation}, offering limited support for fine-grained operation-centric reasoning and rarely examining whether model rationales are grounded in explicit spatio-temporal evidence. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{EgoCoT-Bench}, a fine-grained egocentric benchmark for grounded and verifiable operation-centric reasoning with explicit step-by-step rationale annotations. Overall, EgoCoT-Bench comprises 3,172 verifiable QA pairs over 351 egocentric videos separated into four task groups for a total of 12 sub-task groups, encompassing perception and retrospection, anticipation, and high-level reasoning. The benchmark is constructed through a spatio-temporal scene graphs (STSG) guided generation framework and is further refined by human annotators to ensure correctness, egocentric relevance and fine-grained quality. Experimental results show continuing difficulties with egocentric fine-grained reasoning and further reveal that many multimodal models produce explanations that are answer-correct, but have evidence that is inconsistent with the answer. We hope EgoCoT-Bench can serve as a useful testbed for grounded and verifiable reasoning in egocentric video understanding. Project page and supplementary materials are available at: https://dstardust.github.io/EgoCoT/.

item.title: GoLongRL: Capability-Oriented Long Context Reinforcement Learning with Multitask Alignment
item.author: Lv, Minxuan, Mei, Tiehua, Du, Tanlong, Chen, Junmin, Su, Zhenpeng, Chen, Ziyang, Wang, Ziqi, Wu, Zhennan, Pan, Ruotong, Liang, jian, Tang, Ruiming, Li, Han
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GoLongRL是一个完全开源的能力导向后训练配方，用于长上下文强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）。

背景: 现有的长上下文RL方法通常将数据构建视为设计日益复杂的检索路径，导致任务覆盖面单一和奖励形式无法充分反映实际长上下文要求。

目的: 提供一种能力导向的数据构建方法，并解决异构多任务优化中的优化挑战。

方法: 1. 发布包含23K RLVR样本、完整构建流程和训练代码的数据集，该数据集基于长上下文能力分类法，涵盖9种任务类型，包含精选开源样本和从书籍、学术论文、多轮对话等真实文档生成的合成样本。2. 提出TMN-Reweight方法，结合任务级均值归一化以实现跨任务奖励尺度对齐，以及难度自适应加权以获得更可靠的优势估计。

主要发现: 在相同的GRPO设置下，仅使用该数据集就超越了闭源QwenLong-L1.5数据集；在Qwen3-30B-A3B模型上训练后，其长上下文性能可与DeepSeek-R1-0528和Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507相媲美；TMN-Reweight进一步提高了平均性能，并在评估中保持了或提高了通用能力。

结论: 更广泛的覆盖面和更大的奖励多样性显著有助于长上下文能力的提升；TMN-Reweight方法有效解决了异构奖励带来的优化挑战。

翻译: 我们提出了GoLongRL，这是一个完全开源、能力导向的后训练配方，用于长上下文强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）。现有的长上下文RL方法通常将数据构建视为设计日益复杂的检索路径，导致任务覆盖面单一和奖励形式无法充分反映实际长上下文要求。我们的工作提供了两个贡献。（1）能力导向的数据构建与完全开源。我们公开发布了一个包含23K RLVR样本的数据集、完整的构建流程以及所有训练代码。在长上下文能力分类法的指导下，该数据集涵盖了9种任务类型，每种任务类型都配有其自然评估指标。它包含来自既定语料库的精选开源样本，以及从书籍、学术论文和多轮对话等真实源文档生成的合成样本。在相同的GRPO设置下，仅使用我们的数据集就超越了闭源的QwenLong-L1.5数据集。此外，在此数据上训练的Qwen3-30B-A3B模型提供了可与DeepSeek-R1-0528和Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507相媲美的长上下文性能，这表明更广泛的覆盖面和更大的奖励多样性显著有助于长上下文能力的提升。（2）用于异构多任务优化的TMN-Reweight。为了解决异构奖励带来的优化挑战，我们提出了TMN-Reweight，该方法结合了任务级均值归一化以实现跨任务奖励尺度对齐，以及难度自适应加权以获得更可靠的优势估计。TMN-Reweight进一步提高了平均性能，并在报告的评估中保持了或提高了通用能力。

Abstract

We present GoLongRL, a fully open-source, capability-oriented post-training recipe for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing long-context RL methods often treat data construction as a matter of designing increasingly complex retrieval paths, leading to homogeneous task coverage and reward formulations that inadequately reflect practical long-context requirements. Our work offers two contributions. (1) Capability-oriented data construction with full open release. We openly release a dataset of 23K RLVR samples, the complete construction pipeline, and all training code. Guided by a taxonomy of long-context capabilities, the dataset spans 9 task types, each paired with its natural evaluation metric. It comprises curated open-source samples from established corpora and synthetic samples whose QA pairs are generated from real source documents such as books, academic papers, and multi-turn dialogues. Under the same vanilla GRPO setup, our dataset alone outperforms the closed-source QwenLong-L1.5 dataset. Moreover, our Qwen3-30B-A3B model trained on this data delivers long-context performance comparable to DeepSeek-R1-0528 and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507, suggesting that broader coverage and greater reward diversity substantially benefit long-context capability improvement. (2) TMN-Reweight for heterogeneous multitask optimization. To address optimization challenges from heterogeneous rewards, we propose TMN-Reweight, which combines task-level mean normalization for cross-task reward scale alignment with difficulty-adaptive weighting for more reliable advantage estimation. TMN-Reweight further improves average performance over vanilla GRPO, with general capabilities preserved or improved across reported evaluations.

item.title: SceneCode: Executable World Programs for Editable Indoor Scenes with Articulated Objects
item.author: Wang, Puyi, Wang, Yuhao, Li, Linjie, Yang, Zhengyuan, Lin, Kevin Qinghong, Li, Yangguang, Cheng, Yu
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SceneCode是一个将自然语言提示转化为可执行代码驱动的室内场景生成框架，通过程序化世界生成方法解决现有管道中静态网格和继承资产库限制的问题。

背景: 室内场景合成对于具身AI、机器人操作和基于模拟的策略评估至关重要，但现有管道通常将生成内容表示为静态网格，并仅从精选资产库继承关节，限制了物体级别的可控性。

目的: 通过将物理可交互的室内场景合成表述为程序化世界生成，提出SceneCode框架，将自然语言提示编译为可执行的代码驱动的室内世界，而非一组不透明的网格。

方法: SceneCode框架包括房间级代理骨干将提示转化为结构化房屋布局，通过规划器-设计器-批评家循环发出每个物体的资产请求；每个请求路由到五种代码生成策略之一，转换为合成的部分-wise Blender Python程序，并通过执行引导的修复和细化循环进行验证；生成的程序被编译为模拟就绪资产，并导出为SDF用于物理模拟；持久场景状态注册表将物体请求、可执行程序、渲染几何和模拟资产链接起来。

主要发现: 可执行世界程序提高了提示忠实度室内场景生成，并产生了具有更清洁网格结构和模拟器加载关节元数据的资产。

结论: SceneCode通过程序化世界生成方法，实现了从自然语言到可执行代码驱动的室内场景的转化，提高了场景生成的可控性和资产质量。

翻译: SceneCode是一个将自然语言提示转化为可执行代码驱动的室内场景生成框架，通过程序化世界生成方法解决现有管道中静态网格和继承资产库限制的问题。

Abstract

Indoor scene synthesis underpins embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy evaluation, where a useful scene must specify not only what the environment looks like, but also how its objects are structured. Existing pipelines, however, typically represent generated content as static meshes and inherit articulation only from curated asset libraries, which limits object-level controllability and prevents new interactable assets from being produced on demand. We address this gap by formulating physically interactable indoor scene synthesis as programmatic world generation, and present SceneCode, a framework that compiles a natural language prompt into an executable, code-driven indoor world rather than a collection of opaque meshes. A room-level agentic backbone first turns the prompt into a structured house layout and emits per-object AssetRequests through a planner--designer--critic loop. Each request is then routed to one of five code-generation strategies and converted into a synthesized part-wise Blender Python programs that are validated through an execution-guided repair-and-refine loop. The resulting programs are compiled into simulation-ready assets, and exported as SDF for physics simulation. A persistent scene-state registry links object requests, executable programs, rendered geometry, and simulation assets, turning scene assembly into a traceable and locally editable world-building process. We evaluate SceneCode across scene-level synthesis, object-level asset quality, human judgment, and downstream robot interaction. Results show that executable world programs improve prompt-faithful indoor scene generation and produce assets with cleaner mesh structure, and simulator-loadable articulation metadata. item.title: MCNav: Memory-Aware Dynamic Cognitive Map for Zero-shot Goal-oriented Navigation
item.author: Jingyu Li, Zhe Liu, Wenxiao Wu, Li Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MCNav是一个具有动态认知地图的记忆感知导航框架，旨在解决复杂环境中的实例级目标导航问题。

背景: 现有零样本方法主要关注探索新区域，缺乏对已探索区域信息的深度利用，导致在已访问区域中目标遗漏或误识别时频繁发生导航失败。

目的: 提出MCNav框架，通过动态认知地图存储已探索区域的相关对象信息，并引入记忆感知探索策略来纠正匹配失败和估计目标在已探索区域存在的可能性。

方法: MCNav包含动态认知地图、目标重新验证、遗漏目标重新探索、黑名单机制和双重检查机制。

主要发现: MCNav在HM3Dv1和HM3Dv2数据集上的三个不同任务中实现了最先进的性能，特别是在实例级目标导航任务上表现优异。

结论: MCNav通过有效利用记忆信息，显著提高了复杂环境中的导航成功率。

翻译: 在复杂环境中导航到实例级目标是一个具有挑战性的问题。许多现有的零样本方法通过建模整个环境并利用大型语言模型进行场景理解来实现强大的性能。然而，这些策略主要关注探索新区域，缺乏对已探索区域信息的深度利用。因此，当目标在先前访问的区域中被遗漏或误识别时，导航失败经常发生。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了MCNav，一个具有动态认知地图的记忆感知导航框架。该地图高效存储了关于已探索区域中相关对象的可查询信息。基于这种记忆结构，MCNav引入了两种记忆感知探索策略：目标重新验证，重新评估先前看到的对象以纠正匹配失败，以及遗漏目标重新探索，从上下文线索估计目标存在于已探索区域的可能性。这些策略进一步通过黑名单机制来防止重复错误，并通过双重检查机制进行高置信度确认。我们在HM3Dv1和HM3Dv2数据集上评估了MCNav，涵盖了三个不同的任务，在这些任务中它实现了最先进的性能，特别是在实例级目标导航任务上。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决零样本目标导向导航的问题。这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为MCNav的方法，利用记忆感知的动态认知地图，实现了在零样本场景下的目标导向导航。

Abstract

Navigating to instance-level targets in complex environments is a challenging problem. Many existing zero-shot methods achieve strong performance by modeling the entire environment and leveraging large language models for scene understanding. However, such strategies primarily focus on exploring new regions while lacking a deeper exploitation of information from previously explored areas. Consequently, when targets are missed or misidentified within previously visited regions, navigation failures occur frequently. To address these limitations, we propose MCNav, a memory-aware navigation framework with a dynamic cognitive map. This map stores efficiently queryable information about relevant objects in explored areas. Building on this memory structure, MCNav introduces two memory-aware exploration strategies: goal re-validation, which re-assesses previously seen objects to correct matching failures, and missed goal re-exploration, which estimates the likelihood that a target is present in an explored region from contextual cues. These strategies are further stabilized by a blacklist mechanism to prevent repeated errors and a double-check mechanism for high-confidence confirmation. We evaluate MCNav on the HM3Dv1 and HM3Dv2 datasets across three different tasks, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly on the instance-level goal navigation task.

item.title: Bézier Degradation Modeling for LiDAR-based Human Motion Capture
item.author: Xiaoqi An, Lin Zhao, Jun Li, Chen Gong, Jian Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于激光雷达的3D人体运动捕捉方法，通过贝塞尔曲线建模运动，解决了输入不稳定和遮挡问题。

背景: 激光雷达3D人体运动捕捉在自动驾驶和机器人领域有广泛应用，但现有方法常因输入不稳定和严重遮挡导致预测抖动或失败。

目的: 解决现有方法在处理不稳定输入和严重遮挡时的挑战，实现准确且连贯的运动重建。

方法: 提出BMLiCap框架，采用从粗到细的策略，使用可压缩的贝塞尔曲线建模运动，设计了时间尺度运动变换器和多级运动聚合器来恢复细节和连贯性。

主要发现: 在四个主流基准数据集上，BMLiCap在复杂场景中实现了最先进的准确性和时间连续性。

结论: 该方法能有效补偿严重遮挡并减少预测抖动。

翻译: LiDAR-based 3D human motion capture has broad applications in fields such as autonomous driving and robotics, where accurate motion reconstruction is crucial. However, existing methods often struggle with unstable inputs and severe occlusions, leading to jittery or even failed pose predictions. To address these challenges, we propose BMLiCap, a coarse-to-fine framework that models motion using temporally compressible Bézier curves. By reducing control points through a trajectory-preserving strategy, we obtain a coherent and learning-friendly motion representation. To reconstruct human actions from LiDAR point-cloud cues, we design a progressive motion-reconstruction module. Specifically, a Time-scale Motion Transformer (TMT) is introduced to predict motion curves at multiple temporal scales, and a Multi-level Motion Aggregator (MMA) is utilized to adaptively fuse the multi-scale curves to recover detailed, temporally coherent poses, effectively bridging observation gaps caused by occlusions and noise. Across four mainstream benchmarks LiDARHuman26M, FreeMotion, NoiseMotion, and SLOPER4D, BMLiCap achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and temporal continuity in complex scenes, demonstrating its ability to compensate for severe occlusions and reduce prediction jitter.

Abstract

LiDAR-based 3D human motion capture has broad applications in fields such as autonomous driving and robotics, where accurate motion reconstruction is crucial. However, existing methods often struggle with unstable inputs and severe occlusions, leading to jittery or even failed pose predictions. To address these challenges, we propose BMLiCap, a coarse-to-fine framework that models motion using temporally compressible Bézier curves. By reducing control points through a trajectory-preserving strategy, we obtain a coherent and learning-friendly motion representation. To reconstruct human actions from LiDAR point-cloud cues, we design a progressive motion-reconstruction module. Specifically, a Time-scale Motion Transformer (TMT) is introduced to predict motion curves at multiple temporal scales, and a Multi-level Motion Aggregator (MMA) is utilized to adaptively fuse the multi-scale curves to recover detailed, temporally coherent poses, effectively bridging observation gaps caused by occlusions and noise. Across four mainstream benchmarks LiDARHuman26M, FreeMotion, NoiseMotion, and SLOPER4D, BMLiCap achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and temporal continuity in complex scenes, demonstrating its ability to compensate for severe occlusions and reduce prediction jitter.

item.title: UniRefiner: Teaching Pre-trained ViTs to Self-Dispose Dross via Contrastive Register
item.author: Congpei Qiu, Zhaoyu Hu, Wei Ke, Zhuotao Tian, Yanhao Wu, Tong Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为UniRefiner的通用细化框架，用于处理Vision Transformer中的虚假标记，从而提升其在空间敏感任务中的性能。

背景: Vision Transformers在表示学习方面进展迅速，但在空间敏感任务中，大规模模型的效用受到虚假标记的阻碍。

目的: 提出一种更广泛的虚假标记定义，并系统地分类和表征三种基本的虚假标记类型，进而提出UniRefiner框架来教导预训练的ViTs自我处理这些虚假标记。

方法: UniRefiner使用对比寄存器来显式隔离和重新分配虚假标记，通过双重目标：将图像标记与过滤后的常规标记对齐以保留语义，并将寄存器标记与检测到的虚假标记对齐以捕获虚假信号。

主要发现: 该方法仅需在约5000张图像上进行几个时期的微调即可细化各种ViTs，包括EVA-CLIP-8B和InternViT-6B等大规模模型。

结论: 实验表明UniRefiner带来了持续且显著的改进，例如，细化的EVA-CLIP-8B在ADE20K上达到51.9%的平均IoU，超越了DINOv2等专用视觉模型，零样本分割准确率提高了高达22%。

翻译: 基于Vision Transformers的表示学习发展迅速，然而大规模模型在空间敏感任务中的效用受到虚假标记的阻碍。先前缓解这一问题的努力往往局限于狭义定义，例如将它们视为简单的高范数异常值。我们主张这种范围是不充分的。对于密集预测任务，我们认为任何未能编码位置对齐语义的标记都应被视为虚假伪影。这种更广泛的定义揭示了一个更复杂的问题，引导我们系统地分类和表征三种破坏空间表示的基本类型虚假标记。基于这种全面的诊断，我们提出了UniRefiner，一个通用细化框架，教导预训练的ViTs自我处理这些虚假标记。UniRefiner使用对比寄存器通过双重目标显式隔离和重新分配虚假标记：(i)它将图像标记与过滤后的常规标记对齐以保留语义，(ii)它将寄存器标记与检测到的虚假标记对齐以捕获虚假信号。我们的方法仅需在约5000张图像上进行几个时期的微调即可细化各种ViTs，包括EVA-CLIP-8B和InternViT-6B等大规模模型。实验表明持续且显著的改进：值得注意的是，细化的EVA-CLIP-8B在ADE20K上达到51.9%的平均IoU（+9.4%），超越了DINOv2（49.1%）等专用视觉模型，而零样本分割准确率提高了高达22%。UniRefiner释放了现有大规模基础模型的潜在空间能力，为它们的更广泛应用铺平了道路。

Abstract

Representation learning with Vision Transformers (ViTs) has advanced rapidly, yet the utility of large-scale models in spatially sensitive tasks is hindered by spurious tokens. Prior efforts to mitigate this have been limited, often defining these artifacts narrowly, for example, as simple high-norm outliers. We argue that this scope is insufficient. For dense prediction tasks, we posit that any token failing to encode location-aligned semantics should be treated as a spurious artifact. This broader definition reveals a more complex problem, leading us to systematically categorize and characterize three fundamental types of spurious tokens that corrupt spatial representations. Based on this comprehensive diagnosis, we propose UniRefiner, a universal refinement framework that teaches pre-trained ViTs to self-dispose of these artifacts. UniRefiner uses contrastive registers to explicitly isolate and redistribute spurious tokens via a dual objective: (i) it aligns image tokens with filtered regular tokens to preserve semantics, and (ii) it aligns register tokens with detected spurious tokens to capture the spurious signals. Our method requires only a few epochs of fine-tuning on ~5k images to refine diverse ViTs, including massive models like EVA-CLIP-8B and InternViT-6B. Experiments demonstrate consistent and significant improvements: notably, the refined EVA-CLIP-8B achieves 51.9\% mIoU on ADE20K (+9.4\%), surpassing specialized vision models like DINOv2 (49.1\%), while zero-shot segmentation accuracy improves by up to 22\%. UniRefiner unlocks the latent spatial potential of existing large-scale foundation models, paving the way for their broader application.

item.title: optimize_anything: A Universal API for Optimizing any Text Parameter
item.author: Agrawal, Lakshya A, Lee, Donghyun, Tan, Shangyin, Ma, Wenjie, Elmaaroufi, Karim, Sandadi, Rohit, Seshia, Sanjit A., Sen, Koushik, Klein, Dan, Stoica, Ion, Gonzalez, Joseph E., Khattab, Omar, Dimakis, Alexandros G., Zaharia, Matei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究证明了一个基于大语言模型的单一优化系统能够跨多个不同领域达到最先进水平，通过文本优化和搜索算法实现了显著的性能提升。

背景: 优化问题通常需要专门的工具，但本文探讨了一个基于大语言模型的单一系统是否能在不同领域匹配这些专用工具。

目的: 展示当优化问题被表述为改进由评分函数评估的文本工件时，单一AI优化系统能够实现跨六个不同任务的最先进结果。

方法: 系统支持单任务搜索、多任务搜索（带跨问题迁移）以及泛化到未见输入；通过消融实验分析跨三个领域的行动导向的侧信息与仅评分反馈的对比，以及多任务搜索与独立优化的比较。

主要发现: 系统发现了几乎使Gemini Flash的ARC-AGI准确率提高三倍的代理架构（从32.5%到89.5%），找到削减云成本40%的调度算法，生成87%匹配或优于PyTorch的CUDA内核，并优于AlphaEvolve报告的圆排列解决方案（n=26）；行动导向的侧信息比仅评分反馈收敛更快且最终得分更高；多任务搜索在等效预算下通过跨任务迁移优于独立优化。

结论: 首次证明基于LLM的文本优化是一种通用的问题解决范式，将传统需要特定领域算法的任务统一在单一框架下；系统已开源。

翻译: Can a single LLM-based optimization system match specialized tools across fundamentally different domains? We show that when optimization problems are formulated as improving a text artifact evaluated by a scoring function, a single AI-based optimization system-supporting single-task search, multi-task search with cross-problem transfer, and generalization to unseen inputs-achieves state-of-the-art results across six diverse tasks. Our system discovers agent architectures that nearly triple Gemini Flash's ARC-AGI accuracy (32.5% to 89.5%), finds scheduling algorithms that cut cloud costs by 40%, generates CUDA kernels where 87% match or beat PyTorch, and outperforms AlphaEvolve's reported circle packing solution (n=26). Ablations across three domains reveal that actionable side information yields faster convergence and substantially higher final scores than score-only feedback, and that multi-task search outperforms independent optimization given equivalent per-problem budget through cross-task transfer, with benefits scaling with the number of related tasks. Together, we show for the first time that text optimization with LLM-based search is a general-purpose problem-solving paradigm, unifying tasks traditionally requiring domain-specific algorithms under a single framework. We open-source optimize_anything with support for multiple backends as part of the GEPA project at this https URL .

Abstract

Can a single LLM-based optimization system match specialized tools across fundamentally different domains? We show that when optimization problems are formulated as improving a text artifact evaluated by a scoring function, a single AI-based optimization system-supporting single-task search, multi-task search with cross-problem transfer, and generalization to unseen inputs-achieves state-of-the-art results across six diverse tasks. Our system discovers agent architectures that nearly triple Gemini Flash's ARC-AGI accuracy (32.5% to 89.5%), finds scheduling algorithms that cut cloud costs by 40%, generates CUDA kernels where 87% match or beat PyTorch, and outperforms AlphaEvolve's reported circle packing solution (n=26). Ablations across three domains reveal that actionable side information yields faster convergence and substantially higher final scores than score-only feedback, and that multi-task search outperforms independent optimization given equivalent per-problem budget through cross-task transfer, with benefits scaling with the number of related tasks. Together, we show for the first time that text optimization with LLM-based search is a general-purpose problem-solving paradigm, unifying tasks traditionally requiring domain-specific algorithms under a single framework. We open-source optimize\_anything with support for multiple backends as part of the GEPA project at this https URL .

item.title: Cross-View Attention Fusion Net: A Prior-Guided Dual-View Representation Learning for Cardiac Output Estimation from Short-Term PPG Signals
item.author: Yaowen Zhang, Bo Cui, Libera Fresiello, Peter H. Veltink, Dirk W. Donker, Ying Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种基于双视图深度学习的跨视图注意力融合网络（CVAF-Net），用于从短时固定长度的光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号中准确估计心输出量（CO）。

背景: 心输出量由心脏功能和血管张力共同决定，从PPG信号中准确估计心输出量具有前景但极具挑战性。传统基于特征的方法依赖准确的脉搏检测，可能遗漏潜在的时间关系；而全端到端深度学习模型虽然直接从原始PPG学习，但往往未能充分利用已建立的PPG先验信息。

目的: 提出一种先验引导的双视图深度学习模型（CVAF-Net），用于从短时固定长度的PPG片段中估计心输出量。

方法: CVAF-Net将原始PPG作为时间视图，将特征序列图（FSM）作为结构化先验引导视图，通过跨视图注意力机制融合这两种表示。模型在三个数据集上进行了独立评估：模拟脉搏波（3323名受试者）、血管收缩诱发（79名受试者）以及静息/骑行活动（10名受试者），并与多种机器学习和深度学习基准方法进行了比较。

主要发现: CVAF-Net在大多数基准方法中表现优异，性能与最先进的基于Transformer的模型相当。在模拟数据上，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.19 L/min（MAPE: 3.95%），在真实场景中误差也很低（最小MAE: 1.20 L/min）。与领先的基于Transformer的模型相比，CVAF-Net减少了十二倍的浮点运算量（FLOPs）。生理学一致性分析显示，估计的心输出量与年龄（ρ= -0.274）、心率（ρ= 0.894）和全身血管阻力（ρ= -0.740）的相关性符合预期。

结论: CVAF-Net提供了一种准确、计算高效且可泛化的方法，用于基于可穿戴设备的连续心输出量监测。

翻译: Accurate cardiac output (CO) estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) is promising for unobtrusive hemodynamic monitoring, but remains difficult since CO is jointly determined by cardiac function and vascular tone. Conventional feature-based models use physiologically meaningful PPG descriptors, yet depend on accurate pulse detection and may miss latent temporal relationships. In contrast, fully end-to-end deep learning models learn directly from raw PPG but often underuse established PPG-derived prior information. Here, we introduce the Cross-View Attention Fusion Network (CVAF-Net), a prior-guided dual-view deep learning model for CO estimation from short, fixed-length PPG segments. CVAF-Net processes raw PPG as a temporal view and a feature sequence map (FSM) as a structured prior-guided view, and fuses the two representations through cross-view attention. The model was independently evaluated using 5-, 15-, and 30-s segments from three datasets: simulated pulse waves (3323 subjects), vasoconstriction provocation (79 subjects), and resting/cycling activities (10 subjects), and was compared with multiple machine learning and deep learning benchmarks. CVAF-Net outperformed most benchmark methods and achieved performance comparable to a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.19 L/min (MAPE: 3.95%) on simulated data and high accuracy in real-world settings (minimum MAE: 1.20 L/min). Importantly, CVAF-Net reduced FLOPs by twelvefold compared with the leading Transformer-based model. Plausibility analysis showed physiologically consistent CO estimates, with expected correlations with age (ρ= -0.274), heart rate (ρ= 0.894), and systemic vascular resistance (ρ= -0.740). These findings indicate that CVAF-Net provides an accurate, computationally efficient, and generalizable approach for continuous wearable-based CO monitoring.

Abstract

Accurate cardiac output (CO) estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) is promising for unobtrusive hemodynamic monitoring, but remains difficult since CO is jointly determined by cardiac function and vascular tone. Conventional feature-based models use physiologically meaningful PPG descriptors, yet depend on accurate pulse detection and may miss latent temporal relationships. In contrast, fully end-to-end deep learning models learn directly from raw PPG but often underuse established PPG-derived prior information. Here, we introduce the Cross-View Attention Fusion Network (CVAF-Net), a prior-guided dual-view deep learning model for CO estimation from short, fixed-length PPG segments. CVAF-Net processes raw PPG as a temporal view and a feature sequence map (FSM) as a structured prior-guided view, and fuses the two representations through cross-view attention. The model was independently evaluated using 5-, 15-, and 30-s segments from three datasets: simulated pulse waves (3323 subjects), vasoconstriction provocation (79 subjects), and resting/cycling activities (10 subjects), and was compared with multiple machine learning and deep learning benchmarks. CVAF-Net outperformed most benchmark methods and achieved performance comparable to a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.19 L/min (MAPE: 3.95%) on simulated data and high accuracy in real-world settings (minimum MAE: 1.20 L/min). Importantly, CVAF-Net reduced FLOPs by twelvefold compared with the leading Transformer-based model. Plausibility analysis showed physiologically consistent CO estimates, with expected correlations with age ($ρ= -0.274$), heart rate ($ρ= 0.894$), and systemic vascular resistance ($ρ= -0.740$). These findings indicate that CVAF-Net provides an accurate, computationally efficient, and generalizable approach for continuous wearable-based CO monitoring.

item.title: Tango3D: Towards Alignment for Global and Local 2D-3D Correspondence
item.author: Zebin He, Mingxin Yang, Shuhui Yang, Hanxiao Sun, Xintong Han, Chunchao Guo, Wenhan Luo
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Tango3D是一个统一了密集对应关系和全局检索的3D基础模型，通过几何感知的2D视觉骨干网络和预训练的3D VAE实现像素到点的细粒度对齐和全局语义对齐，并采用三阶段渐进式训练策略来稳定联合学习。

背景: 现有的3D基础模型通常将点云与冻结的视觉-语言空间（如CLIP）对齐，通过将3D形状压缩为全局向量来实现强大的跨模态检索，但这种仅全局的对齐无法建立细粒度的像素到点对应关系。

目的: 为了解决现有模型无法建立细粒度像素到点对应关系的问题，提出Tango3D，旨在统一密集对应关系和全局检索能力。

方法: 使用几何感知的2D视觉骨干网络和预训练的3D VAE将图像编码为2D补丁，将点云编码为3D标记，并将它们映射到单一共享空间中；引入三阶段渐进式训练策略以稳定密集和全局目标的联合学习。

主要发现: 实验表明，该模型成功实现了对象级像素到点对齐，同时保持了竞争力的全局检索能力，这是现有3D基础模型所不具备的联合能力。

结论: 通过建立细粒度对齐特征空间，Tango3D将丰富的语义注入到纯几何3D标记中，为广泛的密集3D下游任务铺平了道路。

翻译: Existing 3D foundation models typically align point clouds to frozen vision-language spaces like CLIP, which achieve strong cross-modal retrieval by compressing 3D shape into a global vector. However, this global-only alignment cannot establish fine-grained pixel-to-point correspondence. To solve this, we present Tango3D, a foundation model that unifies dense correspondence and global retrieval. We use a geometry-aware 2D visual backbone and a pretrained 3D VAE to encode images into 2D patches and point clouds into 3D tokens. These are mapped into a single shared space to achieve both local pixel-to-point alignment and global semantic alignment. To stabilize the joint learning of dense and global objectives, we introduce a three-stage progressive training strategy. Experiments show our model successfully achieves object-level pixel-to-point alignment while maintaining competitive global retrieval, a joint capability not offered by existing 3D foundation models. By establishing a fine-grained alignment feature space, Tango3D injects rich semantics into purely geometric 3D tokens, paving the way for a wide range of dense 3D downstream tasks.

By establishing a fine-grained alignment feature space, Tango3D injects rich semantics into purely geometric 3D tokens, paving the way for a wide range of dense 3D downstream tasks.

item.title: GeoMamba: A Geometry-driven MambaVision Framework and Dataset for Fine-grained Optical-SAR Object Retrieval
item.author: Tiantong Fang, Xiuwei Wang, Jing Xiao, Wujie Zhou, Liang Liao, Mi Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为GeoMamba的几何驱动框架，用于解决光学与合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像之间未对齐条件下的细粒度目标检索问题。

背景: 多源遥感技术能够对地面物体进行互补观测，但在光学与SAR图像未对齐的情况下，跨模态细粒度目标检索仍面临挑战。实际应用中，光学-SAR检索受到显著的模态差异、散斑噪声和结构不一致性的影响，限制了鲁棒的跨模态表示学习。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，本文提出了GeoMamba框架，旨在提高光学-SAR细粒度检索的鲁棒性。

方法: GeoMamba框架包含两个主要模块：几何特征注入（GFI）模块，用于增强跨模态特征交互并引入结构先验，从而提高SAR表示的鲁棒性并促进几何一致的特征学习；几何一致性约束（GCC）模块，结合深度监督（DS）策略，利用经典算子施加分层几何约束，以在表示学习过程中保留信息丰富的物体结构。此外，作者还构建了一个名为FGOS-as的新数据集，包含11个航空航天和海事类别，用于在现实遥感场景中评估未对齐跨模态细粒度目标检索。

主要发现: 在FGOS-as数据集上的广泛实验表明，GeoMamba优于现有方法，在所有到所有检索设置中实现了63.3%的平均精度（mAP）和77.0%的排名-1准确率。

结论: GeoMamba框架在光学-SAR细粒度目标检索任务中表现出色，证明了其在处理未对齐跨模态数据方面的有效性。

翻译: Multi-source remote sensing enables complementary observation of ground objects, while cross-modal fine-grained object retrieval remains challenging, especially under unaligned optical and SAR conditions. Unlike conventional retrieval settings that rely on paired or spatially aligned samples, practical optical-SAR retrieval is affected by substantial modality discrepancy, speckle noise, and structural inconsistency, which limit robust cross-modal representation learning. To address this problem, we propose GeoMamba, a geometry-driven framework tailored for optical-SAR fine-grained retrieval. Specifically, GeoMamba introduces a Geometric Feature Injection (GFI) module that enhances cross-modal feature interaction and incorporates structural priors, thereby improving the robustness of SAR representations and promoting geometry-consistent feature learning. In addition, a Geometric Consistency Constraint (GCC) module, together with a Deep Supervision (DS) strategy, imposes hierarchical geometric constraints using classical operators, which helps preserve informative object structures during representation learning. We further construct a new dataset, FGOS-as, containing 11 aerospace and maritime categories for evaluating unaligned cross-modal fine-grained object retrieval in realistic remote sensing scenarios. Extensive experiments on FGOS-as demonstrate that GeoMamba outperforms existing methods, achieving 63.3% mAP and 77.0% Rank-1 accuracy in all-to-all retrieval setting.

Abstract

Multi-source remote sensing enables complementary observation of ground objects, while cross-modal fine-grained object retrieval remains challenging, especially under unaligned optical and SAR conditions. Unlike conventional retrieval settings that rely on paired or spatially aligned samples, practical optical-SAR retrieval is affected by substantial modality discrepancy, speckle noise, and structural inconsistency, which limit robust cross-modal representation learning. To address this problem, we propose GeoMamba, a geometry-driven framework tailored for optical-SAR fine-grained retrieval. Specifically, GeoMamba introduces a Geometric Feature Injection (GFI) module that enhances cross-modal feature interaction and incorporates structural priors, thereby improving the robustness of SAR representations and promoting geometry-consistent feature learning. In addition, a Geometric Consistency Constraint (GCC) module, together with a Deep Supervision (DS) strategy, imposes hierarchical geometric constraints using classical operators, which helps preserve informative object structures during representation learning. We further construct a new dataset, FGOS-as, containing 11 aerospace and maritime categories for evaluating unaligned cross-modal fine-grained object retrieval in realistic remote sensing scenarios. Extensive experiments on FGOS-as demonstrate that GeoMamba outperforms existing methods, achieving 63.3% mAP and 77.0% Rank-1 accuracy in all-to-all retrieval setting.

item.title: MSAlign: Aligning Molecule and Mass Spectra Foundation Models for Metabolite Identification
item.author: Paul Krzakala, Gabriel Melo, Camille Lançon, Charlotte Laclau, Rémi Flamary, Etienne Thévenot, Florence d'Alché-Buc
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MSAlign的统一框架，用于从质谱数据中准确识别代谢物，通过将质谱模型与分子模型对齐来学习共享表示空间，并解决了评估中的数据划分问题。

背景: 从质谱数据中准确识别代谢物（小分子）是代谢组学中的一个核心挑战，在药物发现、环境分析和临床研究中具有广泛应用。

目的: 解决分子检索任务，即根据一组候选分子从其MS/MS光谱中恢复代谢物的化学结构。

方法: 提出了一个统一框架，包含基于表示对齐和对比学习的最新方法。引入了MSAlign，受视觉-语言模型中多模态对齐的启发，通过轻量级MLP投影训练候选对比目标，学习共享表示空间。

主要发现: MSAlign简单易实现，训练速度快，并在所有基准测试中始终优于现有方法。

结论: 通过引入分布偏移的定量度量来评估现有基准中的划分策略，并公开了所有数据集、划分、候选集以及MSAlign和基线的统一实现，以支持可重复研究。

翻译: Accurately identifying metabolites i.e. small molecules from mass spectrometry data remains a core challenge in metabolomics, with broad applications in drug discovery, environmental analysis, and clinical research. We address the Molecule Retrieval task, which consists in recovering the chemical structure of a metabolite from its MS/MS spectrum given a set of candidate molecules. While the recent release of benchmark datasets such as MassSpecGym and Spectraverse has considerably accelerated the development of novel machine learning approaches, the complexity of data preprocessing pipelines and the lack of unified implementations make methods and results difficult to reproduce and compare. We make three contributions. First, we propose a unified framework encompassing recent approaches based on representation alignment and contrastive learning. Second, we introduce MSAlign, inspired by multimodal alignment in vision-language models, which learns a shared representation space by aligning two frozen foundation models (DreaMS for mass spectra and ChemBERTa for molecules) through lightweight MLP projections trained with a candidate-based contrastive objective. MSAlign is simple to implement, fast to train and consistently outperforms existing approaches across all benchmarks. Third, we investigate a long-standing evaluation problem: data splitting strategies in molecule retrieval implicitly trade off data leakage against domain shift. We formalize this tension by introducing a quantitative measure of distribution shift, and use it to evaluate splitting strategies in existing benchmarks. All datasets, splits, candidate sets, and a unified implementation of MSAlign and baselines are publicly released to support reproducible research.

Abstract

Accurately identifying metabolites i.e. small molecules from mass spectrometry data remains a core challenge in metabolomics, with broad applications in drug discovery, environmental analysis, and clinical research. We address the Molecule Retrieval task, which consists in recovering the chemical structure of a metabolite from its MS/MS spectrum given a set of candidate molecules. While the recent release of benchmark datasets such as MassSpecGym and Spectraverse has considerably accelerated the development of novel machine learning approaches, the complexity of data preprocessing pipelines and the lack of unified implementations make methods and results difficult to reproduce and compare. We make three contributions. First, we propose a unified framework encompassing recent approaches based on representation alignment and contrastive learning. Second, we introduce MSAlign, inspired by multimodal alignment in vision-language models, which learns a shared representation space by aligning two frozen foundation models (DreaMS for mass spectra and ChemBERTa for molecules) through lightweight MLP projections trained with a candidate-based contrastive objective. MSAlign is simple to implement, fast to train and consistently outperforms existing approaches across all benchmarks. Third, we investigate a long-standing evaluation problem: data splitting strategies in molecule retrieval implicitly trade off data leakage against domain shift. We formalize this tension by introducing a quantitative measure of distribution shift, and use it to evaluate splitting strategies in existing benchmarks. All datasets, splits, candidate sets, and a unified implementation of MSAlign and baselines are publicly released to support reproducible research.

item.title: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
item.author: Wei, Jinbiao, Ma, Qianran, Zhao, Yilun, Zhou, Xiao, Ni, Kangqi, Gan, Guo, Cohan, Arman
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OpenComputer是一个用于构建可验证软件世界的框架，旨在为计算机使用代理提供验证基础。

背景: 为了解决计算机使用代理在执行任务时缺乏可靠验证的问题。

目的: 构建一个可验证的软件世界，以评估和改进计算机使用代理的能力。

方法: 框架集成了四个组件：特定应用的状态验证器、自进化的验证层、任务生成管道以及评估工具。

主要发现: 硬编码验证器比大语言模型作为评判者的评估更接近人类裁决，特别是在成功取决于细粒度应用状态的情况下。

结论: 前沿代理在端到端完成方面面临困难，开源模型在OSWorld-Verified分数上出现显著下降，暴露了计算机自动化中存在的持续差距。

翻译: 我们提出了OpenComputer，这是一个用于为计算机使用代理构建可验证软件世界的基于验证器的框架。OpenComputer集成了四个组件：(1)特定应用的状态验证器，它们在真实应用程序上暴露结构化的检查端点；(2)自进化的验证层，利用执行基础反馈提高验证器的可靠性；(3)任务生成管道，合成逼真且机器可检查的桌面任务；(4)评估工具，记录完整轨迹并计算可审计的部分信用奖励。在其当前形式下，OpenComputer涵盖了33个桌面应用程序和1000个最终确定的任务，包括浏览器、办公工具、创意软件、开发环境、文件管理器和通信应用程序。实验表明，OpenComputer的硬编码验证器比大语言模型作为评判者的评估更接近人类裁决，特别是在成功取决于细粒度应用状态的情况下。前沿代理在端到端完成方面面临困难，尽管取得了部分进展，开源模型在OSWorld-Verified分数上出现显著下降，暴露了计算机自动化中存在的持续差距。

深度解读

标题：《OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents》。 * 作者：Jinbiao Wei, Qianran Ma, Yilun Zhao, Xiao Zhou, Kangqi Ni, Guo Gan, Arman Cohan。 * 主题：cs.AI, cs.SE。 * 内容：大部分是二进制流（`stream` 论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了名为 OpenComputer 的系统，这是一个用于计算机使用代理的可验证软件世界，旨在评估和提升 AI 代理在软件任务中的表现。

Abstract

We present OpenComputer, a verifier-grounded framework for constructing verifiable software worlds for computer-use agents. OpenComputer integrates four components: (1) app-specific state verifiers that expose structured inspection endpoints over real applications, (2) a self-evolving verification layer that improves verifier reliability using execution-grounded feedback, (3) a task-generation pipeline that synthesizes realistic and machine-checkable desktop tasks, and (4) an evaluation harness that records full trajectories and computes auditable partial-credit rewards. In its current form, OpenComputer covers 33 desktop applications and 1,000 finalized tasks spanning browsers, office tools, creative software, development environments, file managers, and communication applications. Experiments show that OpenComputer's hard-coded verifiers align more closely with human adjudication than LLM-as-judge evaluation, especially when success depends on fine-grained application state. Frontier agents struggle with end-to-end completion despite partial progress, and open-source models exhibit sharp drops from their OSWorld-Verified scores, exposing a persistent gap in robust computer automation.

item.title: LaCoVL-FER: Landmark-Guided Contrastive Learning Network with Vision-Language Enhancement for Facial Expression Recognition
item.author: Jiaxin Wang, Muwei Jian, Hui Yu, Junyu Dong, Yifan Xia
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LaCoVL-FER是一种用于面部表情识别的新颖方法，通过结合面部地标和视觉语言模型来提高识别性能。

背景: 在野外环境下，面部表情识别面临姿态、遮挡和光照等未受控变化的挑战。现有的基于注意力的方法主要依赖视觉外观线索，存在注意力冗余和不稳定的问题，限制了其在复杂场景中的性能。

目的: 为了解决现有方法中的注意力冗余和不稳定问题，提出了一种新颖的地标引导对比学习网络与视觉语言增强相结合的方法，以提高面部表情识别的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

方法: 1. 设计了地标引导自适应编码器（LGAE），通过双分支门控交叉注意力机制引入几何先验，实现地标几何特征与视觉外观特征的自适应融合。2. 提出了视觉语言增强策略（VLES），利用表情相关特征来细化冻结预训练CLIP图像编码器提取的通用视觉特征。3. 使用表情条件提示（ECP）机制进一步调整冻结预训练CLIP文本编码器的固定类别级提示的文本特征，生成更具实例感知的文本表示。4. 将视觉和文本表示对齐为语义先验以增强面部表情识别的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

主要发现: 在三个具有代表性的真实世界面部表情识别数据集（RAF-DB、FERPlus和AffectNet）上，LaCoVL-FER的性能优于最先进的方法。

结论: LaCoVL-FER通过结合地标几何先验和视觉语言语义先验，显著提高了面部表情识别在复杂场景下的鲁棒性和泛化能力，实验结果验证了其有效性。

翻译: LaCoVL-FER是一种新颖的地标引导对比学习网络与视觉语言增强相结合的方法，用于面部表情识别。该方法整合了来自面部地标和视觉语言模型的几何先验和语义先验。具体而言，设计了一种地标引导自适应编码器（LGAE），通过双分支门控交叉注意力机制引入几何先验，实现了地标几何特征与视觉外观特征的自适应融合，从而产生表情相关特征，聚焦关键面部区域并抑制噪声干扰。同时，提出了视觉语言增强策略（VLES），利用表情相关特征来细化冻结预训练CLIP图像编码器提取的通用视觉特征，生成特定的视觉表示。基于这些表示，使用了表情条件提示（ECP）机制进一步调整冻结预训练CLIP文本编码器的固定类别级提示的文本特征，生成更具实例感知的文本表示。这些视觉和文本表示被对齐为语义先验，以增强面部表情识别的鲁棒性和泛化能力。定量和定性实验表明，LaCoVL-FER在三个具有代表性的真实世界面部表情识别数据集（RAF-DB、FERPlus和AffectNet）上优于最先进的方法。代码可在https://github.com/ylin06804/LaCoVL-FER获取。

Abstract

Facial Expression Recognition (FER) in the wild is still challenging due to uncontrolled variations in pose, occlusion, and illumination. Most existing attention-based methods primarily rely on visual appearance cues, suffering from attention redundancy and instability, which limits their performance in complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose a novel landmark-guided contrastive learning network with vision-language enhancement for FER (LaCoVL-FER), which integrates geometric priors from facial landmarks and semantic priors from a vision-language model. Specifically, a Landmark-Guided Adaptive Encoder (LGAE) is designed to introduce geometric priors through a Bi-branch Gated Cross Attention (BGCA) mechanism, which achieves adaptive fusion of landmark-based geometric and visual appearance features to produce expression-relevant features, thereby focusing on key facial regions and suppressing noise interference. In parallel, a Vision-Language Enhancement Strategy (VLES) is presented to leverage the expression-relevant features to refine the generalizable visual features extracted by the frozen pretrained CLIP image encoder, yielding expression-specific visual representations. Based on these representations, an Expression-Conditioned Prompting (ECP) mechanism is utilized to further adapt the textual features of fixed class-level prompts from the frozen pretrained CLIP text encoder, generating more instance-aware textual representations. These visual-textual representations are aligned as semantic priors to enhance the robustness and generalization of FER. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our LaCoVL-FER outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three representative real-world FER datasets, including RAF-DB, FERPlus, and AffectNet. The code is available at https://github.com/ylin06804/LaCoVL-FER.

item.title: FineBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Human Activity Understanding
item.author: Gueter Josmy Faure, Min-Hung Chen, Jia-Fong Yeh, Hung-Ting Su, Winston H. Hsu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: FineBench是一个专注于细粒度视频理解的人本导向视频问答基准，包含大量长视频和密集标注；FineAgent是一个模块化框架，通过局部定位器和描述符增强开源VLMs的性能。

背景: 现有的视觉语言模型在细粒度理解上存在困难，且现有的人本导向基准缺乏长视频、密集问答覆盖和逐帧空间/时间定位的大规模评估。

目的: 构建FineBench基准以评估细粒度理解，并提出FineAgent框架以增强当前视觉语言模型在细粒度人本导向视频理解方面的能力。

方法: FineBench包含199,420个选择题对，覆盖64个长视频，聚焦人物移动、交互和物体操作；FineAgent是一个模块化框架，利用局部定位器和描述符增强模型。

主要发现: 专有模型如GPT-5表现尚可，但开源VLMs显著表现不佳，特别是在多人场景的空间推理以及区分人类动作和交互的细微差异方面。

结论: FineBench为细粒度人本导向视频理解研究提供了严谨的测试床，FineAgent为提升当前VLMs的推理能力提供了实用方法。

翻译: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) 在通用视频理解方面展示了显著能力，但在细粒度理解上往往难以应对现实应用中对人类动作和交互进行细致解读的需求。虽然一些近期的人本导向基准评估了模型的公平性/伦理、情感感知等行为方面，但它们并未结合长视频、非常密集的问答覆盖以及大规模的逐帧空间/时间定位。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍了FineBench，这是一个专门设计用于评估细粒度理解的人本导向视频问答基准。FineBench包含199,420个选择题对，在64个长视频（每段15分钟）上密集标注，重点关注详细的人物移动、人物交互和物体操作，包括组合动作。广泛的评估显示，虽然像GPT-5这样的专有模型取得了令人满意的表现，但当前的开源VLMs显著表现不佳，特别是在多人场景中的空间推理以及区分人类动作和交互的细微差异方面。为了解决这些已识别的弱点，我们提出了FineAgent，这是一个模块化框架，通过利用局部定位器和描述符来增强VLMs。实验表明，FineAgent在各种开源VLMs的FineBench性能上持续提升了表现。FineBench为未来细粒度人本导向视频理解研究提供了严谨的测试床，而FineAgent为增强当前VLMs中的此类推理能力提供了一种实用方法。

Abstract

Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in general video understanding, yet they often struggle with the fine-grained comprehension crucial for real-world applications requiring nuanced interpretation of human actions and interactions. While some recent human-centric benchmarks evaluate aspects of model behaviour such as fairness/ethics, emotion perception, and broader human-centric metrics, they do not combine long-form videos, very dense QA coverage, and frame-level spatial/temporal grounding at scale. To bridge this gap, we introduce FineBench, a human-centric video question answering (VQA) benchmark specifically designed to assess fine-grained understanding. FineBench comprises 199,420 multiple-choice QA pairs densely annotated across 64 long-form videos (15 minutes each), focusing on detailed person movement, person interaction, and object manipulation, including compositional actions. Our extensive evaluation reveals that while proprietary models like GPT-5 achieve respectable performance, current open-source VLMs significantly underperform, struggling particularly with spatial reasoning in multi-person scenes and distinguishing subtle differences in human movements and interactions. To address these identified weaknesses, we propose FineAgent, a modular framework that enhances VLMs by leveraging a Localizer and a Descriptor. Experiments show that FineAgent consistently improves the performance of various open VLMs on FineBench. FineBench provides a rigorous testbed for future research into fine-grained human-centric video understanding, while FineAgent offers a practical approach to enhance such reasoning in current VLMs.

item.title: Hierarchical Contrastive Learning for Multi-Domain Protein-Ligand Binding
item.author: Shuo Zhang, Rongqi Hong, Huifeng Zhang, Jian K. Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HCLBind是一个自监督框架，用于预测多结构域蛋白与配体的结合亲和力，通过解耦几何表示学习和亲和力回归，并利用分层 decoy 策略和混合架构来学习结合界面特征。

背景: 多结构域蛋白的结合亲和力预测具有挑战性，现有几何深度学习方法通常将蛋白视为静态图，存在刚性假设和柔性区域噪声问题。

目的: 提出HCLBind框架，通过自监督学习解耦几何表示学习和亲和力回归，学习稳健的结合物理语法，并明确优先考虑结构域界面。

方法: 采用从通用到特定的预训练范式，提出分层 decoy 策略（单结构域蛋白通过坐标扰动学习局部物理化学约束，多结构域复合物通过结构域旋转学习全局构象几何），结合域门控图注意力网络和跨模态注意力，并在蛋白和配体基础模型上应用 LoRA。

主要发现: 在 PDBBind 上的实验表明 HCLBind 有效地学习了判别性界面特征，并提供了稳健的不确定性估计，克服了标准监督学习的局限性。

结论: HCLBind 能够有效预测多结构域蛋白的结合亲和力，克服了现有方法的局限性。

翻译: 预测多结构域蛋白与配体的结合亲和力仍然难以解决，其中结构域间的动力学决定了分子识别。现有的几何深度学习方法通常将蛋白视为静态图，受到刚性假设和柔性区域噪声的影响。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 HCLBind，这是一个自监督框架，它将几何表示学习与亲和力回归解耦。HCLBind 利用 Q-BioLiP 数据库上的通用到特定的预训练范式来学习结合的稳健物理语法。我们提出了一种新颖的分层 decoy 策略：模型通过单结构域蛋白中的蛋白坐标扰动学习局部物理化学约束，通过多结构域复合物中的结构域旋转学习全局构象几何。我们的混合架构集成了域门控图注意力网络和跨模态注意力，以明确优先考虑结构域界面。此外，我们在蛋白和配体基础模型上应用了 LoRA，以确保高效优化同时保留进化知识。在 PDBBind 上的实验表明，HCLBind 有效地学习了判别性界面特征，并提供了稳健的不确定性估计，克服了标准监督学习的局限性。代码可在 https://github.com/jiankliu/HCLBind 获取。

Abstract

Predicting protein-ligand binding affinity remains intractable for multi-domain proteins, where inter-domain dynamics govern molecular recognition. Existing geometric deep learning methods typically treat proteins as monolithic static graphs, suffering from rigid-body assumptions and aleatoric noise in flexible regions. To address this, we introduced HCLBind, a self-supervised framework that decouples geometric representation learning from affinity regression. HCLBind leverages a general-to-specific pre-training paradigm on the Q-BioLiP database to learn a robust physical grammar of binding. We propose a novel hierarchical decoy strategy: the model learns local physicochemical constraints through protein coordinate perturbation in single-domain proteins and global conformational geometry through inter-domain rotation in multi-domain complexes. Our hybrid architecture integrates a domain-gated graph attention network and cross-modal attention to explicitly prioritize domain interfaces. Furthermore, we employ LoRA on protein and ligand foundation models, ensuring efficient optimization while preserving evolutionary knowledge. Experiments on PDBBind demonstrate that HCLBind effectively learns discriminative interface features and provides robust uncertainty estimation, overcoming the limitations of standard supervised learning. The code is available at https://github.com/jiankliu/HCLBind.

item.title: Where Does Authorship Signal Emerge in Encoder-Based Language Models?
item.author: Kulumba, Francis, Vimont, Guillaume, Romary, Laurent, Cafiero, Florian
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 相同预训练编码器、数据和损失函数的作者归属模型，仅因评分机制不同，性能差异可达四倍。

背景: 作者归属模型在预训练编码器、数据和损失函数相同的情况下，性能差异显著。

目的: 使用机制可解释性工具解释这种性能差异的来源。

方法: 使用机制可解释性工具，包括因果干预分析评分机制对编码器整合作者归属信号位置的影响，以及分析评分机制的梯度结构和训练动态。

主要发现: 风格特征在所有模型层中均可用，差异非源于表示质量；评分机制决定编码器在何处整合作者归属信号；平均池化迫使信号在早期至中期层整合，而晚期交互将其推迟至后期层；评分机制的梯度结构导致不同的学习轨迹。

结论: 评分机制是导致性能差异的关键因素，它决定了作者归属信号在编码器中的整合位置。

翻译: Authorship attribution models fine-tuned with the same pretrained encoder, data, and loss can differ four-fold in performance depending only on their scoring mechanism. We use mechanistic interpretability tools to explain this gap. Stylistic features such as word length, punctuation density, and function-word frequency are equally available at every layer in every model, including in an off-the-shelf control encoder, hence the gap not coming from representation quality. Instead, causal intervention shows that the scorer determines where the encoder consolidates authorship signal. Mean pooling forces consolidation by early to mid layers, while late interaction defers it to later layers. We further derive this difference from the gradient structure of each scorer, and training dynamics reveal distinct learning trajectories that follow from that difference.

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

Abstract

Authorship attribution models fine-tuned with the same pretrained encoder, data, and loss can differ four-fold in performance depending only on their scoring mechanism. We use mechanistic interpretability tools to explain this gap. Stylistic features such as word length, punctuation density, and function-word frequency are equally available at every layer in every model, including in an off-the-shelf control encoder, hence the gap not coming from representation quality. Instead, causal intervention shows that the scorer determines where the encoder consolidates authorship signal. Mean pooling forces consolidation by early to mid layers, while late interaction defers it to later layers. We further derive this difference from the gradient structure of each scorer, and training dynamics reveal distinct learning trajectories that follow from that difference.

item.title: Fast and Featureless Node Representation Learning with Partial Pairwise Supervision
item.author: Sujan Chakraborty, Saptarshi Bej
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: We introduce Contrastive FUSE, a fast and unified framework for scalable node representation learning in graphs with partially available pairwise node labels and no available node features.

背景: Existing methods often rely on node features or lack efficient optimization for large-scale graphs.

目的: To optimize a spectral contrastive objective integrating community-aware structural signals with signed pairwise constraints for scalable node representation learning.

方法: Replacing expensive modularity gradient with a lightweight approximation, using natural gradient decomposition and adaptive learning-rate scaling.

主要发现: Contrastive FUSE achieves competitive or superior contrastive classification performance without relying on node features, while offering substantial runtime gains over existing baselines.

结论: Coupling modularity-inspired structural learning with contrastive supervision is effective for efficient and scalable contrastive node representation learning.

翻译: 我们介绍了 Contrastive FUSE，这是一个快速且统一的框架，用于在部分可用成对节点标签且没有可用节点特征的图中进行可扩展的节点表示学习。与现有方法不同，我们直接优化一个谱对比目标，该目标将社区感知的结构信号与符号成对约束相结合。为了支持大规模训练，我们用轻量级近似替换了昂贵的模块性梯度，这在显著降低计算成本的同时保留了模块性的结构寻找行为。这产生了一种有效的优化方案，具有自然的梯度分解和自适应学习率缩放，即使在百万边图上也能实现快速迭代更新。在基准引用网络、大型共同购买图和 OGB 数据集上的广泛实验表明，Contrastive FUSE 在不依赖节点特征的情况下实现了竞争性或优越的对比分类性能，同时为现有基线提供了大量的运行时增益。这些结果凸显了将模块性启发的结构学习与对比监督相结合，以实现高效且可扩展的对比节点表示学习的有效性。

Abstract

We introduce Contrastive FUSE, a fast and unified framework for scalable node representation learning in graphs with partially available pairwise node labels and no available node features. Unlike existing methods, we directly optimize a spectral contrastive objective that integrates community-aware structural signals with signed pairwise constraints. To support large-scale training, we replace the expensive modularity gradient with a lightweight approximation, which preserves the structure-seeking behavior of modularity while reducing the computational cost significantly. This yields an efficient optimization scheme with a natural gradient decomposition and adaptive learning-rate scaling, enabling fast iterative updates even on million-edge graphs. Extensive experiments on benchmark citation networks, large co-purchase graphs, and OGB datasets show that Contrastive FUSE achieves competitive or superior contrastive classification performance without relying on node features, while offering substantial runtime gains over existing baselines. These results highlight the effectiveness of coupling modularity-inspired structural learning with contrastive supervision for efficient and scalable contrastive node representation learning.

item.title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents
item.author: Gu, Zhuohan, Zhang, Qizheng, Khattab, Omar, Madden, Samuel
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为PEEK的系统，旨在通过缓存和维持外部上下文的可重用方向性知识，提高长上下文大语言模型代理在重复上下文工作负载下的交互准确性和效率。

背景: 现有的大语言模型代理在处理长且重复的外部上下文（如文档语料库和代码仓库）时，往往只保留代理轨迹、对原始材料的被动访问或任务级策略，缺乏对重复上下文本身的方向性知识的保留。

目的: 引入PEEK系统，通过上下文映射缓存和维持可重用的方向性知识，使代理能够在外部上下文中获得持久性的窥视能力。

方法: PEEK系统包含一个可编程的缓存策略，由三个模块组成：用于从推理时信号中提取可迁移知识的蒸馏器、将其翻译为结构化编辑的制图师以及基于固定令牌预算的基于优先级的驱逐器。

主要发现: 在长上下文推理和信息聚合任务中，PEEK比强基线提高了6.3-34.0%的性能，且迭代次数减少93-145次，成本比最先进的提示学习框架ACE低1.7-5.8倍；在上下文学习任务中，PEEK在成本比ACE低1.4倍的情况下，提高了6.0-14.0%的解决率和7.8-12.1%的评分准确性。

结论: 这些结果表明，上下文映射有助于长上下文大语言模型代理更准确和高效地与重复的外部上下文交互，且这些收益在包括OpenAI Codex在内的不同大语言模型和代理架构中具有泛化性。

翻译: 大语言模型代理越来越多地操作在长且重复的外部上下文上，如文档语料库和代码仓库。在多次调用中，现有方法要么保留代理轨迹，要么保留对原始材料的被动访问，要么保留任务级策略。它们都没有保留我们认为对重复上下文工作负载最需要的东西：关于重复上下文本身的可重用方向性知识（例如，上下文包含什么，如何组织，以及历史上哪些实体、常量和模式是有用的）。我们介绍了PEEK，一个缓存并维持这种方向性知识作为上下文映射的系统：一个小的、固定大小的代理提示中的工件，使其能够对外部上下文进行持久的窥视。该映射由一个可编程的缓存策略维护，该策略包含三个模块：一个蒸馏器，用于从推理时信号中提取可迁移的知识；一个制图师，将其翻译为结构化编辑；以及一个基于优先级的驱逐器，用于强制执行固定的令牌预算。在长上下文推理和信息聚合方面，PEEK比强基线提高了6.3-34.0%，同时迭代次数减少了93-145次，成本比最先进的提示学习框架ACE低1.7-5.8倍。在上下文学习方面，PEEK在成本比ACE低1.4倍的情况下，提高了6.0-14.0%的解决率和7.8-12.1%的评分准确性。这些收益在不同的大语言模型和代理架构中泛化，包括OpenAI Codex，这是一个生产级的编码代理。这些结果共同表明，上下文映射有助于长上下文大语言模型代理更准确和高效地与重复的外部上下文交互。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决长上下文大语言模型智能体在处理长文本时容易迷失方向的问题。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为长上下文能力是当前大模型发展的关键趋势，能让智能体更好地处理复杂任务。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long and recurring external contexts, like document corpora and code repositories. Across invocations, existing approaches preserve either the agent's trajectory, passive access to raw material, or task-level strategies. None of them preserves what we argue is most needed for repeated same-context workloads: reusable orientation knowledge (e.g., what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, constants, and schemas have historically been useful) about the recurring context itself. We introduce PEEK, a system that caches and maintains this orientation knowledge as a context map: a small, constant-sized artifact in the agent's prompt that gives it a persistent peek into the external context. The map is maintained by a programmable cache policy with three modules: a Distiller that extracts transferable knowledge from inference-time signals, a Cartographer that translates it into structured edits, and a priority-based Evictor that enforces a fixed token budget. On long-context reasoning and information aggregation, PEEK improves over strong baselines by 6.3-34.0% while using 93-145 fewer iterations and incurring 1.7-5.8x lower cost than the state-of-the-art prompt-learning framework, ACE. On context learning, PEEK improves solving rate and rubric accuracy by 6.0-14.0% and 7.8-12.1%, respectively, at 1.4x lower cost than ACE. These gains generalize across LMs and agent architectures, including OpenAI Codex, a production-grade coding agent. Together, these results show that a context map helps long-context LLM agents interact with recurring external contexts more accurately and efficiently.

item.title: DASM: Domain-Aware Sharpness Minimization for Multi-Domain Voice Stream Steganalysis
item.author: Pengcheng Zhou, Pianran Guo, Shuhua Chen, Mengqin Zhao, Zhongliang Yang, Linna Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的优化器DASM，用于网络流媒体隐写分析，通过结合域感知锐度最小化和自适应域间隙调制策略，提高了模型在非同源数据分布下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

背景: 网络流媒体中信息隐藏的广泛使用构成了重大安全威胁，现有的隐写分析方法主要依赖于特定场景下的数据分布，难以适应非同源数据分布的实际检测需求。

目的: 为了解决现有主流模型在数据分布偏移下敏感且泛化能力有限的问题，提出一种新的优化器DASM。

方法: DASM包含两个核心机制：一是将域监督对比学习与锐度感知优化相结合，在保持域间特征分离的同时寻找平坦最小值；二是设计自适应域间隙调制策略，通过实时感知不同域的特征可分离性来动态校准优化损失权重。

主要发现: 通过Hessian分析发现，主流模型的损失景观由大量鞍点和尖锐局部最小值主导，导致其对数据分布偏移高度敏感，从根本上限制了泛化能力。

结论: 实验结果表明，该方法在性能上显著优于现有最先进的方法，并实现了卓越的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

翻译: The growing use of information hiding in network streaming media for covert communication poses a significant security threat, necessitating the development of robust detection technologies. However, existing steganalysis methods for network voice streams mostly rely on data distributions in specific scenarios, making it difficult to adapt to the practical detection needs of non-homologous data distributions. Through Hessian analysis, we find that the loss landscapes of mainstream models are dominated by numerous saddle points and sharp local minima, rendering them highly sensitive to data distribution shifts and fundamentally limiting generalization. Therefore, we propose a new optimizer, Domain-Aware Sharpness Minimization (DASM). The core mechanisms of DASM consist of two aspects: first, it integrates domain-supervised contrastive learning with sharpness-aware optimization, explicitly preserving inter-domain feature separation while seeking flat minima; second, we design an adaptive domain gap modulation strategy that dynamically calibrates the optimization loss weights by sensing the real-time feature separability of different domains. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin and achieves excellent generalization and robustness.

Abstract

The growing use of information hiding in network streaming media for covert communication poses a significant security threat, necessitating the development of robust detection technologies. However, existing steganalysis methods for network voice streams mostly rely on data distributions in specific scenarios, making it difficult to adapt to the practical detection needs of non-homologous data distributions. Through Hessian analysis, we find that the loss landscapes of mainstream models are dominated by numerous saddle points and sharp local minima, rendering them highly sensitive to data distribution shifts and fundamentally limiting generalization. Therefore, we propose a new optimizer, Domain-Aware Sharpness Minimization (DASM). The core mechanisms of DASM consist of two aspects: first, it integrates domain-supervised contrastive learning with sharpness-aware optimization, explicitly preserving inter-domain feature separation while seeking flat minima; second, we design an adaptive domain gap modulation strategy that dynamically calibrates the optimization loss weights by sensing the real-time feature separability of different domains. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin and achieves excellent generalization and robustness.

item.title: CogOmniControl: Reasoning-Driven Controllable Video Generation via Creative Intent Cognition
item.author: Yang, Hongji, Li, Songlian, Zhou, Yucheng, Zhao, Xiaotong, Zhao, Alan, Xu, Chengzhong, Shen, Jianbing
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CogOmniControl是一个推理驱动的框架，将可控视频生成分解为创意意图认知和生成两个部分，通过专门的CogVLM和CogOmniDiT模型，以及强化学习和对生成视频进行最佳选择，实现了在专业生产工作流程中的高性能表现。

背景: 现有的扩散模型在处理抽象、稀疏或复杂条件时表现脆弱，导致在专业生产工作流程如故事板草图和粘土渲染条件中性能不佳。现有的视频生成模型通过适配器注入条件或耦合通用视觉语言模型，存在能力差距，无法产生符合用户创意意图的视频。

目的: 提出CogOmniControl框架，旨在解决现有模型在处理复杂创意意图时的不足，实现更专业的视频生成，并释放CogVLM在指导视频生成方面的潜力。

方法: 1. 训练专门的CogVLM，使用真实的动漫制作数据，以生成更专业和清晰的输出，准确认知用户从稀疏和抽象条件中产生的创意意图，并将这些线索调整为密集的推理输出。2. CogOmniDiT通过上下文生成统一各种条件的控制，并通过强化学习与CogVLM的推理输出对齐。3. 利用CogVLM的强大指导能力，引入规划特定评估器和生成视频的最佳选择。4. 构建了CogReasonBench和CogControlBench基准测试，基于包含真实创意意图而非模拟的专业工作流程数据。

主要发现: 在两个基准测试中，CogOmniControl超过了现有的开源模型。

结论: CogOmniControl通过其推理驱动的框架和专门的模型，成功解决了现有视频生成模型在专业生产工作流程中的局限性，实现了更高质量和更符合用户意图的视频生成。

翻译: 最近的扩散模型在视频生成方面实现了强大的照片级真实感和流畅性，但在处理抽象、稀疏或复杂条件时仍然脆弱，导致在故事板草图和粘土渲染条件等专业生产工作流程中性能不佳。现有的视频生成模型要么通过适配器注入条件，要么在扩散骨干网络中耦合通用视觉语言模型，留下了能力差距，无法产生符合用户创意意图的视频。我们提出了CogOmniControl，这是一个推理驱动的框架，将可控视频生成分解为创意意图认知和生成。具体来说，我们使用真实的动漫制作数据训练了一个专门的CogVLM。与通用VLM相比，它生成更专业和清晰的输出，准确认知用户从稀疏和抽象条件中产生的创意意图，并将这些线索调整为密集的推理输出。此外，CogOmniDiT通过上下文生成统一各种条件的控制，并通过强化学习与CogVLM的推理输出对齐。此外，利用CogVLM在指导视频生成方面的强大能力，我们释放了其在规划特定评估器和实现生成视频的最佳选择方面的潜力。这种集成将整个框架转变为一个闭环的“ harness-like ”架构。我们进一步介绍了CogReasonBench和CogControlBench，它们是基于包含真实创意意图而非模拟的专业工作流程数据构建的。在两个基准测试上的实验表明，CogOmniControl超过了现有的开源模型。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Recent diffusion models achieve strong photorealism and fluency in video generation, yet remain fragile under abstract, sparse or complex conditions, leading to poor performance in professional production workflows such as storyboard sketches and clay render conditions. Existing video generation models, either inject conditions through adapters or couple a generic vision-language model (VLM) within a diffusion backbone, leaving a capability gap and failing to produce the videos that align with the user's creative intent. We present CogOmniControl, a reasoning-driven framework that factorizes controllable video generation into creative intent cognition and generation. Specifically, we train a specialized CogVLM using authentic anime production data. Compared to generic VLMs, it generates more professional and clear outputs, accurately cognizing user creative intent from sparse and abstract conditions and tuning these cues into dense reasoning output. Besides, CogOmniDiT unifies the controls from various conditions through in-context generation and is aligned to the CogVLM reasoning outputs via reinforcement learning. Furthermore, leveraging CogVLM's robust capability in guiding video generation, we release its potential in planning specific evaluators and enable a Best-of-N selection for the generated videos. This integration transforms the entire framework into a closed-loop "harness-like" architecture. We further introduce CogReasonBench and CogControlBench, built from professional workflows data that carry genuine creative intent rather than simulated ones. Experiments on two benchmarks show that CogOmniControl surpassed the existing open-source models. The project website: this https URL

item.title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration
item.author: Liu, Jiaqi, Qiu, Shi, Li, Mairui, Li, Bingzhou, Ji, Haonian, Han, Siwei, Ye, Xinyu, Xia, Peng, Dong, Zihan, Zhang, Congyu, Zhang, Letian, Chen, Guiming, Tu, Haoqin, Yang, Xinyu, Feng, Lu, Zhao, Xujiang, Chen, Haifeng, Zhou, Jiawei, Wang, Xiao, Zhang, Weitong, Zhu, Hongtu, Li, Yun, Mei, Jieru, Fei, Hongliang, Zhang, Jiaheng, Li, Linjie, Zhang, Linjun, Zhou, Yuyin, Wang, Sheng, Xiong, Caiming, Zou, James, Zheng, Zeyu, Xie, Cihang, Ding, Mingyu, Yao, Huaxiu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AutoResearchClaw是一个多智能体自主研究管道，旨在通过结构化辩论、自我修复执行器、可验证报告、人机协作和跨运行进化等机制，实现更接近真实科学研究的迭代过程。

背景: 现有自主研究系统通常将研究过程建模为线性管道，依赖单智能体推理，在执行失败时停止，且无法在运行间积累经验。

目的: 构建一个多智能体自主研究管道，以模拟真实科学研究的迭代过程，包括多视角挑战假设、从失败中学习以及跨周期积累经验。

方法: AutoResearchClaw基于五种机制构建：结构化多智能体辩论用于假设生成和结果分析；具有Pivot/Refine决策循环的自我修复执行器，将失败转化为信息；可验证的结果报告以防止伪造数字和幻觉引用；具有七种干预模式的人机协作；以及跨运行进化，将过去的错误转化为未来的安全措施。

主要发现: 在ARC-Bench基准测试上，AutoResearchClaw比AI Scientist v2高出54.7%；人机协作消融实验表明，在高杠杆决策点的精确、有针对性的协作始终优于完全自主和详尽的逐步监督。

结论: AutoResearchClaw被定位为研究放大器，旨在增强而非取代人类科学判断。

翻译: 自动化科学发现需要的不只是从想法生成论文。真实的研究是迭代的：假设从多个角度受到挑战，实验失败并指导下一次尝试，经验在周期间积累。现有的自主研究系统通常将这个过程建模为线性管道：它们依赖单智能体推理，在执行失败时停止，并且不在运行间携带经验。我们提出了AutoResearchClaw，一个基于五种机制的多智能体自主研究管道：用于假设生成和结果分析的结构化多智能体辩论；具有Pivot/Refine决策循环的自我修复执行器，将失败转化为信息；可验证的结果报告，防止伪造数字和幻觉引用；具有七种干预模式的人机协作，从完全自主到逐步监督；以及跨运行进化，将过去的错误转化为未来的安全措施。在ARC-Bench上，一个25主题实验阶段基准，AutoResearchClaw比AI Scientist v2高出54.7%。跨七种干预模式的人机协作消融实验表明，在高杠杆决策点的精确、有针对性的协作始终优于完全自主和详尽的逐步监督。我们将AutoResearchClaw定位为研究放大器，旨在增强而非取代人类科学判断。代码可在此 https URL 获取。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Automating scientific discovery requires more than generating papers from ideas. Real research is iterative: hypotheses are challenged from multiple perspectives, experiments fail and inform the next attempt, and lessons accumulate across cycles. Existing autonomous research systems often model this process as a linear pipeline: they rely on single-agent reasoning, stop when execution fails, and do not carry experience across runs. We present AutoResearchClaw, a multi-agent autonomous research pipeline built on five mechanisms: structured multi-agent debate for hypothesis generation and result analysis, a self-healing executor with a \textsc{Pivot}/\textsc{Refine} decision loop that transforms failures into information, verifiable result reporting that prevents fabricated numbers and hallucinated citations, human-in-the-loop collaboration with seven intervention modes spanning full autonomy to step-by-step oversight, and cross-run evolution that converts past mistakes into future safeguards. On ARC-Bench, a 25-topic experiment-stage benchmark, AutoResearchClaw outperforms AI Scientist v2 by 54.7%. A human-in-the-loop ablation across seven intervention modes reveals that precise, targeted collaboration at high-leverage decision points consistently outperforms both full autonomy and exhaustive step-by-step oversight. We position AutoResearchClaw as a research amplifier that augments rather than replaces human scientific judgment. Code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Stage-adaptive Token Selection for Efficient Omni-modal LLMs
item.author: Xin, Zijie, Yang, Jie, Zhao, Ruixiang, Wang, Tianyi, Rao, Fengyun, Lyu, Jing, Li, Xirong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SEATS是一种训练无关且分阶段自适应的令牌选择方法，旨在通过去除冗余令牌来提高Omni-modal大语言模型（om-LLMs）的推理效率。

背景: Omni-modal大语言模型通过将视频和音频编码为交错的时间对齐令牌序列来实现统一的音频-视觉理解，但处理这些密集的非文本令牌会带来巨大的计算开销。现有的训练无关令牌选择方法要么仅关注视觉输入，要么仅在LLM之前以固定的模态比例修剪om-LLM令牌，无法捕捉跨模态令牌重要性随层深度的演变。

目的: 为了解决现有方法无法捕捉跨模态令牌重要性随层深度演变的问题，提出一种训练无关、分阶段自适应的令牌选择方法（SEATS），以在保持性能的同时提高om-LLM的推理效率。

方法: SEATS方法首先在LLM之前通过注意力加权多样性选择去除时空冗余；在LLM内部，它跨块逐步修剪令牌，并使用查询相关性分数动态分配保留预算；在后期层，一旦跨模态融合完成，它移除所有剩余的非文本令牌。

主要发现: 研究发现视觉和音频依赖关系遵循块状模式，并随深度逐渐减弱，表明许多后期层的非文本令牌在跨模态融合后变得冗余。

结论: 在Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni上的实验表明，SEATS能有效提高推理效率。仅保留10%的视觉和音频令牌，实现了9.3倍的FLOPs减少和4.8倍的预填充加速，同时保持了96.3%的原始性能。

翻译: Omni-modal large language models (om-LLMs) 通过将视频和音频编码为在窗口级别交错的时间对齐令牌序列来实现统一的音频-视觉理解。然而，在整个LLM中处理这些密集的非文本令牌会产生巨大的计算开销。虽然训练无关的令牌选择可以降低这种成本，但现有方法要么仅关注视觉输入，要么仅在LLM之前以固定的模态比例修剪om-LLM令牌，未能捕捉跨模态令牌重要性随层深度的演变。为了解决这一局限性，我们首先分析了om-LLMs的逐层令牌依赖关系。我们发现视觉和音频依赖关系遵循块状模式，并随深度逐渐减弱，表明许多后期层的非文本令牌在跨模态融合后变得冗余。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了SEATS，一种用于高效om-LLM推理的训练无关、分阶段自适应令牌选择方法。在LLM之前，SEATS通过注意力加权多样性选择去除时空冗余。在LLM内部，它跨块逐步修剪令牌，并使用查询相关性分数动态分配保留预算。在后期层，一旦跨模态融合完成，它移除所有剩余的非文本令牌。在Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni上的实验表明，SEATS能有效提高推理效率。仅保留10%的视觉和音频令牌，实现了9.3倍的FLOPs减少和4.8倍的预填充加速，同时保持了96.3%的原始性能。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Omni-modal large language models (om-LLMs) achieve unified audio-visual understanding by encoding video and audio into temporally aligned token sequences interleaved at the window level. However, processing these dense non-textual tokens throughout the LLM incurs substantial computational overhead. Although training-free token selection can reduce this cost, existing methods either focus on visual-only inputs or prune om-LLM tokens only before the LLM with fixed per-modality ratios, failing to capture how cross-modal token importance evolves across layers. To address this limitation, we first analyze the layer-wise token dependency of om-LLMs. We find that visual and audio dependencies follow a block-wise pattern and gradually weaken with depth, indicating that many late-layer non-textual tokens become redundant after cross-modal fusion. Motivated by this observation, we propose SEATS, a training-free, stage-adaptive token selection method for efficient om-LLM inference. Before the LLM, SEATS removes spatiotemporal redundancy via attention-weighted diversity selection. Inside the LLM, it progressively prunes tokens across blocks and dynamically allocates the retention budget from temporal windows to modalities using query relevance scores. In late layers, it removes all remaining non-textual tokens once cross-modal fusion is complete. Experiments on Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni demonstrate that SEATS effectively improves inference efficiency. Retaining only 10% of visual and audio tokens, it achieves a 9.3x FLOPs reduction and a 4.8x prefill speedup while preserving 96.3% of the original performance.

item.title: OP2GS: Object-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting with Dual-Opacity Primitives
item.author: Guiyu Liu, Niklas Vaara, Janne Mustaniemi, Juho Kannala, Janne Heikkilä
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 提供了一种显式且高效的场景表示，但其原语缺乏固有的对象级身份，阻碍了开放词汇场景理解等下游任务。现有方法通常通过将高维特征嵌入蒸馏到高斯中或通过启发式细化将 2D 掩码标签提升到 3D 来解决这一问题。然而，基于特征的方法会产生沉重的存储和解码开销，而基于提升的管道仍然容易受到标签污染的影响：对于外观重建必要的高斯在 2D 到 3D 投影过程中经常接收错误的对象标签。

背景: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 提供了一种显式且高效的场景表示，但其原语缺乏固有的对象级身份，阻碍了下游任务。

目的: 提出 OP2GS，一种对象感知的高斯表示，通过为每个原语添加显式实例身份和专用的实例不透明度 σ* 来解决这些问题。

方法: 引入随机对象损失来优化 1D 实例占用场，使用 3DGS 的标准基于透射率的可见性。语义描述符随后通过多视图聚合在对象级别附加，消除了每个高斯特征存储。

主要发现: 与基于特征训练的方法相比，OP2GS 在实现具有竞争力的开放词汇性能的同时，显著减少了计算开销。与无训练管道相比，它利用物理一致的占用学习来解决可见性歧义。

结论: OP2GS 通过双不透明度公式解耦了视觉存在与实例占用，使得被错误标记的高斯可以保持可用于图像渲染，同时在对象掩码分支中变得透明。

翻译: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 提供了一种显式且高效的场景表示，但其原语缺乏固有的对象级身份，阻碍了下游任务。现有方法通常通过将高维特征嵌入蒸馏到高斯中或通过启发式细化将 2D 掩码标签提升到 3D 来解决这一问题。然而，基于特征的方法会产生沉重的存储和解码开销，而基于提升的管道仍然容易受到标签污染的影响：对于外观重建必要的高斯在 2D 到 3D 投影过程中经常接收错误的对象标签。我们提出了 OP2GS，一种对象感知的高斯表示，通过为每个原语添加显式实例身份和专用的实例不透明度 σ* 来解决这些问题。为了学习这种表示，我们引入了随机对象损失来优化 1D 实例占用场，使用 3DGS 的标准基于透射率的可见性。语义描述符随后通过多视图聚合在对象级别附加，消除了每个高斯特征存储。与基于特征训练的方法相比，OP2GS 在实现具有竞争力的开放词汇性能的同时，显著减少了计算开销。与无训练管道相比，它利用物理一致的占用学习来解决可见性歧义。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为OP2GS的对象感知3D高斯溅射方法，通过使用双不透明度原语来增强对物体的建模能力。

Abstract

3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an explicit and efficient scene representation, but its primitives lack inherent object-level identity, hindering downstream tasks such as open-vocabulary scene understanding. Existing methods typically address this by either distilling high-dimensional feature embeddings into Gaussians or by lifting 2D mask labels into 3D via heuristic refinement. However, feature-based approaches incur heavy storage and decoding overhead, while lifting-based pipelines remain vulnerable to label contamination: Gaussians necessary for appearance reconstruction often receive incorrect object labels during 2D-to-3D projection. We propose OP2GS, an object-aware Gaussian representation that augments each primitive with an explicit instance identity and a dedicated instance opacity $σ^{*}$ for object-mask rendering. The original opacity $σ$ remains responsible for visual reconstruction, while $σ^{*}$ models whether a Gaussian should contribute to a particular object mask. This dual-opacity formulation decouples visual existence from instance occupancy: mislabeled Gaussians can remain available for image rendering while becoming transparent in the object-mask branch. To learn this representation, we introduce a random object loss that optimizes the 1D instance occupancy field using the standard transmittance-based visibility of 3DGS. Semantic descriptors are then attached at the object level through multi-view aggregation, eliminating per-Gaussian feature storage. Compared with feature-training approaches, OP2GS achieves competitive open-vocabulary performance while significantly reducing computational overhead. Compared with training-free pipelines, it leverages physically consistent occupancy learning to resolve visibility ambiguities.

item.title: CopT: Contrastive On-Policy Thinking with Continuous Spaces for General and Agentic Reasoning
item.author: Shi, Dachuan, Zhu, Hanlin, Yuan, Xiangchi, Zhao, Wanjia, Xia, Kejing, Xiao, Wen, Lee, Wenke
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了CopT，一种重新构建的推理管道，通过颠倒思考和回答的顺序来提高效率。CopT首先生成草稿答案，然后基于草稿答案进行后续的有政策思考以进行反思和修正。为了评估草稿答案的可信度，CopT将连续嵌入转换为推理时对比验证器，通过对比模型在离散-token输入和连续-嵌入输入下对同一生成token的支持程度，得出序列级反向KL估计器。CopT在数学、编码和代理推理任务中，在可比或更高的准确率下，将峰值准确率提高了最多23%，并将token使用量减少了最多57%，且无需额外训练。

背景: 传统的思维链（CoT）范式将思考视为回答的前提，这可能导致在模型能够识别答案之前就进行不必要的思考，从而延迟获得合理答案并增加不必要的token成本，这种行为被称为表演性推理。

目的: 为了解决传统CoT范式中的效率问题，本文提出了一种重新构建的推理管道CopT，旨在颠倒思考和回答的顺序，以减少不必要的token使用并提高推理效率。

方法: CopT首先生成草稿答案，然后基于草稿答案进行后续的有政策思考以进行反思和修正。为了评估草稿答案的可信度，CopT将连续嵌入转换为推理时对比验证器，通过对比模型在离散-token输入和连续-嵌入输入下对同一生成token的支持程度，得出序列级反向KL估计器。当答案被认为不够可靠时，CopT会执行进一步的有政策思考，其中第二个KL估计器动态控制草稿答案的可见性，在保留有用部分信息的同时减少被不可靠内容误导的风险。

主要发现: 在数学、编码和代理推理任务中，CopT在可比或更高的准确率下，将峰值准确率提高了最多23%，并将token使用量减少了最多57%，且无需额外训练。

结论: CopT通过颠倒思考和回答的顺序，以及引入基于对比验证的可靠性评估机制，在不进行额外训练的情况下，显著提高了推理任务的准确率并降低了token使用成本，证明了其在提升推理效率和可靠性方面的有效性。

翻译: 思维链（CoT）是一种从大型语言模型（LLMs）中激发推理能力的标准方法。然而，常见的CoT范式将思考视为回答的前提，这可能导致在模型能够识别答案之前就进行不必要的思考，从而延迟获得合理答案并增加不必要的token成本，这种行为被称为表演性推理。在本文中，我们介绍了CopT，一种重新构建的推理管道，它颠倒了思考和回答的顺序。CopT不是在回答之前先思考，而是首先激发草稿答案，然后基于其自身的草稿答案调用后续的有政策思考以进行反思和修正。为了评估草稿答案是否值得信赖，CopT将连续嵌入转换为推理时对比验证器。具体来说，它对比模型在离散-token输入和连续-嵌入输入下对同一生成token的支持，得出序列级反向KL估计器，用于评估答案的可靠性。我们的分析表明，在特定假设下，期望估计值等于未解决潜在状态和发出的答案token之间的互信息，解释了为什么它捕获的是与答案相关的潜在状态的不确定性，而不是潜在状态中的任意不确定性。当答案被认为不够可靠时，CopT执行进一步的有政策思考，其中第二个KL估计器动态控制草稿答案的可见性，在保留有用部分信息的同时减少被不可靠内容误导的风险。在数学、编码和代理推理任务中，CopT在可比或更高的准确率下，将峰值准确率提高了最多23%，并将token使用量减少了最多57%，且无需额外训练。代码可在该URL处获取。

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Chain-of-thought (CoT) is a standard approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities from large language models (LLMs). However, the common CoT paradigm treats thinking as a prerequisite for answering, which can delay access to plausible answers and incur unnecessary token costs even when the model is able to identify an answer before extended thinking, a behavior known as performative reasoning. In this paper, we introduce CopT, a reformulated reasoning pipeline that reverses the usual order of thinking and answering. Instead of thinking before answering, CopT first elicits a draft answer and then invokes subsequent on-policy thinking conditioned on its own draft answer for reflection and correction. To assess whether the draft answer should be trusted, CopT recasts continuous embeddings as inference-time contrastive verifiers. Specifically, it contrasts the model's support for the same generated tokens under discrete-token inputs and continuous-embedding inputs, yielding a sequence-level reverse KL estimator for answer reliability. Our analysis shows that under certain assumptions, the expected estimate equals the mutual information between the unresolved latent state and the emitted answer token, explaining why it captures answer-relevant uncertainty rather than arbitrary uncertainty in the latent state. When the answer is deemed insufficiently reliable, CopT performs further on-policy thinking, where a second KL estimator dynamically controls draft-answer visibility, preserving useful partial information while reducing the risk of being misled by unreliable content. Across mathematics, coding, and agentic reasoning tasks, CopT improves peak accuracy by up to 23% and reduces token usage by up to 57% at comparable or higher accuracy, without any additional training. The code is available at this https URL .

item.title: ThoughtTrace: Understanding User Thoughts in Real-World LLM Interactions
item.author: Chuanyang Jin, Binze Li, Haopeng Xie, Cathy Mengying Fang, Tianjian Li, Shayne Longpre, Hongxiang Gu, Maximillian Chen, Tianmin Shu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ThoughtTrace 是首个大规模对话数据集，将真实多轮人机对话与用户自我报告的思维过程配对，旨在研究用户思维模式。

背景: 现有对话数据集仅捕捉人们说的话，未包含他们说的话背后的想法和反应。

目的: 引入 ThoughtTrace 数据集，将用户发送提示的原因和对话中的反应配对，以研究人机交互背后的认知动态。

方法: ThoughtTrace 包含 1,058 名用户、2,155 次对话、17,058 轮对话和 10,174 条思维标注，收集自 20 个语言模型。

主要发现: ThoughtTrace 捕捉了长期、主题多样的交互，思维与消息在语义上不同，难以从上下文中推断，内容多样且与对话阶段相关；思维有助于下游建模，提升用户行为预测，并为个性化助手训练提供对齐信号。

结论: ThoughtTrace 建立了用户思维作为研究人机交互认知动态的新数据模态，为构建更好理解用户潜在目标、偏好和需求的助手奠定了基础。

翻译: Conversational AI has now reached billions of users, yet existing datasets capture only what people say, not what they think. We introduce ThoughtTrace, the first large-scale dataset that pairs real-world multi-turn human--AI conversations with users' self-reported thoughts: their reasons for sending prompts and reactions to assistant responses. ThoughtTrace comprises 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 turns, and 10,174 thought annotations collected across 20 language models. Our analysis shows that ThoughtTrace captures long-horizon, topically diverse interactions, and that thoughts are semantically distinct from messages, difficult for frontier LLMs to infer from context, diverse in content, and tied to conversation stages. We further demonstrate the utility of thoughts for downstream modeling. First, thoughts improve user-behavior prediction as inference-time context. Second, thought-guided rewrites provide fine-grained alignment signals for training personalized assistants. Together, ThoughtTrace establishes user thoughts as a new data modality for studying the cognitive dynamics behind human--AI interaction and provides a foundation for building assistants that better understand and adapt to users' latent goals, preferences, and needs.

Abstract

Conversational AI has now reached billions of users, yet existing datasets capture only what people say, not what they think. We introduce ThoughtTrace, the first large-scale dataset that pairs real-world multi-turn human--AI conversations with users' self-reported thoughts: their reasons for sending prompts and reactions to assistant responses. ThoughtTrace comprises 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 turns, and 10,174 thought annotations collected across 20 language models. Our analysis shows that ThoughtTrace captures long-horizon, topically diverse interactions, and that thoughts are semantically distinct from messages, difficult for frontier LLMs to infer from context, diverse in content, and tied to conversation stages. We further demonstrate the utility of thoughts for downstream modeling. First, thoughts improve user-behavior prediction as inference-time context. Second, thought-guided rewrites provide fine-grained alignment signals for training personalized assistants. Together, ThoughtTrace establishes user thoughts as a new data modality for studying the cognitive dynamics behind human--AI interaction and provides a foundation for building assistants that better understand and adapt to users' latent goals, preferences, and needs.

item.title: Draft Less, Retrieve More: Hybrid Tree Construction for Speculative Decoding
item.author: Shen, Yuhao, Liu, Tianyu, Hu, Xinyi, Kong, Quan, Zhang, Baolin, Dai, Jun, Zhang, Jun, Ge, Shuang, Chen, Lei, Li, Yue, Wan, Mingcheng, Wang, Cong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Graft是一个训练无损失且完全免费的补偿框架，通过修剪和检索的相互增强操作，打破了修剪和检索之间的权衡，在短上下文生成中实现了高达5.41倍的速度提升，并在大模型Qwen3-235B上比EAGLE-3提高了21.8%的平均速度提升。

背景: 推测解码通过利用草稿-验证范式加速大型语言模型推理，但为了最大化接受率，近期方法构建了广泛的草稿树，这不幸地导致了严重的显存带宽和计算开销，限制了端到端加速。虽然动态深度修剪可以通过移除边缘分支来减少延迟，但它也丢弃了潜在的有效候选者，阻止了接受率达到密集树的最高上限。

目的: 识别资源分配中的关键机会：从密集到修剪的草稿转换释放了大量的计算预算。为了打破修剪和检索之间的权衡，引入Graft补偿框架，将修剪和检索耦合为相互增强的操作。

方法: 采用顺序的'修剪-然后-嫁接'机制，将高度预测的检索令牌附加到修剪打开的位置，用近零开销填充拓扑间隙。Graft完全训练无损失且免费。

主要发现: Graft在短上下文生成、长上下文生成和大规模模型中建立了新的帕累托前沿。在短上下文基准测试中，实现了高达5.41倍的速度提升，并在大规模Qwen3-235B上比EAGLE-3提高了21.8%的平均速度提升。

结论: Graft通过修剪和检索的相互增强操作，成功打破了修剪和检索之间的权衡，在短上下文生成中实现了高达5.41倍的速度提升，并在大模型Qwen3-235B上比EAGLE-3提高了21.8%的平均速度提升。

翻译: 推测解码通过利用草稿-验证范式加速大型语言模型推理，但为了最大化接受率，近期方法构建了广泛的草稿树，这不幸地导致了严重的显存带宽和计算开销，限制了端到端加速。虽然动态深度修剪可以通过移除边缘分支来减少延迟，但它也丢弃了潜在的有效候选者，阻止了接受率达到密集树的最高上限。Graft是一个训练无损失且完全免费的补偿框架，通过修剪和检索的相互增强操作，打破了修剪和检索之间的权衡，在短上下文生成中实现了高达5.41倍的速度提升，并在大模型Qwen3-235B上比EAGLE-3提高了21.8%的平均速度提升。
