Abstract

Tool-using agents are increasingly expected to operate across realistic professional workflows, where they must interpret multimodal inputs, coordinate external tools, inspect intermediate artifacts, and revise their actions before producing a final result. Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate tool use, computer use, and multimodal reasoning in isolation, leaving a gap between benchmark settings and end-to-end omni-modal tool use in the real world. To address this gap, we introduce MM-ToolBench, a benchmark and evaluation harness for task-oriented omni-modal tool use. MM-ToolBench contains 100 executable tasks from two macro task families, Customer Service and Intelligent Creation, covering 20 subcategory slices and supported by 27 MCP servers with 324 tools. The central design of MM-ToolBench is closed-loop multimodal verification: agents must execute tools, inspect rendered or transformed artifacts, and self-correct when outputs fail task-specific requirements. To make such evaluation scalable and verifiable, MM-ToolBench couples MCP-based execution with task-specific grounded evaluators and a semi-automated construction pipeline for scenario discovery, task instantiation, evaluator synthesis, and human audit. Experiments on 15 contemporary agentic models show that MM-ToolBench remains highly challenging: Claude Opus 4.6, commonly regarded as one of the strongest coding-agent models, achieves only 32.0% task success, far below the 94.0% human benchmark. We envision MM-ToolBench as a practical foundation for evaluating and advancing next-generation omni-modal tool-using agents through closed-loop multimodal verification.

item.title: HighSync: High-Quality Lip Synchronization via Latent Diffusion Models
item.author: Saeed Firouzi Daghigh, Majid Iranpour Mobarekeh, Mostafa Alavi, Mehdi Bagheri
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HighSync是一个端到端的扩散框架，用于高保真唇同步，生成与任意输入音频对齐的逼真说话人脸视频。

背景: 现有方法在图像质量和同步精度之间难以平衡，导致输出视觉质量下降或唇部运动时间不一致。

目的: 同时解决图像质量和同步精度两个挑战，并首次在512*512分辨率下原生运行唇同步模型，以适应电影和广播等专业制作环境。

方法: 识别并系统性地消除了一种数据泄漏现象，该现象在先前工作中破坏了时间建模，阻碍模型对音频信号形成真正的依赖。

主要发现: HighSync在感知质量和同步精度指标上均实现了最先进的性能。

结论: HighSync是一个可行的专业级解决方案，源代码、预训练模型和补充视频结果已公开。

翻译: 我们提出了HighSync，一个用于高保真唇同步的端到端扩散框架，生成与任意输入音频对齐的逼真说话人脸视频。现有方法在图像质量和同步精度之间持续挣扎，产生视觉质量下降或时间不一致的唇部运动。HighSync同时解决了这两个挑战，据我们所知，这是第一个在512*512分辨率下原生运行的唇同步模型，使其成为电影和广播等专业制作环境中的可行解决方案。我们的方法的核心是识别并系统性地消除了一种数据泄漏现象，该现象在先前工作中默默破坏了时间建模，阻止模型对音频信号形成真正的依赖。在感知质量和同步精度指标上的全面评估证实，HighSync在这两方面都实现了最先进的性能。源代码、预训练模型和补充视频结果可在以下地址公开获取：https://github.com/saeed5959/high_sync

Abstract

We present HighSync, an end-to-end diffusion-based framework for high-fidelity lip synchronization that generates photorealistic talking-face videos aligned with arbitrary input audio. Existing approaches consistently struggle to reconcile image quality with synchronization accuracy, producing either visually degraded outputs or temporally inconsistent lip movements. HighSync addresses both challenges simultaneously and, to our knowledge, is the first lip sync model to operate natively at 512*512 resolution, positioning it as a viable solution for professional production environments such as the film and broadcast industries. Central to our approach is the identification and systematic elimination of a data leakage phenomenon that has silently undermined temporal modeling in prior work, preventing models from developing a genuine dependence on the audio signal. Comprehensive evaluations across both perceptual quality and synchronization accuracy metrics confirm that HighSync achieves state-of-the-art performance on both fronts. Source code, pre-trained models, and supplementary video results are publicly available at: https://github.com/saeed5959/high_sync

item.title: Neuroscience-inspired Staged Representation Learning with Disentangled Coarse- and Fine-Grained Semantics for EEG Visual Decoding
item.author: Xiang Gao, Hui Tian, Yanming Zhu, Xuefei Yin, Alan Wee-Chung Liew
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种受神经科学启发的分阶段表示学习框架，用于从脑电信号中解码视觉信息。

背景: 现有的脑电视觉解码方法主要关注学习单一的全局脑电嵌入以进行跨模态对齐，但忽略了人类视觉处理的分阶段和分层特征。

目的: 为了解决这一局限性，将脑电视觉解码重新表述为特定阶段的表示分解问题。

方法: 该框架将脑电表示学习组织为三个互补阶段：低级视觉表示学习、高级语义表示学习和整合信息融合。此外，引入了多模态双级语义学习机制，将粗粒度标签级语义与细粒度图像级视觉-语义信息分离，并引入语义潜在通道作为计算表示通道。

主要发现: 在THINGS-EEG基准测试中，该方法在受试者依赖的零样本评估下表现出优越性能，并在受试者独立的零样本评估下提高了精确检索率。

结论: 明确建模分阶段感知、语义和整合表示为基于脑电的视觉解码提供了一种有效的受神经科学启发的框架。

翻译: 从脑电信号中解码视觉信息仍然是脑机接口和医学康复中的一个基本挑战。现有的脑电视觉解码方法主要关注学习单一的全局脑电嵌入以进行跨模态对齐，但它们在很大程度上忽略了人类视觉处理的分阶段和分层特征。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种受神经科学启发的分阶段表示学习框架，将脑电视觉解码重新表述为特定阶段的表示分解问题。所提出的框架将脑电表示学习组织为三个互补阶段：低级视觉表示学习、高级语义表示学习和整合信息融合。为了加强语义建模，我们进一步引入了一种多模态双级语义学习机制，将粗粒度标签级语义与细粒度图像级视觉-语义信息分离。此外，引入了语义潜在通道作为从观测到的视觉脑电信号生成的计算表示通道，扩展了通道级语义表示空间，以进行结构化语义抽象和跨模态对齐。在THINGS-EEG基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该方法在受试者依赖的零样本评估下表现出优越性能，并在受试者独立的零样本评估下提高了精确检索率。包括逐层检索、时间累积、扩展多图像检索和消融研究在内的额外分析进一步支持了分阶段分解和结构化语义建模的有效性。这些结果表明，明确建模分阶段感知、语义和整合表示为基于脑电的视觉解码提供了一种有效的受神经科学启发的框架。

Abstract

Decoding visual information from electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains a fundamental challenge in brain-computer interfaces and medical rehabilitation. Existing EEG visual decoding methods mainly focus on learning a single global EEG embedding for cross-modal alignment, but they largely overlook the staged and hierarchical characteristics of human visual processing. To address this limitation, we propose a neuroscience-inspired staged representation learning framework that reformulates EEG visual decoding as a stage-specific representation decomposition problem. The proposed framework organizes EEG representation learning into three complementary phases: low-level visual representation learning, high-level semantic representation learning, and integrative information fusion. To strengthen semantic modeling, we further introduce a multimodal dual-level semantic learning mechanism that separates coarse label-level semantics from fine image-level visual-semantic information. In addition, semantic latent channels are introduced as computational representation channels generated from observed visual EEG signals, expanding the channel-level semantic representation space for structured semantic abstraction and cross-modal alignment. Extensive experiments on the THINGS-EEG benchmark demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance under subject-dependent zero-shot evaluation and improved exact retrieval under subject-independent zero-shot evaluation. Additional analyses, including layer-wise retrieval, temporal accumulation, expanded multi-image retrieval, and ablation studies, further support the effectiveness of staged decomposition and structured semantic modeling. These results suggest that explicitly modeling staged perceptual, semantic, and integrative representations provides an effective neuroscience-inspired framework for EEG-based visual decoding.

item.title: Extending Pretrained 10-Second ECG Foundation Models to Longer Horizons
item.author: Wei Tang, Jinpei Han, Kangning Cui, Mattia Carletti, Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Shreyank N Gowda, Patitapaban Palo, Anshul Thakur, Lei Clifton, Jean-michel Morel, Raymond H. Chan, David A. Clifton, Xiao Gu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种参数高效的框架，用于将预训练的10秒心电图模型扩展到更长且可变长度的心电图，通过轻量级插件模块实现结构兼容的长序列处理和语义驱动的时序建模。

背景: 现有的心电图基础模型通常基于10秒的诊断片段预训练，但在实际应用中，记录往往更长且时长可变。这些10秒模型缺乏内置的时间信息组合方式，直接扩展到更长的时间范围面临输入长度差异导致的结构不兼容以及限制有意义时序聚合的语义挑战。

目的: 在不重新训练主干网络的情况下，将预训练的心电图基础模型扩展到更长和可变长度的心电图，以解决上述挑战。

方法: 提出了一种参数高效的框架，引入了一个轻量级插件模块。该模块在冻结的预训练10秒模型的指导下，以两种互补方式扩展模型：结构兼容的长序列处理和语义驱动的时序建模。

主要发现: 在多个长时域心电图任务、数据集和基础模型骨干网络上进行的实验表明，该方法能够从预训练的快照模型实现稳健的长时域扩展，始终优于滑动窗口和基于池化的基线方法，且具有强大的参数效率。

结论: 该方法成功实现了对预训练心电图基础模型的长时域扩展，在保持参数效率的同时显著提升了性能。

翻译: 心电图基础模型通常在典型的诊断10秒心电图片段上预训练，已显示出在一系列临床应用中的强大迁移能力。然而，许多现实世界的应用产生的记录通常更长，且在推理时间时长可变。这些10秒模型没有内置的方式跨时间组合信息。将它们扩展到更长的范围引入了两个挑战：由输入长度差异引起的结构不兼容，以及限制有意义时序聚合的语义挑战。我们提出了一种参数高效的框架，在不重新训练主干网络的情况下，将预训练的心电图基础模型扩展到更长和可变长度的心电图。在冻结的预训练10秒模型的指导下，我们引入了一个轻量级插件模块，以两种互补方式扩展模型：（i）结构兼容的长序列处理和（ii）语义驱动的时序建模。在多个长时域心电图任务、数据集和基础模型骨干网络上的实验表明，我们的方法能够从预训练的快照模型实现稳健的长时域扩展，始终优于滑动窗口和基于池化的基线方法，且具有强大的参数效率。

Abstract

Electrocardiogram (ECG) foundation models pretrained on typical diagnostic 10-second ECG segments, have demonstrated strong transferability across a range of clinical applications. However, many real-world applications produce recordings that are typically longer, and are varied in duration during inference time. These 10-second models have no built-in way to combine information across time. Extending them to longer horizons introduces two challenges: structural incompatibilities arising from input-length disparities, and semantic challenges that limit meaningful temporal aggregation. We propose a parameter-efficient framework that extends pretrained ECG foundation models to longer and variable-length ECGs without retraining the backbone. Guided by a frozen pretrained 10-second model, we introduce a lightweight plug-in module that extends the model in two complementary ways: (i) structurally compatible long-sequence processing and (ii) semantically informed temporal modeling. Experiments on multiple long-horizon ECG tasks, datasets, and foundation model backbones demonstrate that our method enables robust long-horizon extension from pretrained snapshot models, consistently outperforming sliding-window and pooling-based baselines with strong parameter efficiency.

item.title: Topo-GS: Continuous Volumetric Embedding of High-Dimensional Data via Topological Gaussian Splatting
item.author: João Paulo Gois, Luis Gustavo Nonato
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文介绍了一种名为 Topo-GS 的框架，旨在通过将高维数据投影转化为无网格体积重建过程，解决传统降维算法中离散点云模式易受遮挡和人工不连续性影响的问题。

背景: 传统的降维算法通常依赖于离散点云范式，这种抽象方式容易受到视觉遮挡和人工不连续性的影响，往往无法表示底层流形的连续密度。

目的: 为了解决传统离散点云模式的局限性，该研究旨在引入一种新的框架，将多维投影转化为无网格体积重建过程。

方法: Topo-GS 框架重新利用了三维高斯溅射技术，通过求解正交 Procrustes 目标来优化，强制执行尽可能保持刚性的先验，并将每个高斯的空间协方差显式对齐到局部切空间。此外，该方法采用了一种拓扑感知策略，根据数据内在维度的不同，定制损失公式以分别保留连续的一维轨迹或连贯的二维表面。

主要发现: 定量和视觉评估表明，Topo-GS 成功将离散散点图转化为连续体积表示，其中固有的投影畸变显式地表现为可观察到的几何变化，同时保持了与离散基线相当的本征拓扑保真度。

结论: 该研究证明了 Topo-GS 能够有效将离散数据转化为连续体积表示，并在保持局部拓扑保真度的同时，使投影畸变成为可观察到的几何变化。

翻译: 该论文介绍了一种名为 Topo-GS 的框架，旨在通过将高维数据投影转化为无网格体积重建过程，解决传统降维算法中离散点云模式易受遮挡和人工不连续性影响的问题。传统的降维算法通常依赖于离散点云范式，这种抽象方式容易受到视觉遮挡和人工不连续性的影响，往往无法表示底层流形的连续密度。为了解决传统离散点云模式的局限性，该研究旨在引入一种新的框架，将多维投影转化为无网格体积重建过程。Topo-GS 框架重新利用了三维高斯溅射技术，通过求解正交 Procrustes 目标来优化，强制执行尽可能保持刚性的先验，并将每个高斯的空间协方差显式对齐到局部切空间。此外，该方法采用了一种拓扑感知策略，根据数据内在维度的不同，定制损失公式以分别保留连续的一维轨迹或连贯的二维表面。定量和视觉评估表明，Topo-GS 成功将离散散点图转化为连续体积表示，其中固有的投影畸变显式地表现为可观察到的几何变化，同时保持了与离散基线相当的本征拓扑保真度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Dimensionality reduction algorithms map high-dimensional data into visualizable 2D or 3D spaces, but traditionally rely on a discrete point-cloud paradigm. This discrete abstraction is susceptible to visual occlusion and artificial discontinuities, often failing to represent the continuous density of the underlying manifold. To address these limitations, we introduce Topo-GS, a framework that repurposes 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to cast multidimensional projection as a meshless volumetric reconstruction process. Instead of standard photometric losses, Topo-GS is driven by local geometric constraints. By solving orthogonal Procrustes targets, the optimization enforces an As-Rigid-As-Possible prior while explicitly aligning the spatial covariance of each Gaussian to the local tangent space. Recognizing that unrolling data of varying intrinsic dimensionalities requires distinct spatial treatments, we utilize a topology-aware strategy that tailors the loss formulation to preserve either continuous 1D trajectories or cohesive 2D surfaces. Quantitative and visual evaluations demonstrate that Topo-GS successfully transforms discrete scatter plots into continuous volumetric representations, where inherent projection distortions explicitly manifest as observable geometric variations, while preserving local topological fidelity comparable to discrete baselines.

item.title: A Joint Synthetic Housing-Household Inventory
item.author: Xiao Qian, Shangjia Dong, Rachel Davidson
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种构建联合住房-家庭库存的框架，该框架将个人和家庭与国家结构库存中的兼容住房单元明确联系起来，同时保持现实的人口密度和人口分布特征。

背景: 目前不存在能够同时捕捉详细住房结构和家庭层面人口特征的保真度数据集，准确理解人类与建成环境之间的相互作用需要同时具备建筑和人口的综合表示。

目的: 构建一个联合住房-家庭库存框架，明确将个人和家庭与国家结构库存中的兼容住房单元联系起来，并保持现实的人口密度和人口分布。

方法: 该框架集成了三个组件：1. 从美国社区调查公共使用微观数据样本记录中生成合成人口，以保留复杂的家庭内部关系；2. 一个量化住房-家庭兼容性的深度对比学习模型；3. 一个基于层次优化的分配程序，强制执行建筑级容量和街区级人口约束。

主要发现: 生成的合成人口在统计现实性方面相对于普查微观数据表现良好，对比学习模型以高预测准确率识别出兼容的住房-家庭对。应用于北卡罗来纳州海岸地区，在建筑、邻里和区域层面的评估显示，联合库存与街区级人口分布相匹配，再现了观察到的空间人口模式且无系统性偏差，并在城市、郊区、农村环境中保持一致的分配质量。

结论: 由此产生的库存支持广泛的潜在应用，包括灾害韧性规划、住房和负担能力分析、能源使用评估和公共卫生研究，通过实现耦合的家庭和建筑级分析。

翻译: 准确理解人类与建成环境之间的相互作用需要同时具备建筑和人口的综合表示。然而，目前不存在能够同时捕捉详细住房结构和家庭层面人口特征的保真度数据集。本文提出了一种构建联合住房-家庭库存的框架，该框架将个人和家庭与国家结构库存中的兼容住房单元明确联系起来，同时保持现实的人口密度和人口分布特征。该框架集成了三个组件：1. 从美国社区调查公共使用微观数据样本记录中生成合成人口，以保留复杂的家庭内部关系；2. 一个量化住房-家庭兼容性的深度对比学习模型；3. 一个基于层次优化的分配程序，强制执行建筑级容量和街区级人口约束。生成的合成人口在统计现实性方面相对于普查微观数据表现良好，对比学习模型以高预测准确率识别出兼容的住房-家庭对。应用于北卡罗来纳州海岸地区，在建筑、邻里和区域层面的评估显示，联合库存与街区级人口分布相匹配，再现了观察到的空间人口模式且无系统性偏差，并在城市、郊区、农村环境中保持一致的分配质量。由此产生的库存支持广泛的潜在应用，包括灾害韧性规划、住房和负担能力分析、能源使用评估和公共卫生研究，通过实现耦合的家庭和建筑级分析。

Abstract

Accurately understanding the interactions between humans and the built environment requires integrated representations of both the buildings and the populations that occupy them. However, high-fidelity datasets that jointly capture detailed housing structures and demographic characteristics at the household level do not currently exist. This paper presents a framework for constructing a joint housing-household inventory that explicitly links individuals and households to compatible housing units from the National Structure Inventory (NSI), while preserving realistic population densities and demographic distributions. The framework integrates three components: (i) synthetic population generation from American Community Survey (ACS) Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) records that preserve complex intra-household relationships; (ii) a deep contrastive learning model that quantifies housing-household compatibility; and (iii) a hierarchical optimization-based allocation procedure that enforces building-level capacity and block-group-level demographic constraints. The generated synthetic population attains high statistical realism relative to the census microdata, and the contrastive learning model identifies compatible housing-household pairs with high predictive accuracy. Applied to coastal North Carolina, evaluations at building, neighborhood, and regional scales show that the joint inventory matches block-group-level demographic distributions, reproduces observed spatial population patterns without systematic bias, and maintains consistent allocation quality across urban, suburban, and rural contexts. By enabling coupled household- and building-level analyses, the resulting inventory supports a broad range of applications, including disaster resilience planning, housing and affordability analysis, energy-use assessment, and public health research.

item.author: Wenxiao Chen, Xueyu Yuan, Liu Liu, Di Wu, Dan Guo
item.description:

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SAFAG的新框架，用于在无需对称性标注的情况下进行可泛化和可操作部件的姿态估计。

背景: 通用机器人物体交互和操作需要高质量的跨类别物体感知。GAParts理解作为该领域的先驱，引起了越来越多的关注。然而，大多数近期工作在对称性问题设计上不足或需要丰富的对称性标注，这严重阻碍了在数据缺乏场景中精确的GAParts姿态估计。

目的: 提出SAFAG，一种新颖的无对称性标注框架，用于可泛化和可操作部件的姿态估计。

方法: 提出了逐步细化两阶段框架，用于从候选到最终四元数的回归；将对称性预测作为概率分布问题，并采用自监督学习策略。

主要发现: 实验结果表明SAFAG具有优越的性能和鲁棒性。

结论: 相信该工作在具身人工智能系统的许多领域具有巨大的应用潜力。

翻译: 摘要：通用机器人物体交互和操作迫切需要高质量的跨类别物体感知。作为该领域的先驱，可泛化和可操作部件（GAParts）理解引起了相关研究人员越来越多的关注。然而，大多数近期工作在对称性问题设计上不足或需要丰富的对称性标注，这严重阻碍了在数据缺乏场景中精确的GAParts姿态估计。在本文中，我们提出了SAFAG，一种新颖的无对称性标注框架，用于可泛化和可操作部件姿态估计。具体而言，我们建议了一个逐步细化的两阶段框架，用于候选到最终四元数的回归，并将对称性预测作为概率分布问题，采用自监督学习策略。实验结果表明我们的SAFAG具有优越的性能和鲁棒性。我们相信我们的工作在具身人工智能系统的许多领域具有巨大的应用潜力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Urgently needed generalizable robot object interaction and manipulation requires high-quality Cross-Category object perception. As a pioneer of this area, Generalizable and Actionable Parts (GAParts) understanding has attracted increasing attention from relevant researchers. However, most recent works either have insufficient design regarding the symmetry issue or require rich symmetry annotation, which severely impedes precise GAPart pose estimation in data-lacking scenarios. In this paper, we propose SAFAG, a novel Symmetry Annotation-Free framework for Generalizable and Actionable Parts Pose Estimation. Specifically, we suggest a stepwise refinement two-stage framework for candidate-to-final quaternion regression, and tackle the symmetry prediction as a probability distribution problem with self-supervised learning strategy. The experimental results demonstrate the superior performance and robustness of our SAFAG. We believe that our work has the enormous potential to be applied in many areas of embodied AI system.

item.title: PyraVid: Hierarchical Multimodal Memory for Long-Horizon Video Reasoning
item.author: Sikuan Yan, Sicheng Dong, Haotong Wang, Ercong Nie, Yilun Liu, Jinhe Bi, Yingjie Xu, Susanna Schwarzmann, Riccardo Trivisonno, Volker Tresp, Yunpu Ma
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PyraVid是一个受认知科学事件分割理论启发的分层多模态记忆框架，旨在解决多模态记忆在长视频理解中的挑战。

背景: 智能体系统需要利用长期经验进行推理，但现有工作主要关注单模态记忆，导致多模态记忆研究相对不足。

目的: PyraVid旨在构建一个分层多模态记忆框架，以解决多模态记忆引入的异构输入集成、以人为中心的信息对齐以及跨不同粒度的证据聚合等挑战。

方法: PyraVid受认知科学事件分割理论启发，将长视频组织成从粗到细的金字塔结构，支持结构引导的记忆扩展和修剪，从而在减少噪声的同时检索具有强因果连接但低语义相似度的相关事件。

主要发现: 在多个长视频理解基准上的实验表明，PyraVid在多个数据集、模型规模和问题类型上均一致提高了性能。

结论: 分层多模态记忆在长时域推理中是有效的。

翻译: 摘要：随着智能体系统被期望能够利用长期经验进行推理，记忆已成为这些系统中日益重要的组成部分。然而，先前的工作主要集中在单模态记忆上，导致多模态记忆相对未被探索，尽管它在现实世界应用中起着核心作用。与单模态设置相比，多模态记忆引入了额外的挑战，包括异构输入集成、以人为中心的信息对齐以及跨不同粒度的证据聚合。我们提出了PyraVid，这是一个受认知科学事件分割理论启发的分层多模态记忆框架。PyraVid将长视频组织成从粗到细的金字塔结构，实现了结构化的记忆访问和有效的证据聚合。它进一步支持结构引导的记忆扩展和修剪，允许检索具有强因果连接但低语义相似度的相关事件，同时减少噪声。在多个长视频理解基准上的实验表明，PyraVid在多个数据集、模型规模和问题类型上均一致提高了性能，突显了分层多模态记忆在长时域推理中的有效性。

Abstract

Memory has become an increasingly important component of agentic systems, as these systems are expected to reason over long-term experience. However, prior work has largely focused on unimodal memory, leaving multimodal memory relatively underexplored despite its central role in real-world applications. Compared with unimodal settings, multimodal memory introduces additional challenges, including heterogeneous input integration, person-centric information alignment, and evidence aggregation across different granularities. We present PyraVid, a hierarchical multimodal memory framework inspired by Event Segmentation Theory from cognitive science. PyraVid organizes long videos into a coarse-to-fine pyramid structure, enabling structured memory access and effective evidence aggregation. It further supports structure-guided memory expansion with pruning, allowing the retrieval of related events with strong causal connectivity but low semantic similarity while reducing noise. Experiments on multiple long-video understanding benchmarks show that PyraVid consistently improves performance across datasets, model scales, and question types, highlighting the effectiveness of hierarchical multimodal memory for long-horizon reasoning.

item.title: A Systematic Survey on Deep Learning Architectures for Point Cloud Classification and Segmentation
item.author: Minhas Kamal, Hiranya Garbha Kumar, Balakrishnan Prabhakaran
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文综述了点云在三维视觉中的深度学习模型，涵盖了分类、部分分割和语义分割三大任务。

背景: 点云是表示3D形状和场景最广泛采用的格式，因其简单性和几何保真度而备受青睐。然而，其固有的无序和不规则性质，加之传感器噪声和遮挡的影响，给基于机器学习的方法带来了独特挑战。

目的: 本文旨在深入探讨三维点云理解的深度学习模型，重点关注三个基本任务：点云分类、部分分割和语义分割。

Abstract

Point cloud stands as the most widely adopted format for representing 3D shapes and scenes due to its simplicity and geometric fidelity. However, its inherent unordered and irregular nature, exacerbated by sensor noise and occlusions, introduces unique challenges for machine learning based methodologies. To combat these issues, diverse strategies have been developed, including converting to a format that has orderliness, extracting local geometry, and permutation-invariant or self-attention-based processing. In this paper, our focus is directed towards deep learning models for three fundamental tasks in 3D vision: point cloud classification, part segmentation, and semantic segmentation. We begin by formally defining point cloud data, followed by an in-depth discussion on its structural characteristics. Then, we categorize notable works based on their backbone structure and evaluate their performance on popular benchmarks. Beyond empirical comparison, we offer insights into architectural innovations and limitations. We also outline open challenges and promising future directions for 3D point cloud understanding.

item.title: Collaborative Learning for Semi-Supervised LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
item.author: Bin Yang, Alexandru Paul Condurache
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CoLLiS是一个利用协作学习进行半监督3D语义分割的新框架，通过在单一步骤中协同训练多个表示来生成伪标签，从而缓解确认偏误和错误传播。

背景: 大规模激光雷达点云的标注既耗时又昂贵，因此半监督学习（SemiSL）被广泛采用。

目的: 解决标准半监督方法中伪标签仅来自单一蒸馏源所导致的确认偏误和错误传播问题，从而提升性能。

方法: CoLLiS框架在单一步骤中协同训练多个表示，将它们视为平等的学生，每个学生从多个表示中自适应蒸馏，并在线监控学生间的差异以解决相互矛盾的监督。

主要发现: 在三个数据集上的广泛实验表明，CoLLiS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LiDAR SemiSL methods，特别是在低标签量条件下表现强劲。

结论: CoLLiS通过协作学习有效缓解了确认偏误，在低标签量条件下显著优于现有的半监督方法。

翻译: Annotating large-scale LiDAR point clouds for 3D semantic segmentation is costly and time-consuming, which motivates the use of semi-supervised learning (SemiSL). Standard LiDAR SemiSL methods typically adopt a two-step training paradigm, where pseudo-labels are separately generated from a single distillation source, either from the same or another LiDAR representation. Such supervision relies on a unique source of pseudo-labels, which can reinforce confirmation bias and propagate errors during training, ultimately limiting performance. To address this challenge, we introduce CoLLiS, a novel framework that leverages Collaborative Learning for LiDAR Semi-supervised segmentation. Unlike prior paradigms with decoupled pseudo-labeling and training phases, CoLLiS trains multiple representations collaboratively in a single step by treating them as coequal students. Each student is adaptively distilled from multiple representations, while inter-student disparities are monitored online to resolve contradictory supervision and effectively mitigate confirmation bias. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that CoLLiS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LiDAR SemiSL methods, with particularly strong gains in low-label regimes.

Abstract

Annotating large-scale LiDAR point clouds for 3D semantic segmentation is costly and time-consuming, which motivates the use of semi-supervised learning (SemiSL). Standard LiDAR SemiSL methods typically adopt a two-step training paradigm, where pseudo-labels are separately generated from a single distillation source, either from the same or another LiDAR representation. Such supervision relies on a unique source of pseudo-labels, which can reinforce confirmation bias and propagate errors during training, ultimately limiting performance. To address this challenge, we introduce CoLLiS, a novel framework that leverages Collaborative Learning for LiDAR Semi-supervised segmentation. Unlike prior paradigms with decoupled pseudo-labeling and training phases, CoLLiS trains multiple representations collaboratively in a single step by treating them as coequal students. Each student is adaptively distilled from multiple representations, while inter-student disparities are monitored online to resolve contradictory supervision and effectively mitigate confirmation bias. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that CoLLiS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LiDAR SemiSL methods, with particularly strong gains in low-label regimes.

item.title: Factorized Latent Dynamics for Video JEPA: An Empirical Study of Auxiliary Objectives
item.author: Santosh Premi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究18种辅助目标在Video-JEPA中的表现，提出FWM-HW-LD方法，在混合数据集上提升下游任务性能。

背景: JEPA框架在自监督视频表示学习中具有潜力，但小规模Video-JEPA训练中辅助目标的行为尚未被充分描述。

目的: 通过小规模实证研究18种辅助目标变体，并研究FWM-HW-LD训练目标以改善下游任务性能。

方法: 在单数据集和混合数据集两种预训练模式下，评估18种辅助目标变体；提出FWM-HW-LD方法，将潜在表示分离为外观和动力学子空间，并对JEPA预测误差和潜在动力学误差应用硬区域加权。

主要发现: 许多辅助目标表现出能力权衡：一项下游能力的提升往往伴随着另一项的下降；FWM-HW-LD在混合数据集设置下，相比基准在ImageNet-100上提升5.92个百分点，在SSv2上提升3.21个百分点，在Diving-48上保持在0.30个百分点以内。

结论: 潜在因式分解是研究Video-JEPA中辅助目标权衡的有用方向。

翻译: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）是一种有前景的自监督视频表示学习框架，但在小规模Video-JEPA训练中，辅助目标的行为尚未得到充分描述。我们对两种预训练模式下18种Video-JEPA辅助目标变体进行了小规模实证研究：单数据集（UCF-101）和混合数据集（UCF-101 + Something-Something V2 + ImageNet-100）。我们在三个互补基准上评估了冻结表示：Diving-48（细粒度运动）、SomethingSomething V2（时间推理）和ImageNet-100（外观）。我们的实验表明，许多辅助目标表现出能力权衡：一项下游能力的提升往往伴随着另一项的下降。然后我们研究了FWM-HW-LD（因子化世界模型与硬区域加权潜在动力学），这是一种训练目标，它将潜在表示分离为外观和动力学子空间，并对JEPA预测误差和潜在动力学误差应用硬区域加权。在我们的混合数据集设置中，与参考基准相比，FWM-HW-LD在ImageNet-100上提高了5.92个百分点，在SSv2上提高了3.21个百分点，同时在Diving-48上保持在0.30个百分点以内。这些结果表明，潜在因式分解是研究Video-JEPA中辅助目标权衡的有用方向。

Abstract

Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) are a promising framework for self-supervised video representation learning, yet the behavior of auxiliary objectives in small-scale Video-JEPA training is not well characterized. We report a small-scale empirical study of 18 auxiliary objective variants for Video-JEPA across two pretraining regimes: single-dataset (UCF-101) and mixed-dataset (UCF-101 + Something-Something V2 + ImageNet-100). We evaluate frozen representations on three complementary benchmarks: Diving-48 (fine-grained motion), SomethingSomething V2 (temporal reasoning), and ImageNet-100 (appearance). Our experiments suggest that many auxiliary objectives exhibit capacity trade-offs: gains on one downstream capability often coincide with degradation on another. We then study FWM-HW-LD (Factorized World-Model with Hard-Region-Weighted Latent Dynamics), a training-time objective that separates the latent representation into appearance and dynamics subspaces and applies hard-region weighting to both JEPA prediction errors and latent dynamics errors. In our mixed-dataset setting, FWM-HW-LD improves ImageNet-100 by +5.92 and SSv2 by +3.21 percentage points relative to the reference baseline, while remaining within 0.30 percentage points on Diving-48. These results indicate that latent factorization is a useful direction for studying auxiliary-objective trade-offs in Video-JEPA.

item.title: iMiGUE-3K: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Micro-Gesture Analysis with Self-Supervised Learning
item.author: Chengyan Wang, Haoyu Chen, Hui Wei, Yueyi Yang, Yunquan Chen, Guoying Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于微手势的情感理解新基准，包含iMiGUE-3K数据集和MG-FMs基础模型，旨在通过微手势分析提升情感理解能力。

背景: 现有方法主要关注面部表情和语音，往往忽视了通过身体语言传达的丰富情感线索。微手势作为一种由内心感受驱动的无意识、潜意识运动，正受到越来越多的关注。

目的: 为了推进微手势研究，本文提出了一个新的基于微手势的情感理解基准，包含一个新颖的数据集和一系列针对不同任务的基础模型。

方法: 采用基于模型的众包数据收集策略构建了iMiGUE-3K数据集，这是迄今为止最大的微手势数据集。该数据集包含332名专业网球运动员过去七年的公开采访视频，总计超过3400个长视频片段和3700万帧。数据集包含32个微手势类别和丰富的描述性注释。基于此数据集，提出了MG-FMs，一个用于可迁移手势表现学习的判别性基础模型。

主要发现: 基于微手势的分析显著改善了情感理解。

结论: 本文希望为微手势分析提供全面的工具，并为心理诊断、情感计算和高级人机交互的未来研究奠定坚实基础。

翻译: 情感理解是情感计算和人工智能中的一个基本挑战。虽然现有方法主要关注面部表情和语音，但往往忽视了通过身体语言传达的丰富情感线索。最近，微手势作为一种由内心感受驱动的无意识、潜意识运动，正受到越来越多的关注。然而，目前尚无支持微手势基础模型预训练的大规模数据集。为了推进微手势研究，本文提出了一个新的基于微手势的情感理解基准，包含一个新颖的数据集和一系列针对不同任务的基础模型。采用基于模型的众包数据收集策略构建了iMiGUE-3K数据集，这是迄今为止最大的微手势数据集。该数据集包含332名专业网球运动员过去七年的公开采访视频，总计超过3400个长视频片段和3700万帧。数据集包含32个微手势类别和丰富的描述性注释，使其成为首个用于细粒度手势情感分析的大规模野外视频数据集。基于iMiGUE-3K，本文提出了MG-FMs，一个用于可迁移手势表现学习的判别性基础模型。基于该基础模型，建立了五个全面的评估任务：微手势识别（无监督、半监督、监督）、微手势检索和微手势情感识别。对代表性方法的系统评估表明，基于微手势的分析显著改善了情感理解。本文希望为微手势分析提供全面的工具，并为心理诊断、情感计算和高级人机交互的未来研究奠定坚实基础。

Abstract

Emotion understanding is a fundamental challenge in affective computing and artificial intelligence. While existing approaches predominantly focus on facial expressions and speech, they often overlook the rich emotional cues conveyed through body language. Recently, micro-gestures (MGs), unintentional, subconscious movements driven by inner feelings, have attracted increasing attention as an alternative to other cues. However, there are no existing large-scale datasets supporting the pre-training of the MG foundation model. To advance MG research, we present a new benchmark for micro-gesture-based emotion understanding, featuring key contributions with a novel dataset (iMiGUE-3K) and a series of foundation models for different tasks. Using a model-based crowd-sourcing data collection strategy, we construct iMiGUE-3K, the largest MG dataset to date. It comprises video recordings from 332 distinct professional tennis players' public press interviews over the past seven years, totaling more than 3.4K long video clips and 37 million frames. The dataset includes 32 micro-gesture classes with rich descriptive annotations, making it the first large-scale, in-the-wild, video dataset for fine-grained gesture-based emotion analysis. Built on iMiGUE-3K, we propose MG-FMs, a discriminative foundation model for transferable gesture presentation learning. Based on the foundation model, we establish five comprehensive evaluation tasks: MG recognition (unsupervised, semi-supervised, supervised), MG retrieval, and MG emotion recognition. Our systematic evaluation of representative methods demonstrates that micro-gesture-based analysis significantly improves emotion understanding. We hope this work can provide comprehensive tools for MG analysis and set a solid foundation for future research in psychological diagnostics, affective computing, and advanced human-computer interaction.

item.title: The Geometry of Projection Heads: Conditioning, Invariance, and Collapse
item.author: Faris Chaudhry
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究开发了一种几何理论，将自监督学习中的投影头建模为可训练的黎曼度量，分析了线性与非线性投影头的性能差异及维度坍塌问题，并揭示了投影头作为几何缓冲器的作用。

背景: 自监督学习中的投影头通常被作为可训练组件，但其几何性质和作用机制尚不明确。

目的: 建立投影头的几何理论，分析其性能、维度坍塌问题以及与信息不变性之间的权衡关系。

方法: 将投影头建模为可训练的黎曼度量；分析线性与非线性投影头的隐式子空间白化及局部度量适应；通过实证分析优化几何；在对比和去相关目标上评估。

主要发现: 线性投影头执行隐式子空间白化；非线性投影头适应局部度量以满足损失拓扑约束；平滑非线性投影头在坍塌平衡点产生负特征值导致不稳定；平滑激活函数（如Swish）能产生显式负曲率以逃逸坍塌；线性投影头和ReLU投影头在连续时间梯度流下无法逃逸坍塌；投影头作为几何缓冲器，解耦语义骨干网络与预训练目标的刚性约束。

结论: 投影头作为通用的几何缓冲器，在解耦语义骨干网络与预训练目标约束方面起关键作用。

翻译: We develop a geometric theory of projection heads in self-supervised learning by modeling the head as a trainable Riemannian metric on the backbone representation manifold. We show that linear heads perform implicit subspace whitening, while nonlinear heads adapt local metrics to satisfy the specific topological constraints of the loss, with head depth empirically dictating this capacity. Analyzing dimensional collapse, we prove that smooth nonlinear heads natively induce negative eigenvalues in the Hessian at collapsed equilibria, making them unstable. We empirically validate this by continuously tracking the optimization geometry during training, which reveals that smooth activations like Swish can generate explicit negative curvature to escape collapse, whereas linear and ReLU heads under continuous-time gradient flow cannot, relying instead on discrete-time optimization dynamics and BatchNorm. Finally, we geometrically characterize how metric degeneracy governs the information-invariance trade-off, explaining why the head must be discarded. Evaluated across contrastive and decorrelation-based objectives on foundation models, our results demonstrate that the projection head acts as a universal geometric buffer, decoupling the semantic backbone from the rigid, destructive constraints of the pretraining objective.

Abstract

We develop a geometric theory of projection heads in self-supervised learning by modeling the head as a trainable Riemannian metric on the backbone representation manifold. We show that linear heads perform implicit subspace whitening, while nonlinear heads adapt local metrics to satisfy the specific topological constraints of the loss, with head depth empirically dictating this capacity. Analyzing dimensional collapse, we prove that smooth nonlinear heads natively induce negative eigenvalues in the Hessian at collapsed equilibria, making them unstable. We empirically validate this by continuously tracking the optimization geometry during training, which reveals that smooth activations like Swish can generate explicit negative curvature to escape collapse, whereas linear and ReLU heads under continuous-time gradient flow cannot, relying instead on discrete-time optimization dynamics and BatchNorm. Finally, we geometrically characterize how metric degeneracy governs the information-invariance trade-off, explaining why the head must be discarded. Evaluated across contrastive and decorrelation-based objectives on foundation models, our results demonstrate that the projection head acts as a universal geometric buffer, decoupling the semantic backbone from the rigid, destructive constraints of the pretraining objective.

item.title: OPTNet: Ordering Point Transformer Network for Post-disaster 3D Semantic Segmentation
item.author: Nhut Le, Ehsan Karimi, Maryam Rahnemoonfar
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OPTNet通过引入可学习的点排序模块，利用自监督排序损失动态预测最优排列以最大化注意力机制的局部性，显著提升了3D点云语义分割的效率与准确性。

背景: 灾后损害评估需要快速准确地识别受损建筑和道路等关键基础设施，这依赖于对3D点云的语义分割。早期Point Transformer（如PTv1, PTv2）依赖计算昂贵的邻居搜索和最远点采样。

目的: 为了提高效率，同时解决早期架构计算昂贵的问题，以及近期架构中固定排序方法无法最优捕捉灾害场景复杂几何形状的缺陷，提出一种新的方法。

方法: 提出OPTNet（Ordering Point Transformer Network），引入可学习的点排序模块，利用自监督排序损失动态预测最优排列以最大化注意力机制的局部性。

主要发现: 在3DAeroRelief数据集上评估，OPTNet显著优于最先进的基线方法。

结论: OPTNet通过动态排序有效提升了性能，为灾后损害评估提供了更高效的解决方案。

翻译: 摘要：灾后损害评估需要快速准确地识别受损建筑和道路等关键基础设施，这依赖于对3D点云的语义分割。早期Point Transformer（如PTv1, PTv2）依赖计算昂贵的邻居搜索和最远点采样。为了提高效率，近期架构如Point Transformer V3（PTv3）采用了静态序列化方法，如希尔伯特曲线或Z-order，来组织非结构化点以进行基于窗口的注意力机制。然而，这些固定排序对于捕捉灾害场景的复杂几何形状并非最优。在本文中，我们提出了OPTNet（Ordering Point Transformer Network），它引入了一个可学习的点排序模块。OPTNet利用自监督排序损失动态预测最优排列，以最大化注意力机制的局部性。我们在3DAeroRelief数据集上评估了我们的方法，显著优于最先进的基线方法。

深度解读

Abstract

Post-disaster damage assessment requires rapid and accurate semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds to identify critical infrastructure such as damaged buildings and roads. Early Point Transformers (e.g., PTv1, PTv2) relied on computationally expensive neighbor searching (k-NN) and Farthest Point Sampling (FPS). To improve efficiency, recent architectures like Point Transformer V3 (PTv3) adopted static serialization methods, such as Hilbert curves or Z-order, to organize unstructured points for window-based attention. However, these fixed orderings are not optimal for capturing the complex geometry of disaster scenes. In this paper, we propose OPTNet (Ordering Point Transformer Network), which introduces a learnable Point Sorter module. OPTNet utilizes a self-supervised ordering loss to dynamically predict an optimal permutation that maximizes the locality of the attention mechanism. We evaluate our method on the 3DAeroRelief dataset, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

item.title: Geometric Phase Transition Enables Extreme Hippocampal Memory Capacity
item.author: Raju, Prashant C.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了海马体群体几何结构的变化如何影响记忆系统的存储容量，发现通过从无序到结晶状几何结构的转变，可以显著提升空间记忆能力。

背景: 尽管硬件约束相似，记忆系统能存储 vastly 不同的信息量。本文比较了食物缓存的黑山雀和非缓存斑胸草雀的海马体结构。

目的: 探究海马体群体几何结构的变化如何影响记忆系统的存储容量，并验证这种几何结构是否是生物记忆高容量的组织原则。

方法: 通过比较黑山雀和非缓存斑胸草雀的海马体几何结构，结合计算建模分析不同几何结构的拓扑刚性和容量优势，并利用 Valiant 的 Stable Memory Allocator 模型进行双重分离验证。

主要发现: 缓存黑山雀的海马体具有结晶状几何结构，表现出更高的几何稳定性和时间连贯性；这种稳定性由兴奋性神经元形成空间支架和抑制性群体提供正交去相关作用共同构建；尽管几何结构优越，但缓存网络在神经元分配可靠性上接近零；结晶状代码在 M=1k 位置以上能维持高保真读出，而无序代码在 M=10 以下就会失效，容量优势超过 100 倍。

结论: 进化通过工程化神经代码的几何结构而非增加神经元数量来实现高容量记忆；几何稳定性是生物记忆高容量的组织原则。

翻译: 尽管硬件约束相似，记忆系统能存储 vastly 不同的信息量。本文发现，优越的空间记忆源于海马体群体几何结构的离散硬化——从无序到结晶状集体编码的转变。比较食物缓存的黑山雀和非缓存斑胸草雀，发现缓存黑山雀的海马体维持着拓扑刚性的“结晶状”几何结构，具有显著更高的几何稳定性（Shesha 0.245 对比 0.166）和近两倍的时间连贯性（Shesha 0.393 对比 0.209），而非缓存黑山雀的海马体则类似于无序的“雾”。这种稳定性由协同电路动力学主动构建：兴奋性神经元形成空间支架，而抑制性群体提供正交去相关，这是一种兴奋性和抑制性群体占据 largely 不重叠的表示子空间的电路模式。与 Valiant 的 Stable Memory Allocator 模型进行双重分离，该模型预测每个记忆由专门的神经元群体构成，证实了这种优势反映的是连续的拓扑组织而非离散的神经元分配：尽管几何结构优越，但缓存网络在分割分配可靠性上表现出接近零。跨 10k 配置的计算建模显示，拓扑刚性是规模扩大的数学先决条件：结晶状代码在 M=1k 位置以上维持高保真读出，而无序代码在 M=10 以下失效，容量优势超过 100 倍。这种容量需要 169 倍的表示冗余：一种稳定流形以抵抗生物噪声的“几何税”。这些结果确立了几何稳定性作为生物记忆组织原则的候选者：进化通过工程化神经代码的几何结构而非增加神经元数量来实现高容量记忆。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Memory systems can store vastly different amounts of information despite similar hardware constraints. Here, we show that superior spatial memory emerges from a discrete stiffening of hippocampal population geometry-a transition from disorganized to crystalline collective coding. Comparing food-caching chickadees to non-caching zebra finches, we found that the caching hippocampus maintains a topologically rigid, "crystalline" geometry with significantly higher geometric stability (Shesha 0.245 v 0.166) and nearly two-fold greater temporal coherence (Shesha 0.393 v 0.209), while the non-caching hippocampus resembles a disorganized "mist." This stability is actively constructed by synergistic circuit dynamics: excitatory neurons form the spatial scaffold while inhibitory populations contribute orthogonal decorrelation, a circuit motif in which excitatory and inhibitory populations occupy largely non-overlapping representational subspaces. A double dissociation with Valiant's Stable Memory Allocator, a model predicting that dedicated neuron ensembles underlie each memory, confirms this advantage reflects continuous topological organization rather than discrete neuron allocation: caching networks exhibit near-zero split-half allocation reliability despite their geometric superiority. Computational modeling across 10k configurations reveals topological rigidity as the mathematical prerequisite for scale: crystalline codes sustain high-fidelity readout beyond M=1k locations while mist codes fail below M=10, a >100-fold capacity advantage. This capacity requires a 169fold representational redundancy: a "geometric tax" stabilizing the manifold against biological noise. These results establish geometric stability as a candidate organizing principle of biological memory: evolution achieves high-capacity memory not by proliferating neurons, but by engineering the geometry of the neural code itself.

item.title: From Runnable to Shippable: Multi-Agent Test-Driven Development for Generating Full-Stack Web Applications from Requirements
item.author: Wan, Yuxuan, Liang, Tingshuo, Xu, Jiakai, Xiao, Jingyu, Huo, Yintong, Lyu, Michael R
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TDDev是一个自动化测试驱动开发框架，通过三个阶段实现从需求到修复的闭环，显著提升了代码生成质量，并发现最优协议取决于模型的生成风格。

背景: 现有编码代理生成的Web应用在功能需求上失败率超过70%，因为无法从源文件或终端输出评估Web正确性，需要部署和浏览器交互模拟。

目的: 提出TDDev框架，自动化测试驱动开发流程，并通过控制性实证研究比较不同开发协议对代码生成质量的影响。

方法: TDDev框架包含三个阶段：1.将高层需求转换为结构化验收测试；2.部署应用并通过浏览器交互模拟验证；3.将浏览器观察到的失败转换为结构化修复报告。

主要发现: TDD基础设施相比无TDD基线 consistently 提升了34-48个百分点的生成质量；最优协议取决于模型的生成风格：整体构建型模型受益于代理强制执行，保守扩展型模型受益于增量执行；不匹配协议会消除TDD益处并使token成本增加25倍。

结论: TDDev将手动开发者干预减少到零，将工作量从持续提示工程转移到自主、反馈驱动的优化。

翻译: 编码代理可以从自然语言描述生成Web应用程序，但最近的基准研究显示，生成的应用程序在超过70%的情况下无法满足功能需求。核心困难在于无法从源文件或终端输出评估Web正确性：应用程序必须被部署，通过模拟浏览器交互进行测试，并且必须将失败转化为可操作的修复信号——这些步骤当前代理无法在没有人类调解的情况下执行。我们提出了TDDev，一个通过三个阶段自动化此闭环的框架：(1)在编写任何代码之前将高层需求转换为结构化验收测试，(2)部署应用程序并通过基于浏览器的交互模拟对其进行验证，(3)将浏览器观察到的失败转换为结构化修复报告供编码代理使用。在TDDev的推动下，我们进行了首次针对Web应用程序生成的测试驱动开发（TDD）策略的控制性实证研究，比较了两种编码代理、两种骨干模型和两个基准上的四种开发协议。TDD基础设施相比无TDD基线 consistently 提高了34-48个百分点的生成质量。核心发现是最优协议取决于模型的生成风格：整体构建应用程序的模型从代理强制执行中受益最大，而保守扩展代码的模型从增量执行中受益。将协议与生成风格不匹配会完全消除TDD益处，同时使token成本增加25倍。一项用户研究证实，TDDev将手动开发者干预减少到零，将工作量从持续提示工程转移到自主、反馈驱动的优化。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Coding agents can generate web applications from natural-language descriptions, yet a recent benchmark study shows that generated applications fail to meet functional requirements in over 70% of cases. The core difficulty is that web correctness cannot be assessed from source files or terminal output: the application must be deployed, exercised through simulated browser interactions, and failures must be translated into actionable repair signals -- steps that current agents cannot perform without human mediation. We present TDDev, a framework that automates this closed loop through three stages: (1) converting high-level requirements into structured acceptance tests before any code is written, (2) deploying the application and validating it through browser-based interaction simulation, and (3) translating browser-observed failures into structured repair reports for the coding agent. Enabled by TDDev, we conduct the first controlled empirical study of Test-driven development (TDD) strategies for web application generation, comparing four development protocols across two coding agents, two backbone models, and two benchmarks. TDD infrastructure consistently improves generation quality by 34--48 percentage points over a no-TDD baseline. The central finding is that the optimal protocol depends on the model's generation style: models that build applications holistically benefit most from agentic enforcement, while models that extend code conservatively benefit from incremental enforcement. Mismatching protocol to generation style eliminates the TDD benefit entirely while multiplying token cost up to 25-fold. A user study confirms that TDDev reduces manual developer intervention to zero, shifting the workload from continuous prompt engineering to autonomous, feedback-driven refinement.

item.title: Image-to-Video Diffusion: From Foundations to Open Frontiers
item.author: Xianlong Wang, Wenbo Pan, Shijia Zhou, Ke Li, Yuqi Wang, Zeyu Ye, Hangtao Zhang, Leo Yu Zhang, Xiaohua Jia
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究将扩散图像到视频生成作为独立主题进行综述，分析了任务定义、模型架构、数据集和评估指标，并基于架构和训练范式对现有方法进行了分类。

背景: 扩散图像到视频生成是生成模型的重要方向，相比更广泛的视频生成任务，对内容一致性、身份保持和运动连贯性有更严格的要求。现有文献大多在更广泛的话题中讨论，缺乏针对该领域的专门分类和系统分析。

目的: 填补现有文献的空白，将扩散图像到视频生成作为独立主题进行研究，通过综述任务定义、模型架构、数据集和评估指标，并基于架构和训练范式对现有方法进行分类。

方法: 首先回顾任务定义、模型架构、数据集和评估指标，然后基于架构和训练范式对现有方法进行分类，并提炼出四个核心设计：条件编码、时序建模、噪声先验设计和时空上采样，同时讨论代表性应用场景和主要开放挑战。

主要发现: 现有方法可基于架构和训练范式进行分类，核心设计包括条件编码、时序建模、噪声先验设计和时空上采样。

结论: 该研究为扩散图像到视频生成提供了系统的分类和分析框架，指出了核心设计要素和主要开放挑战。

翻译: Diffusion-based image-to-video (I2V) generation has become a central direction in generative models by turning a reference image, with optional conditions, into a temporally coherent video. Compared with broader video generation settings, this task places stricter demands on content consistency, identity preservation, and motion coherence. Although the literature grows rapidly, existing works mostly discuss I2V generation within broader topics and still lack a dedicated taxonomy together with a systematic analysis centered on this field. This work addresses that gap by treating diffusion I2V generation as a standalone subject. It first reviews the task formulation, model architectures, datasets, and evaluation metrics, and then organizes existing methods through a taxonomy based on architecture and training paradigm. It further distills four core designs, namely condition encoding, temporal modeling, noise prior design, and spatial-temporal upsampling, and discusses representative application scenarios together with major open challenges.

Abstract

Diffusion-based \textit{image-to-video} (I2V) generation has become a central direction in generative models by turning a reference image, with optional conditions, into a temporally coherent video. Compared with broader video generation settings, this task places stricter demands on content consistency, identity preservation, and motion coherence. Although the literature grows rapidly, existing works mostly discuss I2V generation within broader topics and still lack a dedicated taxonomy together with a systematic analysis centered on this field. This work addresses that gap by treating diffusion I2V generation as a standalone subject. It first reviews the task formulation, model architectures, datasets, and evaluation metrics, and then organizes existing methods through a taxonomy based on architecture and training paradigm. It further distills four core designs, namely condition encoding, temporal modeling, noise prior design, and spatial-temporal upsampling, and discusses representative application scenarios together with major open challenges.

item.title: LiteFrame: Efficient Vision Encoders Unlock Frame Scaling in Video LLMs
item.author: Jihwan Kim, Nikhil Parthasarathy, Danfeng Qin, Junhwa Hur, Deqing Sun, Bohyung Han, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Boqing Gong
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为LiteFrame的高效视频编码器，通过压缩令牌蒸馏技术，在减少延迟的同时提高了视频理解能力。

背景: 随着视频大语言模型向长视频扩展，视觉令牌上下文长度的爆炸式增长带来了挑战。现有的策略主要关注事后令牌减少，但这会将延迟瓶颈从大语言模型转移到昂贵的逐帧视觉编码器处理上。

目的: 为了解决长视频处理中的延迟瓶颈问题，引入LiteFrame，这是一种高效的视频编码器骨干网络，旨在通过压缩令牌蒸馏训练框架，使紧凑的学生视觉编码器直接预测信息密集的时空压缩表示。

方法: 提出压缩令牌蒸馏（CTD）训练框架，教导紧凑的学生视觉编码器直接预测由大型教师视觉模型产生的信息密集、时空压缩的表示。此外，结合语言模型适应（LMA）进一步优化性能。

主要发现: 与InternVL3-8B相比，LiteFrame在处理更多帧数的同时，将端到端延迟降低了35%，并在多个基准测试中提高了平均视频理解准确率。

结论: 该研究展示了在固定计算预算下解锁长视频理解的新潜力路径，证明了在保持高准确率的同时显著降低延迟的可行性。

翻译: 随着视频大语言模型向长视频扩展，视觉令牌上下文长度的爆炸式增长带来了挑战。现有的策略主要关注事后令牌减少，但这会将延迟瓶颈从大语言模型转移到昂贵的逐帧视觉编码器处理上。为了解决长视频处理中的延迟瓶颈问题，引入LiteFrame，这是一种高效的视频编码器骨干网络，旨在通过压缩令牌蒸馏训练框架，使紧凑的学生视觉编码器直接预测信息密集的时空压缩表示。此外，结合语言模型适应（LMA）进一步优化性能。与InternVL3-8B相比，LiteFrame在处理更多帧数的同时，将端到端延迟降低了35%，并在多个基准测试中提高了平均视频理解准确率。该研究展示了在固定计算预算下解锁长视频理解的新潜力路径，证明了在保持高准确率的同时显著降低延迟的可行性。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决视频大语言模型在处理更多视频帧时面临的效率瓶颈问题。通过设计高效的视觉编码器，让模型能够“解锁”帧缩放能力，从而在不增加过多计算成本的情况下提升对视频动作和细节的理解能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 提出了一种名为 LiteFrame 的高效视觉编码器，旨在解决视频大语言模型中增加帧数时的效率瓶颈。

Abstract

The fundamental challenge in scaling Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) to long-form video lies in managing the explosion of visual-token context length. Existing strategies predominantly focus on "post-hoc" token reduction -- reducing visual tokens after feature extraction to alleviate the LLM's computational overhead. While these methods effectively reduce the number of visual tokens, we observe that the primary latency bottleneck then shifts from the LLM to the expensive per-frame processing of the vision encoder. To address this, we introduce LiteFrame, a strong, yet highly efficient video encoder backbone for Video LLMs. To train LiteFrame, we propose Compressed Token Distillation (CTD), a novel training framework that teaches a compact student vision encoder to directly predict information-dense, spatio-temporally compressed representations produced by a large teacher vision model, effectively bypassing redundant computation. When coupled with further Language Model Adaptation (LMA), this approach results in a new latency-accuracy Pareto frontier -- compared with InternVL3-8B, LiteFrame provides a 35% reduction in end-to-end latency while processing 8$\times$ more frames and improves average video understanding accuracy across multiple benchmarks. Our results demonstrate a new potential path to unlocking longer-form video understanding under fixed compute budgets.

item.title: How Do Electrocardiogram Models Scale?
item.author: Jiawei Li, Fabio Bonassi, Ming Jin, Stefan Gustafsson, Johan Sundström, Thomas B. Schön, Antônio H. Ribeiro
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究系统调查了心电图模型中的神经和损失到损失的缩放定律，通过预训练120个模型，解耦了模型架构和预训练范式的影响。

背景: 虽然缩放定律为自然语言处理中的基础模型建立了基本框架，但在心电图模型中的应用仍缺乏充分表征。近期研究在增加模型大小或预训练数据集大小时，下游增益并不总是保持一致。

目的: 系统地调查心电图领域内的神经和损失到损失的缩放定律，以明确架构归纳偏置、预训练范式和预期改进的作用。

方法: 在大型CODE数据集上预训练了120个模型（参数范围从2万到2亿），解耦了模型架构（ResNet与Transformer）和预训练范式（监督学习与自监督学习）的影响。

主要发现: 1. 监督学习模型在分布内数据上存在数据瓶颈，而自监督学习模型在模型和数据规模上均能稳健扩展；2. 在分布外泛化方面，ResNet比Transformer参数效率高1.3到2.5倍，自监督学习比监督学习数据效率高16倍，迁移效率高7.6倍；3. 在观察到的规模范围内，基于ResNet的模型通常实现最低的分布外损失，自监督学习在未见临床任务上占主导地位，而自监督Transformer在非常大的模型规模上超越其他方法。

结论: 有效的心电图基础模型的路径在于架构和范式的战略对齐，而非单纯的暴力扩展。

翻译: While scaling laws have established a fundamental framework for foundation models in natural language processing, their applicability to electrocardiogram (ECG) models remains poorly characterized. Indeed, recent studies do not always yield consistent downstream gains as one increases the model size or pre-training dataset size of ECG models, leaving the exact roles of architectural inductive biases, pre-training paradigms, and expected improvements with size largely unanswered. In this work, we systematically investigate neural and loss-to-loss scaling laws within the ECG domain. By pre-training over 120 models (ranging from 20K to 200M parameters) on the large-scale CODE dataset (2.3M records), we decouple the effects of model architecture (ResNet vs. Transformer) and pre-training paradigm, namely supervised learning (SL) versus self-supervised learning (SSL). We found that (i) SL models are data-bottlenecked in-distribution, whereas SSL models scale robustly across both model and data sizes; (ii) for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, ResNets are 1.3 to 2.5 times more parameter-efficient than Transformers, while SSL is up to 16 times more data-efficient and achieves up to 7.6 times higher transfer efficiency than SL on unseen clinical tasks; (iii) across the observed scales, ResNet-based models generally achieve the lowest OOD loss, with SSL dominating on unseen clinical tasks and self-supervised Transformers overtaking at very large model sizes. Our results suggest that the path to effective ECG foundation models lies in the strategic alignment of architecture and paradigm rather than brute-force scaling.

Abstract

While scaling laws have established a fundamental framework for foundation models in natural language processing, their applicability to electrocardiogram (ECG) models remains poorly characterized. Indeed, recent studies do not always yield consistent downstream gains as one increases the model size or pre-training dataset size of ECG models, leaving the exact roles of architectural inductive biases, pre-training paradigms, and expected improvements with size largely unanswered. In this work, we systematically investigate neural and loss-to-loss scaling laws within the ECG domain. By pre-training over $120$ models (ranging from $20$K to $200$M parameters) on the large-scale CODE dataset ($2.3$M records), we decouple the effects of model architecture (ResNet vs. Transformer) and pre-training paradigm, namely supervised learning (SL) versus self-supervised learning (SSL). We found that (i) SL models are data-bottlenecked in-distribution, whereas SSL models scale robustly across both model and data sizes; (ii) for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, ResNets are $1.3$ to $2.5$ times more parameter-efficient than Transformers, while SSL is up to $16$ times more data-efficient and achieves up to $7.6$ times higher transfer efficiency than SL on unseen clinical tasks; (iii) across the observed scales, ResNet-based models generally achieve the lowest OOD loss, with SSL dominating on unseen clinical tasks and self-supervised Transformers overtaking at very large model sizes. Our results suggest that the path to effective ECG foundation models lies in the strategic alignment of architecture and paradigm rather than brute-force scaling.

item.title: A2RBench: An Automatic Paradigm for Formally Verifiable Abstract Reasoning Benchmark Generation
item.author: Ma, Qingchuan, Ma, Yuexiao, Xie, Yongkang, Xie, Tianyu, Zheng, Xiawu, Ji, Rongrong
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为A2RBench的自动化流程，用于评估大语言模型的抽象推理能力，发现当前模型在抽象推理方面存在显著缺陷，且在高维任务理解上不足。

背景: 现有基准测试要么依赖昂贵的手动标注，限制了规模，要么存在测量记忆而非真正推理的风险。

目的: 为了准确测量大语言模型的抽象推理能力，引入了A2RBench自动化流程。

方法: A2RBench流程包括生成、扩展、评估和分析四个阶段。生成阶段由LLM创建多样化的任务；扩展阶段利用验证过的规则扩展输入空间以生成任务变体；通过建立理论框架并证明程序化验证（即反向操作完美逆转正向操作）可消除幻觉。

主要发现: 1. 当前LLM在抽象推理方面存在根本性缺陷，顶尖模型在代表性子集上显著低于人类（39.8% vs 68.5%）；2. 当前LLM在生成3D任务的复杂性上远低于2D和1D，揭示了其对高维任务理解的缺乏；3. 出乎意料的是，信息复杂度更高的输入反而能简化推理过程。

结论: 通过A2RBench的评估，揭示了当前大语言模型在抽象推理和高维任务理解上的不足，为改进模型提供了依据。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为A2RBench的自动化流程，用于评估大语言模型的抽象推理能力，发现当前模型在抽象推理方面存在显著缺陷，且在高维任务理解上不足。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决抽象推理基准缺乏形式可验证性的问题，提出了自动生成此类基准的范式。这很重要，因为形式可验证能确保测试集的准确性和可靠性，从而为模型评估提供坚实基础。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 提供的文本仅包含PDF文件的元数据和结构信息，不包含论文的正文内容。因此，无法回答作者是如何思考设计方法以及是否有借鉴现有工作的具体细节。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一种自动范式，用于生成A2RBench这一形式可验证的抽象推理基准。

Abstract

Abstract reasoning ability reflects the intelligence and generalization capacity of LLMs to extract and apply abstract rules. However, accurately measuring this ability remains challenging: existing benchmarks either rely on expensive manual annotation, limiting their scale, or risk measuring memorization rather than genuine reasoning. To address this, we introduce an automated pipeline named A2RBench, encompassing generation, expansion, evaluation, and analysis. Specifically, in the generation stage, LLMs create diverse tasks demanding genuine reasoning; in the expansion stage, LLMs reuse validated rules and expand new input spaces to generate task variations, achieving scaling. However, such a process may cause hallucinations. To eliminate it, we further establish a theoretical framework and prove that programmatic verification--testing whether the inverse operation perfectly reverses the forward operation (cycle consistency)--guarantees a unique solution. Through extensive evaluations on mainstream LLMs, we find: (1) Current LLMs exhibit fundamental deficiencies in abstract reasoning, with top models significantly underperforming humans on a representative subset (39.8% vs. 68.5%). (2) Current LLMs fall far short of 2D and 1D in the complexity of generated 3D tasks, revealing their lack of understanding of high-dimensional tasks. (3) Counterintuitively, inputs with higher information complexity can simplify the reasoning process.

item.title: OProver: A Unified Framework for Agentic Formal Theorem Proving
item.author: Ma, David, Ma, Kaijing, Guo, Shawn, Shi, Yunfeng, Zhao, Enduo, Shi, Jiajun, Zhang, Zhaoxiang, Cheung, Gavin, Liu, Jiaheng, Wang, Zili
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OProver是一个用于Lean 4中代理形式定理证明的统一框架，通过迭代修订失败证明和编译器反馈来提升证明能力。

背景: 大型证明生成和验证器感知训练在形式定理证明中取得了进展，但代理证明很少集成到证明器训练中，仅在推理时出现。

目的: 提出OProver框架，旨在通过代理证明和检索编译器验证证明来改进形式定理证明。

方法: OProver通过继续预训练和迭代后训练进行训练，使用失败证明尝试的迭代修订，构建OProofs索引，利用修复轨迹作为SFT数据，以及使用未解决的困难案例进行强化学习。

主要发现: OProver-32B在五个基准测试中取得了最佳Pass@32，包括MiniF2F (93.3%)、ProverBench (58.2%)和PutnamBench (11.3%)，在MathOlympiad (22.8%)和ProofNet (33.2%)中排名第二。

结论: OProver在多个基准测试中表现优于任何先前的开放权重全证明证明器，证明了代理证明在形式定理证明中的有效性。

翻译: 最近形式定理证明的进展得益于大规模证明生成和验证器感知训练，但代理证明很少集成到证明器训练中，仅在推理时出现。我们提出了OProver，这是一个用于Lean 4中代理形式定理证明的统一框架，在该框架中，失败的证明尝试使用检索到的编译器验证证明和Lean编译器反馈进行迭代修订。OProver通过继续预训练和迭代后训练进行训练：每次迭代运行代理证明，将新验证的证明索引到OProofs和检索记忆中，使用修复轨迹作为SFT数据，并使用未解决的困难案例进行强化学习。OProofs由公共Lean资源、大规模证明合成和代理证明轨迹构建，包含177万Lean语句、686万编译器验证证明以及带有检索上下文、失败尝试、反馈和修复的序列化轨迹。在五个基准测试中，OProver-32B在MiniF2F (93.3%)、ProverBench (58.2%)和PutnamBench (11.3%)上取得了最佳Pass@32，在MathOlympiad (22.8%)和ProofNet (33.2%)上排名第二，比任何先前的开放权重全证明证明器有更多的顶尖排名。

Abstract

Recent progress in formal theorem proving has benefited from large-scale proof generation and verifier-aware training, but agentic proving is rarely integrated into prover training, appearing only at inference time. We present OProver, a unified framework for agentic formal theorem proving in Lean 4, in which failed proof attempts are iteratively revised using retrieved compiler verified proofs and Lean compiler feedback. OProver is trained through continued pretraining followed by iterative post-training: each iteration runs agentic proving, indexes newly verified proofs into OProofs and the retrieval memory, uses repair trajectories as SFT data, and uses unresolved hard cases for RL. OProofs is built from public Lean resources, large-scale proof synthesis, and agentic proving traces, containing 1.77M Lean statements, 6.86M compiler-verified proofs, and serialized trajectories with retrieved context, failed attempts, feedback, and repairs. Across five benchmarks, OProver-32B attains the best Pass@32 on MiniF2F (93.3%), ProverBench (58.2%), and PutnamBench (11.3%), and ranks second on MathOlympiad (22.8%) and ProofNet (33.2%) more top placements than any prior open-weight whole-proof prover.

item.title: CLAP: Contrastive Latent-space Prompt Optimization for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
item.author: Ruiyang Zhu, Yuehan He, Boyuan Zheng, Zesen Zhao, Ahmad Chalhoub, Qingzhao Zhang, Z. Morley Mao
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CLAP是一种位置感知的适应框架，通过车辆到万物通信按需检索，增强冻结的VLA驾驶模型，显著减少挑战性场景规划错误。

背景: 基于视觉-语言-动作模型的端到端自动驾驶系统在常见驾驶场景中表现良好，但在罕见但安全关键的长期尾部情况（如主动施工区域和复杂让行几何形状）中表现脆弱。

目的: 提出一种方法，解决超越数据缩放和模型训练的长期挑战场景问题。

方法: CLAP框架，利用监督对比学习发现特定路障的硬场景方向，随后进行方向正则化的提示优化，选择性改进挑战性帧同时保持正常帧性能。

主要发现: 在VLA的隐藏状态层，相同路障簇的场景紧密且占据紧凑的潜在空间区域；在单个路障内，长期尾部和正常帧在潜在表示中大量混合。

结论: 在NAVSIM基准测试中，CLAP在各种最先进的VLA骨干网络上，使挑战性场景规划错误减少了24%，且正常帧性能无下降。

翻译: 基于视觉-语言-动作模型的端到端自动驾驶系统在常见驾驶场景中表现强劲，但在主动施工区域和复杂让行几何形状等罕见但安全关键的长期尾部情况中仍表现脆弱。本文提出了一种超越数据缩放和模型训练来解决长期挑战场景的方法。我们介绍了CLAP（对比潜在空间提示优化），这是一种位置感知的适应框架，通过车辆到万物通信按需检索，利用众包数据优化的特定路障软提示来增强冻结的VLA驾驶模型。我们的方法基于对VLA潜在空间的两个观察：在VLA的隐藏状态层，来自同一路障簇的场景紧密且占据潜在空间的紧凑区域；在单个路障内，长期尾部和正常帧在潜在表示中大量混合，使得在不干扰另一方的情况下难以改进。CLAP通过两阶段流程解决此问题：监督对比学习以发现特定路障的硬场景方向，随后是方向正则化的提示优化，选择性改进挑战性帧同时保持正常帧性能。在NAVSIM基准测试中，CLAP在各种最先进的VLA骨干网络上，使挑战性场景规划错误减少了24%，且正常帧性能无下降。

Abstract

End-to-end autonomous driving systems powered by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance on common driving scenarios, yet remain brittle in rare but safety-critical long-tail situations such as active construction zones and complex yielding geometries. In this paper, we present a method that addresses the long-tail challenging scenes beyond data scaling and model training. We introduce CLAP (Contrastive Latent-space Prompt optimization), a location-aware adaptation framework that augments a frozen VLA driving model with per-roadblock soft prompts, optimized from crowdsourced data and retrieved on demand via Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication. Our approach rests on two observations from VLAs' latent space: (i) at the VLA's hidden-state layer, scenarios from the same roadblock cluster tightly and occupy compact regions of the latent space; and (ii) within a single roadblock, long-tail and normal frames are heavily intermixed in the latent representation, making it difficult to improve one without disturbing the other. CLAP addresses this via a two-stage pipeline: supervised contrastive learning to discover a roadblock-specific hard-scene direction, followed by directionally regularized prompt optimization that selectively improves challenging frames while preserving normal frame performance. On the NAVSIM benchmark with various state-of-the-art VLA backbones, CLAP reduces challenging scenario planning error by 24% with no regression on normal frames, significantly improving planning performance.

item.title: UNR-Explainer: Counterfactual Explanations for Unsupervised Node Representation Learning Models
item.author: Hyunju Kang, Geonhee Han, Hogun Park
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的UNR-Explainer方法，用于在无监督节点表示学习中生成反事实解释。该方法通过扰动识别导致节点k近邻发生显著变化的子图，为无监督下游任务如链接预测和聚类提供简单且关键的信息。

背景: 节点表示学习（如图神经网络）在机器学习中至关重要，但对可靠解释生成的需求日益增长，而无监督模型的相关研究仍较少。

目的: 为了填补无监督节点表示学习中解释生成的空白，提出一种生成反事实解释的方法。

方法: 基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的UNR-Explainer方法，通过扰动识别导致节点k近邻发生显著变化的最重要子图。

主要发现: 该方法在多种数据集上对无监督的GraphSAGE和DGI方法表现出优越的性能。

结论: 基于k近邻的反事实解释方法为理解无监督下游任务提供了简单且关键的信息，UNR-Explainer能够生成具有表现力的反事实解释。

翻译: 节点表示学习，如图神经网络（GNN），已成为机器学习中的关键方法。对可靠解释生成的需求不断增长，而无监督模型仍被探索不足。为了填补这一差距，我们介绍了一种在无监督节点表示学习中生成反事实（CF）解释的方法。我们识别出最重要的子图，这些子图在扰动时导致感兴趣节点的k近邻在学习的嵌入空间中发生显著变化。基于k近邻的CF解释方法为理解无监督下游任务（如top-k链接预测和聚类）提供了简单且关键的信息。因此，我们介绍了UNR-Explainer，用于基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）为无监督节点表示学习方法生成具有表现力的CF解释。所提出的方法在多种数据集上对无监督GraphSAGE和DGI表现出优越性能。

Abstract

Node representation learning, such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), has emerged as a pivotal method in machine learning. The demand for reliable explanation generation surges, yet unsupervised models remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce a method for generating counterfactual (CF) explanations in unsupervised node representation learning. We identify the most important subgraphs that cause a significant change in the k-nearest neighbors of a node of interest in the learned embedding space upon perturbation. The k-nearest neighbor-based CF explanation method provides simple, yet pivotal, information for understanding unsupervised downstream tasks, such as top-k link prediction and clustering. Consequently, we introduce UNR-Explainer for generating expressive CF explanations for Unsupervised Node Representation learning methods based on a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). The proposed method demonstrates superior performance on diverse datasets for unsupervised GraphSAGE and DGI.

item.title: Efficient Feature-Free Initialization for Monocular Visual-Inertial Systems Using a Feed-Forward 3D Model
item.author: Yuantai Zhang, Jiaqi Yang, Huajian Zeng, Changhao Chen, Haoang Li, Liang Li, Dezhen Song, Xingxing Zuo
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无需视觉特征追踪的特征无关初始化框架，利用前馈3D模型预测的点云进行视觉惯性导航系统的初始化。

背景: 现有的视觉惯性导航系统初始化方法严重依赖视觉特征对应关系，且通常需要3-4秒的传感器数据才能成功初始化，这限制了其适用性和效率。

目的: 为了解决现有方法对视觉特征依赖强、初始化耗时长的局限性，本文旨在提出一种新的初始化框架。

方法: 本文提出了一种特征无关初始化框架，该框架利用前馈3D模型预测的尺度不变点云，从而消除了对视觉特征追踪和估计的需求。

主要发现: 实验表明，该方法在公共数据集上取得了最高的成功率，超过90%，并且显著减少了成功初始化所需的数据持续时间，通常降至1.2秒以下。在包含各种室内外场景的自收集数据集上验证了鲁棒性，特别是在现有方法容易失败的视觉退化环境中表现良好。

结论: 该方法显著降低了系统复杂度并提高了初始化的可靠性，在成功率、初始化速度和鲁棒性方面均优于现有方法。

翻译: 摘要：快速可靠的初始化对于单目视觉惯性导航系统至关重要，因为它为后续的状态估计建立了起始条件。尽管取得了稳步进展，但大多数现有方法严重依赖视觉特征对应关系，并且需要3-4秒的传感器数据才能成功初始化，这限制了它们的适用性和效率。随着前馈3D模型的兴起，该模型可以直接从图像中预测点云，我们从简洁的角度重新审视了视觉惯性初始化问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种特征无关初始化框架，该框架利用前馈3D模型预测的尺度不变点云，从而消除了对视觉特征追踪和估计的需求。这种设计大大降低了系统复杂度并提高了初始化的可靠性。在公共数据集上的实验表明，所提出的特征无关初始化方法取得了最高的成功率，超过90%，并显著减少了成功初始化所需的数据持续时间，通常降至1.2秒以下。我们进一步在涵盖各种室内外场景的自收集数据集上验证了该方法，证明了其鲁棒的性能，特别是在现有方法经常失败的视觉退化环境中。代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/Yuantai-Z/FF-VIO-Init 获取。
