Abstract

Fast and reliable initialization is critical for monocular visual-inertial navigation systems (VINS), as it establishes the starting conditions for subsequent state estimation. Despite steady progress, most existing methods heavily rely on visual feature correspondences and require 3-4 seconds of sensory data for successful initialization, which limits their applicability and efficiency. With the advent of feed-forward 3D models that can directly predict point clouds from images, we revisit the visual-inertial initialization problem from a concise perspective. In this work, we propose a feature-free initialization framework that leverages up-to-scale point clouds predicted by a feed-forward 3D model, thereby obviating the need for visual feature tracking and estimation. This design substantially reduces system complexity and improves the reliability of initialization. Experiments on public datasets demonstrate that the proposed feature-free initialization method achieves the highest success rate, exceeding 90%, and significantly reduces the data duration required for successful initialization, typically to under 1.2 s. We further validate our method on a self-collected dataset covering various indoor and outdoor scenarios, demonstrating robust performance, particularly in visually degraded environments where existing methods often fail. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Yuantai-Z/FF-VIO-Init.

item.title: Text-Guided Visual Representation Learning for Robust Multimodal E-Commerce Recommendation
item.author: Yufei Guo, Jing Ma, Tianlu Zhang, Shijie Yang, Yanlong Zang, Weijie Ding, Pinghua Gong, Jungong Han
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 TGQ-Former 的文本引导视觉表示学习框架，用于解决电商商品检索中的噪声问题。

背景: 电商商品图像常包含促销覆盖层和背景杂乱信息，导致虚假视觉线索并降低检索鲁棒性。这一问题在基于冻结视觉编码器和轻量级连接器的多模态大语言模型（MLRM）管道中尤为突出。

目的: 利用结构化元数据作为语义指导来提取视觉标记，同时保留互补的视觉证据。

方法: 采用混合查询连接器来解耦元数据锚定和探索性视觉流，并引入轻量级可靠性感知双门控向量调制模块，以在噪声输入下自适应校准它们的贡献。

主要发现: 在包含全池检索的大规模真实世界电商数据集上，TGQ-Former 始终优于强连接器基线和端到端多模态大语言模型。平均而言，它将 Hit Rate@100 提高了 6.04%。

结论: 文本引导的视觉编码对于稳健的多模态检索是有效的。

翻译: 多模态项目嵌入对于电商项目对项目检索至关重要，然而现实世界的产品图像通常包含促销覆盖层和背景杂乱信息，这些信息注入了虚假的视觉线索并降低了检索鲁棒性。这一问题在基于冻结视觉编码器和轻量级连接器的 MLRM 风格管道中尤为突出，其中冻结的视觉编码器通过轻量级连接器连接到 LLM，该连接器必须选择性聚合视觉标记。我们提出了文本引导 Q-Former (TGQ-Former)，这是一种文本引导的视觉表示学习框架，它利用结构化元数据作为视觉标记提取的语义指导，同时保留互补的视觉证据。具体而言，TGQ-Former 采用混合查询连接器来解耦元数据锚定和探索性视觉流，并引入轻量级可靠性感知双门控向量调制模块，以在噪声输入下自适应校准它们的贡献。在包含全池检索的大规模真实世界电商数据集上的实验表明，TGQ-Former 始终优于强连接器基线和端到端 MLLMs。平均而言，它将 Hit Rate@100 提高了 6.04%，证明了文本引导的视觉编码对于稳健的多模态检索的有效性。

Abstract

Multimodal item embeddings are crucial for e-commerce item-to-item (I2I) retrieval, yet real-world product images often contain promotional overlays and background clutter that inject spurious visual cues and degrade retrieval robustness. This issue is particularly pronounced in MLRM-style pipelines, where a frozen vision encoder is connected to an LLM through a lightweight connector that must selectively aggregate visual tokens. We propose Text-Guided Q-Former (TGQ-Former), a text-guided visual representation learning framework that leverages structured metadata as semantic guidance for visual token extraction while preserving complementary visual evidence. Concretely, TGQ-Former employs a hybrid-query connector to disentangle metadata-anchored and exploratory visual streams, and introduces a lightweight reliability-aware dual-gated vector modulation module to adaptively calibrate their contributions under noisy inputs. Experiments on large-scale, real-world e-commerce datasets with full-pool retrieval show that TGQ-Former consistently outperforms strong connector baselines and end-to-end MLLMs. On average, it improves Hit Rate@100 (H@100) by 6.04%, demonstrating the effectiveness of text-guided visual encoding for robust multimodal retrieval.

item.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Sparse Matrix Reordering
item.author: Ziwei Li, Tao Yuan, Fangfang Liu, Shuzi Niu, Huiyuan Li, Wenjia Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于多网格图网络和路径三元组不等式的新方法，用于稀疏矩阵的重排序以减少填充，实验证明该方法在减少填充和加速 LU 分解方面优于现有方法。

背景: 稀疏矩阵的重排序可以显著减少填充，但寻找最小化填充的排序是 NP 完全问题。现有方法（包括图论和深度学习方法）依赖于代理目标且缺乏理论保证。

目的: 利用填充路径定理揭示填充生成与稀疏结构之间的直接关系，提出一种新的方法来减少填充。

方法: 首先使用多网格图网络捕获每个顶点的结构信息；然后基于不等式推导出三元组采样策略；最后引入端最大链损失函数来减少预测分数满足这些不等式的三元组数量。

主要发现: 填充路径定理揭示了填充生成与稀疏结构之间的直接关系；提出的基于多网格图网络和三元组采样策略的方法在减少填充和加速 LU 分解方面表现出优越性。

结论: 实验评估表明，该方法在减少填充和加速 LU 分解时间方面优于现有方法。

翻译: 通过适当的排序重新排列稀疏矩阵的行或列可以显著减少填充，即矩阵分解过程中引入的新非零元素，从而降低内存使用和运行时间。然而，寻找最小化填充的排序是 NP 完全问题。现有的方法，包括图论和深度学习方法，都依赖于没有理论保证的代理目标。填充路径定理揭示了填充生成与矩阵稀疏结构之间的直接且内在的关系，即路径三元组不等式。在这里，我们首先采用多网格图网络来捕获每个顶点的结构信息。然后，我们基于不等式推导出三元组采样策略。最后，我们引入端最大链损失函数来减少预测分数满足这些不等式的三元组数量。在公开可用的 SuiteSparse 矩阵集合上的实验评估表明，所提出的方法在填充减少和 LU 分解加速方面表现出优越性。

Abstract

Rearranging the rows or columns of a sparse matrix using an appropriate ordering can significantly reduce fill-ins, i.e., new nonzeros introduced during matrix factorization, decreasing memory usage and runtime. However, finding an ordering that minimizes fill-ins is NP-complete. Existing approaches, including graph-theoretic and deep learning methods, rely on surrogate objectives without theoretical guarantees. The Fill-Path Theorem reveals a direct and intrinsic relationship between fill-in generation and the sparse structure of the matrix as path triplet inequalities. Here we first employ a multigrid graph network to capture structural information for each vertex. We then derive a triplet sampling strategy based on inequalities. Finally, we introduce an end-max chain loss function to reduce the number of triplets whose predicted scores satisfy these inequalities. Experimental evaluations on the publicly available SuiteSparse matrix collection demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in terms of both fill-in reduction and speedup in LU factorization time.

item.title: Learning Displacement-Robust Representations for Landslide Early Warning under Rainfall Forecast Uncertainty
item.author: Ren Ozeki, Hamada Rizk, Hirozumi Yamaguchi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对降雨引起的滑坡风险，提出了一种抗降雨场位移的滑坡早期预警系统。

背景: 气候变化加剧了极端降雨事件，导致全球滑坡风险增加。

目的: 为了提供足够的疏散时间，需要开发能够整合观测降雨和短期降雨预报的滑坡早期预警系统。

方法: 提出了基于降雨-运动感知对比学习（RMCL）的滑坡预测模型，该模型通过引入时间相关的降雨场扰动来模拟预报引起的位移。

主要发现: 在覆盖日本19个滑坡区域的两年降雨和地形数据上进行的实验表明，该系统比最先进的基线精度提高了高达37%。

结论: 将降雨建模为移动的空间场并在学习中解决降雨场位移问题，显著提高了运营早期预警系统中短期滑坡预测的可靠性。

翻译: 摘要：随着气候变化加剧极端降雨事件，降雨引起的滑坡在全球范围内构成了日益增长的风险。为了提供足够的疏散时间，用于实时灾害监测的滑坡早期预警系统（LEWS）必须通过整合观测降雨和来自时空环境数据流的短期降雨预报来估算近未来的滑坡风险。尽管最近的滑坡预测方法通过统计和深度学习方法提高了预测性能，但大多数都假设降雨输入准确。然而，在运营环境中，滑坡预测依赖于降雨预报，而降雨预报由于预报不确定性往往包含降雨场的空间位移。这种位移可能会改变局部累积降雨并降低预测精度。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种对降雨场位移具有鲁棒性的新型LEWS。关键思想是从降雨和地形数据中学习在降雨场运动中保持稳定的潜在表示，从而实现可靠的地理空间数据集成以进行滑坡风险估计。滑坡预测模型使用降雨-运动感知对比学习（RMCL）进行训练，该学习引入了时间相关的降雨场扰动，以模拟降雨驱动的时空环境数据流中的预报引起的位移。实验使用日本覆盖19个滑坡区域的两年降雨和地形数据进行。所提出的系统比最先进的基线精度提高了高达37%。这些结果表明，将降雨建模为移动的空间场并在学习中解决降雨场位移问题，显著提高了运营早期预警系统中短期滑坡预测的可靠性。

Abstract

Rainfall-induced landslides pose a growing risk worldwide as climate change intensifies extreme rainfall events. To provide sufficient evacuation time, landslide early warning systems (LEWS) for real-time disaster monitoring must estimate near-future landslide risk by integrating observed rainfall with short-term rainfall forecasts from spatio-temporal environmental data streams. Although recent landslide prediction methods have improved predictive performance using statistical and deep learning approaches, most assume accurate rainfall inputs. In operational settings, however, landslide prediction relies on rainfall forecasts, which often contain spatial displacement of rainfall fields due to forecasting uncertainties. Such displacement can alter local accumulated rainfall and degrade prediction accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose a novel LEWS robust to rainfall field displacement. The key idea is to learn latent representations from rainfall and terrain data that remain stable under displacement in rainfall field motion, enabling reliable geospatial data integration for landslide risk estimation. The landslide prediction model is trained using Rainfall-Motion-Aware Contrastive Learning (RMCL), which introduces temporally correlated rainfall field perturbations to emulate forecast-induced displacement in rainfall-driven spatio-temporal environmental data streams. Experiments were conducted using two years of rainfall and terrain data across Japan, covering 19 regions with landslide events. The proposed system achieved up to 37% higher precision than state-of-the-art baselines. These results demonstrate that modeling rainfall as a moving spatial field and addressing rainfall field displacement during learning significantly improve the reliability of short-term landslide prediction in operational early warning systems.

item.title: Visual Sculpting: Visually-Aligned Planning Representations for Long-Horizon Robot Clay Sculpting
item.author: Peter Schaldenbrand, Jean Oh
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于粘土雕刻的机器人控制方法，通过建模粘土的动力学特性并使用视觉对齐的表示进行规划，实现了长时程的粘土浮雕雕刻任务。

背景: 粘土雕刻是一项需要灵巧操作和长时程规划的艺术任务，作为机器人问题可被形式化为形状到形状的匹配挑战。

目的: 为了解决现有可变形物体操作方法需要针对每个目标重新训练策略或依赖稀疏点云表示无法捕捉纹理等重要特征的问题，本文旨在提出一种能够捕捉光照和纹理特征的动力学模型和规划方法。

方法: 本文提出了一种建模可变形材料动力学的方法，在视觉对齐的表示中进行机器人粘土雕刻规划。动作被表示为参数化的推力，使用单个末端执行器。

主要发现: 在三种不同的可变形材料和各种末端执行器的测试中，该动力学模型在性能上与最先进的方法相当，并且与视觉规划兼容。该方法适用于长时程（>100次动作）的粘土浮雕雕刻。

结论: 在视觉对齐的表示中进行规划具有优势，但分析表明相比于3D表示，这种表示在规划方面具有挑战性。

翻译: 粘土雕刻是一项微妙的、艺术性的任务，涉及灵巧的操作和长时程规划以实现高层目标。作为一个机器人问题，我们将粘土雕刻形式化为形状到形状的匹配挑战。先前的可变形物体操作工作要么需要针对每个目标重新训练策略，要么依赖于动力学模型，该模型将状态表示为稀疏点云，无法很好地捕捉重要的粘土特征，如纹理。我们提出了一种建模可变形材料动力学的方法，并在视觉对齐的表示中进行机器人粘土雕刻规划，以捕捉光照和纹理特征。使用三种不同的可变形材料和各种末端执行器，我们证明了我们的动力学模型在性能上与最先进的方法相当，并且具有与视觉规划兼容的额外好处。我们的动作被表示为参数化的推力，使用单个末端执行器，这证明适合长时程（>100次动作）的粘土浮雕雕刻。最后，我们展示了在视觉对齐的表示中进行规划的好处，但也提供了分析，提供了证据表明为什么这种表示相比3D表示在规划方面具有挑战性。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Clay sculpting is a nuanced, artistic task involving dexterous manipulation with long-horizon planning to achieve high-level goals. As a robotics problem, we formulate clay sculpting as a shape-to-shape matching challenge. Prior deformable object manipulation work either requires retraining a policy per goal or relies on dynamics models which represent state as sparse point clouds which do not capture important clay features, such as textures, well. We present a method for modeling the dynamics of deformable materials and planning for robotic sculpting in a representation that is visually-aligned, capturing lighting and texture features. With three different deformable materials and various end-effectors, we demonstrate that our dynamics model is comparable in performance to the state-of-the-art with the added benefit of being compatible with visual planning. Our actions are represented as parametrized pushes into clay with a single end-effector, which proved to be suitable for long-horizon (>100 actions) clay relief sculptures. Lastly, we show the benefits of planning in a visually-aligned representation, but also provide analysis providing evidence as to why this representation is challenging to plan in compared to 3D representations.

item.title: Rethinking Point Clouds as Sequences: A Causal Next-Token Predictive Learning Framework
item.author: Yumeng Yao, Jingzhi Dong, Haowen Gu, Tao Chen, Zonghan Wu, Xiaoshui Huang, Yazhou Yao
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了PointNTP，这是一种将点云预训练重新定义为完全因果、无解码器的潜在空间Next-Token Prediction问题的方法。

背景: 随着多模态基础模型和预测预训练的快速发展，如何为3D点云配备与Next-token和Next-embedding学习更好的对齐的预训练范式是一个重要的开放问题。现有的点云自监督方法大多建立在掩码重建或显式几何生成之上，因此仍受限于输入恢复而非预测依赖建模。

目的: 为了解决现有方法受限于输入恢复而非预测依赖建模的问题，本文引入了PointNTP，旨在通过因果Transformer在潜在空间中直接学习结构依赖。

方法: PointNTP将每个点云首先划分为局部补丁，并根据补丁中心几何结构将其序列化为结构化的3D token序列。该序列由仅前缀条件下的因果Transformer建模，并使用基于位移的预测目标进行训练，该目标通过stop-gradient目标进行稳定。

主要发现: 实验表明，PointNTP在多个下游任务中表现高度竞争：在ScanObjectNN的OBJ_BG、OBJ_ONLY和PB_T50_RS上分别达到93.8%、92.6%和89.3%；在ShapeNetPart的Cls.mIoU上达到85.0%；在S3DIS Area 5上达到71.1%的mAcc。

结论: 无解码器的因果潜在预测为点云自监督学习提供了一种简单、可扩展且可能模态无关的范式，为3D数据的Foundation-style预测学习提供了新的3D视角。

翻译: 随着多模态基础模型和预测预训练的快速发展，一个重要的开放问题是如何为3D点云配备与next-token和next-embedding学习更好地对齐的预训练范式。现有的点云自监督方法大多建立在掩码重建或显式几何生成之上，因此仍受限于输入恢复而非预测依赖建模。在本文中，我们介绍了PointNTP，它将点云预训练重新定义为完全因果、无解码器的潜在Next-Token Prediction问题。具体来说，每个点云首先被划分为局部补丁，并根据补丁中心几何结构序列化为结构化的3D token序列。由此产生的序列由仅前缀条件下的因果Transformer建模，并使用基于位移的预测目标进行训练，该目标通过stop-gradient目标进行稳定。这种设计使模型能够在潜在空间中直接学习结构依赖，而无需重建解码器或显式几何恢复。广泛的实验表明，所提出的PointNTP在多个下游任务中表现高度竞争：它在ScanObjectNN的OBJ_BG、OBJ_ONLY和PB_T50_RS上分别达到93.8%、92.6%和89.3%；在ShapeNetPart的Cls.mIoU上达到85.0%；并在S3DIS Area 5上达到71.1%的mAcc。总体而言，无解码器的因果潜在预测为点云自监督学习提供了一种简单、可扩展且可能模态无关的范式，为3D数据的Foundation-style预测学习提供了新的3D视角。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决点云预训练方法的问题，通过将点云视为序列并利用因果预测下一个标记来改进学习框架。这在研究中很重要，因为它有助于提升三维数据的表示学习能力，并为多媒体基础模型的发展提供新的思路。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 文中未明确说明作者的设计思路和借鉴的具体现有工作，因此无法回答。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法将点云视为序列，利用因果下一个标记预测进行自监督学习。整体实现流程未知。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种将点云视为序列的新方法，利用因果下一个标记预测进行自监督学习，以改进 3D 表示学习。

Abstract

With the rapid progress of multimodal foundation models and predictive pre-training, an important open question is how to equip 3D point clouds with a pre-training paradigm that is better aligned with next-token and next-embedding learning. Existing point-cloud self-supervised methods are largely built on masked reconstruction or explicit geometric generation, and thus remain tied to input recovery rather than predictive dependency modeling. In this paper, we introduce PointNTP, which reformulates point cloud pre-training as a fully causal, decoder-free latent Next-Token Prediction problem. Specifically, each point cloud is first partitioned into local patches and serialized into a structured 3D token sequence according to patch-center geometry. The resulting sequence is then modeled by a causal Transformer under prefix-only conditioning, and trained with a shift-based prediction objective stabilized by stop-gradient targets. This design enables the model to learn structural dependencies directly in latent space, without reconstruction decoders or explicit geometric recovery. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed PointNTP is highly competitive across multiple downstream tasks: it achieves 93.8%(+0.5%), 92.6%(+0.3%), and 89.3%(+1.1%) on OBJ_BG, OBJ_ONLY, and PB_T50_RS of ScanObjectNN, respectively; obtains 85.0%(+0.1%) in Cls.mIoU on ShapeNetPart; and reaches 71.1% mAcc on S3DIS Area 5. Overall, decoder-free causal latent prediction provides a simple, scalable, and potentially modality-agnostic paradigm for point-cloud self-supervised learning, offering a new 3D perspective on foundation-style predictive learning for 3D data.

item.title: Deepfake Detection in Social Media: A Temporal Artifact Analysis Using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks
item.author: Mohammadreza Rashidi, Raja Hashim Ali, Sami Ur Rahman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对合成面部视频的检测问题，提出了一种基于R3D-18的3D卷积神经网络检测器，通过复合损失函数训练，在128x128分辨率下实现了92.8%的准确率，并证明了时间伪影比空间伪影具有更强的泛化能力。

背景: 合成面部视频在社交媒体上迅速传播，超出了平台监管的响应速度，增加了虚假信息和基于身份的攻击成本。

目的: 解决帧级深度伪造检测器在生成器质量提高时准确率急剧下降的问题，并提高检测器的泛化能力。

方法: 使用基于R3D-18的3D卷积神经网络，结合二元交叉熵和时序一致性正则化项的复合损失函数进行训练；模型处理16帧视频片段，并使用Kinetics-400动作识别权重进行初始化。

主要发现: 在128x128分辨率下，跨数据集无微调迁移到FaceForensics++的准确率达到76.4%，微调后有所提升；迁移学习贡献了7.2个百分点，人脸追踪增加了3.5个百分点；时序一致性正则化在高质量伪造上提供了额外增益。

结论: 时间伪影比空间伪影具有更广泛的泛化能力，这种检测信号能够抵抗社交媒体的重新编码。

翻译: Synthetic facial videos have proliferated across social media faster than platform moderation can respond, raising the cost of disinformation and identity-based attacks. Frame-level deepfake detectors degrade sharply as generator quality increases; high-quality 128x128 GAN output cuts spatial-only accuracy by five percentage points while leaving temporal inconsistencies largely intact. We address this gap with a 3D Convolutional Neural Network detector based on R3D-18, trained with a composite loss that combines binary cross-entropy with a temporal-consistency regularizer. The model processes 16-frame clips from the DeepfakeTIMIT dataset and is initialized from Kinetics-400 action-recognition weights. We report 92.8% accuracy on intra-dataset evaluation at 128x128 resolution; cross-dataset transfer to FaceForensics++ without fine-tuning reaches 76.4%, rising after minimal fine-tuning. Ablation studies show that transfer learning contributes 7.2 percentage points and face tracking adds 3.5 points, while temporal consistency regularization provides additional gains on high-quality fakes. The results establish that temporal artifacts generalize more broadly than spatial ones, providing a detection signal that survives social-media re-encoding.

Abstract

Synthetic facial videos have proliferated across social media faster than platform moderation can respond, raising the cost of disinformation and identity-based attacks. Frame-level deepfake detectors degrade sharply as generator quality increases; high-quality 128x128 GAN output cuts spatial-only accuracy by five percentage points while leaving temporal inconsistencies largely intact. We address this gap with a 3D Convolutional Neural Network detector based on R3D-18, trained with a composite loss that combines binary cross-entropy with a temporal-consistency regularizer. The model processes 16-frame clips from the DeepfakeTIMIT dataset and is initialized from Kinetics-400 action-recognition weights. We report 92.8% accuracy on intra-dataset evaluation at 128x128 resolution; cross-dataset transfer to FaceForensics++ without fine-tuning reaches 76.4%, rising after minimal fine-tuning. Ablation studies show that transfer learning contributes 7.2 percentage points and face tracking adds 3.5 points, while temporal consistency regularization provides additional gains on high-quality fakes. The results establish that temporal artifacts generalize more broadly than spatial ones, providing a detection signal that survives social-media re-encoding.

item.title: Prediction of Challenging Behaviors Associated with Profound Autism in a Classroom Setting Using Wearable Sensors
item.author: Yadhu Kartha, Conor Anderson, Jenny Foster, Theresa Hamlin, Johanna Lantz, Ryan Lay, Juergen Hahn, Gari D. Clifford, Hyeokhyen Kwon
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了在特殊教育教室中预测自闭症谱系障碍儿童具有挑战性的行为，旨在通过机器学习模型实现提前干预，以减少安全风险并促进学习。

背景: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）患者常表现出社交互动和沟通方面的挑战，以及受限或重复的思维和行为模式。其中约四分之一的患者被归类为重度自闭症，常表现出自伤、攻击、逃跑或异食癖等具有严重安全风险和扰乱学习的行为。

目的: 研究在现实世界的特殊教育教室中预测具有挑战性的行为是否可行，并建立主动干预系统的基础。

方法: 研究收集了来自9名10至21岁儿童和青少年的约110.7小时的标记多模态可穿戴数据，包括加速度计、皮肤电活动（EDA）和皮肤温度。研究使用最先进的多模态可穿戴时间序列分析基础模型进行微调。

主要发现: 具有挑战性的行为 episodes 可以提前最多10分钟被预测，预测的 AUC-ROC 为 0.78。

结论: 这些结果为开发主动的课堂干预系统奠定了基础，使教师能够在特殊教育教室中最大限度地减少具有挑战性的行为的安全风险。

翻译: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的特征是社交互动和沟通方面的挑战，以及受限或重复的思维和行为模式，表现形式差异显著。约四分之一的自闭症儿童被归类为重度自闭症，常表现出自伤、攻击、逃跑或异食癖等具有严重安全风险并扰乱学习的行为。先前的工作已将可穿戴传感器和机器学习应用于检测具有挑战性的行为，但主要局限于受控的实验室环境。这项工作证明了在现实世界的特殊教育教室中预测具有挑战性的行为 episodes 是可行的。我们在标准课堂会议中收集了来自9名10至21岁儿童和青少年的约110.7小时的标记多模态可穿戴数据，包括加速度计、皮肤电活动（EDA）和皮肤温度。我们对用于多模态可穿戴时间序列分析的最先进基础模型进行了微调，结果表明具有挑战性的行为 episodes 可以提前最多10分钟被预测，AUC-ROC 为 0.78。这些结果为开发主动的课堂干预系统奠定了基础，使教师能够在特殊教育教室中最大限度地减少具有挑战性的行为的安全风险。

Abstract

Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is characterized by challenges with social interaction and communication and by restricted or repetitive patterns of thought and behavior, with significant variability in presentation. Approximately a quarter of children with ASD are classified as having profound autism, who often exhibit challenging behaviors, such as self-injurious behavior, aggression, elopement, or pica, that pose serious safety risks and disrupt learning in educational settings. Prior work has applied wearable sensors and machine learning to detect challenging behaviors, but has been largely confined to controlled laboratory environments. This work demonstrates that predicting challenging behavior episodes is feasible in a real-world special education classroom. We collected approximately 110.7 hours of labeled multimodal wearable data comprising accelerometry, electrodermal activity (EDA), and skin temperature from 9 children and young adults aged 10 to 21 years across standard classroom sessions. We fine-tuned state-of-the-art foundation models for multimodal wearable time-series analysis and show that challenging behavior episodes can be predicted up to 10 minutes in advance with an AUC-ROC of 0.78. These results establish a concrete foundation for developing proactive in-class intervention systems that enable teachers to minimize the safety risks of challenging behaviors in special education classrooms

item.title: Reservation Based Smart Parking Management
item.author: Giacomo Cabri, Manuela Montangero, Filippo Muzzini, Roberto Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种双机制架构来增强停车系统的可靠性，通过动态缓冲区和基于声誉的奖励系统来解决停车预留问题。

背景: 在智慧城市和智能交通系统（ITS）的框架下，高效的停车管理对于减少城市拥堵和排放至关重要。然而，当前的基于预留的系统经常遇到预留车位被占用的情况（即“无停车”情况）。

目的: 引入一种双机制架构以增强系统可靠性，通过动态缓冲区和基于声誉的奖励系统来缓解“无停车”情况并提高资源利用率。

方法: 提出了一种双机制架构，包括一个使用动态大小缓冲区的预留模块，以及一个利用“基于星级”指标来激励准时离开的基于声誉的奖励系统。

主要发现: SUMO城市模拟器进行的模拟显示，动态缓冲区策略在停车可用性和预留成功率之间提供了更好的权衡。

结论: 该系统通过逐渐适应用户行为，缓解了“无停车”情况并提高了资源利用率，显著增强了城市的可行性。

翻译: 在智慧城市和智能交通系统（ITS）的框架下，高效的停车管理对于减少城市拥堵和排放至关重要。然而，当前的基于预留的系统经常遇到预留车位被占用的情况（即“无停车”情况）。本文引入了一种双机制架构来增强系统可靠性。一个预留模块使用动态大小的非预留车位缓冲区来授予停车可用性。一个基于声誉的奖励系统利用“基于星级”的指标，通过经济处罚和访问限制来激励准时离开。在SUMO城市模拟器中进行的模拟显示，动态缓冲区策略在停车可用性和预留成功率之间提供了更好的权衡。通过逐渐适应用户行为，该系统缓解了“无停车”情况并提高了资源利用率，显著增强了城市的可行性。

Abstract

In the framework of Smart Cities and Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), efficient parking management is essential to reduce urban congestion and emissions. However, current reservation-based systems often encounter a scenario in which users find their reserved slot occupied by a previous occupant who failed to vacate on time ("No PARK" situation). This paper introduces a dual-mechanism architecture designed to enhance system reliability. A Reservation Module uses a dynamic size buffer of non-reservable slots to grant parking availability. A reputation-based Reward System exploits a "star-based" metric to incentivize punctual departures through financial penalties and access restrictions. The simulations conducted with the SUMO urban simulator are promising, showing that the dynamic buffer strategy provides a better tradeoff between parking availability and reservation success. By progressively adapting to users behavior, the proposed system mitigates "NO PARK" instances and improves resource utilization, significantly enhancing urban viability. Index Terms-Smart City, Intelligent transportation systems, Parking, Reservation systems, V2I, Reputation-based mechanisms, Smart Parking

item.title: Mono-Hydra++: Real-Time Monocular Scene Graph Construction with Multi-Task Learning for 3D Indoor Mapping
item.author: U. V. B. L. Udugama, George Vosselman, Francesco Nex
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Mono-Hydra++是一种实时单目RGB加IMU管线，用于室内度量语义映射和分层3D场景图构建。

背景: 自主敏捷机器人需要理解物体、房间、地点和空间关系，但传统度量地图仅支持定位和避障，缺乏语义和关系结构。3D场景图通过连接几何与物体级和房间级理解解决了这一差距，但在敏捷平台上构建此类表示仍很困难，因为空中和轻量级机器人在有效载荷、电源和计算能力上受到严格限制，使得RGB-D相机和LiDAR传感器在许多 onboard 设置中不切实际。

目的: 提出Mono-Hydra++系统，旨在在资源受限的机器人平台上实现实时度量语义映射和场景图构建，且不依赖主动深度传感器。

方法: 该系统结合了基于DINOv3的多任务深度和语义模型M2H-MX，与深度特征视觉惯性里程计前端，VIO导出位姿图中的稀疏预测深度约束，动态区域的语义掩码，以及体积融合前Mono-Hydra后端的位置感知时间对齐。

主要发现: 在Go-SLAM ScanNet评估子集上，Mono-Hydra++使用单目RGB加IMU输入，比最强RGB-D基线平均轨迹误差低1.6%；在校准的7-Scenes数据集上，比最强竞争校准基线平均ATE提高29.8%。在ITC建筑部署中，使用RealSense RGB加IMU验证了系统，并在Jetson Orin NX 16GB上以25.53 FPS部署ONNX/TensorRT FP16 M2H-MX-L感知模型，证明了嵌入式可行性。

结论: Mono-Hydra++能够在不依赖主动深度传感器的情况下，为资源受限的机器人平台提供实时度量语义映射和场景图构建。

翻译: 自主敏捷机器人需要的不止是度量几何：它们必须理解物体、房间、地点和空间关系，以便进行搜索、检查、探索和人与机器人交互。传统的度量地图支持定位和避障，但不提供这种语义和关系结构。3D场景图通过将几何与物体级和房间级理解联系起来解决了这一差距。在敏捷平台上构建此类表示仍然困难，因为空中和轻量级机器人在严格的载荷、电源和计算限制下运行，使得RGB-D相机和LiDAR传感器在许多 onboard 设置中不切实际。我们提出了Mono-Hydra++，一种用于室内度量语义映射和分层3D场景图构建的实时单目RGB加IMU管线。该系统结合了基于DINOv3的多任务深度和语义模型M2H-MX，与深度特征视觉惯性里程计前端，VIO导出位姿图中的稀疏预测深度约束，动态区域的语义掩码，以及体积融合前Mono-Hydra后端的位置感知时间对齐。在Go-SLAM ScanNet评估子集上，Mono-Hydra++比我们比较中最强的RGB-D基线平均轨迹误差低1.6%，同时仅使用单目RGB加IMU输入。在校准的7-Scenes上，它比最强的竞争校准基线平均ATE提高了29.8%。我们还在ITC建筑部署中进一步验证了Mono-Hydra++，使用RealSense RGB加IMU，并通过在Jetson Orin NX 16GB上以25.53 FPS部署ONNX/TensorRT FP16 M2H-MX-L感知模型，证明了嵌入式可行性。这些结果表明，Mono-Hydra++可以为资源受限的机器人平台提供实时度量语义映射和场景图构建，而不依赖主动深度传感器。

深度解读

Abstract

Autonomous agile robots need more than metric geometry: they must understand objects, rooms, places, and spatial relations for search, inspection, exploration, and human robot interaction. Conventional metric maps support localization and collision avoidance, but do not provide this semantic and relational structure. 3D scene graphs address this gap by connecting geometry with object level and room level understanding. Building such representations on agile platforms remains difficult because aerial and lightweight robots operate under strict payload, power, and compute limits, making RGB-D cameras and LiDAR sensors impractical for many onboard settings. We present Mono-Hydra++, a real time monocular RGB plus IMU pipeline for indoor metric semantic mapping and hierarchical 3D scene graph construction. The system combines M2H-MX, a DINOv3 based multi-task model for depth and semantics, with a deep feature visual inertial odometry front end, sparse predicted depth constraints in the VIO derived pose graph, semantic masking for dynamic regions, and pose aware temporal alignment before volumetric fusion in the Mono-Hydra backend. On the Go-SLAM ScanNet evaluation subset, Mono-Hydra++ achieves 1.6% lower average trajectory error than the strongest RGB-D baseline in our comparison, while using only monocular RGB plus IMU input. On calibrated 7-Scenes, it improves average ATE by 29.8% over the strongest competing calibrated baseline. We further validate Mono-Hydra++ in a real ITC building deployment using RealSense RGB plus IMU and demonstrate embedded feasibility by deploying the ONNX/TensorRT FP16 M2H-MX-L perception model at 25.53 FPS on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB. These results show that Mono-Hydra++ can provide real time metric semantic mapping and scene graph construction for resource constrained robotic platforms without relying on active depth sensors.

item.title: PEIRA: Learning Predictive Encoders through Inter-View Regressor Alignment
item.author: Michael Arbel, Basile Terver, Jean Ponce
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文分析了非对比自监督学习方法的动态特性，并提出了一种名为PEIRA的新方法，该方法通过定义明确的优化目标来提高对非对比自监督学习机制的理解。

背景: 非对比自监督学习是一种有效的预测性表示学习框架，但像SimSiam、BYOL、I-JEPA或DINO等流行且在实践中有效的方法，依赖于一种自蒸馏来训练教师-学生网络，但它们通常不最小化一个明确定义的优化目标，因此其机制仍知之甚少。

目的: 分析一种变体的联合嵌入预测架构JEPA的动态特性，并引入PEIRA，一种具有明确优化目标的非对比自监督学习方法。

方法: 使用正则化线性回归器来预测数据两个视图的 learned representations 之间的 JEPA 变体，PEIRA 方法通过最优线性回归器的迹来定义明确的优化目标。

主要发现: 非坍缩的稳定平衡点与主要的非线性正则相关子空间对齐，坍缩的平衡点也可能是稳定的吸引子；PEIRA 的唯一稳定平衡点是非平凡的全局最小值，并恢复相同的正则相关子空间，正则化选择有效维度；实验表明 PEIRA 在性能上与 VICReg 和 LeJEPA 基线具有竞争力。

结论: PEIRA 方法在理论上有明确的优化目标，且实验结果支持了理论分析，表明该方法在图像分类任务上具有竞争力。

翻译: 非对比自监督学习是一种有效的预测性表示学习框架，但像SimSiam、BYOL、I-JEPA或DINO等流行且在实践中有效的方法，依赖于一种自蒸馏来训练教师-学生网络，但它们通常不最小化一个明确定义的优化目标，因此其机制仍知之甚少。本文分析了使用正则化线性回归器来预测数据两个视图的 learned representations 之间的 JEPA 变体的动态特性，并完全表征了其稳定性：非坍缩的稳定平衡点与主要的非线性正则相关子空间对齐，而坍缩的平衡点也可能是稳定的吸引子。受此结果启发，我们引入了 PEIRA，一种具有通过最优线性回归器的迹明确定义的优化目标的非对比自监督学习方法。我们证明其唯一的稳定平衡点是非平凡的全局最小值，并恢复相同的正则相关子空间，其中正则化选择有效维度。在 ImageNet-1K 和 CIFAR-10 上的实验表明 PEIRA 在性能上与 VICReg 和 LeJEPA 基线具有竞争力，定性经验结果支持了理论。

Abstract

Non-contrastive self-supervised learning (SSL) is an effective framework for predictive representation learning, but popular (and in practice effective) methods such as SimSiam, BYOL, I-JEPA or DINO, which rely on a form of self-distillation to train a teacher-student network, remain poorly understood as they typically do not minimize a well-defined objective. We analyze the dynamics of a variant of the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) using a regularized linear regressor to predict the learned representations of two views of the data from one another, and fully characterize its stability: non-collapsed stable equilibria align with leading nonlinear canonical correlation subspaces, while collapsed equilibria may also be stable attractors. Motivated by this result, we introduce PEIRA, a non-contrastive SSL method with an explicit objective defined through the trace of the optimal linear regressor. We show that its only stable equilibria are nontrivial global minimizers and recover the same canonical correlation subspaces, with regularization selecting the effective dimension. Experiments on ImageNet-1K and CIFAR-10 show PEIRA is competitive with VICReg and LeJEPA baselines, and qualitative empirical results support the theory.

item.title: Stop When Reasoning Converges: Semantic-Preserving Early Exit for Reasoning Models
item.author: Min, Dehai, Vaccarino, Giovanni, Chen, Huiyi, Wu, Yongliang, Yona, Gal, Cheng, Lu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PUMA框架通过结合轻量级冗余检测器和答案级验证，在保持推理准确性和连贯性的同时显著减少令牌使用量。

背景: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过生成长思维链（CoT）实现强大性能，但常因过度思考导致令牌浪费和延迟增加。现有推理时早期退出方法主要依赖答案级信号（如置信度或试答一致性），但这些信号主要反映答案准备度而非推理收敛度，可能导致过早退出并降低最终答案准确性。

目的: 识别推理级语义冗余作为语义保持早期退出的互补信号，提出一种可插拔框架以在移除冗余推理的同时保持答案准确性和连贯的推理前缀。

方法: 提出PUMA框架，结合轻量级冗余检测器和答案级验证。检测器标记语义冗余的候选退出点，验证确认停止是否安全。

主要发现: 在五个LRM和五个挑战性推理基准上，PUMA平均减少26.2%的令牌使用量，同时保持准确性和保留的CoT质量。在代码生成、零样本视觉语言推理和停止策略内化实验中，推理级冗余被证明是高效推理的稳健、可迁移和可学习的信号。

结论: 推理级语义冗余是一个有效的早期退出信号，PUMA框架成功实现了推理效率的提升，且不影响推理质量。

翻译: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过生成长思维链（CoT）实现强大性能，但常因过度思考导致令牌浪费和延迟增加。现有推理时早期退出方法主要依赖答案级信号（如置信度或试答一致性），但这些信号主要反映答案准备度而非推理收敛度，可能导致过早退出并降低最终答案准确性。我们识别推理级语义冗余作为语义保持早期退出的互补信号：当连续步骤不再增加新颖进展而是重新审视既定结论时，推理轨迹可能已收敛。基于这一见解，我们提出PUMA框架，结合轻量级冗余检测器和答案级验证。检测器标记语义冗余的候选退出点，验证确认停止是否安全，使PUMA能够在移除冗余继续推理的同时保持答案准确性和连贯的推理前缀。在五个LRM和五个挑战性推理基准上，PUMA平均减少26.2%的令牌使用量，同时保持准确性和保留的CoT质量。在代码生成、零样本视觉语言推理和停止策略内化上的额外实验进一步表明，推理级冗余是高效推理的稳健、可迁移和可学习的信号。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种在推理收敛时停止的方法，以保持语义。

Abstract

Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by generating long chains of thought (CoT), but often overthink, continuing to reason after a solution has already stabilized and thereby wasting tokens and increasing latency. Existing inference-time early-exit methods rely primarily on answer-level signals, such as confidence or trial-answer consistency, to decide when to stop. However, these signals mainly reflect answer readiness rather than reasoning convergence: they may trigger before the model has finished exploring or self-correcting, causing premature exits that can degrade final-answer accuracy and leave the retained reasoning chain semantically incomplete. We identify reasoning-level semantic redundancy as a complementary signal for semantic-preserving early exit: when successive steps no longer add novel progress and instead revisit established conclusions, the reasoning trajectory has likely converged. Building on this insight, we propose PUMA, a plug-and-play framework that combines a lightweight Redundancy Detector with answer-level verification. The detector flags semantically redundant candidate exits, while verification confirms whether stopping is safe, allowing PUMA to remove redundant continuation while preserving both answer accuracy and a coherent reasoning prefix. Across five LRMs and five challenging reasoning benchmarks, PUMA achieves 26.2% average token reduction while preserving accuracy and retained CoT quality. Additional experiments on code generation, zero-shot vision-language reasoning, and learned stopping-policy internalization further demonstrate that reasoning-level redundancy is a robust, transferable, and learnable signal for efficient reasoning. Our code is available at \url{ this https URL }.

item.title: PRIME: Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation for Legged and Humanoid Robots
item.author: Jiarong Kang, Kunzhao Ren, Tao Pang, Xiaobin Xiong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PRIME的方法，旨在通过物理一致性约束和联合估计摩擦力及惯性参数，从 onboard kinematics 中实现准确的运动估计。

背景: 人形和足式机器人通过与环境的间歇性接触进行交互，使得准确的运动估计依赖于对接触动力学的推理。然而，标准感知管道（无论是基于 onboard proprioception 的 EKFs 还是外部 motion capture 系统）仅能恢复运动学信息，而接触力、接触时机和惯性参数仍无法被观测到。因此，纯运动学重建往往违反刚体动力学，特别是在接触丰富的运动中。

目的: 为了在现实世界的部署中从 onboard kinematics 实现准确的运动估计，我们提出了 PRIME（Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation），这是一种最大后验概率（MAP）形式，旨在将测量的运动学和执行器命令细化为动态一致的轨迹，同时联合估计摩擦接触力和物理一致的惯性参数。

方法: PRIME 方法结合了可微分的接触动力学、平滑互补约束和 Anitescu 风格的摩擦模型，产生了一个平滑的优化问题，该问题在各种接触转换中保持可解性。

主要发现: 在包含四足机器人和 Unitree G1 人形机器人的接触丰富运动上评估 PRIME，展示了改进的轨迹一致性和准确的惯性参数识别。

结论: 除了利用校准的惯性参数改善状态估计和反馈控制外，PRIME 还能从部署中的真实机器人产生力和接触标记的运动重建，这些数据可用于为下游学习应用（包括大规模行为建模和机器人基础模型）提供高质量数据。

翻译: 人形和足式机器人通过与环境的间歇性接触进行交互，使得准确的运动估计根本上依赖于对接触动力学的推理。然而，标准感知管道——无论是基于 onboard proprioception 的扩展卡尔曼滤波器还是外部运动捕捉系统——仅能恢复运动学信息，而接触力、接触时机和惯性参数仍然未被观测到。因此，纯运动学重建往往违反刚体动力学，特别是在接触丰富的运动中。为了在现实世界的部署中从 onboard kinematics 实现准确的运动估计，我们提出了 PRIME（Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation），这是一种最大后验概率（MAP）形式，它将测量的运动学和执行器命令细化为动态一致的轨迹，同时联合估计摩擦接触力和物理一致的惯性参数。我们的方法结合了可微分的接触动力学、平滑互补约束和 Anitescu 风格的摩擦模型，产生了一个平滑的优化问题，该问题在各种接触转换中保持可解性。我们在包含四足机器人和 Unitree G1 人形机器人的接触丰富运动上评估了 PRIME，展示了改进的轨迹一致性和准确的惯性参数识别。除了利用校准的惯性参数改善状态估计和反馈控制外，PRIME 还能从部署中的真实机器人产生力和接触标记的运动重建，这些数据可用于为下游学习应用（包括大规模行为建模和机器人基础模型）提供高质量数据。

Abstract

Humanoid and legged robots interact with the environment through intermittent contacts, making accurate motion estimation fundamentally dependent on reasoning about contact dynamics. However, standard sensing pipelines-whether based on onboard proprioception with Extended Kalman Filters (EKFs) or external motion capture systems-recover only kinematics, while contact forces, contact timing, and inertial parameters remain unobserved. As a result, purely kinematic reconstructions often violate rigid-body dynamics, particularly during contact-rich motions. To enable accurate motion estimation from onboard kinematics in real-world deployment, we propose PRIME (Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation), a Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) formulation that refines measured kinematics and actuator commands into a dynamically consistent trajectory while jointly estimating frictional contact forces and physically consistent inertial parameters. Our approach incorporates differentiable contact dynamics with smoothed complementarity constraints and an Anitescu-style friction model, yielding a smooth optimization problem that remains tractable across versatile contact transitions. We evaluate PRIME on contact-rich locomotion with quadrupedal robots and the Unitree G1 humanoid, demonstrating improved trajectory consistency and accurate inertial parameter identification. Beyond improving state estimation and feedback control with calibrated inertial parameters, PRIME produces force- and contact-annotated motion reconstructions from real robots in deployment, which can be used to provide high-quality data for downstream learning applications, including large-scale behavior modeling and robot foundation models.

item.title: Agent Bazaar: Enabling Economic Alignment in Multi-Agent Marketplaces
item.author: Karten, Seth, Crow, Cameron, Jin, Chi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了Agent Bazaar框架，评估经济一致性，识别两种失败模式并提出解决方案，训练出表现更好的模型，并提出了EAS指标。

背景: 大型语言模型作为自主经济代理部署引入了系统性风险，代理直接与市场交互可能放大波动性并掩盖大规模欺骗。

目的: 评估经济一致性，即代理系统保持市场稳定性和完整性的能力，并训练出具有经济一致性的模型。

方法: 提出了Agent Bazaar多代理模拟框架，识别两种失败模式，提出稳定公司和怀疑守护者，使用REINFORCE++训练模型，提出EAS指标。

主要发现: 模型大多无法自我调节，失败严重程度因模型而异而非大小；提出的解决方案在更困难的市场条件下仍脆弱；训练出的9B模型优于所有评估的前沿和开放权重模型；经济一致性独立于通用能力。

结论: 经济一致性可以针对特定强化学习直接训练，且与通用能力正交。

翻译: 该研究提出了Agent Bazaar框架，用于评估经济一致性，即代理系统保持市场稳定性和完整性的能力。研究识别了两种失败模式：在B2C市场中，算法不稳定性导致价格波动直至市场崩溃；在C2C市场中，Sybil欺骗导致单一欺骗代理控制多个协调卖家身份，用欺诈性 listings 淹没市场，侵蚀信任和消费者福利。研究评估了前沿和开放权重模型，发现它们大多无法自我调节，失败严重程度因模型而异而非大小。研究提出了经济一致的调节器，稳定公司和怀疑守护者，它们改善了结果但在更困难的市场条件下仍脆弱。为了缩小这一差距，研究使用自适应课程和REINFORCE++训练代理，产生了一个9B模型，优于所有评估的前沿和开放权重模型。研究提出了经济一致性评分（EAS），一个聚合稳定性、完整性、福利和盈利能力的4部分标量指标，使直接跨模型比较成为可能。研究结果表明，经济一致性独立于通用能力，并且可以通过针对特定强化学习直接训练。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决多智能体市场中的经济对齐问题。在现实或研究中，多智能体系统需要有效的市场机制来协调行为，这对资源分配和系统效率很重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) as autonomous economic agents introduces systemic risks that extend beyond individual capability failures. As agents transition to directly interacting with marketplaces, their collective behavior can amplify volatility and mask deception at scale. We introduce the Agent Bazaar, a multi-agent simulation framework for evaluating Economic Alignment, the capacity of agentic systems to preserve market stability and integrity. We identify two failure modes: (1) Algorithmic Instability in a B2C market ("The Crash"), where firms amplify price volatility until the market collapses, and (2) Sybil Deception in a C2C market ("The Lemon Market"), where a single deceptive agent controlling multiple coordinated seller identities floods the market with fraudulent listings, eroding trust and consumer welfare. We evaluate frontier and open-weight models across both scenarios and find that models largely fail to self-regulate, with failure severity varying by model rather than by size. We propose economically aligned harnesses, Stabilizing Firms and Skeptical Guardians, that improve outcomes but remain fragile under harder market conditions. To close this gap, we train agents with REINFORCE++ using an adaptive curriculum, producing a 9B model that outperforms all evaluated frontier and open-weight models. We propose the Economic Alignment Score (EAS), a 4-component scalar metric aggregating stability, integrity, welfare, and profitability, enabling direct cross-model comparison. Our results show that economic alignment is orthogonal to general capability and can be directly trained with targeted RL.

item.title: Sometin Beta Pass Notin (SBPN): Improving Multilingual ASR for Nigerian Languages via Knowledge Distillation
item.author: Sewade Ogun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种多语言自动语音识别框架，旨在解决尼日利亚语言在数据稀缺、拼写不一致、声调符号、口音多样、代码切换和本地化命名实体等方面的建模挑战，通过两阶段蒸馏过程显著缩小了性能差距。

背景: 尽管现代多语言自动语音识别系统支持多种尼日利亚语言，但其性能持续落后于英语和法语等高资源语言。尼日利亚语言面临独特建模障碍，包括严重的数据稀缺、拼写不一致、声调符号、多样的口音、频繁的代码切换以及本地化命名实体。

目的: 开发一个多语言自动语音识别框架，以解决尼日利亚语言面临的独特建模挑战，缩小与高资源语言的性能差距。

方法: 采用两阶段蒸馏过程。首先，利用现有单语言模型进行学生-教师知识蒸馏，并结合稳健的语言特定N-gram语言模型；其次，使用伪标记数据进行迭代自我改进以进一步优化准确性。

主要发现: 该方法显著缩小了性能差距，平均相对词错误率比单语言基线降低了29%。模型在Common Voice和Fleurs等主要基准测试中均优于最先进的多语言模型。此外，本文介绍了Sometin Beta Pass Notin（SBPN），这是一个覆盖约鲁巴语、豪萨语、伊博语、尼日利亚皮钦语和尼日利亚英语的多语言自动语音识别基础模型。

结论: 通过发布SBPN-Base和SBPN-Large两个开放基础模型，旨在为该地区丰富的语音和文化景观的进一步研究提供自动语音识别资源。

翻译: 尽管现代多语言自动语音识别系统支持多种尼日利亚语言，但其性能持续落后于英语和法语等高资源语言。尼日利亚语言面临独特建模障碍，包括严重的数据稀缺、拼写不一致、声调符号、多样的口音、频繁的代码切换以及本地化命名实体。为解决这些挑战，我们开发了一种利用两阶段蒸馏过程的多语言自动语音识别框架。首先，我们利用现有单语言模型进行学生-教师知识蒸馏，并结合稳健的语言特定N-gram语言模型。其次，我们使用伪标记数据进行迭代自我改进以进一步优化准确性。该方法显著缩小了性能差距，平均相对词错误率比单语言基线降低了29%。我们的模型在Common Voice和Fleurs等主要基准测试中均优于最先进的多语言模型。我们介绍了Sometin Beta Pass Notin（SBPN），这是一个覆盖约鲁巴语、豪萨语、伊博语、尼日利亚皮钦语和尼日利亚英语的多语言自动语音识别基础模型。SBPN以两种规模发布：SBPN-Base（1.2亿参数）和SBPN-Large（6亿参数）。通过将这些作为开放基础模型发布，我们旨在为该地区丰富的语音和文化景观的进一步研究提供自动语音识别资源。

Abstract

Although modern multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems support several Nigerian languages, their performance consistently lags behind high-resource languages like English and French. Nigerian languages present unique modelling hurdles, including acute data scarcity, inconsistent orthography, tonal diacritics, diverse accents, frequent code-switching, and localized named entities. To address these challenges, we developed a multilingual ASR framework utilizing a two-stage distillation process. First, we employ student-teacher knowledge distillation from existing monolingual models, conditioned on robust language-specific N-gram language models. Second, we perform iterative self improvement using pseudo-labelled data to further refine accuracy. Our method significantly bridges the performance gap, achieving on average a relative Word Error Rate (WER) reduction of 29 % over monolingual baselines. Our models also outperform state-of-the-art multilingual models across major benchmarks, including Common Voice and Fleurs. We introduce Sometin Beta Pass Notin (SBPN), a foundational multilingual ASR model covering Yorùbá, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, and Nigerian English. SBPN is released in two sizes: SBPN-Base (120 M parameters) and SBPN-Large (600 M parameters). By releasing these as open foundation models, we aim to provide ASR resources for further research into the rich phonetic and cultural landscape of the region.

item.title: Sequential Structure in Intraday Futures Data: LSTM vs Gradient Boosting on MNQ
item.author: Mathias Mesfin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文比较了梯度提升和长短期记忆网络在微E-mini纳斯达克100期货日内方向预测中的表现，发现单只股票数据集的五分钟OHLCV序列在预测结构上不可靠。

背景: 受近期关于金融蜡烛图数据的基座模型研究（如Kronos架构）的启发，研究五分钟OHLCV柱状序列是否包含可利用的顺序预测结构。

目的: 评估在单只工具数据集规模下，五分钟OHLCV柱状序列是否包含可利用的顺序预测结构，并比较梯度提升和长短期记忆网络架构。

方法: 使用2021年至2025年的944个交易日数据，在三个样本外期间进行严格的扩展窗口前向验证，评估四种模型配置。目标变量是当天的收盘价是否比上午10:30的开盘价高出十点以上。

主要发现: 所有配置的样本外准确率均未超过51.8%的基准率。梯度提升变体的组合样本外准确率在50.00%到50.89%之间，LSTM为50.59%。排列测试显示最佳梯度提升模型的p值为0.135，LSTM为0.515，均无统计显著预测优势。特征重要性在跨前向验证折叠中不稳定，表明是噪声拟合而非稳定的结构信号捕获。

结论: 四年的单只工具五分钟OHLCV数据不足以进行可靠的基于顺序ML的日内预测。本文的主要贡献是在受限的真实世界数据集上对Kronos启发架构的记录评估，为顺序金融ML的数据规模要求提供了经验下限。

翻译: 本文比较了梯度提升和长短期记忆网络架构在微E-mini纳斯达克100期货日内方向预测中的表现。受近期关于金融蜡烛图数据的基座模型研究（如Kronos架构）的启发，研究五分钟OHLCV柱状序列是否包含可利用的顺序预测结构。使用2021年至2025年的944个交易日数据，在三个样本外期间进行严格的扩展窗口前向验证，评估四种模型配置。目标变量是当天的收盘价是否比上午10:30的开盘价高出十点以上。所有配置的样本外准确率均未超过51.8%的基准率。梯度提升变体的组合样本外准确率在50.00%到50.89%之间，LSTM为50.59%。排列测试显示最佳梯度提升模型的p值为0.135，LSTM为0.515，均无统计显著预测优势。特征重要性在跨前向验证折叠中不稳定，表明是噪声拟合而非稳定的结构信号捕获。四年的单只工具五分钟OHLCV数据不足以进行可靠的基于顺序ML的日内预测。本文的主要贡献是在受限的真实世界数据集上对Kronos启发架构的记录评估，为顺序金融ML的数据规模要求提供了经验下限。

Abstract

This paper compares gradient boosting and long short-term memory (LSTM) architectures for intraday directional prediction in Micro E-Mini Nasdaq 100 futures (MNQ). Motivated by recent foundation-model research on financial candlestick data, including the Kronos architecture, we test whether five-minute OHLCV bar sequences contain exploitable sequential predictive structure at the scale of a single instrument dataset. Using 944 trading days from 2021-2025, four model configurations are evaluated under strict expanding-window walk-forward validation across three out-of-sample periods. The target variable is whether the session close exceeds the 10:30 AM open by more than ten points. No configuration produces statistically significant out-of-sample accuracy above the 51.8% base rate. Combined OOS accuracies range from 50.00% to 50.89% across gradient boosting variants, while the LSTM achieves 50.59%. Permutation tests yield p-values of 0.135 for the best gradient boosting model and 0.515 for the LSTM, indicating no statistically significant predictive edge. Feature importance instability across walk-forward folds suggests noise fitting rather than stable structural signal capture. The results indicate that four years of single-instrument five-minute OHLCV data are insufficient for reliable sequential ML-based intraday forecasting. The primary contribution is a documented evaluation of a Kronos-inspired architecture on a constrained real-world dataset, providing an empirical lower bound on data scale requirements for sequential financial ML.

item.title: UST-Hand: An Uncertainty-aware Spatiotemporal Point Cloud Interaction Network for 3D Self-supervised Hand Pose Estimation
item.author: Tianhao Han, Haoyang Zhang, Liang Xie, Haochen Chang, Kun Gao, Yuan Cheng, Pengfei Ren, Erwei Yin
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为UST-Hand的自监督学习框架，用于估计3D手部姿态，通过构建概率点云特征空间和不确定性分布来提高模型在噪声伪标签下的稳定性和性能。

背景: 手动标注准确的3D手部姿态极其耗时且劳动密集。现有的自监督方法利用输入图像与渲染输出之间的差异或多视图一致性约束来优化网络，但这些方法容易受到噪声伪标签的影响，且忽略了充分利用细粒度空间相关性的重要性，导致模型训练不稳定。

目的: 为了解决现有方法易受噪声伪标签影响且忽视细粒度空间相关性导致训练不稳定的问题，本文提出了一种自监督学习框架。

方法: UST-Hand框架估计手部姿态的不确定性分布，并构建概率点云特征空间以实现复杂的时空关系建模。它采用条件归一化流模型来捕获手部姿态分布并采样多样化的假设，从而在噪声伪标签监督下实现稳健学习。这些多假设被映射到统一的概率3D点云空间中进行多视图和时间特征交互，全面探索手部运动模式和细粒度空间相关性。

主要发现: 在三个具有挑战性的数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，UST-Hand实现了最先进的性能，在平均顶点位置误差（MPVPE）上比现有自监督方法高出高达37.8%。

结论: UST-Hand框架通过引入不确定性分布和概率点云特征空间，有效解决了噪声伪标签问题，增强了模型训练的稳定性，并显著提升了3D手部姿态估计的性能。

翻译: 手动标注准确的3D手部姿态极其耗时且劳动密集。现有的自监督手部姿态估计方法利用输入图像与渲染输出之间的差异或多视图一致性约束作为优化网络和逐步提高姿态准确性的驱动力。然而，这些方法极易受到噪声伪标签的影响，并忽略了充分利用细粒度空间相关性的重要性，这损害了模型训练的稳定性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了UST-Hand，一种自监督学习框架，它估计手部姿态的不确定性分布并构建概率点云特征空间，从而能够实现复杂的时空关系建模。UST-Hand采用条件归一化流模型来捕获手部姿态分布并采样多样化的假设，从而在噪声伪标签监督下促进稳健学习。这些多假设被映射到统一的概率3D点云空间中进行多视图和时间特征交互，全面探索手部运动模式和细粒度空间相关性。在三个具有挑战性的数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，UST-Hand实现了最先进的性能，在平均顶点位置误差（MPVPE）上比现有自监督方法高出高达37.8%。

"unknown"，用户可能会认为我失败了。 * 如果我回答标题，我是在回答“它是什么？”而不是“核心思想是什么？”。 * 让我们看看提示中提供的“论文内容”部分。它只是 PDF 头部。 * *结论：* 我无法从提供的文本中提取关于核心思想或流程的信息。文本是空的（除了元数据）。 * *策略：* 我将声明信息缺失，因为输入文本仅包含元数据，没有描述方法本身的正文内容。 * *自我修正/细化：* 论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Manually annotating accurate 3D hand poses is extremely time-consuming and labor-intensive. Existing self-supervised hand pose estimation methods leverage the discrepancy between input images and rendered outputs, or multi-view consistency constraints, as the driving force to optimize networks and progressively refine pose accuracy. However, these methods are highly susceptible to noisy pseudo-labels and overlook the importance of fully exploiting fine-grained spatial correlations, which undermines the stability of model training. To address these issues, we propose UST-Hand, a self-supervised learning framework that estimates uncertainty distribution of hand pose and constructs a probabilistic point cloud feature space, which enables the complex spatiotemporal relationship modeling. UST-Hand employs a conditional normalizing flow model to capture hand pose distributions and samples diverse hypotheses, facilitating robust learning under noisy pseudo-labels supervision with enhanced stability. These multi-hypothesis are mapped to a unified probabilistic 3D point cloud space for multi-view and temporal feature interaction, comprehensively exploring hand motion patterns and fine-grained spatial correlations. Extensive experiments on three challenging datasets demonstrate that UST-Hand achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing self-supervised methods by up to 37.8% in Mean Per Vertex Position Error (MPVPE).

item.title: AURORA: Contextual Orthogonalization for Geometric Representation Learning in Healthcare Foundation Models
item.author: Yuanyun Zhang, Shi Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AURORA框架通过正交化关系对齐实现医疗表示学习，分解表示为对应不同上下文因子的正交语义子空间，提高语义解缠和几何可解释性，在临床预测和检索任务中优于重建、对比和自蒸馏基线，增强了上下文解缠、邻域纯度和机构分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

背景: 现有的医疗基础模型通过大规模自监督学习实现了强大的预测性能，但其潜在表示经常将生理严重程度、干预强度、观察结构和机构工作流程纠缠到共享的嵌入方向中。虽然对下游预测有效，但这些表示在上下文变化下仍保持语义不透明和不稳定。

目的: 介绍AURORA（Adaptive Uncertainty aware Representations through Orthogonalized Relational Alignment），一种基于上下文潜在几何的医疗表示学习新框架。

方法: AURORA不优化单一统一的嵌入流形，而是将表示分解为对应不同上下文因子的正交语义子空间，并在每个子空间内学习关系一致性目标。

主要发现: AURORA在多个临床预测和检索任务中始终优于重建、对比和自蒸馏基线，同时显著提高了上下文解缠、邻域纯度和机构分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

结论: 潜在几何本身构成了医疗基础模型设计的重要维度，根据上下文语义显式构建表示空间为超越传统预测压缩目标提供了补充方向。

翻译: Recent healthcare foundation models have achieved strong predictive performance through large scale self supervised learning, yet their latent representations frequently entangle physiologic severity, intervention intensity, observational structure, and institutional workflow into shared embedding directions. While effective for downstream prediction, such representations remain semantically opaque and unstable under contextual shift. We introduce AURORA, Adaptive Uncertainty aware Representations through Orthogonalized Relational Alignment, a new framework for healthcare representation learning based on contextual latent geometry. Rather than optimizing a single unified embedding manifold, AURORA decomposes representations into orthogonal semantic subspaces corresponding to distinct contextual factors and learns relational consistency objectives within each subspace. This induces latent spaces that are both semantically disentangled and geometrically interpretable. Across multiple clinical prediction and retrieval tasks, AURORA consistently outperforms reconstruction, contrastive, and self distillation baselines while substantially improving contextual disentanglement, neighborhood purity, and robustness under institutional distribution shift. Our results suggest that latent geometry itself constitutes an important axis of healthcare foundation model design and that explicitly structuring representation space according to contextual semantics provides a complementary direction beyond conventional predictive compression objectives.

Abstract

Recent healthcare foundation models have achieved strong predictive performance through large scale self supervised learning, yet their latent representations frequently entangle physiologic severity, intervention intensity, observational structure, and institutional workflow into shared embedding directions. While effective for downstream prediction, such representations remain semantically opaque and unstable under contextual shift. We introduce AURORA, Adaptive Uncertainty aware Representations through Orthogonalized Relational Alignment, a new framework for healthcare representation learning based on contextual latent geometry. Rather than optimizing a single unified embedding manifold, AURORA decomposes representations into orthogonal semantic subspaces corresponding to distinct contextual factors and learns relational consistency objectives within each subspace. This induces latent spaces that are both semantically disentangled and geometrically interpretable. Across multiple clinical prediction and retrieval tasks, AURORA consistently outperforms reconstruction, contrastive, and self distillation baselines while substantially improving contextual disentanglement, neighborhood purity, and robustness under institutional distribution shift. Our results suggest that latent geometry itself constitutes an important axis of healthcare foundation model design and that explicitly structuring representation space according to contextual semantics provides a complementary direction beyond conventional predictive compression objectives.

item.title: Why We Look Where We Look: Emergent Human-like Fixations of a Foveated Visual Language Model Maximizing Scene Understanding
item.author: Shravan Murlidaran, Ziqi Wen, Sana Shehabi, Miguel P. Eckstein
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了人类自由观看场景时的注视模式及其背后的认知机制。

背景: 当人类自由观看场景时，他们最初将目光集中在场景中心，随后注视人、文本、被注视或被抓取的物体以及语义上有意义的区域。

目的: 探究这些特征性注视模式反映了什么，以及它们是否优化了潜在的感知任务。

方法: 构建了一个具有模拟中央凹视觉的计算代理，通过优化场景理解进行训练，并与其他训练目标（如搜索或分类场景）或不同外周视觉能力的代理进行对比。

主要发现: 优化场景理解的代理表现出涌现的人类注视特征模式；而优化搜索或分类场景，或拥有优于/劣于人类外周视觉的代理，对人类注视模式的预测准确性较低。

结论: 人类自由观看的注视模式可能是由于在中央凹视觉的生物限制下优化场景理解而产生的功能性副产品。

翻译: 摘要：当人类在没有特定任务的情况下观看场景（自由观看）时，他们最初将眼动指向场景中心，然后注视人、文本、被注视或被抓取的物体以及语义上有意义的区域。这些特征性注视模式反映了什么，以及它们是否优化了潜在的感知任务，目前尚不清楚。我们展示了一个具有模拟中央凹视觉的计算代理，经过优化场景理解的训练，表现出涌现的人类注视特征模式。相反，经过优化搜索或分类场景训练的代理版本，或配备了优于或劣于人类视觉的外周视觉的代理，对人类注视模式的预测准确性较低。因此，人类自由观看注视模式可能是由于在中央凹视觉的生物限制下优化场景理解而产生的功能性副产品。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

When humans view scenes without a specific task (free-viewing), they initially direct their eye movements toward the scene center and then fixate on people, text, objects being gazed at or grasped, and semantically meaningful regions. What these signature fixation patterns reflect and whether they optimize an underlying perceptual task remain unknown. We show that a computational agent with simulated foveation, trained to optimize scene comprehension, exhibits emergent human fixation signature patterns. In contrast, versions of the agent trained to search or classify scenes, or equipped with peripheral vision that was better or worse than human vision, predicted human fixation patterns less accurately. Thus, human free-viewing fixation patterns may emerge as a functional byproduct of optimizing scene comprehension under the biological constraints of foveated vision.

item.title: SNLP: Layer-Parallel Inference via Structured Newton Corrections
item.author: Han, Ligong, Xu, Kai, Wang, Hao, Srivastava, Akash
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文提出了一种名为结构化牛顿层并行（SNLP）的新方法，通过将Transformer层视为非线性残差方程的解，并利用结构化的牛顿更新来并行化推理过程，从而缓解了自回归语言模型的延迟瓶颈。

背景: 自回归语言模型通过顺序执行Transformer层产生延迟瓶颈，传统的张量或流水线并行无法完全解决这一问题。

目的: 研究是否可以通过将跨层的隐藏状态轨迹视为非线性残差方程的解，并使用并行牛顿风格更新来放松层间依赖关系。

方法: 引入结构化牛顿层并行（SNLP）训练和推理框架，用廉价的结构诱导代理动态替换精确的层雅可比矩阵。在残差Transformer中，这产生了恒等牛顿（IDN），在mHC风格架构中，使用了模型的残差混合矩阵。此外，还引入了SNLP感知的正则化。

主要发现: 在nanochat规模Transformer上的实验表明，SNLP正则化提高了层并行兼容性，并改善了标准顺序困惑度，减少了基线困惑度4.7%-23.4%。在推理时，结合层融合和分块分解，SNLP实现了实用的墙钟加速。

结论: 层并行推理不仅仅是顺序执行的数值近似，而是一种有用的求解器诱导推理偏差。然而，即插即用的预训练模型对此过程适应性较差，且精确收敛恢复的是顺序计算而非单调的推理时扩展。

翻译: 自回归语言模型通过顺序执行Transformer层产生延迟瓶颈，传统的张量或流水线并行无法完全解决这一问题。论文提出了一种名为结构化牛顿层并行（SNLP）的新方法，通过将Transformer层视为非线性残差方程的解，并利用结构化的牛顿更新来并行化推理过程，从而缓解了延迟瓶颈。实验表明，SNLP正则化提高了层并行兼容性，并改善了标准顺序困惑度，在推理时结合层融合和分块分解实现了实用的加速。这些结果表明层并行推理不仅仅是一种数值近似，而是一种有用的求解器诱导推理偏差。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决大语言模型推理效率低的问题，通过结构化牛顿修正实现层并行推理。这在现实中很重要，因为大模型计算资源消耗巨大，加速推理能降低成本并提升实用性。

Abstract

Autoregressive language models execute Transformer layers sequentially, creating a latency bottleneck that is not removed by conventional tensor or pipeline parallelism. We study whether this layerwise dependency can be relaxed by treating the hidden-state trace across layers as the solution of a nonlinear residual equation and solving it with parallel Newton-style updates. While this view is principled, exact Newton corrections require expensive Jacobian-vector products and naive fixed-point iterations are unstable on trained Transformers. We introduce Structured Newton Layer Parallelism (SNLP), a training and inference framework that replaces exact layer Jacobians with cheap architecture-induced surrogate dynamics. In residual Transformers, this yields Identity Newton (IDN), where the correction reduces to a prefix-sum-like update; in mHC-style architectures, HC Newton (HCN) uses the model's residual mixing matrix. We further introduce SNLP-aware regularization, which trains models to make one or a few structured Newton iterations accurately approximate the sequential forward. Experiments on nanochat-scale Transformers show that SNLP regularization improves layer-parallel compatibility and can also improve standard sequential perplexity, reducing baseline PPL by 4.7%-23.4%. At inference time, SNLP combined with layer fusion and chunkwise decomposition achieves practical wall-clock speedups: on a 0.5B Nanochat model, it reaches 2.3x speedup while still improving PPL by 6.1%. These results suggest that layer-parallel inference is not merely a numerical approximation to sequential execution, but can act as a useful solver-induced inference bias. We also characterize limitations: off-the-shelf pretrained models are less amenable to this procedure, and exact convergence recovers the sequential computation rather than providing monotonic inference-time scaling.

item.title: Guard: Scalable Straggler Detection and Node Health Management for Large-Scale Training
item.author: Guanliang Liu, Abhinandan Patni, Congzhu Lin, Zoe Zeng, Jack Wittmayer, Josh Wu, Ashvin Nihalani, Binxuan Huang, Yinghong Liu, Rory Na, Anthony Ko, Alexander Zhipa, Cong Cheng, Mi Sun, Vijay Rajakumar, Rejith George Joseph, Parthasarathy Govindarajen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Guard是一个可扩展的系统，用于在大规模训练集群中检测迟滞者并确保节点健康，通过结合在线性能监控和离线节点扫描机制，显著提升了训练效率和稳定性。

背景: 训练前沿级基础模型涉及协调数万GPU进行数月运行，微小的性能退化会累积成巨大的效率损失。现有健康检查机制（如NCCL测试或GPU烧机）主要关注功能正确性，往往无法检测出导致系统性能无声降级的迟滞行为。

目的: 提出Guard系统，旨在在大规模训练集群中检测迟滞者并确保节点健康，以解决现有机制无法检测急性故障和长期迟滞行为的问题。

方法: Guard结合了训练期间的轻量级在线性能监控与离线节点扫描机制，该机制在生产工作负载参与前系统性地评估和筛选节点。

主要发现: 部署在大规模基础模型预训练工作负载上，Guard将平均FLOPs利用率提高了1.7倍，将运行间训练步方差从20%降低到1%，增加了平均无故障时间，并显著减少了操作和调试开销。

结论: 主动的迟滞检测和系统性的节点筛选对于维持大规模训练的稳定性和高效性至关重要。

翻译: 训练前沿级基础模型涉及协调数万GPU进行数月运行，微小的性能退化会累积成巨大的效率损失。现有健康检查机制（如NCCL测试或GPU烧机）主要关注功能正确性，往往无法检测出导致系统性能无声降级的迟滞行为。Guard是一个可扩展的系统，用于在大规模训练集群中检测迟滞者并确保节点健康，通过结合在线性能监控和离线节点扫描机制，显著提升了训练效率和稳定性。部署在大规模基础模型预训练工作负载上，Guard将平均FLOPs利用率提高了1.7倍，将运行间训练步方差从20%降低到1%，增加了平均无故障时间，并显著减少了操作和调试开销。主动的迟滞检测和系统性的节点筛选对于维持大规模训练的稳定性和高效性至关重要。

Abstract

Training frontier-scale foundation models involves coordinating tens of thousands of GPUs over multi-month runs, where even minor performance degradations can accumulate into substantial efficiency losses. Existing health-check mechanisms, such as NCCL tests or GPU burn-in, primarily focus on functional correctness and often fail to detect fail-slow behaviors that silently degrade system performance. In this paper, we present Guard, a scalable system for detecting stragglers and ensuring node health in large-scale training clusters. Guard combines lightweight online performance monitoring during training with an offline node-sweep mechanism that systematically evaluates and qualifies nodes before they participate in production workloads. This design enables Guard to detect both acute failures and long-running fail-slow behaviors that traditional diagnostics cannot capture. Deployed on large-scale foundation model pretraining workloads, Guard improves mean FLOPs utilization by up to 1.7x, reduces run-to-run training step variance from 20% to 1%, increases mean time to failure (MTTF), and significantly reduces operational and debugging overhead. These results demonstrate that proactive straggler detection and systematic node qualification are critical for maintaining stable and efficient large-scale training.

item.title: Evaluating Cognitive Age Alignment in Interactive AI Agents
item.author: Shen, Yifan, Zhang, Jiawen, Xu, Jian, Kim, Junho, Lourentzou, Ismini, Cao, Xu, Huang, Meihuan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ChildAgentEval是一个基于儿童韦氏智力测验的交互式基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型代理的认知年龄对齐情况。

背景: 尽管多模态大语言模型在语言和视觉推理方面展现出巨大潜力，但现有的人工智能代理在处理基础任务时仍存在明显不足，无法像儿童一样轻松解决简单问题。

目的: 受儿童韦氏智力测验启发，引入ChildAgentEval，旨在建立首个具有心理测量学基础的交互式基准，以评估多模态大语言模型代理的认知年龄对齐程度。

方法: 通过系统性地将不同多模态大语言模型交互代理的推理表现与特定年龄段人类发展阶段的推理表现进行比较，从而揭示当前人工智能系统在模拟特定年龄段认知行为方面的能力。

主要发现: 通过该基准测试，暴露了当前人工智能代理系统在哪些方面能够模拟特定年龄段的认知行为，又在哪些方面无法模拟。

结论: ChildAgentEval基准测试揭示了当前人工智能代理在认知年龄对齐方面存在的差距，为改进人工智能系统提供了评估依据。

翻译: 虽然代理人工智能及其核心的多模态大语言模型在从日常生活到高级科学研究的各个领域都展示了在语言和视觉推理方面的显著前景，但人工智能与人类智能之间仍存在巨大鸿沟。尽管集成了强大的工具和先进的多模态大语言模型，最先进的人工智能代理经常在基础任务上失败，而这些任务儿童可以轻松解决。受儿童韦氏智力测验的启发，我们引入了ChildAgentEval，这是第一个具有心理测量学基础的交互式基准，用于评估基于多模态大语言模型的代理的认知年龄对齐情况。ChildAgentEval系统地比较了各种基于多模态大语言模型的交互代理的推理表现与特定年龄段的人类发展阶段的推理表现，暴露了当前代理人工智能系统在哪些方面能够模拟特定年龄段的认知行为，又在哪些方面无法模拟。

Abstract

While agentic AI and its core multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable promise in language and visual reasoning across domains ranging from daily life to advanced scientific research, a profound gap remains between artificial and human intelligence. Despite the integration of powerful tools and advanced MLLMs, state-of-the-art AI agents frequently fail at foundational, seemingly simple tasks that a child can resolve with ease. Inspired by the Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children (WISC), we introduce ChildAgentEval, the first psychometrically grounded interactive benchmark for evaluating cognitive age alignment in MLLM-based agents. ChildAgentEval systematically compares the reasoning performance of various MLLM-based interactive agents against age-specific human developmental stages, exposing where current agentic AI systems can and cannot simulate age-specific cognitive behavior.

item.title: DCFold: Efficient Protein Structure Generation with Single Forward Pass
item.author: Zhe Zhang, Yuanning Feng, Yuxuan Song, Keyue Qiu, Hao Zhou, Wei-Ying Ma
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DCFold是一种单步生成模型，在保持AlphaFold3水平准确性的同时实现了15倍推理加速。

背景: AlphaFold3虽然准确率高，但迭代设计导致推理时间过长，限制了实际部署。

目的: 提出DCFold，旨在实现单步生成模型，在保持预测保真度的同时大幅提高推理速度。

方法: DCFold采用Dual Consistency训练框架，结合了新颖的Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM)调度器。

主要发现: DCFold在推理速度上实现了15倍加速，同时保持了预测保真度。

结论: DCFold在结构预测和结合物设计基准测试中验证了其有效性。

翻译: AlphaFold3引入了一种基于扩散的架构，将蛋白质结构预测提升到了全原子分辨率，并提高了准确性。这种最先进的性能已将AlphaFold3确立为各种生成和设计任务的基石模型。然而，其迭代设计显著增加了推理时间，限制了在虚拟筛选和蛋白质设计等下游设置中的实际部署。我们提出了DCFold，这是一种单步生成模型，达到了AlphaFold3级别的准确性。我们的Dual Consistency训练框架，结合了新颖的Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM)调度器，使DCFold能够在保持预测保真度的同时实现15倍的推理加速。我们在结构预测和结合物设计基准测试中验证了其有效性。

Abstract

AlphaFold3 introduces a diffusion-based architecture that elevates protein structure prediction to all-atom resolution with improved accuracy. This state-of-the-art performance has established AlphaFold3 as a foundation model for diverse generation and design tasks. However, its iterative design substantially increases inference time, limiting practical deployment in downstream settings such as virtual screening and protein design. We propose DCFold, a single-step generative model that attains AlphaFold3-level accuracy. Our Dual Consistency training framework, which incorporates a novel Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM) scheduler, enables DCFold to achieve a 15x acceleration in inference while maintaining predictive fidelity. We validate its effectiveness across both structure prediction and binder design benchmarks.

item.title: An Efficient Streaming Video Understanding Framework with Agentic Control
item.author: Jinming Liu, Jianguo Huang, Zhaoyang Jia, Jiahao Li, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zongyu Guo, Bin Li, Wenjun Zeng, Yan Lu, Xin Jin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: R3-Streaming提出了一种级联控制问题框架，通过动态压缩记忆、判断响应准备度并路由计算，以优化流式视频理解。

背景: 现有方法通常采用静态策略，如固定内存压缩或依赖单一模型，导致快速模型在复杂查询上表现不佳，而重型模型违反实时约束且过度复杂化简单查询。

目的: 将流式视频理解构建为级联控制问题，使每个下游决策建立在逐步完善的信息状态之上，以优化处理流程。

方法: 1. 引入基于年龄的遗忘策略进行记忆压缩；2. 提出TB-GRPO，一种目标平衡的强化学习目标，用于路由计算；3. 将系统压缩记忆、判断响应准备度并路由计算作为级联控制问题处理。

主要发现: R3-Streaming在流式多模态大模型中达到最先进结果，在OVO-Bench上达到57.92，在StreamingBench上达到76.36，同时将视觉token使用量减少95%至96%。

结论: R3-Streaming在流式视频理解任务中表现优异，有效解决了现有方法的权衡问题，并显著降低了资源消耗。

翻译: 流式视频需要在严格的延迟预算下处理动态信息密度。然而，现有方法通常采用静态策略，如固定内存压缩或依赖单一模型，导致权衡：快速模型在复杂查询上失败，而始终开启的重型模型违反实时约束并过度复杂化简单查询。与其预先固定这些决策，我们提出了R3-Streaming（记住、响应、推理），将流式视频理解构建为级联控制问题：对于每个查询，系统压缩记忆、判断响应准备度并顺序路由计算，以便每个下游决策都建立在逐步完善的信息状态之上。为了优化此管道，我们引入了用于记忆压缩的基于年龄的遗忘策略，因为激进地压缩历史帧可以产生显著的性能增益。对于计算路由，我们提出了TB-GRPO，一种目标平衡的强化学习目标，将困难查询路由到更强的模型，同时防止模式崩溃。广泛的评估表明，R3-Streaming在流式多模态大模型中实现了最先进的结果，在OVO-Bench上达到57.92，在StreamingBench上达到76.36，同时将视觉token使用量减少了95%至96%。

Abstract

Streaming video requires handling dynamic information density under strict latency budgets. Yet, existing methods typically employ static strategies, such as fixed memory compression or reliance on a single model, forcing a trade-off: fast models fail on complex queries, while always-on heavy models violate real-time constraints and overcomplicate simple queries. Rather than fixing these decisions upfront, we propose R3-Streaming (Remember, Respond, Reason), which formulates streaming video understanding as a cascaded control problem: for each query, the system compresses memory, judges response readiness, and routes computation sequentially, so that each downstream decision builds on progressively refined information states. To optimize this pipeline, we introduce an age-aware forgetting policy for memory compression, as aggressively compressing historical frames can yield substantial performance gains. For compute routing, we propose TB-GRPO, a target-balanced reinforcement learning objective that routes hard queries to a stronger model while preventing mode collapse. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that R3-Streaming achieves state-of-the-art results among streaming MLLMs, reaching 57.92 on OVO-Bench and 76.36 on StreamingBench, while reducing visual token usage by 95 to 96 percent.

item.title: Transfer Learning for Customized Car Racing Environments
item.author: Benedict Florance Arockiaraj, Richard Chang, Wesley Yee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本项目探索了深度强化学习中的迁移学习技术，旨在通过在一个赛道上训练智能体，将其知识迁移到其他赛道以实现快速圈速。

背景: 迁移学习是一种利用在一个任务中获得的知识来解决另一个相关任务的技术，常用于深度学习领域。

目的: 利用迁移学习在OpenAI的赛车环境中实现快速圈速，通过零样本迁移或微调的方式，将训练好的智能体应用到其他自定义目标环境中。

方法: 对比了基于模型和基于模型的方法，在赛车环境中进行训练和测试，并观察迁移学习的效果。

主要发现: 基于模型的方法在性能上优于基于模型的方法，且收敛速度更快；迁移学习不仅提升了目标域的性能，还在学习过程中表现出高性能能力。

结论: 迁移学习在深度强化学习任务中能有效提升性能，特别是在赛车环境中基于模型的方法表现更佳。

翻译: 摘要：迁移学习是一种模型/代理可以利用在一个任务中获得的知识/专业知识，并将其利用来解决另一个紧密相关任务的技术，常用于解决深度学习中的问题。通过本项目，我们在深度强化学习的范围内探索迁移学习。具体而言，我们希望利用迁移学习通过在一个赛道上训练智能体，并利用零样本迁移或额外的微调在其他的自定义目标环境中进行赛车，以实现快速圈速。此外，我们比较了基于模型和基于模型的方法的性能，并观察到基于模型的方法在该环境中性能占主导地位，且收敛速度比基于模型的方法更快。我们观察到，在大多数设置中，迁移学习不仅提高了目标域的性能，而且在学习过程中表现出高性能能力。

Abstract

Transfer Learning, a technique where a model/agent can use the knowledge/expertise that it gained from one task and exploit that to solve another closely-related task, is often used in tackling problems in deep learning. Through this project, we explore transfer learning in the purview of deep reinforcement learning. Specifically, we want to use transfer learning to achieve the fast lap times in OpenAI's Car racing environment by training the agent on one circuit, and racing it on other customized target environments by zero-shot transfer or by additional fine-tuning. In addition, we compare the performance of model-based and model-free approaches, and observe that model-based approaches dominate in performance and converge faster than model-free approaches in this environment. We observe that transfer learning in most setups not only boosts the performance on the target domain, but also shows high performance ability during learning.

item.title: AtlasVA: Self-Evolving Visual Skill Memory for Teacher-Free VLM Agents
item.author: Wang, Pan, Hu, Yihao, Liu, Xiujin, Yang, Jingchu, Wang, Hang, Wen, Zhihao
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为AtlasVA的框架，用于增强视觉语言模型代理的记忆能力，通过将记忆组织为空间热力图、视觉示例和符号化文本技能三个互补层，并利用这些自进化图谱作为潜在性奖励进行强化学习优化。

背景: 现有的视觉语言模型代理框架大多依赖文本存储记忆，并依赖专有的教师模型进行总结或细化，这种设计在空间决策方面表现不佳，因为几何先验被压缩成有损的语言，稀疏交互往往通过延迟的文本反馈而非密集的视觉信号进行监督。

目的: 提出一种无需外部大型语言模型监督的视觉技能记忆框架，旨在使视觉语言模型代理的可重用经验保持视觉基础，从而更好地适应空间决策任务。

方法: AtlasVA将记忆组织为三个互补层：空间热力图、视觉示例和符号化文本技能；直接从轨迹统计和轻量级网格启发式方法进化危险和亲和热力图；并将这些自进化的热力图作为潜在性奖励重新用于强化学习。

主要发现: 在Sokoban、FrozenLake、3D具身导航和3D机器人操作基准测试中，AtlasVA consistently outperforms text-centric memory baselines and competitive VLM agents，特别是在空间密集型任务上表现强劲。

结论: AtlasVA统一了感知、记忆和优化，无需外部LLM监督，在多个基准测试中优于基于文本的记忆基线和竞争性VLM代理，证明了视觉基础记忆框架的有效性。

翻译: Vision-language model (VLM) agents increasingly rely on memory-augmented reinforcement learning to reuse experience across long-horizon tasks, yet most existing frameworks store memory as text and depend on proprietary teacher models to summarize or refine it. This design is poorly matched to spatial decision making: geometric priors are compressed into lossy language, and sparse interaction is often supervised through delayed textual feedback rather than dense visually grounded signals. We argue that reusable experience for VLM agents should remain visually grounded. Based on this insight, we propose AtlasVA, a teacher-free visual skill memory framework that organizes memory into three complementary layers: spatial heatmaps, visual exemplars, and symbolic text skills. AtlasVA further evolves danger and affinity atlases directly from trajectory statistics and lightweight grid heuristics, and reuses these self-evolving atlases as potential-based shaping rewards for reinforcement learning. This unifies perception, memory, and optimization without external LLM supervision. Experiments on Sokoban, FrozenLake, 3D embodied navigation, and 3D robotic manipulation benchmarks show that AtlasVA consistently outperforms text-centric memory baselines and competitive VLM agents, with especially strong gains on spatially intensive tasks. 如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Vision-language model (VLM) agents increasingly rely on memory-augmented reinforcement learning to reuse experience across long-horizon tasks, yet most existing frameworks store memory as text and depend on proprietary teacher models to summarize or refine it. This design is poorly matched to spatial decision making: geometric priors are compressed into lossy language, and sparse interaction is often supervised through delayed textual feedback rather than dense visually grounded signals. We argue that reusable experience for VLM agents should remain visually grounded. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{AtlasVA}, a teacher-free visual skill memory framework that organizes memory into three complementary layers: spatial heatmaps, visual exemplars, and symbolic text skills. AtlasVA further evolves danger and affinity atlases directly from trajectory statistics and lightweight grid heuristics, and reuses these self-evolving atlases as potential-based shaping rewards for reinforcement learning. This unifies perception, memory, and optimization without external LLM supervision. Experiments on \textsc{Sokoban}, \textsc{FrozenLake}, 3D embodied navigation, and 3D robotic manipulation benchmarks show that AtlasVA consistently outperforms text-centric memory baselines and competitive VLM agents, with especially strong gains on spatially intensive tasks. item.title: SAFE-SVD: Sensitivity-Aware Fidelity-Enforcing SVD for Physics Foundation Models
item.author: Chengjie Hong, Feixiang He, Yiheng Zeng, Lulu Kang, He Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种新的物理基础模型压缩方法

背景: 物理基础模型是AI for Science的新趋势，模型压缩对减少内存使用和加速推理至关重要，但在物理基础模型中，保持物理保真度至关重要

目的: 解决物理数据函数性质带来的挑战，即偏导数编码时空动力学并对压缩高度敏感，传统压缩方法往往导致严重性能下降或失败

方法: 引入了一种敏感性感知保真度强制压缩框架，在压缩过程中显式建模输出函数空间中损失感知层的敏感性

主要发现: 实验显示在多个模型和数据集上相比现有方法有显著提升，在保持准确性的同时实现了更高的压缩比，在某些情况下提高了数个数量级

结论: 该工作可能引领AI for Science中高效、可部署和可持续的科学基础模型这一新子领域的发展

翻译: 我们提出了一种新的物理基础模型压缩方法，这是AI for Science领域的新趋势。虽然模型压缩对于减少大型基础模型的内存使用和加速推理至关重要，但在物理基础模型中，保持物理保真度至关重要。挑战在于物理数据的函数性质，其中偏导数编码时空动力学并对压缩高度敏感。传统压缩方法忽略了这种结构，往往导致严重性能下降或失败。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种敏感性感知保真度强制压缩框架，在压缩过程中显式建模输出函数空间中损失感知层的敏感性。这为压缩科学基础模型同时保持准确性和物理保真度提供了新途径。实验显示在多个模型和数据集上相比现有方法有显著提升，在保持准确性的同时实现了更高的压缩比，在某些情况下提高了数个数量级。更广泛地说，这项工作可能引领AI for Science中高效、可部署和可持续的科学基础模型这一新子领域的发展。

Abstract

We propose a new method for compressing physics foundation models (PFMs) which is a new trend in AI for Science. While model compression is essential for reducing memory use and accelerating inference in large foundation models, it remains under-explored for PFMs, where preserving physical fidelity is crucial. The challenge lies in the functional nature of physics data, where partial derivatives encode spatiotemporal dynamics and exhibit high sensitivity to compression. Conventional compression methods ignore this structure, often causing severe performance degradation or failure. To address this, we introduce a sensitivity-aware fidelity-enforcing compression framework that explicitly models loss-aware layer sensitivity in the output function space during compression. This provides a new route to compressing scientific foundation models while preserving accuracy and physical fidelity. Experiments show substantial gains over existing methods across multiple models and datasets, achieving significantly higher compression ratios while maintaining accuracy, in some cases by orders of magnitude. More broadly, the work potentially leads to a new subfield of efficient, deployable, and sustainable scientific foundation models in AI for Science.

item.title: Inter-LPCM: Learning-based Inter-Frame Predictive Coding for LiDAR Point Cloud Compression
item.author: Chang Sun, Hui Yuan, Shiqi Jiang, Chongzhen Tian, Guanghui Zhang, Raouf Hamzaoui
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于学习的球形坐标系点云压缩方法，通过引入帧间预测模型来提高压缩效率。

背景: 传统的球形坐标点云压缩方法如PredGeom依赖简单的线性模型，难以捕捉复杂的运动模式和结构依赖；现有的基于学习的方法未利用帧间相关性。

目的: 为了解决上述限制，提出了一种基于学习的帧间预测编码方法，称为Inter-LPCM，旨在提高点云压缩的性能。

方法: 1. 采用基于预设角分辨率的角度差分编码策略进行方位角预测；2. 引入帧间半径预测模型，利用当前帧和参考帧的邻近点估计当前点的半径；3. 设计轻量级注意力预测模型以捕捉不同坐标间的长程几何相关性；4. 提出RD优化的量化方法；5. 为每个球形坐标分量设计独立的熵编码模型。

主要发现: 通过上述方法，Inter-LPCM能够更有效地减少几何冗余，提高压缩性能。

结论: Inter-LPCM方法在球形坐标系点云压缩中表现出色，能够捕捉复杂的运动模式和结构依赖，源代码已公开。

翻译: 由于LiDAR传感器以固定的角分辨率获取点云数据，因此可以在球形坐标系中系统地对数据进行参数化和高效压缩。传统的基于球形坐标的点云压缩方法展示了强大的率失真性能，其中基于几何的点云压缩标准中的预测几何编码方法是一个突出的例子。尽管PredGeom包含帧间预测模式，但它依赖于简单的线性模型，限制了其捕捉复杂运动模式和结构依赖的能力。同时，现有的球形域基于学习的方法没有利用帧间相关性来减少几何冗余。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种基于学习的帧间预测编码方法，称为Inter-LPCM。对于方位角预测，我们采用基于预设角分辨率的差分编码策略。为了提高半径压缩，我们引入了一个帧间半径预测模型，利用当前帧和已注册参考帧中的邻近点来估计当前点的半径。此外，我们设计了一个轻量级注意力预测模型，通过捕捉不同坐标之间的长程几何相关性来预测仰角。对于量化，我们提出了一种RD优化的方法来选择球形坐标系中的量化步长。对于熵编码，我们为每个球形坐标分量设计了不同的模型。这些模型适应了每个坐标的统计先验，从而能够进行更准确的概率估计。我们的源代码已公开。

Abstract

Because LiDAR sensors acquire point clouds with a fixed angular resolution, the resulting data can be systematically parameterized and efficiently compressed in the spherical coordinate system. Traditional spherical coordinate-based point cloud compression methods have demonstrated strong rate-distortion (RD) performance, with the predictive geometry coding (PredGeom) method in the geometry-based point cloud compression (G-PCC) standard being a prominent example. Although PredGeom includes an inter-frame prediction mode, it relies on a simple linear model, which limits its ability to capture complex motion patterns and structural dependencies. Meanwhile, existing learning-based compression methods in the spherical domain do not exploit inter-frame correlations to reduce geometry redundancy. To address these limitations, we propose a learning-based inter-frame predictive coding method, termed Inter-LPCM. For azimuth prediction, we employ a delta coding strategy based on the predefined angular resolution. To improve radius compression, we introduce an inter-frame radius predictive (Inter-RP) model that estimates the current point's radius using neighboring points from both the current frame and the registered reference frame. In addition, we design a lightweight attention-based prediction (LAEP) model to predict elevation angles by capturing long-range geometric correlations across different coordinates. For quantization, we propose an RD-optimized method to select quantization steps in the spherical coordinate system. For entropy coding, we design distinct models for each spherical coordinate component. These models are adapted to the statistical priors of each coordinate, enabling more accurate probability estimation. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/SDUChangSun/Inter-LPCM

item.title: Semantic Reranking at Inference Time for Hard Examples in Rhetorical Role Labeling
item.author: Anas Belfathi, Nicolas Hernandez, Laura Monceaux, Warren Bonnard, Richard Dufour
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为RISE的推理时语义重排序框架，旨在通过利用标签语义信息来优化语言模型在困难样本上的预测性能。

背景: 修辞角色标注（RRL）在法律、医疗和科学等领域广泛应用。虽然语言模型在平均性能上表现强劲，但在预测置信度低的困难样本上仍不可靠。现有方法通常隐式处理不确定性，并将标签视为离散标识符，忽略了标签名称中编码的语义信息。

目的: 引入RISE框架，利用标签语义在推理时对模型输出进行重排序，以改进对困难实例的预测。

方法: RISE是一个推理时语义重排序框架。它自动识别低置信度预测，并使用对比学习的标签表示对模型输出进行重排序，无需重新训练或修改底层模型。此外，研究还提出了人工困难度标注以从模型和人类角度研究难度。

主要发现: 在八个领域特定的RRL数据集上，RISE在困难样本上平均获得了+9.15个宏观F1分数的提升。在可解释性方面，人工标注显示与模型预测之间存在中等程度的共识（Cohen's kappa = 0.40）。

结论: RISE框架能够有效利用标签语义信息来提升语言模型在困难样本上的表现，且无需对模型进行重新训练或修改。

翻译: 修辞角色标注（RRL）为文档中的每个句子分配一个功能角色，并在法律、医疗和科学领域得到广泛应用。虽然语言模型（LMs）实现了强大的平均性能，但在预测置信度低的困难样本上仍不可靠。现有方法通常隐式处理不确定性并将标签视为离散标识符，忽略了标签名称中编码的语义信息。我们介绍了RISE，这是一个推理时语义重排序框架，利用标签语义来细化困难实例的预测。RISE自动识别低置信度预测，并使用对比学习的标签表示对模型输出进行重排序，无需重新训练或修改底层模型。在八个领域特定的RRL数据集上，RISE在困难样本上平均获得了+9.15个宏观F1分数的提升。为了可解释性，我们进一步提出了人工困难度标注，以从模型和人类角度研究难度，揭示了与Cohen's kappa = 0.40的中等一致性。

Abstract

Rhetorical Role Labeling (RRL) assigns a functional role to each sentence in a document and is widely used in legal, medical, and scientific domains. While language models (LMs) achieve strong average performance, they remain unreliable on hard examples, where prediction confidence is low. Existing approaches typically handle uncertainty implicitly and treat labels as discrete identifiers, overlooking the semantic information encoded in label names. We introduce RISE, an inference-time semantic reranking framework that leverages label semantics to refine predictions on hard instances. RISE automatically identifies low-confidence predictions and reranks model outputs using contrastively learned label representations, without retraining or modifying the underlying model. Experiments on eight domain-specific RRL datasets with seven LMs, including encoder-based and causal architectures, show an average gain of +9.15 macro-F1 points on hard examples. For explainability, we further propose manual hardness annotations to study difficulty from both model and human perspectives, revealing a moderate agreement with Cohen's kappa = 0.40.

item.title: Functionalization via Structure Completion and Motion Rectification
item.author: Mingrui Zhao, Sai Raj Kishore Perla, Kai Wang, Sauradip Nag, Duc Anh Nguyen, Jiayi Peng, Ruiqi Wang, Angel X. Chang, Manolis Savva, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Hao Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种将视觉上合理但功能上不完整的3D模型转化为功能性和物理可操作模型的新任务，即对象功能化。

背景: 现有的3D资产获取和创建主要依赖于视图或外观，导致数字3D模型缺乏必要的结构组件（如关节、支撑、内部结构或交互元素）。同时，即使是人工标注的运动数据也经常存在错误，导致物理上不切实际的行为。

目的: 将视觉上合理但非功能性的3D模型转化为功能性且物理可操作的模型。

方法: 将功能化定义为图补全问题，使用新的功能图表示，其中标记的节点代表对象部分，标记的边编码功能和接触关系，可移动节点携带运动属性。开发了神经图功能化器来补全代表非功能性3D对象的图，然后驱动几何实现阶段以实例化预测的连接器和结构元素。

主要发现: 该方法在运动预测准确率上与最先进方法匹配，同时在碰撞和连通性方面的功能性方面有显著改善。

结论: 该方法能够有效地将非功能性3D模型转化为功能性模型，并修正了错误的人工标注和预测运动。

翻译: 3D资产的获取和创建在很大程度上是由视图或外观驱动的。因此，现有的数字3D模型往往缺乏必要的结构组件来按预期功能运行，例如关节、支撑、内部结构或交互元素。同时，即使是人工标注的运动也经常容易出错，导致物理上不切实际的行为。我们引入了对象功能化，这是一个旨在将视觉上合理但非功能性的3D模型转化为功能性且物理可操作模型的新任务。我们将功能化定义为一个新的功能图表示上的图补全问题，其中标记的节点代表对象部分，标记的边编码功能和接触关系，可移动节点携带运动属性，以便结构功能缺陷表现为缺失的节点或错误的边。我们开发了一个神经图功能化器来完成代表非功能性3D对象的图。然后，完成的图驱动一个几何实现阶段，在3D中实例化预测的连接器和结构元素，并产生修正错误的人工标注和预测运动的令人信服的副作用。为了支持训练和评估，我们引入了FurFun-233，这是一个包含233对非功能化和功能化家具模型的集合。在PartNet-Mobility（“零样本”）和HSSD测试集上，我们的方法在运动预测准确率上与最先进的方法相匹配，同时在碰撞和连通性方面的功能性方面有显著改善。
