这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出通过多任务协同实现统一多模态建模。相比之前的工作，它强调多任务之间的协同作用，以实现更统一的模型架构。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

We present Lance, a lightweight native unified model supporting multimodal understanding, generation, and editing for both images and videos. Rather than relying on model capacity scaling or text-image-dominant designs, Lance explores a practical paradigm for unified multimodal modeling via collaborative multi-task training. It is grounded in two core principles: unified context modeling and decoupled capability pathways. Specifically, Lance is trained from scratch and employs a dual-stream mixture-of-experts architecture on shared interleaved multimodal sequences, enabling joint context learning while decoupling the pathways for understanding and generation. We further introduce modality-aware rotary positional encoding to mitigate interference among heterogeneous visual tokens and boost cross-task alignment. During training, Lance adopts a staged multi-task training paradigm with capability-oriented objectives and adaptive data scheduling to strengthen both semantic comprehension and visual generation performance. Experimental results demonstrate that Lance substantially outperforms existing open-source unified models in image and video generation, while retaining strong multimodal understanding capabilities. The homepage is available at this https URL .

item.title: Ensembling Tabular Foundation Models - A Diversity Ceiling And A Calibration Trap
item.author: Aditya Tanna, Yash Desai, Pratinav Seth, Mohamed Bouadi, Nassim Bouarour, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了表格基础模型（TFMs）的集成策略，发现集成效果不如预期，并比较了多种集成方法。

背景: 表格基础模型（TFMs）在许多表格任务上已能匹敌或超越经过调优的梯度提升树，但没有任何单一模型能在所有数据集上获胜。

目的: 在153个OpenML分类任务上，对六种现代TFMs和六种集成策略进行基准测试，以评估集成方法的有效性。

方法: 使用六种现代TFMs作为基础模型，在153个OpenML分类任务上评估六种集成策略，包括两层级级联堆叠、逻辑回归元学习器等，并进行了Friedman和Nemenyi分析。

主要发现: 六种TFMs之间高度冗余（平均配对Q统计量接近1）；最佳集成策略（两层级级联堆叠）比最强单一TFM准确率仅提高0.18%，但计算量增加了253倍；三种集成策略与最佳单一TFF处于同一等效组，另外三种显著较差；逻辑回归元学习器在准确率和ROC-AUC上具有竞争力，但log-loss排名最差。

结论: 由于集成策略的计算成本高昂且效果提升有限，建议将贪心选择作为实际应用中的默认策略。

翻译: 表格基础模型（TFMs）现在在越来越多的表格任务上匹配或击败了经过调优的梯度提升树，但没有单一TFM在每一个数据集上都获胜。集成是这里的首选解决方案，但效果不如预期。六种现代TFMs构成了一个近乎冗余的池：它们的平均配对Q统计量是0.961，接近1，以至于任何凸组合都受到上限限制。我们在153个OpenML分类任务上对六种TFMs和六种集成策略进行了基准测试。最佳集成策略，两层级级联堆叠，比最强的单一TFM准确率提高了0.18%，但计算量增加了253倍。Friedman和Nemenyi分析将三种集成策略和最佳基础TFM放在一个等效组中；另外三种集成策略显著比最佳基础TFM差。使用逻辑回归元学习器的堆叠是最引人注目的案例：具有竞争力的准确率和ROC-AUC，在集成中log-loss排名最差。元学习器通过锐化类边界来提高准确率，但这会破坏校准。我们建议将贪心选择作为实用的默认选项。

Abstract

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) now match or beat tuned gradient-boosted trees on a growing fraction of tabular tasks, but no single TFM wins on every dataset. Ensembling is the go to fix here, and it works less well than expected. Six modern TFMs form a near-redundant pool: their mean pairwise Q-statistic is $0.961$, close enough to $1$ that any convex combination is bounded above. We benchmark six ensemble strategies over six TFMs on 153 OpenML classification tasks. The best ensemble, two-level cascade stacking, buys $+0.18\%$ accuracy over the strongest single TFM at $253\times$ the compute. A Friedman and Nemenyi analysis places three ensembles and the best base TFM in a single equivalence group; three other ensembles are significantly \emph{worse} than the best base. Stacking with a logistic-regression meta-learner is the most striking case: competitive accuracy and ROC-AUC, the worst log-loss rank among the ensembles. The meta-learner improves accuracy by sharpening class boundaries, which destroys calibration. We recommend greedy selection as the practical default.

item.title: Distilling Tabular Foundation Models for Structured Health Data
item.author: Aditya Tanna, Nassim Bouarour, Mohamed Bouadi, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu, Pratinav Seth
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究通过知识蒸馏将大型表格基础模型（TFM）的预测能力迁移到轻量级模型中，解决了TFM在医疗数据集上的高推理成本和基础设施要求问题。

背景: 表格基础模型（TFM）在医疗数据集上表现出色，但其高推理成本和基础设施要求限制了其实际应用。

目的: 研究是否可以通过知识蒸馏将TFM的预测行为转移到轻量级表格模型中。

方法: 针对TFM在推理时依赖训练集上下文导致的上下文泄漏问题，采用分层留一折教师标注方法。实验涉及19个医疗数据集、6个TFM教师模型、4种学生模型家族以及多个多教师集成模型。

主要发现: 蒸馏后的学生模型在CPU上至少比教师模型快26倍，且保留了至少90%的教师AUC，在某些情况下甚至超过教师模型，同时保持了校准度和公平性。多教师平均并未一致优于最佳单一教师。

结论: 泄漏感知的知识蒸馏是将TFM级预测能力带入推理受限医疗环境的可行途径。

翻译: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) 在医疗数据集上取得了强大的性能，但其推理成本和基础设施要求限制了其实际使用。我们研究了是否可以通过知识蒸馏将其预测行为转移到轻量级表格模型中。由于TFM在推理时以训练集为条件，朴素蒸馏可能会引入上下文泄漏；我们通过分层留一折教师标注解决了这一问题。在19个医疗数据集、6个TFM教师模型、4种学生模型家族以及几个多教师集成模型上，我们发现蒸馏后的学生模型保留了至少90%的教师AUC，在某些情况下甚至超过了教师模型，同时在CPU上的运行速度至少快了26倍，并保持了对于健康应用至关重要的校准和公平性。此外，多教师平均并未一致优于最佳单一教师。因此，泄漏感知的知识蒸馏是将TFM级预测能力带入推理受限医疗环境的可行途径。

Abstract

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong performance on health datasets, but their inference cost and infrastructure requirements limit practical use. We study whether their predictive behavior can be transferred to lightweight tabular models through knowledge distillation. Since in-context TFMs condition on the training set at inference time, naive distillation can introduce context leakage; we address this with stratified out-of-fold teacher labeling. Across $19$ healthcare datasets, $6$ TFM teachers, $4$ student families, and several multi-teacher ensembles, we find that distilled students retain at least $90\%$ of teacher AUC, outperforming teachers in some cases, while running at least $26\times$ faster on CPU and preserving calibration and fairness critical for health applications. Moreover, multi-teacher averaging does not consistently improve over the best single teacher. Leakage-aware distillation is thus a viable route for bringing TFM-quality predictions into inference-constrained health settings.

item.title: SafeDiffusion-R1: Online Reward Steering for Safe Diffusion Post-Training
item.author: Kumar, Komal, Deria, Ankan, Basu, Abhishek, Shamshad, Fahad, Cholakkal, Hisham, Nandakumar, Karthik
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于在线强化学习的框架，通过利用CLIP嵌入的内在属性来引导文本表示，从而在无需监督配对数据或奖励模型微调的情况下，有效减少生成内容中的不当内容，同时保持生成质量。

背景: 现有的去除预训练中学习的不安全内容的方法需要昂贵的监督数据，且离线强化学习和监督微调方法容易导致灾难性遗忘，降低生成质量。

目的: 解决数据稀缺和模型退化问题，消除对微调专用安全/不安全奖励模型的需求，并使模型能够从多样化的提示词中学习，包括明确的非安全内容，而不会发生灾难性遗忘。

方法: 提出了一种新颖的在线强化学习框架，使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）对负向和正向文本提示进行后训练；引入了一种引导奖励机制，利用CLIP嵌入的内在属性，在嵌入空间中将文本表示引导至正向安全方向并远离负向方向。

主要发现: 该方法将不当内容减少至18.07%（对比SD v1.4的48.9%），将裸露检测减少至15（对比646基线），并在GenEval上将组合生成质量从42.08%提升至47.83%；这些安全增益在七个危害类别的跨领域非安全提示词中实现了最先进的性能。

结论: 该方法在无需监督配对数据或奖励模型微调的情况下实现了最先进的性能，证明了其有效性和泛化能力。

翻译: 扩散模型已被广泛研究用于去除预训练期间学习的不安全内容。现有方法需要昂贵的监督数据，即不安全文本与安全图像真值配对或负向/正向图像对，这使得它们难以扩展。此外，离线强化学习和监督微调方法在离线生成合成数据时容易遭受灾难性遗忘，降低生成质量。我们提出了一种新颖的在线强化学习框架，通过在负向和正向文本提示上使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行后训练，解决了数据稀缺和模型退化问题。为了消除对微调专用安全/不安全奖励模型的需求，我们引入了一种引导奖励机制，利用CLIP嵌入的内在属性：在嵌入空间中将文本表示引导至正向安全方向并远离负向方向。我们的在线策略方法使模型能够从多样化的提示词中学习，包括明确的非安全内容，而不会发生灾难性遗忘。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法将不当内容减少至18.07%（对比SD v1.4的48.9%），将裸露检测减少至15（对比646基线），并在GenEval上将组合生成质量从42.08%提升至47.83%。值得注意的是，这些安全增益在七个危害类别的跨领域非安全提示词中实现了最先进的性能，无需监督配对数据或奖励模型微调。Github: this https URL 。

Abstract

Diffusion models have been widely studied for removing unsafe content learned during pre-training. Existing methods require expensive supervised data, either unsafe-text paired with safe-image groundtruth or negative/positive image pairs, making them impractical to scale. Furthermore, offline reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning approaches that generate synthetic data offline suffer from catastrophic forgetting, degrading generation quality. We propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that addresses both data scarcity and model degradation through post-training with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on both negative and positive text prompts. To eliminate the need for fine-tuning specialized safe/unsafe reward models, we introduce a \textit{steering reward mechanism} that exploits an inherent property of CLIP embeddings: steering text representations toward positive safety directions and away from negative ones in the embedding space. Our online-policy approach enables the model to learn from diverse prompts, including explicit unsafe content, without catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces inappropriate content to 18.07\% (vs. 48.9\% for SD v1.4) and nudity detections to 15 (vs. 646 baseline) while improving compositional generation quality from 42.08\% to 47.83\% on GenEval. Remarkably, these safety gains generalize to out-of-domain unsafe prompts across seven harm categories, achieving state-of-the-art performance without supervised paired data or reward tuning. item.title: EgoExoMem: Cross-View Memory Reasoning over Synchronized Egocentric and Exocentric Videos
item.author: Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Di Wen, Shaofang Quan, Chengzhi Wu, Jiaming Zhang, Kailun Yang, Kunyu Peng, Rainer Stiefelhagen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EgoExoMem是一个跨视角记忆推理基准，包含2.6K高质量多选题，涵盖时空和跨视角问答类型。

背景: 自中心记忆在具身智能中广泛应用，但可能不足以进行全面的空间-时间推理。

目的: 受人类从场域和观察者视角双重回忆的启发，引入EgoExoMem作为首个跨视角记忆推理基准。

方法: 提出E²-Select，一种无训练的帧选择方法，结合相关性预算分配与每视图k-DPP采样，以处理视图不对称性和跨视图时间一致性。

主要发现: 自中心和外部视角提供互补的记忆线索；现有多模态大模型在基准上表现不佳，最佳模型仅达55.3%；E²-Select在帧选择和基于RAG的记忆基线上达到58.2%的SOTA性能；分析揭示了问题框架与答案定位之间存在系统的视图偏好冲突。

结论: 跨视角记忆推理具有新颖性和挑战性，现有模型距离解决该基准仍有很大差距。

翻译: Egocentric memory is widely used in embodied intelligence, but it may be insufficient for comprehensive spatial-temporal reasoning. Inspired by human recall from both field and observer perspectives, we introduce EgoExoMem, the first benchmark for cross-view memory reasoning over synchronized egocentric and exocentric videos. EgoExoMem contains 2.6K high-quality MCQs across eight temporal, spatial, and cross-view QA types. To support dual-view retrieval, we propose E²-Select, a training-free frame selection method for synchronized ego-exo videos. It combines relevance-based budget allocation with per-view k-DPP sampling to handle view asymmetry and cross-view temporal consistency. Experiments show that ego and exo views provide complementary memory cues, while existing MLLMs remain far from solving the benchmark: the best model reaches only 55.3%. E²-Select achieves state-of-the-art performance of 58.2% over frame-selection and RAG-based memory baselines. Further analysis reveals systematic view-preference conflicts between question framing and answer grounding, underscoring the novelty and challenge of cross-view memory reasoning.

Abstract

Egocentric memory is widely used in embodied intelligence, but it may be insufficient for comprehensive spatial-temporal reasoning. Inspired by human recall from both field and observer perspectives, we introduce EgoExoMem, the first benchmark for cross-view memory reasoning over synchronized egocentric and exocentric videos. EgoExoMem contains $2.6K$ high-quality MCQs across eight temporal, spatial, and cross-view QA types. To support dual-view retrieval, we propose E$^2$-Select, a training-free frame selection method for synchronized ego-exo videos. It combines relevance-based budget allocation with per-view k-DPP sampling to handle view asymmetry and cross-view temporal consistency. Experiments show that ego and exo views provide complementary memory cues, while existing MLLMs remain far from solving the benchmark: the best model reaches only $55.3\%$. E$^2$-Select achieves state-of-the-art performance of $58.2\%$ over frame-selection and RAG-based memory baselines. Further analysis reveals systematic view-preference conflicts between question framing and answer grounding, underscoring the novelty and challenge of cross-view memory reasoning.

item.title: LongLive-2.0: An NVFP4 Parallel Infrastructure for Long Video Generation
item.author: Chen, Yukang, Wang, Luozhou, Huang, Wei, Yang, Shuai, Zhang, Bohan, Xiao, Yicheng, Chu, Ruihang, Mao, Weian, Hu, Qixin, Liu, Shaoteng, Zhao, Yuyang, Mao, Huizi, Chen, Ying-Cong, Xie, Enze, Qi, Xiaojuan, Han, Song
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LongLive-2.0是一个基于NVFP4的并行基础设施，用于长视频生成的全流程训练和推理，解决了速度和内存瓶颈问题。

背景: 长视频生成面临速度和内存瓶颈，现有方法如Self-Forcing系列依赖ODE初始化和分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）。

目的: 构建一个能够高效处理长视频生成全流程（训练和推理）的并行基础设施，并直接将扩散模型调整为长、多镜头、交互式自回归扩散模型。

方法: 训练方面采用序列并行自回归（AR）训练（实例化为Balanced SP），结合NVFP4精度以降低GPU内存成本并加速GEMM计算；推理方面在Blackwell GPU上启用W4A4 NVFP4推理，量化KV缓存，并利用异步流式VAE解码提升吞吐量；在非Blackwell GPU上部署SP推理以匹配速度。

主要发现: 实验显示训练速度提升高达2.15倍，推理速度提升1.84倍；LongLive-2.0-5B在Blackwell GPU上实现45.7 FPS推理；该系统是首个用于长视频生成的NVFP4训练和推理系统。

结论: LongLive-2.0通过高效的并行基础设施和数据处理方法，显著提升了长视频生成的训练和推理效率，并保持了强大的性能表现。

翻译: 我们介绍了LongLive-2.0，这是一个基于NVFP4的并行基础设施，贯穿长视频生成的全训练和推理工作流程，解决了速度和内存瓶颈问题。在训练方面，我们引入了序列并行自回归（AR）训练，实例化为Balanced SP，它协同设计了高效的teacher-forcing布局与SP执行，通过在每个rank上配对clean-history和noisy-target时间块，实现了具有SP感知分块VAE编码的自然teacher-forcing掩码。结合NVFP4精度，它降低了GPU内存成本并加速了训练期间的GEMM计算，其比例随视频长度增长而增加。此外，我们展示了高质量的基础设施和数据集能够实现 remarkably clean 的训练流程。与依赖ODE初始化和后续分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）的现有Self-Forcing系列方法不同，LongLive-2.0直接将扩散模型调整为长、多镜头、交互式自回归（AR）扩散模型。它还可以进一步转换为具有独立LoRA权重的实时生成（4到2去噪步骤）。对于Blackwell GPU上的推理，我们启用了W4A4 NVFP4推理，将KV缓存量化为NVFP4以节省内存，并通过异步流式VAE解码提升端到端吞吐量。在非Blackwell GPU架构上，我们部署SP推理以匹配Blackwell GPU上的速度，同时量化的KV缓存可以降低SP的GPU间通信。实验显示训练速度提升高达2.15倍，推理速度提升1.84倍。LongLive-2.0-5B实现了45.7 FPS推理，并在基准测试上取得了强劲的性能。据我们所知，LongLive-2.0是首个用于长视频生成的NVFP4训练和推理系统。

Abstract

We present LongLive-2.0, an NVFP4-based parallel infrastructure throughout the full training and inference workflow of long video generation, addressing speed and memory bottlenecks. For training, we introduce sequence-parallel autoregressive (AR) training, instantiated as Balanced SP, which co-designs the efficient teacher-forcing layout with SP execution by pairing clean-history and noisy-target temporal chunks on each rank, enabling a natural teacher-forcing mask with SP-aware chunked VAE encoding. Combined with NVFP4 precision, it reduces GPU memory cost and accelerates GEMM computation during training, the proportion of which increases as video length grows. Moreover, we show that a high-quality infrastructure and dataset enable a remarkably clean training pipeline. Unlike existing Self-Forcing series methods that rely on ODE initialization and subsequent distribution matching distillation (DMD), LongLive-2.0 directly tunes a diffusion model into a long, multi-shot, interactive auto-regressive (AR) diffusion model. It can be further converted to real-time generation (4 to 2 denoising steps) with standalone LoRA weights. For inference on Blackwell GPUs, we enable W4A4 NVFP4 inference, quantize KV cache into NVFP4 for memory savings, and boost end-to-end throughput with asynchronous streaming VAE decoding. On non-Blackwell GPU architectures, we deploy SP inference to match the speed on Blackwell GPUs, while the quantized KV cache can lower inter-GPU communication of SP. Experiments show up to 2.15x speedup in training, and 1.84x in inference. LongLive-2.0-5B achieves 45.7 FPS inference while attaining strong performance on benchmarks. To our knowledge, LongLive-2.0 is the first NVFP4 training and inference system for long video generation.

item.title: Actionable World Representation
item.author: Kunqi Xu, Jitao Li, Jianglong Ye, Tianshu Tang, Isabella Liu, Sifei Liu, Xueyan Zou
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为WorldString的神经架构，旨在通过直接从点云或RGB-D视频流学习来建模真实世界对象的状态流形，作为物理世界模型的基础构建块。

背景: 受大语言模型中涌现的人类智能行为启发，研究社区正在追求世界模型中的类似涌现能力，特别强调对物理世界的建模。在物理世界模型的范围内，对象是构成物理现实的基本原语，它们是可操作的实体，具有由内在属性决定的多种状态。

目的: 为了构建可操作的对象表示，本文旨在通过统一且原则性的方式显式地建模这一基本元素，以解决当前方法通过视频生成或动态场景重建来处理对象动作状态的问题。

方法: 提出了一种名为WorldString的神经架构，该架构能够通过直接从点云或RGB-D视频流学习来建模真实世界对象的状态流形。

主要发现: WorldString作为一个通用的数字孪生，作为物理世界模型的基础构建块，其完全可微分的结构无缝地支持与策略学习和神经动力学的未来集成。

结论: WorldString为构建物理世界模型提供了一个有效的解决方案，能够统一且原则性地建模可操作对象的状态。

翻译: 受大语言模型中涌现的人类智能行为启发，研究社区正在追求世界模型中的类似涌现能力，特别强调对物理世界的建模。在物理世界模型的范围内，对象是构成物理现实的基本原语，从人类到计算机，我们几乎接触的一切都是对象。这些对象很少是静态的；它们是可操作的实体，具有由内在属性决定的多种状态。虽然当前方法通过视频生成或动态场景重建来处理对象动作状态，但没有任何方法显式地以统一、原则性的方式建模这一基本元素来构建可操作的对象表示。我们提出了WorldString，一种神经架构，能够通过直接从点云或RGB-D视频流学习来建模真实世界对象的状态流形。作为通用的数字孪生，它作为物理世界模型的基础构建块；因此，我们将其命名为WorldString。令人高兴的是，其完全可微分的结构无缝地支持与策略学习和神经动力学的未来集成。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Inspired by the emergent behaviors in large language models that generalized human intelligence, the research community is pursuing similar emergent capabilities within world models, with a emphasis on modeling the physical world. Within the scope of physical world model, objects are the fundamental primitives that constitute physical reality. From humans to computers, nearly everything we interact with is an object. These objects are rarely static; they are actionable entities with varying states determined by their intrinsic properties. While current methods approach object action states either via video generation or dynamic scene reconstruction, none explicitly model this basic element in a unified, principled way to build an actionable object representation. We propose WorldString, a neural architecture capable of modeling the state manifold of real-world objects by learning directly from point clouds or RGB-D video streams. Serving as a versatile digital twin, it acts as a foundational building block for physical world models; thus, we name it WorldString. Sweetly, its fully differentiable structure seamlessly enables future integration with policy learning and neural dynamics.

item.title: Code as Agent Harness
item.author: Ning, Xuying, Tieu, Katherine, Fu, Dongqi, Wei, Tianxin, Li, Zihao, Bei, Yuanchen, Zou, Jiaru, Ai, Mengting, Liu, Zhining, Li, Ting-Wei, Chen, Lingjie, Zhao, Yanjun, Yang, Ke, Li, Bingxuan, Qian, Cheng, Li, Gaotang, Lin, Xiao, Zeng, Zhichen, Qiu, Ruizhong, Chen, Sirui, Sun, Yifan, Yang, Xiyuan, Wang, Ruida, Pan, Rui, Yang, Chenyuan, Zhang, Dylan, Fang, Liri, Cui, Zikun, Cao, Yang, Chen, Pan, Sun, Dorothy, Chen, Ren, Srinivasan, Mahesh, Mathur, Nipun, Xia, Yinglong, Li, Hong, Yan, Hong, Lu, Pan, Zhang, Lingming, Zhang, Tong, Tong, Hanghang, He, Jingrui
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文综述了代码作为代理系统基础设施的新视角，将代码视为代理系统的核心基础。

背景: 大型语言模型在代码理解和生成方面展现出强大能力，代码在代理系统中正从目标输出转变为推理、行动和环境建模的操作基础。

目的: 通过代理工具的视角，将代码框架化为代理工具，系统地研究代码作为代理基础设施的视角。

方法: 围绕三个连接的层面组织综述：1. 工具接口；2. 工具机制（规划、记忆、工具使用及反馈驱动控制）；3. 从单代理到多代理系统的扩展。

主要发现: 总结了代码作为代理工具的代表方法及其实际应用，包括编码助手、GUI/OS自动化、具身代理、科学发现、个性化推荐、DevOps和企业工作流程。

结论: 本文提供了通往可执行、可验证和有状态AI代理系统的统一路线图，并指出了工具工程面临的开放挑战。

翻译: 大型语言模型在代码理解和生成方面展现出强大能力，从竞争性编程到仓库级软件工程。在新兴的代理系统中，代码不再仅仅是目标输出。它越来越多地作为代理推理、行动、环境建模和基于执行的验证的操作基础。我们从代理工具的视角构建了这一转变，并引入代码作为代理工具：一个将代码作为代理基础设施基础的统一视图。为了系统地研究这一视角，我们围绕三个连接的层面组织综述。首先，我们研究工具接口，代码在此连接代理与推理、行动和环境建模。其次，我们检查工具机制：用于长期执行的规划、记忆和工具使用，以及使工具可靠和自适应的反馈驱动的控制和优化。第三，我们讨论从单代理系统到多代理设置扩展工具，其中共享代码工件支持多代理协调、审查和验证。在这些层面中，我们总结了代码作为代理工具的代表方法和实际应用，包括编码助手、GUI/OS自动化、具身代理、科学发现、个性化和推荐、DevOps和企业工作流程。我们进一步概述了工具工程的开放挑战，包括超越最终任务成功的评估、在反馈不完整下的验证、无回归的工具改进、多个代理之间的一致共享状态、安全关键行动的人工监督以及向多模态环境的扩展。通过将代码作为代理AI的工具置于中心，本综述提供了通往可执行、可验证和有状态的AI代理系统的统一路线图。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Recent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding and generating code, from competitive programming to repository-level software engineering. In emerging agentic systems, code is no longer only a target output. It increasingly serves as an operational substrate for agent reasoning, acting, environment modeling, and execution-based verification. We frame this shift through the lens of agent harnesses and introduce code as agent harness: a unified view that centers code as the basis for agent infrastructure. To systematically study this perspective, we organize the survey around three connected layers. First, we study the harness interface, where code connects agents to reasoning, action, and environment modeling. Second, we examine harness mechanisms: planning, memory, and tool use for long-horizon execution, together with feedback-driven control and optimization that make harness reliable and adaptive. Third, we discuss scaling the harness from single-agent systems to multi-agent settings, where shared code artifacts support multi-agent coordination, review, and verification. Across these layers, we summarize representative methods and practical applications of code as agent harness, spanning coding assistants, GUI/OS automation, embodied agents, scientific discovery, personalization and recommendation, DevOps, and enterprise workflows. We further outline open challenges for harness engineering, including evaluation beyond final task success, verification under incomplete feedback, regression-free harness improvement, consistent shared state across multiple agents, human oversight for safety-critical actions, and extensions to multimodal environments. By centering code as the harness of agentic AI, this survey provides a unified roadmap toward executable, verifiable, and stateful AI agent systems.

item.title: Can These Views Be One Scene? Evaluating Multiview 3D Consistency when 3D Foundation Models Hallucinate
item.author: Soumava Paul, Prakhar Kaushik, Alan Yuille
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究多视图3D评估的可靠性问题，提出了一种基于COLMAP的度量方法，在多视图3D一致性方面表现出更高的鲁棒性。

背景: 现有的多视图3D评估假设输入是静态3D场景的观测，但在非视点合成和稀疏视图重建中，该假设可能失效。现有的基于参考的度量需要真值，而真值自由的度量如MEt3R依赖于学习到的重建骨干网络，其失败模式描述不佳。

目的: 研究神经重建先验与经典几何验证的可靠性问题，并提出一种受控的鲁棒性基准。

方法: 引入了一个受控的鲁棒性基准，该基准将神经度量分解为骨干网络、残差和聚合组件。还提出了基于COLMAP的度量，使用匹配、配准、密集支持和重建失败作为失败感知的一致性信号。

主要发现: VGGT、MASt3R、DUSt3R和Fast3R可以在无关场景、重复图像和随机噪声上产生密集几何和跨视图支持。提出的基于COLMAP的度量在真实NVS输出和结构化人类研究中，与人类判断的相关性比MEt3R高4倍。

结论: 基于COLMAP的度量方法在多视图3D一致性评估中表现出更高的鲁棒性和准确性。

翻译: Multiview 3D evaluation assumes that the images being scored are observations of one static 3D scene. This assumption can fail in NVS and sparse-view reconstruction: inputs or generated outputs may contain artifacts, outlier frames, repeated views, or noise, yet still receive high 3D consistency scores. Existing reference-based metrics require ground truth, while ground-truth-free metrics such as MEt3R depend on learned reconstruction backbones whose failure modes are poorly characterized. We study this reliability problem by comparing neural reconstruction priors with classical geometric verification. We introduce enchmark, a controlled robustness benchmark for multiview 3D consistency, and a parametric family that decomposes neural metrics into backbone, residual, and aggregation components. This family recovers MEt3R and yields variants up to $3imes$ more robust. Our analysis shows that VGGT, MASt3R, DUSt3R, and Fast3R can hallucinate dense geometry and cross-view support for unrelated scenes, repeated images, and random noise. We introduce COLMAP-based metrics that use matches, registration, dense support, and reconstruction failure as failure-aware consistency signals. On real NVS outputs and a structured human study, these metrics achieve up to $4imes$ higher correlation with human judgments than MEt3R.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要关注 3D 基础模型在生成多个视图时，这些视图在 3D 空间中是否保持一致，即它们是否能构成一个真实的场景。这很重要，因为 3D 基础模型经常产生幻觉，如果不检查一致性，就无法确保生成内容的真实性和可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 输入文本仅包含PDF元数据和结构信息，未提供论文的具体内容、创新点或与之前工作的比较细节。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文主要研究如何评估多视图3D一致性，特别是在3D基础模型产生幻觉的情况下。

Abstract

Multiview 3D evaluation assumes that the images being scored are observations of one static 3D scene. This assumption can fail in NVS and sparse-view reconstruction: inputs or generated outputs may contain artifacts, outlier frames, repeated views, or noise, yet still receive high 3D consistency scores. Existing reference-based metrics require ground truth, while ground-truth-free metrics such as MEt3R depend on learned reconstruction backbones whose failure modes are poorly characterized. We study this reliability problem by comparing neural reconstruction priors with classical geometric verification. We introduce \benchmark, a controlled robustness benchmark for multiview 3D consistency, and a parametric family that decomposes neural metrics into backbone, residual, and aggregation components. This family recovers MEt3R and yields variants up to $3\times$ more robust. Our analysis shows that VGGT, MASt3R, DUSt3R, and Fast3R can hallucinate dense geometry and cross-view support for unrelated scenes, repeated images, and random noise. We introduce COLMAP-based metrics that use matches, registration, dense support, and reconstruction failure as failure-aware consistency signals. On real NVS outputs and a structured human study, these metrics achieve up to $4\times$ higher correlation with human judgments than MEt3R.

item.title: Steered LLM Activations are Non-Surjective
item.author: Mishra, Aayush, Khashabi, Daniel, Liu, Anqi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了激活引导作为一种白盒控制技术，探讨了其行为是否可以通过文本提示实现。研究证明在实用假设下，激活引导会将残差流推离离散提示可到达的状态流形，几乎不可能找到能重现引导行为的提示。研究还通过三个常用大语言模型进行了实证验证。

背景: 激活引导是一种流行的白盒控制技术，用于修改模型激活以引发行为的抽象变化。它在可解释性研究和安全研究中已成为标准工具，例如探测真实性或将激活转化为人类可读的解释。

目的: 研究对于固定模型，是否每个被引导的激活都能在其自然前向传播下找到原像，即是否每个被引导的行为都能通过文本提示实现。

方法: 将此问题视为一个满射问题，在实用假设下证明激活引导会将残差流推离离散提示可到达的状态流形。并在三个广泛使用的大语言模型上进行了实证研究。

主要发现: 几乎不可能找到能重现引导行为的提示，即白盒引导行为与黑盒提示行为之间存在形式上的分离。

结论: 不应将激活引导的容易程度和成功性作为基于提示的可解释性或脆弱性的证据，并主张评估协议应明确分离白盒和黑盒干预。

翻译: 激活引导是一种流行的白盒控制技术，通过修改模型激活来引发行为的抽象变化。它在可解释性（例如探测真实性，或将激活转化为人类可读的解释）和安全研究（例如越狱能力）中已成为标准工具。然而，尚不清楚引导的行为是否可以通过任何文本提示实现。在这项工作中，我们将这个问题视为一个满射问题：对于固定模型，每个被引导的激活在其模型的自然前向传播下是否都存在原像？在实用假设下，我们证明激活引导将残差流推离离散提示可到达的状态流形。几乎不可能找到能重现引导行为的提示。我们还在三个广泛使用的大语言模型上说明了这一发现。我们的结果确立了白盒引导能力和黑盒提示之间的形式分离。因此，我们警告不要将激活引导的容易程度和成功性作为基于提示的可解释性或脆弱性的证据，并主张评估协议应明确分离白盒和黑盒干预。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文指出，通过引导大语言模型的激活函数，无法覆盖所有可能的状态，即激活函数是非满射的。

Abstract

Activation steering is a popular white-box control technique that modifies model activations to elicit an abstract change in its behavior. It has also become a standard tool in interpretability (e.g., probing truthfulness, or translating activations into human-readable explanations) and safety research (e.g., jailbreakability). However, it is unclear whether steered behavior is realizable by any textual prompt. In this work, we cast this question as a surjectivity problem: for a fixed model, does every steered activation admit a preimage under the model's natural forward pass? Under practical assumptions, we prove that activation steering pushes the residual stream off the manifold of states reachable from discrete prompts. Almost surely, no prompt can reproduce the same internal behavior induced by steering. We also illustrate this finding empirically across three widely used LLMs. Our results establish a formal separation between white-box steerability and black-box prompting. We therefore caution against interpreting the ease and success of activation steering as evidence of prompt-based interpretability or vulnerability, and argue for evaluation protocols that explicitly decouple white-box and black-box interventions.

item.title: Vision-Based Safe Human-Robot Collaboration with Uncertainty Guarantees
item.author: Jakob Thumm, Marian Frei, Tianle Ni, Matthias Althoff, Marco Pavone
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于视觉的人体姿态估计和运动预测框架，为可验证安全的人机协作提供保证。

背景: 为了实现可验证安全的人机协作，需要对人体运动预测提供概率置信度保证。

目的: 构建一个结合随机不确定性估计和OOD检测的框架，以实现高概率置信度，并提出用于人体运动预测的符合预测集。

方法: 将随机不确定性估计与OOD检测相结合，提出符合预测集来集成到可验证的安全框架中。

主要发现: 在记录的人体运动数据和真实的人机协作环境中评估了该管道。

结论: 该框架能够为可验证安全的人机协作提供概率置信度保证。

翻译: 我们提出了一种基于视觉的人体姿态估计和运动预测框架，为可验证安全的人机协作提供概率置信度保证。我们的框架结合了随机不确定性估计和OOD检测以实现高概率置信度。为了将我们的管道集成到可验证的安全框架中，我们提出了用于人体运动预测的高置信度、有效的符合预测集。我们在记录的人体运动数据和真实的人机协作环境中评估了我们的管道。

Abstract

We propose a framework for vision-based human pose estimation and motion prediction that gives conformal prediction guarantees for certifiably safe human-robot collaboration. Our framework combines aleatoric uncertainty estimation with OOD detection for high probabilistic confidence. To integrate our pipeline in certifiable safety frameworks, we propose conformal prediction sets for human motion predictions with high, valid confidence. We evaluate our pipeline on recorded human motion data and a real-world human-robot collaboration setting.

item.title: Distilling Long-CoT Reasoning through Collaborative Step-wise Multi-Teacher Decoding
item.author: Yun, Taewon, Shin, Jisu, Choi, Jeonghwan, Bang, Seunghwan, Song, Hwanjun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CoRD是一个协作多教师解码框架，通过预测困惑度评分和束搜索进行逐步推理合成，使异构大推理模型能够共同构建连贯的推理轨迹，同时高效保留多样化的高潜力假设。

背景: 蒸馏大推理模型对于使长链式推理变得实用至关重要，因为全规模推理在计算上仍然不可行。现有的基于策划的方法在事后选择完整的推理轨迹，忽略了异构教师之间的协作，缺乏动态探索，导致冗余采样和遗漏互补推理。

目的: 引入CoRD，一个协作多教师解码框架，通过预测困惑度评分和束搜索指导逐步推理合成，使异构大推理模型能够共同构建连贯的推理轨迹，同时高效保留多样化的高潜力假设。

方法: CoRD是一个协作多教师解码框架，它执行逐步推理合成，由基于预测困惑度的评分和束搜索引导。这使异构大推理模型能够共同构建连贯的推理轨迹，同时高效保留多样化的高潜力假设。

主要发现: 实验表明，CoRD产生更高质量的推理数据，并以更少、结构化的监督信号实现了接近教师水平的学生性能，没有实质性的效率开销。CoRD进一步很好地推广到域外和开放式设置。

结论: CoRD产生更高质量的推理数据，并以更少、结构化的监督信号实现了接近教师水平的性能，没有实质性的效率开销。CoRD进一步很好地推广到域外和开放式设置。

Abstract

Distilling large reasoning models is essential for making Long-CoT reasoning practical, as full-scale inference remains computationally prohibitive. Existing curation-based approaches select complete reasoning traces post-hoc, overlooking collaboration among heterogeneous teachers and lacking dynamic exploration, which leads to redundant sampling and missed complementary reasoning. We introduce CoRD, a collaborative multi-teacher decoding framework that performs step-wise reasoning synthesis guided by predictive perplexity-based scoring and beam search. This enables heterogeneous LRMs to jointly construct coherent reasoning trajectories while efficiently preserving diverse, high-potential hypotheses. Experiments show that CoRD produces higher-quality reasoning data and achieves near teacher-level student performance with fewer, structured supervision signals, without substantial efficiency overhead. CoRD further generalizes well to out-of-domain and open-ended settings. The dataset and model are available at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

item.title: DiagnosticIQ: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Industrial Maintenance Action Recommendation from Symbolic Rules
item.author: De Silva, Devin Yasith, Patel, Dhaval, Constantinides, Christodoulos, Lin, Shuxin, Zhou, Nianjun, Adams, Paul J, Rosato, Sal, Constantinides, Nicolas, McGuinness, Deborah L., Kalagnanam, Jayant
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了大型语言模型在工业资产维护决策支持中的应用，通过构建了一个包含6690道专家验证多选题的基准数据集，评估了29个LLM和4个嵌入基线模型的表现。研究发现模型在处理结构扰动时存在脆弱性，且部署瓶颈在于校准而非能力。

背景: 工业资产维护依赖于工程师编写的符号规则，这些规则基于传感器条件触发并提示技术人员执行纠正措施。瓶颈不在于检测而在于响应：将规则翻译成维护步骤需要通过多年实践获得的特定资产知识。

目的: 调查LLMs是否能作为规则到动作步骤的决策支持工具。

方法: 提出了ours基准数据集，包含来自16种资产类型的118个规则-动作对的6690道专家验证多选题。贡献包括：(i) 符号到多选题管道，将规则归一化为析取范式并基于嵌入生成干扰项；(ii) 五种变体以探测不同故障模式；(iii) 29个LLM和4个嵌入基线的基准。

主要发现: 前沿模型已接近：前三名LLM在宏点数上相差不到1分。ours-Pro暴露了脆弱性，所有模型在干扰项扩展下相对准确率下降13-60%。ours-Aug暴露了模式匹配：在条件反转下，前沿模型仍有49-63%的时间选择原始答案。部署瓶颈不在于能力而在于校准：前沿模型能处理模板式故障检测但在结构扰动下失效。

结论: ours基准需要超越操作经验的专家知识。模型在处理结构扰动时存在脆弱性，部署瓶颈在于校准而非能力。

翻译: 监控复杂工业资产依赖于工程师编写的符号规则，这些规则基于传感器条件触发并提示技术人员执行纠正措施。瓶颈不在于检测而在于响应：将规则翻译成维护步骤需要通过多年实践获得的特定资产知识。我们调查了LLMs是否能作为规则到动作步骤的决策支持工具，并引入ours基准，包含来自16种资产类型的118个规则-动作对的6690道专家验证多选题。我们贡献了(i)符号到多选题管道，将规则归一化为析取范式并基于嵌入生成干扰项；(ii)五种变体以探测不同故障模式；(iii)29个LLM和4个嵌入基线的基准。一项人工评估（9名从业者，平均准确率45.0%）确认ours需要超越操作经验的专家知识。三个发现脱颖而出。前沿已关闭：前三名LLM在宏点数上相差不到1分，Bradley-Terry Elo将claude-opus-4-6排在第二名模型之上30分。然而ours-Pro暴露了脆弱性，所有模型在干扰项扩展下相对准确率下降13-60%。ours-Aug暴露了模式匹配：在条件反转下，前沿模型仍有49-63%的时间选择原始答案。部署瓶颈不在于能力而在于校准：前沿模型能处理模板式故障检测但在结构扰动下失效。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一个名为 DiagnosticIQ 的基准数据集，旨在评估大语言模型在工业维护场景中，基于符号规则推荐维护行动的能力。

Abstract

Monitoring complex industrial assets relies on engineer-authored symbolic rules that trigger based on sensor conditions and prompt technicians to perform corrective actions. The bottleneck is not detection but response: translating rules into maintenance steps requires asset-specific knowledge gained through years of practice. We investigate whether LLMs can serve as decision support for this rule-to-action step and introduce \ours{}, a benchmark of 6{,}690 expert-validated multiple-choice questions from 118 rule-action pairs across 16 asset types. We contribute (i) a symbolic-to-MCQA pipeline normalizing rules to Disjunctive Normal Form with embedding-based distractor sampling, (ii) five variants probing distinct failure modes (Pro, Pert, Verbose, Aug, Rationale), and (iii) a benchmark of 29 LLMs and 4 embedding baselines. A human evaluation (9 practitioners, mean 45.0\%) confirms \ours{} requires specialist knowledge beyond operational experience. Three findings stand out. The frontier has closed: the top three LLMs lie within one Macro point, with Bradley-Terry Elo placing claude-opus-4-6 30 points above the next model. Yet \ours{}\,Pro exposes brittleness, with every model losing 13--60\% relative accuracy under distractor expansion. \ours{}\,Aug exposes pattern-matching: under condition inversion, frontier models still select the original answer 49--63\% of the time. The deployment bottleneck is not capability but calibration: frontier models handle template-style fault detection but break under structural perturbation.

item.title: Follow the Mean: Reference-Guided Flow Matching
item.author: Curvo, Pedro M. P., Zhdanov, Maksim, Eijkelboom, Floor, van de Meent, Jan-Willem
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于流匹配的可控生成新方法，通过示例调整而非微调或测试时搜索来控制生成过程。

背景: 现有的可控生成方法通常依赖于微调、辅助网络或测试时搜索。

目的: 展示流匹配具有不同的控制接口：通过示例进行适应。

方法: 提出了两种形式：Reference-Mean Guidance（无需训练，通过参考集计算端点均值修正）和 Semi-Parametric Guidance（通过显式均值锚点和学习残差细化器）。

主要发现: 对于确定性插值，速度场仅由条件端点均值控制；改变均值即可改变流；Reference-Mean Guidance在保持提示、种子和权重不变的情况下实现了对颜色、身份、风格和结构的控制；Semi-Parametric Guidance在AFHQv2上匹配了无条件DiT-B/4的质量。

结论: 生成模型可以通过数据而非参数更新来适应；这指向了一个更广泛的方向。

翻译: 现有的可控生成方法通常依赖于微调、辅助网络或测试时搜索。我们展示了流匹配具有不同的控制接口：通过示例进行适应。对于确定性插值，速度场仅由条件端点均值控制；改变均值即可改变流。这产生了一个简单的可控生成原则：通过改变预训练模型所遵循的参考集来引导它。我们在两种形式中实现了这一想法。Reference-Mean Guidance是无训练的：它从参考库计算闭式端点均值修正，并将其应用于冻结的FLUX.2-klein（4B）模型，在保持提示、种子和权重不变的情况下实现了对颜色、身份、风格和结构的控制。Semi-Parametric Guidance通过显式均值锚点和学习残差细化器分摊了相同的想法，在AFHQv2上匹配了无条件DiT-B/4的质量，同时允许在推理时交换参考集。这些结果指向了一个更广泛的方向：通过数据而非参数更新来适应的生成模型。

Abstract

Existing approaches to controllable generation typically rely on fine-tuning, auxiliary networks, or test-time search. We show that flow matching admits a different control interface: adaptation through examples. For deterministic interpolants, the velocity field is solely governed by a conditional endpoint mean; shifting this mean shifts the flow itself. This yields a simple principle for controllable generation: steer a pretrained model by changing the reference set it follows. We instantiate this idea in two forms. Reference-Mean Guidance is training-free: it computes a closed-form endpoint-mean correction from a reference bank and applies it to a frozen FLUX.2-klein (4B) model, enabling control of color, identity, style, and structure while keeping the prompt, seed, and weights fixed. Semi-Parametric Guidance amortizes the same idea through an explicit mean anchor and learned residual refiner, matching unconditional DiT-B/4 quality on AFHQv2 while allowing the reference set to be swapped at inference time. These results point to a broader direction: generative models that adapt through data, not parameter updates.

item.title: Learning to Foresee: Unveiling the Unlocking Efficiency of On-Policy Distillation
item.author: Cai, Yuchen, Cao, Ding, Lin, Liang, Luo, Chunxi, Xu, Xin, Yang, Kai, Liu, Weijie, Yang, Saiyong, Zhao, Tianxiang, Sun, Guangzhong, Liu, Guiquan, Fang, Junfeng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了基于策略蒸馏（OPD）在大型语言模型中的高效性，并提出了EffOPD方法以加速训练。

背景: 现有研究主要将OPD的优势归因于更密集和稳定的监督，但OPD效率背后的参数级机制理解不足。

目的: 研究OPD效率的来源，提出EffOPD方法以加速OPD训练。

方法: 通过分析模块分配层面和更新方向层面，提出EffOPD方法，该方法通过自适应选择外推步长并沿当前更新方向移动来加速训练。

主要发现: OPD的效率源于一种‘前瞻性’：它建立了通往最终模型的稳定更新轨迹。具体表现为在模块分配层面识别低边际效用区域并集中更新；在更新方向层面表现出更强的低秩集中性。

结论: EffOPD无需额外可训练模块或复杂超参数调整，平均训练加速达三倍，同时保持可比的最终性能。

翻译: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for large language models. However, existing studies largely attribute this advantage to denser and more stable supervision, while the parameter-level mechanisms underlying OPD's efficiency remain poorly understood. In this work, we argue that OPD's efficiency stems from a form of ``foresight'': it establishes a stable update trajectory toward the final model early in training. This foresight manifests in two aspects. First, at the Module-Allocation Level, OPD identifies regions with low marginal utility and concentrates updates on modules that are more critical to reasoning. Second, at the Update-Direction Level, OPD exhibits stronger low-rank concentration, with its dominant subspaces aligning closely with the final update subspace early in training. Building on these findings, we propose EffOPD, a plug-and-play acceleration method that speeds up OPD by adaptively selecting an extrapolation step size and moving along the current update direction. EffOPD requires no additional trainable modules or complex hyperparameter tuning, and achieves an average training acceleration of 3x while maintaining comparable final performance. Overall, our findings provide a parameter-dynamics perspective for understanding the efficiency of OPD and offer practical insights for designing more efficient post-training methods for large language models.

Abstract

On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for large language models. However, existing studies largely attribute this advantage to denser and more stable supervision, while the parameter-level mechanisms underlying OPD's efficiency remain poorly understood. In this work, we argue that OPD's efficiency stems from a form of ``foresight'': it establishes a stable update trajectory toward the final model early in training. This foresight manifests in two aspects. First, at the \textbf{Module-Allocation Level}, OPD identifies regions with low marginal utility and concentrates updates on modules that are more critical to reasoning. Second, at the \textbf{Update-Direction Level}, OPD exhibits stronger low-rank concentration, with its dominant subspaces aligning closely with the final update subspace early in training. Building on these findings, we propose \textbf{EffOPD}, a plug-and-play acceleration method that speeds up OPD by adaptively selecting an extrapolation step size and moving along the current update direction. EffOPD requires no additional trainable modules or complex hyperparameter tuning, and achieves an average training acceleration of $3\times$ while maintaining comparable final performance. Overall, our findings provide a parameter-dynamics perspective for understanding the efficiency of OPD and offer practical insights for designing more efficient post-training methods for large language models.

item.title: OmniHumanoid: Streaming Cross-Embodiment Video Generation with Paired-Free Adaptation
item.author: Song, Yiren, Deng, Xiyao, Yang, Pei, Wang, Yihan, Shou, Mike Zheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OmniHumanoid是一个跨具身视频生成框架，旨在通过学习可转移的运动和适应特定具身，实现跨不同人形机器人的运动迁移。

背景: 跨具身视频生成面临的主要挑战是运动动力学部分可转移，而外观和形态具有特定性。现有方法常混淆这些因素，且许多需要每具身配对数据，限制了扩展性。

目的: 提出OmniHumanoid框架，将可转移的运动学习和特定具身的适应进行解耦，以实现可扩展的数据生成。

方法: 通过轻量级特定具身适配器，仅使用未配对视频从跨具身的配对视频中学习共享运动模型。引入分支隔离注意力设计以减少运动迁移和具身适应之间的干扰。构建了包含多样化人形资产、场景和视角的合成跨具身数据集。

主要发现: 在合成和现实世界基准测试中，OmniHumanoid实现了高运动保真度和具身一致性，能够在不重新训练共享运动模型的情况下，实现对新未见人形具身的可扩展适应。

结论: OmniHumanoid通过解耦运动学习和具身适应，有效解决了跨具身视频生成中的挑战，实现了高效且可扩展的运动迁移。

翻译: Cross-embodiment video generation aims to transfer motions across different humanoid embodiments, such as human-to-robot and robot-to-robot, enabling scalable data generation for embodied intelligence. A major challenge in this setting is that motion dynamics are partly transferable across embodiments, whereas appearance and morphology remain embodiment-specific. Existing approaches often entangle these factors, and many require paired data for every target embodiment, which limits scalability to new robots. We present OmniHumanoid, a framework that factorizes transferable motion learning and embodiment-specific adaptation. Our method learns a shared motion transfer model from motion-aligned paired videos spanning multiple embodiments, while adapting to a new embodiment using only unpaired videos through lightweight embodiment-specific adapters. To reduce interference between motion transfer and embodiment adaptation, we further introduce a branch-isolated attention design that separates motion conditioning from embodiment-specific modulation. In addition, we construct a synthetic cross-embodiment dataset with motion-aligned paired videos rendered across diverse humanoid assets, scenes, and viewpoints. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that OmniHumanoid achieves strong motion fidelity and embodiment consistency, while enabling scalable adaptation to unseen humanoid embodiments without retraining the shared motion model.

Abstract

Cross-embodiment video generation aims to transfer motions across different humanoid embodiments, such as human-to-robot and robot-to-robot, enabling scalable data generation for embodied intelligence. A major challenge in this setting is that motion dynamics are partly transferable across embodiments, whereas appearance and morphology remain embodiment-specific. Existing approaches often entangle these factors, and many require paired data for every target embodiment, which limits scalability to new robots. We present OmniHumanoid, a framework that factorizes transferable motion learning and embodiment-specific adaptation. Our method learns a shared motion transfer model from motion-aligned paired videos spanning multiple embodiments, while adapting to a new embodiment using only unpaired videos through lightweight embodiment-specific adapters. To reduce interference between motion transfer and embodiment adaptation, we further introduce a branch-isolated attention design that separates motion conditioning from embodiment-specific modulation. In addition, we construct a synthetic cross-embodiment dataset with motion-aligned paired videos rendered across diverse humanoid assets, scenes, and viewpoints. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that OmniHumanoid achieves strong motion fidelity and embodiment consistency, while enabling scalable adaptation to unseen humanoid embodiments without retraining the shared motion model.

item.title: H\"older Policy Optimisation
item.author: Chen, Yuxiang, Liang, Dingli, Chen, Yihang, Gong, Ziqin, Le, Chenyang, Wang, Zhaokai, Zhu, Jiachen, Yang, Lingyu, Lin, Jianghao, Zhang, Weinan, Wang, Jun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HölderPO通过动态调节Hölder均值参数p，在训练过程中平衡梯度集中度和方差，从而提升大语言模型在数学和交互任务上的性能。

背景: 现有的Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO)算法在将轨迹级优势映射到策略更新时，依赖于固定的token级概率聚合机制，这限制了算法的适应性。

目的: 提出HölderPO框架，通过统一token级概率聚合来优化策略，解决梯度集中度与方差之间的权衡问题。

方法: HölderPO利用Hölder均值进行概率聚合，通过动态调节参数p来控制梯度集中度和方差。训练过程中采用动态退火算法逐步调整p值。

主要发现: HölderPO在多个数学基准测试中实现了54.9%的平均准确率，比标准GRPO提高了7.2%，在ALFWorld上达到了93.8%的成功率。

结论: HölderPO在稳定性和收敛性上优于现有基线，证明了动态调节聚合参数能有效解决梯度集中度与稳定性的权衡问题。

翻译: Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO)通过估计一组采样轨迹的优势来增强大型语言模型。然而，将这些轨迹级优势映射到策略更新需要聚合每个序列内的token级概率。依赖此步骤的固定聚合机制从根本上限制了算法的适应性。经验上，我们观察到关键的权衡：某些固定聚合经常遭受训练崩溃，而其他聚合则无法产生令人满意的表现。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了HölderPO，一个通过Hölder均值统一token级概率聚合的通用策略优化框架。通过显式调节参数p，我们的框架为梯度集中度和方差界限之间的权衡提供了连续控制。理论上，我们证明了较大的p能集中梯度以放大稀疏学习信号，而较小的p严格限制梯度方差。由于没有静态配置能普遍解决这种集中度-稳定性权衡，我们实例化了一个动态退火算法框架，该算法在训练生命周期中逐步调度p。广泛的评估表明，与现有基线相比具有卓越的稳定性和收敛性。具体来说，我们的方法在多个数学基准测试中实现了54.9%的最先进平均准确率，比标准GRPO提高了7.2%的相对增益，并在ALFWorld上取得了93.8%的卓越成功率。

Abstract

Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) enhances large language models by estimating advantages across a group of sampled trajectories. However, mapping these trajectory-level advantages to policy updates requires aggregating token-level probabilities within each sequence. Relying on a fixed aggregation mechanism for this step fundamentally limits the algorithm's adaptability. Empirically, we observe a critical trade-off: certain fixed aggregations frequently suffer from training collapse, while others fail to yield satisfactory performance. To resolve this, we propose \textbf{HölderPO}, a generalised policy optimisation framework unifying token-level probability aggregation via the Hölder mean. By explicitly modulating the parameter $p$, our framework provides continuous control over the trade-off between gradient concentration and variance bounds. Theoretically, we prove that a larger $p$ concentrates the gradient to amplify sparse learning signals, whereas a smaller $p$ strictly bounds gradient variance. Because no static configuration can universally resolve this concentration-stability trade-off, we instantiate the framework with a dynamic annealing algorithm that progressively schedules $p$ across the training lifecycle. Extensive evaluations demonstrate superior stability and convergence over existing baselines. Specifically, our approach achieves a state-of-the-art average accuracy of $54.9\%$ across multiple mathematical benchmarks, yielding a substantial $7.2\%$ relative gain over standard GRPO and secures an exceptional $93.8\%$ success rate on ALFWorld.

item.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
item.author: Ma, Dongsheng, Li, Jiayu, Wang, Zhengren, Wang, Yijie, Kong, Jiahao, Zeng, Weijun, Xiao, Jutao, Yang, Jie, Zhang, Wentao, Wang, Bin, He, Conghui
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了CiteVQA基准测试，旨在评估多模态大语言模型在文档理解中的引用准确性，通过要求模型返回答案和对应的引用区域来评估模型的表现。

背景: 当前的多模态大语言模型文档理解评估仅关注最终答案，而忽略了支持证据的检查。这种仅关注答案的方法掩盖了一个关键的失败模式：模型可能在错误的段落中找到正确答案，这在法律、金融和医疗等高风险领域是一个重大风险。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，本文引入了CiteVQA基准测试，要求模型在回答问题时返回元素级的边界框引用，并联合评估答案和引用区域。

方法: CiteVQA包含1,897个问题，涵盖711个PDF文档，跨越七个领域和两种语言，平均每份文档40.6页。通过自动化管道生成真实引用（通过掩码消融识别关键证据），并经过专家审查验证。评估核心是严格归属准确度SAA，只有当答案和引用区域都正确时才给予评分。

主要发现: 对20个多模态大语言模型的审计揭示了普遍的归属幻觉：模型经常在引用错误区域的情况下产生正确答案。最强的系统Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview的SAA仅为76.0，最强的开源多模态大语言模型仅达到22.5。

结论: CiteVQA暴露了仅关注答案的评估所忽视的可靠性差距，为缩小这一差距提供了必要的工具，以实现值得信赖的文档智能。

翻译: 多模态大语言模型在文档理解方面取得了显著进展，但当前的文档视觉问答评估仅对最终答案进行评分，而忽略了对支持证据的检查。这种仅关注答案的方法掩盖了一个关键的失败模式：模型可能在错误的段落中找到正确答案——这是法律、金融和医疗等高风险领域的一个重大风险。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了CiteVQA基准测试，要求模型在回答每个问题时返回元素级的边界框引用，并联合评估两者。CiteVQA包含1,897个问题，跨越711个PDF文档，涵盖七个领域和两种语言，平均每份文档40.6页。为了确保保真度和可扩展性，真实引用是通过自动化管道生成的——通过掩码消融识别关键证据——并随后通过专家审查进行验证。我们评估的核心是严格归属准确度SAA，只有当答案和引用区域都正确时才给予评分。对20个多模态大语言模型的审计揭示了普遍的归属幻觉：模型经常在引用错误区域的情况下产生正确答案。最强的系统Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview的SAA仅为76.0，最强的开源多模态大语言模型仅达到22.5。最终，为了实现值得信赖的文档智能，CiteVQA暴露了仅关注答案的评估所忽视的可靠性差距，提供了缩小这一差距所需的工具。我们的仓库可在该https URL处获得。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 由于提供的文本仅包含论文的元数据和目录结构，不包含正文内容，因此无法回答作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的以及是否有借鉴现有工作。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced document understanding, yet current Doc-VQA evaluations score only the final answer and leave the supporting evidence unchecked. This answer-only approach masks a critical failure mode: a model can land on the correct answer while grounding it in the wrong passage -- a critical risk in high-stakes domains like law, finance, and medicine, where every conclusion must be traceable to a specific source region. To address this, we introduce CiteVQA, a benchmark that requires models to return element-level bounding-box citations alongside each answer, evaluating both jointly. CiteVQA comprises 1,897 questions across 711 PDFs spanning seven domains and two languages, averaging 40.6 pages per document. To ensure fidelity and scalability, the ground-truth citations are generated by an automated pipeline-which identifies crucial evidence via masking ablation-and are subsequently validated through expert review. At the core of our evaluation is Strict Attributed Accuracy (SAA), which credits a prediction only when the answer and the cited region are both correct. Auditing 20 MLLMs reveals a pervasive Attribution Hallucination: models frequently produce the right answer while citing the wrong region. The strongest system (Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview) achieves an SAA of only 76.0, and the strongest open-source MLLM reaches just 22.5. Ultimately, towards trustworthy document intelligence, CiteVQA exposes a reliability gap that answer-only evaluations overlook, providing the instrumentation needed to close it. Our repository is available at this https URL .

item.title: PanoWorld: Towards Spatial Supersensing in 360$^\circ$ Panorama World
item.author: Changpeng Wang, Xin Lin, Junhan Liu, Yuheng Liu, Zhen Wang, Donglian Qi, Yunfeng Yan, Xi Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了全景感知模型在全景图理解方面的能力，提出了PanoWorld模型和PanoSpace-Bench基准，通过引入球面空间交叉注意力机制和大规模元数据构建流程，显著提升了模型在全景空间推理任务上的性能。

背景: 现有的多模态大实验室模型（MLLMs）在主导的视角图像范式下难以进行空间理解，因为这种范式继承了人类感知的窄视场。全景360度感知虽然能捕捉整个周围环境，但现有MLLM管道通常将全景图分解为多个视角视图，忽略了等距圆柱投影（ERP）的球面结构。

目的: 研究全景原生的理解能力，要求MLLM能够将ERP全景图作为一个连续的、以观察者为中心的空间进行推理。具体包括定义语义锚定、球面定位、参考系变换和深度感知的3D空间推理等关键能力。

方法: 1. 构建大规模元数据构建流程，将混合来源的ERP全景图转换为几何感知、语言锚定和深度感知的监督信号，并将其实例化为能力对齐的指令微调数据。2. 引入PanoWorld模型，通过球面空间交叉注意力将球面几何注入视觉流。

主要发现: PanoWorld在PanoSpace-Bench、H* Bench和R2R-CE Val-Unseen基准测试中显著优于专有和开源基线模型。

结论: 稳健的全景推理需要专门的全景原生监督和几何感知的模型适应。

翻译: 多模态大型实验室模型（MLLMs）在主导的视角图像范式下仍然难以进行空间理解，因为这种范式继承了人类感知的窄视场。对于导航、机器人搜索和3D场景理解，360度全景感知提供了一种通过一次性捕捉整个周围环境来实现的超感知形式。然而，现有的MLLM管道通常将全景图分解为多个视角视图，使得等距圆柱投影（ERP）的球面结构在很大程度上是隐含的。在本文中，我们研究了全景原生的理解能力，这要求MLLM能够将ERP全景图作为一个连续的、以观察者为中心的空间进行推理。为此，我们首先定义了全景原生理解的关键能力，包括语义锚定、球面定位、参考系变换和深度感知的3D空间推理。然后，我们构建了一个大规模元数据构建流程，将混合来源的ERP全景图转换为几何感知、语言锚定和深度感知的监督，并将这些信号实例化为能力对齐的指令微调数据。在模型方面，我们引入了PanoWorld，它具有球面空间交叉注意力，将球面几何注入视觉流。我们进一步构建了PanoSpace-Bench，这是一个用于评估ERP原生空间推理的诊断基准。实验表明，PanoWorld在PanoSpace-Bench、H* Bench和R2R-CE Val-Unseen基准测试中显著优于专有和开源基线。这些结果证明，稳健的全景推理需要专门的全景原生监督和几何感知的模型适应。所有源代码和提出的数据都将公开发布。

Abstract

Multimodal large laboratory models (MLLMs) still struggle with spatial understanding under the dominant perspective-image paradigm, which inherits the narrow field of view of human-like perception. For navigation, robotic search, and 3D scene understanding, 360-degree panoramic sensing offers a form of supersensing by capturing the entire surrounding environment at once. However, existing MLLM pipelines typically decompose panoramas into multiple perspective views, leaving the spherical structure of equirectangular projection (ERP) largely implicit. In this paper, we study pano-native understanding, which requires an MLLM to reason over an ERP panorama as a continuous, observer-centered space. To this end, we first define the key abilities for pano-native understanding, including semantic anchoring, spherical localization, reference-frame transformation, and depth-aware 3D spatial reasoning. We then build a large-scale metadata construction pipeline that converts mixed-source ERP panoramas into geometry-aware, language-grounded, and depth-aware supervision, and instantiate these signals as capability-aligned instruction tuning data. On the model side, we introduce PanoWorld with Spherical Spatial Cross-Attention, which injects spherical geometry into the visual stream. We further construct PanoSpace-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating ERP-native spatial reasoning. Experiments show that PanoWorld substantially outperforms both proprietary and open-source baselines on PanoSpace-Bench, H* Bench, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen benchmarks. These results demonstrate that robust panoramic reasoning requires dedicated pano-native supervision and geometry-aware model adaptation. All source code and proposed data will be publicly released.

item.title: Granite Embedding Multilingual R2 Models
item.author: Parul Awasthy, Aashka Trivedi, Yushu Yang, Ken Barker, Yulong Li, Bhavani Iyer, Martin Franz, Juergen Bross, Meet Doshi, Vignesh P, Vishwajeet Kumar, Todd Ward, Abraham Daniels, Madison Lee, Luis Lastras, Jaydeep Sen, Radu Florian
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 介绍 Granite Embedding R2 模型家族，支持200多种语言的企业级密集检索

背景: 基于之前仅关注英语的R2发布，扩展了对52种语言和编程代码的支持

目的: 提供跨语言文本搜索、代码检索、长文档搜索和推理检索数据集的最先进性能

方法: 基于ModernBERT架构构建两个双编码器模型，全尺寸311M参数，紧凑型97M参数（通过模型剪枝和词汇选择构建），支持Matryoshka表示学习

主要发现: 紧凑型模型在100M参数以下的多语言嵌入模型中检索得分最高；全尺寸模型支持灵活的嵌入维度

结论: 模型在受监管的企业数据上训练，采用Apache 2.0许可证发布，支持负责任使用和 unrestricted 研究与企业采用

翻译: We introduce the multilingual Granite Embedding R2 models, a family of encoder-based embedding models for enterprise-scale dense retrieval across 200+ languages. Extending our English-focused R2 release, these models add enhanced support for 52 languages and programming code, a 32,768-token context window (a 64x expansion over R1), and state-of-the-art overall performance across multilingual and cross-lingual text search, code retrieval, long-document search, and reasoning retrieval datasets. The release consists of two bi-encoder models based on the ModernBERT architecture with an expanded multilingual vocabulary: a 311M-parameter full-size, and a 97M-parameter compact model built via model pruning and vocabulary selection that achieves the highest retrieval score of any open multilingual embedding model under 100M parameters. The full-size also supports Matryoshka Representation Learning for flexible embedding dimensionality. Both models are trained on enterprise-appropriate data with governance oversight, and released under the Apache 2.0 license at https://huggingface.co/collections/ibm-granite, designed to support responsible use and enable unrestricted research and enterprise adoption.

Abstract

We introduce the multilingual Granite Embedding R2 models, a family of encoder-based embedding models for enterprise-scale dense retrieval across 200+ languages. Extending our English-focused R2 release, these models add enhanced support for 52 languages and programming code, a 32,768-token context window (a 64x expansion over R1), and state-of-the-art overall performance across multilingual and cross-lingual text search, code retrieval, long-document search, and reasoning retrieval datasets. The release consists of two bi-encoder models based on the ModernBERT architecture with an expanded multilingual vocabulary: a 311M-parameter full-size, and a 97M-parameter compact model built via model pruning and vocabulary selection that achieves the highest retrieval score of any open multilingual embedding model under 100M parameters. The full-size also supports Matryoshka Representation Learning for flexible embedding dimensionality. Both models are trained on enterprise-appropriate data with governance oversight, and released under the Apache 2.0 license at https://huggingface.co/collections/ibm-granite, designed to support responsible use and enable unrestricted research and enterprise adoption.

item.title: MMSkills: Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents
item.author: Zhang, Kangning, Shao, Shuai, Li, Qingyao, Lin, Jianghao, Fu, Lingyue, Wang, Shijian, Jiao, Wenxiang, Lu, Yuan, Liu, Weiwen, Zhang, Weinan, Yu, Yong
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了MMSkills框架，旨在解决视觉智能体在复用程序化知识时的挑战，通过将文本程序与运行时状态卡片和多视图关键帧结合，构建可重用的多模态技能包。

背景: 现有的技能包主要编码为文本提示、可执行代码或学习到的例程，而视觉智能体的程序化知识本质上是多模态的，不仅取决于执行什么操作，还取决于识别相关状态、解释视觉证据以及决定下一步行动。

目的: 为了解决三个实际挑战：多模态技能包应包含什么内容、如何从公共交互经验中推导出此类技能包、以及智能体如何在推理时咨询多模态证据而不使用过多图像上下文或过度依赖参考截图。

方法: 提出了MMSkills框架，包括表示、生成和使用可重用多模态程序。每个MMSkill是一个紧凑的、状态条件的包，结合了文本程序、运行时状态卡片和多视图关键帧。构建方法包括轨迹到技能生成器，通过工作流分组、程序归纳、视觉基础和元技能指导审计来转换公共非评估轨迹。使用方法包括分支加载的多模态技能智能体，在临时分支中检查选定的状态卡片和关键帧，与实时环境对齐并提炼为结构化指导。

主要发现: 在GUI和基于游戏的视觉智能体基准测试中，MMSkills一致地提高了前沿和较小的多模态智能体。

结论: 外部多模态程序化知识补充了模型内部先验知识。

翻译: 可重用的技能已成为提高智能体能力的核心基础，然而大多数现有的技能包主要将可重用的行为编码为文本提示、可执行代码或学习到的例程。然而，对于视觉智能体而言，程序化知识本质上是多模态的：复用不仅取决于执行什么操作，还取决于识别相关状态、解释进度或失败的视觉证据，以及决定下一步做什么。我们将这一要求形式化为多模态程序化知识，并解决了三个实际挑战：多模态技能包应包含什么内容、此类技能包可以从公共交互经验中推导出来，以及智能体如何在推理时咨询多模态证据而不使用过多的图像上下文或过度锚定到参考截图。我们介绍了MMSkills，一个用于表示、生成和使用可重用多模态程序以进行运行时视觉决策制定的框架。每个MMSkill是一个紧凑的、状态条件的包，将文本程序与运行时状态卡片和多视图关键帧结合。为了构建这些包，我们开发了一个智能体轨迹到技能生成器，通过工作流分组、程序归纳、视觉基础和元技能指导审计，将公共非评估轨迹转换为可重用的多模态技能。为了使用它们，我们引入了一个分支加载的多模态技能智能体：选定的状态卡片和关键帧在临时分支中被检查，与实时环境对齐，并提炼为结构化指导。在GUI和基于游戏的视觉智能体基准测试中的实验表明，MMSkills一致地提高了前沿和较小的多模态智能体，表明外部多模态程序化知识补充了模型内部先验。

Abstract

Reusable skills have become a core substrate for improving agent capabilities, yet most existing skill packages encode reusable behavior primarily as textual prompts, executable code, or learned routines. For visual agents, however, procedural knowledge is inherently multimodal: reuse depends not only on what operation to perform, but also on recognizing the relevant state, interpreting visual evidence of progress or failure, and deciding what to do next. We formalize this requirement as multimodal procedural knowledge and address three practical challenges: (I) what a multimodal skill package should contain; (II) where such packages can be derived from public interaction experience; and (III) how agents can consult multimodal evidence at inference time without excessive image context or over-anchoring to reference screenshots. We introduce MMSkills, a framework for representing, generating, and using reusable multimodal procedures for runtime visual decision making. Each MMSkill is a compact, state-conditioned package that couples a textual procedure with runtime state cards and multi-view keyframes. To construct these packages, we develop an agentic trajectory-to-skill Generator that transforms public non-evaluation trajectories into reusable multimodal skills through workflow grouping, procedure induction, visual grounding, and meta-skill-guided auditing. To use them, we introduce a branch-loaded multimodal skill agent: selected state cards and keyframes are inspected in a temporary branch, aligned with the live environment, and distilled into structured guidance for the main agent. Experiments across GUI and game-based visual-agent benchmarks show that MMSkills consistently improve both frontier and smaller multimodal agents, suggesting that external multimodal procedural knowledge complements model-internal priors.

item.title: Learning POMDP World Models from Observations with Language-Model Priors
item.author: Six, Valentin, Panse, Frederik, Fajeau, Mathis, Da Costa, Lancelot, Sharma, Mridul, Amayuelas, Alfonso, Xiao, Tim Z., Hyland, David, Hennig, Philipp, Schölkopf, Bernhard
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Pinductor利用语言模型先验知识，通过少量观察-动作轨迹学习部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程模型，在性能和样本效率上优于传统方法。

背景: 智能体在导航、操作机器人或玩游戏时，需要先学习环境的工作原理。部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程是内部世界模型的灵活建模类，但仅从观察-动作轨迹学习它们具有挑战性，通常需要大量的环境交互。

目的: 研究语言模型先验知识是否能通过利用先验知识来减少昂贵的交互需求。

方法: Pinductor提出了一种方法，让语言模型从少量观察-动作轨迹中提出候选的POMDP模型，并迭代地优化它们以最大化基于信念的似然得分。

主要发现: 尽管使用了严格更少的信息，Pinductor的表现和样本效率与假设拥有隐藏状态访问权限的基于语言模型的POMDP学习方法相匹配，并且显著优于基于表格的POMDP基线。性能随着语言模型能力的提升而扩展，并且随着环境语义信息的被移除而优雅地下降。

结论: 语言模型先验知识是部分可观察性下样本高效世界模型学习的实用工具，也是迈向现实环境中通用智能体的一步。

翻译: 无论是在导航建筑物、操作机器人还是玩游戏，一个能在环境中有效行动的智能体必须首先学习该环境如何工作的内部模型。部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs）为这种内部世界模型提供了灵活的建模类，但仅从观察-动作轨迹学习它们具有挑战性，通常需要大量的环境交互。我们询问语言模型先验知识是否能通过利用先验知识来减少昂贵的交互需求，并引入了Pinductor（POMDP-inductor）：一个LLM从少量观察-动作轨迹中提出候选的POMDP模型，并迭代地优化它们以最大化基于信念的似然得分。尽管使用了严格更少的信息，Pinductor的表现和样本效率与假设拥有隐藏状态访问权限的基于语言模型的POMDP学习方法相匹配，并且显著优于基于表格的POMDP基线。进一步的结果表明，性能随着语言模型能力的提升而扩展，并且随着环境语义信息的被移除而优雅地下降。这些结果共同将语言模型先验知识定位为部分可观察性下样本高效世界模型学习的实用工具，也是迈向现实环境中通用智能体的一步。代码可在此链接获取。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一种利用语言模型作为先验知识，从观察中学习部分可观察环境世界模型的方法。

Abstract

Whether navigating a building, operating a robot, or playing a game, an agent that acts effectively in an environment must first learn an internal model of how that environment works. Partially-observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) provide a flexible modeling class for such internal world models, but learning them from observation-action trajectories alone is challenging and typically requires extensive environment interaction. We ask whether language-model priors can reduce costly interaction by leveraging prior knowledge, and introduce \emph{Pinductor} (POMDP-inductor): an LLM proposes candidate POMDP models from a few observation-action trajectories and iteratively refines them to optimize a belief-based likelihood score. Despite using strictly less information, \emph{Pinductor} matches the performance and sample efficiency of LLM-based POMDP learning methods that assume privileged access to the hidden state, while significantly surpassing the sample efficiency of tabular POMDP baselines. Further results show that performance scales with LLM capability and degrades gracefully as semantic information about the environment is withheld. Together, these results position language-model priors as a practical tool for sample-efficient world-model learning under partial observability, and a step toward generalist agents in real-world environments. Code is available at this https URL .

item.title: HodgeCover: Higher-Order Topological Coverage Drives Compression of Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
item.author: Zhong, Tao, Zheng, Dongzhe, Allen-Blanchette, Christine
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了一种基于调和分解的稀疏混合专家模型压缩方法，通过识别和覆盖专家网络中的关键结构来优化推理成本。

背景: 稀疏混合专家模型通过少量专家路由token，学习无关的压缩技术可以在不重新训练的情况下降低推理成本。

目的: 解决现有压缩器在处理专家合并时无法识别可合并三元组的问题，通过数学分析找到阻碍因素并构建新的选择目标。

方法: 将专家网络建模为2-复形，利用边缘屏障和三元组屏障构建信号，通过调和分解隔离出阻碍合并的调和核，并设计HodgeCover算法贪婪覆盖关键边和三角形，结合权重剪枝的混合变体。

主要发现: 该方法在三种开放权重稀疏MoE骨干网络上，在专家减少轴上匹配了现有学习无关基线，在激进压缩轴上领先，并平衡了所有四个调和分量的保留质量。

结论: 暴露学习到的MoE结构的调和核改变了在最重要的压缩模式下获胜的压缩器。

翻译: 稀疏混合专家层通过少量专家路由token，无学习的压缩这些层在不重新训练的情况下减少推理成本。一个微妙的障碍阻碍了该家族中的每一个现有压缩器：三个专家可以两两兼容，但当合并在一起时形成一个不可约循环，因此任何基于成对信号对专家进行排名的分数在结构上对哪些三元组可以联合合并是盲目的。我们显示该障碍是一个精确的数学对象，即2-复形上的单纯拉普拉斯算子的调和核，其顶点是专家，边携带KL合并屏障，面携带三元组屏障；对边缘屏障信号进行Hodge分解精确地隔离了核。我们将诊断转化为一个选择目标：HodgeCover贪婪地覆盖调和关键边和三元组关键三角形，HodgeCover的混合变体将其与幸存者上的现成权重剪枝配对。在三种开放权重的稀疏MoE骨干网络上进行激进的专家减少，HodgeCover在专家减少轴上匹配了最先进的学习无关基线，在混合轴的激进压缩前沿上领先，并在所有四个调和分量上独特地平衡了保留质量。这些结果表明，暴露学习到的MoE结构的调和核改变了在最重要的压缩模式下获胜的压缩器。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了一种名为 HodgeCover 的新方法，利用高阶拓扑覆盖来压缩稀疏混合专家模型。

Abstract

Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers route tokens through a handful of experts, and learning-free compression of these layers reduces inference cost without retraining. A subtle obstruction blocks every existing compressor in this family: three experts can each be pairwise compatible yet form an irreducible cycle when merged together, so any score that ranks experts on pairwise signals is structurally blind to which triples are jointly mergeable. We show the obstruction is a precise mathematical object, the harmonic kernel of the simplicial Laplacian on a 2-complex whose vertices are experts, whose edges carry KL merge barriers, and whose faces carry triplet barriers; Hodge-decomposing the edge-barrier signal isolates the kernel exactly. We turn the diagnostic into a selection objective: HodgeCover greedily covers the harmonic-critical edges and triplet-critical triangles, and a hybrid variant of HodgeCover pairs it with off-the-shelf weight pruning on survivors. On three open-weight Sparse MoE backbones under aggressive expert reduction, HodgeCover matches state-of-the-art learning-free baselines on the expert-reduction axis, leads on the aggressive-compression frontier of the hybrid axis, and uniquely balances retained mass across all four Hodge components. These results show that exposing the harmonic kernel of a learned MoE structure changes which compressor wins at the regime that matters most.

item.title: Network-Aware Bilinear Tokenization for Brain Functional Connectivity Representation Learning
item.author: Leo Milecki, Qingyu Hu, Bahram Jafrasteh, Mert R. Sabuncu, Qingyu Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: NERVE是一个基于自监督学习的框架，通过双线性分词重新定义功能连接矩阵的分词方式，以适应大脑网络的自组织结构。

背景: 现有的掩码自编码器方法通常采用基于区域或图的方法，将功能连接矩阵视为结构同质的元素，忽略了大规模大脑网络的组织结构。

目的: 解决如何对功能连接矩阵进行分词以对齐大脑网络内在模块组织结构的基本问题。

方法: NERVE框架将功能连接矩阵划分为内部和跨网络连接块的补丁，通过新颖的结构化双线性因子分解嵌入功能连接补丁，将参数复杂度从二次方降低到线性。

主要发现: 在三个大规模发育队列（ABCD、PNC和CCNP）上的评估表明，网络感知的公式化产生了更稳定和可迁移的表示，特别是在跨队列评估中。消融研究证实了所提出的双线性网络嵌入和基于解剖学的分块对性能至关重要。

结论: 这些发现强调了将特定领域的结构先验纳入功能连接学自监督学习的重要性。

翻译: Masked autoencoders (MAEs) have recently shown promise for self-supervised representation learning of resting-state brain functional connectivity (FC). However, a fundamental question remains unresolved: how should FC matrices be tokenized to align with the intrinsic modular organization of large-scale brain networks? Existing approaches typically adopt region-centric or graph-based schemes that treat FC as structurally homogeneous elements and overlook the large-scale network brain organization. We introduce NERVE (Network-Aware Representations of Brain Functional Connectivity via Bilinear Tokenization), a self-supervised learning framework that redefines FC tokenization by partitioning FC matrices into patches of intra- and inter-network connectivity blocks. Unlike image-based MAE, where fixed-size patches share a common tokenizer, FC patches defined by network pairs are heterogeneous in size and correspond to distinct functional roles. To resolve this problem, NERVE embeds FC patches through a novel structured bilinear factorization. This formulation preserves network identity and reduces parameter complexity from quadratic to linear scaling in the number of networks. We evaluate NERVE across three large-scale developmental cohorts (ABCD, PNC, and CCNP) for behavior and psychopathology prediction. Compared to structurally agnostic MAE variants and graph-based self-supervised baselines, the proposed network-aware formulation yields more stable and transferable representations, particularly in cross-cohort evaluation. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed bilinear network embedding and anatomically grounded parcellation are critical for performance. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating domain-specific structural priors into self-supervised learning for functional connectomics. Code is available at: https://github.com/leomlck/NERVE.

Abstract

Masked autoencoders (MAEs) have recently shown promise for self-supervised representation learning of resting-state brain functional connectivity (FC). However, a fundamental question remains unresolved: how should FC matrices be tokenized to align with the intrinsic modular organization of large-scale brain networks? Existing approaches typically adopt region-centric or graph-based schemes that treat FC as structurally homogeneous elements and overlook the large-scale network brain organization. We introduce NERVE (Network-Aware Representations of Brain Functional Connectivity via Bilinear Tokenization), a self-supervised learning framework that redefines FC tokenization by partitioning FC matrices into patches of intra- and inter-network connectivity blocks. Unlike image-based MAE, where fixed-size patches share a common tokenizer, FC patches defined by network pairs are heterogeneous in size and correspond to distinct functional roles. To resolve this problem, NERVE embeds FC patches through a novel structured bilinear factorization. This formulation preserves network identity and reduces parameter complexity from quadratic to linear scaling in the number of networks. We evaluate NERVE across three large-scale developmental cohorts (ABCD, PNC, and CCNP) for behavior and psychopathology prediction. Compared to structurally agnostic MAE variants and graph-based self-supervised baselines, the proposed network-aware formulation yields more stable and transferable representations, particularly in cross-cohort evaluation. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed bilinear network embedding and anatomically grounded parcellation are critical for performance. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating domain-specific structural priors into self-supervised learning for functional connectomics. Code is available at: https://github.com/leomlck/NERVE.

item.title: Beyond Binary: Reframing GUI Critique as Continuous Semantic Alignment
item.author: Yuchen Sun, Pei Fu, Shaojie Zhang, Anan Du, Xiuwen Xi, Ruoceng Zhang, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan, Chongyang Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) 是一种通过采样多个候选动作并使用 Critic 模型进行排序来提升通用 GUI 代理性能的新范式。然而，现有的 GUI critic 模型采用二元分类，导致有效动作和看似合理但无效的干扰项得分难以区分。本文提出了 BBCritic 和 BBBench，通过两阶段对比学习在共享的 Affordance Space 中对齐指令和动作，恢复层级结构，并证明了 GUI critique 本质上是一个度量学习问题而非分类问题。

背景: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) 通过采样多个候选动作并使用 Critic 模型进行排序，是提升通用 GUI 代理性能的有前景范式。然而，现有 GUI critic 模型普遍采用二元分类，其有效性依赖于 critic 的精细排名能力。

目的: 解决现有 GUI critic 模型在二元分类下，有效动作与看似合理但无效的干扰项得分难以区分的问题。

方法: 引入 BBCritic，基于功能等价假设，通过两阶段对比学习在共享的 Affordance Space 中对齐指令和动作，恢复被二元监督扁平化的层级结构。同时提出 BBBench，首个结合密集动作空间和层级四分类法的 GUI critic 基准。

主要发现: BBCritic-3B 在无需额外标注的情况下，性能优于 7B 参数的 SOTA 二元模型；在跨平台和任务上表现出强大的零样本迁移能力。

结论: GUI critique 本质上是一个度量学习问题，而非分类问题。

翻译: Test-Time Scaling (TTS)，通过采样多个候选动作并使用 Critic 模型进行排序，已成为一种有前景的通用 GUI 代理范式。其有效性取决于 critic 的精细排名能力。然而，现有的 GUI critic 模型普遍采用二元分类。我们对这些模型的动机分析揭示了一个严重的纠缠：有效动作和看似合理但无效的干扰项的得分变得难以区分。我们将这种失败归因于两个结构性缺陷：Affordance Collapse——层级 affordance 空间被压缩为 0/1 标签；以及 Noise Sensitivity——二元目标对噪声决策边界过拟合。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 BBCritic，这是一种基于功能等价假设的范式转变。通过两阶段对比学习，BBCritic 在共享的 Affordance Space 中对齐指令和动作，恢复了二元监督扁平化的层级结构。我们还提出了 BBBench，首个 GUI critic 基准，它将密集动作空间与层级四分类法配对，实现了精细排名评估。实验结果表明，BBCritic-3B 在没有任何额外标注的情况下，优于 7B 参数的 SOTA 二元模型。它展示了跨平台和任务的强大零样本迁移能力，支持我们的方法论观点：GUI critique 本质上是一个度量学习问题，而不是分类问题。

Abstract

Test-Time Scaling (TTS), which samples multiple candidate actions and ranks them via a Critic Model, has emerged as a promising paradigm for generalist GUI agents. Its efficacy thus hinges on the critic's fine-grained ranking ability. However, existing GUI critic models uniformly adopt binary classification. Our motivational analysis of these models exposes a severe entanglement: scores for valid actions and plausible-but-invalid distractors become indistinguishable. We attribute this failure to two structural defects: Affordance Collapse--the hierarchical affordance space is compressed into 0/1 labels; and Noise Sensitivity--binary objectives overfit to noisy decision boundaries. To resolve this, we introduce BBCritic (Beyond-Binary Critic), a paradigm shift grounded in the Functional Equivalence Hypothesis. Through two-stage contrastive learning, BBCritic aligns instructions and actions in a shared Affordance Space, recovering the hierarchical structure that binary supervision flattens. We also present BBBench (Beyond-Binary Bench), the first GUI critic benchmark that pairs a dense action space with a hierarchical four-level taxonomy, enabling fine-grained ranking evaluation. Experimental results show that BBCritic-3B, trained without any extra annotation, outperforms 7B-parameter SOTA binary models. It demonstrates strong zero-shot transferability across platforms and tasks, supporting our methodological view: GUI critique is fundamentally a metric-learning problem, not a classification one.

item.title: InsightTok: Improving Text and Face Fidelity in Discrete Tokenization for Autoregressive Image Generation
item.author: Yue, Yang, Wei, Fangyun, He, Tianyu, Zhao, Jinjing, Ni, Zanlin, Liu, Zeyu, Guo, Jiayi, Shi, Lei, Dong, Yue, Chen, Li, Li, Ji, Huang, Gao, Chen, Dong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 InsightTok 的离散视觉分词器框架，通过局部感知损失增强文本和面部保真度。

背景: 文本和面部是视觉生成中最重要的模式，但基于离散分词的自回归生成器面临挑战。标准离散分词器通过激进的下采样和量化丢弃了精细结构，导致文本可读性和面部特征保持困难。

目的: 为了解决标准离散分词器目标与文本可读性和面部保真度对齐不足的问题，提出 InsightTok 框架。

方法: InsightTok 采用局部感知损失，这是一种内容感知的分词器训练方法，使用紧凑的 16k 码本和 16 倍下采样率。

主要发现: InsightTok 在文本和面部重建方面显著优于先前的分词器，且不损害通用重建质量。这些改进在 InsightAR 中产生了更清晰的文本和更真实的面部细节。

结论: 结果表明，在分词器训练中使用专门监督可以推动离散图像生成的发展。

翻译: 文本和面部是视觉生成中最具感知显著性且在实践上最重要的模式，但对于基于离散分词的自回归生成器来说仍然具有挑战性。一个主要的瓶颈是分词器：激进的下采样和量化通常会丢弃保持可读字形和独特面部特征所需的精细结构。我们将这种差距归因于标准离散分词器目标与文本可读性和面部保真度对齐不足，因为这些目标通常优化通用重建，同时均匀地压缩多样化的内容。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 InsightTok，这是一个简单而有效的离散视觉分词器框架，通过局部感知损失增强文本和面部保真度。使用紧凑的 16k 码本和 16 倍下采样率，InsightTok 在文本和面部重建方面显著优于先前的分词器，且不损害通用重建质量。这些改进在 InsightAR 中持续转移到了自回归图像生成上，产生了文本更清晰且面部细节更真实的图像。总的来说，我们的结果强调了在分词器训练中使用专门监督在推动离散图像生成方面的潜力。

Abstract

Text and faces are among the most perceptually salient and practically important patterns in visual generation, yet they remain challenging for autoregressive generators built on discrete tokenization. A central bottleneck is the tokenizer: aggressive downsampling and quantization often discard the fine-grained structures needed to preserve readable glyphs and distinctive facial features. We attribute this gap to standard discrete-tokenizer objectives being weakly aligned with text legibility and facial fidelity, as these objectives typically optimize generic reconstruction while compressing diverse content uniformly. To address this, we propose InsightTok, a simple yet effective discrete visual tokenization framework that enhances text and face fidelity through localized, content-aware perceptual losses. With a compact 16k codebook and a 16x downsampling rate, InsightTok significantly outperforms prior tokenizers in text and face reconstruction without compromising general reconstruction quality. These gains consistently transfer to autoregressive image generation in InsightAR, producing images with clearer text and more faithful facial details. Overall, our results highlight the potential of specialized supervision in tokenizer training for advancing discrete image generation.

item.title: Learning from Failures: Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization with Verifiable Rewards
item.author: Ren, Mengjie, Lou, Jie, Cao, Boxi, Wen, Xueru, Lin, Hongyu, Han, Xianpei, Sun, Le, Yu, Xing, Lu, Yaojie
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为CIPO的方法，通过将失败的轨迹转化为纠正导向的监督信号，结合标准RLVR目标进行联合优化，从而提高模型推理和纠错能力。

背景: 现有的强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）训练往往受到稀疏二元奖励和弱信用分配的阻碍，导致优化信号模糊，未能充分利用失败轨迹中的有用信息。

目的: 为了解决RLVR训练中稀疏奖励和弱信用分配的问题，提出一种简单有效的扩展方法，以改善学习效果并增强模型纠正自身错误的能力。

方法: Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization (CIPO) 将在线策略失败的轨迹转化为纠正导向的监督，无需外部信号，并与标准RLVR目标联合优化。

主要发现: 在涵盖数学推理和代码生成的11个基准测试中，CIPO consistently and significantly outperforms strong baselines in both reasoning and correction performance，并且 yields stronger pass@K gains。

结论: CIPO不仅提高了模型的推理能力，还增强了其纠错能力，表明它改善了模型的内在推理能力，而不仅仅是重新分配现有正确答案的概率质量。

翻译: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）已成为提高大型语言模型推理能力的一种有效范式。然而，RLVR训练往往受到稀疏二元奖励和弱信用分配的阻碍，导致优化信号模糊，未能充分利用失败轨迹中嵌入的有用信息。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了面向纠正的策略优化（CIPO），这是RLVR的一种简单有效的扩展，它将在线策略失败的轨迹转化为面向纠正的监督，而不依赖任何外部信号。通过联合优化从模型自身失败尝试中得出的纠正样本与标准RLVR目标，CIPO提高了学习效果，同时明确增强了模型纠正自身错误的能力。在涵盖数学推理和代码生成的11个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，CIPO在推理和纠错性能方面始终显著优于强基线。此外，CIPO产生了更强的pass@K增益，表明它改善了模型的内在推理能力，而不仅仅是重新分配现有正确答案的概率质量。

Abstract

Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, RLVR training is often hindered by sparse binary rewards and weak credit assignment, resulting in ambiguous optimization signals and underutilization of the useful information embedded in failed trajectories. To address this challenge, we propose Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization (CIPO), a simple and effective extension to RLVR that converts on-policy failed trajectories into correction-oriented supervision, without relying on any external signals. By jointly optimizing correction samples derived from the model's own failed attempts together with the standard RLVR objective, CIPO improves learning effectiveness while explicitly enhancing the model's ability to correct its own errors. Extensive experiments across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that CIPO consistently and significantly outperforms strong baselines in both reasoning and correction performance. Moreover, CIPO yields stronger pass@K gains, indicating that it improves the model's intrinsic reasoning capacity rather than merely redistributing probability mass over existing correct answers.

item.title: Forgetting That Sticks: Quantization-Permanent Unlearning via Circuit Attribution
item.author: Sadhu, Saisab, Seth, Pratinav, Sankarapu, Vinay Kumar
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文介绍了MANSU方法，旨在解决机器遗忘在量化后失效的问题，通过结合因果电路归因和受限零空间投影等技术，实现了有意义的遗忘、保留保护、非正PTQ差距和结构擦除。

背景: 标准机器遗忘评估在训练后立即测量行为抑制，但实际部署的语言模型首先经过量化。4位后训练量化（PTQ）可以逆转机器遗忘，这表明这是一个系统性双重失败：基于梯度的遗忘方法在压缩后失去遗忘效果，而能通过量化的方法几乎不改变模型。

目的: 提出MANSU（Mechanistic-Aligned Null-Space Unlearning）方法，旨在解决机器遗忘在量化后的双重失效问题，并引入Circuit Attribution Divergence（CAD）作为机制验证指标。

方法: MANSU方法结合了因果电路归因以隔离最小遗忘集子图，电路受限零空间投影与对角Fisher保留边界，以及保证量化生存的每参数幅度下限。

主要发现: 所有基线方法的每参数更新都低于NF4量化bin宽度（47-828倍）；更新在数十亿参数间扩散无法清除量化bin边界；这导致了一个稀疏性-永久性权衡；MANSU是首个在多个模型家族和危险基准上同时满足所有四个属性的方法。

结论: 梯度基线方法在压缩后恢复高达+0.05的准确率；MANSU通过构造保证量化生存，实现了有意义的遗忘、保留保护、非正PTQ差距和结构擦除。

翻译: 标准机器遗忘评估在训练后立即测量行为抑制，但实际部署的语言模型首先经过量化。最近的工作表明，4位后训练量化（PTQ）可以逆转机器遗忘；我们表明这并非一个调优伪影，而是一个系统性双重失败：在压缩后失去遗忘效果的基于梯度的方法，以及几乎不改变模型但能通过量化的方法。这两种失败都追溯到同一个根本原因：在所有基线中，每参数更新都低于NF4量化bin宽度；更新在数十亿参数间扩散无法清除量化bin边界，这是我们形式化为稀疏性-永久性权衡的一个后果。我们提出了MANSU（Mechanistic-Aligned Null-Space Unlearning），它通过结合因果电路归因以隔离最小遗忘集子图，电路受限零空间投影与对角Fisher保留边界，以及保证量化生存的每参数幅度下限，解决了这两种模式。我们此外引入了Circuit Attribution Divergence（CAD），这是一个机制验证指标，区分结构擦除与行为抑制，这是现有指标无法做到的。在多个模型家族和危险基准上，MANSU是首个同时以每种属性的余量满足所有四个属性（有意义的遗忘、保留保护、非正PTQ差距和结构擦除）的方法，而梯度基线方法在压缩后恢复高达+0.05的准确率。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决模型如何永久遗忘特定知识的问题。它通过识别模型中负责该知识的特定部分，并利用量化技术来确保遗忘效果持久，防止模型恢复。这在现实中非常重要，因为模型可能包含偏见或过时信息，需要安全且不可逆地移除，以保障模型的安全性和可控性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 输入文本仅包含论文的元数据和结构信息，未包含具体的方法设计思路或对现有工作的借鉴说明。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 输入文本仅包含论文的元数据和结构信息，未提供具体内容，因此无法回答核心思想和实现流程。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种通过电路归因实现量化永久性遗忘的方法，旨在让模型在遗忘特定知识后，通过量化操作固化遗忘效果，防止模型恢复。

Abstract

Standard unlearning evaluations measure behavioral suppression in full precision, immediately after training, despite every deployed language model being quantized first. Recent work has shown that 4-bit post-training quantization can reverse machine unlearning; we show this is not a tuning artefact but a systematic dual failure: gradient-based methods that achieve meaningful forgetting lose it under compression, while methods that survive quantization barely change the model. Both failures trace to the same root cause: across all baselines, per-parameter updates lie 47-828x below the NF4 quantization bin width; updates diffused across billions of parameters cannot clear quantization bin boundaries, a consequence we formalize as a sparsity-permanence tradeoff. We present MANSU (Mechanistic-Aligned Null-Space Unlearning), which resolves both modes by combining causal circuit attribution to isolate the minimal forget-set subgraph, circuit-restricted null-space projection with a diagonal-Fisher retain bound, and a per-parameter magnitude floor guaranteeing quantization survival by construction. We additionally introduce Circuit Attribution Divergence (CAD), a mechanistic verification metric distinguishing structural erasure from behavioral suppression, a distinction existing metrics cannot make. Across multiple model families and hazard benchmarks, MANSU is the first method to jointly satisfy all four properties with margin on each (meaningful forgetting, retain preservation, non-positive PTQ gap, and structural erasure), while gradient-based baselines recover up to +0.05 accuracy under compression.

item.title: From Plans to Pixels: Learning to Plan and Orchestrate for Open-Ended Image Editing
item.author: Rajan, Anirudh Sundara, Singh, Krishna Kumar, Lee, Yong Jae
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种用于长跨度图像编辑的体验式框架，通过规划器和协调器协同工作，结合视觉语言法官提供基于结果的奖励，以实现更连贯和可靠的编辑效果。

背景: 现有的图像编辑模型在处理抽象、多步骤指令时存在困难；先前的基于代理的方法虽然能分解任务，但依赖手工制作的流程或教师模仿，限制了灵活性，且难以将学习与实际编辑结果解耦。

目的: 提出一种长跨度图像编辑的体验式框架，通过规划器生成结构化的原子分解，协调器选择工具和区域执行步骤，并利用视觉语言法官提供基于结果的奖励来训练协调器，同时利用成功的轨迹来优化规划器。

方法: 该框架包含规划器生成结构化原子分解、协调器选择工具和区域执行步骤、视觉语言法官提供基于结果的奖励（用于指令遵循和视觉质量），以及利用成功轨迹优化规划器。

主要发现: 通过紧密耦合规划与奖励驱动的执行，该方法比单步或基于规则的分步基线产生更连贯和可靠的编辑效果。

结论: 该方法通过将规划与奖励驱动的执行紧密耦合，能够实现更连贯和可靠的图像编辑。

翻译: 现代图像编辑模型能够产生逼真的结果，但在处理抽象、多步骤指令（例如“使这个广告更素食友好”）时存在困难。先前的基于代理的方法虽然能分解此类任务，但依赖手工制作的流程或教师模仿，限制了灵活性，且难以将学习与实际编辑结果解耦。我们提出了一种用于长跨度图像编辑的体验式框架，其中规划器生成结构化的原子分解，协调器选择工具和区域来执行每个步骤。视觉语言法官为指令遵循和视觉质量提供基于结果的奖励。协调器被训练以最大化这些奖励，成功的轨迹被用来优化规划器。通过紧密耦合规划与奖励驱动的执行，我们的方法比单步或基于规则的分步基线产生更连贯和可靠的编辑效果。
