如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Modern image editing models produce realistic results but struggle with abstract, multi step instructions (e.g., ``make this advertisement more vegetarian-friendly''). Prior agent based methods decompose such tasks but rely on handcrafted pipelines or teacher imitation, limiting flexibility and decoupling learning from actual editing outcomes. We propose an experiential framework for long-horizon image editing, where a planner generates structured atomic decompositions and an orchestrator selects tools and regions to execute each step. A vision language judge provides outcome-based rewards for instruction adherence and visual quality. The orchestrator is trained to maximize these rewards, and successful trajectories are used to refine the planner. By tightly coupling planning with reward driven execution, our approach yields more coherent and reliable edits than single-step or rule-based multistep baselines.

item.title: GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Large Language Model Decoding
item.author: Meng, Fanxu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA)的新方法，旨在解决DeepSeek-V2/V3中使用的Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)在特定硬件上推理效率受限的问题。

背景: DeepSeek-V2/V3中使用的MLA注意力机制将键值压缩为低秩潜在表示，性能接近H100的峰值性能。然而，MLA的训练权重仅暴露了一种解码路径（吸收型MQA），这种路径将高效推理绑定在H100级别的计算带宽比上，牺牲了沿头轴的张量并行性，并且在如受限的H20等通用推理GPU上无法获得多Token预测（MTP）增益。

目的: 为了解决MLA在特定硬件上推理效率受限的问题，提出一种最小化的修改方案，使训练权重暴露两种代数等价的解码路径，以适应不同硬件的峰值性能。

方法: 提出Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA)，这是MLA的最小修改。GQLA允许在相同的参数上暴露两种解码路径：一种是MLA的MQA吸收路径，另一种是具有每组扩展缓存的GQA路径。运行时根据目标硬件选择路径，无需重新训练或自定义内核。此外，为了避免从头预训练，将TransMLA扩展为TransGQLA，将预训练的GQA检查点转换为GQLA模型。

主要发现: GQLA允许单组权重同时支持H100（MQA吸收路径，s_q=1）和H20（GQA + MTP，s_q=2）的峰值性能，并在GQA路径上支持高达8路零冗余张量并行。在LLaMA-3-8B模型上，TransGQLA在MQA吸收路径上将每token KV缓存压缩到GQA基线的28.125%，同时在每组路径上保持GQA级别的流量。

结论: GQLA通过提供灵活的解码路径选择，消除了MLA对特定硬件的依赖，实现了跨不同硬件平台的推理效率优化，同时保持了模型压缩和并行能力。

翻译: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)，即DeepSeek-V2/V3中使用的注意力机制，将键和值联合压缩为低秩潜在表示，并几乎完美匹配H100的峰值性能。然而，其训练权重仅暴露了一种解码路径——一种吸收型MQA形式——这种形式将高效推理绑定在H100级别的计算带宽比上，沿头轴牺牲了张量并行性，并且在如出口受限的H20等通用推理GPU上无法获得多Token预测（MTP）增益。我们提出了Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA)，这是MLA的最小修改，其训练权重在相同参数上暴露两种代数等价的解码路径：一种是MLA的MQA吸收路径，另一种是具有每组扩展缓存的GQA路径。运行时选择与目标硬件匹配的路径——无需重新训练，无需自定义内核——因此一组GQLA权重同时固定了H100（MQA吸收，s_q=1）和H20（GQA + MTP，s_q=2）的峰值性能，同时在GQA路径上支持高达8路零冗余张量并行。为了避免从头预训练，我们将TransMLA扩展为TransGQLA，它将预训练的GQA检查点转换为GQLA模型；在LLaMA-3-8B上，它在MQA吸收路径上将每token KV缓存压缩到GQA基线的28.125%，同时在每组路径上保持GQA级别的流量。

Abstract

Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), the attention used in DeepSeek-V2/V3, jointly compresses keys and values into a low-rank latent and matches the H100 roofline almost perfectly. Its trained weights, however, expose only one decoding path - an absorbed MQA form - which ties efficient inference to H100-class compute-bandwidth ratios, forfeits tensor parallelism along the head axis, and yields no Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) gain on commodity inference GPUs such as the export-restricted H20. We propose Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA), a minimal modification of MLA whose trained weights expose two algebraically equivalent decoding paths over the same parameters: an MQA-absorb path identical to MLA's, and a GQA path with a per-group expanded cache. The runtime picks the path that matches the target hardware - no retraining, no custom kernels - so a single set of GQLA weights pins the rooflines of both H100 (MQA-absorb, s_q=1) and H20 (GQA + MTP, s_q=2), while supporting up to 8-way zero-redundancy tensor parallelism on the GQA path. To avoid pretraining from scratch we extend TransMLA into TransGQLA, which converts a pretrained GQA checkpoint into a GQLA model; on LLaMA-3-8B it compresses the per-token KV cache to 28.125% of the GQA baseline on the MQA-absorb path while structurally preserving GQA-level traffic on the per-group path.

item.title: ReactiveGWM: Steering NPC in Reactive Game World Models
item.author: Wang, Zeqing, Chen, Danze, Xing, Zhaohu, Tong, Zizhao, Zhang, Yinhan, Yang, Xingyi, Jin, Yeying
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ReactiveGWM 是一种能够合成玩家与 NPC 之间动态交互的响应式游戏世界模型，它通过解耦玩家控制和 NPC 行为，实现了跨游戏的零样本策略迁移。

背景: 现有的游戏世界模型通常从玩家主观视角模拟环境，将 NPC 视为背景像素，无法捕捉玩家与 NPC 之间的交互，缺乏对动作诱导的 NPC 响应性的物理理解。

目的: 引入 ReactiveGWM，旨在合成玩家与 NPC 之间的动态交互，并实现跨游戏的零样本策略迁移。

方法: ReactiveGWM 明确解耦玩家控制和 NPC 行为，玩家动作通过轻量级加性偏差注入扩散模型，NPC 高层响应通过交叉注意力模块进行建模，并学习跨游戏的交互逻辑表示。

主要发现: 在两款街头霸王游戏中，ReactiveGWM 在保持玩家精细控制的同时，实现了与提示对齐的稳健 NPC 策略遵循。

结论: 该方法为与 NPC 的可扩展、策略丰富的交互铺平了道路，无需特定领域的重新训练即可解锁可控的 NPC 交互。

翻译: 当前的游戏世界模型从主观、以玩家为中心的视角模拟环境。然而，通过将非玩家角色（NPC）仅仅视为背景像素，这些模型无法捕捉玩家与 NPC 之间的交互。在某种意义上，它们充当的是被动视频渲染器，而不是真正的模拟引擎，缺乏建模动作诱导的 NPC 响应性所需的物理理解。我们引入了 ReactiveGWM，这是一种响应式游戏世界模型，它合成了玩家与 NPC 之间的动态交互。ReactiveGWM 不纠缠所有交互动态，而是明确解耦玩家控制和 NPC 行为。玩家动作通过轻量级加性偏差注入扩散模型，而高层 NPC 响应（例如，进攻、控制、防御）通过交叉注意力模块进行建模。关键的是，这些模块学习了一种跨游戏的交互逻辑表示。这实现了零样本策略迁移：我们学习的模块可以直接插入到不同游戏的现成、未标注的世界模型中。这立即解锁了可控的 NPC 交互，而无需任何特定领域的重新训练。在两款街头霸王游戏中进行了评估，ReactiveGWM 在保持玩家精细控制的同时，实现了与提示对齐的稳健 NPC 策略遵循，为与 NPC 的可扩展、策略丰富的交互铺平了道路。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Current game world models simulate environments from a subjective, player-centric perspective. However, by treating the Non-Player Character (NPC) merely as background pixels, these models cannot capture interactions between the player and NPC. In that sense, they act as passive video renderers rather than real simulation engines, lacking the physical understanding needed to model action-induced NPC reactivities. We introduce ReactiveGWM, a reactive game world model that synthesizes dynamic interactions between the player and NPC. Instead of entangling all interaction dynamics, ReactiveGWM explicitly decouples player controls from NPC behaviors. Player actions are injected into the diffusion backbone via a lightweight additive bias, while high-level NPC responses (e.g., Offense, Control, Defense) are grounded through cross-attention modules. Crucially, these modules learn a game-agnostic representation of interactive logic. This enables zero-shot strategy transfer: our learned modules can be plugged directly into off-the-shelf, unannotated world models of different games. This instantly unlocks steerable NPC interactions without any domain-specific retraining. Evaluated on two Street Fighter games, ReactiveGWM maintains fine-grain player controllability while achieving robust, prompt-aligned NPC strategy adherence, paving the way for scalable, strategy-rich interaction with the NPC.

item.title: Tadpole: Autoencoders as Foundation Models for 3D PDEs with Online Learning
item.author: Qiang Liu, Felix Koehler, Benjamin Holzschuh, Nils Thuerey
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Tadpole是一个用于三维偏微分方程的新型基础模型，解决了可迁移性、高维扩展性和多功能性等关键挑战。

背景: 三维偏微分方程学习面临可迁移性、高维扩展性和多功能性等关键挑战。

目的: 介绍Tadpole，一个用于三维偏微分方程的新型基础模型，旨在解决这些挑战。

方法: Tadpole作为一个自编码器在合成三维PDE数据上进行预训练，该数据由高效的在线数据生成框架生成。它通过编码单通道空间切片来学习丰富的可迁移表示。对于动力学学习，提出了一种新颖的参数高效微调策略，结合了低秩适应、潜在空间变换和重新引入的跳跃连接。

主要发现: Tadpole能够在大规模、多样化的训练中扩展到相当于数百TB的训练数据。它可以在异构物理系统上学习丰富的可迁移表示。尽管仅作为自编码器预训练，Tadpole可以高效地应用于重建以外的多个下游任务，包括动力学学习和生成建模。参数高效微调策略在准确的时间建模方面表现出色，且可训练参数数量最少。

结论: Tadpole在各种下游任务中表现出强大的微调性能，突显了其作为三维PDE学习基础模型的多样性和有效性。

翻译: 我们介绍了Tadpole，这是一个用于三维偏微分方程的新型基础模型，解决了可迁移性、高维扩展性和多功能性等关键挑战。Tadpole作为一个自编码器在由高效的在线数据生成框架生成的合成三维PDE数据上进行预训练。这实现了大规模、多样化的训练，而无需存储或I/O开销，通过扩展到相当于数百TB的训练数据得到了证明。通过编码单通道空间切片，Tadpole在具有不同状态变量数量和空间分辨率的异构物理系统上学习丰富的可迁移表示。尽管仅作为自编码器预训练，Tadpole可以高效地应用于重建以外的多个下游任务，包括动力学学习和生成建模。对于动力学学习，我们提出了一种新颖的参数高效微调策略，结合了低秩适应、潜在空间变换和重新引入的跳跃连接，以在可训练参数数量最少的情况下实现准确的时间建模。Tadpole在各种下游任务中表现出强大的微调性能，突显了其作为三维PDE学习基础模型的多样性和有效性。Tadpole的源代码和预训练权重可在https://github.com/tum-pbs/tadpole获取。

Abstract

We introduce Tadpole, a novel foundation model for three-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) that addresses key challenges in transferability, scalability to high dimensionality, and multi-functionality. Tadpole is pre-trained as an autoencoder on synthetic 3D PDE data generated by an efficient online data-generation framework. This enables large-scale, diverse training without storage or I/O overhead, demonstrated by scaling to an equivalent of hundreds of terabytes of training data. By autoencoding single-channel spatial crops, Tadpole learns rich and transferable representations across heterogeneous physical systems with varying numbers of state variables and spatial resolutions. Although pre-trained solely as an autoencoder, Tadpole can be efficiently applied for multiple downstream tasks beyond reconstruction, including dynamics learning and generative modeling. For dynamics learning, we propose a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy that integrates low-rank adaptation, latent-space transformations, and reintroduced skip connections, achieving accurate temporal modeling with a minimal number of trainable parameters. Tadpole demonstrates strong fine-tuning performance across various downstream tasks, highlighting its versatility and effectiveness as a foundation model for 3D PDE learning. Source code and pre-trained weights of Tadpole are available at https://github.com/tum-pbs/tadpole

item.title: PhysBrain 1.0 Technical Report
item.author: Lian, Shijie, Yu, Bin, Lin, Xiaopeng, Wu, Changti, Yuan, Hang, Hu, Xiaolin, Shen, Zhaolong, Miao, Yuzhuo, Liu, Haishan, Tian, Yuxuan, Shi, Yukun, Huang, Cong, Chen, Kai
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PhysBrain 1.0 通过将大规模人类自视角视频转换为结构化物理常识监督，实现了从多模态理解到机器人动作的有效桥梁。

背景: 虽然视觉-语言-动作模型发展迅速，但仅靠机器人轨迹难以获得广泛物理理解的学习覆盖。

目的: 研究一条互补的路径，即通过将大规模人类自视角视频转化为结构化物理常识监督，从而实现机器人适应。

方法: 数据引擎提取场景元素、空间动力学、动作执行和深度感知关系，将其转化为问答监督以训练 PhysBrain VLMs；随后通过保持能力和语言敏感的适应设计，将物理先验转移至 VLA 策略。

主要发现: 在 ERQA、PhysBench、SimplerEnv-WidowX、LIBERO 和 RoboCasa 等多模态问答基准和具身控制基准上，PhysBrain 1.0 取得了最先进的结果，并在 SimplerEnv 上表现出特别强的跨域性能。

结论: 从人类交互视频中扩展物理常识可以提供一种从多模态理解到机器人动作的有效桥梁。

翻译: Vision-language-action models have advanced rapidly, but robot trajectories alone provide limited coverage for learning broad physical understanding. PhysBrain 1.0 studies a complementary route: converting large-scale human egocentric video into structured physical commonsense supervision before robot adaptation. Our data engine extracts scene elements, spatial dynamics, action execution, and depth-aware relations, then turns them into question-answer supervision for training PhysBrain VLMs. The resulting physical priors are further transferred to VLA policies through a capability-preserving and language-sensitive adaptation design. Across multimodal QA benchmarks and embodied control benchmarks, including ERQA, PhysBench, SimplerEnv-WidowX, LIBERO, and RoboCasa, PhysBrain 1.0 achieves SOTA results and shows especially strong out-of-domain performance on SimplerEnv. These results suggest that scaling physical commonsense from human interaction video can provide an effective bridge from multimodal understanding to robot action.

Abstract

Vision-language-action models have advanced rapidly, but robot trajectories alone provide limited coverage for learning broad physical understanding. PhysBrain 1.0 studies a complementary route: converting large-scale human egocentric video into structured physical commonsense supervision before robot adaptation. Our data engine extracts scene elements, spatial dynamics, action execution, and depth-aware relations, then turns them into question-answer supervision for training PhysBrain VLMs. The resulting physical priors are further transferred to VLA policies through a capability-preserving and language-sensitive adaptation design. Across multimodal QA benchmarks and embodied control benchmarks, including ERQA, PhysBench, SimplerEnv-WidowX, LIBERO, and RoboCasa, PhysBrain 1.0 achieves SOTA results and shows especially strong out-of-domain performance on SimplerEnv. These results suggest that scaling physical commonsense from human interaction video can provide an effective bridge from multimodal understanding to robot action.

item.title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution
item.author: Li, Han, Tian, Jinyu, Feng, Rili, Du, Yuqiao, Zheng, Chong, Wang, Chenyu, Liu, Chenchen, Li, Shihao, Lei, Xinping, Yao, Yifan, Xie, Weihao, Zhu, Letian, Liu, Jiaheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Solvita是一个无需更新底层大语言模型权重即可实现持续学习的框架，通过四个专门代理和可训练的图结构知识网络，将问题解决过程组织成策略选择、程序合成、认证监督和针对性攻击的闭环系统，利用结果信号进行强化学习更新，从而动态路由未来查询并积累可迁移的推理经验。

背景: 大型语言模型在处理硬性竞争编程的严谨推理需求方面仍面临困难，现有的多代理框架虽然尝试弥合这一可靠性差距，但它们本质上是无状态的，依赖于静态检索并丢弃从先前任务中获得的有价值的解决问题和调试经验。

目的: 提出Solvita框架，旨在解决现有LLM在竞争编程推理上的不足，通过构建一个能够持续学习且无需更新底层模型权重的系统，使代理能够积累可迁移的推理经验。

方法: Solvita将问题解决重组为策略选择、程序合成、认证监督和针对性攻击的闭环系统，由四个专门代理：规划者、求解者、预言机和黑客执行。每个代理都配有一个可训练的图结构知识网络，利用结果信号如通过/失败裁决、测试认证质量和黑客发现的对抗性漏洞作为强化学习更新网络权重，使代理能够根据过去的成功和失败动态路由未来查询。

主要发现: 在CodeContests、APPS、AetherCode和实时Codeforces轮次上的评估中，Solvita在代码生成代理中建立了新的最先进水平，优于现有的多代理管道，并且几乎将单次通过基线的准确率提高了一倍。

结论: Solvita框架通过引入可训练的图结构知识网络和强化学习机制，成功实现了代理在无需更新底层模型权重情况下的持续学习和经验积累，显著提升了在竞争编程任务中的表现。

翻译: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理硬性竞争编程的严谨推理需求方面仍面临困难。虽然最近的多代理框架尝试弥合这一可靠性差距，但它们本质上是无状态的：它们依赖于静态检索，并丢弃从先前任务中获得的有价值的解决问题和调试经验。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Solvita，一个能够实现持续学习且无需更新底层LLM权重的代理进化框架。Solvita将问题解决重组为策略选择、程序合成、认证监督和针对性攻击的闭环系统，由四个专门代理：规划者、求解者、预言机和黑客执行。关键的是，每个代理都配有一个可训练的图结构知识网络。随着系统的运行，结果信号，如通过/失败裁决、测试认证质量和黑客发现的对抗性漏洞，被重新构建为对这些网络权重的强化学习更新。这允许代理根据过去的成功和失败动态路由未来查询，有效地随时间积累可迁移的推理经验。在CodeContests、APPS、AetherCode和实时Codeforces轮次上的评估中，Solvita在代码生成代理中建立了新的最先进水平，优于现有的多代理管道，并且几乎将单次通过基线的准确率提高了一倍。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with the rigorous reasoning demands of hard competitive programming. While recent multi-agent frameworks attempt to bridge this reliability gap, they remain fundamentally stateless: they rely on static retrieval and discard the valuable problem-solving and debugging experience gained from previous tasks. To address this, we present Solvita, an agentic evolution framework that enables continuous learning without requiring weight updates to the underlying LLM. Solvita reorganizes problem-solving into a closed-loop system of strategy selection, program synthesis, certified supervision, and targeted hacking, executed by four specialized agents: Planner, Solver, Oracle, and Hacker. Crucially, each agent is paired with a trainable, graph-structured knowledge network. As the system operates, outcome signals, such as pass/fail verdicts, test certification quality, and adversarial vulnerabilities discovered by the Hacker, are recast as reinforcement learning updates to these network weights. This allows the agents to dynamically route future queries based on past successes and failures, effectively accumulating transferable reasoning experience over time. Evaluated across CodeContests, APPS, AetherCode, and live Codeforces rounds, Solvita establishes a new state-of-the-art among code-generation agents, outperforming existing multi-agent pipelines and nearly doubling the accuracy of single-pass baselines.

item.title: FFAvatar: Few-Shot, Feed-Forward, and Generalizable Avatar Reconstruction
item.author: Nguyen, Thuan Hoang, Luo, Jiahao, Nie, Yinyu, Li, Hao, Qian, Gordon Guocheng, Wang, Jian
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: FFAvatar是一种通用的前馈框架，能够在几秒钟内从少量未对齐的人像图像中重建高质量、可动画化的3D高斯人头模型。

背景: 传统的头像重建依赖于针对每个主体的优化，这需要数小时的计算，或者依赖于昂贵的预处理，这限制了可扩展性。

目的: 介绍FFAvatar，旨在从少量未对齐的人像图像中快速重建高质量、可动画化的3D高斯人头模型。

方法: FFAvatar通过Multi-View Query-Former将多张源图像的信息融合到统一的规范高斯表示中，并通过FLAME参数预测直接从像素端到端地对其进行动画化。此外，提出了三阶段训练课程：1）在超过100万个身份的单目视频数据上进行可扩展的预训练；2）在360度采集的小型高质量数据集上进行多视图微调；3）可选的个性化调整。

主要发现: FFAvatar在NeRSemble基准测试中，相比最先进的LAM方法在PSNR上显著提高了5.5。它支持在单张NVIDIA A100 GPU上以49 FPS的速度进行动画化，无需个性化时在2秒内重建，个性化时在10秒内重建。

结论: FFAvatar在身份保持、几何一致性和动画保真度方面设定了新的标准。

翻译: 摘要：头像重建传统上依赖于针对每个主体的优化，这需要数小时的计算，或者依赖于昂贵的预处理，这限制了可扩展性。我们介绍了FFAvatar，这是一个通用的前馈框架，能够在几秒钟内从少量未对齐的人像图像中重建高质量、可动画化的3D高斯人头模型。FFAvatar通过Multi-View Query-Former将多张源图像的信息融合到统一的规范高斯表示中，并通过FLAME参数预测直接从像素端到端地对其进行动画化，消除了离线FLAME提取的开销。我们进一步提出了一个三阶段训练课程，以实现广泛的泛化和高保真重建：（i）在超过100万个身份的广泛单目视频数据上进行可扩展的预训练，以学习强大的通用先验；（ii）在360度采集的小型高质量数据集上进行多视图微调，以增强几何保真度和极端视角感知；（iii）可选的个性化，在500步优化内适应特定身份以实现最大保真度。广泛的实验表明，FFAvatar在身份保持、几何一致性和动画保真度方面设定了新的标准。在NeRSemble基准测试中，它比最先进的LAM方法显著提高了5.5 PSNR。此外，FFAvatar支持实时部署，无需个性化时在2秒内重建头像，个性化时在10秒内重建，并在单张NVIDIA A100 GPU上支持49 FPS的动画。

Abstract

Avatar reconstruction has traditionally relied on per-subject optimization that requires hours of computation or on expensive preprocessing that limits scalability. We introduce FFAvatar, a generalizable feed-forward framework that reconstructs high-quality, animatable 3D Gaussian head avatars from few-shot unposed portrait images in seconds. FFAvatar fuses information from multiple source images into a unified canonical Gaussian representation through Multi-View Query-Former, which is animated via FLAME parameters predicted end-to-end directly from pixels, eliminating the overhead of offline FLAME extraction. We further propose a three-stage training curriculum that achieves both broad generalization and high-fidelity reconstruction: (i) scalable pretraining on extensive monocular video data with over 1M identities to learn strong generalizable priors; (ii) multi-view fine-tuning on a small but high-quality dataset of 360-degree captures to enhance geometric fidelity and extreme-view awareness; and (iii) optional personalization that adapts to specific identities for maximum fidelity within 500 optimization steps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FFAvatar sets a new standard for identity preservation, geometric consistency, and animation fidelity. On the NeRSemble benchmark, it outperforms the state-of-the-art LAM by a substantial 5.5 PSNR gain. Furthermore, FFAvatar enables real-time deployment, reconstructing avatars in 2 seconds without personalization and 10 seconds with personalization, while supporting 49 FPS animation on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.

item.title: COPRA: Conditional Parameter Adaptation with Reinforcement Learning for Video Anomaly Detection
item.author: Darryl Cherian Jacob, Xinyu Liu, Kai Wang, Pan He
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: COPRA是一个用于视频异常检测的条件参数自适应框架，通过生成输入特定的参数更新来动态适应冻结的视觉语言模型。

背景: 现有的基于视觉语言模型的视频异常检测方法在训练和推理之间存在数据分布和模型配置的根本不匹配。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在静态后训练适应方面的局限性，以及训练和测试之间的一致性问题，提出COPRA框架。

方法: COPRA生成输入特定的参数更新，在训练和推理期间动态适应冻结的VLM，而不是使用固定的提示或共享的参数更新。

主要发现: COPRA在标准VAD基准测试中表现出色，在域内和跨域设置中始终优于静态基线。此外，COPRA能够泛化到未见过的任务，如多选题视频问答和密集描述。

结论: COPRA是一个有效的权重空间生成框架，用于可扩展、自适应和上下文感知的视频理解。

翻译: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在视频异常检测（VAD）中表现出强大的性能，并提供可解释的预测。然而，现有的基于VLM的VAD方法在训练和推理中存在数据分布和模型配置的根本不匹配。首先，大多数方法依赖于静态的后训练适应，限制了在未见环境或异常类型等分布偏移下的泛化能力。其次，它们在长视频的稀疏帧上训练VLM，但在密集采样的短片段上进行推理，造成了训练和测试之间的一致性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了COPRA，一个用于基于VLM的VAD的条件参数自适应框架。COPRA生成输入特定的参数更新，在训练和推理期间动态适应冻结的VLM，而不是使用固定的提示或共享的参数更新。实验表明，在标准VAD基准测试中表现出色，在域内和跨域设置中始终优于静态基线。此外，COPRA泛化到未见过的任务，如多选题视频问答和密集描述。这些结果突出了COPRA作为一个有效的权重空间生成框架，用于可扩展、自适应和上下文感知的视频理解。代码将在https://github.com/THE-MALT-LAB/COPRA发布。

Abstract

Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in video anomaly detection (VAD) while providing interpretable predictions. However, existing VLM-based VAD methods suffer from a fundamental mismatch between training and inference in both data distribution and model configuration. First, most approaches rely on static post-training adaptation, limiting generalization under distribution shifts such as unseen environments or anomaly types. Second, they train VLMs on sparse frames from long videos, but perform inference on densely sampled short segments, creating inconsistencies between training and testing. To address these limitations, we propose COPRA, a conditional parameter adaptation framework for VLM-based VAD. Instead of fixed prompts or shared parameter updates, COPRA generates input-specific parameter updates to dynamically adapt a frozen VLM for each video segment during both training and inference. Experiments show strong performance on standard VAD benchmarks, consistently outperforming static baselines in both in-domain and cross-domain settings. Moreover, COPRA generalizes beyond VAD to unseen tasks such as multiple-choice Video Question Answering and Dense Captioning. These results highlight COPRA as an effective weight-space generation framework for scalable, adaptive, and context-aware video understanding. The code will be released at https://github.com/THE-MALT-LAB/COPRA

item.title: HoloMotion-1 Technical Report
item.author: Maiyue Chen, Kaihui Wang, Bo Zhang, Xihan Ma, Zhiyuan Yang, Yi Ren, Qijun Huang, Zihao Zhu, Yucheng Wang, Zhizhong Su
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HoloMotion-1是一个用于零样本全身动作跟踪的人形动作基础模型。

背景: 该模型通过大规模混合动作语料库进行控制策略训练，其中视频重建动作提供主要动作多样性，而精心制作的动作捕捉和内部动作数据提供更高保真度的监督和面向部署的覆盖。

目的: 为了超越传统的仅动作捕捉训练，使策略暴露于更广泛的行为、捕捉条件和动作风格。

方法: 模型集成了大容量时序建模、稀疏激活的混合专家Transformer和KV缓存推理以实现实时控制，以及序列级训练策略以提高扩展动作序列的学习效率。

主要发现: 在多个未见过的动作基准测试中，HoloMotion-1在多样化的动作类型和捕捉条件下稳健地泛化，显著提高了跟踪精度，并直接转移到真实人形机器人上而无需特定任务的微调。

结论: 该模型能够处理来自异构数据的学习挑战，包括重建噪声、源域不匹配、动作质量不均以及在大行为变化下的时序建模需求。

翻译: 在本报告中，我们介绍了HoloMotion-1，这是一个用于零样本全身动作跟踪的人形动作基础模型。HoloMotion-1的一个关键创新是使用大规模混合动作语料库扩展控制策略训练，其中来自野外视频的视频重建动作提供了主要的动作多样性，而精心制作的动作捕捉和内部动作数据提供了更高保真度的监督和面向部署的覆盖。这种数据机制使HoloMotion-1能够超越传统的仅动作捕捉训练，并使策略暴露于更广泛的行为、捕捉条件和动作风格。从这种异构数据中学习引入了新的挑战，包括重建噪声、源域不匹配、动作质量不均以及在大行为变化下进行时序建模的需求。为了解决这些挑战，HoloMotion-1集成了大容量时序建模、用于实时控制的稀疏激活混合专家Transformer和KV缓存推理，以及提高扩展动作序列学习效率的序列级训练策略。在多个未见过的动作基准测试上的广泛实验表明，HoloMotion-1在多样化的动作类型和捕捉条件下稳健地泛化，显著提高了跟踪精度，并直接转移到真实人形机器人上而无需特定任务的微调。

Abstract

In this report, we present HoloMotion-1, a humanoid motion foundation model for zero-shot whole-body motion tracking. A key innovation of HoloMotion-1 is to scale control-policy training with a large-scale hybrid motion corpus, where video-reconstructed motions from in-the-wild videos provide the dominant source of motion diversity, while curated motion-capture and in-house motion data provide higher-fidelity supervision and deployment-oriented coverage. This data regime enables HoloMotion-1 to move beyond conventional MoCap-only training and exposes the policy to substantially broader behaviors, capture conditions, and motion styles. Learning from such heterogeneous data introduces new challenges, including reconstruction noise, source-domain mismatch, uneven motion quality, and the need for temporal modeling under large behavioral variation. To address these challenges, HoloMotion-1 integrates large-capacity temporal modeling, a sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts Transformer with KV-cache inference for real-time control, and a sequence-level training strategy that improves learning efficiency on extended motion sequences. Extensive experiments on multiple unseen motion benchmarks show that HoloMotion-1 generalizes robustly across diverse motion types and capture conditions, significantly improves tracking accuracy over prior methods, and transfers directly to a real humanoid robot without task-specific fine-tuning.

item.title: Minerva-Ego: Spatiotemporal Hints for Egocentric Video Understanding
item.author: Arsha Nagrani, Jasper Uijilings, Shyamal Buch, Tobias Weyand, Sudheendra Vijayanarasimhan, Bo Hu, Ramin Mehran, David A Ross, Cordelia Schmid
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了Minerva-Ego基准测试，用于评估复杂的第一人称视觉推理能力，通过在视频数据中添加多步骤多模态问题和时空密集的人类标注推理轨迹，发现前沿模型与人类表现仍有较大差距，并通过提示模型关注'哪里'和'何时'观察显著提升了性能。

背景: 现有的标准基准测试仅评估输出结果（如问题的答案），缺乏对中间推理步骤的评估，且大多数答案仅限于文本领域。

目的: 介绍Minerva-Ego基准测试，用于评估复杂的第一人称视觉推理能力。

方法: 在最近从第一人称/具身设置录制的高质量视频数据源上，添加了一组具有挑战性的多步骤多模态问题和时空密集的人类标注推理轨迹。此外，通过标注推理轨迹中的相关对象，作为时空掩码注释。

主要发现: 前沿模型与人类表现之间存在巨大差距；提示模型关注'哪里'和'何时'观察可显著提高性能。

结论: Minerva-Ego基准测试揭示了当前模型在复杂第一人称视觉推理方面的局限性，并表明通过适当的提示可以改善性能。

翻译: 视频推理模型是第一人称和具身智能体的核心组件。然而，用于评估模型的标准基准测试仅提供对输出的评估（例如问题的答案），而不评估中间推理步骤，并且大多数仅提供文本领域的答案。我们介绍了Minerva-Ego，一个用于评估复杂第一人称视觉推理的基准测试。我们通过一组具有挑战性的多步骤多模态问题和时空密集的人类标注推理轨迹，扩展了最近从第一人称/具身设置录制的高质量视频数据源。基准测试实验表明，最先进的模型与人类表现之间仍有巨大差距。为了详细调查这一差距，我们在数据集中的每个推理轨迹上标注了解决问题所需的对象，作为时空掩码注释。通过广泛的评估，我们发现用'哪里'和'何时'观察的提示来提示前沿模型可以显著提高性能。Minerva-Ego可以在https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune下载。

Abstract

Video reasoning models are a core component of egocentric and embodied agents. However, standard benchmarks for assessing models provide only evaluation of the output (e.g. the answer to a question), without evaluation of intermediate reasoning steps, and most provide answers only in the text domain. We introduce Minerva-Ego, a benchmark for evaluating complex egocentric visual reasoning. We extend recent high-quality video data sources recorded from egocentric / embodied settings with a set of challenging, multi-step multimodal questions and spatiotemporally-dense human-annotated reasoning traces. Benchmarking experiments show that state-of-the-art models still have a large gap to human performance. To investigate this gap in detail, we annotate each reasoning trace in the dataset with the objects of interest required to solve the question, as spatiotemporal mask annotations. Through extensive evaluations, we identify that prompting frontier models with hints of 'where' and 'when' to look yields substantial improvements in performance. Minerva-Ego can be downloaded at https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune.

item.title: Controllable Molecular Generative Foundation Models
item.author: Yihan Zhu, Yuhan Liu, Weijiang Li, Tengfei Luo, Meng Jiang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CoMole是一个可控分子生成基础模型，通过统一的无特征图扩散管道和强化学习优化，在多个基准测试中实现了高可控性和低误差。

背景: 尽管基础模型在语言和视觉领域取得成功，分子图生成仍缺乏统一框架来处理异构设计任务，且缺乏可靠的可控性。

目的: 提出CoMole模型，旨在解决分子图生成中缺乏统一框架和可靠可控性的问题。

方法: CoMole构建了统一的无特征图扩散管道，通过学习无特征图空间将预训练的结构先验转移到可控生成中，并利用强化学习优化条件反向策略。

主要发现: 在涵盖材料和药物发现的三个异构基准测试中，CoMole在所有九个目标上可控性排名第一，相对最强基线将平均绝对误差降低了高达48.2%，且在无基于规则修正或事后过滤的情况下保持有效性高于0.94。

结论: CoMole能够将可控性转移到未见过的属性上，仅通过优化任务嵌入（生成器冻结）即可实现与强任务特定基线竞争的性能。

翻译: 尽管基础模型在语言和视觉领域取得了成功，分子图生成仍然缺乏一个统一的框架来处理具有可靠可控性的异构设计任务。虽然强化学习为任务特定优化提供了自然的后训练机制，但将其应用于图生成模型受到巨大的原子级动作空间和化学上无效中间状态的阻碍。我们提出了CoMole，这是一个构建了统一的无特征图扩散管道的可控分子生成基础模型。通过学习无特征图空间，CoMole将预训练的结构先验转移到可控生成中，其中强化学习在化学上有意义的决策上优化条件反向策略。我们从理论上表征了原子级RL的瓶颈，并证明了无特征策略优化是合理的。在跨越材料和药物发现的三个异构基准测试中，CoMole在所有九个目标上可控性排名第一，相对最强基线将平均绝对误差降低了高达48.2%，并且在没有基于规则的修正或事后过滤的情况下，有效性保持在0.94以上。我们进一步表明，CoMole通过仅使用冻结的生成器优化任务嵌入，将可控性转移到未见过的属性上，实现了与强任务特定基线竞争的性能。

Abstract

Despite the success of foundation models in language and vision, molecular graph generation still lacks a unified framework for heterogeneous design tasks with reliable controllability. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural post-training mechanism for task-specific optimization, applying it to graph generative models is hindered by the vast atom-wise action spaces and chemically invalid intermediate states. We propose \textbf{Co}ntrollable \textbf{Mole}cular Generative Foundation Models (CoMole), built with a unified motif-aware graph diffusion pipeline. By learning a motif-aware graph space, CoMole transfers pretrained structural priors into controllable generation, where RL optimizes conditional reverse policies over chemically meaningful decisions. We theoretically characterize the bottleneck of atom-level RL and justify motif-aware policy optimization. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks spanning materials and drug discovery, CoMole ranks first in controllability on all nine targets, reduces MAE by up to 48.2% relative to the strongest baselines, and maintains validity above 0.94 without rule-based correction or post-hoc filtering. We further show that CoMole transfers controllability to unseen properties by optimizing only task embeddings with the generator frozen, achieving performance competitive with strong task-specific baselines.

item.title: ChangeFlow -- Latent Rectified Flow for Change Detection in Remote Sensing
item.author: Rolih, Blaž, Fučka, Matic, Wolf, Filip, Zajc, Luka Čehovin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 ChangeFlow 的生成式框架，通过潜在空间中的 rectified flow 将变化检测重新定义为合成变化掩码的过程，旨在解决现有方法在计算成本和条件机制复杂性方面的局限性。

背景: 遥感变化检测旨在定位同一地理区域两张图像之间的变化。然而，现有的变化掩码通常遵循区域级标注惯例而非纯局部外观差异，导致上下文相关且有时模糊。大多数最先进的方法使用逐像素判别分类，产生单一预测，未能明确将变化区域建模为一个连贯的整体。

目的: 为了解决先前判别式和生成式方法的局限性，提出 ChangeFlow 框架，通过潜在空间中的 rectified flow 将变化检测重新定义为合成变化掩码的过程。

方法: ChangeFlow 是一个生成式框架，通过 rectified flow 在潜在空间中合成变化掩码。它由结构化且轻量级的条件信号引导，其随机设计自然支持基于采样的预测集成。

主要发现: 在四个基准测试中，ChangeFlow 达到了平均 80.4% 的 F1 分数，比之前的最佳方法平均提高了 1.3 个百分点，同时保持了与最近的强基线相当的推理速度。

结论: ChangeFlow 通过采样预测掩码的聚合提高了鲁棒性，样本一致性提供了实用的置信度估计，突出了模糊区域。

翻译: 遥感变化检测旨在定位同一地理区域两张图像之间的变化。在实践中，变化掩码通常遵循区域级标注惯例而非纯局部外观差异，使其具有上下文依赖性且有时模糊。大多数最先进的方法使用逐像素判别分类，为每个输入产生单一预测，未能明确将变化区域建模为一个连贯的整体。一种自然的替代方案是生成式公式化，它可以建模合理的掩码分布，使采样能够捕获模糊性并鼓励全局一致性。然而，现有的生成式 RSCD 方法通常由于像素空间生成的计算成本高昂和条件机制的复杂性而落后于强大的判别式基线。为了解决先前判别式和生成式方法的局限性，我们提出了 ChangeFlow，这是一个生成式框架，通过 rectified flow 将变化检测重新定义为潜在空间中变化掩码的合成。ChangeFlow 由结构化且轻量级的条件信号引导，其随机设计自然支持基于采样的预测集成。具体而言，聚合多个预测的变化掩码提高了鲁棒性，而样本一致性提供了实用的置信度估计，突出了模糊区域。在四个基准测试中，ChangeFlow 达到了平均 80.4% 的 F1 分数，比之前的最佳方法平均提高了 1.3 个百分点，同时保持了与最近的强基线相当的推理速度。项目页面：this https URL

Abstract

Remote sensing change detection (RSCD) aims to localise changes between two images of the same geographic region. In practice, change masks often follow region-level annotation conventions rather than purely local appearance differences, making them context-dependent and occasionally ambiguous. Most state-of-the-art methods utilise per-pixel discriminative classification, which produces a single prediction per input and fails to explicitly model the changed region as a coherent whole. A natural alternative is generative formulation, which can model a distribution of plausible masks, enabling sampling to capture ambiguity and encourage global consistency. However, existing generative RSCD approaches typically lag behind strong discriminative baselines due to the high computational cost of pixel-space generation and the complexity of their conditioning mechanisms. To address the limitations of prior discriminative and generative methods, we propose ChangeFlow, a generative framework that reformulates change detection as the synthesis of a change mask in latent space via rectified flow. ChangeFlow is guided by a structured yet lightweight conditioning signal, and its stochastic design naturally supports sampling-based prediction ensembling. Namely, aggregating multiple predicted change masks improves robustness, while sample agreement provides a practical confidence estimation that highlights ambiguous regions. Across four benchmarks, ChangeFlow achieves an average F1 of 80.4\%, improving by 1.3 points on average over the previous best method, while maintaining inference speed comparable to recent strong baselines. item.title: PanoWorld: Geometry-Consistent Panoramic Video World Modeling
item.author: Le Jiang, Xiangyu Bai, Bishoy Galoaa, Shayda Moezzi, Caleb James Lee, Tooba Imtiaz, Edmund Yeh, Jennifer Dy, Yanzhi Wang, Sarah Ostadabbas
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PanoWorld 是一个全景视频世界模型，能够从单张图像和描述生成几何一致的全景视频。

背景: 现有的全景视频方法主要优化视觉真实感，未明确约束底层3D场景状态，导致输出结果在深度、对应关系和运动方面存在不一致。

目的: 将全景视频生成视为几何和动力学一致的潜在状态建模问题，而非纯粹的视觉合成。

方法: 基于预训练的透视视频世界模型，引入两个轻量级正则化项：深度一致性损失和轨迹一致性损失；对条件和位置编码应用球形几何感知适配；引入 PanoGeo 数据集。

主要发现: PanoWorld 在保持竞争性视觉真实感的同时，提高了几何一致性。

结论: 全景视频生成必须被视为几何建模问题，以支持具身人工智能应用的整体空间理解需求。

翻译: 我们提出了 PanoWorld，一个全景视频世界模型，能够从单张图像和描述生成几何一致的全景视频。现有的全景视频方法主要优化视觉真实感，并未明确约束底层3D场景状态，导致输出结果在球面表面呈现深度不一致、对应关系断裂和运动不合理的现象。我们通过将全景视频生成视为几何和动力学一致的潜在状态建模问题而非纯粹的视觉合成，解决了这一差距。基于预训练的透视视频世界模型，我们引入了两个轻量级正则化项：针对伪全景深度值的深度一致性损失，以及监督跨时间追踪点3D世界帧位置轨迹一致性损失。我们进一步对条件和位置编码应用了球形几何感知适配。此外，我们引入了 PanoGeo，这是一个统一的全景视频数据集，包含来自多种真实和合成来源的深度、轨迹和提示注释，用于训练和分层评估。实验表明，PanoWorld 在保持竞争性视觉真实感的同时，提高了几何一致性，确立了全景视频生成必须被视为几何建模问题，以支持具身人工智能应用的整体空间理解需求。代码可在 https://github.com/ostadabbas/PanoWorld 获取。

Abstract

We present PanoWorld, a panoramic video world model that generates geometry-consistent 360$\degree$ video from a single image and a caption. Existing panoramic video methods optimize primarily for visual realism and do not explicitly constrain the underlying 3D scene state, producing outputs that appear plausible yet exhibit inconsistent depth, broken correspondences, and implausible motion across the spherical surface. We address this gap by framing panoramic video generation as a geometry- and dynamics-consistent latent state modeling problem rather than pure visual synthesis. Building on a pre-trained perspective video world model, we introduce two lightweight regularizers: a depth consistency loss against pseudo ground-truth panoramic depth, and a trajectory consistency loss that supervises the 3D world-frame positions of tracked points across time. We further apply spherical-geometry-aware adaptation to the conditioning and positional encoding. We additionally introduce PanoGeo, a unified geometry-aware panoramic video dataset with consistent depth, trajectory, and prompt annotations across diverse real and synthetic sources, used for both training and stratified evaluation. Experiments show that PanoWorld improves geometric consistency over prior panoramic generation methods while maintaining competitive visual realism, establishing that panoramic video generation must be treated as a geometric modeling problem to support the holistic spatial understanding requirements of embodied AI applications. Code is available at https://github.com/ostadabbas/PanoWorld.

item.title: ELDOR: A Dataset and Benchmark for Illegal Gold Mining in the Amazon Rainforest
item.author: Kangning Cui, Surendra Bohara, Suraj Prasai, Zishan Shao, Wei Tang, Martin Pillaca, Edwin Flores, Zhen Yang, Gregory Larsen, Evan Dethier, David Lutz, Jean-Michel Morel, Miles Silman, Victor Pauca, Fan Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ELDOR是一个用于非法黄金开采监测的大规模无人机基准数据集，包含超过2500公顷的手动标注正射影像，支持语义分割、分割衍生识别、直接多标签分类和类存在识别四种基准任务。

背景: 非法黄金开采导致亚马逊雨林森林砍伐、水污染和长期生态系统破坏，但难以在精细空间尺度上进行监测。卫星影像支持大规模观测，但往往遗漏小型采矿相关结构和细微的土地覆盖变化，特别是在频繁云层覆盖的情况下。

目的: 介绍ELDOR，一个用于监测雨林非法黄金开采造成的环境和景观干扰的大规模无人机基准。建立四种基准任务，并比较通用和遥感专用分割模型、视觉基础模型相关分割方法、直接多标签分类方法和视觉语言模型。

方法: ELDOR包含手动标注的正射影像，覆盖超过2500公顷，具有采矿相关活动和周围生态结构的像素级语义标签。在受控的封闭集协议下，比较了通用和遥感专用分割模型、视觉基础模型相关分割方法、直接多标签分类方法和视觉语言模型。

主要发现: 当前方法在处理稀有的小型采矿结构和细粒度的恢复类别方面仍然困难，表明需要上下文感知和多模态建模。

结论: 为了支持领域分析和实际使用，构建了一个交互式探索器，为领域专家提供数据探索和模型推理的统一界面。

翻译: 非法黄金开采在亚马逊雨林中导致森林砍伐、水污染和长期生态系统破坏，但在精细空间尺度上仍然难以监测。卫星影像支持大规模观测，但往往遗漏小型采矿相关结构和细微的土地覆盖变化，特别是在频繁云层覆盖的情况下。我们介绍了ELDOR，一个用于监测雨林非法黄金开采造成的环境和景观干扰的大规模无人机基准。ELDOR包含手动标注的正射影像，覆盖超过2500公顷，具有采矿相关活动和周围生态结构的像素级语义标签。利用这一统一的标注来源，我们建立了四种基准任务：语义分割、分割衍生识别、直接多标签分类和类存在识别。在这些任务中，我们在受控的封闭集协议下比较了通用和遥感专用分割模型、视觉基础模型相关分割方法、直接多标签分类方法和视觉语言模型。结果显示，当前方法在处理稀有的小型采矿结构和细粒度的恢复类别方面仍然困难，表明需要上下文感知和多模态建模。为了支持领域分析和实际使用，我们进一步构建了一个交互式探索器，为领域专家提供数据探索和模型推理的统一界面。

Abstract

Illegal gold mining in the Amazon rainforest causes deforestation, water contamination, and long-term ecosystem disruption, yet remains difficult to monitor at fine spatial scales. Satellite imagery supports large-scale observation, but often misses small mining-related structures and subtle land-cover transitions, especially under frequent cloud cover. We introduce ELDOR, a large-scale UAV benchmark for monitoring environmental and landscape disturbance from illegal gold mining in the rainforest. ELDOR contains manually annotated orthomosaic imagery covering over 2,500 hectares, with pixel-level semantic labels for both mining-related activities and surrounding ecological structures. With this unified annotation source, we establish four benchmark tasks: semantic segmentation, segmentation-derived recognition, direct multi-label classification, and class-presence recognition with vision-language models. Across these tasks, we compare generic and remote-sensing-specific segmentation models, vision foundation model-related segmentation methods, direct multi-label classification methods, and vision-language models under a controlled closed-set protocol. Results show that current methods still struggle with rare small-scale mining structures and fine-grained recovery classes, suggesting the need for context-aware and multimodal modeling. To support domain analysis and practical use, we further build an interactive explorer for domain experts that provides a unified interface for data exploration and model inference.

item.title: Social-Mamba: Socially-Aware Trajectory Forecasting with State-Space Models
item.author: Po-Chien Luan, Wuyang Li, Yang Gao, Alexandre Alahi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Social-Mamba的新架构，用于在拥挤环境中进行人类轨迹预测。该方法通过将社交互动重新表述为结构化顺序过程，利用Cycle Mamba模块实现连续的双向信息流，从而在保持高精度的同时提高了计算效率和参数效率。

背景: 人类轨迹预测对于拥挤环境中的安全导航至关重要。虽然注意力机制能有效捕捉复杂依赖关系，但计算成本随邻居数量增加而呈二次方增长。选择性状态空间模型虽然提供线性时间替代方案，但其顺序设计与社交互动的非结构化和动态性质不匹配。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在计算效率和模型设计上的不足，提出Social-Mamba架构，以实现更准确、高效的人类轨迹预测。

方法: Social-Mamba将社交互动重新表述为结构化顺序过程，核心是Cycle Mamba模块，实现连续双向信息流。该方法将智能体组织在以自我为中心的网格上，引入社交三元组分解，将互动分解为时间、自我中心和目标中心扫描，并通过可学习的社交门和全局扫描动态集成这些扫描。

主要发现: 在五个轨迹预测基准测试中，Social-Mamba实现了最先进的精度，同时提供了优越的参数效率和计算可扩展性。将Social-Mamba嵌入流匹配框架进一步增强了准确性和效率。

结论: Social-Mamba作为一种灵活且稳健的基础，为未来的轨迹预测研究提供了有力支持。代码已公开。

翻译: 人类轨迹预测对于拥挤环境中的安全导航至关重要，需要平衡准确性与计算效率的模型。高效建模社交互动是密集人群中性能的关键。然而，大多数最近的方法依赖于注意力机制，虽然能有效捕捉复杂依赖，但计算成本随邻居数量增加而呈二次方增长，难以扩展。最近，选择性状态空间模型提供了线性时间替代方案；然而，其固有的顺序设计与社交互动的非结构化和动态性质不匹配。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了Social-Mamba，一种重新表述社交互动为结构化顺序过程的轨迹预测架构。其核心是Cycle Mamba块，一个能够实现连续双向信息流的新颖模块。Social-Mamba将智能体组织在以自我为中心的网格上，并引入社交三元组分解，将互动分解为时间、自我中心和目标中心扫描。这些通过可学习的社交门和全局扫描动态集成，以生成准确且高效的轨迹预测。在五个轨迹预测基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Social-Mamba实现了最先进的精度，同时提供了优越的参数效率和计算可扩展性。此外，将Social-Mamba嵌入流匹配框架进一步增强了准确性和效率，将其确立为未来轨迹预测研究灵活且稳健的基础。代码已公开：https://github.com/vita-epfl/Social-Mamba

Abstract

Human trajectory forecasting is crucial for safe navigation in crowded environments, requiring models that balance accuracy with computational efficiency. Efficiently modeling social interactions is key to performance in dense crowds. Yet, most recent methods rely on attention mechanisms, which are effective at capturing complex dependencies, but incur quadratic computational costs that scale poorly with the growing number of neighbors. Recently, Selective State-Space Models have provided a linear-time alternative; however, their inherently sequential design is misaligned with the unstructured and dynamic nature of social interactions. To address this challenge, we propose Social-Mamba, a forecasting architecture that reformulates social interactions as structured sequential processes. At its core is the Cycle Mamba block, a novel module that enables continuous bidirectional information flow. Social-Mamba organizes agents on an egocentric grid and introduces social triplet factorization, which decomposes interactions into temporal, egocentric, and goal-centric scans. These are dynamically integrated through a learnable social gate and global scan to generate accurate and efficient trajectory predictions. Extensive experiments on five trajectory forecasting benchmarks show that Social-Mamba achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while offering superior parameter efficiency and computational scalability. Furthermore, embedding Social-Mamba into a flow-matching framework further enhances both accuracy and efficiency, establishing it as a flexible and robust foundation for future trajectory forecasting research. The code is publicly available: https://github.com/vita-epfl/Social-Mamba

item.title: Differentially Private Motif-Preserving Multi-modal Hashing
item.author: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DMP-MH提出了一种去隐私化再蒸馏的框架，通过确定性裁剪节点度数来限制敏感度，生成受保护的合成图，并利用双重哈希网络进行跨模态对齐，在严格归纳协议下优于现有方法。

背景: 跨模态哈希方法依赖用户交互产生的语义相似性图进行监督，但这些图包含易受链接重建攻击的敏感行为模式。现有隐私保护方法在图结构数据上失效：差分隐私SGD破坏关系模式，图合成方法在无标度网络中存在不受限的局部敏感度，导致中心节点修改引起三角形计数变化过大，需注入大量噪声。

目的: 提出DMP-MH框架，将隐私与表示学习解耦，通过确定性裁剪节点度数限制敏感度，生成受保护的合成图，并利用双重哈希网络进行跨模态对齐。

方法: 首先通过确定性裁剪节点度数限制敏感度，独立于数据集大小；然后通过在(ε,δ)-边差分隐私下使用噪声镜像下降生成受保护的合成图；最后利用双重哈希网络通过整体结构损失强制跨模态对齐。

主要发现: 在MIRFlickr-25K和NUS-WIDE数据集上，DMP-MH在严格归纳协议下优于私有基线，mAP提升高达11.4个百分点，同时保留高达92.5%的非私有性能。

结论: DMP-MH框架有效解决了图结构数据中的隐私保护问题，在保持高性能的同时显著提升了安全性。

翻译: Cross-modal hashing enables efficient retrieval by encoding images and text into compact binary codes. State-of-the-art methods rely on semantic similarity graphs derived from user interactions for supervision, yet these graphs encode sensitive behavioral patterns vulnerable to link reconstruction attacks. Existing privacy-preserving approaches fail on graph-structured data: Differentially Private SGD destroys relational motifs by treating samples independently, while graph synthesis methods suffer from unbounded local sensitivity in scale-free networks, hub nodes cause single-edge modifications to alter triangle counts by $ext{O}(N)$, necessitating prohibitive noise injection. We term this phenomenon Hubness Explosion. We propose DMP-MH, a Sanitize-then-Distill framework that decouples privacy from representation learning. Our approach first bounds sensitivity by deterministically clipping node degrees, capping the $L_2$-sensitivity of triangle motifs independently of dataset size. A sanitized synthetic graph is then generated via Noisy Mirror Descent under $(ε,δ)$-Edge Differential Privacy. Finally, dual-stream hashing networks distill this topology using a holistic structural loss that enforces cross-modal alignment. Evaluated on MIRFlickr-25K and NUS-WIDE under a strict inductive protocol, DMP-MH outperforms private baselines by up to 11.4 mAP points while retaining up to 92.5% of non-private performance.

Abstract

Cross-modal hashing enables efficient retrieval by encoding images and text into compact binary codes. State-of-the-art methods rely on semantic similarity graphs derived from user interactions for supervision, yet these graphs encode sensitive behavioral patterns vulnerable to link reconstruction attacks. Existing privacy-preserving approaches fail on graph-structured data: Differentially Private SGD destroys relational motifs by treating samples independently, while graph synthesis methods suffer from unbounded local sensitivity in scale-free networks, hub nodes cause single-edge modifications to alter triangle counts by $\mathcal{O}(N)$, necessitating prohibitive noise injection. We term this phenomenon Hubness Explosion. We propose DMP-MH, a Sanitize-then-Distill framework that decouples privacy from representation learning. Our approach first bounds sensitivity by deterministically clipping node degrees, capping the $L_2$-sensitivity of triangle motifs independently of dataset size. A sanitized synthetic graph is then generated via Noisy Mirror Descent under $(ε,δ)$-Edge Differential Privacy. Finally, dual-stream hashing networks distill this topology using a holistic structural loss that enforces cross-modal alignment. Evaluated on MIRFlickr-25K and NUS-WIDE under a strict inductive protocol, DMP-MH outperforms private baselines by up to 11.4 mAP points while retaining up to 92.5% of non-private performance.

item.title: Toward World Modeling of Physiological Signals with Chaos-Theoretic Balancing and Latent Dynamics
item.author: Yunfei Luo, Xi Chen, Yuliang Chen, Lanshuang Zhang, Md Mofijul Islam, Siwei Zhao, Peter Kotanko, Subhasis Dasgupta, Andrew Campbell, Rakesh Malhotra, Tauhidur Rahman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为NormWear-2的世界模型，旨在通过编码多变量生理信号和临床干预变量来预测生理信号的长期演变。

背景: 现有的建模研究主要关注静态任务，如分类、事件预测或短期预测，而生理信号的长期信号级预测和预测性质尚未得到充分探索。

目的: 引入NormWear-2，构建一个能够编码多变量生理信号和临床干预变量并建模其联合时间演变的动态系统世界模型，以实现跨多个时间尺度的连贯预测。

方法: 该方法结合了先验预训练知识的推理和非参数潜在状态转换的即时适应，在预训练阶段利用混沌理论平衡动态系统多样性以获得更稳健的表示。

主要发现: 较小的平衡语料库在性能上优于两倍大小的语料库，并能够捕获分岔状态；NormWear-2在时间、频率和潜在表示域上均取得了最佳预测性能，显著优于最先进的时间序列基础模型。

结论: NormWear-2在保持竞争力的下游表示质量的同时，实现了生理信号通用世界模型的重要一步。

翻译: 生理时间序列信号反映了人体复杂、多尺度的动态过程。现有的建模研究主要关注分类、事件预测或短期预测等静态任务，而生理信号的长期信号级预测和预测性质尚未得到充分探索。我们介绍了NormWear-2，这是一个世界模型，它将多变量生理信号和临床干预变量编码到共享的潜在空间中，并将它们的联合时间演变建模为一个动态系统。我们的方法结合了来自先验预训练知识的推理（直觉）和即时的非参数潜在状态转换适应（洞察），使得能够在多种时间尺度上，在异质临床干预条件下进行连贯的预测。在预训练阶段，我们发现混沌理论的动态系统多样性平衡产生了更稳健的表示，较小的平衡语料库在性能上优于两倍大小的语料库，并能够捕获分岔状态。我们在涵盖日常生活、现场护理和临床设置的各种现实世界生理数据集上评估了世界模型的性能，包括健身规划、血液透析、糖尿病管理和手术监测。这些评估数据集包括来自8,026名受试者的记录，研究持续时间从高分辨率信号数据的3.2小时到纵向临床生物标志物跟踪的2.3年不等。NormWear-2在时间、频率和潜在表示域上均取得了最佳的整体预测性能，显著优于最先进的时间序列基础模型，同时保持了竞争力的下游表示质量，为生理信号的通用世界模型迈出了一步。

Abstract

Physiological time series signals reflect complex, multi-scale dynamical processes of the human body. Existing modeling studies focus on static tasks such as classification, event forecasting, or short-horizon next step prediction, while long-horizon signal-level forecasting and predictive nature of physiological signals remain underexplored. We introduce NormWear-2, a world model that encodes both multivariate physiological signals and clinical intervention variables into a shared latent space and models their joint temporal evolution as a dynamical system. Our approach combines inference from prior pre-trained knowledge (intuition) with instant non-parametric latent state transition adaptation (insight), enabling coherent forecasting across multiple temporal scales, conditioned on heterogeneous clinical interventions. During the pretraining phase, we find that chaos-theoretic balancing of dynamical regime diversity yields more robust representations, with a smaller balanced corpus outperforming one twice its size and capturing bifurcation regimes. We evaluate the world model performance across diverse real-world physiological datasets spanning heterogeneous temporal resolutions and intervention regimes, covering daily life, point-of-care, and clinical settings, including fitness planning, hemodialysis, diabetes management, and surgical monitoring. These evaluation datasets comprise records from 8,026 subjects, spanning study durations from 3.2 hours for high-resolution signal data to 2.3 years for longitudinal clinical biomarker tracking. NormWear-2 achieves the best overall forecasting performance across time, frequency, and latent representation domains, with significant improvements over state-of-the-art time series foundation models, while maintaining competitive downstream representation quality, providing a step toward general-purpose world models for physiological signals.

item.title: SurvivalPFN: Amortizing Survival Prediction via In-Context Bayesian Inference
item.author: Shi-ang Qi, Vahid Balazadeh, Michael Cooper, Russell Greiner, Rahul G. Krishnan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SurvivalPFN是一个通过上下文学习实现贝叶斯推断的先验数据拟合网络，旨在简化生存分析中合适估计器的选择。

背景: 生存分析提供了在存在删失情况下建模时间到事件结果的强大统计框架，但选择合适的估计器需要大量的方法论和领域专业知识。

目的: 引入SurvivalPFN，通过上下文学习对删失观测进行贝叶斯推断的摊销，使模型能够在单次前向传递中进行生存分析。

方法: SurvivalPFN在多样化的合成、可识别和右删失数据生成过程上进行了预训练，能够在推理过程中适应每个数据集的有效复杂性，无需特定任务训练或超参数调整，避免了严格的参数假设。

主要发现: 在涵盖61个数据集、21种方法和5个评估指标的广泛基准测试中，SurvivalPFN实现了强大的预测性能，并且经常优于现有的生存模型。

结论: SurvivalPFN为生存分析提供了一个原则性和实用的基础模型，具有在医疗保健、金融和工程等高影响力领域应用的潜力。

翻译: 摘要：生存分析提供了在存在删失情况下建模时间到事件结果的强大统计框架。然而，从许多专门的生存方法中选择合适的估计器通常需要大量的方法论和领域专业知识。我们介绍了SurvivalPFN，这是一个通过上下文学习对删失观测进行贝叶斯推断的先验数据拟合网络。SurvivalPFN在多样化的合成、可识别和右删失数据生成过程上进行了预训练，使其能够在推理过程中通过单次前向传递摊销生存分析。因此，该模型适应每个数据集的有效复杂性，而无需特定任务训练或超参数调整，避免了严格的参数假设，并产生校准的生存分布。在涵盖61个数据集、21种方法和5个评估指标的广泛基准测试中，SurvivalPFN实现了强大的预测性能，并且经常优于现有的生存模型。这些结果表明，SurvivalPFN为生存分析提供了一个原则性和实用的基础模型，具有在医疗保健、金融和工程等高影响力领域应用的潜力。

Abstract

Survival analysis provides a powerful statistical framework for modeling time-to-event outcomes in the presence of censoring. However, selecting an appropriate estimator from the many specialized survival approaches often requires substantial methodological and domain expertise. We introduce SurvivalPFN, a prior-data fitted network that amortizes Bayesian inference for censored observations through in-context learning. SurvivalPFN is pretrained on a diverse family of synthetic, identifiable, and right-censored data-generating processes, enabling it to amortize survival analysis in a single forward pass during inference. As a result, the model adapts to the effective complexity of each dataset without task-specific training or hyperparameter tuning, avoids restrictive parametric assumptions, and produces calibrated survival distributions. In a large-scale benchmark spanning 61 datasets, 21 methods, and 5 evaluation metrics, SurvivalPFN achieves strong predictive performance and often improves upon established survival models. These results suggest that SurvivalPFN offers a principled and practical foundation model for survival analysis, with potential applications in high-impact domains such as healthcare, finance, and engineering (https://github.com/rgklab/SurvivalPFN).

item.title: Learning Dynamic Structural Specialization for Underwater Salient Object Detection
item.author: Lin Hong, Chenhui Wang, Linan Deng, Yuning Cui, Yu Zhang, Xin Wang, Bojian Zhang, Wenqi Ren, Xingchen Yang, Fumin Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于动态结构特化的水下显著目标检测方法，通过分解共享基表示并动态协调边界敏感和区域连贯分支来提高检测精度

背景: 水下视觉场景理解和机器人应用需要水下显著目标检测，但现有方法在处理水下图像退化时面临定位不准确、显著区域碎片化和边界预测粗糙的挑战

目的: 解决现有水下显著目标检测方法在处理水下图像退化时的挑战，提高目标定位准确性和显著区域完整性

方法: 提出DSS-USOD方法，从单张水下图像提取共享基表示，分解为边界敏感分支和区域连贯分支，引入空间协调模块根据局部结构上下文动态调节两个分支的贡献，并采用合作结构监督促进分支特化和稳定空间协调

主要发现: 在基准数据集上实现了优越的性能，并在水下机器人上进行了实际部署验证了其有效性

结论: DSS-USOD能够更好地平衡边界精度和区域连贯性，在退化水下条件下表现优异

翻译: Underwater salient object detection (USOD) has attracted increasing attention for underwater visual scene understanding and vision-guided robotic applications. However, existing USOD methods still struggle with underwater image degradations, which often lead to inaccurate object localization, fragmented salient regions, and coarse boundary prediction. To address these challenges, this paper proposes DSS-USOD, a novel RGB-based USOD method built upon dynamic structural specialization. DSS-USOD extracts a shared base representation from a single underwater image, decomposes it into boundary-sensitive and region-coherent structural features, and dynamically coordinates their contributions according to local structural context. Specifically, the extracted shared base representation is decomposed into a boundary-sensitive branch for modeling fine-grained boundary details and a region-coherent branch for capturing region-level structural consistency. A spatial coordination module is then introduced to adaptively regulate the relative contributions of the two branches according to local structural context. Moreover, cooperative structural supervision is introduced to promote branch specialization and stabilize spatial coordination, enabling DSS-USOD to better balance boundary precision and region coherence under degraded underwater conditions. Extensive experiments show that DSS-USOD achieves superior performance on benchmark datasets. Finally, real-world deployment on an underwater robot validates the practical effectiveness of DSS-USOD for underwater object inspection.

Abstract

Underwater salient object detection (USOD) has attracted increasing attention for underwater visual scene understanding and vision-guided robotic applications. However, existing USOD methods still struggle with underwater image degradations, which often lead to inaccurate object localization, fragmented salient regions, and coarse boundary prediction. To address these challenges, this paper proposes DSS-USOD, a novel RGB-based USOD method built upon dynamic structural specialization. DSS-USOD extracts a shared base representation from a single underwater image, decomposes it into boundary-sensitive and region-coherent structural features, and dynamically coordinates their contributions according to local structural context. Specifically, the extracted shared base representation is decomposed into a boundary-sensitive branch for modeling fine-grained boundary details and a region-coherent branch for capturing region-level structural consistency. A spatial coordination module is then introduced to adaptively regulate the relative contributions of the two branches according to local structural context. Moreover, cooperative structural supervision is introduced to promote branch specialization and stabilize spatial coordination, enabling DSS-USOD to better balance boundary precision and region coherence under degraded underwater conditions. Extensive experiments show that DSS-USOD achieves superior performance on benchmark datasets. Finally, real-world deployment on an underwater robot validates the practical effectiveness of DSS-USOD for underwater object inspection.

item.title: NavRL++: A System-Level Framework for Improving Sim-to-Real Transfer in Reinforcement Learning-Based Robot Navigation
item.author: Zhefan Xu, Hanyu Jin, Kenji Shimada
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种强化学习导航框架及完整的训练部署流程，通过系统性实证研究分析了影响仿真到现实迁移的关键因素，并提出了一种扰动感知微调策略和基于Transformer的时间推理策略，在多种机器人平台上实现了零样本仿真到现实迁移。

背景: 近年来强化学习在自主导航领域取得了显著进展，但现有方法主要关注框架设计，对仿真到现实迁移的分析不足，且缺乏对训练策略如何影响现实部署性能的深入洞察。

目的: 为了弥合这一差距，本文不仅引入了有效的强化学习框架，还提出了完整的训练和部署流程，并进行了系统性实证研究以解耦影响强化学习导航仿真到现实迁移的关键因素。

方法: 1. 引入扰动感知微调策略，通过显式考虑经验识别的域差异来提高迁移鲁棒性；2. 提出基于Transformer的时间推理策略，利用短视距观察进行导航控制，以减轻感知降级并增强控制平滑度；3. 在多个机器人平台上进行实验验证。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，所提出的训练策略和策略架构在静态和动态环境中均优于基于学习的基线，在静态设置中性能可与基于优化的规划器相媲美，并实现了零样本仿真到现实迁移。

结论: 本文的研究验证了所提出的方法在多种机器人平台上的有效性，能够有效解决仿真到现实迁移中的问题。

翻译: 近年来，强化学习在自主导航方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有方法大多强调强化学习框架的设计，如输入表示、动作空间和奖励函数，而对仿真到现实迁移的分析有限，且对训练策略如何影响现实部署性能的洞察不足。为了弥合这一差距，我们不仅引入了一种有效的强化学习框架，还提出了完整的训练和部署流程，以及一项系统性实证研究，该研究解耦了影响强化学习导航仿真到现实迁移的关键因素，包括传感器噪声、感知故障、系统延迟和控制响应。基于对这些因素的分析，我们引入了扰动感知微调，这是一种后训练适应策略，通过显式考虑经验识别的域差异来提高迁移鲁棒性。为了进一步减轻现实部署中的感知降级并增强控制平滑度，我们提出了一种基于Transformer的时间推理策略，该策略利用短视距观察进行导航控制。我们在静态和动态环境中定量评估了单个仿真到现实扰动和训练设计选择如何影响导航性能。实验结果表明，所提出的训练策略和策略架构在静态和动态环境中均优于基于学习的基线，在静态设置中性能可与基于优化的规划器相媲美。我们在包括空中和足式机器人在内的多个机器人平台上通过导航中心任务（如探索和检查）验证了我们的方法，证明了零样本仿真到现实迁移。

Abstract

Recent years have witnessed significant progress in autonomous navigation using reinforcement learning. However, existing approaches largely emphasize reinforcement learning framework design, such as input representations, action spaces, and reward functions, while providing limited analysis of sim-to-real transfer and insufficient insight into how training strategies affect real-world deployment performance. To bridge this gap, we not only introduce an effective RL framework but also present a complete training and deployment pipeline, along with a systematic empirical study that disentangles the key factors affecting sim-to-real transfer in reinforcement learning-based navigation, including sensor noise, perception failures, system latency, and control response. Building on insights from this analysis, we introduce perturbation-aware fine-tuning, a post-training adaptation strategy that improves transfer robustness by explicitly accounting for empirically identified domain discrepancies. To further mitigate perception degradation and enhance control smoothness in real-world deployment, we propose a Transformer-based temporal reasoning policy that leverages short-horizon observation for navigation control. We quantitatively evaluate how individual sim-to-real perturbations and training design choices impact navigation performance across environments. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed training strategy and policy architecture outperform learning-based baselines in both static and dynamic environments, while achieving performance comparable to optimization-based planners in static settings. We validate our approach through real-world deployment on multiple robotic platforms, including aerial and legged robots, across navigation-centric tasks such as exploration and inspection, demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

item.title: MaxSketch: Robust Distinct Counting in Streams via Random Projections
item.author: Nikos Tsikouras, Constantine Caramanis, Christos Tzamos
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MaxSketch的方法，用于在高维噪声数据流中估计不同元素的数量。该方法利用了学习表示中常见的几何结构，通过随机高维投影构建了一个简单的最大线性草图，从而在保证估计精度的情况下显著降低了内存消耗。

背景: 在现代设置中，观测数据是高维且嘈杂的，重复出现的同一对象仅是近似相似的。传统的草图算法如HyperLogLog依赖于相同元素的一致哈希值，在这种环境下会失效。

目的: 在高维噪声数据流中，利用学习表示中常见的几何结构，提出一种能够有效估计不同元素数量的方法，以解决传统算法在近似相似性数据下的失效问题。

方法: 引入了MaxSketch，这是一种基于随机高维投影构建的简单最大线性草图。该方法利用了数据流中不同对象在潜在空间中的几何结构。

主要发现: 在几何结构假设下，使用$m = ilde{O} (rac{ext{log} n}{ext{ε}^2})$个随机投影（以及相应的内存）足以以$(1+ext{ε})$的因子恢复真实的不同计数。实验结果表明MaxSketch能准确估计图像流中的不同计数，并能在训练范围之外泛化。

结论: MaxSketch证明了利用几何结构可以显著降低不同计数问题的复杂度。该研究架起了经典流式算法与现代表示学习之间的桥梁，展示了如何通过几何结构从根本上减少不同计数的复杂性。

翻译: 在高维噪声数据流中估计不同元素的数量是一个在重复元素完全相同时已被充分理解的问题。然而，在现代设置中，观测数据是高维且嘈杂的，因此同一对象的重复实例仅是近似相似的——例如，同一个人的不同图像在像素级别上可能有显著差异。像HyperLogLog这样的经典草图依赖于相同元素的一致哈希值，在这种环境下会失效。在一般度量空间中关于鲁棒不同计数的近期工作实现了$ilde{Θ}(ext{√n})$的内存，这在最坏情况下是紧的。我们表明，在常见于学习表示的几何结构下，可以实现 substantially improved memory guarantees。我们介绍了MaxSketch，这是一种由随机高维投影构建的简单最大线性草图，并证明了它能够成功估计不同潜在对象的数量。具体来说，我们证明了在这种假设下，$m = ilde{O} (rac{ext{log} n}{ext{ε}^2})$个随机投影（以及因此$ilde{O} (rac{ext{log} n}{ext{ε}^2})$的内存）足以以$(1+ext{ε})$的因子恢复真实的不同计数。在图像流上的实验证实，MaxSketch能准确估计不同计数，并能在训练范围之外泛化。我们的结果架起了经典流式算法和现代表示学习之间的桥梁，展示了几何结构如何从根本上减少不同计数的复杂性。

Abstract

Estimating the number of distinct elements in a data stream is well understood when repeated elements are identical. In modern settings, however, observations are high-dimensional and noisy, so repeated instances of the same object are only approximately similar -- for example, different images of the same individual may vary significantly at the pixel level. Classical sketches such as HyperLogLog rely on consistent hash values for identical elements and break down in this regime. Recent work on robust distinct counting in general metric spaces achieves $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{n})$ memory, which is tight in the worst case. We show that substantially improved memory guarantees are possible under geometric structure common in learned representations. We introduce MaxSketch, a simple max-linear sketch built from random Gaussian projections, and prove that it succeeds in estimating the number of distinct latent objects. Concretely, we show that under this assumption $m = \widetilde{O} (\log n / \varepsilon^2)$ random projections (and hence $\widetilde{O} (\log n/\varepsilon^2)$ memory) suffice to recover the true distinct count within a $(1+\varepsilon)$ factor. Experiments on image streams confirm that MaxSketch accurately estimates distinct counts and generalizes beyond the training regime. Our results bridge classical streaming algorithms and modern representation learning, showing how geometric structure can fundamentally reduce the complexity of distinct counting.

item.title: STAR: A Stage-attributed Triage and Repair framework for RCA Agents in Microservices
item.author: Junle Wang, Xingchuang Liao, Wenjun Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为STAR的框架，用于修复基于大语言模型的根因分析代理在微服务AIOps中的错误推理轨迹。

背景: 基于大语言模型的根因分析代理在微服务AIOps中具有前景，但其可靠性脆弱，早期证据收集、假设形成或因果分析中的错误会传播并破坏最终诊断。

目的: 为了提高根因分析代理的可靠性，本文提出了STAR框架，旨在修复错误的根因分析轨迹。

方法: STAR框架将根因分析工作流显式分解为四个结构化阶段：证据包、假设集、分析结构和决策报告。它基于LangGraph，执行分阶段审计、预算感知的快速/慢速路由、通过反事实候选评估进行决定性阶段定位以及特定阶段的修补和重放。

主要发现: 在公共大规模基准和真实生产数据集上的评估显示，STAR在根因定位和故障类型分类方面均优于强基线。STAR能高精度地识别出有故障的阶段，并在一或两轮重放中修复大多数初始错误的轨迹，且从快速/慢速路由和反事实阶段评估中受益显著。

结论: 明确建模根因分析代理在何处失败是通往可靠、可调试和自修复代理根因分析系统的有效路径。

翻译: 基于大语言模型的根因分析代理在微服务AIOps中具有前景，但其可靠性脆弱。本文提出了STAR框架，将根因分析工作流分解为四个结构化阶段，并基于LangGraph进行分阶段审计和修复。实验表明，STAR能提高诊断准确性，高精度定位故障阶段，并在一或两轮内修复错误轨迹，明确建模失败位置是构建可靠系统的有效路径。

Abstract

LLM-based root cause analysis (RCA) agents have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for incident diagnosis in microservice AIOps. However, their reliability remains fragile: an error in early evidence collection, hypothesis formulation, or causal analysis can propagate through the reasoning trace and eventually corrupt the final diagnosis. In this paper, we present \textbf{STAR}, a \emph{Stage-attributed Triage and Repair} framework for repairing erroneous RCA traces. STAR explicitly decomposes an RCA workflow into four structured stages, namely \emph{Evidence Package} (EP), \emph{Hypothesis Set} (HS), \emph{Analysis Structure} (AS), and \emph{Decision Report} (DR), and treats agent failure as a stage-localizable reasoning bug rather than a monolithic end-to-end error. Built on top of LangGraph, STAR performs stage-wise auditing, budget-aware \emph{Fast/Slow Routing}, \emph{decisive stage localization via counterfactual candidate evaluation}, and stage-specific patch-and-replay repair. We evaluate STAR on a public large-scale benchmark and a real-world production dataset, using two RCA agent workflows and three foundation models. Experimental results show that STAR consistently improves both root cause localization and fault type classification over strong baselines. Moreover, STAR identifies the decisive faulty stage with high accuracy, repairs most initially incorrect traces within one or two replay rounds, and benefits substantially from both Fast/Slow Routing and counterfactual stage evaluation. These results suggest that explicitly modeling \emph{where} an RCA agent fails is an effective path toward reliable, debuggable, and self-repairing agentic RCA systems.

item.title: Efficient Image Synthesis with Sphere Latent Encoder
item.author: Do, Tung, Nguyen, Thuan Hoang, Li, Hao
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的图像生成方法，通过将框架解耦为固定的预训练图像编码器和独立的球形潜空间去噪模型，解决了现有方法在计算效率和目标冲突方面的问题。

背景: 现有的少步图像生成方法（如一致性方法和基于平均流的方法）虽然减少了采样步数，但往往面临训练不稳定和可扩展性有限的问题。Sphere Encoder虽然能在几步内生成高质量图像，但在推理过程中需要在像素空间和潜空间之间重复转换，且在单一架构中联合优化重建和生成，导致计算效率低下和目标冲突。

目的: 为了解决Sphere Encoder在计算效率和目标冲突方面的局限性，本文提出了一种新的方法，该方法将框架解耦为固定的预训练图像编码器和独立的球形潜空间去噪模型。

方法: 将框架解耦为固定的预训练图像编码器和独立的球形潜空间去噪模型。这种方法消除了训练和推理过程中的重复像素空间操作，提高了效率，并允许重建和生成独立专业化。

主要发现: 在Animal-Faces、Oxford-Flowers和ImageNet-1K数据集上，该方法在生成质量和推理速度方面显著优于Sphere Encoder，同时与强大的少步和多步基线方法取得了竞争性结果。

结论: 该方法通过解耦框架，显著提高了图像生成的效率和性能，在生成质量和推理速度上均优于Sphere Encoder，并在多个数据集上取得了竞争性结果。

翻译: Few-step图像生成取得了快速进展，一致性和基于平均流的方法显著减少了采样步数。尽管具有低推理成本，但这些方法往往面临训练不稳定和可扩展性有限的问题。Sphere Encoder是一种最近的替代方案，它能在几步内生成高质量图像；然而，它需要在推理过程中在像素空间和潜空间之间重复转换，并在单一架构中联合优化重建和生成。这种设计导致计算效率低下和重建与生成之间的目标冲突。为了解决这些局限性，我们将框架解耦为固定的预训练图像编码器和在球形潜空间中完全训练的独立潜去噪模型。我们的方法消除了训练和推理过程中的重复像素空间操作，提高了效率，并允许重建和生成独立专业化。在Animal-Faces、Oxford-Flowers和ImageNet-1K数据集上，我们的方法在生成质量和推理速度方面显著优于Sphere Encoder，同时与强大的少步和多步基线方法取得了竞争性结果。

Abstract

Few-step image generation has seen rapid progress, with consistency and meanflow-based methods significantly reducing the number of sampling steps. Despite their low inference cost, these approaches often suffer from training instability and limited scalability. Sphere Encoder is a recent alternative that produces high-quality images in only a few steps; however, it requires repeated transitions between the pixel space and latent space during inference while jointly optimizing reconstruction and generation within a single architecture. This design leads to computational inefficiency and objective conflict between reconstruction and generation. To address these limitations, we decouple the framework into a fixed pretrained image encoder and a separate latent denoising model trained entirely in a spherical latent space. Our approach eliminates repeated pixel-space operations during training and inference, improving efficiency and allowing reconstruction and generation to specialize independently. On Animal-Faces, Oxford-Flowers and ImageNet-1K datasets, our method significantly outperforms Sphere Encoder in both generation quality and inference speed, while achieving competitive results against strong few-step and multi-step baselines.

item.title: Dynamic and Open-Set RF Fingerprinting and Localization in Crowded Indoor Environments through Contrastive Channel State Information Learning
item.author: Fawaz Abdul Razak, Yasin Yilmaz
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于CSI的对比学习框架ContraCSI，用于在低成本设备上进行射频指纹识别，并研究了多种编码器架构和开放集认证方法。

背景: 射频指纹识别作为密码学认证的补充方法，具有抗欺骗、重放攻击和密钥泄露的能力。CSI相比IQ样本更易于获取，可通过物理层特征实现设备认证。

目的: 提出ContraCSI框架，利用低成本ESP32设备进行基于CSI的对比学习射频指纹识别，并研究多种编码器架构和开放集认证方法。

方法: 1. 提出ContraCSI框架，使用低成本ESP32设备；2. 研究多种编码器架构：Vision Transformer (ViT)、轻量级3D-CNN (Lite3D-CNN) 和 R3D18；3. 研究开放集认证：使用基于几何熵最小化的异常分数和顺序累积和测试；4. 在真实室内环境中进行实验，模拟动态拥挤环境。

主要发现: 1. 对于封闭集识别，ViT变体表现最佳；2. Lite3D-CNN-Contra能够有效拒绝未见过或未注册的发射机；3. 在高度动态和拥挤的室内环境中具有高认证准确性和强泛化能力；4. CSI可用于室内定位。

结论: ContraCSI框架在非理想条件下表现出色，能够有效拒绝未知发射机，并展示了在室内部署中集成认证和定位的潜力。

翻译: 本文提出了一种基于CSI的对比学习框架ContraCSI，用于在低成本设备上进行射频指纹识别，并研究了多种编码器架构和开放集认证方法。射频指纹识别作为密码学认证的补充方法，具有抗欺骗、重放攻击和密钥泄露的能力。CSI相比IQ样本更易于获取，可通过物理层特征实现设备认证。本文提出ContraCSI框架，利用低成本ESP32设备进行基于CSI的对比学习射频指纹识别，并研究多种编码器架构和开放集认证方法。方法包括：1. 提出ContraCSI框架，使用低成本ESP32设备；2. 研究多种编码器架构：Vision Transformer (ViT)、轻量级3D-CNN (Lite3D-CNN) 和 R3D18；3. 研究开放集认证：使用基于几何熵最小化的异常分数和顺序累积和测试；4. 在真实室内环境中进行实验，模拟动态拥挤环境。主要发现包括：1. 对于封闭集识别，ViT变体表现最佳；2. Lite3D-CNN-Contra能够有效拒绝未见过或未注册的发射机；3. 在高度动态和拥挤的室内环境中具有高认证准确性和强泛化能力；4. CSI可用于室内定位。ContraCSI框架在非理想条件下表现出色，能够有效拒绝未知发射机，并展示了在室内部署中集成认证和定位的潜力。

Abstract

Radio Frequency Fingerprinting (RFF) using deep learning has gained attention as a complementary approach to cryptographic authentication, offering resistance to spoofing, replay attacks, and key leakage. While most RFF approaches rely on In-Phase and Quadrature (IQ) samples, Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a more accessible alternative, enabling device authentication through physical-layer characteristics. In this work, we propose ContraCSI, a CSI-based contrastive learning framework for RFF using low-cost ESP32 devices. We investigate multiple encoder backbones, including a Vision Transformer (ViT), a lightweight 3D-CNN (Lite3D-CNN), and R3D18, to learn joint CSI and device-ID embeddings for transmitter authentication. For closed-set identification, the ViT variants achieve the best overall performance. We further study open-set authentication by applying a Geometric Entropy Minimization (GEM)-based anomaly score and sequential CUSUM (Cumulative Sum) test on embeddings learned by Lite3D-CNN-Contra, enabling rejection of unseen or non-enrolled transmitters rather than forcing a closed-set label. To evaluate robustness in highly dynamic and crowded indoor environments with human motion, multipath fading, and varying device orientations and distances, we conduct extensive experiments in a real-world setting. Our results demonstrate high authentication accuracy, strong generalization in non-ideal conditions, and effective rejection of unknown transmitters. Additionally, we explore CSI-based indoor localization via trilateration, illustrating the potential for integrated authentication and localization in practical indoor deployments.

item.title: CM-EVS: Sparse Panoramic RGB-D-Pose Data for Complete Scene Coverage
item.author: Liu, Jiale, Li, Jungang, Yu, Jieming, Yu, Xinglin, Dongfang, Zihao, Ding, Zongjian, Ding, Kaifeng, Yang, Yi, Chen, Lidong, Zou, Yang, Bai, Shunwen, Zhang, Jiahuan, Huang, Haoran, Huang, Shan, Gao, Yudong, Cheng, Mingjun
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为COVER的训练无关方法，用于将3D资产转换为稀疏、紧凑且可审计的RGB-D-pose全景数据集CM-EVS，以解决现有3D视觉学习数据中冗余高、标注不一致和覆盖不完整的问题。

背景: 现有的3D视觉学习依赖于从度量3D资产中采样的观测，但现有的扫描、网格、点云、模拟和重建数据并未直接提供稀疏、可比且几何一致的全景训练接口。密集轨迹导致附近视图重复，特定源渲染策略产生异质标注，而稀疏启发式方法可能遗漏重要区域或引入深度不一致的观测。

目的: 研究如何将3D资产转换为稀疏的全景RGB-D-pose数据，该数据需保持完整的场景覆盖，同时具有低冗余和可审计的来源。

方法: 提出COVER（Coverage-Oriented Viewpoint curation with ERP Range-depth warping），一种训练无关的全景视角策展人。它从选定视角投影几何到候选ERP探针，评分增量覆盖并惩罚深度冲突。在代理误差有界的情况下，其贪婪覆盖代理保留了标准覆盖风格近似行为。

主要发现: 使用COVER构建的CM-EVS数据集包含来自Blender室内、HM3D和ScanNet++的1,275个室内场景的36,373个策展ERP帧，以及来自TartanGround和OB3D的室外全景图。每个室内场景仅用25帧中位数即可覆盖所有13种统一房间类型，同时保持紧凑的场景级覆盖。COVER改善了覆盖与冲突的权衡。

结论: CM-EVS是一个稀疏、紧凑且可审计的RGB-D-pose资源，适用于几何一致的全景3D学习，COVER方法在覆盖与冲突之间取得了更好的平衡。

翻译: 现代3D视觉学习依赖于从度量3D资产中采样的观测，但现有的扫描、网格、点云、模拟和重建并未直接提供稀疏、可比且几何一致的全景训练接口。密集轨迹导致附近视图重复，特定源渲染策略产生异质标注，而稀疏启发式方法可能遗漏重要区域或引入深度不一致的观测。本研究研究如何将3D资产转换为稀疏的全景RGB-D-pose数据，该数据需保持完整的场景覆盖，同时具有低冗余和可审计的来源。提出COVER（Coverage-Oriented Viewpoint curation with ERP Range-depth warping），一种训练无关的全景视角策展人。它从选定视角投影几何到候选ERP探针，评分增量覆盖并惩罚深度冲突。在代理误差有界的情况下，其贪婪覆盖代理保留了标准覆盖风格近似行为。使用COVER构建的CM-EVS数据集包含来自Blender室内、HM3D和ScanNet++的1,275个室内场景的36,373个策展ERP帧，以及来自TartanGround和OB3D的室外全景图。每个室内场景仅用25帧中位数即可覆盖所有13种统一房间类型，同时保持紧凑的场景级覆盖。实验表明COVER改善了覆盖与冲突的权衡，使CM-EVS成为几何一致的全景3D学习的稀疏、紧凑且可审计的RGB-D-pose资源。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决如何利用稀疏的全景 RGB-D 姿态数据来覆盖完整场景的问题。这在现实和研究中很重要，因为它能帮助机器人和计算机视觉系统更全面地理解环境，从而提升导航和交互的准确性。
