PrivacyReasoning。 * 这些都是安全/对齐论文。 * 但我不能*仅*基于标题推断“为什么重要”（例如，安全对齐是重要的，因为 AI 伤害人类）。那是外部知识。 * 所以，严格来说，答案是“unknown”。 * *最终决定：* 我将输出“unknown”。这是对“如果文中没有明确说明”最准确的遵守。 * *等等，让我再检查一下提示。* “简洁、准确、通俗的中文解释”。 * “unknown”是中文吗？是的。 * 它准确吗？是的。 * 它通俗吗？是的。 * 它简洁吗？是的。 * 它回答问题吗？它回答了“问题是什么？”，通过说“文本没有说”。 * *替代方案：* “输入文本仅包含论文的元数据和结构信息，未提供关于论文主要解决的问题及其重要性的具体内容。” * 这更安全，因为它解释了*为什么*，而不仅仅是说“unknown”。 * 让我们选择解释性句子。 * *实际上，让我们再看一遍提示。* “如果文中没有明确说明，请写 'unknown'”。 * 这条规则通常覆盖“简洁解释”。 * 所以，我将输出“unknown”。 * *等等，让我再检查一下提示。* “回答‘一个’问题”。 * 如果我说“unknown”，我是在回答问题吗？不，我是在说“我不知道”。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了名为 LiSA 的方法，旨在通过保守策略诱导实现终身安全适应。

Abstract

As AI agents move from chat interfaces to systems that read private data, call tools, and execute multi-step workflows, guardrails become a last line of defense against concrete deployment harms. In these settings, guardrail failures are no longer merely answer-quality errors: they can leak secrets, authorize unsafe actions, or block legitimate work. The hardest failures are often contextual: whether an action is acceptable depends on local privacy norms, organizational policies, and user expectations that resist pre-deployment specification. This creates a practical gap: guardrails must adapt to their own operating environments, yet deployment feedback is typically limited to sparse, noisy user-reported failures, and repeated fine-tuning is often impractical. To address this gap, we propose LiSA (Lifelong Safety Adaptation), a conservative policy induction framework that improves a fixed base guardrail through structured memory. LiSA converts occasional failures into reusable policy abstractions so that sparse reports can generalize beyond individual cases, adds conflict-aware local rules to prevent overgeneralization in mixed-label contexts, and applies evidence-aware confidence gating via a posterior lower bound, so that memory reuse scales with accumulated evidence rather than empirical accuracy alone. Across PrivacyLens+, ConFaide+, and AgentHarm, LiSA consistently outperforms strong memory-based baselines under sparse feedback, remains robust under noisy user feedback even at 20% label-flip rates, and pushes the latency--performance frontier beyond backbone model scaling. Ultimately, LiSA offers a practical path to secure AI agents against the unpredictable long tail of real-world edge risks.

item.title: Exploiting LLM Agent Supply Chains via Payload-less Skills
item.author: Xinyu Liu, Yukai Zhao, Xing Hu, Xin Xia
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了Semantic Compliance Hijacking (SCH)攻击方法，通过将恶意目标转化为自然语言指令来绕过现有安全机制，在自主代理环境中实现未经授权的代码生成和执行。

背景: 大型语言模型驱动的自主代理通过第三方技能获取外部功能，这扩大了潜在攻击面。现有的审计机制主要依赖安全扫描来识别显式代码载荷和预定义威胁内容，但无法检测通过代理内在生成能力在运行时动态合成的恶意行为。

目的: 介绍Semantic Compliance Hijacking (SCH)攻击方法，这是一种针对自主编码环境的无载荷供应链攻击，旨在评估该攻击在现实世界中的可行性。

方法: 开发了一个自动化管道，在包含三个主流代理框架和三个不同基础模型的测试矩阵中，使用上下文场景评估SCH攻击的有效性。此外，还引入了Multi-Skill Automated Optimization (MS-AO)技术来优化攻击。

主要发现: SCH攻击具有普遍性，在配置最脆弱的情况下，机密性泄露的成功率高达77.67%，远程代码执行的成功率高达67.33%。引入MS-AO进一步提升了攻击效率，被操纵的技能文件保持了0.00%的检测率，能够绕过当前的扫描工具。

结论: 该研究指出了代理供应链中一个未被充分探索的攻击面，表明需要从基于签名的检测模型转向语义意图验证。

翻译: 该研究提出了Semantic Compliance Hijacking (SCH)攻击方法，通过将恶意目标转化为自然语言指令来绕过现有安全机制，在自主代理环境中实现未经授权的代码生成和执行。

Abstract

Autonomous agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) acquire external functionalities through third-party skills available in open marketplaces. Adopting these integrations broadens the potential attack surface, prompting a need for systematic security evaluation. Current auditing mechanisms are effective at identifying explicit code payloads and predefined threat contents through security scanning. These detection mechanisms are bypassed if malicious behaviors lack direct injection and are instead synthesized dynamically at runtime through the agent's inherent generative capabilities. Exploring this blind spot, we introduce Semantic Compliance Hijacking (SCH), a payload-less supply chain attack targeting autonomous coding environments. The SCH approach translates malicious goals into unstructured natural language instructions formatted as necessary compliance rules, leading the agent to generate and execute unauthorized code. To assess the real-world viability of this attack, we developed an automated pipeline to evaluate its effectiveness across a test matrix comprising three mainstream agent frameworks and three distinct foundation models using contextualized scenarios. The findings demonstrate the pervasive nature of this threat, with SCH achieving peak success rates of up to 77.67% for confidentiality breaches and 67.33% for Remote Code Execution (RCE) under the most vulnerable configurations. Furthermore, the introduction of Multi-Skill Automated Optimization (MS-AO) further boosted attack efficacy. By omitting recognizable Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) signatures and explicit harmful intents, the manipulated skill files maintained a 0.00% detection rate, evading current scanning tools. This research highlights an underexplored attack surface within agent supply chains, pointing to a necessary transition from signature-based detection models toward semantic intent validation.

item.title: From Schema to Signal: Retrieval-Augmented Modeling for Relational Data Analytics
item.author: Lingze Zeng, Shaofeng Cai, Changshuo Liu, Zhongle Xie, Yuncheng Wu, Beng Chin Ooi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为RAM的新框架，结合图结构与属性语义进行关系数据分析

背景: 关系数据库在电商、金融和社会等领域应用广泛，但现有深度神经网络在处理规范化多表结构和复杂表间关系时面临挑战，现有方法往往依赖严格定义的图结构，忽略了元组属性中嵌入的隐式语义信号且连接性僵化

目的: 提出一种名为RAM的新框架，将图结构与属性语义相结合，以解决关系数据库分析的挑战

方法: RAM框架将元组属性视为令牌，使用随机游走构建上下文文档，利用信息检索技术估计元组间的语义相关性；基于文档提出两种基于检索的增强方法：ATRA利用表内相关性进行对比学习，ETRA链接跨表语义相关的元组以增强图连接性；提出一种针对关系数据的逐层模型架构，包括属性嵌入、特征集成和图聚合层

主要发现: 在五个真实世界关系数据库上的广泛实验表明，RAM在各种预测任务中始终优于现有基线

结论: RAM为关系数据分析建立了最先进水平

翻译: 存储在关系数据库中的关系数据是许多跨领域现实世界应用的基础，如电子商务、金融和社会。虽然深度神经网络在单表表格数据上取得了强劲性能，但由于规范化多表结构和复杂的表间关系，将这些模型扩展到关系数据库具有挑战性。现有方法往往严格依赖模式定义的图，忽略了嵌入在元组属性中的隐式语义信号，且连接性僵化。在这项工作中，我们提出了检索增强建模（RAM），一种将图结构与属性语义相结合用于关系数据分析的新颖框架。RAM将元组属性视为令牌，并使用随机游走构建上下文文档，从而能够使用信息检索技术来估计元组之间的语义相关性。基于这些文档，我们引入了两种基于检索的增强：ATRA利用表内相关性进行对比学习，ETRA链接跨表语义相关的元组以增强图连接性。然后，我们提出了一种针对关系数据的逐层模型架构，它涉及属性嵌入、特征集成和图聚合层，以实现表达性和灵活的表示学习。在五个真实世界关系数据库上的广泛实验表明，RAM在各种预测任务中始终优于现有基线，为关系数据分析建立了最先进水平。

Abstract

Relational data stored in RDBMS is foundational to many real-world applications across domains such as e-commerce, finance, and sociality. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved strong performance on tabular data with a single table, extending these models to relational databases is challenging due to the normalized multi-table structure and complex inter-table relationships. Existing approaches often rely strictly on schema-defined graphs, which overlook implicit semantic signals embedded in tuple attributes and suffer from rigid connectivity. In this work, we propose Retrieval-Augmented Modeling (RAM), a novel framework that combines graph structure with attribute semantics for relational data analytics. RAM treats tuple attributes as tokens and uses random walks to construct contextual documents, enabling the use of information retrieval techniques to estimate semantic relevance between tuples. Building on these documents, we introduce two retrieval-based augmentations: ATRA, which leverages intra-table relevance for contrastive learning, and ETRA, which links semantically related tuples across tables to enhance graph connectivity. Then, we propose a layer-wise model architecture tailored for relational data, which involves attribute embedding, feature integration, and graph aggregation layers to enable expressive and flexible representation learning. Extensive experiments on five real-world relational databases demonstrate that RAM consistently outperforms existing baselines in diverse prediction tasks, establishing a state-of-the-art for relational data analytics.

item.title: Reduce the Artifacts Bias for More Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
item.author: Yiheng Li, Yang Yang, Zichang Tan, Gao Li, Zhen Lei, Wenhao Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于GAN的图像上采样方法，结合分离专家融合框架，以解决生成式图像检测中的领域偏移问题。

背景: 随着AI生成图像误用的增加，通用图像检测技术变得紧迫。现有最先进的方法采用对齐训练数据集来减少内容、大小和格式偏差，但基于重建的方法通常引入有限且同质的伪影，无法捕捉多样化的生成模式。

目的: 为了补充基于重建的伪造图像，提出一种基于GAN的上采样方法，以模仿GAN生成的伪造模式，同时保持内容、大小和格式的对齐。

方法: 提出分离专家融合框架，首先通过LoRA适配在冻结的基础模型上训练特定领域的专家，然后通过门控网络进行解耦融合，以自适应地结合专家特征。

主要发现: 该方法引入了多样化的互补伪影模式，使SEF能够学习更稳健的决策边界，并在13个多样化基准测试中表现出色。

结论: 该方法不仅有利于GAN生成图像的检测，还引入了多样化的互补伪影模式，提高了跨更广泛生成方法的泛化能力。

翻译: 随着AI生成图像误用的增加，通用图像检测技术变得紧迫。现有最先进的方法采用对齐训练数据集来减少内容、大小和格式偏差，但基于重建的方法通常引入有限且同质的伪影，无法捕捉多样化的生成模式。为了补充基于重建的伪造图像，提出一种基于GAN的上采样方法，以模仿GAN生成的伪造模式，同时保持内容、大小和格式的对齐。提出分离专家融合框架，首先通过LoRA适配在冻结的基础模型上训练特定领域的专家，然后通过门控网络进行解耦融合，以自适应地结合专家特征。该方法引入了多样化的互补伪影模式，使SEF能够学习更稳健的决策边界，并在13个多样化基准测试中表现出色。该方法不仅有利于GAN生成图像的检测，还引入了多样化的互补伪影模式，提高了跨更广泛生成方法的泛化能力。

Abstract

As the misuse of AI-generated images grows, generalizable image detection techniques are urgently needed. Recent state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods adopt aligned training datasets to reduce content, size, and format biases, empowering models to capture robust forgery cues. A common strategy is to employ reconstruction techniques, e.g., VAE and DDIM, which show remarkable results in diffusion-based methods. However, such reconstruction-based approaches typically introduce limited and homogeneous artifacts, which cannot fully capture diverse generative patterns, such as GAN-based methods. To complement reconstruction-based fake images with aligned yet diverse artifact patterns, we propose a GAN-based upsampling approach that mimics GAN-generated fake patterns while preserving content, size, and format alignment. This naturally results in two aligned but distinct types of fake images. However, due to the domain shift between reconstruction-based and upsampling-based fake images, direct mixed training causes suboptimal results, where one domain disrupts feature learning of the other. Accordingly, we propose a Separate Expert Fusion (SEF) framework to extract complementary artifact information and reduce inter-domain interference. We first train domain-specific experts via LoRA adaptation on a frozen foundational model, then conduct decoupled fusion with a gating network to adaptively combine expert features while retaining their specialized knowledge. Rather than merely benefiting GAN-generated image detection, this design introduces diverse and complementary artifact patterns that enable SEF to learn a more robust decision boundary and improve generalization across broader generative methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields strong results across 13 diverse benchmarks. Codes are released at: https://github.com/liyih/SEF_AIGC_detection.

item.title: GroupMemBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent Memory in Multi-Party Conversations
item.author: Jingbo Yang, Kwei-Herng Lai, Xiaowen Wang, Shiyu Chang, Yaar Harari, Evgeniy Gabrilovich
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究针对现有大语言模型代理在多用户环境下的记忆系统局限性，提出了GroupMemBench基准测试，发现当前记忆系统在多用户场景下表现严重不足。

背景: 现有的大语言模型代理记忆系统和基准测试主要基于单用户、一对一的设置，而实际部署中经常涉及多用户、多渠道的交互，导致对群体记忆的三个关键属性（群体动态、基于说话人的信念追踪、适应受众的语言）缺乏测量。

目的: 介绍GroupMemBench基准测试，旨在暴露群体记忆的三个关键属性，并评估当前记忆系统在多用户场景下的能力。

方法: 通过图基础合成管道生成具有可控回复结构和条件的多方对话，并结合对抗性查询管道，将每个问题绑定到特定提问者，通过迭代搜索挑战性、现实的查询来构建基准测试。

主要发现: 对领先记忆系统的基准测试显示，最强的系统平均准确率仅为46.0%，知识更新准确率27.1%，术语歧义准确率37.7%，且简单的BM25基准匹配或超过了大多数代理记忆系统。

结论: 当前的记忆摄取过程会抹去群体记忆所依赖的结构和词汇特征，表明多用户记忆问题尚未解决。

翻译: 大语言模型代理越来越多地作为个人助理和职场合作伙伴发挥作用，其效用取决于能够在长时间对话中提取、检索和应用信息的记忆系统。然而，现有的记忆系统和基准测试都是围绕二元、单用户设置构建的，尽管实际部署经常跨越涉及多个用户与代理以及用户之间相互交互的群体和渠道。这种不匹配导致群体记忆的三个属性未被测量：(i)超越连接的一对一聊天之外的群体动态，(ii)基于说话人的信念追踪，需要按用户建模记忆，以及(iii)适应受众的语言，心智理论转变产生角色特定的词汇。我们介绍了GroupMemBench基准测试，它暴露了所有这三个属性。一个图基础的合成管道生成具有可控回复结构和条件的多方对话，并对每条消息进行特定用户人物形象和目标受众的条件化。然后，对抗性查询管道将每个问题绑定到六个类别中的特定提问者，涵盖多跳推理、知识更新、术语歧义、用户隐含推理、时间推理和放弃，并迭代搜索反映全面记忆能力的挑战性、现实的查询。对领先记忆系统的基准测试显示，最强的系统平均准确率仅为46.0%，知识更新为27.1%，术语歧义为37.7%，而简单的BM25基准匹配或超过了大多数代理记忆系统。这表明当前的记忆摄取抹去了群体记忆所依赖的结构和词汇特征，使多用户记忆远未解决。

Abstract

Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly serve as personal assistants and workplace collaborators, where their utility depends on memory systems that extract, retrieve, and apply information across long-running conversations. However, both existing memory systems and benchmarks are built around the dyadic, single-user setup, even though real deployments routinely span groups and channels with multiple users interacting with the agent and with each other. This mismatch leaves three properties of group memory unmeasured: (i) group dynamics that go beyond concatenated one-on-one chats, (ii) speaker-grounded belief tracking, where the per-user memory modeling is needed, and (iii) audience-adapted language, where Theory-of-Mind shifts produce role-specific vocabulary. We introduce GroupMemBench, a benchmark that exposes all three. A graph-grounded synthesis pipeline produces multi-party conversations with controllable reply structure and conditions each message on per-user personas and target audiences. An adversarial query pipeline then binds every question to a specific asker across six categories, spanning multi-hop reasoning, knowledge update, term ambiguity, user-implicit reasoning, temporal reasoning, and abstention, and iteratively searches challenging, realistic queries that reflect comprehensive memory capability. Benchmarking leading memory systems exposes a sharp collapse: the strongest one reaches only 46.0% average accuracy, with knowledge update at 27.1% and term ambiguity at 37.7%, while a simple BM25 baseline matches or exceeds most agent memory systems. This indicates current memory ingestion erases the structural and lexical features group memory depends on, leaving multi-user memory far from solved.

item.title: Med-DisSeg: Dispersion-Driven Representation Learning for Fine-Grained Medical Image Segmentation
item.author: Zhiquan Chen, Haitao Wang, Guowei Zou, Hejun Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Med DisSeg 的医学图像分割框架，旨在解决分割中的挑战。

背景: 医学图像分割是精准医学的基础，但在处理异质外观、模糊边界和大型解剖变异时仍面临困难。

目的: 解决目标与周围组织之间相似强度和纹理模式导致的模糊激活和不可靠分离问题，这些失败归因于编码过程中的表示崩溃和不足的细粒度多尺度解码。

方法: 提出 Med DisSeg 框架，结合轻量级分散损失和自适应注意力机制。分散损失通过将批次内的隐藏表示视为负对来扩大样本间距，产生分散且边界感知的嵌入。基于这些增强的表示，编码器加强结构敏感响应，解码器执行自适应多尺度校准以保留互补的局部纹理和全局形状信息。

主要发现: 在涵盖三种成像模态的五个数据集上进行了广泛实验，取得了持续的最先进性能。

结论: Med DisSeg 在多器官 CT 分割中取得了有竞争力的结果，支持了其鲁棒性和跨任务适用性。

翻译: Accurate medical image segmentation is fundamental to precision medicine, yet robust delineation remains challenging under heterogeneous appearances, ambiguous boundaries, and large anatomical variability. Similar intensity and texture patterns between targets and surrounding tissues often lead to blurred activations and unreliable separation. We attribute these failures to representation collapse during encoding and insufficient fine grained multi scale decoding. To address these issues, we propose Med DisSeg, a dispersion driven medical image segmentation framework that jointly improves representation learning and anatomical delineation. Med DisSeg combines a lightweight Dispersive Loss with adaptive attention for fine grained structure segmentation. The Dispersive Loss enlarges inter sample margins by treating in batch hidden representations as negative pairs, producing well dispersed and boundary aware embeddings with negligible overhead. Based on these enhanced representations, the encoder strengthens structure sensitive responses, while the decoder performs adaptive multi scale calibration to preserve complementary local texture and global shape information. Extensive experiments on five datasets spanning three imaging modalities demonstrate consistent state of the art performance. Moreover, Med DisSeg achieves competitive results on multi organ CT segmentation, supporting its robustness and cross task applicability.

Abstract

Accurate medical image segmentation is fundamental to precision medicine, yet robust delineation remains challenging under heterogeneous appearances, ambiguous boundaries, and large anatomical variability. Similar intensity and texture patterns between targets and surrounding tissues often lead to blurred activations and unreliable separation. We attribute these failures to representation collapse during encoding and insufficient fine grained multi scale decoding. To address these issues, we propose Med DisSeg, a dispersion driven medical image segmentation framework that jointly improves representation learning and anatomical delineation. Med DisSeg combines a lightweight Dispersive Loss with adaptive attention for fine grained structure segmentation. The Dispersive Loss enlarges inter sample margins by treating in batch hidden representations as negative pairs, producing well dispersed and boundary aware embeddings with negligible overhead. Based on these enhanced representations, the encoder strengthens structure sensitive responses, while the decoder performs adaptive multi scale calibration to preserve complementary local texture and global shape information. Extensive experiments on five datasets spanning three imaging modalities demonstrate consistent state of the art performance. Moreover, Med DisSeg achieves competitive results on multi organ CT segmentation, supporting its robustness and cross task applicability.

item.title: Privacy Auditing with Zero (0) Training Run
item.author: Tudor Cebere, Mathieu Even, Linus Bleistein, Aurélien Bellet
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为Zero-Run privacy auditing的后验框架，用于在不重新训练或随机化数据的情况下评估模型的隐私参数。

背景: 现有的隐私审计方法需要干预训练流程，这在大型部署系统如基础模型中往往不可行。

目的: 提出一种后验框架，利用两个固定数据集（已知成员和非成员）在不干预训练的情况下进行隐私审计。

方法: 基于因果推断思想，将分布偏移和算法泄露的联合效应建模为自适应组合，提出两种互补的修正方法：一种是产生保守的全局修正，另一种是调整逐点的成员猜测以获得更精确的实例相关界限。

主要发现: 在合成数据和大规模模型上的实验表明，Zero-Run审计在重新训练或受控数据插入不可行时，能够实现实用的隐私评估。

结论: Zero-Run隐私审计框架能够在不干预训练流程的情况下，有效评估模型的隐私参数。

翻译: 隐私审计为学习算法的差分隐私参数提供了经验下界。然而，现有方法需要干预训练流程，要么多次重新训练，要么随机化数据包含。这对于大型部署系统（如基础模型）往往不可行。我们介绍了Zero-Run隐私审计，一种使用两个固定数据集的后验框架：已知是训练集成员的示例和已知是非成员的示例。在这种观察模式下，成员身份不再被随机化；相反，成员和非成员数据通常在分布上有所不同，因此成员推断分数可能反映的是分布偏移而不是算法泄露。借鉴因果推断的思想，我们形式化了这种混杂效应，并提出了两种互补的修正方法，以产生有效的隐私审计。我们的第一种方法将分布偏移和算法泄露的联合效应建模为自适应组合，产生保守的全局修正。我们的第二种方法对观察到的数据进行条件处理，并调整逐点的成员猜测，产生更精确的实例相关界限。在合成数据和大规模模型上的实验表明，Zero-Run审计在重新训练或受控数据插入不可行时，能够实现实用的隐私评估。

Abstract

Privacy auditing provides empirical lower bounds on the differential privacy parameters of learning algorithms. Existing methods, however, require interventional access to the training pipeline, either to retrain multiple times or to randomize data inclusion. This is often infeasible for large deployed systems such as foundation models. We introduce Zero-Run privacy auditing, a post-hoc framework for auditing models using two fixed datasets: examples known to be training-set members and examples known to be non-members. In this observational regime, membership is no longer randomized; instead, member and non-member data often differ in distribution, so membership inference scores may reflect a distribution shift rather than algorithmic leakage. Drawing on ideas from causal inference, we formalize this confounding effect and propose two complementary corrections that yield valid privacy audits. Our first approach models the combined effect of distribution shift and algorithmic leakage as an adaptive composition, producing conservative global corrections. Our second approach conditions on observed data and adjusts pointwise membership guesses, yielding sharper instance-dependent bounds. Experiments on synthetic data and large-scale models show that Zero-Run auditing enables practical privacy evaluation when retraining or controlled data insertion is infeasible.

item.title: Towards Accurate Single Panoramic 3D Detection: A Semantic Gaussian Centric Approach
item.author: Kanglin Ning, Yiran Zhao, Wenrui Li, Shaoru Sun, Xingtao Wang, Xiaopeng Fan
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于连续语义三维高斯表示的单目全景三维目标检测框架PanoGSDet，旨在解决现有方法将二维特征投影到离散三维网格导致几何连续性被破坏和表示效率受限的问题。

背景: 全景图像中的三维目标检测对于全面理解场景至关重要，但准确将二维特征映射到三维仍是一个重大挑战。现有方法通常将二维特征投影到离散的三维网格上，这破坏了几何连续性并限制了表示效率。

目的: 为了克服现有方法的局限性，提出PanoGSDet框架，利用连续语义三维高斯表示来提高三维目标检测的准确性和效率。

方法: PanoGSDet框架包含全景深度估计组件和语义高斯组件。全景深度估计组件从单目全景输入中提取等距圆柱投影语义和深度特征。语义高斯组件包括语义高斯上采样模块（将球形特征投影到三维语义高斯）、语义高斯优化模块（优化这些语义高斯）以及高斯引导预测头（从优化后的高斯表示生成三维边界框）。

主要发现: 在Structured3D数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法显著优于现有方法。

结论: PanoGSDet框架通过使用连续语义三维高斯表示，有效解决了现有方法中几何连续性被破坏和表示效率受限的问题，在三维目标检测任务上取得了显著成效。

翻译: Three-dimensional object detection in panoramic imagery is crucial for comprehensive scene understanding, yet accurately mapping 2D features to 3D remains a significant challenge. Prevailing methods often project 2D features onto discrete 3D grids, which break geometric continuity and limit representation efficiency. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes PanoGSDet, a monocular panoramic 3D detection framework built upon continuous semantic 3D Gaussian representations. The proposed framework comprises a panoramic depth estimation component and a semantic Gaussian component. The panoramic depth estimation component extracts the equirectangular semantic and depth features from the monocular panorama input. The semantic Gaussian component includes a semantic Gaussian lifting module that projects spherical features into 3D semantic Gaussians, a semantic Gaussian optimization module that refines these semantic Gaussians, and a Gaussian guided prediction head that generates 3D bounding boxes from optimized Gaussian representations. Extensive experiments on the Structured3D dataset demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing methods.

item.title: One Step to the Side: Why Defenses Against Malicious Finetuning Fail Under Adaptive Adversaries
item.author: Itay Zloczower, Eyal Lenga, Gilad Gressel, Yisroel Mirsky
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究指出了当前防御机制在面对恶意微调攻击时的局限性，并提出了一种统一的适应性攻击方法来打破这些防御。

背景: 随着越来越多的模型提供商发布开放权重或允许用户通过 API 微调基础模型，尽管这些模型在发布前经过了安全对齐，但它们的安全防护措施往往可以通过在有害数据上进行微调而被移除。

目的: 为了评估当前防御机制的有效性，研究旨在识别防御机制中的共同弱点，并开发一种统一的适应性攻击方法来打破所有防御机制。

方法: 通过调查 15 种最近的防御方法，识别了防御机制中存在的单一弱点，即它们只是掩盖或误导有害行为路径而没有移除行为本身，并开发了一种统一的适应性攻击方法。

主要发现: 当前的防御方法并不提供稳健的安全性；它们主要阻止了它们被设计用来对抗的攻击。

结论: 作者希望这种针对该领域的统一适应性攻击者能帮助未来的研究人员和从业者在部署前对新防御进行压力测试。

翻译: 模型提供商越来越多地发布开放权重或允许用户通过 API 微调基础模型。尽管这些模型在发布前经过了安全对齐，但它们的安全防护措施往往可以通过在有害数据上进行微调而被移除。最近的防御旨在使模型对这种恶意微调具有鲁棒性，但它们主要针对固定的攻击进行评估，这些攻击没有考虑到防御本身。我们表明这些鲁棒性声明是不完整的。调查了 15 种最近的防御方法，我们识别了几种防御机制，并表明它们共享一个单一的弱点：它们只是掩盖或误导有害行为的路径，而没有移除行为本身。然后，我们开发了一种统一的适应性攻击，可以打破所有防御机制中的防御。我们的结果表明，当前的方法并不提供稳健的安全性；它们主要阻止了它们被设计用来对抗的攻击。我们希望，针对该领域的这种统一适应性攻击者将有助于未来的研究人员和从业者在部署前对新防御进行压力测试。

Abstract

Model providers increasingly release open weights or allow users to fine-tune foundation models through APIs. Although these models are safety-aligned before release, their safeguards can often be removed by fine-tuning on harmful data. Recent defenses aim to make models robust to such malicious fine-tuning, but they are largely evaluated only against fixed attacks that do not account for the defense. We show that these robustness claims are incomplete. Surveying 15 recent defenses, we identify several defense mechanisms and show that they share a single weakness: they obscure or misdirect the path to harmful behavior without removing the behavior itself. We then develop a unified adaptive attack that breaks defenses across all defense mechanisms. Our results show that current approaches do not provide robust security; they mainly stop the attacks they were designed against. We hope that our unified adaptive adversary for this domain will help future researchers and practitioners stress-test new defenses before deployment.

item.title: MambaRain: Multi-Scale Mamba-Attention Framework for 0-3 Hour Precipitation Nowcasting
item.author: Chunlei Shi, Cui Wu, Xiang Xu, Hao Li, Ni Fan, Xue Han, Yongchao Feng, Yufeng Zhu, Boyu Liu, Zengliang Zang, Hongbin Wang, Yanlan Yang, Dan Niu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MambaRain的新型多尺度编码器-解码器架构，旨在解决降水临近预报中长时间尺度（0-3小时）预测的挑战。

背景: 降水临近预报对于灾害缓解和运营决策至关重要，但现有确定性方法在90分钟后的预测性能严重下降，难以捕捉雷达观测数据中的长距离时空依赖关系。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在捕捉长距离时空依赖关系方面的局限性，提出MambaRain架构，以扩展可行的预报范围至2-3小时。

方法: MambaRain采用混合设计范式，结合Mamba块的线性复杂度长距离时间建模与自注意力机制。Mamba块利用选择性状态空间机制建模全局时间动态，自注意力模块明确表征降水场内的空间相关性。此外，引入了谱损失形式以减轻混沌降水系统特有的模糊伪影。

主要发现: MambaRain在0-3小时的降水临近预报任务中显著优于现有确定性方法，特别是在具有挑战性的2-3小时预测范围内表现突出。

结论: MambaRain通过互补协同作用实现了全面的时空表示学习，有效延长了可行的预报范围至2-3小时，并显著提高了准确性，同时保留了细尺度运动细节。

翻译: Accurate precipitation nowcasting over extended horizons (0-3 hours) is essential for disaster mitigation and operational decision-making, yet remains a critical challenge in the field. Existing deterministic approaches are predominantly constrained to shorter prediction windows (0-2 hours), exhibiting severe performance degradation beyond 90 minutes owing to their inherent difficulty in capturing long-range spatiotemporal dependencies from radar-derived observations. To address these fundamental limitations, we propose MambaRain, a novel multi-scale encoder-decoder architecture that synergistically integrates Mamba's linear-complexity long-range temporal modeling with self-attention mechanisms for explicit spatial correlation capture. The core innovation lies in a hybrid design paradigm wherein Mamba blocks leverage selective state space mechanisms to model global temporal dynamics across extended sequences with computational efficiency, while self-attention modules explicitly characterize spatial correlations within precipitation fields - a capability inherently absent in Mamba's sequential processing paradigm. This complementary synergy enables comprehensive spatiotemporal representation learning, effectively extending the viable forecasting horizon to 2-3 hours with substantial accuracy improvements. Furthermore, we introduce a spectral loss formulation to mitigate blurring artifacts characteristic of chaotic precipitation systems, thereby preserving fine-scale motion details critical for nowcasting accuracy. Experimental validation demonstrates that MambaRain substantially outperforms existing deterministic methodologies in 0-3 hour nowcasting tasks, with particularly pronounced performance gains in the challenging 2-3 hour prediction range.

Abstract

Accurate precipitation nowcasting over extended horizons (0-3 hours) is essential for disaster mitigation and operational decision-making, yet remains a critical challenge in the field. Existing deterministic approaches are predominantly constrained to shorter prediction windows (0-2 hours), exhibiting severe performance degradation beyond 90 minutes owing to their inherent difficulty in capturing long-range spatiotemporal dependencies from radar-derived observations. To address these fundamental limitations, we propose MambaRain, a novel multi-scale encoder-decoder architecture that synergistically integrates Mamba's linear-complexity long-range temporal modeling with self-attention mechanisms for explicit spatial correlation capture. The core innovation lies in a hybrid design paradigm wherein Mamba blocks leverage selective state space mechanisms to model global temporal dynamics across extended sequences with computational efficiency, while self-attention modules explicitly characterize spatial correlations within precipitation fields - a capability inherently absent in Mamba's sequential processing paradigm. This complementary synergy enables comprehensive spatiotemporal representation learning, effectively extending the viable forecasting horizon to 2-3 hours with substantial accuracy improvements. Furthermore, we introduce a spectral loss formulation to mitigate blurring artifacts characteristic of chaotic precipitation systems, thereby preserving fine-scale motion details critical for nowcasting accuracy. Experimental validation demonstrates that MambaRain substantially outperforms existing deterministic methodologies in 0-3 hour nowcasting tasks, with particularly pronounced performance gains in the challenging 2-3 hour prediction range.

item.title: ViMU: Benchmarking Video Metaphorical Understanding
item.author: Qi Li, Xinchao Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了ViMU，这是一个首个用于系统评估视频模型隐含意义理解能力的基准测试。

背景: 视频不仅是记录和传达视觉信息的工具，还承载着情感、态度和社会意义等难以明确表达的内容。然而，现有的视频理解模型主要关注字面视觉理解，缺乏对隐喻、讽刺和社会意义的系统性理解能力。

目的: 为了填补这一空白，引入ViMU基准测试，旨在评估视频理解模型是否能超越字面感知，推断隐含意义，并将解释建立在多模态证据之上。

方法: ViMU通过设计无提示的问题，包括开放式和选择题，来评估模型对隐含意义的理解能力。

主要发现: unknown

结论: ViMU是一个无提示的基准测试，确保在回答问题前不向模型透露关键证据，从而更准确地评估模型的隐含意义理解能力。

翻译: 任何新的媒介一旦出现，就不仅仅用于传输显性内容。它所携带的信息通常在两个层面上运作：一个是直接呈现的内容，另一个是隐含在其中的潜台词——即创作者通过媒介试图传达的隐含想法和意图。同样，自视频技术被广泛采用以来，视频不仅作为记录和传达视觉信息的强大工具，还成为承载情感、态度和社会意义的载体，这些意义往往难以明确表达。因此，许多视频的真正意义并不完全在于屏幕上显示的内容；它通常嵌入在语境、表达风格和观众的社会体验中。此类视频潜台词的一些形式是幽默的，而另一些则带有讽刺、嘲弄或批评。这些隐含意义在不同文化背景和社会群体中也可能被非常不同地解读。然而，大多数现有的视频理解模型仍然主要关注字面视觉理解，例如识别物体、动作或时间关系，缺乏系统性地理解嵌入视频中的隐喻、讽刺和社会意义的能力。为了填补这一差距，我们介绍了ViMU，这是首个旨在系统评估前沿模型视频隐含意义理解能力的基准测试。ViMU评估视频理解模型是否能超越字面感知来推断隐含意义，同时将其解释建立在多模态证据之上，并回答开放式和选择题。重要的是，所有问题都是无提示设计的，确保在回答前不向模型透露关键证据。

Abstract

Any new medium, once it emerges, is used for more than the transmission of overt content alone. The information it carries typically operates on two levels: one is the content directly presented, while the other is the subtext beneath it-the implicit ideas and intentions the creator seeks to convey through the medium. Likewise, since video technologies became widely adopted, video has served not only as a powerful tool for recording and communicating visual information, but also as a vehicle for emotions, attitudes, and social meanings that are often difficult to articulate explicitly. Thus, the true meaning of many videos does not reside solely in what is shown on screen; it is often embedded in context, style of expression, and the viewer's social experience. Some forms of such video subtext are humorous, while others carry irony, mockery, or criticism. These implicit meanings can also be interpreted very differently across cultural backgrounds and social groups. However, most existing video understanding models still focus primarily on literal visual comprehension, such as recognizing objects, actions, or temporal relations, and lack a systematic ability to understand the metaphorical, ironic, and social meanings embedded in videos. To bridge this gap, we introduce ViMU, the first benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the subtext understanding capabilities of frontier models in videos. ViMU assesses whether video understanding models can go beyond literal perception to infer implicit meaning while grounding their interpretations in multimodal evidence and answering both open-ended and multiple-choice questions. Importantly, all questions are designed to be hint-free, ensuring that no key evidence is disclosed to models before answering.

item.title: Efficient Dense Matching for Enhanced Gaussian Splatting Using AV1 Motion Vectors
item.author: Julien Zouein, Vibhoothi Vibhoothi, François Pitié, Anil Kokaram
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种基于AV1视频编解码器特征检测和匹配的管道，用于提高3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)场景重建的初始点云质量，从而减少训练时间并提高渲染质量。

背景: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 是一种用于实时、照片级真实感场景重建的框架，但其在纹理区域稀疏的初始点云质量上严重依赖标准结构从运动 (SfM) 管道（如 COLMAP），后者计算成本高且在纹理区域稀疏。

目的: 引入一种基于AV1的特征检测和匹配管道，以减少SfM处理开销，并生成比传统SfM更密集的点云。

方法: 利用AV1视频编解码器固有的运动向量，绕过计算昂贵的穷举匹配，同时保持几何稳健性。

主要发现: 该管道生成的点云比传统SfM密集多达八倍；这直接改善了3DGS性能，在达到基线质量时训练时间平均减少了63%，VMAF得分提高了9点。

结论: 基于AV1的初始点云初始化显著提高了3DGS的重建效率和渲染质量。

翻译: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 已成为一种用于实时、照片级真实感场景重建的突出框架，相比神经辐射场 (NeRF) 提供了显著的加速。然而，3DGS表示的保真度仍然严重依赖于初始点云的质量。虽然使用COLMAP的标准结构从运动 (SfM) 管道提供了充分的初始化，但它们通常 suffer from 高计算成本和纹理区域的稀疏性，这降低了后续重建的准确性和收敛速度。在这项工作中，我们介绍了一种基于AV1的特征检测和匹配管道，显著减少了SfM处理开销。通过利用AV1视频编解码器固有的运动向量，我们绕过了计算昂贵的穷举匹配，同时保持了几何稳健性。我们的管道产生了明显更密集的点云，其点数是传统SfM的八倍。我们证明这种增强的初始化直接改善了3DGS性能，在达到基线质量时训练时间平均减少了63%，VMAF得分提高了9点。项目页面：https://sigmedia.tv/AV1-3DGS.github.io/

Abstract

3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a prominent framework for real-time, photorealistic scene reconstruction, offering significant speed-ups over Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF). However, the fidelity of 3DGS representations remains heavily dependent on the quality of the initial point cloud. While standard Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines using COLMAP provide adequate initialisation, they often suffer from high computational costs and sparsity in textureless regions, which degrades subsequent reconstruction accuracy and convergence speed. In this work, we introduce an AV1-based feature detection and matching pipeline that significantly reduces SfM processing overhead. By leveraging motion vectors inherent to the AV1 video codec, we bypass computationally expensive exhaustive matching while maintaining geometric robustness. Our pipeline produces substantially denser point clouds, with up to eight times as many points as classical SfM. We demonstrate that this enhanced initialisation directly improves 3DGS performance, yielding an 9-point increase in VMAF and a 63% average reduction in training time required to reach baseline quality. The project page: https://sigmedia.tv/AV1-3DGS.github.io/

item.title: Multimodal Learning for MIMO Beam Prediction Based on Variational Inference
item.author: Zijian Zheng, Wenqiang Yi, Hyundong Shin, Arumugam Nallanathan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于变分推断的多模态框架，用于解决大规模MIMO系统中的波束预测问题，该框架通过模块化特征提取和跨模态语义对齐来提高数据效率。

背景: 在集成感知与通信的大规模MIMO系统中，准确的波束预测对于缓解信令开销和延迟至关重要。虽然多模态学习可以利用其他传感器的互补信息来提高预测精度，但获取语义对齐的多模态数据集的高成本限制了其实际部署。

目的: 提出一种基于变分推断的多模态框架，以解决多模态数据获取成本高的问题，同时提高波束预测的准确性和鲁棒性。

方法: 该框架将优化问题解耦为模块化特征提取和跨模态语义对齐。具体采用两阶段训练策略：首先利用大量单模态数据进行表示学习，然后在有限的多模态样本上进行精细对齐。

主要发现: 在DeepSense6G数据集上的实验结果表明，该框架在仅使用传统端到端基准测试所需20%的多模态训练数据的情况下，仍能实现具有竞争力的波束预测精度并保持高可靠性。

结论: 所提出的框架通过两阶段训练策略有效增强了数据效率，并在感知不确定性下确保了鲁棒的特征融合，证明了其在资源受限情况下的有效性。

翻译: Accurate beam prediction is essential for mitigating signalling overhead and latency in integrated sensing and communication-enabled massive multi-input multi-output systems. With the aid of multimodal learning, the prediction accuracy can be enhanced by leveraging the complementary information from other existing sensors, but the practical deployment is often constrained by the high cost of acquiring semantically aligned multimodal datasets. This paper proposes a variational-inference-based multimodal framework that decouples the optimization problem into modular feature extraction and cross-modal semantic alignment. Specifically, we develop a two-stage training strategy where the model utilises abundant unimodal data for representation learning before performing refined alignment on limited multimodal samples. This design enhances data efficiency and ensures robust feature fusion under sensing uncertainties. Experimental results on the DeepSense6G dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive beam prediction accuracy and maintains high reliability, while only requiring 20% of the multimodal training data compared to conventional end-to-end benchmarks.

Abstract

Accurate beam prediction is essential for mitigating signalling overhead and latency in integrated sensing and communication-enabled massive multi-input multi-output systems. With the aid of multimodal learning, the prediction accuracy can be enhanced by leveraging the complementary information from other existing sensors, but the practical deployment is often constrained by the high cost of acquiring semantically aligned multimodal datasets. This paper proposes a variational-inference-based multimodal framework that decouples the optimization problem into modular feature extraction and cross-modal semantic alignment. Specifically, we develop a two-stage training strategy where the model utilises abundant unimodal data for representation learning before performing refined alignment on limited multimodal samples. This design enhances data efficiency and ensures robust feature fusion under sensing uncertainties. Experimental results on the DeepSense6G dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive beam prediction accuracy and maintains high reliability, while only requiring 20% of the multimodal training data compared to conventional end-to-end benchmarks.

item.title: EponaV2: Driving World Model with Comprehensive Future Reasoning
item.author: Jiawei Xu, Zhizhou Zhong, Zhijian Shu, Mingkai Jia, Mingxiao Li, Jia-Wang Bian, Qian Zhang, Kaicheng Zhang, Jin Xie, Jian Yang, Wei Yin
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EponaV2是一种新型驾驶世界模型，通过预测更全面的前景表示来提升轨迹规划质量，并引入了基于LLM训练流程的优化机制。

背景: 现有的感知规划范式依赖昂贵的人工标注，限制了其可扩展性；而现有的无感知驾驶世界模型仅基于下一帧图像预测，缺乏足够的监督，导致场景理解不足和轨迹规划不理想。

目的: 提出EponaV2范式，以实现高质量轨迹规划并具备全面的前景推理能力，同时提升模型在现实世界中的推理能力。

方法: 受人类驾驶员预测3D几何和语义的启发，训练模型预测更全面的前景表示，可解码为未来的几何和语义地图；引入基于LLM训练流程的流匹配组相对策略优化机制。

主要发现: EponaV2在三个NAVSIM基准测试中取得了最先进的无感知模型性能，轨迹规划指标显著提升。

结论: EponaV2通过预测全面的前景表示和引入LLM训练流程的优化机制，有效增强了模型对周围环境的理解能力和现实世界推理能力，从而实现了更好的轨迹规划。

翻译: Data scaling plays a pivotal role in the pursuit of general intelligence. However, the prevailing perception-planning paradigm in autonomous driving relies heavily on expensive manual annotations to supervise trajectory planning, which severely limits its scalability. Conversely, although existing perception-free driving world models achieve impressive driving performance, their real-world reasoning ability for planning is solely built on next frame image forecasting. Due to the lack of enough supervision, these models often struggle with comprehensive scene understanding, resulting in unsatisfactory trajectory planning. In this paper, we propose EponaV2, a novel paradigm of driving world models, which achieves high-quality planning with comprehensive future reasoning. Inspired by how human drivers anticipate 3D geometry and semantics, we train our model to forecast more comprehensive future representations, which can be additionally decoded to future geometry and semantic maps. Extracting the 3D and semantic modalities enables our model to deeply understand the surrounding environment, and the future prediction task significantly enhances the real-world reasoning capabilities of EponaV2, ultimately leading to improved trajectory planning. Moreover, inspired by the training recipe of Large Language Models (LLMs), we introduce a flow matching group relative policy optimization mechanism to further improve planning accuracy. The state-of-the-art (SOTA) performances of EponaV2 among perception-free models on three NAVSIM benchmarks (+1.3PDMS, +5.5EPDMS) demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods.

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了EponaV2，这是一个利用全面未来推理来驱动自动驾驶世界模型的系统。

Abstract

Data scaling plays a pivotal role in the pursuit of general intelligence. However, the prevailing perception-planning paradigm in autonomous driving relies heavily on expensive manual annotations to supervise trajectory planning, which severely limits its scalability. Conversely, although existing perception-free driving world models achieve impressive driving performance, their real-world reasoning ability for planning is solely built on next frame image forecasting. Due to the lack of enough supervision, these models often struggle with comprehensive scene understanding, resulting in unsatisfactory trajectory planning. In this paper, we propose EponaV2, a novel paradigm of driving world models, which achieves high-quality planning with comprehensive future reasoning. Inspired by how human drivers anticipate 3D geometry and semantics, we train our model to forecast more comprehensive future representations, which can be additionally decoded to future geometry and semantic maps. Extracting the 3D and semantic modalities enables our model to deeply understand the surrounding environment, and the future prediction task significantly enhances the real-world reasoning capabilities of EponaV2, ultimately leading to improved trajectory planning. Moreover, inspired by the training recipe of Large Language Models (LLMs), we introduce a flow matching group relative policy optimization mechanism to further improve planning accuracy. The state-of-the-art (SOTA) performances of EponaV2 among perception-free models on three NAVSIM benchmarks (+1.3PDMS, +5.5EPDMS) demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods.

item.title: NeuroAtlas: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Clinical EEG and Brain-Computer Interfaces
item.author: Konstantinos Kontras, Trui Osselaer, Stylianos G. Mouslech, Angeliki-Ilektra Karaiskou, Guido Gagliardi, Thomas Strypsteen, Mohammad Hossein Badiei, Anku Rani, Maarten Vanmarcke, Miguel Bhagubai, Chanakya Ekbote, Jaedong Hwang, Christos Chatzichristos, Paul Pu Liang, Maarten De Vos
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者介绍了NeuroAtlas，这是一个包含42个数据集和26万小时数据的最大脑电图基准测试，涵盖了临床脑电图和脑机接口领域。研究评估了通用时间序列基础模型在脑电图任务上的表现，发现脑电图专用模型并不总是优于通用时间序列模型。研究强调了标准机器学习指标不足以评估临床效用，并提出了更合适的评估指标。

背景: 基础模型（FMs）在包括脑电图（EEG）在内的多个领域兴起，但它们在EEG领域的有效性尚不明确。现有评估在数据集、预处理和报告指标方面存在差异，往往掩盖了EEG的临床相关性。

目的: 介绍NeuroAtlas，这是迄今为止最大的EEG基准测试，包含临床EEG和脑机接口的多个数据集和26万小时数据，以及专门的临床评估指标。评估EEG基础模型与监督基线以及通用时间序列基础模型的表现。

方法: 构建了包含42个数据集和26万小时数据的NeuroAtlas基准测试，涵盖临床EEG（癫痫、睡眠医学、脑龄估计）和脑机接口。评估了EEG专用模型与通用时间序列基础模型，并使用更合适的临床评估指标（如事件级决策质量、睡眠图特征、脑龄差）进行评估。

主要发现: 1. EEG专用模型并不总是优于通用时间序列模型；2. 标准机器学习指标不足以评估临床效用，需要更合适的指标；3. 模型排名和性能在不同领域内差异显著。

结论: 预训练模型表现大致相当，只有少数模型有微弱优势，当前模型尚未实现开箱即用的统一EEG模型的承诺。NeuroAtlas揭示了这一差距，并为下一代统一EEG基础模型提供了数据集和指标。

翻译: 基础模型（FMs）承诺提取跨下游任务通用的统一表示。它们在包括脑电图（EEG）在内的多个领域兴起，但它们在该特定领域的有效性尚不明确。已发表的评估在数据集、可能影响报告结果的EEG特定预处理以及报告指标方面存在差异，经常掩盖EEG的临床相关性。我们介绍了NeuroAtlas，这是迄今为止最大的EEG基准测试：42个数据集和26万小时，涵盖临床EEG（癫痫、睡眠医学、脑龄估计）和脑机接口，并包括每个任务的多个数据集以及专门的临床评估指标。除了根据监督基线评估EEG-FMs外，我们还展示了通用时间序列FMs的结果。我们报告了三个发现。首先，EEG专用模型并不总是优于时间序列FMs，后者既没有EEG专注的架构，也没有在EEG上进行预训练。其次，标准机器学习指标不足以评估临床效用：因此，我们彻底评估了更合适的措施，如癫痫、睡眠和脑龄领域的事件级决策质量、睡眠图特征和脑龄差。第三，模型排名和性能在不同领域内可能差异显著。我们得出结论，预训练模型表现大致相当，只有少数模型有微弱优势，当前模型尚未实现开箱即用的统一EEG模型的承诺。NeuroAtlas揭示了这一差距，并为下一代统一EEG FMs提供了数据集和指标。

Abstract

Foundation models (FMs) promise to extract unified representations that generalize across downstream tasks. They have emerged across fields, including electroencephalography (EEG), but it is less clear how effective they are in this particular field. Published evaluations differ in datasets, in the EEG-specific preprocessing that might influence reported results, and in the reported metrics, frequently obscuring the clinical relevance in EEG. We introduce NeuroAtlas, the largest EEG benchmark to date: 42 datasets and 260k hours covering clinical EEG (epilepsy, sleep medicine, brain age estimation) and brain-computer interfaces, and include multiple datasets per task along with bespoke clinical evaluation metrics. Besides evaluating EEG-FMs with respect to supervised baselines, we present results from generic time-series FMs. We report three findings. First, EEG-specific FMs do not consistently outperform time-series FMs, which have neither EEG-focused architectures nor been pretrained on EEG. Second, standard machine learning metrics are insufficient to assess clinical utility: thus, we thoroughly evaluate more appropriate measures such as the quality of event-level decision-making, hypnogram-derived features, and the brain-age gap in the domains of epilepsy, sleep, and brain age, respectively. Third, model rankings and performance can vary substantially within domains. We conclude that pretrained models perform largely on par, with only narrow advantages for a few, and that current models do not yet deliver on the promise of an out-of-the-box unified EEG model. NeuroAtlas exposes this gap and provides the datasets and metrics for the next generation of unified EEG FMs.

item.title: Vision-Core Guided Contrastive Learning for Balanced Multi-modal Prognosis Prediction of Stroke
item.author: Liren Chen, Lidong Sun, Mingyan Huang, Junzhe Tang, Yinghui Zhu, Guanjie Wang, Yiqing Xia, Ting Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种用于缺血性卒中预后诊断的新型三模态融合模型，通过大语言模型生成诊断文本并设计视觉条件双对齐融合模块实现多模态深度交互。

背景: 现有的多模态方法主要局限于双模态融合，缺乏有效整合医学图像、结构化临床数据和未结构化文本的框架，且各模态间缺乏深度双向交互。

目的: 构建一个能够有效整合医学图像、结构化临床数据和未结构化文本的三模态融合模型，以解决缺血性卒中预后诊断的挑战。

方法: 首先利用大语言模型从脑部MRI自动生成半结构化诊断文本以丰富数据表示；其次设计视觉条件双对齐融合模块，利用视觉特征作为条件先验引导文本交互，并通过双语义对齐损失实现动态深度融合。

主要发现: 在真实临床数据集上的广泛实验表明，该模型实现了最先进的性能表现。

结论: 所提出的模型通过数据表示增强和核心融合模块设计，有效缓解了模态异质性，显著提升了缺血性卒中预后诊断的准确性。

翻译: 摘要：深度学习和多模态融合在医学诊断中展示了变革潜力，通过整合多样化的数据源。然而，由于现有多模态方法的局限性，缺血性卒中的准确预后仍然具有挑战性。首先，当前方法主要局限于双模态融合，缺乏有效整合医学图像、结构化临床数据和未结构化文本三者的框架。其次，它们往往无法在模态之间建立深度双向交互。为了解决这些关键差距，本文提出了一种用于缺血性卒中预后诊断的新型三模态融合模型。我们的方法首先通过利用大语言模型从脑部MRI自动生成半结构化诊断文本来丰富数据表示。这一过程不仅解决了专家注释的稀缺问题，还作为正则化的语义增强，提高了多模态融合的鲁棒性。此外，我们设计了一个核心组件，称为视觉条件双对齐融合模块，该模块战略性地使用视觉特征作为条件先验，以引导与生成文本的细粒度交互。该模块通过双语义对齐损失实现动态且深刻的融合，有效缓解了模态异质性。在真实临床数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的模型实现了最先进的性能。

Abstract

Deep learning and multi-modal fusion have demonstrated transformative potential in medical diagnosis by integrating diverse data sources. However, accurate prognosis for ischemic stroke remains challenging due to limitations in existing multi-modal approaches. First, current methods are predominantly confined to dual-modal fusion, lacking a framework that effectively integrates the trifecta of medical images, structured clinical data, and unstructured text. Second, they often fail to establish deep bidirectional interactions between modalities; To address these critical gaps, this paper proposes a novel tri-modal fusion model for ischemic stroke prognosis. Our approach first enriches the data representation by employing a Large Language Model (LLM) to automatically generate semi-structured diagnostic text from brain MRIs. This process not only addresses the scarcity of expert annotations but also serves as a regularized semantic enhancement, improving multimodal fusion robustness. Furthermore, we design a core component termed the Vision-Conditioned Dual Alignment Fusion Module (VDAFM), which strategically uses visual features as a conditional prior to guide fine-grained interaction with the generated text. This module achieves a dynamic and profound fusion through a dual semantic alignment loss, effectively mitigating modal heterogeneity. Extensive experiments on a real-world clinical dataset demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance.

item.title: IntentVLA: Short-Horizon Intent Modeling for Aliased Robot Manipulation
item.author: Lian, Shijie, Yu, Bin, Lin, Xiaopeng, Shen, Zhaolong, Yang, Laurence Tianruo, Jin, Yurun, Liu, Haishan, Wu, Changti, Yuan, Hang, Huang, Cong, Chen, Kai
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: IntentVLA 是一个历史条件化的 VLA 框架，通过编码最近的视觉观察来生成短视距意图表示，从而改善机器人模仿学习中的执行稳定性。

背景: 机器人模仿数据通常是多模态的，相似的视觉-语言观察可能被不同的动作块跟随，因为人类演示者具有不同的短视距意图、任务阶段或最近的上下文。

目的: 为了解决现有帧条件 VLA 策略在部分可观察性下可能在不同重规划步骤间重新采样不同意图，导致相邻动作块冲突和不稳定执行的问题。

方法: 引入了 IntentVLA，这是一个历史条件化的 VLA 框架，将最近的视觉观察编码为紧凑的短视距意图表示，并使用它来条件化动作块生成。此外，还引入了 AliasBench，一个 12 任务模糊感知基准测试。

主要发现: 在 AliasBench、SimplerEnv、LIBERO 和 RoboCasa 上，IntentVLA 提高了 rollout 稳定性并优于强 VLA 基线。

结论: IntentVLA 通过编码短视距意图有效地解决了部分可观察性下的意图冲突问题，从而实现了更稳定的机器人执行。

翻译: 摘要：机器人模仿数据通常是多模态的：相似的视觉-语言观察可能被不同的动作块跟随，因为人类演示者以不同的短视距意图、任务阶段或最近的上下文行动。现有的帧条件 VLA 策略仅从当前的观察和指令推断每个动作块，因此在部分可观察性下，它们可能在相邻的重规划步骤间重新采样不同的意图，导致动作块间的冲突和不稳定的执行。我们介绍了 IntentVLA，这是一个历史条件化的 VLA 框架，将最近的视觉观察编码为紧凑的短视距意图表示，并使用它来条件化动作块生成。我们进一步介绍了 AliasBench，一个在 RoboTwin2 上的 12 任务模糊感知基准测试，具有匹配的训练数据和评估环境，该测试隔离了短视距观察模糊性。在 AliasBench、SimplerEnv、LIBERO 和 RoboCasa 上，IntentVLA 提高了 rollout 稳定性并优于强 VLA 基线。

Abstract

Robot imitation data are often multimodal: similar visual-language observations may be followed by different action chunks because human demonstrators act with different short-horizon intents, task phases, or recent context. Existing frame-conditioned VLA policies infer each chunk from the current observation and instruction alone, so under partial observability they may resample different intents across adjacent replanning steps, leading to inter-chunk conflict and unstable execution. We introduce IntentVLA, a history-conditioned VLA framework that encodes recent visual observations into a compact short-horizon intent representation and uses it to condition chunk generation. We further introduce AliasBench, a 12-task ambiguity-aware benchmark on RoboTwin2 with matched training data and evaluation environments that isolate short-horizon observation aliasing. Across AliasBench, SimplerEnv, LIBERO, and RoboCasa, IntentVLA improves rollout stability and outperforms strong VLA baselines

item.title: Video-Zero: Self-Evolution Video Understanding
item.author: Ruixu Zhang, Deyi Ji, Lanyun Zhu, Xuanyi Liu, Yuxin Meng, Ruihang Chu, Yujiu Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Video-Zero的框架，通过无标注的问答协同进化方法，专注于视频推理中的证据定位，从而提升视频理解模型的性能。

背景: 视频自我进化在视频理解领域应用尚不充分，因为视频具有长时、动态和冗余的特点，而推理所需的证据往往稀疏且时间局部化。

目的: 解决视频自我进化的关键瓶颈不是难度，而是证据的定位。

方法: 提出Video-Zero框架，包含Questioner和Solver两个组件，通过迭代循环实现证据发现、基于证据的监督和证据对齐的学习。

主要发现: 在涵盖时间定位、长视频理解和视频推理的13个基准测试中，Video-Zero一致地改进了多种视频VLM骨干网络。

结论: 证据中心的自我进化是有效的且具有可迁移性。

翻译: Self-evolution offers a promising path for improving reasoning models without relying on intensive human annotation. However, extending this paradigm to video understanding remains underexplored and challenging: videos are long, dynamic, and redundant, while the evidence needed for reasoning is often sparse and temporally localized. Naively generating difficult question-answer pairs from full videos can therefore produce supervision that appears challenging but is weakly grounded, relying on static cues or language priors rather than temporal evidence. In this work, we argue that the key bottleneck of video self-evolution is not difficulty alone, but grounding. We propose Video-Zero, an annotation-free Questioner--Solver co-evolution framework that centers self-evolution on temporally localized evidence. The Questioner discovers informative evidence segments and generates evidence-grounded questions, while the Solver learns to answer and align its predictions with the supporting evidence. This closes an iterative loop of evidence discovery, grounded supervision, and evidence-aligned learning. Across 13 benchmarks spanning temporal grounding, long-video understanding, and video reasoning, Video-Zero consistently improves multiple video VLM backbones, demonstrating the effectiveness and transferability of evidence-centered self-evolution.

Abstract

Self-evolution offers a promising path for improving reasoning models without relying on intensive human annotation. However, extending this paradigm to video understanding remains underexplored and challenging: videos are long, dynamic, and redundant, while the evidence needed for reasoning is often sparse and temporally localized. Naively generating difficult question-answer pairs from full videos can therefore produce supervision that appears challenging but is weakly grounded, relying on static cues or language priors rather than temporal evidence. In this work, we argue that the key bottleneck of video self-evolution is not difficulty alone, but grounding. We propose Video-Zero, an annotation-free Questioner--Solver co-evolution framework that centers self-evolution on temporally localized evidence. The Questioner discovers informative evidence segments and generates evidence-grounded questions, while the Solver learns to answer and align its predictions with the supporting evidence. This closes an iterative loop of evidence discovery, grounded supervision, and evidence-aligned learning. Across 13 benchmarks spanning temporal grounding, long-video understanding, and video reasoning, Video-Zero consistently improves multiple video VLM backbones, demonstrating the effectiveness and transferability of evidence-centered self-evolution.

item.title: MonoPRIO: Adaptive Prior Conditioning for Unified Monocular 3D Object Detection
item.author: Leon Davies, Qinggang Meng, Mohamad Saada, Baihua Li, Simon Sølvsten
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 MonoPRIO 的统一单目三维目标检测方法，通过自适应先验条件化解决单目三维目标检测中因遮挡、截断和投影引起的尺寸和深度不确定性问题，在 KITTI 数据集上取得了最佳性能。

背景: 单目三维目标检测面临挑战，因为单视角证据无法确定度量尺寸和深度，特别是在遮挡、截断以及由投影引起的尺度-深度模糊情况下。

目的: 提出 MonoPRIO，一种统一单目三维检测器，旨在通过在尺寸路径上进行自适应先验条件化来解决这一瓶颈。

方法: MonoPRIO 在离线阶段构建类感知尺寸原型，将每个解码器查询路由到软混合先验，应用不确定性感知的对数空间条件化，并在训练期间对匹配的正样本使用 Cluster-Aligned Prior (CAP) 正则化。

主要发现: 在 KITTI 测试服务器上，MonoPRIO 实现了报告完整汽车、行人和骑行者指标的方法中最佳的统一多类结果。在仅限汽车的设置中，它在 Easy/Moderate/Hard 类别中实现了最佳 3D 边界框 AP，且计算量比 MonoCLUE 少。消融和诊断显示，路由注入和 CAP 带来互补增益，在易模糊、部分遮挡和低数据情况下收益最大。

结论: 自适应先验在图像证据无法确定度量尺寸时最有效，但异常几何或极端可见性损失仍可能导致路由先验与真实实例几何不匹配。

翻译: 单目三维目标检测仍然具有挑战性，因为度量尺寸和深度由单视角证据无法确定，特别是在遮挡、截断和投影引起的尺度-深度模糊情况下。虽然最近的方法提高了深度和几何推理，但在统一多类设置中，度量尺寸仍然不稳定，其中类变性和部分可见性扩大了合理的尺寸模式。我们提出了 MonoPRIO，一种统一单目三维检测器，通过在尺寸路径上进行自适应先验条件化来解决这一瓶颈。MonoPRIO 在离线阶段构建类感知尺寸原型，将每个解码器查询路由到软混合先验，应用不确定性感知的对数空间条件化，并在训练期间对匹配的正样本使用 Cluster-Aligned Prior (CAP) 正则化。在 KITTI 测试服务器上，MonoPRIO 实现了报告完整汽车、行人和骑行者指标的方法中最佳的统一多类结果。在仅限汽车的设置中，它在 Easy/Moderate/Hard 类别中实现了最佳 3D 边界框 AP，且计算量比 MonoCLUE 少。消融和诊断显示，路由注入和 CAP 带来互补增益，在易模糊、部分遮挡和低数据情况下收益最大。这些发现表明，自适应先验在图像证据无法确定度量尺寸时最有效，但异常几何或极端可见性损失仍可能导致路由先验与真实实例几何不匹配。代码、训练模型、结果日志和可复现材料可在 https://github.com/bigggs/MonoPRIO 获取。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Monocular 3D object detection remains challenging because metric size and depth are underdetermined by single-view evidence, particularly under occlusion, truncation, and projection-induced scale-depth ambiguity. Although recent methods improve depth and geometric reasoning, metric size remains unstable in unified multi-class settings, where class variability and partial visibility broaden plausible size modes. We propose MonoPRIO, a unified monocular 3D detector that targets this bottleneck through adaptive prior conditioning in the size pathway. MonoPRIO constructs class-aware size prototypes offline, routes each decoder query to a soft mixture prior, applies uncertainty-aware log-space conditioning, and uses Cluster-Aligned Prior (CAP) regularisation on matched positives during training. On the official KITTI test server, MonoPRIO achieves the strongest fully reported unified multi-class result among methods reporting complete Car, Pedestrian, and Cyclist metrics. In the car-only setting, it also achieves the strongest 3D bounding-box AP across Easy/Moderate/Hard categories among compared methods without extra data, while using substantially less compute than MonoCLUE. Ablations and diagnostics show complementary gains from routed injection and CAP, with the largest benefits in ambiguity-prone, partially occluded, and low-data regimes. These findings indicate that adaptive priors are most effective when image evidence underdetermines metric size, while atypical geometry or extreme visibility loss can still cause mismatch between routed priors and true instance geometry. Code, trained models, result logs, and reproducibility material are available at https://github.com/bigggs/MonoPRIO.

item.title: Exploring Bottlenecks in VLM-LLM Navigation: How 3D Scene Understanding Capability Impacts Zero-Shot VLN
item.author: Ziyi Xia, Chaoran Xiong, Litao Wei, Xinhao Hu, Ling Pei
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了零样本视觉语言导航（VLN）中3D场景理解能力对导航性能的实际影响，并提出了一种基于统计成功率的性能上限分析方法。

背景: 零样本视觉语言导航（VLN）因数据收集成本低和泛化能力强而受到关注，通常由预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）和大型语言模型（LLM）集成驱动。然而，当前3D感知模型优先考虑像素级精度，这与具身导航对计算限制和实时效率的严格要求存在冲突。

目的: 量化3D场景理解能力对VLN性能的实际影响，以解决感知模型与导航实时性之间的矛盾。

方法: 基于典型的VLM-LLM框架，提出了两个核心子系统的统计成功率（SR）上限：1）依赖拓扑映射语义的慢速LLM规划器；2）利用空间坐标和边界框的快速反应式导航器。评估使用了最先进的3D场景理解模型。

主要发现: 验证了提出的上限，并揭示了感知饱和现象，即感知精度的提升超过特定阈值后，导航成功的收益递减。3D场景理解应从严格的像素级精度转向优先考虑导航相关的核心词汇和准确的边界框比例。

结论: 3D场景理解能力对VLN性能存在实际影响，且存在感知饱和现象，因此VLN的3D场景理解不应优先考虑像素级精度，而应关注导航相关的核心词汇和边界框比例。

翻译: 本文量化了3D场景理解能力对零样本视觉语言导航（VLN）性能的实际影响。基于典型的VLM-LLM框架，我们提出了两个核心子系统的统计成功率（SR）上限：1）依赖拓扑映射语义的慢速LLM规划器；2）利用空间坐标和边界框的快速反应式导航器。使用最先进的3D场景理解模型进行的评估验证了我们的上限，并揭示了感知饱和现象，表明感知精度的提升超过特定阈值后，导航成功的收益递减。我们的发现表明，VLN的3D场景理解应从严格的像素级精度转向优先考虑导航相关的核心词汇和准确的边界框比例。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要研究视觉语言模型和大语言模型在导航中的瓶颈，特别是3D场景理解能力如何影响零样本视觉语言导航的效果。这个问题很重要，因为零样本导航意味着机器人在没有针对特定场景训练的情况下也能工作，这对于实现更通用的机器人导航能力非常关键。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation (VLN) has gained significant attention due to its minimal data collection costs and inherent generalization. This paradigm is typically driven by the integration of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs), where VLMs construct 3D scene graphs while LLMs handle high-level reasoning and decision-making. However, a critical bottleneck exists in this system: current 3D perception models prioritize pixel-level accuracy, directly conflicting with the strict computational limits and real-time efficiency demanded by embodied navigation. To address this gap, this paper quantifies the actual impact of 3D scene understanding capability on VLN performance. Based on typical VLM-LLM frameworks, we propose statistical success rate (SR) upper bounds for two core subsystems: 1) the slow LLM planner, which relies on topological mapping semantics, and 2) the fast reactive navigator, which utilizes spatial coordinates and bounding boxes to execute LLM decisions. Evaluations using state-of-the-art 3D scene understanding models validate our proposed bounds and reveal a perception saturation phenomenon, indicating that improvements in perception accuracy beyond a certain threshold yield diminishing returns in navigation success. Our findings suggest that 3D scene understanding for VLN should pivot away from strict pixel-level precision, prioritizing instead navigation-relevant core vocabularies and accurate bounding box proportions.

item.title: GFMate: Empowering Graph Foundation Models with Test-time Prompt Tuning
item.author: Yan Jiang, Ruihong Qiu, Zi Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Graph prompt tuning 在图学习中有潜力，但现有方法存在特定领域依赖和预训练策略限制，本文提出 GFMate 方法。

背景: 现有图提示方法将源域信息嵌入提示中，限制了泛化能力，且仅依赖少样本微调，忽视了未标记目标域测试数据的丰富信息。

目的: 旨在赋予图基础模型预训练无关的测试时图提示微调能力。

方法: GFMate 引入质心和层提示，在目标域预训练后应用，避免与特定源域和预训练策略纠缠；并设计测试时互补学习目标，利用标记和未标记数据。

主要发现: 在12个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，GFMate 性能和效率优越，最高提升达30.63%。

结论: GFMate 通过测试时提示微调有效提升了图基础模型的泛化能力。

翻译: Graph prompt tuning has shown great potential in graph learning by introducing trainable prompts to enhance the model performance in conventional single-domain scenarios. Recent research has extended graph prompts to improve Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) by few-shot tuning auxiliary prompts. Despite their progress, most existing methods embed source-domain information into prompts, which serve either as input to GFMs or encoded during model pre-training. Such prompt entanglement with specific source domains and GFM pre-training strategy restricts their generalisability to other domains and different GFMs. Furthermore, existing GFM prompts merely rely on few-shot tuning for adaptation, neglecting the rich information in unlabelled target domain test data. Motivated by these insights, this paper aims to empower GFMs with pre-training-agnostic test-time graph prompt tuning, named GFMate. GFMate introduces centroid and layer prompts applied after pre-training on target domains, avoiding entanglement with specific source domains and model pre-training. In addition, a test-time complementary learning objective is devised to exploit both labelled and unlabelled target domain data for effective test-time prompt tuning. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior performance and efficiency of GFMate, achieving improvements of up to 30.63%. Code is available at https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/GFMate.

Abstract

Graph prompt tuning has shown great potential in graph learning by introducing trainable prompts to enhance the model performance in conventional single-domain scenarios. Recent research has extended graph prompts to improve Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) by few-shot tuning auxiliary prompts. Despite their progress, most existing methods embed source-domain information into prompts, which serve either as input to GFMs or encoded during model pre-training. Such prompt entanglement with specific source domains and GFM pre-training strategy restricts their generalisability to other domains and different GFMs. Furthermore, existing GFM prompts merely rely on few-shot tuning for adaptation, neglecting the rich information in unlabelled target domain test data. Motivated by these insights, this paper aims to empower GFMs with pre-training-agnostic test-time graph prompt tuning, named GFMate. GFMate introduces centroid and layer prompts applied after pre-training on target domains, avoiding entanglement with specific source domains and model pre-training. In addition, a test-time complementary learning objective is devised to exploit both labelled and unlabelled target domain data for effective test-time prompt tuning. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior performance and efficiency of GFMate, achieving improvements of up to 30.63%. Code is available at https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/GFMate.

item.title: MetaGEM: Bottom-Up Reconstruction of Genome-Scale Metabolic Networks via Deep Enzyme-Metabolite Anchoring
item.author: Weiyu Xiao, Jiangbin Zheng, Stan Z. Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MetaGEM提出了一种从代谢组学证据构建基因组规模代谢模型的新框架，通过酶作为物理锚点，结合蛋白质语言模型和三维代谢物表示，显著提高了酶-代谢物预测性能，并在大肠杆菌、枯草芽孢杆菌和铜绿假单胞菌的模型重建中表现出色。

背景: 传统的自上而下的基因组规模代谢模型重建严重依赖序列同源性，往往无法解决未知酶和代谢暗物质的问题；直接从代谢组学重建也面临映射问题中的组合模糊性和虚假网络等困难。

目的: 提出MetaGEM框架，旨在利用酶作为物理锚点，将系统级网络推断转化为酶-代谢物相互作用预测，从而实现从代谢组学证据到可计算代谢网络的实用途径。

方法: MetaGEM采用自下而上的框架，使用多模态双塔架构，结合蛋白质语言模型中的蛋白质进化语义和三维代谢物表示；引入对比学习和难负样本挖掘来分离结构相似的代谢物并减少假阳性相互作用。

主要发现: 在去同源化基准测试中，MetaGEM实现了最先进的酶-代谢物预测性能，AUROC达到0.9701，MCC达到0.8033，并且在低序列身份分割下保持稳健；下游重建的模型改善了网络连通性，捕获了非特异性酶，并与实验表型微阵列和基因必需性数据表现出强一致性。

结论: MetaGEM提供了一条从代谢组学证据到计算代谢网络的实用路线，并为自动化AI驱动的虚拟细胞重建奠定了基础。

翻译: 基因组规模代谢模型（GEMs）是系统生物学和理性底盘设计的重要工具，但传统的自上而下的重建严重依赖序列同源性，往往无法解决未知酶和代谢暗物质的问题。直接从代谢组学重建也很困难，因为将观察到的代谢物映射到反应是一个具有组合模糊性和可能虚假网络的病态逆问题。在这里，我们提出了MetaGEM，一种自下而上的框架，它使用酶作为物理锚点，将系统级网络推断转化为酶-代谢物相互作用预测。MetaGEM使用多模态双塔架构，结合来自蛋白质语言模型的蛋白质进化语义和三维代谢物表示。它进一步引入了对比学习和难负样本挖掘，以分离结构相似的代谢物并减少假阳性相互作用。在一个去同源化的基准测试中，MetaGEM实现了最先进的酶-代谢物预测性能，AUROC为0.9701，MCC为0.8033，并且在低序列身份分割下保持稳健。在下游重建中，MetaGEM为大肠杆菌、枯草芽孢杆菌和铜绿假单胞菌生成了功能基因组规模代谢模型。重建的模型改善了网络连通性，捕获了非特异性酶，并与实验表型微阵列和基因必需性数据表现出强一致性。这些结果表明，MetaGEM提供了一条从代谢组学证据到可计算代谢网络的实用路线，并为自动化AI驱动的虚拟细胞重建奠定了基础。

Abstract

Genome-scale metabolic models (GEMs) are essential tools for systems biology and rational chassis design, but conventional top-down reconstruction depends heavily on sequence homology and often leaves unknown enzymes and metabolic dark matter unresolved. Direct reconstruction from metabolomics is also difficult because mapping observed metabolites to reactions is an ill-posed inverse problem with combinatorial ambiguity and possible spurious networks. Here we present MetaGEM, a bottom-up framework that uses enzymes as physical anchors to convert system-level network inference into enzyme-metabolite interaction prediction. MetaGEM uses a multimodal dual-tower architecture that combines protein evolutionary semantics from a protein language model with three-dimensional metabolite representations. It further introduces contrastive learning with hard negative mining to separate structurally similar metabolites and reduce false positive interactions. On a de-homologized benchmark, MetaGEM achieves state-of-the-art enzyme-metabolite prediction performance, with AUROC of 0.9701 and MCC of 0.8033, and remains robust under low sequence identity splits. In downstream reconstruction, MetaGEM generates functional genome-scale metabolic models for Escherichia coli, Bacillus subtilis, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. The reconstructed models improve network connectivity, capture promiscuous enzymes, and show strong agreement with experimental phenotype microarray and gene essentiality data. These results indicate that MetaGEM provides a practical route from metabolomic evidence to computable metabolic networks and offers a foundation for automated AI-driven virtual cell reconstruction.

item.title: Unlocking Complex Visual Generation via Closed-Loop Verified Reasoning
item.author: Cheng, Hanbo, Lin, Limin, Zhang, Ruo, Pan, Yicheng, Du, Jun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CLVR框架通过闭环视觉推理解决当前文本到图像生成模型的复杂语义处理和推理延迟问题。

背景: 当前文本到图像模型主要依赖单步生成范式，难以处理复杂语义，且参数扩展收益递减。多步推理方法存在未验证的规划幻觉、僵化的事后反思、长上下文优化不稳定和推理延迟高等问题。

目的: 提出闭环视觉推理框架，深度耦合视觉语言逻辑规划与像素级扩散生成，以解决复杂视觉生成的瓶颈问题。

方法: CLVR包含自动数据引擎（带视觉验证的步骤级验证）以合成可靠推理轨迹，提出代理提示强化学习（PPRL）通过将多模态历史蒸馏为显式奖励信号来解决长上下文优化不稳定，以及提出Delta-Space Weight Merge（DSWM）以减少推理延迟。

主要发现: CLVR在多个基准测试中优于现有开源基线，并接近商业专有模型的性能，解锁了复杂视觉生成的通用测试时扩展能力。

结论: CLVR框架有效克服了现有文本到图像生成模型的瓶颈，实现了复杂视觉生成的高效和高质量。

翻译: 尽管取得了快速进步，当前的文本到图像模型主要依赖单步生成范式，难以处理复杂语义，且参数扩展收益递减。虽然最近的多步推理方法显示出前景，但它们受到缺乏验证的未验证规划幻觉、僵化的事后反思、长上下文优化不稳定以及高昂推理延迟的限制。为了克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了闭环视觉推理框架，这是一个深度耦合视觉语言逻辑规划与像素级扩散生成的综合系统。CLVR引入了一个带有步骤级视觉验证的自动数据引擎来合成可靠的推理轨迹，并提出了代理提示强化学习来解决长上下文优化不稳定，通过将交错的多模态历史蒸馏为显式奖励信号以实现准确的因果归因。此外，为了减轻由迭代去噪引起的严重延迟瓶颈，我们提出了Delta-Space Weight Merge，这是一种理论上合理的方法，将对齐权重与现成的蒸馏先验融合，将每步推理成本减少到仅4 NFEs，而无需昂贵的重新蒸馏。大量实验表明，CLVR在多个基准测试中优于现有的开源基线，并接近商业专有模型的性能，解锁了复杂视觉生成的通用测试时扩展能力。

Abstract

Despite rapid advancements, current text-to-image (T2I) models predominantly rely on a single-step generation paradigm, which struggles with complex semantics and faces diminishing returns from parameter scaling. While recent multi-step reasoning approaches show promise, they are hindered by ungrounded planning hallucinations lacking verification, monolithic post-hoc reflection, long-context optimization instabilities, and prohibitive inference latency. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose the Closed-Loop Visual Reasoning (CLVR) framework, a comprehensive system that deeply couples visual-language logical planning with pixel-level diffusion generation. CLVR introduces an automated data engine with step-level visual verification to synthesize reliable reasoning trajectories, and proposes Proxy Prompt Reinforcement Learning (PPRL) to resolve long-context optimization instabilities by distilling interleaved multimodal histories into explicit reward signals for accurate causal attribution. Furthermore, to mitigate the severe latency bottleneck caused by iterative denoising, we propose $\Delta$-Space Weight Merge (DSWM), a theoretically grounded method that fuses alignment weights with off-the-shelf distillation priors, reducing the per-step inference cost to just 4 NFEs without requiring expensive re-distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CLVR outperforms existing open-source baselines across multiple benchmarks and approaches the performance of proprietary commercial models, unlocking general test-time scaling capabilities for complex visual generation.

item.title: Denoising-GS: Gaussian Splatting with Spatial-aware Denoising
item.author: Qingyuan Zhou, Xinyi Liu, Weidong Yang, Ning Wang, Shuquan Ye, Ben Fei, Ying He, Wanli Ouyang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Denoising-GS 是一种新的 3D 高斯溅射优化框架，旨在通过去噪过程提高新视图合成（NVS）的保真度。

背景: 3D 高斯溅射（3DGS）在高质量新视图合成（NVS）方面取得了显著成功，但优化过程不可避免地引入了噪声高斯原语，这是由于结构从运动（SfM）点云的稀疏和不完整初始化造成的。

目的: 为了解决现有方法仅关注调整原语位置而忽略潜在空间结构的问题，本文提出了一种新的视角，将 3DGS 的优化视为原语去噪过程，并提出了 Denoising-GS，一种同时考虑原语位置和空间结构的感知去噪框架。

方法: 1. 设计了一个保留原语空间优化流的优化器，促进连贯和定向的去噪而非随机扰动；2. 基于空间梯度的去噪策略，联合考虑原语的空间支撑以确保梯度一致的更新；3. 基于不确定性的去噪模块，估计原语级不确定性以修剪冗余或噪声原语；4. 空间连贯性细化策略，在稀疏区域选择性分裂原语以维持结构完整性。

主要发现: 在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，Denoising-GS 在保持表示紧凑性的同时，一致地增强了 NVS 保真度，并在所有基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

结论: Denoising-GS 通过引入空间感知去噪框架，成功解决了 3DGS 优化中的噪声问题，显著提升了新视图合成的质量。

翻译: 3D 高斯溅射（3DGS）的最新进展在高质量新视图合成（NVS）方面取得了显著成功，然而优化过程不可避免地引入了噪声高斯原语，这是由于结构从运动（SfM）点云的稀疏和不完整初始化造成的。大多数现有方法仅关注在优化过程中调整原语的位置，而忽略了潜在的空间结构。为此，我们引入了一种新视角，将 3DGS 的优化视为原语去噪过程，并提出了 Denoising-GS，一种同时考虑原语位置和空间结构的感知去噪框架。具体而言，我们设计了一个保留原语空间优化流的优化器，促进连贯和定向的去噪而非随机扰动。在此基础上，基于空间梯度的去噪策略联合考虑原语的空间支撑以确保梯度一致的更新。此外，基于不确定性的去噪模块估计原语级不确定性以修剪冗余或噪声原语，而空间连贯性细化策略在稀疏区域选择性分裂原语以维持结构完整性。在三个基准数据集上进行的实验表明，Denoising-GS 在保持表示紧凑性的同时一致地增强了 NVS 保真度，并在所有基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。源代码和模型将公开提供。

Abstract

Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable success in high-fidelity Novel View Synthesis (NVS), yet the optimization process inevitably introduces noisy Gaussian primitives due to the sparse and incomplete initialization from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) point clouds. Most existing methods focus solely on adjusting the positions of primitives during optimization, while neglecting the underlying spatial structure. To this end, we introduce a new perspective by formulating the optimization of 3DGS as a primitive denoising process and propose Denoising-GS, a spatial-aware denoising framework for Gaussian primitives by taking both the positions and spatial structure into consideration. Specifically, we design an optimizer that preserves the spatial optimization flow of primitives, facilitating coherent and directed denoising rather than random perturbations. Building upon this, the Spatial Gradient-based Denoising strategy jointly considers the spatial supports of primitives to ensure gradient-consistent updates. Furthermore, the Uncertainty-based Denoising module estimates primitive-wise uncertainty to prune redundant or noisy primitives, while the Spatial Coherence Refinement strategy selectively splits primitives in sparse regions to maintain structural completeness. Experiments conducted on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that Denoising-GS consistently enhances NVS fidelity while maintaining representation compactness, achieving state-of-the-art performance across all benchmarks. Source code and models will be made publicly available.

item.title: Tokenizer Fertility and Zero-Shot Performance of Foundation Models on Ukrainian Legal Text: A Comparative Study
item.author: Volodymyr Ovcharov
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究对比了七种模型在乌克兰法律文本处理上的效率与性能，发现分词器效率差异显著，NVIDIA Nemotron Super 3在成本和性能上表现最佳，且零样本提示优于少样本提示。

背景: 现有研究缺乏对乌克兰法律文本领域内模型分词效率的系统比较。

目的: 对七种来自五家提供商的模型在乌克兰国家法院登记处（EDRSR）的273份已验证判决书上进行基准测试，测量分词器效率和零样本性能。

方法: 在273份乌克兰法律文本上测试七种模型的分词器生育率（token消耗量）和零样本任务性能，并进行了分层和提示敏感性消融实验。

主要发现: 1. 分词器生育率差异达1.6倍，Qwen3模型比Llama系列模型多消耗60%的token；2. NVIDIA Nemotron Super 3（120B）综合得分最高（83.1），以三分之一的API成本击败了参数更多但表现更差的Mistral Large 3；3. 少样本提示导致性能下降最多达26个百分点，这是乌克兰语言演示固有的问题，而非示例选择导致的。

结论: 对于从业者，在选择模型前应进行分词器分析；对于形态学丰富的语言，零样本提示比少样本提示更可靠。

翻译: Foundation models tokenize Ukrainian legal text with vastly different efficiency, yet no systematic comparison exists for this domain. We benchmark seven models from five providers on 273 validated court decisions from Ukraine's state registry (EDRSR), measuring tokenizer fertility and zero-shot performance on three tasks. Three findings emerge. (1) Tokenizer fertility varies 1.6x: Qwen3 models consume 60% more tokens than Llama-family models on identical input, directly reducing API cost. (2) NVIDIA Nemotron Super 3 (120B) achieves the highest composite score (83.1), outperforming Mistral Large 3 (675B total, 41B active) -- a model with 5.6x more total parameters and 3.4x more active parameters per token -- at one-third the API cost. (3) Few-shot prompting degrades performance by up to 26 percentage points; stratified and prompt-sensitivity ablations confirm this is intrinsic to Ukrainian-language demonstrations, not an artifact of example selection. For practitioners: tokenizer analysis should precede model selection, and zero-shot is a more reliable default than few-shot for morphologically rich languages.

Abstract

Foundation models tokenize Ukrainian legal text with vastly different efficiency, yet no systematic comparison exists for this domain. We benchmark seven models from five providers on 273 validated court decisions from Ukraine's state registry (EDRSR), measuring tokenizer fertility and zero-shot performance on three tasks. Three findings emerge. (1) Tokenizer fertility varies 1.6x: Qwen3 models consume 60% more tokens than Llama-family models on identical input, directly reducing API cost. (2) NVIDIA Nemotron Super 3 (120B) achieves the highest composite score (83.1), outperforming Mistral Large 3 (675B total, 41B active) -- a model with 5.6x more total parameters and 3.4x more active parameters per token -- at one-third the API cost. (3) Few-shot prompting degrades performance by up to 26 percentage points; stratified and prompt-sensitivity ablations confirm this is intrinsic to Ukrainian-language demonstrations, not an artifact of example selection. For practitioners: tokenizer analysis should precede model selection, and zero-shot is a more reliable default than few-shot for morphologically rich languages.

item.title: Beyond Individual Intelligence: Surveying Collaboration, Failure Attribution, and Self-Evolution in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
item.author: Qi, Shihao, Ma, Jie, Xing, Rui, Guo, Wei, Huang, Xiao, Gao, Zhitao, Deng, Jianhao, Liu, Jun, Zhang, Lingling, Wei, Bifan, Yang, Boqian, Wang, Pinghui, Sun, Jianwen, Tao, Jing, Wu, Yaqiang, Liu, Hui, Yao, Yu, Liu, Tongliang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该综述文章探讨了基于大语言模型的自主智能体在多智能体系统中的协调、故障诊断及自我进化能力，提出了LIFE进展框架。

背景: 基于大语言模型的自主智能体在推理、规划和工具使用方面表现出色，但在跨角色、工具和环境的持续协调方面存在局限。多智能体系统通过结构化协作解决此问题，但协调的紧密性也放大了错误传播的风险，导致难以诊断且难以转化为结构自我改进。

目的: 提供统一的综述，组织围绕四个因果关联阶段，即LIFE进展：建立能力基础、通过协作集成智能体、通过归因发现故障、通过自主自我进化。

方法: 通过系统分类法对每个阶段进行正式化描述，揭示相邻阶段之间的依赖关系，并识别阶段边界处的开放挑战。

主要发现: 揭示了每个阶段既依赖于下一个阶段又约束下一个阶段，并提出了跨阶段研究议程，以实现闭环多智能体系统。

结论: 通过整合先前分散的研究线索，旨在为自主、自我进化的多智能体智能提供系统性参考和概念路线图。

翻译: 基于大语言模型的自主智能体在推理、规划和工具使用方面表现出强大的能力，但在需要跨角色、工具和环境持续协调的任务中仍受到限制。多智能体系统通过专业化智能体之间的结构化协作来解决这一问题，但更紧密的协调也放大了一种较少被探索的风险：错误可以在智能体和交互回合之间传播，产生难以诊断且很少转化为结构自我改进的故障。现有综述分别涵盖单个智能体能力、多智能体协作或智能体自我进化，留下了它们之间因果依赖关系的未考察。本综述提供了围绕四个因果关联阶段组织的统一综述，我们称之为LIFE进展：奠定能力基础、通过协作集成智能体、通过归因发现故障、通过自主自我进化。对于每个阶段，我们提供系统分类法并形式化描述相邻阶段之间的依赖关系，揭示每个阶段既依赖于下一个阶段又约束下一个阶段。除了综合现有工作外，我们在阶段边界处识别开放挑战，并为能够持续诊断故障、重组结构和完善智能体行为的闭环多智能体系统提出跨阶段研究议程，将当前协调框架扩展到更具自组织性的集体智能形式。通过连接这些先前分散的研究线索，本综述旨在为自主、自我进化的多智能体智能提供系统性参考和概念路线图。

Abstract

LLM-based autonomous agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool use, yet remain limited when tasks require sustained coordination across roles, tools, and environments. Multi-agent systems address this through structured collaboration among specialized agents, but tighter coordination also amplifies a less explored risk: errors can propagate across agents and interaction rounds, producing failures that are difficult to diagnose and rarely translate into structural self-improvement. Existing surveys cover individual agent capabilities, multi-agent collaboration, or agent self-evolution separately, leaving the causal dependencies among them unexamined. This survey provides a unified review organized around four causally linked stages, which we term the LIFE progression: Lay the capability foundation, Integrate agents through collaboration, Find faults through attribution, and Evolve through autonomous self-improvement. For each stage, we provide systematic taxonomies and formally characterize the dependencies between adjacent stages, revealing how each stage both depends on and constrains the next. Beyond synthesizing existing work, we identify open challenges at stage boundaries and propose a cross-stage research agenda for closed-loop multi-agent systems capable of continuously diagnosing failures, reorganizing structures, and refining agent behaviors, extending current coordination frameworks toward more self-organizing forms of collective intelligence. By bridging these previously fragmented research threads, this survey aims to offer both a systematic reference and a conceptual roadmap toward autonomous, self-improving multi-agent intelligence.

item.title: MemLens: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Memory in Large Vision-Language Models
item.author: Xiyu Ren, Zhaowei Wang, Yiming Du, Zhongwei Xie, Chi Liu, Xinlin Yang, Haoyue Feng, Wenjun Pan, Tianshi Zheng, Baixuan Xu, Zhengnan Li, Yangqiu Song, Ginny Wong, Simon See
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了MEMLENS基准测试，用于评估多模态多会话对话中的记忆能力，包含789个问题，涵盖五种记忆能力，并在四种标准上下文长度下进行测试。

背景: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）需要记忆来处理长多模态交互，目前主要有长上下文LVLMs和记忆增强代理两种方法方向，但缺乏对真正需要多模态证据的问题进行系统性比较的基准。

目的: 为了填补现有基准的空白，作者引入MEMLENS，这是一个全面的多模态多会话对话记忆基准测试。

方法: MEMLENS包含789个问题，涵盖五种记忆能力（信息提取、多会话推理、时间推理、知识更新和回答拒绝），在四种标准上下文长度（32K-256K tokens）下，基于跨模态令牌计数方案进行测试。

主要发现: 1. 图像消融研究证实，解决MEMLENS需要视觉证据，移除证据图像会使前沿LVLMs在包含图像的问题上准确率降至2%以下；2. 27个LVLMs和7个记忆增强代理的评估显示，长上下文LVLMs通过直接视觉接地获得高短上下文准确率，但随着对话增长而下降，而记忆代理长度稳定但失去视觉保真度；3. 多会话推理限制大多数系统在30%以下，且单一方法无法解决该任务。

结论: 这些结果激励了混合架构的开发，该架构结合长上下文注意力机制与结构化多模态检索。

翻译: Memory is essential for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to handle long, multimodal interactions, with two method directions providing this capability: long-context LVLMs and memory-augmented agents. However, no existing benchmark conducts a systematic comparison of the two on questions that genuinely require multimodal evidence. To close this gap, we introduce MEMLENS, a comprehensive benchmark for memory in multimodal multi-session conversations, comprising 789 questions across five memory abilities (information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge update, and answer refusal) at four standard context lengths (32K-256K tokens) under a cross-modal token-counting scheme. An image-ablation study confirms that solving MEMLENS requires visual evidence: removing evidence images drops two frontier LVLMs below 2% accuracy on the 80.4% of questions whose evidence includes images. Evaluating 27 LVLMs and 7 memory-augmented agents, we find that long-context LVLMs achieve high short-context accuracy through direct visual grounding but degrade as conversations grow, whereas memory agents are length-stable but lose visual fidelity under storage-time compression. Multi-session reasoning caps most systems below 30%, and neither approach alone solves the task. These results motivate hybrid architectures that combine long-context attention with structured multimodal retrieval. Our code is available at https://github.com/xrenaf/MEMLENS.
