如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了VoxCor方法，用于解决多模态体素对应问题，且该方法无需训练。

Abstract

Cross-modal 3D medical image analysis requires voxelwise representations that remain anatomically consistent across imaging contrasts, scanners, and acquisition protocols. Recent work has shown that frozen 2D Vision Transformer (ViT) foundation models can support such representations, but typical pipelines extract features along a single anatomical axis and adapt those features inside a registration solver for one image pair at a time, leaving complementary viewing directions unused and producing representations that do not transfer to new volumes. We introduce VoxCor, a training-free fit--transform method for reusable volumetric feature representations from frozen 2D ViT foundation models. During an offline fitting phase, VoxCor combines triplanar ViT inference with a compact closed-form weighted partial least squares (WPLS) projection that uses fitting-time voxel correspondences to select modality-stable anatomical directions in the triplanar feature space. At transform time, new volumes are mapped by triplanar ViT inference and linear projection alone, without fine-tuning or registration. Voxel correspondences can then be queried directly by nearest-neighbor search. We evaluate VoxCor on intra-subject Abdomen MR--CT and inter-subject HCP T2w--T1w tasks using deformable registration, voxelwise k-nearest-neighbor segmentation, and segmentation-center landmark localization. VoxCor improves the hardest cross-subject, cross-modality transfer settings, reduces encoder sensitivity for dense correspondence transfer, and yields registration performance competitive with handcrafted descriptors and learned 3D features. This positions VoxCor as a reusable feature layer for downstream multimodal analysis beyond pairwise registration. Code, configuration files, and implementation details are publicly available on GitHub at \href{https://github.com/guneytombak/VoxCor}{guneytombak/VoxCor}.

item.title: OmniLiDAR: A Unified Diffusion Framework for Multi-Domain 3D LiDAR Generation
item.author: Youquan Liu, Weidong Yang, Ao Liang, Xiang Xu, Lingdong Kong, Yang Wu, Dekai Zhu, Xin Li, Runnan Chen, Ben Fei, Tongliang Liu, Wanli Ouyang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OmniLiDAR是一个统一的文本条件扩散框架，能够在八个代表性域中生成激光雷达扫描数据，通过跨域训练策略和特征建模方法实现跨域生成。

背景: LiDAR场景生成对于可扩展模拟和合成数据创建越来越重要，特别是在多样化的传感条件下难以大规模采集。传统的基于扩散的LiDAR生成器通常在单域设置下开发，需要针对不同数据集或传感条件分别建立模型，阻碍了在异质分布偏移下的统一可控合成。

目的: 提出OmniLiDAR，一个统一的文本条件扩散框架，旨在在共享的range-image表示下跨八个代表性域生成LiDAR扫描，以克服单域设置的限制。

方法: 引入跨域训练策略（CDTS），在每个mini-batch中混合域并利用条件引导生成；提出跨域特征建模（CDFM），沿方位角和仰角轴捕获方向依赖性以反映range图像的各向异性扫描结构；提出域自适应特征缩放（DAFS）作为轻量级调制，以在去噪过程中考虑结构化的域依赖特征偏移。

主要发现: 构建了8域数据集，结合真实世界扫描与基于物理的天气模拟和系统束减少；实验表明在下游应用中具有强大的生成保真度和一致的增益，包括LiDAR语义分割和3D目标检测的生成数据增强，以及在损坏下的鲁棒性评估，以及在有限标签情况下的持续效益。

结论: OmniLiDAR通过统一框架和跨域策略，实现了在多样化传感条件下的LiDAR扫描生成，并在下游任务中表现出色。

翻译: LiDAR场景生成对于可扩展模拟和合成数据创建越来越重要，特别是在多样化的传感条件下难以大规模采集。传统的基于扩散的LiDAR生成器通常在单域设置下开发，需要针对不同数据集或传感条件分别建立模型，阻碍了在异质分布偏移下的统一可控合成。为此，我们提出了OmniLiDAR，一个统一的文本条件扩散框架，能够在共享的range-image表示下跨八个代表性域生成LiDAR扫描，这些域涵盖三种偏移类型：恶劣天气、传感器配置变化（如减少光束）以及跨平台采集（车辆、无人机和四足机器人）。为了能够在异质域上训练单个模型而不隔离域优化，我们引入了跨域训练策略（CDTS），在每个mini-batch中混合域并利用条件引导生成。我们进一步提出了跨域特征建模（CDFM），沿方位角和仰角轴捕获方向依赖性以反映range图像的各向异性扫描结构，并提出了域自适应特征缩放（DAFS）作为轻量级调制，以在去噪过程中考虑结构化的域依赖特征偏移。在没有公开综合基准的情况下，我们通过结合真实世界扫描与基于物理的天气模拟和系统束减少，同时遵循官方划分，构建了8域数据集。广泛的实验证明了强大的生成保真度和下游用例中的一致增益，包括LiDAR语义分割和3D目标检测的生成数据增强，以及在损坏下的鲁棒性评估，以及在有限标签情况下的持续效益。

Abstract

LiDAR scene generation is increasingly important for scalable simulation and synthetic data creation, especially under diverse sensing conditions that are costly to capture at scale. Typically, diffusion-based LiDAR generators are developed under single-domain settings, requiring separate models for different datasets or sensing conditions and hindering unified, controllable synthesis under heterogeneous distribution shifts. To this end, we present OmniLiDAR, a unified text-conditioned diffusion framework that generates LiDAR scans in a shared range-image representation across eight representative domains spanning three shift types: adverse weather, sensor-configuration changes (e.g., reduced beams), and cross-platform acquisition (vehicle, drone, and quadruped). To enable training a single model over heterogeneous domains without isolating optimization by domain, we introduce a Cross-Domain Training Strategy (CDTS) that mixes domains within each mini-batch and leverages conditioning to steer generation. We further propose Cross-Domain Feature Modeling (CDFM), which captures directional dependencies along azimuth and elevation axes to reflect the anisotropic scanning structure of range images, and Domain-Adaptive Feature Scaling (DAFS) as a lightweight modulation to account for structured domain-dependent feature shifts during denoising. In the absence of a public consolidated benchmark, we construct an 8-domain dataset by combining real-world scans with physically based weather simulation and systematic beam reduction while following official splits. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong generation fidelity and consistent gains in downstream use cases, including generative data augmentation for LiDAR semantic segmentation and 3D object detection, as well as robustness evaluation under corruptions, with consistent benefits in limited-label regimes.

item.title: Training Long-Context Vision-Language Models Effectively with Generalization Beyond 128K Context
item.author: Zhaowei Wang, Lishu Luo, Haodong Duan, Weiwei Liu, Sijin Wu, Ji Luo, Shen Yan, Shuai Peng, Sihang Yuan, Chaoyi Huang, Yi Lin, Yangqiu Song
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文系统研究了长上下文持续预训练方法，通过扩展7B模型上下文长度至128K并进行了大量消融实验，提出了MMProLong模型，在长文档理解、网页检索、视觉文本压缩和长视频理解等任务上表现出色。

背景: 长上下文建模是现代大型视觉语言模型的核心能力，但在实际训练配方方面仍探索不足，特别是在长上下文数据混合的设计与平衡方面。

目的: 对LVLMs的长上下文持续预训练进行系统研究，通过扩展7B模型的上下文长度至128K，并利用长文档数据进行大量消融实验，以建立实用的长上下文预训练配方。

方法: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型，在仅使用50亿token预算的情况下进行长上下文持续预训练，引入MMProLong模型，并进行了关于序列长度分布、检索和推理数据的消融实验。

主要发现: 1. 长文档VQA比OCR转录更有效；2. 平衡的数据分布优于目标长度聚焦的数据；3. 检索仍是主要瓶颈，偏向检索密集型混合数据；4. 纯长文档VQA能保留短上下文能力。

结论: MMProLong模型在长文档VQA上提升了7.1%的分数，并在256K和512K上下文下保持强性能，无需额外训练即可泛化到网页检索、视觉文本压缩和长视频理解等任务。

翻译: 长上下文建模已成为现代大型视觉语言模型的核心能力，使其能够在长文档理解、视频分析和代理工作流中的多轮工具使用中持续管理上下文。然而，实际的训练配方仍探索不足，特别是在长上下文数据混合的设计与平衡方面。在这项工作中，我们对LVLMs的长上下文持续预训练进行了系统研究，通过扩展7B模型从32K到128K上下文，并对长文档数据进行了广泛的消融实验。我们首先表明，长文档VQA比OCR转录更有效。基于这一观察，我们的消融实验进一步得出三个关键发现：i) 对于序列长度分布，平衡的数据优于目标长度聚焦的数据（例如128K），表明长上下文能力需要跨各种长度和位置的可泛化关键信息检索；ii) 检索仍然是主要瓶颈，偏向检索密集型混合数据和适度的推理数据以实现任务多样性；iii) 纯长文档VQA在很大程度上保留了短上下文能力，表明格式化的长数据减少了混合短数据的需要。基于这些发现，我们介绍了MMProLong，它通过仅使用50亿token预算从Qwen2.5-VL-7B进行长上下文持续预训练获得。MMProLong将长文档VQA分数提高了7.1%，并在其128K训练窗口之外的256K和512K上下文下保持强性能，无需额外训练。它进一步泛化到基于网页的多模态针点检索、长上下文视觉文本压缩和长视频理解，无需特定任务的监督。总的来说，我们的研究建立了一个实用的长上下文预训练配方，并为推进长上下文视觉语言模型奠定了实证基础。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Long-context modeling is becoming a core capability of modern large vision-language models (LVLMs), enabling sustained context management across long-document understanding, video analysis, and multi-turn tool use in agentic workflows. Yet practical training recipes remain insufficiently explored, particularly for designing and balancing long-context data mixtures. In this work, we present a systematic study of long-context continued pre-training for LVLMs, extending a 7B model from 32K to 128K context with extensive ablations on long-document data. We first show that long-document VQA is substantially more effective than OCR transcription. Building on this observation, our ablations further yield three key findings: i) for sequence-length distribution, balanced data outperforms target-length-focused data (e.g., 128K), suggesting that long-context ability requires generalizable key-information retrieval across various lengths and positions; ii) retrieval remains the primary bottleneck, favoring retrieval-heavy mixtures with modest reasoning data for task diversity; and iii) pure long-document VQA largely preserves short-context capabilities, suggesting that instruction-formatted long data reduces the need for short-data mixing. Based on these findings, we introduce MMProLong, obtained by long-context continued pre-training from Qwen2.5-VL-7B with only a 5B-token budget. MMProLong improves long-document VQA scores by 7.1% and maintains strong performance at 256K and 512K contexts beyond its 128K training window, without additional training. It further generalizes to webpage-based multimodal needle retrieval, long-context vision-text compression, and long-video understanding without task-specific supervision. Overall, our study establishes a practical LongPT recipe and an empirical foundation for advancing long-context vision-language models.

item.title: A transfer-learning-enhanced POD-FNN surrogate for rapid signal prediction and inverse fitting in thermoreflectance with patterned transducers
item.author: Xiao, Bingjia, Chen, Tao, Jiang, Puqing
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于迁移学习增强的POD-FNN代理模型，用于快速预测图案化换能器热反射率中的相位，以解决迭代拟合中高保真前向评估成本高的问题。

背景: 图案化换能器热反射率通过抑制金属换能器中的横向热扩散来增强对低热导率材料的灵敏度，但其更广泛的应用受到迭代拟合中重复高保真前向评估成本的限制。

目的: 开发一种迁移学习增强的POD-FNN代理模型，以实现图案化换能器热反射率中相位的快速预测。

方法: 首先构建了经过验证的COMSOL模型，直接对相位信号应用正交分解以建立紧凑的降阶表示；然后训练一个前馈神经网络，根据热物理和几何参数预测POD系数。

主要发现: 该代理模型在原始参数域内实现了平均和中位RMSE分别为0.19和0.17度，最大RMSE低于0.47度，同时将平均预测时间从5.39秒减少到0.01秒（约534倍）；在逆分析中，代表案例的拟合时间从约18950秒减少到约65秒，且精度相当；在扩展参数域中，迁移学习进一步提高了性能；将目标域数据集从6000个样本减少到1000个样本，也降低了高保真数据生成时间。

结论: 该框架为图案化热反射率工作流程中的重复前向评估、快速逆拟合和具有成本效益的模型更新提供了一条准确且高效的途径。

翻译: Patterned-transducer thermoreflectance enhances sensitivity to low-thermal-conductivity materials by suppressing lateral heat spreading in the metal transducer, but its wider use is limited by the cost of repeated high-fidelity forward evaluations in iterative fitting. Here, we develop a transfer-learning-enhanced POD-FNN surrogate for rapid phase prediction in patterned-transducer thermoreflectance, using patterned FDTR as a representative case. A validated COMSOL model is first constructed, and proper orthogonal decomposition is applied directly to the phase signals to build a compact reduced-order representation. A feedforward neural network is then trained to predict the POD coefficients from thermophysical and geometric parameters. Within the original parameter domain, the surrogate achieves mean and median RMSE values of 0.19 and 0.17 degrees, with a maximum RMSE below 0.47 degrees, while reducing the average prediction time per signal from 5.39 s to 0.01 s (about 534x). In inverse analysis, the fitting time for a representative case is reduced from about 18950 s to about 65 s with comparable accuracy. The framework is further applied to measured Al/SiO2 samples, yielding stable silica thermal conductivities of 1.44 +/- 0.088, 1.43 +/- 0.093, and 1.50 +/- 0.079 W/(m K) for conventional FDTR and patterned FDTR with pattern radii of 5.3 and 3.25 um, respectively. Transfer learning further improves performance in expanded parameter domains, with the TL-FR strategy giving the best overall results. Reducing the additional target-domain dataset from 6000 to 1000 samples also lowers the high-fidelity data-generation time from about 34179 s to about 5885 s. The proposed framework provides an accurate and efficient route for repeated forward evaluation, rapid inverse fitting, and cost-effective model updating in patterned thermoreflectance workflows.

Abstract

Patterned-transducer thermoreflectance enhances sensitivity to low-thermal-conductivity materials by suppressing lateral heat spreading in the metal transducer, but its wider use is limited by the cost of repeated high-fidelity forward evaluations in iterative fitting. Here, we develop a transfer-learning-enhanced POD-FNN surrogate for rapid phase prediction in patterned-transducer thermoreflectance, using patterned FDTR as a representative case. A validated COMSOL model is first constructed, and proper orthogonal decomposition is applied directly to the phase signals to build a compact reduced-order representation. A feedforward neural network is then trained to predict the POD coefficients from thermophysical and geometric parameters. Within the original parameter domain, the surrogate achieves mean and median RMSE values of 0.19 and 0.17 degrees, with a maximum RMSE below 0.47 degrees, while reducing the average prediction time per signal from 5.39 s to 0.01 s (about 534x). In inverse analysis, the fitting time for a representative case is reduced from about 18950 s to about 65 s with comparable accuracy. The framework is further applied to measured Al/SiO2 samples, yielding stable silica thermal conductivities of 1.44 +/- 0.088, 1.43 +/- 0.093, and 1.50 +/- 0.079 W/(m K) for conventional FDTR and patterned FDTR with pattern radii of 5.3 and 3.25 um, respectively. Transfer learning further improves performance in expanded parameter domains, with the TL-FR strategy giving the best overall results. Reducing the additional target-domain dataset from 6000 to 1000 samples also lowers the high-fidelity data-generation time from about 34179 s to about 5885 s. The proposed framework provides an accurate and efficient route for repeated forward evaluation, rapid inverse fitting, and cost-effective model updating in patterned thermoreflectance workflows.

item.title: EngramaBench: Evaluating Long-Term Conversational Memory with Structured Graph Retrieval
item.author: Julian Acuna
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了 EngramaBench 基准测试，并评估了 Engrama 图结构记忆系统与 GPT-4o 全上下文提示和 Mem0 向量检索系统的性能差异。

背景: 大语言模型助手需要跨多个会话保留和推理信息。

目的: 评估不同记忆架构在长期对话记忆中的表现。

方法: 使用 EngramaBench（包含五个角色、一百个多会话对话、一百五十个查询）评估 Engrama、GPT-4o 全上下文提示和 Mem0。所有系统使用相同的回答模型 GPT-4o，以隔离记忆架构的影响。

主要发现: GPT-4o 全上下文得分最高，Engrama 在全局得分上略低但在跨空间推理上表现更好，Mem0 最便宜但性能最弱。消融实验显示 Engrama 的跨空间优势是以牺牲全局得分为代价的。

结论: 结构化记忆专业化与整体优化之间存在系统层面的权衡。

翻译: Large language model assistants are increasingly expected to retain and reason over information accumulated across many sessions. We introduce EngramaBench, a benchmark for long-term conversational memory built around five personas, one hundred multi-session conversations, and one hundred fifty queries spanning factual recall, cross-space integration, temporal reasoning, adversarial abstention, and emergent synthesis. We evaluate Engrama, a graph-structured memory system, against GPT-4o full-context prompting and Mem0, an open-source vector-retrieval memory system. All three use the same answering model (GPT-4o), isolating the effect of memory architecture. GPT-4o full-context achieves the highest composite score (0.6186), while Engrama scores 0.5367 globally but is the only system to score higher than full-context prompting on cross-space reasoning (0.6532 vs. 0.6291, n=30). Mem0 is cheapest but substantially weaker (0.4809). Ablations reveal that the components driving Engrama's cross-space advantage trade off against global composite score, exposing a systems-level tension between structured memory specialization and aggregate optimization.

Abstract

Large language model assistants are increasingly expected to retain and reason over information accumulated across many sessions. We introduce EngramaBench, a benchmark for long-term conversational memory built around five personas, one hundred multi-session conversations, and one hundred fifty queries spanning factual recall, cross-space integration, temporal reasoning, adversarial abstention, and emergent synthesis. We evaluate Engrama, a graph-structured memory system, against GPT-4o full-context prompting and Mem0, an open-source vector-retrieval memory system. All three use the same answering model (GPT-4o), isolating the effect of memory architecture. GPT-4o full-context achieves the highest composite score (0.6186), while Engrama scores 0.5367 globally but is the only system to score higher than full-context prompting on cross-space reasoning (0.6532 vs. 0.6291, n=30). Mem0 is cheapest but substantially weaker (0.4809). Ablations reveal that the components driving Engrama's cross-space advantage trade off against global composite score, exposing a systems-level tension between structured memory specialization and aggregate optimization.

item.title: Trust-SSL: Additive-Residual Selective Invariance for Robust Aerial Self-Supervised Learning
item.author: Boulila, Wadii, Ammar, Adel, Benjdira, Bilel, Driss, Maha
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种基于加性残差的训练策略和架构修改，以增强自监督学习对遥感图像退化（如雾霾、模糊）的鲁棒性。

背景: 自监督学习是遥感图像表示学习的标准方法，但现有方法在处理严重退化图像时，强制对齐干净视图和退化视图会引入虚假结构。

目的: 提出一种训练策略和架构修改，增强自监督学习对图像退化（如雾霾、模糊、遮挡）的鲁棒性。

方法: 引入逐样本、逐因子的信任权重作为对比损失的加性残差，并使用停止梯度而非乘性门控。

主要发现: 在多个数据集上实现了最高的线性探测准确率；在严重信息擦除（如雾霾）场景下提升显著；在跨域零样本测试中具有一致的AUROC增益；消融实验证实加性残差是改进的主要原因；基于Dempster-Shafer融合的证据变体引入了可解释的冲突和未知信号。

结论: 该方法为不确定性感知的自监督学习提供了具体的设计原则，代码已公开。

翻译: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a standard approach for representation learning in aerial imagery. Existing methods enforce invariance between augmented views, which works well when augmentations preserve semantic content. However, aerial images are frequently degraded by haze, motion blur, rain, and occlusion that remove critical evidence. Enforcing alignment between a clean and a severely degraded view can introduce spurious structure into the latent space. This study proposes a training strategy and architectural modification to enhance SSL robustness to such corruptions. It introduces a per-sample, per-factor trust weight into the alignment objective, combined with the base contrastive loss as an additive residual. A stop-gradient is applied to the trust weight instead of a multiplicative gate. While a multiplicative gate is a natural choice, experiments show it impairs the backbone, whereas our additive-residual approach improves it. Using a 200-epoch protocol on a 210,000-image corpus, the method achieves the highest mean linear-probe accuracy among six backbones on EuroSAT, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45 (90.20% compared to 88.46% for SimCLR and 89.82% for VICReg). It yields the largest improvements under severe information-erasing corruptions on EuroSAT (+19.9 points on haze at s=5 over SimCLR). The method also demonstrates consistent gains of +1 to +3 points in Mahalanobis AUROC on a zero-shot cross-domain stress test using BDD100K weather splits. Two ablations (scalar uncertainty and cosine gate) indicate the additive-residual formulation is the primary source of these improvements. An evidential variant using Dempster-Shafer fusion introduces interpretable signals of conflict and ignorance. These findings offer a concrete design principle for uncertainty-aware SSL. Code is publicly available at this https URL .

Abstract

Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a standard approach for representation learning in aerial imagery. Existing methods enforce invariance between augmented views, which works well when augmentations preserve semantic content. However, aerial images are frequently degraded by haze, motion blur, rain, and occlusion that remove critical evidence. Enforcing alignment between a clean and a severely degraded view can introduce spurious structure into the latent space. This study proposes a training strategy and architectural modification to enhance SSL robustness to such corruptions. It introduces a per-sample, per-factor trust weight into the alignment objective, combined with the base contrastive loss as an additive residual. A stop-gradient is applied to the trust weight instead of a multiplicative gate. While a multiplicative gate is a natural choice, experiments show it impairs the backbone, whereas our additive-residual approach improves it. Using a 200-epoch protocol on a 210,000-image corpus, the method achieves the highest mean linear-probe accuracy among six backbones on EuroSAT, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45 (90.20% compared to 88.46% for SimCLR and 89.82% for VICReg). It yields the largest improvements under severe information-erasing corruptions on EuroSAT (+19.9 points on haze at s=5 over SimCLR). The method also demonstrates consistent gains of +1 to +3 points in Mahalanobis AUROC on a zero-shot cross-domain stress test using BDD100K weather splits. Two ablations (scalar uncertainty and cosine gate) indicate the additive-residual formulation is the primary source of these improvements. An evidential variant using Dempster-Shafer fusion introduces interpretable signals of conflict and ignorance. These findings offer a concrete design principle for uncertainty-aware SSL. Code is publicly available at this https URL .

item.title: Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
item.author: Huang, Zhaohong, Zhang, Yuxin, Liu, Wenjing, Chao, Fei, Ji, Rongrong
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于原型的测试时适应方法，旨在解决现有基于缓存的方法在延迟和性能上的问题。

背景: 测试时适应是视觉语言模型连接预训练和测试数据分布差距的有前景的范式。近期工作主要集中在无反向传播的基于缓存的设计上，但这些方法存在两个关键限制：随着类别的增加，推理延迟增加；缓存中样本不足或不正确时性能次优。

目的: 提出原型测试时适应（PTA）范式，利用类特定知识原型从测试样本中积累知识，实现高效且有效的测试时适应。

方法: PTA使用一组类特定知识原型，根据每个测试样本的零样本类置信度自适应加权原型，并将样本的视觉特征整合到对应类特定原型中。知识仅通过原型集成和利用，消除了缓存填充和检索的开销。

主要发现: PTA在15个图像识别基准和4个鲁棒点云分析基准上实现了最先进的性能。例如，PTA在10个跨域基准上将CLIP的准确率从65.64%提高到69.38%，同时在大规模ImageNet-1K上保留了CLIP 92%的推理速度。相比之下，基于缓存的TDA准确率较低（67.97%），且推理速度仅为CLIP的50%。

结论: PTA在保持高效率的同时实现了最先进的性能，证明了其作为高效且有效的测试时适应范式的有效性。

翻译: 测试时适应已成为视觉语言模型连接预训练和测试数据分布差距的有前景的范式。近期工作主要集中在无反向传播的基于缓存的设计上，但这些方法引入了两个关键限制：随着缓存随类别数量增长，推理延迟增加，导致大规模设置中的低效；当缓存包含不足或不正确的样本时，性能次优。在本文中，我们提出了原型测试时适应（PTA），这是一种高效且有效的测试时适应范式，使用一组类特定知识原型从测试样本中积累知识。特别是，知识原型根据每个测试样本的零样本类置信度自适应加权，将样本的视觉特征整合到相应的类特定原型中。值得注意的是，来自过去测试样本的知识仅通过原型集成和利用，消除了阻碍现有测试时适应方法效率的缓存填充和检索开销。这赋予PTA极高的效率，同时在15个图像识别基准和4个鲁棒点云分析基准上实现了最先进的性能。例如，PTA在10个跨域基准上将CLIP的准确率从65.64%提高到69.38%，同时在大规模ImageNet-1K上保留了CLIP 92%的推理速度。相比之下，基于缓存的TDA准确率较低（67.97%），且推理速度仅为CLIP的50%。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决视觉语言模型在测试时适应的问题，特别是如何利用原型来调整模型。这个问题很重要，因为在现实世界中，数据分布经常变化，测试时适应能让模型在推理过程中根据新数据调整，从而提高模型的准确性和鲁棒性。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a promising paradigm for vision-language models (VLMs) to bridge the distribution gap between pre-training and test data. Recent works have focused on backpropagation-free TTA methods that rely on cache-based designs, but these introduce two key limitations. First, inference latency increases as the cache grows with the number of classes, leading to inefficiencies in large-scale settings. Second, suboptimal performance occurs when the cache contains insufficient or incorrect samples. In this paper, we present Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation (PTA), an efficient and effective TTA paradigm that uses a set of class-specific knowledge prototypes to accumulate knowledge from test samples. Particularly, knowledge prototypes are adaptively weighted based on the zero-shot class confidence of each test sample, incorporating the sample's visual features into the corresponding class-specific prototype. It is worth highlighting that the knowledge from past test samples is integrated and utilized solely in the prototypes, eliminating the overhead of cache population and retrieval that hinders the efficiency of existing TTA methods. This endows PTA with extremely high efficiency while achieving state-of-the-art performance on 15 image recognition benchmarks and 4 robust point cloud analysis benchmarks. For example, PTA improves CLIP's accuracy from 65.64% to 69.38% on 10 cross-domain benchmarks, while retaining 92% of CLIP's inference speed on large-scale ImageNet-1K. In contrast, the cache-based TDA achieves a lower accuracy of 67.97% and operates at only 50% of CLIP's inference speed.

item.title: Transferable Physics-Informed Representations via Closed-Form Head Adaptation
item.author: Wong, Jian Cheng, Lai, Isaac Yin Chung, Chiu, Pao-Hsiung, Ooi, Chin Chun, Gupta, Abhishek, Ong, Yew-Soon
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于快速伪逆PINN框架的可迁移学习方法，旨在解决PINNs在缺乏训练样本时难以泛化的问题。

背景: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在求解控制广泛物理现象的偏微分方程方面显示出潜力，但当前方法在缺乏训练示例时难以有效预测或求解新的偏微分方程，表明它们对未见问题实例的泛化能力较差。

目的: 提出一种基于快速伪逆PINN框架的可迁移学习方法，以实现PINNs在未见实例上的快速且准确的物理信息求解。

方法: Pi-PINN在共享嵌入空间中学习可迁移的物理信息表示，并通过在偏微分方程约束下使用最小二乘最优伪逆的闭式头部适应，实现快速求解已知和未知偏微分方程实例。此外，还研究了数据驱动的多任务学习损失与物理信息损失的协同作用。

主要发现: Pi-PINN在各种偏微分方程问题（包括泊松方程、亥姆霍兹方程和伯格斯方程）上表现出有效性，能够在无需任何数据的情况下为未见实例产生快速且准确的物理信息解。Pi-PINN的预测速度比典型PINN快100-1000倍，且即使只有两个训练样本，其相对误差也比典型的数据驱动模型低10-100倍。

结论: 研究结果表明，具有闭式头部适应的可迁移表示能够增强PINNs在偏微分方程族以及科学和工程应用中的效率和泛化能力。

翻译: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）因其解决控制广泛物理现象的偏微分方程的潜力而受到广泛关注。通过将物理定律纳入学习过程，PINN模型已证明能够合理地学习物理结果。然而，当前的PINN方法在缺乏训练示例时难以有效地预测或求解新的偏微分方程，表明它们对未见问题实例的泛化能力较差。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于快速伪逆PINN框架的可迁移学习方法。Pi-PINN在共享嵌入空间中学习可迁移的物理信息表示，并通过在偏微分方程约束下使用最小二乘最优伪逆的闭式头部适应，实现快速求解已知和未知偏微分方程实例。我们进一步研究了数据驱动的多任务学习损失与物理信息损失的协同作用，为设计性能更佳的PINNs提供了见解。我们在包括泊松方程、亥姆霍兹方程和伯格斯方程在内的各种偏微分方程问题上展示了Pi-PINN的有效性，能够在无需任何数据的情况下为未见实例产生快速且准确的物理信息解。Pi-PINN的预测速度比典型PINN快100-1000倍，且即使只有两个训练样本，其相对误差也比典型的数据驱动模型低10-100倍。总的来说，我们的发现突出了具有闭式头部适应的可迁移表示在增强PINNs在偏微分方程族以及科学和工程应用中的效率和泛化方面的潜力。

Abstract

Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have garnered significant interest for their potential in solving partial differential equations (PDEs) that govern a wide range of physical phenomena. By incorporating physical laws into the learning process, PINN models have demonstrated the ability to learn physical outcomes reasonably well. However, current PINN approaches struggle to predict or solve new PDEs effectively when there is a lack of training examples, indicating they do not generalize well to unseen problem instances. In this paper, we present a transferable learning approach for PINNs premised on a fast Pseudoinverse PINN framework (Pi-PINN). Pi-PINN learns a transferable physics-informed representation in a shared embedding space and enables rapid solving of both known and unknown PDE instances via closed-form head adaptation using a least-squares-optimal pseudoinverse under PDE constraints. We further investigate the synergies between data-driven multi-task learning loss and physics-informed loss, providing insights into the design of more performant PINNs. We demonstrate the effectiveness of Pi-PINN on various PDE problems, including Poisson's equation, Helmholtz equation, and Burgers' equation, achieving fast and accurate physics-informed solutions without requiring any data for unseen instances. Pi-PINN can produce predictions 100-1000 times faster than a typical PINN, while producing predictions with 10-100 times lower relative error than a typical data-driven model even with only two training samples. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of transferable representations with closed-form head adaptation to enhance the efficiency and generalization of PINNs across PDE families and scientific and engineering applications.

item.title: SyMTRS: Benchmark Multi-Task Synthetic Dataset for Depth, Domain Adaptation and Super-Resolution in Aerial Imagery
item.author: Safouane El Ghazouali, Nicola Venturi, Michael Rueegsegger, Umberto Michelucci
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SyMTRS是一个大规模合成遥感数据集，旨在解决深度学习在遥感领域对高质量标注数据的依赖问题，特别是针对单目深度估计、域适应和超分辨率等任务。

背景: 现有的遥感深度学习严重依赖大型标注数据集，但获取几何、辐射和多域任务的高质量地面真值既昂贵又往往不可行。缺乏准确的深度标注、受控的光照变化和多尺度配对图像限制了单目深度估计、域适应和航空场景超分辨率的发展。

目的: 提出SyMTRS，一个大规模合成数据集，以填补遥感研究中的关键空白，通过提供完美的几何地面真值和一致的多域监督来实现受控实验。

方法: 使用高保真城市仿真管道生成SyMTRS数据集。该数据集提供高分辨率RGB航空图像（2048 x 2048）、像素级完美的深度图、用于域适应的夜间对应图像，以及用于x2、x4和x8尺度超分辨率的对齐低分辨率变体。

主要发现: SyMTRS作为一个统一的多任务基准，支持几何理解、跨域鲁棒性和分辨率增强的联合研究。

结论: SyMTRS通过提供完美的几何地面真值和一致的多域监督，能够进行受控实验，从而推动遥感领域的研究进展。

翻译: 摘要：深度学习在遥感领域的最新进展严重依赖大型标注数据集，然而获取几何、辐射和多域任务的高质量地面真值既昂贵又往往不可行。特别是缺乏准确的深度标注、受控的光照变化和多尺度配对图像限制了单目深度估计、域适应和航空场景超分辨率的发展。我们提出了SyMTRS，一个使用高保真城市仿真管道生成的大规模合成数据集。该数据集提供高分辨率RGB航空图像（2048 x 2048）、像素级完美的深度图、用于域适应的夜间对应图像，以及用于x2、x4和x8尺度超分辨率的对齐低分辨率变体。与专注于单一任务或模态的现有遥感数据集不同，SyMTRS被设计为一个统一的 multi-task benchmark，支持几何理解、跨域鲁棒性和分辨率增强的联合研究。我们描述了数据集生成过程、其统计属性以及其相对于现有基准的定位。SyMTRS旨在通过实现具有完美几何地面真值和一致多域监督的受控实验，来填补遥感研究中的关键空白。本工作获得的结果可以从此Github仓库中复现：https://github.com/safouaneelg/SyMTRS。

深度解读

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文构建了一个名为 SyMTRS 的基准数据集，用于在航空影像中同时解决深度估计、域适应和超分辨率问题。

Abstract

Recent advances in deep learning for remote sensing rely heavily on large annotated datasets, yet acquiring high-quality ground truth for geometric, radiometric, and multi-domain tasks remains costly and often infeasible. In particular, the lack of accurate depth annotations, controlled illumination variations, and multi-scale paired imagery limits progress in monocular depth estimation, domain adaptation, and super-resolution for aerial scenes. We present SyMTRS, a large-scale synthetic dataset generated using a high-fidelity urban simulation pipeline. The dataset provides high-resolution RGB aerial imagery (2048 x 2048), pixel-perfect depth maps, night-time counterparts for domain adaptation, and aligned low-resolution variants for super-resolution at x2, x4, and x8 scales. Unlike existing remote sensing datasets that focus on a single task or modality, SyMTRS is designed as a unified multi-task benchmark enabling joint research in geometric understanding, cross-domain robustness, and resolution enhancement. We describe the dataset generation process, its statistical properties, and its positioning relative to existing benchmarks. SyMTRS aims to bridge critical gaps in remote sensing research by enabling controlled experiments with perfect geometric ground truth and consistent multi-domain supervision. The results obtained in this work can be reproduced from this Github repository: https://github.com/safouaneelg/SyMTRS.

item.title: SpaMEM: Benchmarking Dynamic Spatial Reasoning via Perception-Memory Integration in Embodied Environments
item.author: Liao, Chih-Ting, Xiao, Xi, Meng, Chunlei, Chen, Zhangquan, Qiao, Yitong, Zhou, Weilin, Wang, Tianyang, Zheng, Xu, Cao, Xin
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SpaMEM是一个大规模诊断基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在长期空间一致性方面的能力，通过动作条件化的场景变换来隔离空间信念演化的机制。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在静态视觉-空间推理方面有所进步，但在具身环境中，由于环境变化和自我中心观察的持续修正，往往难以保持长期的空间一致性。

目的: 引入SpaMEM基准，通过动作条件化的场景变换（生成、放置、移除）来隔离空间信念演化的机制，并评估模型在长期交互中的表现。

方法: 构建了一个基于物理数据的基准，包含超过一千万张跨四种模态的高保真图像，来自一千个程序生成的房屋中的两万五千多个交互序列。将具身空间推理形式化为三个层次，包含十五个诊断任务，并评估短期更新和长期重建。

主要发现: 代表性开源VLM家族表现出一致的瓶颈：坐标一致的定位是一个硬性上限；从第二层到第三层的急剧崩溃暴露了强烈的符号依赖性，即模型在基于文本的记录方面成功，但在维持稳健的视觉记忆方面困难。

结论: SpaMEM提供了细粒度的诊断标准，并激励了显式的状态表示、信念修正和长期情节整合机制。

翻译: 多模态大语言模型在静态视觉-空间推理方面取得了进展，但在具身环境中，由于环境变化和自我中心观察的持续修正，往往难以保持长期的空间一致性。我们介绍了SpaMEM，这是一个大规模诊断基准，通过动作条件化的场景变换（生成、放置、移除）在长期交互范围内隔离空间信念演化的机制。SpaMEM建立在物理数据集之上，包含超过一千万张跨四种模态的高保真图像，来自一千个程序生成的房屋中的两万五千多个交互序列。我们将具身空间推理形式化为三个层次，包含十五个诊断任务：第一层从单次观测测量原子空间感知；第二层通过文本状态历史来探测时间推理，以排除感知噪声；第三层要求在相同任务维度下从原始视觉流进行端到端的信念维持。我们进一步评估了短期（逐步）更新和长期（情节）重建。对代表性开源VLM家族的基准测试显示了一致的堆叠瓶颈：坐标一致的定位仍然是一个硬性上限，从第二层到第三层的急剧崩溃暴露了强烈的符号依赖性，即模型在基于文本的记录方面成功，但在维持稳健的视觉记忆方面困难。SpaMEM提供了细粒度的诊断标准，并激励了显式的状态表示、信念修正和长期情节整合机制。

Abstract

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced static visual--spatial reasoning, yet they often fail to preserve long-horizon spatial coherence in embodied settings where beliefs must be continuously revised from egocentric observations under environmental change. We introduce SpaMEM (Spatial Memory from Action Sequences), a large-scale diagnostic benchmark that isolates the mechanics of spatial belief evolution via action-conditioned scene transformations (spawn, place, remove) over long interaction horizons. SpaMEM is built on a physically grounded dataset with 10,601,392 high-fidelity images across four modalities (RGB, depth, instance, semantic segmentation), collected from 25,000+ interaction sequences in 1,000 procedurally generated houses. We formalize embodied spatial reasoning as a three-level hierarchy with 15 diagnostic tasks: Level 1 measures atomic spatial perception from single observations; Level 2 probes temporal reasoning with oracle textual state histories to factor out perceptual noise; and Level 3 requires end-to-end belief maintenance from raw visual streams under the same task dimensions. We further evaluate both short-term (step-wise) updates and long-term (episodic) reconstruction. Benchmarking representative open-source VLM families reveals a consistent stacked bottleneck: coordinate-consistent grounding remains a hard ceiling, and the sharp collapse from Level 2 to Level 3 exposes a pronounced symbolic scaffolding dependency, where models succeed with text-based bookkeeping but struggle to sustain robust visual memory. SpaMEM provides a granular diagnostic standard and motivates explicit mechanisms for state representation, belief revision, and long-horizon episodic integration.

item.title: Large-Scale Photogrammetric Documentation of St. John's Co-Cathedral: A Workflow for Cultural Heritage Preservation
item.author: Kenely, Matthew, Bugeja, Mark, Grima, Andre, Pullicino, Peter, Pullicino, Matthew, Seychell, Dylan
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于圣约翰大教堂大规模摄影测量文档化的综合方法论，通过多模态数据采集和AI辅助处理，实现了包含250-300亿三角形的详细3D重建，并探讨了高斯溅射作为补充表示技术的初步实验。

背景: 圣约翰大教堂位于马耳他瓦莱塔，是一座联合国教科文组织世界遗产地，以其华丽的巴洛克建筑和卡拉瓦乔大师作品而闻名。

目的: 为文化保护提供完整的文档化工作流程，解决数字化复杂巴洛克建筑空间、高反射金属表面、深色材料、复杂挂毯以及受限访问等独特挑战，实现灾难恢复文档、保护分析、虚拟旅游和学术研究等多种保存目的。

方法: 通过为期七晚的仅晚间数据采集，使用单反相机、无人机摄影和LIDAR扫描捕获99,000张图像；采用多模态数据获取、图像分级和AI辅助降噪、LIDAR点云清理、RealityCapture混合摄影测量重建以及网格细分等策略；结合自动化工作流与必要的人工干预，并进行了高斯溅射作为补充表示技术的初步实验。

主要发现: 该方法论成功应对了巴洛克遗产地特有的反射表面挑战，结合自动化与人工干预处理了项目的规模和复杂性，证明了高斯溅射作为补充表示技术的可行性。

结论: 该工作流程为遗产专业人士在类似大型建筑文档化项目中提供了详细且可复制的指南，解决了在复杂现实世界遗产场景中应用摄影测量方法的实际挑战。

翻译: 本文提出了一种用于马耳他瓦莱塔圣约翰大教堂大规模摄影测量文档化的综合方法论，该教堂是一座联合国教科文组织世界遗产地，以其华丽的巴洛克建筑和卡拉瓦乔大师作品而闻名。在为期七晚的仅晚间数据采集期间，我们使用单反相机、无人机摄影和LIDAR扫描捕获了99,000张图像，以创建包含250-300亿三角形的详细3D重建。本文记录了我们为文化保护提供的完整工作流程，解决了数字化具有高度反射金属表面、深色材料、复杂挂毯和受限访问的复杂巴洛克建筑空间的独特挑战。我们详细介绍了从多模态数据获取到处理的管道，包括战略性图像分级和AI辅助降噪以解决低光噪点、广泛的LIDAR点云清理、使用RealityCapture的混合摄影测量重建以及用于实时可视化引擎的网格细分策略。我们的方法论结合了自动化工作流与必要的人工干预，以处理项目的规模和复杂性，特别关注巴洛克遗产地特有的反射表面挑战。我们还提出了高斯溅射作为补充表示技术的初步实验。由此产生的数字档案服务于多种保存目的，包括灾难恢复文档、保护分析、虚拟旅游和学术研究。这项工作为遗产专业人士在类似大型建筑文档化项目中提供了详细、可复制的工作流程，解决了在复杂现实世界遗产场景中应用摄影测量方法所面临的实际挑战。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种用于圣约翰大教堂大规模摄影测量文档的工作流，以实现文化遗产的三维重建与数字化保护。

Abstract

We present a comprehensive methodology for the large-scale photogrammetric documentation of St. John's Co-Cathedral in Valletta, Malta, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its ornate Baroque architecture and Caravaggio masterpieces. Over seven nights of evening-only data collection, we captured 99,000 images using DSLR cameras, drone photography, and LIDAR scanning to create a highly detailed 3D reconstruction comprising 25-30 billion triangles. This paper documents our complete workflow for cultural heritage preservation, addressing the unique challenges of digitizing complex baroque architectural spaces with highly reflective metallic surfaces, dark materials, intricate tapestries, and restricted access. We detail our pipeline from multi-modal data acquisition through processing, including strategic image grading and AI-assisted denoising to address low-light grain, extensive LIDAR point cloud cleanup, hybrid photogrammetric reconstruction using RealityCapture, and mesh subdivision strategies for real-time visualization engines. Our methodology combines automated workflows with necessary manual intervention to handle the scale and complexity of the project, with particular attention to reflective surface challenges characteristic of baroque heritage sites. We also present preliminary experiments with Gaussian splatting as a complementary representation technique. The resulting digital archive serves multiple preservation purposes including disaster recovery documentation, conservation analysis, virtual tourism, and scholarly research. This work provides a detailed, replicable workflow for heritage professionals undertaking similar large-scale architectural documentation projects, addressing the practical challenges of applying photogrammetric methods in complex real-world heritage scenarios.

item.title: FlowS: One-Step Motion Prediction via Local Transport Conditioning
item.author: Leandro Di Bella, Adrian Munteanu, Bruno Cornelis
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FlowS的条件流匹配框架，通过局部传输条件化策略，实现了单步生成运动预测，在保持高准确性和多样性的同时，满足了实时性要求。

背景: 生成式运动预测需要同时满足高准确性、多样化的多模态未来以及严格的低延迟。扩散模型满足前两个要求但违反了第三个要求，需要数十到数百步去噪。

目的: 解决扩散模型在生成运动预测时需要大量去噪步骤导致的延迟问题，实现单步推理。

方法: 提出了FlowS框架，包含两个机制：1. 在线、场景条件化的学习先验，发射K个校准的锚定轨迹，将模式发现转化为局部修正；2. 步骤一致的位移场，强制半群自洽性，确保单步继承多步准确性。

主要发现: 当基础分布位于合理未来附近时，单步积分是准确的。锚定该场在直线路径上的学习先验产生了一个稳定、低方差的训练目标，避免了先前自洽方法在高方差引导信号上的问题。

结论: 在Waymo开放运动数据集上，FlowS在单步推理下达到了最先进的Soft mAP和mAP，证明了局部传输条件化使一步生成运动预测对关键自主性具有实用性。

翻译: 生成式运动预测必须同时满足现实世界自主性的三个要求：高准确性、多样化的多模态未来和严格的低延迟。扩散模型满足前两个但违反了第三个，需要数十到数百步去噪。我们识别了一种解决这种张力的条件化策略：当底层传输问题是局部时，单步积分是准确的。一个必须在一步中发现正确行为模式并跨越长位移的模型会积累大的离散化误差；将基础分布条件化以位于合理未来附近，将问题简化为短距离精炼，在此范围内单步欧拉步就足够了。我们在FlowS中实例化了这种局部传输条件化，这是一个具有两个机制的条件流匹配框架。首先，一个在线的、场景条件化的学习先验为每个智能体发射K个校准的锚定轨迹，每个轨迹已经接近合理的未来，将模式发现转化为局部修正。其次，一个步骤一致的位移场强制半群自洽性，保证单步继承多步准确性。关键在于，锚定该场在直线路径上的学习先验产生了一个稳定、低方差的训练目标，不同于先前自洽方法在曲线路径上遭受高方差引导信号的问题。在Waymo开放运动数据集上，FlowS在75 FPS的集成下实现了最先进的Soft mAP和mAP，证明了局部传输条件化使一步生成运动预测对关键自主性具有实用性。代码和预训练模型将在接受后发布。

Abstract

Generative motion prediction must satisfy three simultaneous requirements for real-world autonomy: high accuracy, diverse multimodal futures, and strictly bounded latency. Diffusion models meet the first two but violate the third, requiring tens to hundreds of denoising steps. We identify a conditioning strategy that resolves this tension: \textit{single-step integration is accurate when the underlying transport problem is local}. A model that must both discover the correct behavioral mode and traverse a long displacement in one step accumulates large discretization errors; conditioning the base distribution to lie near plausible futures reduces the problem to short-range refinement, the regime where a single Euler step suffices. We instantiate this \emph{local transport conditioning} in FlowS, a conditional flow matching framework with two mechanisms. First, an online, scene-conditioned learned prior emits $K$ calibrated anchor trajectories per agent, each already near a plausible future, converting mode discovery into local correction. Second, a step-consistent displacement field enforces semigroup self-consistency, guaranteeing that a single step inherits multi-step accuracy. Crucially, anchoring this field at learned priors along straight-line paths yields a {stable, low-variance} training target, unlike prior self-consistency methods that suffer from {high-variance bootstrap} signals on curved diffusion paths. On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, FlowS achieves state-of-the-art Soft mAP {(0.4804) and mAP (0.4703) with ensemble at 75\,FPS} with single-step inference, demonstrating that local transport conditioning makes one-step generative motion prediction practical for safety-critical autonomy. Code and pretrained models will be released upon acceptance.

item.title: Virtual-reality based patient-specific simulation of spine surgical procedures: A fast, highly automated and high-fidelity system for surgical education and planning
item.author: Raj Kumar Ranabhat, Tayler D Ross, Tony Jiao, Jeremie Larouche, Joel Finkelstein, Michael Hardisty
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究利用人工智能和计算机视觉技术，基于患者的CT和MRI图像生成患者特定的脊柱减压手术虚拟现实模拟，旨在提供一种安全且高效的术前训练和规划工具。

背景: 外科手术训练通常涉及多种方式，但日益增加的临床压力限制了手术室（OR）的直接接触机会。现有的VR训练往往基于标准化场景，而非针对个别临床病例。

目的: 研究旨在利用AI和计算机视觉方法，从CT和MRI中生成患者特定的模拟，具体包括脊柱狭窄症的患者特定脊柱减压模拟；目标是自动创建3D解剖模型并进行包括椎板切除术、椎间盘切除术和椎间孔切开术在内的VR模拟。

方法: 研究采用了多模态融合（配准）CT和MRI以及相关结构的分割技术。通过Dice相似系数（DSC）评估分割准确性，通过目标配准误差（TRE）评估配准准确性，并从外科医生和学员处获得定性反馈。

主要发现: 研究成功高效地生成了高保真度的患者特定3D模型（每例约2.5分钟）。分割准确性高，骨骼DSC为0.95，软组织结构DSC为0.895；配准准确性平均TRE为1.73毫米。半结构化访谈表明，参与者对空间理解、程序信心和教育价值的感知有所提高。

结论: 该平台显著减少了患者特定建模的时间和成本，从而促进了术前规划、术后评估和全面的手术模拟。

翻译: 该研究利用人工智能和计算机视觉技术，基于患者的CT和MRI图像生成患者特定的脊柱减压手术虚拟现实模拟，旨在提供一种安全且高效的术前训练和规划工具。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 提出了一种基于虚拟现实的高速、高度自动化和高保真的脊柱手术患者特定模拟系统，用于手术教育和规划。

Abstract

Surgical training involves didactic teaching, mentor-led learning, surgical skills laboratories, and direct exposure to surgery; however, increasing clinical pressures have limited operating room (OR) exposure. This work leverages virtual reality (VR) to provide a safe and immersive training environment. Existing VR training is often based on standardized scenarios not tailored to individual clinical cases. This study addresses this limitation using artificial intelligence (AI) based computer vision methods to generate patient-specific simulations from computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). This study focuses on patient-specific spinal decompression simulation for spinal stenosis in a virtual operating room. The objectives were (1) automatic creation of 3D anatomical models and (2) VR simulation of spinal decompression procedures including laminectomy, disc resection, and foraminotomy. Model construction required multimodal fusion (registration) of CT and MRI and segmentation of relevant structures. Segmentation was evaluated using the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC), and registration accuracy using Target Registration Error (TRE). Qualitative feedback was obtained from surgeons and trainees. High-fidelity patient-specific 3D models were generated efficiently (approximately 2.5 minutes per case, N = 15). Segmentation accuracy was high, with a DSC of 0.95 (+/- 0.03) for vertebral bone and 0.895 (+/- 0.02) for soft tissue structures. Registration accuracy showed a mean TRE of 1.73 (+/- 0.42) mm. Semi-structured interviews indicated improved spatial understanding, increased procedural confidence, and strong perceived educational value. This platform significantly reduced the time and costs of patient-specific modelling, thereby facilitating pre-operative planning, post-procedural assessments, and comprehensive surgical simulation.

item.title: MAEPose: Self-Supervised Spatiotemporal Learning for Human Pose Estimation on mmWave Video
item.author: Xijia Wei, Yuan Fang, Kevin Chetty, Youngjun Cho, Nadia Bianchi-Berthouze
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于掩码自编码的毫米波雷达人体姿态估计方法MAEPose，直接在毫米波频谱图视频上进行操作，通过无监督学习时空运动感知的通用表示，并利用热力图解码器进行多帧姿态估计预测。

背景: 现有的毫米波雷达人体姿态估计方法通常依赖于稀疏点云或频谱图图像等预提取的中间表示，这丢弃了雷达视频流中自然存在的丰富时空信息，且信号处理增加了系统复杂性。此外，现有解决方案主要采用端到端监督方式，未利用未标记的原始视频流来学习通用表示。

目的: 为了解决现有方法中信息丢失和系统复杂性的问题，以及缺乏利用无标签原始视频流学习通用表示的问题，提出一种直接在毫米波频谱图视频上操作的方法。

方法: 提出MAEPose，一种基于掩码自编码的人体姿态估计方法，直接在毫米波频谱图视频上操作。该方法从无标签雷达视频中学习时空运动感知的通用表示，并利用其热力图解码器进行多帧姿态估计预测。

主要发现: 在三个数据集上进行的留一法交叉验证和严格的统计测试中，MAEPose在MPJPE上比最先进的基线方法一致地高出最多22.1%（p<0.05）。在零样本旁观者干扰下，仅增加6.5%的误差即可保持鲁棒精度。消融研究证实了预训练和热力图解码器都做出了重大贡献。模态分析表明，利用Range-Doppler视频作为输入比Range-Azimuth或它们的融合能更好地实现姿态估计性能，且计算成本更低。

结论: MAEPose通过直接处理毫米波频谱图视频和无监督学习，有效解决了现有方法中信息丢失和系统复杂性的问题，并在姿态估计性能上显著优于现有基线方法，同时保持了在干扰下的鲁棒性。

翻译: 摘要：毫米波雷达提供了比基于RGB的人体姿态估计更具隐私保护性的替代方案。然而，现有方法通常依赖于稀疏点云或频谱图图像等预提取的中间表示，其中雷达视频流中自然存在的丰富时空信息被丢弃用于模型学习，而此类信号处理增加了系统复杂性。此外，现有解决方案主要采用端到端监督方式，未利用未标记的原始视频流来学习通用表示。在本研究中，我们提出了MAEPose，一种基于掩码自编码的人体姿态估计方法，直接在毫米波频谱图视频上操作。MAEPose从无标签雷达视频中学习时空运动感知的通用表示，并利用其热力图解码器进行多帧姿态估计预测。我们在三个数据集上进行了基于留一法交叉验证的严格统计测试。MAEPose在MPJPE上比最先进的基线方法一致地高出最多22.1%（p<0.05），并在零样本旁观者干扰下仅增加6.5%的误差即可保持鲁棒精度。消融研究证实了预训练和热力图解码器都做出了重大贡献，而模态分析表明，利用Range-Doppler视频作为输入比Range-Azimuth或它们的融合能更好地实现姿态估计性能，且计算成本更低。

Abstract

Millimetre-wave (mmWave) radar offers a more privacy-preserving alternative to RGB-based human pose estimation. However, existing methods typically rely on pre-extracted intermediate representations such as sparse point clouds or spectrogram images, where the rich spatiotemporal information naturally present in radar video streams is discarded for model learning, while such signal processing adds system complexity. In addition, existing solutions are mainly conducted in an end-to-end supervised manner without leveraging unlabelled raw video streams to learn generalized representations. In this study, we present MAEPose, a masked autoencoding-based human pose estimation approach that operates directly on mmWave spectrogram videos. MAEPose learns spatiotemporal motion-aware generalized representations from unlabelled radar video, and leverages its heatmap decoder for multi-frame pose estimation predictions. We evaluate it across three datasets based on leave-one-person-out cross-validation with rigorous statistical testing. MAEPose consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 22.1% in MPJPE p<0.05, and maintains robust accuracy under zero-shot bystander interference with only a 6.5% error increase. Ablation studies confirm that both the pre-training and the heatmap decoder contribute substantially, while modality analysis indicates that leveraging Range-Doppler video as input achieves better pose estimation performance than Range-Azimuth or their fusion, with lower computational cost.

item.title: CGM-JEPA: Learning Consistent Continuous Glucose Monitor Representations via Predictive Self-Supervised Pretraining
item.author: Muhammad, Hada Melino, Li, Zechen, Salim, Flora, Metwally, Ahmed A.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CGM-JEPA是一种自监督预训练框架，通过预测掩码潜在表示而非原始值来捕获更高层次的时间结构和分布结构，从而解决CGM部署中的模态转移问题。

背景: 连续血糖监测（CGM）可以检测早期代谢亚型，但大规模部署面临两个耦合问题：同一生理状态通过多个视图（CGM时间序列、静脉口服葡萄糖耐量试验、葡萄糖密度摘要）出现，导致单一视图表示在模态或设置转移时无法迁移；基线在这些转移中表现不一致。

目的: 提出CGM-JEPA自监督预训练框架，通过预测掩码潜在表示而非原始值来获得抽象表示，从而实现跨模态的迁移；X-CGM-JEPA添加了掩码葡萄糖密度跨视图目标以补充分布信息。

方法: 在228名受试者的约38.9万条未标记CGM读数上预训练，在三个场景（队列泛化、静脉到CGM转移、家庭CGM）下评估，使用20次迭代乘以2折交叉验证；X-CGM-JEPA在所有三个场景中均排名第一或第二。

主要发现: X-CGM-JEPA在所有三个场景中均排名第一或第二，在队列泛化中比最强基线高出最多6.5个百分点，在静脉到CGM转移中高出最多3.6个百分点；在模态转移中匹配平均AUROC但重新分配向较弱的亚组；在稀疏领域内静脉数据上，分布视图提升了标签感知聚类。

结论: CGM-JEPA和X-CGM-JEPA在跨模态和跨场景的血糖监测任务中显著优于基线方法，能够有效解决单一视图表示的迁移问题。

翻译: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) can detect early metabolic subphenotypes (insulin resistance, IR; β-cell dysfunction), but population-scale deployment faces two coupled problems. First, the same physiological state appears through multiple views (CGM time series, venous OGTT, Glucodensity summaries), so single-view representations fail to transfer when deployment shifts the modality or setting. Second, baselines perform inconsistently across these shifts. Abstract

Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) can detect early metabolic subphenotypes (insulin resistance, IR; $\beta$-cell dysfunction), but population-scale deployment faces two coupled problems. First, the same physiological state appears through multiple views (CGM time series, venous OGTT, Glucodensity summaries), so single-view representations fail to transfer when deployment shifts the modality or setting. Second, baselines perform inconsistently across these shifts. Both problems point to one remedy: representations that abstract away from any single view to capture higher-level temporal and distributional structure. X-CGM-JEPA adds a masked Glucodensity cross-view objective for complementary distributional information. We pretrain on $\sim$389k unlabeled CGM readings from 228 subjects and evaluate on two clinical cohorts ($N=27$ and $N=17$ public-release subsets) across three regimes (cohort generalization, venous-to-CGM transfer, home CGM) under 20-iteration $\times$ 2-fold cross-validation. X-CGM-JEPA ranks first or second on AUROC for both endpoints across all three regimes while no baseline does, exceeding the strongest baseline by up to $+6.5$ pp in cohort generalization and $+3.6$ pp in venous-to-CGM transfer (paired Wilcoxon, $p<0.001$). Under modality shift, it matches mean AUROC while redistributing toward weaker subgroups (ethnicity AUROC gap shrinks 25-54%); on sparse in-domain venous data, the distributional view lifts label-aware clustering (ARI $+39\%$, NMI $+40\%$). item.title: TRIMMER: A New Paradigm for Video Summarization through Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Mishra, Pritam, Ballester, Coloma, Karatzas, Dimosthenis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为TRIMMER的自监督强化学习视频摘要框架，通过两阶段方法实现高效的视频摘要生成。

背景: 随着视频内容在监控、教育和社交媒体等领域的快速增长，对高效内容理解的需求日益增加。现有的视频摘要方法往往依赖昂贵的标注、难以跨域泛化，且计算成本高昂。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在跨域泛化、计算成本以及捕捉长程时间依赖和语义结构方面的不足，提出TRIMMER框架。

方法: TRIMMER是一个两阶段的自监督强化学习框架。第一阶段通过自监督学习学习鲁棒表示；第二阶段通过强化学习进行时空决策，使用基于信息论的奖励函数进行引导。该方法引入了基于熵的指标来捕捉高阶时间动态和语义多样性，并直接在选定的帧索引上计算奖励以提高计算效率。

主要发现: 在标准基准测试中，TRIMMER在无监督和自监督方法中达到了最先进的性能，同时与领先的监督方法保持竞争力。

结论: TRIMMER在可扩展性和泛化性方面表现出色，证明了其对于高效视频摘要的有效性。

翻译: 随着监控、教育和社交媒体等领域的视频内容快速增长，高效的内容理解变得越来越关键。视频摘要通过生成简洁但语义丰富的表示来解决这一挑战，但现有方法往往依赖昂贵的标注，难以跨域泛化，且由于复杂的架构导致计算成本高昂。此外，与监督方法相比，无监督和弱监督方法通常在捕捉长程时间依赖和语义结构方面表现不佳。在这项工作中，我们提出了TRIMMER（Temporal Relative Information Maximization for Multi-objective Efficient Reinforcement），这是一个用于视频摘要的新型自监督强化学习框架。TRIMMER分两个阶段运行：它首先通过自监督学习学习鲁棒的表示，然后通过强化学习进行时空决策，由信息论奖励函数引导。与依赖相似性目标的先前方法不同，我们的方法引入了基于熵的指标来捕捉高阶时间动态和语义多样性，同时直接在选定的帧索引上计算奖励以提高计算效率。在标准基准上的广泛实验表明，TRIMMER在无监督和自监督方法中达到了最先进的性能，同时与领先的监督方法保持竞争力，突出了其在可扩展和可泛化的视频摘要方面的有效性。

Abstract

The rapid growth of video content across domains such as surveillance, education, and social media has made efficient content understanding increasingly critical. Video summarization addresses this challenge by generating concise yet semantically meaningful representations, but existing approaches often rely on expensive manual annotations, struggle to generalize across domains, and incur significant computational costs due to complex architectures. Moreover, unsupervised and weakly supervised methods typically underperform compared to supervised counterparts in capturing long-range temporal dependencies and semantic structure. In this work, we propose TRIMMER (Temporal Relative Information Maximization for Multi-objective Efficient Reinforcement), a novel self-supervised reinforcement learning framework for video summarization. TRIMMER operates in two stages: it first learns robust representations via self-supervised learning and then performs spatio-temporal decision making through reinforcement learning guided by information-theoretic reward functions. Unlike prior approaches that rely on similarity-based objectives, our method introduces entropy-based metrics to capture higher-order temporal dynamics and semantic diversity, while computing rewards directly over selected frame indices to improve computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that TRIMMER achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised and self-supervised methods, while remaining competitive with leading supervised approaches, highlighting its effectiveness for scalable and generalizable video summarization.

item.title: Super-Resolution of Airborne Laser Scanning Point Clouds for Forest Inventory
item.author: Jinyuan Shao, Sangyoong Park, Chunxi Zhao, Ayman Habib, Songlin Fei
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于体素CNN的3D森林超分辨率模型3DFSR，用于改善激光雷达点云的密度和噪声问题，从而提高森林调查的准确性。

背景: 机载激光扫描ALS能够收集大面积的点云，但点云稀疏且存在噪声，导致个体树木级别的森林调查不准确，如树干定位和树木尺寸估计。

目的: 为了克服ALS点云稀疏和噪声的问题，提出一种深度学习模型3D Forest Super Resolution (3DFSR)，以同时提高点云密度并减少噪声。

方法: 3DFSR是一种基于体素的CNN，采用U-Net架构。该方法在温带森林（美国）和北方森林（德国）采集的ALS点云上进行了评估。

主要发现: 3DFSR生成的树木结构点云比其他最先进的点云超分辨率算法更精细，实现了0.249 m Chamfer Distance和2.711 m Hausdorff Distance。树干检测F1分数从原始ALS点云的0.71提升至3DFSR点云的0.97；胸径估计RMSE从13.45 cm降至6.43 cm；树干重建与MLS点云相比具有0.170 m Chamfer Distance和0.377 m Hausdorff Distance，以及0.95 R2体积估计。该方法适用于处理10至1700点/m²的点密度，且无需迁移学习即可在不同激光雷达平台采集的数据上泛化。

结论: 3DFSR生成的点云能够直接用于树干检测、胸径测量和树干重建，证明了其在森林调查中的有效性。

翻译: Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS) can collect point clouds across large areas, enabling large-scale forest inventory. However, ALS point clouds are sparse and noisy, resulting in inaccurate individual-tree-level forest inventory, such as stem localization and tree size estimation. To overcome this problem, we propose a deep learning model, 3D Forest Super Resolution (3DFSR), to simultaneously improve point density and reduce noise for ALS forest point cloud. 3DFSR is a voxel-based CNN with a U-Net architecture. The proposed 3DFSR is evaluated on ALS point clouds collected in both temperate forests in the U.S. and boreal forests in Germany. Experimental results demonstrate that 3DFSR can generate finer point clouds of tree structure than other state-of-the-art point cloud super-resolution algorithms, achieving 0.249 m Chamfer Distance and 2.711 m Hausdorff Distance. Furthermore, to verify the effectiveness of 3DFSR point clouds in forest inventory, we conduct stem detection, DBH measurements, and stem reconstruction on both original ALS point clouds and 3DFSR enhanced point clouds. We find that stem detection and reconstruction algorithms developed for TLS/MLS point clouds can directly work on our 3DFSR point clouds, and DBH can be derived with circle-fitting method. F1 score of stem detection is improved from 0.71 on original ALS point clouds to 0.97 on 3DFSR point clouds; DBH estimation improves from 13.45 cm RMSE using allometric equations to 6.43 cm using circle fitting; comparing to stems reconstruction from MLS point clouds, stem reconstructed from 3DFSR point clouds has 0.170 m of Chamfer Distance and 0.377 m of Hausdorff Distance, and 0.95 R2 volume estimation. Finally, we find that the proposed 3DFSR is applicable to process point densities from 10 to 1700 points/m2; it also can be generalized across data collected from different LiDAR platforms without transfer learning.

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文致力于利用超分辨率技术提升机载激光扫描点云的细节，以更精准地支持森林调查工作。

Abstract

Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS) can collect point clouds across large areas, enabling large-scale forest inventory. However, ALS point clouds are sparse and noisy, resulting in inaccurate individual-tree-level forest inventory, such as stem localization and tree size estimation. To overcome this problem, we propose a deep learning model, 3D Forest Super Resolution (3DFSR), to simultaneously improve point density and reduce noise for ALS forest point cloud. 3DFSR is a voxel-based CNN with a U-Net architecture. The proposed 3DFSR is evaluated on ALS point clouds collected in both temperate forests in the U.S. and boreal forests in Germany. Experimental results demonstrate that 3DFSR can generate finer point clouds of tree structure than other state-of-the-art point cloud super-resolution algorithms, achieving 0.249 m Chamfer Distance and 2.711 m Hausdorff Distance. Furthermore, to verify the effectiveness of 3DFSR point clouds in forest inventory, we conduct stem detection, DBH measurements, and stem reconstruction on both original ALS point clouds and 3DFSR enhanced point clouds. We find that stem detection and reconstruction algorithms developed for TLS/MLS point clouds can directly work on our 3DFSR point clouds, and DBH can be derived with circle-fitting method. F1 score of stem detection is improved from 0.71 on original ALS point clouds to 0.97 on 3DFSR point clouds; DBH estimation improves from 13.45 cm RMSE using allometric equations to 6.43 cm using circle fitting; comparing to stems reconstruction from MLS point clouds, stem reconstructed from 3DFSR point clouds has 0.170 m of Chamfer Distance and 0.377 m of Hausdorff Distance, and 0.95 R2 volume estimation. Finally, we find that the proposed 3DFSR is applicable to process point densities from 10 to 1700 points/m2; it also can be generalized across data collected from different LiDAR platforms without transfer learning.

背景: k-NN 搜索是几何处理和计算机图形学中的基本操作。虽然空间划分结构（如 kd-trees）是标准方法，但它们往往忽略流形数据的内在低维结构。动态规划方法（DP-NNS）利用增量构建的 Voronoi 图加速查询，但仅限于单最近邻搜索。

目的: 将 DP-NNS 框架推广以支持流形对齐数据的任意 k-NN 查询。

方法: 基于几何观察，即如果 p_i 是查询 q 的最近邻，则第二近邻位于前缀集合 P_{1:i-1} 或 p_i 的后继列表中。通过递归扩展这一原则，提出了 Manifold k-NN 算法。该方法还支持动态前缀查询（在任意子集 P_{1:m} 中搜索）以及通过局部 Delaunay 更新支持点删除。

主要发现: 该方法在体积到表面的查询场景中实现了 1 到 10 倍的速度提升。它天然支持动态前缀查询，且在多种几何数据集上表现出高效性和广泛适用性。

结论: Manifold k-NN 算法在流形对齐数据上显著优于传统 kd-trees，为现代图形管线提供了高效的解决方案。

翻译: k-近邻搜索是几何处理和计算机图形学中的基本原语。虽然空间划分结构如 kd 树是标准的，但它们往往对流形视而不见，无法利用从 2 流形采样的点的内在低维结构。基于动态规划的最近邻搜索（DP-NNS）的近期进展利用增量构建的 Voronoi 图来加速查询，其中每个站点 p 维护一个后继列表，逐步细化其 Voronoi 单元。然而，DP-NNS 仅限于单最近邻（k=1）搜索，排除了其在需要局部邻域统计的应用中的采用。在本文中，我们将 DP-NNS 框架推广以支持流形对齐数据的任意 k-NN 查询。我们的方法建立在几何观察之上，即如果 p_i 是查询 q 在 P 中的最近邻，则 q 的第二近邻必须位于前缀集合 P_{1:i-1} = {p_1, ..., p_{i-1}} 或 p_i 的后继列表中。通过递归扩展这一原则，我们引入了 Manifold k-NN，一种递归算法方案，对于流形对齐数据，它显著优于传统的 kd 树。我们的方法在体积到表面的查询场景中实现了 1 到 10 倍的速度提升，并且天然支持动态前缀查询——能够在任何子集 P_{1:m}（m ≤ n）中实现 k-NN 搜索且无开销。此外，我们通过局部 Delaunay 更新扩展了框架以支持点删除，为点集修改提供了完整的动态操作套件。在多样化几何数据集上的综合实验证明了该方法在效率及其对现代图形管线的广泛适用性。源代码可在此处获取。

Abstract

k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) search is a fundamental primitive in geometry processing and computer graphics. While spatial partitioning structures such as kd-trees are standard, they are often manifold-blind, failing to exploit the intrinsic low-dimensional structure of points sampled from 2-manifolds. Recent advances in dynamic programming-based nearest neighbor search (DP-NNS) leverage incrementally constructed Voronoi diagrams to accelerate queries, where each site p maintains a list of successors that progressively refine its Voronoi cell. However, DP-NNS is restricted to single nearest neighbor (k=1) searches, precluding their adoption in applications that require local neighborhood statistics. In this paper, we generalize the DP-NNS framework to support arbitrary k-NN queries for manifold-aligned data. Our approach is founded on the geometric observation that if p_i is the nearest neighbor of a query q in P, then the second nearest neighbor of q must reside either within the prefix set P_{1:i-1} = {p_1, \dots, p_{i-1}} or within p_i's successor list. By recursively extending this principle, we introduce Manifold k-NN, a recursive algorithmic scheme that significantly outperforms conventional kd-trees for manifold-aligned data. Our method achieves a 1\times--10\times speedup in volume-to-surface query scenarios and inherently supports dynamic prefix queries -- enabling k-NN searches within any subset P_{1:m} (m \leq n) with zero overhead. Furthermore, we extend the framework to support point deletion via local Delaunay updates, providing a complete suite of dynamic operations for point set modification. Comprehensive experiments on diverse geometric datasets demonstrate the efficiency and broad applicability of our approach for modern graphics pipelines. Source code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Channel-Level Relation to Attentive Aggregation with Neighborhood-Homogeneity Constraint for Point Cloud Analysis
item.author: Shi, Jiaqi, Xiao, Jin, Hu, Xiaoguang, Ji, Wenxuan, Jia, Zichong, Long, Zifan, Chen, Tianyou, Zhang, Baochang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 PointCRA 的新网络，通过引入时间趋势变化作为新的评估维度，并结合多级校准框架和专用损失函数，有效解决了现有方法在复杂邻域中特征捕捉的挑战，并在多个数据集上取得了优异的性能。

背景: 在三维点云理解中，准确捕捉复杂邻域内的判别性特征是核心挑战，直接影响 embodied AI 和自动驾驶等下游任务的执行精度。现有方法在特征相关性判别方面存在局限，仅限于点级空间分布或通道响应，导致评估粗糙，且在多尺度点云网络的深层中不可避免地造成显著的信息损失。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在复杂邻域特征捕捉中的局限性以及多尺度网络深层的信息损失问题，提出 PointCRA 网络。

方法: PointCRA 引入了时间趋势变化作为新的评估维度，以避免现有空间和通道注意力机制中权重维度坍塌导致的信息损失。在此基础上，构建了一个由邻域同质性引导的多级校准框架进行权重校准，并设计了一个专用损失函数。该方法利用内在特征先验来自适应地纠正特征聚合，具有可解释性和低参数开销。

主要发现: 在 S3DIS 数据集上达到 77.5% mIoU，在 ScanObjectNN 数据集上达到 90.4% OA，在 ShapeNetPart 数据集上达到 87.4% instance mIoU。

结论: PointCRA 方法具有可迁移性、可解释性和高效性，通过广泛的实验验证了其合理性。

翻译: 在三维点云理解中，核心挑战在于准确捕捉复杂邻域内的判别性特征，这直接影响 embodied AI 和自动驾驶等下游任务的执行精度。现有方法探索特征相关性判别，但仅限于点级空间分布或通道响应，仅能实现粗粒度级别的评估。对于现代多尺度点云网络，这种粗粒度指标不可避免地在深层中造成显著的信息损失。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 PointCRA，这是一种具有基于通道级度量增强机制的新型网络。我们的核心思想是引入时间趋势变化作为新的评估维度，以避免现有空间和通道注意力机制中权重维度坍塌导致的信息损失。在此基础上，我们构建了一个由邻域同质性引导的多级校准框架进行权重校准，并设计了一个专用损失函数来增强通道。该方法利用内在特征先验来自适应地纠正特征聚合，具有可解释性和低参数开销。我们的方法是可迁移的、可解释的和高效的。我们在各种数据集和基准模型上验证了所提出的方法，并通过广泛的分析实验进一步证明了其合理性。我们的 PointCRA 在 S3DIS 数据集上实现了 77.5% mIoU，在 ScanObjectNN 数据集上实现了 90.4% OA，在 ShapeNetPart 数据集上实现了 87.4% instance mIoU。代码和预训练权重在 GitHub 上公开可用。

Abstract

In 3D point cloud understanding, the core challenge lies in accurately capturing discriminative features within complex neighborhoods, which directly affects the execution precision of downstream tasks such as embodied AI and autonomous driving. Existing methods explore feature correlation discrimination but are limited to point-level spatial distribution or channel responses, enabling only coarse-grained level evaluation. For modern multi-scale point cloud networks, such coarse-grained metrics inevitably incur significant information loss in deeper layers. To address this, we propose PointCRA, a novel network with a channel-level metric-based enhancement mechanism. Our core idea is to introduce temporal trend variation as a new evaluation dimension to avoid the information loss caused by weight dimension collapse in existing spatial and channel attention mechanisms. On this basis, we construct a multi-level calibration framework guided by neighborhood homogeneity for weight calibration, and design a dedicated loss function to enhance channel this http URL leverages intrinsic feature priors to adaptively correct feature aggregation, offering interpretability with low parameter overhead. Our method is transferable, interpretable, and efficient. We validate the proposed method on diverse datasets and benchmark models, and further demonstrate its rationality through extensive analytical experiments. Our PointCRA achieves 77.5\% mIoU on the S3DIS dataset, 90.4\% OA on the ScanObjectNN dataset, and 87.4\% instance mIoU on the ShapeNetPart dataset. The code and pretrained weights are publicly available on GitHub: this https URL

item.title: CNNs for Vis-NIR Chemometrics: From Contradiction to Conditional Design
item.author: Dário Passos
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文综述了近红外光谱深度学习在化学计量学中的研究现状，指出不同研究在卷积神经网络设计上存在不一致结论，并提出了一个条件设计框架以解决这一问题。

背景: 近红外光谱深度学习研究在卷积神经网络设计上存在不一致结论，如核大小、网络深度、数据预处理和训练策略的差异，导致同一架构在不同研究中表现优劣不一，给化学计量学实践者带来实际困境。

目的: 本文旨在通过分析这些矛盾，提出一个条件设计框架，将架构和预处理选择与光谱物理特性、数据集特征和部署场景联系起来，推动化学计量学从模板驱动的架构选择转向可重复、物理感知和部署对齐的模型比较。

方法: 通过追溯重复出现的分歧，识别了三个关键原因：水基矩阵中可见-近红外测量的间接性质、有效感受野与信息光谱结构宽度的不匹配，以及作为隐藏超参数的验证设计（包括划分策略、超参数调优预算和部署类偏移暴露）。

主要发现: 这些矛盾并非不可调和的方法问题，而是未受控调节变量的结构预期后果；验证设计作为隐藏超参数可以主导模型排名；提出了一个条件设计框架，将架构和预处理与光谱物理、数据集特征和部署场景联系起来。

结论: 提出的视角将化学计量学从模板驱动的架构选择转向可重复、物理感知和部署对齐的模型比较。

翻译: 近红外光谱深度学习在化学计量学中的研究日益增多，但关于卷积神经网络设计的结论相互矛盾，包括小核与大核、浅层与深层架构、原始光谱与预处理、单域训练与迁移学习等。因此，同一架构在不同研究中表现优劣不一，给化学计量学实践者造成了实际困境。本文综述指出，这些矛盾并非不可调和的方法问题，而是未受控调节变量的结构预期后果。具体而言，重复出现的分歧归因于：（i）水基矩阵中可见-近红外测量的间接性质；（ii）有效感受野与信息光谱结构宽度的不匹配；（iii）验证设计（包括划分策略、超参数调优预算和部署类偏移暴露）作为隐藏超参数，可以主导模型排名。基于已发表的化学计量学和光谱学研究证据，本文提出了一个条件设计框架，将架构和预处理选择与光谱物理、数据集特征和预期部署场景联系起来。总体而言，提出的视角将化学计量学从模板驱动的架构选择转向可重复、物理感知和部署对齐的模型比较。

Abstract

Near-infrared (NIR; a.k.a.\ NIRS) deep-learning studies in chemometrics increasingly report mutually inconsistent conclusions regarding convolutional neural network (CNN) design, including small versus large kernels, shallow versus deep architectures, raw spectra versus preprocessing, and single-domain training versus transfer learning. As a result, the same architecture can appear superior in one study and inferior in another, creating a practical impasse for chemometric practitioners. In this review, we argue that these contradictions are not evidence of irreconcilable methods but a structurally expected consequence of uncontrolled moderating variables. Specifically, we trace recurring disagreements to (i) the indirect nature of Vis--NIR measurement in water-dominated matrices, (ii) mismatch between effective receptive field (ERF) and the width of informative spectral structure, and (iii) validation design (including split strategy, hyperparameter tuning budget, and exposure to deployment-like shifts) acting as a hidden hyperparameter that can dominate model ranking. Building on evidence from published chemometrics and spectroscopy studies, we propose a conditional design framework that links architecture and preprocessing choices to spectral physics, dataset regime, and intended deployment scenario. Overall, the proposed perspective moves DL Chemometrics from template-driven architecture selection toward reproducible, physics-aware, and deployment-aligned model comparison.

item.title: VideoNet: A Large-Scale Dataset for Domain-Specific Action Recognition
item.author: Tanush Yadav, Mohammadreza Salehi, Jae Sung Park, Vivek Ramanujan, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Yejin Choi, Ali Farhadi, Rohun Tripathi, Ranjay Krishna
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了VideoNet基准测试，旨在重新聚焦于特定领域的动作识别任务，并发现现有视觉语言模型在处理此类任务时存在显著挑战，通过收集大规模训练数据并微调模型，取得了优于其他开放权重模型的性能。

背景: 由于缺乏足够多样化和具有挑战性的数据，现代视觉语言模型不再评估其动作识别能力。视频在捕捉跨越多帧的动作方面具有独特性，动作识别长期以来一直是视频理解的核心任务。

目的: 为了在视觉语言模型时代重新振兴动作识别，倡导重新关注特定领域的动作，并提出了VideoNet基准测试。

方法: 提出了VideoNet基准测试，涵盖37个领域中的1000种不同动作。收集了首个大规模特定领域动作训练数据集，包含近50万视频问答对。使用Molmo2-4B模型在收集的数据上进行微调。

主要发现: 在多选题设置中，Gemini 3.1 Pro准确率为69.9%，而Qwen3-VL-8B仅为45.0%。即使在二选一设置中，Qwen也仅达到59.2%的准确率。在提供少量示例时，Qwen提升了7.0%，而Gemini下降了4.8%。这些提升远低于非专家人类在提供少量示例时13.6%的提升。

结论: 视觉语言模型难以充分利用少量示例。通过在收集的大规模训练数据上微调Molmo2-4B模型，在VideoNet基准测试中超越了所有开放权重8B模型。

翻译: 视频在捕捉跨越多帧的动作方面具有独特性。因此，多年来动作识别一直是视频理解的核心任务。不幸的是，由于缺乏足够多样化和具有挑战性的数据，现代视觉语言模型不再评估其动作识别能力。为了在视觉语言模型时代重新振兴动作识别，我们倡导重新关注特定领域的动作。为此，我们介绍了VideoNet，这是一个涵盖37个领域1000种不同动作的特定领域动作识别基准。我们从多选题评估设置开始，其中封闭模型和开放模型之间的差异明显：Gemini 3.1 Pro达到69.9%的准确率，而Qwen3-VL-8B仅为45.0%。为了了解为什么视觉语言模型在VideoNet上表现挣扎，我们将问题放宽为二选一设置，其中随机机会为50%。即便如此，Qwen也仅达到59.2%的准确率。进一步放宽评估设置，我们提供了k∈{1,2,3}个动作的少量示例。一些模型在少量设置中表现出色，而另一些则失败；Qwen提升了7.0%，而Gemini下降了4.8%。值得注意的是，这些提升远低于非专家人类在提供少量示例时13.6%的提升。发现视觉语言模型难以充分利用少量示例后，我们将重点从测试时改进转移到训练端。我们收集了首个特定领域动作的大规模训练数据集，总计近50万视频问答对。使用我们的数据微调Molmo2-4B模型，我们在VideoNet基准测试中超越了所有开放权重8B模型。

Abstract

Videos are unique in their ability to capture actions which transcend multiple frames. Accordingly, for many years action recognition was the quintessential task for video understanding. Unfortunately, due to a lack of sufficiently diverse and challenging data, modern vision-language models (VLMs) are no longer evaluated on their action recognition capabilities. To revitalize action recognition in the era of VLMs, we advocate for a returned focus on domain-specific actions. To this end, we introduce VideoNet, a domain-specific action recognition benchmark covering 1,000 distinct actions from 37 domains. We begin with a multiple-choice evaluation setting, where the difference between closed and open models is stark: Gemini 3.1 Pro attains 69.9% accuracy while Qwen3-VL-8B gets a mere 45.0%. To understand why VLMs struggle on VideoNet, we relax the questions into a binary setting, where random chance is 50%. Still, Qwen achieves only 59.2% accuracy. Further relaxing the evaluation setup, we provide $k\in\{1,2,3\}$ in-context examples of the action. Some models excel in the few-shot setting, while others falter; Qwen improves $+7.0\%$, while Gemini declines $-4.8\%$. Notably, these gains fall short of the $+13.6\%$ improvement in non-expert humans when given few-shot examples. Finding that VLMs struggle to fully exploit in-context examples, we shift from test-time improvements to the training side. We collect the first large-scale training dataset for domain-specific actions, totaling nearly 500k video question-answer pairs. Fine-tuning a Molmo2-4B model on our data, we surpass all open-weight 8B models on the VideoNet benchmark.

item.title: A Closed-Form Persistence-Landmark Pipeline for Certified Point-Cloud and Graph Classification
item.author: Sushovan Majhi, Atish Mitra, Žiga Virk, Pramita Bagchi
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PLACE 是一个用于点云和图分类的闭式管道，通过持久同调签名进行分类，并提供了基于训练标签的定量保证。

背景: 论文介绍了 PLACE (Persistence-Landmark Analytic Classification Engine)，这是一个用于分类点云和图的闭式管道。

目的: 通过持久同调签名对点云和图进行分类，并从训练标签中推导出三个定量保证。

方法: PLACE 使用嵌入将 Mitra-Virk 单点坐标函数在稀疏地标网格上求和；闭式权重最大化结构畸变常数 λ(ν)（非干扰下 D_n 的 Lipschitz 下界）。

主要发现: 1. 提供了基于训练标签的三个定量保证：基于边际的过剩风险率、闭式描述符选择规则和单预测证书；2. 在 Orbit5k 数据集上 PLACE 是最强的基于图的图方法；3. 在 MUTAG 和 COX2 上匹配最强的基于拓扑的基线；4. Mahalanobis 边际是异构化学图池上最强的闭式描述符选择器。

结论: PLACE 在 Orbit5k 上表现最强，在 MUTAG 和 COX2 上匹配最强的拓扑基线。剩余差距分为两个可诊断的领域：对 NCI1/NCI109 的描述符盲视，以及在其他地方的池覆盖限制。

翻译: 本文介绍了 PLACE (Persistence-Landmark Analytic Classification Engine)，这是一个通过持久同调签名对点云和图进行分类的闭式管道。从训练标签中推导出了三个定量保证——基于边际的过剩风险率、闭式描述符选择规则和单预测证书——无需学习权重或保留的校准。嵌入将 Mitra-Virk 单点坐标函数在稀疏地标网格上求和；闭式权重最大化结构畸变常数 λ(ν)（非干扰下 D_n 的 Lipschitz 下界）。(i) 一个由类别均值分离 Δ 和嵌入半径 R 驱动的 O(kR/(Δ√m_min)) 边际界，由样本饥饿的极小极大下界匹配。(ii) 在 Ledoit-Wolf 收缩协方差下的 Mahalanobis 边际是异构 64 描述符化学图池上最强的闭式描述符选择器（在 10 个基准测试中平均 Spearman ρ≈+0.54，在 10 个中有 9 个为正）；各向同性代理 Δ/√ℓ 在同质（14-15 描述符）蛋白质/社交池上允许闭式选择一致性率。(iii) 无单预测开销的训练时间决定的证书，具有非渐近 Pinelis 形式和渐近高斯插入形式。经验上，PLACE 是 Orbit5k 上最强的基于图的方法，并在统计噪声范围内匹配 MUTAG 和 COX2 上最强的基于拓扑的基线。剩余差距分为两个可诊断的领域：对 NCI1/NCI109 的描述符盲视，以及在其他地方的池覆盖限制。两个半径在每个基准测试的训练集大小上都超过了触发阈值 Δ̂/2，由多元范数界的 √ℓ 缩放主导；单预测证书是构造性的，但在这些大小下尚未操作化。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决对点云和图进行认证分类的问题。文中没有明确说明这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要。
