如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一个名为 DAP 的网络，用于异构毫米波动作识别，该网络能够感知多普勒信息。

Abstract

Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides privacy-preserving sensing and is valuable for human action recognition (HAR). Existing mmWave point cloud datasets are limited in scale and mostly collected under homogeneous single-source settings, preventing current methods from handling real-world distribution shifts caused by heterogeneous radar sources, such as different devices and frequency bands. To address this, we introduce UniMM-HAR, the largest and first mmWave point cloud HAR dataset for heterogeneous multi-source scenarios, standardizing three distinct radar configurations to realistically evaluate cross-source generalization. We further propose the Doppler-aware Point Cloud Network (DAP-Net) to tackle heterogeneity challenges. DAP-Net enhances intra-modal representations and performs cross-modal alignment to learn source-invariant action semantics. Leveraging action-consistent spatio-temporal Doppler patterns as anchors, the Dual-space Doppler Reparameterization (D2R) module performs sample-adaptive geometric densification and Doppler-guided feature recalibration, while the Text Alignment Module (TAM) provides stable semantic anchors via a pretrained textual space. Experiments show that DAP-Net significantly outperforms existing methods under heterogeneous radar settings, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and strong cross-source robustness.

item.title: WISTERIA: Learning Clinical Representations from Noisy Supervision via Multi-View Consistency in Electronic Health Records
item.author: Ruan Dong, Yuanyun Zhang, Shi Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: WISTERIA是一个弱监督表示学习框架，将标签建模为潜在临床状态的随机观测，通过构建多个弱监督算子并强制一致性来学习表示，并引入本体感知正则化。

背景: 电子健康记录(EHR)的表示学习主要遵循自然语言处理范式，依赖序列建模和重建目标，但现实世界临床监督信号本质上是弱的，源于异质、噪声和机构特定的标签过程。

目的: 提出WISTERIA框架，明确建模监督过程而非将标签视为固定目标，以学习鲁棒且具有临床意义的表示。

方法: WISTERIA将标签建模为潜在临床状态的随机观测，构建多个弱监督算子并通过一致性学习表示，引入本体感知正则化以施加语义结构。

主要发现: WISTERIA在标准EHR基准上提高了预测性能，对标签噪声具有强鲁棒性，且相比基于序列的预训练目标表现出优越的跨机构泛化能力。

结论: 明确建模监督过程而非将标签视为固定目标，为从EHR数据中学习鲁棒且具有临床意义的表示提供了更合适的归纳偏置。

翻译: 电子健康记录(EHR)中的表示学习主要遵循从自然语言处理继承的范式，依赖于序列建模和基于重建的目标，将临床标签视为真实值。然而，现实世界的临床监督本质上是弱的，源于异质、噪声和机构特定的标签过程，如计费代码、启发式表型和不完整的注释。在这项工作中，我们提出了WISTERIA，一个弱监督表示学习框架，将标签建模为潜在临床状态的随机观测。WISTERIA不针对单一监督信号进行优化，而是构建多个弱监督算子，并通过强制它们诱导的标签分布之间的一致性来学习表示。这种多视图形式诱导了一种隐式去噪机制，允许模型通过协调噪声标签生成者之间的分歧来恢复具有临床意义的结构。我们进一步在标签空间中引入本体感知正则化，以对监督信号施加语义结构。经验上，WISTERIA在标准EHR基准上提高了预测性能，表现出对标签噪声的强鲁棒性，并且相比基于序列的预训练目标表现出优越的跨机构泛化能力。这些结果表明，明确建模监督过程而不是将标签视为固定目标，为从EHR数据中学习鲁棒且具有临床意义的表示提供了更合适的归纳偏置。

Abstract

Representation learning in electronic health records (EHR) has largely followed paradigms inherited from natural language processing, relying on sequence modeling and reconstruction based objectives that treat clinical labels as ground truth. However, real world clinical supervision is inherently weak, arising from heterogeneous, noisy, and institution specific labeling processes such as billing codes, heuristic phenotypes, and incomplete annotations. In this work, we propose WISTERIA, a weakly supervised representation learning framework that models labels as stochastic observations of an underlying latent clinical state. Instead of optimizing against a single supervision signal, WISTERIA constructs multiple weak supervision operators and learns representations by enforcing consistency across their induced label distributions. This multi view formulation induces an implicit denoising mechanism, allowing the model to recover clinically meaningful structure by reconciling disagreement between noisy labelers. We further incorporate ontology aware regularization in the label space to impose semantic structure over supervision signals. Empirically, WISTERIA improves predictive performance across standard EHR benchmarks, demonstrates strong robustness to label noise, and exhibits superior cross institutional generalization compared to sequence based pretraining objectives. These results suggest that explicitly modeling the supervision process rather than treating labels as fixed targets provides a more appropriate inductive bias for learning robust and clinically meaningful representations from EHR data.

item.title: EgoMemReason: A Memory-Driven Reasoning Benchmark for Long-Horizon Egocentric Video Understanding
item.author: Ziyang Wang, Yue Zhang, Shoubin Yu, Ce Zhang, Zengqi Zhao, Jaehong Yoon, Hyunji Lee, Gedas Bertasius, Mohit Bansal
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了EgoMemReason基准测试，用于评估长时间自我中心视频理解中的记忆驱动推理能力。该基准测试包含500个问题，涵盖实体记忆、事件记忆和行为记忆三种类型，并揭示了当前模型在长时间记忆推理方面的局限性。

背景: 下一代视觉助手（如智能眼镜、具身智能体和全天候生活记录系统）需要处理长达数天甚至一周的连续视觉体验。然而，现有的周长视频基准测试主要侧重于感知和识别，而非需要跨多天整合证据的推理。

目的: 为了填补这一空白，作者引入了EgoMemReason，这是一个全面的基准测试，通过记忆驱动推理系统性地评估周长自我中心视频理解能力。

方法: EgoMemReason评估三种互补的记忆类型：实体记忆（追踪物体状态随时间的变化）、事件记忆（回忆和排序相隔数小时或数天的活动）以及行为记忆（从整个周期间稀疏重复的观察中抽象出 recurring patterns）。该基准包含500个问题，平均每个问题涉及5.1个视频片段和25.9小时的记忆回溯。

主要发现: 在17种方法（包括多模态大模型和智能体框架）上的评估显示，即使是表现最好的模型，整体准确率仅为39.6%。进一步分析表明，三种记忆类型因不同原因失效，且随着证据跨越的时间范围变长，性能会下降。

结论: EgoMemReason为评估和推进长上下文、具有记忆感知的多模态系统奠定了坚实基础，并揭示了长时域记忆问题尚未解决。

翻译: 下一代视觉助手，如智能眼镜、具身智能体和全天候生活记录系统，必须对长达一天或更长时间的连续视觉体验进行推理。在超长视频设置中，相关信息在数小时或数天内稀疏分布，这使得记忆成为一个基本挑战：模型必须随时间积累信息，回忆先前的状态，追踪时间顺序，并抽象重复出现的模式。然而，现有的周长视频基准测试主要设计用于感知和识别，如时刻定位或全局总结，而不是需要整合跨多天证据的推理。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍了EgoMemReason，这是一个全面的基准测试，通过记忆驱动推理系统性地评估周长自我中心视频理解。EgoMemReason评估三种互补的记忆类型：实体记忆，追踪物体状态随时间的变化；事件记忆，回忆和排序相隔数小时或数天的活动；以及行为记忆，从整个周期间稀疏重复的观察中抽象出 recurring patterns。EgoMemReason包含500个问题，涵盖三种记忆类型和六个核心挑战，平均每个问题有5.1个视频片段的证据和25.9小时的记忆回溯。我们在17种方法上评估了EgoMemReason，包括多模态大模型和智能体框架，发现即使是最好的模型也只达到了39.6%的整体准确率。进一步分析表明，三种记忆类型因不同原因失效，且随着证据跨越的时间范围变长，性能会下降，这表明长时域记忆仍然远未解决。我们相信EgoMemReason为评估和推进长上下文、具有记忆感知的多模态系统奠定了坚实基础。

Abstract

Next-generation visual assistants, such as smart glasses, embodied agents, and always-on life-logging systems, must reason over an entire day or more of continuous visual experience. In ultra-long video settings, relevant information is sparsely distributed across hours or days, making memory a fundamental challenge: models must accumulate information over time, recall prior states, track temporal order, and abstract recurring patterns. However, existing week-long video benchmarks are primarily designed for perception and recognition, such as moment localization or global summarization, rather than reasoning that requires integrating evidence across multiple days. To address this gap, we introduce EgoMemReason, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates week-long egocentric video understanding through memory-driven reasoning. EgoMemReason evaluates three complementary memory types: entity memory, tracking how object states evolve and change across days; event memory, recalling and ordering activities separated by hours or days; and behavior memory, abstracting recurring patterns from sparse, repeated observations over the whole week period. EgoMemReason comprises 500 questions across three memory types and six core challenges, with an average of 5.1 video segments of evidence per question and 25.9 hours of memory backtracking. We evaluate EgoMemReason on 17 methods across MLLMs and agentic frameworks, revealing that even the best model achieves only 39.6% overall accuracy. Further analysis shows that the three memory types fail for distinct reasons and that performance degrades as evidence spans longer temporal horizons, revealing that long-horizon memory remains far from solved. We believe EgoMemReason establishes a strong foundation for evaluating and advancing long-context, memory-aware multimodal systems.

item.title: TOC-Bench: A Temporal Object Consistency Benchmark for Video Large Language Models
item.author: Junzhe Chen, Siyuan Meng, Yuxi Chen, Man Zhao, Xiaojie Guo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Video-LLMs 在通用视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但在时间对象一致性方面仍存在不足。本文提出了 TOC-Bench 基准来评估这一能力，实验发现模型在事件计数、排序、身份推理和幻觉验证等方面存在显著弱点。

背景: 现有基准主要关注事件识别或粗粒度推理，很少评估模型在遮挡、消失、重现等复杂场景下保持对象身份、状态和连续性的能力，导致评估可能高估模型的时间推理能力。

目的: 为了解决现有评估忽视对象中心时间连贯性的问题，设计一个专门用于诊断 Video-LLMs 时间对象一致性的基准 TOC-Bench。

方法: 提出三层时间必要性过滤协议，移除依赖语言先验或单帧捷径的候选问题，保留 17,900 个时间依赖项，最终构建包含 2,323 个高质量问答对和 1,951 个视频的人工验证基准。

主要发现: 时间对象一致性仍是 Video-LLMs 的主要挑战。模型在事件计数、事件排序、身份敏感推理和幻觉感知验证方面存在显著弱点，尽管在通用基准上表现强劲。

结论: 时间对象一致性是 Video-LLMs 需要解决的关键问题，现有模型在此方面的表现仍不理想。

翻译: Video large language models have achieved remarkable progress in general video understanding, yet their ability to maintain temporal object consistency remains insufficiently explored. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on event recognition, action understanding, or coarse temporal reasoning, but rarely evaluate whether a model can consistently preserve the identity, state, and temporal continuity of the same object across occlusion, disappearance, reappearance, state transitions, and cross-object interactions. As a result, current evaluations may overestimate temporal reasoning ability while overlooking failures in object-centric temporal coherence. To address this issue, we introduce TOC-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate temporal object consistency in Video-LLMs. TOC-Bench is explicitly object-track grounded, where each queried subject is associated with a per frame object trajectory and structured temporal event timeline. To ensure that benchmark items depend on temporally ordered visual evidence rather than language priors, single-frame shortcuts, or unordered frame cues, we propose a three-layer temporal-necessity filtering protocol that removes 60.7% of candidate QA pairs and retains 17,900 temporally dependent items spanning 10 diagnostic dimensions. From this filtered pool, we further construct a human-verified benchmark containing 2,323 high-quality QA pairs over 1,951 videos. Experiments on representative Video-LLMs show that temporal object consistency remains a major unsolved challenge. Current models exhibit substantial weaknesses in event counting, event ordering, identity-sensitive reasoning, and hallucination-aware verification, despite strong performance on general video understanding benchmarks.

Abstract

Video large language models (Video-LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in general video understanding, yet their ability to maintain temporal object consistency remains insufficiently explored. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on event recognition, action understanding, or coarse temporal reasoning, but rarely evaluate whether a model can consistently preserve the identity, state, and temporal continuity of the same object across occlusion, disappearance, reappearance, state transitions, and cross-object interactions. As a result, current evaluations may overestimate temporal reasoning ability while overlooking failures in object-centric temporal coherence. To address this issue, we introduce TOC-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate temporal object consistency in Video-LLMs. TOC-Bench is explicitly object-track grounded, where each queried subject is associated with a per frame object trajectory and structured temporal event timeline. To ensure that benchmark items depend on temporally ordered visual evidence rather than language priors, single-frame shortcuts, or unordered frame cues, we propose a three-layer temporal-necessity filtering protocol that removes 60.7% of candidate QA pairs and retains 17,900 temporally dependent items spanning 10 diagnostic dimensions. From this filtered pool, we further construct a human-verified benchmark containing 2,323 high-quality QA pairs over 1,951 videos. Experiments on representative Video-LLMs show that temporal object consistency remains a major unsolved challenge. Current models exhibit substantial weaknesses in event counting, event ordering, identity-sensitive reasoning, and hallucination-aware verification, despite strong performance on general video understanding benchmarks.

item.title: From Syntax to Semantics: Unveiling the Emergence of Chirality in SMILES Translation Models
item.author: Zehao Li, Yasuhiro Yoshikai, Shumpei Nemoto, Hiroyuki Kusuhara, Tadahaya Mizuno
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了化学语言模型如何从分子字符串表示中学习化学意义，而非仅表面模式，并重点关注手性信息的获取。

背景: 手性对药理活性和毒性有显著影响，但化学语言模型往往难以可靠地区分手性构型。

目的: 提出Pan-CORE模型家族，通过高时间分辨率检查点分析，探究手性信息在训练过程中的学习机制。

方法: 使用基于自回归Transformer的编码器-解码器模型进行SMILES翻译，并分析注意力动态、残差流轨迹和潜在空间几何。

主要发现: 在所有测试的Pan-CORE变体中，观察到手性标记准确率在长期平台期后突然跃升，表明手性学习停滞不仅由模型容量引起，还反映了手性约束的复杂性。分析支持一种以编码器为中心的机制，即手性标记表示经历瞬态不稳定性和重构，表现为向量范数和方向稳定性的V形下降和恢复，以及潜在空间中手性分子表示的清晰重组。

结论: SMILES翻译可作为分析化学语言模型中语义涌现机制的有用实验系统，对可解释的化学表示学习具有重要意义。

翻译: Understanding how chemical language models (CLMs) learn chemical meaning from molecular string representations, rather than only surface-level string patterns, is an important question in chemical representation learning and machine learning for chemistry. Chirality provides a demanding test case: enantiomers can differ greatly in pharmacological activity and toxicity, yet CLMs often struggle to distinguish chiral configurations reliably. Here we present Pan-CORE (Pan-Chemical Omniscale Representation Engine), a family of autoregressive Transformer-based encoder-decoder models for SMILES translation, and use high-temporal-resolution checkpoint analysis to investigate how chiral information is learned during training. Across all tested Pan-CORE variants, we observe a reproducible jump-up in which chiral-token accuracy rises abruptly after a long plateau, suggesting that chiral learning stagnation is not explained by model capacity alone and instead reflects the complexity of chiral constraints. Analyses of attention dynamics, residual-stream trajectories, and latent-space geometry support an encoder-centered mechanism in which chiral-token representations undergo transient destabilization and reconstruction, seen as a V-shaped drop and recovery in vector norm and directional stability, together with a clear reorganization of chiral molecular representations in the latent space. Encoder-decoder cross-evaluation further supports the encoder-centered nature of the transition, and targeted attention-head ablation identifies a small set of chiral-sensitive heads whose removal selectively reduces chiral-token accuracy even in the fully trained model. These findings show that SMILES translation can serve as a useful experimental system for mechanistic analysis of semantic emergence in CLMs, with implications for interpretable chemical representation learning.

Abstract

Understanding how chemical language models (CLMs) learn chemical meaning from molecular string representations, rather than only surface-level string patterns, is an important question in chemical representation learning and machine learning for chemistry. Chirality provides a demanding test case: enantiomers can differ greatly in pharmacological activity and toxicity, yet CLMs often struggle to distinguish chiral configurations reliably. Here we present Pan-CORE (Pan-Chemical Omniscale Representation Engine), a family of autoregressive Transformer-based encoder-decoder models for SMILES translation, and use high-temporal-resolution checkpoint analysis to investigate how chiral information is learned during training. Across all tested Pan-CORE variants, we observe a reproducible jump-up in which chiral-token accuracy rises abruptly after a long plateau, suggesting that chiral learning stagnation is not explained by model capacity alone and instead reflects the complexity of chiral constraints. Analyses of attention dynamics, residual-stream trajectories, and latent-space geometry support an encoder-centered mechanism in which chiral-token representations undergo transient destabilization and reconstruction, seen as a V-shaped drop and recovery in vector norm and directional stability, together with a clear reorganization of chiral molecular representations in the latent space. Encoder-decoder cross-evaluation further supports the encoder-centered nature of the transition, and targeted attention-head ablation identifies a small set of chiral-sensitive heads whose removal selectively reduces chiral-token accuracy even in the fully trained model. These findings show that SMILES translation can serve as a useful experimental system for mechanistic analysis of semantic emergence in CLMs, with implications for interpretable chemical representation learning.

item.title: Learning to Perceive "Where": Spatial Pretext Tasks for Robust Self-Supervised Learning
item.author: Yang Shen, Yusen Cai, Weronika Hryniewska-Guzik, Qing Lin, Mengmi Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Spatial Prediction (SP)的自监督学习方法，通过预测局部视图间的相对位置和尺度来增强对空间结构的感知，并在多项视觉任务中取得了改进。

背景: 现有的自监督学习方法主要关注物体不变表示，往往忽略了物体部分之间的空间结构和关系。

目的: 为了解决现有方法忽视空间结构的问题，引入Spatial Prediction (SP)任务。

方法: SP是一个空间感知的预任务回归任务，用于预测同一图像中解耦的局部视图之间的相对位置和尺度。该方法通过建模部分与部分之间的关系来捕捉细粒度的空间依赖性，并作为解耦的插件无缝集成到各种SSL框架中。

主要发现: 实验表明，SP在图像识别、细粒度分类、语义分割和深度估计等任务上表现一致，且在物体识别的分布外鲁棒性方面有显著提升。在评估空间推理的拼图理解任务上表现强劲，表明空间结构和几何感知得到改善。

结论: 明确建模空间信息为自监督学习提供了有效的归纳偏置，从而获得更结构化的表示和更好的泛化能力。

翻译: Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) methods primarily learn object-invariant representations but often neglect the spatial structure and relationships among object parts. To address this limitation, we introduce Spatial Prediction (SP), a spatially aware pretext regression task that predicts the relative position and scale between a pair of disentangled local views from the same image. By modeling part-to-part relationships in a continuous geometric space, SP encourages representations to capture fine-grained spatial dependencies beyond invariant categorical semantics, thereby learning the compositional structure of visual scenes. SP is implemented as a decoupled plug-in and can be seamlessly integrated into diverse SSL frameworks. Extensive experiments show consistent improvements across image recognition, fine-grained classification, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, as well as substantial gains in out-of-distribution robustness for object recognition. To evaluate spatial reasoning, we introduce (1) a position and scale prediction task on image patch pairs and (2) a jigsaw understanding task requiring patch reordering and recognition after reconstruction. Strong performance on these tasks indicates improved spatial structure and geometric awareness. Overall, explicitly modeling spatial information provides an effective inductive bias for SSL, leading to more structured representations and better generalization. Code and models will be released.

Abstract

Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) methods primarily learn object-invariant representations but often neglect the spatial structure and relationships among object parts. To address this limitation, we introduce Spatial Prediction (SP), a spatially aware pretext regression task that predicts the relative position and scale between a pair of disentangled local views from the same image. By modeling part-to-part relationships in a continuous geometric space, SP encourages representations to capture fine-grained spatial dependencies beyond invariant categorical semantics, thereby learning the compositional structure of visual scenes. SP is implemented as a decoupled plug-in and can be seamlessly integrated into diverse SSL frameworks. Extensive experiments show consistent improvements across image recognition, fine-grained classification, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, as well as substantial gains in out-of-distribution robustness for object recognition. To evaluate spatial reasoning, we introduce (1) a position and scale prediction task on image patch pairs and (2) a jigsaw understanding task requiring patch reordering and recognition after reconstruction. Strong performance on these tasks indicates improved spatial structure and geometric awareness. Overall, explicitly modeling spatial information provides an effective inductive bias for SSL, leading to more structured representations and better generalization. Code and models will be released.

item.title: Lakestream: A Consistent and Brokerless Data Plane for Large Foundation Model Training
item.author: Ting Sun, Junjie Zhang, Xiao Yan, Songxin Zhang, Zhuoyang Song, Jingyi Xi, Zunyao Mao, Bingyi Jing, Jiaxing Zhang, Zejian Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Lakestream是一种无代理、原生对象存储的训练数据平面，旨在解决现有数据加载器在分布式训练中的问题。

背景: 现代大型基础模型训练已将数据管道从静态摄入层转变为必须与训练过程共同演进的动态组件。现有系统存在不足：同位置数据加载器缺乏故障隔离，而基于消息队列的分散式数据加载器基于记录/偏移量抽象，无法表达分布式训练所需的批次级语义。

目的: 提出Lakestream，一种无代理、原生对象存储的训练数据平面，以解决现有数据加载器在分布式训练中的问题。

方法: Lakestream具有三个关键特性：首先引入事务性全局批次TGB，基于湖仓风格ACID存储语义并扩展了训练特定的一致性，包括原子所有秩批次可见性、全局有序步序列、检查点对齐的生命周期管理和端到端精确一次恢复；其次通过在清单中内联生产者状态并将回收与分布式检查点状态绑定，直接在存储层实现恢复和保留；第三，其去中心化自适应提交DAC算法在清单增长时维持稳定的摄入吞吐量，无需生产者之间的通信。

主要发现: 在64 GPU上进行的大规模多模态预训练和SFT工作负载评估显示，Lakestream在同位置数据加载器吞吐量上表现更好，同时提供完整的故障隔离；在摄入吞吐量上优于Apache Kafka；消费者读取延迟低于Kafka。

结论: Lakestream通过其三个关键特性，成功解决了现有数据加载器在分布式训练中的问题，提供了更好的吞吐量、故障隔离和读取延迟。

翻译: 现代大型基础模型（LFM）训练已将数据管道从静态摄入层转变为必须与训练过程共同演进的动态组件。现有系统装备不足：同位置数据加载器提供无故障隔离，而基于消息队列的分散式数据加载器基于记录/偏移量抽象，无法表达分布式训练所需的批次级语义。我们提出了Lakestream，一种无代理、原生对象存储的训练数据平面，具有三个关键特性。首先，它引入了事务性全局批次（TGB），该批次基于湖仓风格的ACID存储语义，并扩展了训练特定的一致性，包括原子所有秩批次可见性、全局有序步序列、检查点对齐的生命周期管理和端到端精确一次恢复。其次，它通过在清单中内联生产者状态并将回收与分布式检查点状态绑定，直接在存储层实现恢复和保留。第三，其去中心化自适应提交（DAC）算法在清单增长时维持稳定的摄入吞吐量，无需生产者之间的通信。在64 GPU上进行的大规模多模态预训练和SFT工作负载评估显示，Lakestream在同位置数据加载器吞吐量上表现更好，同时提供完整的故障隔离；在摄入吞吐量上优于Apache Kafka；消费者读取延迟低于Kafka。

Abstract

Modern Large Foundation Model (LFM) training has transformed the data pipeline from a static ingestion layer into a dynamic component that must co-evolve with the training process. Existing systems are ill-equipped: colocated dataloaders offer no failure isolation, while message queue-based disaggregated dataloaders operate on a record/offset abstraction that cannot express the batch-level semantics required by distributed training. We present Lakestream, a brokerless, object-store-native training data plane with three key properties. First, it introduces the Transactional Global Batch (TGB), which builds on lakehouse-style ACID storage semantics and extends them with training-specific consistency, including atomic all-rank batch visibility, a globally ordered step sequence, checkpoint-aligned lifecycle management, and end-to-end exactly-once recovery. Second, it realizes recovery and retention directly in the storage layer, by inlining producer state in the manifest and tying reclamation to distributed checkpoint state. Third, its Decentralized Adaptive Commit (DAC) algorithm sustains stable ingestion throughput as the manifest grows, without any inter-producer communication. Evaluations on large-scale multimodal pre-training and SFT workloads using 64 GPUs show that Lakestream outperforms colocated dataloader throughput while providing full failure isolation, outperforms Apache Kafka in ingestion throughput, and achieves lower consumer read latency than Kafka.

item.title: Slum Detection and Density Mapping with AlphaEarth Foundations: A Representation Learning Evaluation Across 12 Global Cities
item.author: Shuyang Hou, Ziqi Liu, Haoyue Jiao, Zhangyan Xu, Xiaopu Zhang, Lutong Xie, Yaxian Qing, Jianyuan Liang, Xuefeng Guan, Huayi Wua
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究评估了AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF)在贫民窟检测任务中的适用性，通过多城市、多年份的数据分析，探讨了其在贫民窟分类和亚像素密度估计中的表现。

背景: Pixel-level slum mapping 长期受限于跨城市泛化能力不足、缺乏连续密度估计以及全局可比性弱的问题。AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) 提供了一种新的分析就绪基础，但其对贫民窟检测这一间接耦合任务的适用性尚未经过测试。

目的: 评估 AEF 在 12 个城市和 69 个城市-年份对（2017-2024）上的贫民窟分类和亚像素密度估计表现，并分析其能力与互补性需求。

方法: 使用 GRAM 伪掩码作为监督标签，在四种训练策略、两种协议（随机划分和 3x3 空间块交叉验证）、六种辅助特征配置和五种基线模型下进行评估，并结合表示级分析（PCA、SHAP）和全区域映射。

主要发现: 1. 同城跨年训练在两种协议下均表现最佳；2. 回归 R^2 主要受零/非零边界区分驱动，正像素 R^2 始终为负；3. PC36 在各项任务中排名最高；4. POI 特征带来最大的密度增益；5. 对于满足双任务可用性阈值的六个城市，2017-2024 年的全区域推断保留了贫民窟簇结构。

结论: 研究阐明了基础模型嵌入在贫民窟监测中的能力及互补性需求。

翻译: 研究评估了AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF)在贫民窟检测任务中的适用性，通过多城市、多年份的数据分析，探讨了其在贫民窟分类和亚像素密度估计中的表现。Pixel-level slum mapping 长期受限于跨城市泛化能力不足、缺乏连续密度估计以及全局可比性弱的问题。AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) 提供了一种新的分析就绪基础，但其对贫民窟检测这一间接耦合任务的适用性尚未经过测试。评估 AEF 在 12 个城市和 69 个城市-年份对（2017-2024）上的贫民窟分类和亚像素密度估计表现，并分析其能力与互补性需求。使用 GRAM 伪掩码作为监督标签，在四种训练策略、两种协议（随机划分和 3x3 空间块交叉验证）、六种辅助特征配置和五种基线模型下进行评估，并结合表示级分析（PCA、SHAP）和全区域映射。1. 同城跨年训练在两种协议下均表现最佳；2. 回归 R^2 主要受零/非零边界区分驱动，正像素 R^2 始终为负；3. PC36 在各项任务中排名最高；4. POI 特征带来最大的密度增益；5. 对于满足双任务可用性阈值的六个城市，2017-2024 年的全区域推断保留了贫民窟簇结构。研究阐明了基础模型嵌入在贫民窟监测中的能力及互补性需求。

Abstract

Pixel-level slum mapping has long been constrained by limited cross-city generalisation, the absence of continuous density estimation, and weak global comparability. AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF), a globally consistent 64-dimensional annual surface embedding at 10 m, offers a new analysis-ready basis for lightweight slum monitoring, but its applicability to slum detection - an indirectly coupled task shaped by both built form and socio-economic processes - remains untested. We evaluate AEF on slum classification and sub-pixel density estimation across 12 cities and 69 city-year pairs (2017-2024), using GRAM pseudo-masks as supervisory labels. The evaluation spans four training strategies, two protocols (random split and 3x3 spatial block cross-validation), six auxiliary feature configurations, and five baseline models, complemented by representation-level analyses (PCA, SHAP) and full-AOI mapping. Five findings emerge. (1) Same-city cross-year training is optimal under both protocols (median spatial F1 = 0.616, R^2 = 0.466); temporal expansion outperforms cross-city transfer, indicating city-scale representational drift. (2) Regression R^2 is driven primarily by zero/non-zero boundary discrimination: positive-pixel R^2 is consistently negative across all cities, revealing limited capacity to model intra-pixel density gradients at 10 m. (3) PC36 is consistently top-ranked across tasks; classification saturates at k = 32 while regression remains unsaturated at k = 64. (4) POI features yield the largest density gain (Delta R^2 = +0.064). (5) For six cities meeting dual-task usability thresholds, full-AOI inference across 2017-2024 preserves slum cluster structure (mean SSIM = 0.926). The study delineates the capabilities and complementarity needs of foundation-model embeddings for slum monitoring.

item.title: MFVLR: Multi-domain Fine-grained Vision-Language Reconstruction for Generalizable Diffusion Face Forgery Detection and Localization
item.author: Yaning Zhang, Tianyi Wang, Zan Gao, Yibo Zhao, Chunjie Ma, Meng Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种多域细粒度视觉-语言重建模型，用于通用的人脸伪造检测与定位。

背景: 人脸生成技术快速发展引发关注，现有方法主要依赖图像模态，忽略了细粒度文本等其他模态，且难以处理扩散模型生成的人脸。

目的: 解决现有方法泛化能力受限的问题，实现通用的人脸伪造检测和定位，特别是针对扩散模型生成的人脸。

方法: 提出了多域细粒度视觉-语言重建模型。具体包括：细粒度语言变换器、多域视觉编码器、视觉解码器以及即插即用的视觉注入模块。

主要发现: 实验表明该网络在跨生成器、跨伪造类型和跨数据集评估中均优于现有最先进的方法。

结论: 该模型通过语言引导的表示学习，有效实现了对扩散合成人脸的检测与定位，具有较好的泛化能力。

翻译: The swift advancement in photo-realistic face generation technology has sparked considerable concerns across society and academia, emphasizing the requirement of generalizable face forgery detection and localization methods. Prior works tend to capture face forgery patterns across multiple domains using image modality, other modalities like fine-grained texts are not comprehensively investigated, which restricts the generalization capability of models. Besides, they usually analyze facial images created by GAN, but struggle to identify and localize those synthesized by diffusion. To solve the problems, in this paper, we devise a novel multi-domain fine-grained vision-language reconstruction (MFVLR) model, which explores comprehensive and diverse visual forgery traces via language-guided face forgery representation learning, to achieve generalizable diffusion-synthesized face forgery detection and localization (DFFDL). Specifically, we devise a fine-grained language transformer that studies general fine-grained language embeddings using language reconstruction. We propose a multi-domain vision encoder to capture general and complementary visual forgery patterns across the image and residual domains. A vision decoder is designed to reconstruct image appearance and achieve forgery localization. Besides, we propose an innovative plug-and-play vision injection module to enhance the interaction between the vision and language embeddings. Extensive experiments and visualizations demonstrate that our network outperforms the state of the art on different settings like cross-generator, cross-forgery, and cross-dataset evaluations.

Abstract

The swift advancement in photo-realistic face generation technology has sparked considerable concerns across society and academia, emphasizing the requirement of generalizable face forgery detection and localization methods. Prior works tend to capture face forgery patterns across multiple domains using image modality, other modalities like fine-grained texts are not comprehensively investigated, which restricts the generalization capability of models. Besides, they usually analyze facial images created by GAN, but struggle to identify and localize those synthesized by diffusion. To solve the problems, in this paper, we devise a novel multi-domain fine-grained vision-language reconstruction (MFVLR) model, which explores comprehensive and diverse visual forgery traces via language-guided face forgery representation learning, to achieve generalizable diffusion-synthesized face forgery detection and localization (DFFDL). Specifically, we devise a fine-grained language transformer that studies general fine-grained language embeddings using language reconstruction. We propose a multi-domain vision encoder to capture general and complementary visual forgery patterns across the image and residual domains. A vision decoder is designed to reconstruct image appearance and achieve forgery localization. Besides, we propose an innovative plug-and-play vision injection module to enhance the interaction between the vision and language embeddings. Extensive experiments and visualizations demonstrate that our network outperforms the state of the art on different settings like cross-generator, cross-forgery, and cross-dataset evaluations.

item.title: When Normality Shifts: Risk-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection
item.author: Wei Huang, Hezhe Qiao, Kailai Zhang, Zaisheng Ye, Yu-Ming Shang, Xiangling Fu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为RTTAD的无监督表格异常检测方法，通过训练和测试阶段的协同机制解决数据不足和异常污染问题。

背景: 现有方法通常从正常样本中学习特征模式，但训练数据规模和多样性有限，导致正常模式刻画不完整。测试时适应虽然有效，但孤立关注测试时优化忽略了与训练阶段的协同，且盲目适应未标记的测试数据会导致异常污染，阻碍模型区分正常和异常样本的能力。

目的: 为了解决训练数据不足和测试时适应导致的异常污染问题，提出一种风险感知的测试时适应方法RTTAD，以应对正常性偏移并提升检测性能。

方法: RTTAD采用协同的两阶段机制。训练阶段通过协作的双任务学习捕获多级表示以建立稳健的正常先验。测试阶段使用测试时对比学习模块，通过使用高置信度的伪正常样本选择性更新模型并约束异常样本，同时结合基于k近邻的对比目标来优化嵌入分布。

主要发现: 在15个表格数据集上的广泛实验表明，RTTAD实现了最先进的整体检测性能。

结论: RTTAD通过协同机制有效解决了异常检测中的数据局限和污染问题，显著提升了检测能力。

翻译: 无监督表格异常检测方法通常在训练期间从正常样本中学习特征模式，并在测试期间识别偏离这些模式的样本为异常。然而，在实际场景中，训练数据的有限规模和多样性往往导致正常模式的刻画不完整。虽然测试时适应提供了一种补救措施，但其孤立地关注测试时优化忽略了与训练阶段学习的关键协同作用。此外，对未标记测试数据的盲目适应不可避免地会触发异常污染，阻碍模型充分实现其正常样本和异常样本之间的判别能力。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了RTTAD，一种用于无监督表格异常检测的风险感知测试时适应方法。RTTAD通过协同的两阶段机制整体应对正常性偏移。在训练期间，协作的双任务学习捕获多级表示以建立稳健的正常先验。在测试期间，测试时对比学习模块通过使用高置信度的伪正常样本选择性更新模型同时约束异常样本，明确考虑了适应风险。此外，TTCL结合了基于k近邻的对比目标来优化嵌入分布，从而进一步增强了模型的判别能力。在15个表格数据集上的广泛实验表明，RTTAD实现了最先进的整体检测性能。

Abstract

Unsupervised tabular anomaly detection methods typically learn feature patterns from normal samples during training and subsequently identify samples that deviate from these patterns as anomalies during testing. However, in practical scenarios, the limited scale and diversity of training data often lead to an incomplete characterization of normal patterns. While test-time adaptation offers a remedy, its isolated focus on test-time optimization ignores the critical synergy with training-phase learning. Furthermore, indiscriminate adaptation to unlabeled test data inevitably triggers anomaly contamination, preventing the model from fully realizing its discriminative capability between normal and anomalous samples. To address these issues, we propose RTTAD, a Risk-aware Test-time adaptation method for unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection. RTTAD holistically tackles normality shifts via a synergistic two-stage mechanism. During training, collaborative dual-task learning captures multi-level representations to establish a robust normal prior. During testing, a Test-Time Contrastive Learning (TTCL) module explicitly accounts for adaptation risk by selectively updating the model using high-confidence pseudo-normal samples while constraining anomalous ones. Additionally, TTCL incorporates a k-nearest neighbor-based contrastive objective to refine embedding distributions, thereby further enhancing the model's discriminative capacity. Extensive experiments on 15 tabular datasets demonstrate that RTTAD achieves state-of-the-art overall detection performance.

item.title: BROS: Bias-Corrected Randomized Subspaces for Memory-Efficient Single-Loop Bilevel Optimization
item.author: Hengrui Zhang, Boao Kong, Engao Zhang, Kun Yuan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为BROS的内存高效单循环随机双层优化方法，旨在解决现有方法在内存压力和收敛保证方面的不足。

背景: 随机双层优化已成为深度学习中超参数学习、数据重加权、表示学习和数据混合优化的标准框架。现有的精确单循环SBO方法和内存高效的代理SBO方法要么对大型底层神经网络产生严重的内存压力，要么在标准假设下缺乏竞争力的收敛保证。

目的: 提出BROS方法，使其在保持与精确单循环SBO方法相同的收敛率阶数的同时，实现内存效率。

方法: BROS方法在随机子空间中执行底层和辅助更新，采用Rademacher双探针校正来恢复无偏的Hessian作用估计量。

主要发现: 在标准假设下，BROS保留了MA-SOBA在寻找ε-平稳点时的O(ε^{-2})样本复杂度。实验表明，BROS在超数据清洗、数据混合学习、超表示学习和ViT样本重加权等任务中，将峰值内存减少了高达44.9%，同时紧密匹配全空间基线性能。

结论: BROS是一种有效的内存高效单循环SBO方法，在保持高收敛率的同时显著降低了内存使用。

翻译: Stochastic bilevel optimization (SBO) has become a standard framework for hyperparameter learning, data reweighting, representation learning, and data-mixture optimization in deep learning. Existing exact single-loop SBO methods and memory-efficient surrogate SBO methods either create severe memory pressure for large lower-level neural networks or lack competitive convergence guarantees under standard assumptions. In this paper, we propose BROS, a memory-efficient single-loop SBO method with the same convergence rate order as exact single-loop SBO methods. BROS performs lower and auxiliary updates in randomized subspaces with a Rademacher bi-probe correction that recovers an unbiased Hessian-action estimator. We prove that BROS preserves the O(ε^{-2}) sample complexity of MA-SOBA for finding an ε-stationary point under only standard assumptions. Experiments on hyper-data cleaning, data-mixture learning, hyper-representation learning, and ViT sample reweighting show that BROS reduces peak memory by up to 44.9% while closely matching full-space baseline performance.

Abstract

Stochastic bilevel optimization (SBO) has become a standard framework for hyperparameter learning, data reweighting, representation learning, and data-mixture optimization in deep learning. Existing exact single-loop SBO methods and memory-efficient surrogate SBO methods either create severe memory pressure for large lower-level neural networks or lack competitive convergence guarantees under standard assumptions. In this paper, we propose BROS, a memory-efficient single-loop SBO method with the same convergence rate order as exact single-loop SBO methods. BROS performs lower and auxiliary updates in randomized subspaces with a Rademacher bi-probe correction that recovers an unbiased Hessian-action estimator. We prove that BROS preserves the $\mathcal O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample complexity of MA-SOBA for finding an $\varepsilon$-stationary point under only standard assumptions. Experiments on hyper-data cleaning, data-mixture learning, hyper-representation learning, and ViT sample reweighting show that BROS reduces peak memory by up to 44.9% while closely matching full-space baseline performance.

item.title: Physical probes expose and alleviate chemical-environment collapse in molecular representations
item.author: Jiebin Fang, Zidi Yan, Churu Mao, Yongjun Jiang, Xinyi Tang, Lei Miao, Dan Lu, Yun Huang, Wanjing Ding, Zhongjun Ma
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文构建了互补的高保真实验和计算13C NMR资源，揭示了分子表示学习中存在的表示坍缩问题，并开发了一种名为CLAIM的框架来解决这一问题。

背景: 核磁共振光谱学提供了局部化学环境的实验读出，但在分子表示学习中受到异构数据和原子级分配不完整的限制。

目的: 为了缓解表示坍缩的瓶颈，开发CLAIM框架，以对齐高效的拓扑分子输入与原子分辨的NMR观测值。

方法: CLAIM框架通过分层化学先验和跨级对比学习，将高效的拓扑分子输入与原子分辨的NMR观测值对齐。

主要发现: CLAIM框架恢复了丢失的化学分辨率，显著提高了原子级分子-光谱检索；在灵活和互变异构系统中对13C NMR预测保持稳健；在不显式3D建模的情况下改善立体异构体区分；并迁移到更广泛的分子属性任务。

结论: 物理基础的光谱对齐作为缓解化学环境坍缩和指导实验基础分子表示学习的有效策略得以确立。

翻译: 核磁共振光谱学提供了局部化学环境的实验读出，但在分子表示学习中受到异构数据和原子级分配不完整的限制。本文构建了互补的高保真实验和计算13C NMR资源，揭示了分子表示学习中存在的表示坍缩问题：拓扑上等价的原子在其实际化学环境中可能保持实验上的差异，而显式3D描述在动态条件下进一步受到静态构象的限制。为了缓解这一瓶颈，我们开发了CLAIM（分子NMR原子到分子推断的对比学习）框架，该框架将高效的拓扑分子输入与原子分辨的NMR观测值对齐。通过分层化学先验和跨级对比学习，CLAIM恢复了丢失的化学分辨率，并显著提高了原子级分子-光谱检索。CLAIM在灵活和互变异构系统的13C NMR预测中保持稳健，在不显式3D建模的情况下改善了立体异构体区分，并迁移到更广泛的分子属性任务，包括ADMET预测和荧光估计。这些结果确立了物理基础的光谱对齐作为缓解化学环境坍缩和指导实验基础分子表示学习的有效策略。

Abstract

Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy provides an experimental readout of local chemical environments, but its use in molecular representation learning has been constrained by heterogeneous data and incomplete atom-level assignments. Here we construct complementary high-fidelity experimental and computational 13C NMR resources, which reveal a recurrent form of representational collapse: atoms that are equivalent in molecular topology can remain experimentally distinct in their real chemical environments, whereas explicit 3D descriptions are further limited by static conformations in dynamic regimes. To alleviate this bottleneck, we develop CLAIM (Contrastive Learning for Atom-to-molecule Inference of Molecular NMR), a framework that aligns efficient topological molecular inputs with atom-resolved NMR observables. Through hierarchical chemical priors and cross-level contrastive learning, CLAIM restores lost chemical resolution and markedly improves atom-level molecule-spectrum retrieval. CLAIM remains robust in flexible and tautomeric systems for 13C NMR prediction, improves stereoisomer discrimination without explicit 3D modelling, and transfers to broader molecular property tasks including ADMET prediction and fluorescence estimation. These results establish physically grounded spectral alignment as an effective strategy for alleviating chemical-environment collapse and for guiding experimentally grounded molecular representation learning.

item.title: OpenSGA: Efficient 3D Scene Graph Alignment in the Open World
item.author: Gang Chen, Sebastián Barbas Laina, Stefan Leutenegger, Javier Alonso-Mora
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 场景图对齐在部分重叠观测构建的两个3D场景图之间建立物体对应关系。

背景: 现有方法主要关注子扫描到子扫描的对齐，且严重依赖几何点云特征，忽略了帧到扫描的对齐和开放集视觉语言特征。此外，现有数据集规模小且物体多样性有限。

目的: 提出统一且高效的场景图对齐框架，以实现高效的场景理解、物体级重定位以及多智能体间的全局地图融合。

方法: 提出融合视觉语言、文本和几何特征及空间上下文的框架，包含距离门控空间注意力编码器、基于最小费用流的分配器和全局场景嵌入生成器等模块。同时引入了包含超过70万样本的大规模数据集ScanNet-SG。

主要发现: 在帧到扫描和子扫描到子扫描任务上取得了最佳整体性能，显著优于现有方法。

结论: 该方法能够在大坐标差异下实现准确对齐，代码和数据集已发布。

翻译: 场景图对齐在部分重叠观测构建的两个3D场景图之间建立物体对应关系。这使机器人在重新访问地点时能够实现高效场景理解和物体级重定位，以及多智能体间的全局地图融合。这些能力对于需要长期记忆进行环境交互的长时任务机器人至关重要。现有方法主要关注子扫描到子扫描的对齐，且严重依赖几何点云特征，忽略了帧到扫描的对齐和开放集视觉语言特征。此外，现有数据集规模小且物体多样性有限。我们提出了一个统一且高效的场景图对齐框架，通过融合视觉语言、文本和几何特征及空间上下文来预测物体对应关系。该框架包含距离门控空间注意力编码器、基于最小费用流的分配器和全局场景嵌入生成器等模块，以在大坐标差异下实现准确对齐。我们还引入了ScanNet-SG数据集，通过自动化标注流程生成，包含超过70万样本，涵盖509个物体类别和3000多个类别。实验表明，该方法在F2S和S2S任务上取得了最佳整体性能，显著优于现有方法。代码和数据集已发布。

深度解读

Abstract

Scene graph alignment establishes object correspondences between two 3D scene graphs constructed from partially overlapping observations. This enables efficient scene understanding and object-level relocalization when a robot revisits a place, as well as global map fusion across multiple agents. Such capabilities are essential for robots that require long-term memory for long-horizon tasks involving interactions with the environment. Existing approaches mainly focus on subscan-to-subscan (S2S) alignment and depend heavily on geometric point-cloud features, leaving frame-to-scan (F2S) alignment and open-set vision-language features underexplored. In addition, existing datasets for scene graph alignment remain small-scale with limited object diversity, constraining systematic training and evaluation. We present a unified and efficient scene graph alignment framework that predicts object correspondences by fusing vision-language, textual, and geometric features with spatial context. The framework comprises modules such as a distance-gated spatial attention encoder, a minimum-cost-flow-based allocator, and a global scene embedding generator to achieve accurate alignment even under large coordinate discrepancies. We further introduce ScanNet-SG, a large-scale dataset generated via an automated annotation pipeline with over 700k samples, covering 509 object categories from ScanNet labels and over 3k categories from GPT-4o-based tagging. Experiments show that our method achieves the best overall performance on both F2S and S2S tasks, substantially outperforming existing scene graph alignment methods. Our code and dataset are released at: https://autonomousrobots.nl/paper_websites/opensga.

item.title: Multi-layer attentive probing improves transfer of audio representations for bioacoustics
item.author: Marius Miron, David Robinson, Masato Hagiwara, Titouan Parcollet, Jules Cauzinille, Gagan Narula, Milad Alizadeh, Ellen Gilsenan-McMahon, Sara Keen, Emmanuel Chemla, Benjamin Hoffman, Maddie Cusimano, Diane Kim, Felix Effenberger, Jane K. Lawton, Aza Raskin, Olivier Pietquin, Matthieu Geist
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究系统研究了生物声学基准测试中的探测头策略，评估了不同探测方法对模型性能的影响。

背景: 现有的生物声学基准测试通常使用固定且低容量的探测头（如最终编码器层的线性层），这种标准化虽然便于模型比较，但可能因忽视编码器特征与探测头设计的交互作用而引入偏差。

目的: 系统研究两种生物声学基准测试（BEANs和BirdSet）中的不同探测策略，以评估探测头设计对模型评估结果的影响。

方法: 在BEANs和BirdSet两个基准测试上，评估了最后层探测和多层探测，以及线性探测和注意力探测。

主要发现: 利用时间信息的大型探测头具有更优越的性能；当前基准测试中仅依赖最后层探测设置可能无法准确反映编码器质量；多层探测提高了所有测试模型的下游任务性能；对于Transformer模型，注意力探测比线性探测具有更优越的性能。

结论: 探测头设计（特别是利用时间信息的大型探测头）对评估结果有重要影响，当前基准测试可能因使用固定的低容量探测头而低估了编码器的实际质量。

翻译: 探测头将机器学习模型从音频中学习的表示映射到下游任务标签，是评估表示学习的关键组件。大多数生物声学基准测试使用固定、低容量的探测头，例如最终编码器层上的线性层。虽然这种标准化使得模型比较成为可能，但它可能通过忽视编码器特征与探测头设计之间的相互作用来使结果产生偏差。在这项工作中，我们在两个生物声学基准测试BEANs和BirdSet上系统地研究了不同的探测策略。我们评估了最后层探测和多层探测，以及线性探测和注意力探测。我们表明，利用时间信息的大型探测头具有更优越的性能。我们的结果表明，当依赖最后层探测设置时，当前基准测试可能会错误地表示编码器质量。多层探测提高了所有测试模型的下游任务性能，而注意力探测对于Transformer模型比线性探测具有更优越的性能。

Abstract

Probing heads map the representations learned from audio by a machine learning model to downstream task labels and are a key component in evaluating representation learning. Most bioacoustic benchmarks use a fixed, low-capacity probe, such as a linear layer on the final encoder layer. While this standardization enables model comparisons, it may bias results by overlooking the interaction between encoder features and probe design. In this work, we systematically study different probing strategies across two bioacoustic benchmarks, BEANs and BirdSet. We evaluate last- and multi-layer probing, across linear and attention probes. We show that larger probe heads that leverage time information have superior performance. Our results suggest that current benchmarks may misrepresent encoder quality when relying on a last-layer probing setup. Multi-layer probing improves downstream task performance across all tested models, while attention probing has superior performance to linear probing for transformer models.

item.title: GridProbe: Posterior-Probing for Adaptive Test-Time Compute in Long-Video VLMs
item.author: Mohamed Eltahir, Lama Ayash, Ali Habibullah, Tanveer Hussain, Naeemullah Khan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为GridProbe的高效训练后探测推理范式，通过在答案空间对证据进行评分，自适应选择问题相关帧，从而降低二次注意力成本并保持高准确率。

背景: 长视频理解在视觉语言模型中受限于数千帧的单次前向传播和二次注意力成本。现有的缓解方法通常在训练前选择少量信息帧，但受限于对比预训练信号，在处理推理密集型查询时表现不佳。

目的: 提出GridProbe，旨在通过自适应帧选择实现次二次注意力成本，且几乎不损失准确率。

方法: 将帧排列在K×K网格上，运行轻量级的行和列探测，通过外积生成可解释的重要性图，利用其偏度和峰度驱动形状自适应选择，用每个问题的有效帧预算M_eff替换固定的帧预算M。

主要发现: M_eff能追踪问题的内在难度而不需要看到答案；在Video-MME-v2上，GridProbe在减少3.36倍TFLOPs的情况下与基线平均准确率相差仅1.6个百分点；在LongVideoBench上，GridProbe在减少0.35倍计算量的情况下优于基线；将小型选择器与更强的QA模型配对可严格优于2B基线模型。

结论: GridProbe实现了测试时自适应计算，选择器和QA模型可解耦，且重要性图的可解释性为行为诊断、落地和帧选择蒸馏开辟了未来途径。

翻译: Long-video understanding in VLMs is bottlenecked by a single monolithic forward pass over thousands of frames at quadratic attention cost. A common mitigation is to first select a small subset of informative frames before the forward pass; common for training-free selectors via auxiliary encoder-space similarities. Such signals are capped by contrastive pretraining, which usually fails on reasoning-heavy queries (negation, cross-frame counting, holistic summarization). We propose GridProbe, an efficient training-free posterior-probing inference paradigm that scores evidence in answer space using a frozen VLM's own reasoning and then selects question-relevant frames adaptively, resulting in sub-quadratic attention cost with little to no accuracy loss. We arrange frames on a K×K grid and run lightweight row R and column C probes, where each probe reads its peak posterior as a query-conditioned confidence. The outer product of R and C yields an interpretable importance map whose skewness and kurtosis drive Shape-Adaptive Selection, a closed-form rule that reliably replaces the fixed frame budget M with a per-question M_eff. We show empirically that M_eff tracks intrinsic question difficulty without ever seeing the answer, a sign of test-time adaptive compute. On Video-MME-v2, GridProbe matches the monolithic baseline within 1.6 pp Avg Acc at 3.36× TFLOPs reduction, while on LongVideoBench it Pareto-dominates the baseline (+0.9 pp at 0.35× compute). Because the selector and QA models can be decoupled, pairing a small 2B selector with a stronger 4B or 8B QA is strictly Pareto-dominant over the 2B monolithic baseline (up to +4.0 pp at 0.52× compute, on average), with no retraining. Finally, the interpretability of the importance maps opens future avenues for behavioral diagnostics, grounding, and frame-selection distillation.

Abstract

Long-video understanding in VLMs is bottlenecked by a single monolithic forward pass over thousands of frames at quadratic attention cost. A common mitigation is to first select a small subset of informative frames before the forward pass; common for training-free selectors via auxiliary encoder-space similarities. Such signals are capped by contrastive pretraining, which usually fails on reasoning-heavy queries (negation, cross-frame counting, holistic summarization). We propose GridProbe, an efficient training-free posterior-probing inference paradigm that scores evidence in answer space using a frozen VLM's own reasoning and then selects question-relevant frames adaptively, resulting in sub-quadratic attention cost with little to no accuracy loss. We arrange frames on a $K{\times}K$ grid and run lightweight row R and column C probes, where each probe reads its peak posterior as a query-conditioned confidence. The outer product of R and C yields an interpretable importance map whose skewness and kurtosis drive Shape-Adaptive Selection, a closed-form rule that reliably replaces the fixed frame budget $M$ with a per-question $M_{\mathrm{eff}}$. We show empirically that $M_{\mathrm{eff}}$ tracks intrinsic question difficulty without ever seeing the answer, a sign of test-time adaptive compute. On Video-MME-v2, GridProbe matches the monolithic baseline within $1.6$ pp Avg Acc at $3.36\times$ TFLOPs reduction, while on LongVideoBench it Pareto-dominates the baseline ($+0.9$ pp at $0.35\times$ compute). Because the selector and QA models can be decoupled, pairing a small 2B selector with a stronger 4B or 8B QA is strictly Pareto-dominant over the 2B monolithic baseline (up to $+4.0$ pp at $0.52\times$ compute, on average), with no retraining. Finally, the interpretability of the importance maps opens future avenues for behavioral diagnostics, grounding, and frame-selection distillation.

item.title: Beyond the Last Layer: Multi-Layer Representation Fusion for Visual Tokenization
item.author: Zhu, Xuanyu, Bai, Yan, Shi, Yang, Lou, Yihang, Zhang, Yuanxing, Jin, Jing, Zhou, Yuan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DRoRAE是一种轻量级融合模块，通过自适应聚合所有编码器层来恢复丢失的视觉细节，从而提升图像重建和生成质量。

背景: 现有的基于冻结预训练视觉编码器的表示自编码器通常仅从最后一层提取特征，忽略了中间层分布的丰富层次信息。

目的: 提出DRoRAE以显式融合多层特征，从而恢复被多层语义抽象衰减的低级视觉细节。

方法: DRoRAE采用能量约束路由和增量校正来自适应聚合所有编码器层，并使用三阶段解耦训练策略。

主要发现: DRoRAE在ImageNet-256上显著降低了重建和生成FID分数，揭示了融合容量与重建质量之间的对数线性缩放定律，并将表示丰富性识别为视觉分词器的新维度。

结论: 显式融合多层特征能显著恢复丢失信息，且表示丰富性是一个可预测的缩放维度。

翻译: DRoRAE是一种轻量级融合模块，通过能量约束路由和增量校正自适应聚合所有编码器层，生成与冻结预训练解码器兼容的丰富潜在表示。该方法采用三阶段解耦训练策略：首先在冻结解码器的隐式分布约束下学习融合，然后微调解码器以充分利用丰富表示。在ImageNet-256上，DRoRAE将重建rFID从0.57降至0.29，生成FID从1.74提升至1.65（配合AutoGuidance），且收益也迁移到了文本到图像合成中。此外，研究揭示了融合容量与重建质量之间的对数线性缩放定律（R²=0.86），并将表示丰富性识别为视觉分词器的一个新维度，类似于NLP中的词汇量大小。

深度解读

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Representation autoencoders that reuse frozen pretrained vision encoders as visual tokenizers have achieved strong reconstruction and generation quality. However, existing methods universally extract features from only the last encoder layer, discarding the rich hierarchical information distributed across intermediate layers. We show that low-level visual details survive in the last layer merely as attenuated residuals after multiple layers of semantic abstraction, and that explicitly fusing multi-layer features can substantially recover this lost information. We propose DRoRAE (Depth-Routed Representation AutoEncoder), a lightweight fusion module that adaptively aggregates all encoder layers via energy-constrained routing and incremental correction, producing an enriched latent compatible with a frozen pretrained decoder. A three-phase decoupled training strategy first learns the fusion under the implicit distributional constraint of the frozen decoder, then fine-tunes the decoder to fully exploit the enriched representation. On ImageNet-256, DRoRAE reduces rFID from 0.57 to 0.29 and improves generation FID from 1.74 to 1.65 (with AutoGuidance), with gains also transferring to text-to-image synthesis. Furthermore, we uncover a log-linear scaling law ($R^2{=}0.86$) between fusion capacity and reconstruction quality, identifying \textit{representation richness} as a new, predictably scalable dimension for visual tokenizers analogous to vocabulary size in NLP.

item.title: Rapid Forest Fuel Load Estimation via Virtual Remote Sensing and Metric-Scale Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
item.author: Quanyun Wu, Kyle Gao, Wentao Sun, Zhengsen Xu, Hudson Sun, Linlin Xu, Yuhao Chen, David A. Clausi, Jonathan Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种利用虚拟遥感数据快速进行森林调查的新颖自动化流程，通过低空轨道影像和相机位姿生成，结合Pi-Long模型和度量恢复模块，最终实现近实时森林生物量估算。

背景: 传统的森林覆盖率和可燃生物量估算方法依赖机载激光雷达或实地调查，成本高昂且耗时，而卫星图像缺乏垂直分辨率，难以进行冠层体积分析。

目的: 开发一种利用虚拟遥感数据快速进行森林调查的自动化流程，以提供一种可扩展、低成本且高效的替代物理扫描的方案。

方法: 首先生成目标区域的低空轨道影像和相机位姿；利用Pi-Long模型进行密集3D重建；引入度量恢复模块，通过Sim(3) Umeyama优化将重建轨迹与Google Earth Studio地面真值位姿对齐；将度量尺度点云正交投影到鸟瞰图高度和密度图；最后采用基于分水岭的分割算法结合高度方差分析来分类树种、计算叶面积指数并估算总燃料负荷。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，该流程提供了可扩展、低成本且高效的替代物理扫描的方案，能够实现具有高几何一致性的森林生物量近实时估算。

结论: 该管道为物理扫描提供了可扩展、成本效益高的替代方案，能够实现具有高几何一致性的森林生物量近实时估算。

翻译: Accurate quantification of forest coverage and combustible biomass (fuel load) is critical for wildfire risk assessment and ecosystem management. However, traditional methods relying on airborne LiDAR or field surveys are cost-prohibitive and time-intensive, while satellite imagery often lacks the vertical resolution required for canopy volume analysis. This paper proposes a novel, automated pipeline for rapid forest inventory using virtual remote sensing data derived from Google Earth Studio (GES). Our approach first generates low-altitude orbital imagery and camera poses for a target region. For dense 3D reconstruction, we employ Pi-Long, developed within the VGGT-Long framework. This model serves as a scalable extension of the Pi-3 feed-forward Transformer architecture. To address the inherent scale ambiguity in monocular reconstruction, we introduce a metric recovery module that aligns the reconstructed trajectory with GES ground truth poses via Sim(3) Umeyama optimization. The metric-scale point cloud is then orthogonally projected into Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) height and density maps. Finally, we employ a watershed-based segmentation algorithm combined with height variance analysis to classify tree species (conifer vs. broadleaf), calculate Leaf Area Index (LAI), and estimate total fuel load. Experimental results demonstrate that this pipeline offers a scalable, cost-effective alternative to physical scanning, enabling near-real-time estimation of forest biomass with high geometric consistency.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决森林燃料负荷的快速估算问题。森林燃料负荷是评估森林火灾风险的关键指标，准确估算对于火灾预防和救援至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Accurate quantification of forest coverage and combustible biomass (fuel load) is critical for wildfire risk assessment and ecosystem management. However, traditional methods relying on airborne LiDAR or field surveys are cost-prohibitive and time-intensive, while satellite imagery often lacks the vertical resolution required for canopy volume analysis. This paper proposes a novel, automated pipeline for rapid forest inventory using virtual remote sensing data derived from Google Earth Studio (GES). Our approach first generates low-altitude orbital imagery and camera poses for a target region. For dense 3D reconstruction, we employ Pi-Long, developed within the VGGT-Long framework. This model serves as a scalable extension of the Pi-3 feed-forward Transformer architecture. To address the inherent scale ambiguity in monocular reconstruction, we introduce a metric recovery module that aligns the reconstructed trajectory with GES ground truth poses via Sim(3) Umeyama optimization. The metric-scale point cloud is then orthogonally projected into Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) height and density maps. Finally, we employ a watershed-based segmentation algorithm combined with height variance analysis to classify tree species (conifer vs. broadleaf), calculate Leaf Area Index (LAI), and estimate total fuel load. Experimental results demonstrate that this pipeline offers a scalable, cost-effective alternative to physical scanning, enabling near-real-time estimation of forest biomass with high geometric consistency.

item.title: Elucidating Representation Degradation Problem in Diffusion Model Training
item.author: Zhipeng Yao, Dazhou Li, Zitong Zhang, Durude Mahee, Fan Zhu, Wenbin Zhang, Xinwei He, Yeying Jin, Rui Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Elucidated Representation Diffusion (ERD) 的框架，旨在解决扩散模型训练效率低下的问题。该方法通过动态重新分配优化努力来稳定表示学习，从而加速收敛并提升生成质量。

背景: 扩散模型虽然取得了显著成功，但其训练过程因严重的优化瓶颈而变得低效。随着噪声水平的增加，训练模型的输出会出现渐进的结构性扭曲，这会 destabilize 训练并损害生成质量。

目的: 为了解决扩散模型训练中因表示退化导致的优化瓶颈问题，提出 Elucidated Representation Diffusion (ERD) 框架。

方法: 提出 Elucidated Representation Diffusion (ERD)，这是一个即插即用的框架，能够根据有效的可恢复性动态重新分配优化努力。

主要发现: 分析表明，这种不稳定性是由不匹配的目标可恢复性驱动的，这与神经切线核 (NTK) 谱减弱和有效低秩行为有关。

结论: ERD 通过在不使用外部监督的情况下稳定表示学习，加速了收敛，并在扩散模型骨干网络中实现了强大的实证性能。

翻译: 扩散模型已经取得了显著的成功，但由于严重的优化瓶颈，其训练仍然效率低下，我们称之为表示退化。随着噪声水平的增加，训练模型的输出表现出渐进的结构性扭曲，这会 destabilize 训练并损害生成质量。我们的分析表明，这种不稳定性是由不匹配的目标可恢复性驱动的，这与神经切线核 (NTK) 谱减弱和有效低秩行为有关。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Elucidated Representation Diffusion (ERD)，这是一个即插即用的框架，能够根据有效的可恢复性动态重新分配优化努力。通过在不使用外部监督的情况下稳定表示学习，ERD 加速了收敛，并在扩散模型骨干网络中实现了强大的实证性能。

Abstract

Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success, yet their training remains inefficient due to a severe optimization bottleneck, which we term Representation Degradation. As noise levels increase, the outputs of the trained model exhibit progressive structural distortion, which can destabilize training and impair generation quality. Our analysis suggests that this instability is driven by mismatched target recoverability, which is associated with Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) spectral weakening and effective low-rank behavior. To address this, we propose Elucidated Representation Diffusion (ERD), a plug-and-play framework that dynamically reallocates optimization effort according to effective recoverability. By stabilizing representation learning without external supervision, ERD accelerates convergence and achieves strong empirical performance across diffusion backbones.

item.title: Benchmarking Sensor-Fault Robustness in Forecasting
item.author: Alexander Windmann, Philipp Wittenberg, Gianluca Manca, Marcel Dix, Jens U. Brandt, Oliver Niggemann
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了SensorFault-Bench，这是一个用于评估预测架构和鲁棒性改进方法的共享CPS接地传感器故障压力测试协议，以及一个组织方法比较的操作分类法。

背景: 现有的CPS预测模型依赖于存在噪声、偏差、缺失或时间错位的传感器流数据，但标准预测评估往往仅根据名义误差选择模型，未显示它们在这些故障下是否保持鲁棒性。

目的: 引入SensorFault-Bench协议和操作分类法，以评估预测架构和鲁棒性改进方法，并分离相对鲁棒性与绝对误差。

方法: 在四个真实世界数据集和八个由标准化严重性模型控制的评分场景中，报告最坏场景降级、清洁MSE和最坏场景故障时间MSE。使用不连续的故障转移分割，使显式故障训练方法在相邻故障家族上训练，而评估使用单独的基准场景。

主要发现: 清洁MSE排名与最坏场景故障时间误差排名可能不一致。Chronos-2在清洁MSE上与最后值朴素预测器匹配或落后，但在ETTh1和Traffic上具有最大的最坏场景降级。鲁棒性改进方法在选择性降级减少方面表现不同：投影梯度下降对抗训练和随机训练在值故障主导观察到的降级时领先，而故障增强在可用性故障主导时领先。

结论: SensorFault-Bench提供了开源代码、记录的数据访问指南以及重现和扩展指南，以便在相同的CPS传感器故障鲁棒性协议下评估新数据集、架构和鲁棒性改进方法。

翻译: 摘要：现有的CPS预测模型依赖于存在噪声、偏差、缺失或时间错位的传感器流数据，但标准预测评估往往仅根据名义误差选择模型，未显示它们在这些故障下是否保持鲁棒性。本文介绍了SensorFault-Bench，这是一个用于评估预测架构和鲁棒性改进方法的共享CPS接地传感器故障压力测试协议，以及一个组织方法比较的操作分类法。在四个真实世界数据集和八个由标准化严重性模型控制的评分场景中，它报告了最坏场景降级、清洁MSE和最坏场景故障时间MSE，将相对鲁棒性与绝对误差分开。不连续的故障转移分割允许显式故障训练方法在相邻故障家族上训练，而评估使用单独的基准场景。经验上，清洁MSE排名与最坏场景故障时间误差排名可能不一致。Chronos-2，评估的零样本基础模型代表，在两个单目标数据集上的清洁MSE上与最后值朴素预测器匹配或落后，并且在ETTh1和Traffic上具有最大的最坏场景降级，其中所有通道都是预测目标。对于评估的鲁棒性改进方法集，成对差值显示选择性降级减少：投影梯度下降对抗训练和随机训练在值故障主导观察到的降级时领先，而故障增强在可用性故障主导时领先。SensorFault-Bench提供了开源代码、记录的数据访问指南以及重现和扩展指南，以便在相同的CPS传感器故障鲁棒性协议下评估新数据集、架构和鲁棒性改进方法。

Abstract

Cyber-physical system (CPS) forecasting models depend on sensor streams with noisy, biased, missing, or temporally misaligned readings, yet standard forecasting evaluation often selects models by nominal error without showing whether they remain robust under such faults. We introduce SensorFault-Bench, a shared CPS-grounded sensor-fault stress-test protocol for evaluating forecasting architectures and robustness-improvement methods, and an operational taxonomy organizing the method comparison. Across four real-world datasets and eight scored scenarios governed by a standardized severity model, it reports worst-scenario degradation, clean mean squared error (MSE), and worst-scenario fault-time MSE, separating relative robustness from absolute error. A disjoint fault-transfer split lets explicit fault-training methods train on adjacent fault families while evaluation uses separate benchmark scenarios. Empirically, forecasting architectures favored by clean MSE can degrade sharply under faults, and clean-MSE rankings can disagree with worst-scenario fault-time error rankings. Chronos-2, the evaluated zero-shot foundation-model representative, matches or trails the last-value naive forecaster in clean MSE on the two single-target datasets and has the largest worst-scenario degradation on ETTh1 and Traffic, where all channels are forecast targets. For the evaluated robustness-improvement method set, paired deltas show selective degradation reductions: projected gradient descent adversarial training and randomized training lead where value faults dominate observed degradation, while fault augmentation leads where availability faults dominate. SensorFault-Bench provides open-source code, documented data access, and reproduction and extension guides, so new datasets, architectures, and robustness-improvement methods can be evaluated under the same CPS sensor-fault robustness protocol.

item.title: V4FinBench: Benchmarking Tabular Foundation Models, LLMs, and Standard Methods on Corporate Bankruptcy Prediction
item.author: Marcin Kostrzewa, Sebastian Tomczak, Roman Furman, Anna Poberezhna, Michał Furgała, Oleksii Furman, Maciej Zięba
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究介绍了V4FinBench基准数据集，包含超过一百万条公司年度记录，用于评估破产预测方法。

背景: 破产预测是一个高风险的金融任务，具有严重的类别不平衡和多时间跨度预测需求。公开数据集稀缺且规模较小，免费基准数据集包含6000到80000个公司年度观测值，而更大的资源则位于订阅付费墙后。

目的: 为了填补这一差距，研究引入了V4FinBench基准数据集，旨在支持在现实类别不平衡条件下评估表格和基础模型方法。

方法: V4FinBench包含来自维谢格拉德集团（V4）经济体（2006-2021年）超过一百万条公司年度记录，具有131个财务和非财务特征、六个预测时间跨度以及一个综合困境标准。研究提供了标准表格基线、微调TabPFN和QLoRA微调Llama-3-8B的参考评估。

主要发现: 在不平衡感知微调下，TabPFN在较长时间跨度上在F1分数和ROC-AUC上匹配或超过了梯度提升。相比之下，Llama-3-8B在所有时间跨度上的ROC-AUC上落后于梯度提升，并且在F1分数上通常较弱，差距在即时时间跨度之外急剧扩大。在美国家庭破产数据集的外部评估中，V4FinBench微调的TabPFN检查点优于原始TabPFN。

结论: V4FinBench已公开发布，以支持在现实金融数据上进一步评估和开发预测方法。

翻译: 企业破产预测是一项高风险的金融任务，具有严重的类别不平衡和多时间跨度预测需求。支持它的公开数据集仍然稀缺且规模较小：广泛使用的免费基准包含6000到80000个公司年度观测值，而更大的资源则位于订阅付费墙后。为了解决这一差距，我们介绍了V4FinBench，这是一个包含来自维谢格拉德集团（V4）经济体（2006-2021年）超过一百万条公司年度记录的基准，具有131个财务和非财务特征、六个预测时间跨度以及一个综合困境标准，该标准联合捕捉偿付能力、盈利能力和流动性恶化。V4FinBench旨在支持在现实类别不平衡条件下评估表格和基础模型方法，正样本率在0.19%到0.36%之间。我们提供了标准表格基线、微调TabPFN和QLoRA微调Llama-3-8B的参考评估。在不平衡感知微调下，TabPFN在较长时间跨度上在F1分数和ROC-AUC上匹配或超过了梯度提升。相比之下，Llama-3-8B在所有时间跨度上的ROC-AUC上落后于梯度提升，并且在F1分数上通常较弱，差距在即时时间跨度之外急剧扩大。在美国家庭破产数据集的外部评估中，V4FinBench微调的TabPFN检查点优于原始TabPFN，表明适应捕捉了可转移的财务困境结构，而不仅仅是V4特定的模式。V4FinBench已公开发布，以支持在现实金融数据上进一步评估和开发预测方法。

Abstract

Corporate bankruptcy prediction is a high-stakes financial task characterized by severe class imbalance and multi-horizon forecasting demands. Public datasets supporting it remain scarce and small: widely used free benchmarks contain between 6,000 and 80,000 company-year observations, while larger resources are behind subscription paywalls. To address this gap, we introduce V4FinBench, a benchmark of over one million company-year records from the Visegràd Group (V4) economies (2006-2021), with 131 financial and non-financial features, six prediction horizons, and a composite distress criterion jointly capturing solvency, profitability, and liquidity deterioration. V4FinBench is designed to support the evaluation of tabular and foundation-model methods under realistic class imbalance, with positive rates between 0.19% and 0.36%. We provide reference evaluations of standard tabular baselines, finetuned TabPFN, and QLoRA-finetuned Llama-3-8B. With imbalance-aware finetuning, TabPFN matches or exceeds gradient boosting at longer time horizons on both $F_1$-score and ROC-AUC. In contrast, Llama-3-8B trails gradient boosting on ROC-AUC at every horizon and is generally weaker on $F_1$-score, with the gap widening sharply beyond the immediate horizon. In an external evaluation on the American Bankruptcy Dataset, the V4FinBench-finetuned TabPFN checkpoint improves over vanilla TabPFN, suggesting that adaptation captures transferable financial-distress structure rather than only V4-specific patterns. V4FinBench is publicly released to support further evaluation and development of prediction methods on realistic financial data.

item.title: RubricEM: Meta-RL with Rubric-guided Policy Decomposition beyond Verifiable Rewards
item.author: Li, Gaotang, Mishra, Bhavana Dalvi, Wang, Zifeng, Yan, Jun, Chen, Yanfei, Li, Chun-Liang, Le, Long T., Han, Rujun, Lee, George, Tong, Hanghang, Lee, Chen-Yu, Pfister, Tomas
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为RubricEM的框架，旨在通过基于标准的研究轨迹训练深度研究代理，解决缺乏可验证奖励的问题。

背景: 训练深度研究代理（能够规划、搜索、评估证据和综合长篇报告的系统）将强化学习推向了可验证奖励之外的领域。这些代理的输出缺乏真实答案，轨迹跨越许多工具增强的决策，标准后训练缺乏将过去的尝试转化为可重用经验的机制。

目的: 本文认为标准评分不应仅作为最终答案的评估器，而应作为构建策略执行、法官反馈和代理记忆的共享接口。

方法: RubricEM是一种基于标准引导的强化学习框架，结合了分阶段策略分解和基于反思的元策略进化。它首先通过将规划、证据收集、审查和综合基于自生成的标准进行条件化，使研究轨迹具有阶段感知性。然后，它使用分阶段标准判断来提供密集的语义反馈，以进行长期优化。同时，它训练一个共享骨干反思元策略，将判断的轨迹蒸馏成可重用的基于标准的指导。

主要发现: RubricEM-8B在四个长篇研究基准测试中表现出强劲性能，优于可比的开放模型，并接近专有的深度研究系统。

结论: 通过彻底的分析，我们理解了RubricEM的关键成分。

翻译: 训练深度研究代理，即能够规划、搜索、评估证据和综合长篇报告的系统，将强化学习推向了可验证奖励之外的领域。它们的输出缺乏真实答案，轨迹跨越许多工具增强的决策，标准后训练缺乏将过去的尝试转化为可重用经验的机制。在这项工作中，我们认为标准不应仅作为最终答案的评估器，而应作为构建策略执行、法官反馈和代理记忆的共享接口。基于这种观点，我们介绍了RubricEM，一种基于标准引导的强化学习框架，结合了分阶段策略分解和基于反思的元策略进化。RubricEM首先通过将规划、证据收集、审查和综合基于自生成的标准进行条件化，使研究轨迹具有阶段感知性。然后，它使用分阶段标准判断来提供密集的语义反馈，以进行长期优化。同时，RubricEM训练一个共享骨干反思元策略，将判断的轨迹蒸馏成可重用的基于标准的指导。由此产生的RubricEM-8B在四个长篇研究基准测试中表现出强劲性能，优于可比的开放模型，并接近专有的深度研究系统。除了最终性能外，我们还进行了彻底的分析，以理解RubricEM的关键成分。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 1. **分析请求：** * **角色：** 严谨的学术论文助手。 * **输入：** 一段 PDF 元数据/内容片段（标题：《RubricEM: Meta-RL with Rubric-guided Policy Decomposition beyond Verifiable Rewards》，作者列表，元数据）。 * **任务：** 回答一个问题：“这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？” * **约束条件：** * 基于输入文本（不要编造）。 * 简洁、准确、通俗的中文。 * 避免使用公式、符号或缩写。 * 如果文中没有明确说明，请写 "unknown"。 * 回答尽量简短（2-4 句）。 * **仅**输出纯文本（不要 JSON、markdown、代码块、额外解释）。2. **分析输入文本：** * **标题：** "RubricEM: Meta-RL with Rubric-guided Policy Decomposition beyond Verifiable Rewards" * **关键词：** Meta-RL（元强化学习），Rubric-guided（评分指南引导的），Policy Decomposition（策略分解），Beyond Verifiable Rewards（超越可验证奖励）。 * **元数据：** 作者列表，DOI，arXiv ID。 * **内容：** PDF 结构（页码、链接、流数据）。*关键在于*，提供的文本是 PDF 的二进制/结构化表示，而不是论文的实际文本内容（摘要、引言、正文）。它包含链接到引用（例如，cite.google2025gemini, cite.openai2025deepresearch），但除了标题和作者外，没有提供关于*问题*或*重要性*的实质性文本。3. **评估约束条件与输入：** * 约束条件：“必须基于输入文本回答”。 * 输入：仅包含标题、作者和元数据。 * 问题：“这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？” * 分析：标题暗示了“元强化学习”和“评分指南引导的分解”，但*没有*提供关于*问题*或*重要性*的具体细节（例如，“现有方法在 X 上失效，因为 Y”）。 * 然而，通常在这些提示中，如果用户提供了标题，他们期望我根据标题推断，或者如果文本缺失，则说明文本缺失。提示明确指出：“如果文中没有明确说明，请写 'unknown'”。 * *自我修正/细化：* Abstract

Training deep research agents, namely systems that plan, search, evaluate evidence, and synthesize long-form reports, pushes reinforcement learning beyond the regime of verifiable rewards. Their outputs lack ground-truth answers, their trajectories span many tool-augmented decisions, and standard post-training offers little mechanism for turning past attempts into reusable experience. In this work, we argue that rubrics should serve not merely as final-answer evaluators, but as the shared interface that structures policy execution, judge feedback, and agent memory. Based on this view, we introduce RubricEM, a rubric-guided reinforcement learning framework that combines stagewise policy decomposition with reflection-based meta-policy evolution. RubricEM first makes research trajectories stage-aware by conditioning planning, evidence gathering, review, and synthesis on self-generated rubrics. It then assigns credit with Stage-Structured GRPO, which uses stagewise rubric judgments to provide denser semantic feedback for long-horizon optimization. In parallel, RubricEM trains a shared-backbone reflection meta-policy that distills judged trajectories into reusable rubric-grounded guidance for future attempts. The resulting RubricEM-8B achieves strong performance across four long-form research benchmarks, outperforming comparable open models and approaching proprietary deep-research systems. Beyond final performance, we perform thorough analyses to understand the key ingredients of RubricEM.

item.title: When and How to Canonize: A Generalization Perspective
item.author: Yonatan Sverdlov, Benjamin Friedman, Snir Hordan, Nadav Dym
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种理论框架，通过界定量化数来分析通过组平均或规范化实现不变性的方法的泛化误差。

背景: 虽然对称数据的处理通常使用不变架构，但人们越来越感兴趣通过应用组平均或规范化到非不变骨干网络来实现不变性，然而这些替代策略的理论泛化性质仍知之甚少。

目的: 引入一个理论框架来分析这些方法的泛化误差，通过界定量化数。

方法: 通过界定量化数来分析泛化误差，并建立严格的泛化层级。

主要发现: 规范模型的误差界最多等于结构不变和组平均模型的误差界，最少等于非不变基线的误差界；存在最优规范化和次优规范化；在点云处理中，字典排序的覆盖数随点云维度呈指数增长，而希尔伯特曲线规范化保证多项式增长。

结论: 希尔伯特曲线序列化在先进点云架构中的实证成功得到了第一个正式的理论证明；实验支持了理论主张。

翻译: 虽然不变架构是处理对称数据的标准，但通过应用组平均或规范化到非不变骨干网络来实现不变性正受到越来越多的关注。然而，这些替代策略的理论泛化性质仍知之甚少。我们引入了一个理论框架，通过界定量化数来分析这些方法的泛化误差。我们建立了一个严格的泛化层级：规范化模型的误差界最多等于结构不变和组平均模型的误差界，最少等于非不变基线的误差界。此外，我们表明存在最优规范化，其达到最优误差界，以及次优规范化，其达到非不变误差界，这取决于规范化的正则性。最后，将此框架应用于点云处理中的置换群，我们严格证明了字典排序的覆盖数随点云维度呈指数增长，而希尔伯特曲线规范化保证多项式增长。这为希尔伯特曲线序列化在先进点云架构中的实证成功提供了第一个正式的理论证明。我们以支持理论主张的实验结束。代码可在 https://github.com/yonatansverdlov/Canonization 获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要探讨在什么情况下以及如何对模型或数据进行规范化处理，以提升其泛化能力。这个问题在机器学习和人工智能研究中非常重要，因为规范化是提高模型性能、防止过拟合以及增强模型在未知数据上表现的关键技术。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

While invariant architectures are standard for processing symmetric data, there is growing interest in achieving invariance by applying group averaging or canonization to non-invariant backbones. However, the theoretical generalization properties of these alternative strategies remain poorly understood. We introduce a theoretical framework to analyze the generalization error of these methods by bounding their covering numbers. We establish a rigorous generalization hierarchy: the error bounds of canonized models are at best equal to the error bounds of structurally invariant and group-averaged models, and at worst equal to the bounds of non-invariant baselines. Furthermore, we show that there exist optimal canonizations which attain the optimal error bounds, and poor canonizations which attain the non-invariant error bounds, and that this depends on the regularity of the canonization. Finally, applying this framework to permutation groups in point cloud processing, we rigorously prove that the covering number of lexicographical sorting grows exponentially with point cloud dimension, whereas Hilbert curve canonization guarantees polynomial growth. This provides the first formal theoretical justification for the empirical success of Hilbert curve serialization in state-of-the-art point cloud architectures. We conclude with experiments that support our theoretical claims. Code is available at https://github.com/yonatansverdlov/Canonization

item.title: LoopUS: Recasting Pretrained LLMs into Looped Latent Refinement Models
item.author: Park, Taekhyun, Lee, Yongjae, Kim, Dohee, Bae, Hyerim
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Looped Depth Up-Scaling (LoopUS) 是一种后训练框架，旨在将标准预训练 LLM 转换为循环架构，通过四个核心组件实现推理导向性能的提升。

背景: 循环计算通过扩展测试时计算量显示出提高 LLM 推理导向性能的潜力。然而，现有方法通常需要从头训练循环模型或应用破坏性改造，这涉及大量计算成本并可能损害预训练能力。

目的: 为了解决这些局限性，引入了 Looped Depth Up-Scaling (LoopUS)，这是一种后训练框架，旨在将标准预训练 LLM 转换为循环架构。

方法: LoopUS 将预训练 LLM 重铸为编码器、循环推理块和解码器。它通过四个核心组件实现这一潜在细化架构：(1) 分解，由分阶段表示动力学引导；(2) 输入依赖的选择性门，以减轻隐藏状态漂移；(3) 随机深度监督，用于在长递归时间范围内进行高效学习；(4) 置信度头，用于自适应早期退出。

主要发现: 这些机制将标准非循环模型转换为循环形式，同时稳定其免受计算瓶颈和表示崩溃的影响。通过稳定的潜在循环，LoopUS 在不延长生成轨迹或从头训练循环的情况下提高了推理导向性能。

结论: LoopUS 实现了推理导向性能的提升，无需从头训练循环模型或延长生成轨迹。

翻译: Looped computation shows promise in improving the reasoning-oriented performance of LLMs by scaling test-time compute. However, existing approaches typically require either training recurrent models from scratch or applying disruptive retrofits, which involve substantial computational costs and may compromise pretrained capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce Looped Depth Up-Scaling (LoopUS), a post-training framework that converts a standard pretrained LLM into a looped architecture. As a key technical contribution, LoopUS recasts the pretrained LLM into an encoder, a looped reasoning block, and a decoder. It operationalizes this latent-refinement architecture through four core components: (1) block decomposition, guided by staged representation dynamics; (2) an input-dependent selective gate to mitigate hidden-state drift; (3) random deep supervision for memory-efficient learning over long recursive horizons; and (4) a confidence head for adaptive early exiting. Collectively, these mechanisms transform a standard non-looped model into a looped form while stabilizing it against both computational bottlenecks and representation collapse. Through stable latent looping, LoopUS improves reasoning-oriented performance without extending the generated traces or requiring recurrent training from scratch. For more details, see this https URL
