item.author: Juntong Wang, Haoyue Zhao, guanghui Pan, Xiyuan Wang, Yanbo Wang, Qiyan Deng, Muhan Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SAGE的自进化代理图记忆引擎，旨在解决语言代理长期记忆的瓶颈问题。

背景: 长期记忆是语言代理的中心瓶颈。现有的RAG和GraphRAG系统将记忆图视为静态检索中间件，限制了从部分线索恢复完整证据链、利用可重用图结构角色以及通过下游反馈改进记忆的能力。

目的: 引入SAGE系统，将图记忆建模为动态长期记忆基质，以解决现有系统的局限性。

方法: SAGE耦合了两个角色：一个从交互历史中增量构建结构化图记忆的内存写入器，以及一个基于图基础模型的内存读取器，用于执行检索并向写入器提供反馈。系统包含严格的理论分析支持。

主要发现: 在多跳问答、开放域检索、特定领域问答和长期代理记忆基准测试中，SAGE提高了证据恢复、答案锚定和检索效率。经过两次自进化轮次，在多跳问答中达到最佳平均排名；在零样本开放域迁移中，在NQ数据集上达到82.5/91.6的Recall@2和5。在LongMemEval和HaluMem上的结果表明，训练和读写器反馈改善了多种长期记忆和幻觉诊断指标。

结论: 自进化、结构感知的图记忆是构建稳健长期语言代理的有前景的基础。

翻译: 长期记忆正成为语言代理的中心瓶颈。现有的RAG和GraphRAG系统在很大程度上将记忆图视为静态检索中间件，这限制了它们从部分线索恢复完整证据链、利用可重用的图结构角色以及通过下游反馈改进记忆本身的能力。我们介绍了SAGE，一个自进化代理图记忆引擎，它将图记忆建模为动态长期记忆基质。SAGE耦合了两个角色：一个从交互历史中增量构建结构化图记忆的内存写入器，以及一个基于图基础模型的内存读取器，用于执行检索并向内存写入器提供反馈。我们提供了支持该框架的严格理论分析。在多跳问答、开放域检索、特定领域问答和长期代理记忆基准测试中，SAGE提高了证据恢复、答案锚定和检索效率：经过两次自进化轮次，它在多跳问答中实现了最佳平均排名；在零样本开放域迁移中，它在NQ上达到了82.5/91.6的Recall@2和5。在LongMemEval和HaluMem上的进一步结果表明，训练和读写器反馈改善了多种长期记忆和幻觉诊断指标，表明自进化、结构感知的图记忆是构建稳健长期语言代理的有前景的基础。

Abstract

Long-term memory is becoming a central bottleneck for language agents. Exsting RAG and GraphRAG systems largely treat memory graphs as static retrieval middleware, which limits their ability to recover complete evidence chains from partial cues, exploit reusable graph-structrual roles, and improve the memory itself through downstream feedback. We introduce SAGE, a Self-evolving Agentic Graph-memory Engine that models graph memory as a dynamic long-term memory substrate. SAGE couples two roles: a memory writer that incrementally constucts structured graph memory from interaction histories, and a Graph Foundation Model-based memory reader to perform retrieval and provide feedback to the memory writer. We provide rigorooous theoretical annalyses supporting the framework. Across multi-hop QA, open-domain retireval, domain-specific review QA, and long-term agent-memory benchmarks, SAGE improves evidence recovery, answer grounding, and retrieval efficiency: after two self-evolution rounds, it achieves the best average rank on multi-hop QA; in zero-shot open-domain transfer, it reaches 82.5/91.6 Recall@2/5 on NQ. Further results on LongMemEval and HaluMem show that traning and reader-writer feedback improve multiple long-term memory and hallucination-diagnostic metrics, suggesting that self-evolving, structure-aware graph memory is a promising foundation for robust long-horizon language agents.

item.title: BARISTA: A Multi-Task Egocentric Benchmark for Compositional Visual Understanding
item.author: Patrick Knab, Orgest Xhelili, Inis Buzi, Drago Andres Guggiana Nilo, Mohd Saquib Khan, Lorenz Kolb, Manuel Scherzer, Kerem Yildirir, Christian Bartelt, Philipp Johannes Schubert
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了BARISTA数据集和基准测试，用于评估咖啡制作过程中的视频理解能力。该数据集包含185个真实咖啡制作视频，提供了详细的场景图和零样本语言任务。实验表明不同任务家族之间存在显著差异，没有一种模型家族在所有任务上表现一致。

背景: 场景理解是通用物理智能的核心，视频是捕捉场景状态和时序动态的主要模态。然而，理解物理过程仍然困难，因为模型必须结合物体定位、手物交互、关系解析、时序推理和步骤级程序推理。现有基准通常单独评估这些能力，限制了诊断模型在程序任务上失败的原因。

目的: 为了解决现有基准单独评估能力的问题，作者引入了BARISTA，一个密集标注的以第一人称视角的数据集和基准测试。该数据集旨在提供对咖啡制作过程的全面理解，通过场景图和零样本语言任务来评估模型在多个方面的能力。

方法: 作者构建了BARISTA数据集，包含185个真实咖啡制作视频，涵盖全自动、手冲滤杯和胶囊式工作流程。数据集提供了逐帧场景图，链接了持久物体身份与掩码、轨迹、边界框、属性、类型关系、手物交互、活动和过程步骤。从这些场景图中，作者推导出了涵盖短语定位、手物交互识别、指代、活动识别、关系提取和时序视觉问答的零样本语言任务。

主要发现: 实验揭示了任务家族之间的强变化，没有一种模型家族在所有任务上表现一致。这表明BARISTA是一个具有挑战性的程序视频理解诊断基准。

结论: BARISTA数据集和基准测试为评估和理解咖啡制作过程中的视频理解能力提供了一个新的平台。通过提供详细的场景图和多样化的零样本任务，它有助于诊断模型在程序任务上失败的原因，并推动通用物理智能的发展。

Abstract

Scene understanding is central to general physical intelligence, and video is a primary modality for capturing both state and temporal dynamics of a scene. Yet understanding physical processes remains difficult, as models must combine object localization, hand-object interactions, relational parsing, temporal reasoning, and step-level procedural inference. Existing benchmarks usually evaluate these capabilities separately, limiting diagnosis of why models fail on procedural tasks. We introduce BARISTA, a densely annotated egocentric dataset and benchmark of 185 real-world coffee-preparation videos covering fully automatic, portafilter-based, and capsule-based workflows. BARISTA provides verified per-frame scene graphs linking persistent object identities to masks, tracks, boxes, attributes, typed relations, hand-object interactions, activities, and process steps. From these graphs, we derive zero-shot language-based tasks spanning phrase grounding, hand-object interaction recognition, referring, activity recognition, relation extraction, and temporal visual question answering. Experiments reveal strong variation across task families and no consistently dominant model family, positioning BARISTA as a challenging diagnostic benchmark for procedural video understanding. Code and dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ramblr/BARISTA.

item.title: World Action Models: The Next Frontier in Embodied AI
item.author: Siyin Wang, Junhao Shi, Zhaoyang Fu, Xinzhe He, Feihong Liu, Chenchen Yang, Yikang Zhou, Zhaoye Fei, Jingjing Gong, Jinlan Fu, Mike Zheng Shou, Xuanjing Huang, Xipeng Qiu, Yu-Gang Jiang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提供了世界行动模型（WAMs）的系统性综述，定义了该范式，并分析了其架构、数据生态及评估协议。

背景: 现有的 VLA 模型缺乏对物理世界演变的显式建模，且相关研究缺乏统一框架。

目的: 正式定义 WAMs，梳理其发展脉络，对现有方法进行分类，并分析数据生态。

方法: 将方法分为级联和联合 WAMs，分析了数据来源（遥操作、演示、仿真、视频）和评估协议。

主要发现: WAMs 统一了状态建模与动作生成；方法分为级联和联合架构；数据来源多样；评估侧重于视觉、物理常识和动作合理性。

结论: 首次系统阐述了 WAMs 的全景，明确了架构范式及其权衡，指出了未来挑战和机遇。

翻译: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型在具身策略学习中取得了强大的语义泛化能力，但它们学习的是反应式的观察到动作的映射，而没有显式建模物理世界在干预下的演变。越来越多的工作通过将世界模型（环境动力学的预测模型）集成到动作生成流程中来解决这一局限性。我们将这种新兴范式称为世界行动模型：统一预测状态建模与动作生成的具身基础模型，旨在针对未来状态和动作的联合分布而非仅针对动作。然而，现有文献在架构、学习目标和应用场景上仍显碎片化，缺乏统一的概念框架。我们正式定义了 WAMs 并将其与相关概念区分开来，追溯了导致这一范式产生的 VLA 和世界模型研究的基础。我们将现有方法组织成级联和联合 WAMs 的结构化分类法，并进一步按生成模态、条件机制和动作解码策略进行细分。我们系统分析了推动 WAMs 发展的数据生态系统，涵盖了机器人遥操作、便携式人类演示、仿真和互联网规模的自我中心视频，并综合了围绕视觉保真度、物理常识和动作合理性组织的新兴评估协议。总的来说，这篇综述提供了对 WAMs 领域的第一个系统性描述，阐明了关键架构范式及其权衡，并确定了这一快速发展的领域的开放挑战和未来机遇。

Abstract

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved strong semantic generalization for embodied policy learning, yet they learn reactive observation-to-action mappings without explicitly modeling how the physical world evolves under intervention. A growing body of work addresses this limitation by integrating world models, predictive models of environment dynamics, into the action generation pipeline. We term this emerging paradigm World Action Models (WAMs): embodied foundation models that unify predictive state modeling with action generation, targeting a joint distribution over future states and actions rather than actions alone. However, the literature remains fragmented across architectures, learning objectives, and application scenarios, lacking a unified conceptual framework. We formally define WAMs and disambiguate them from related concepts, and trace the foundations and early integration of VLA and world model research that gave rise to this paradigm. We organize existing methods into a structured taxonomy of Cascaded and Joint WAMs, with further subdivision by generation modality, conditioning mechanism, and action decoding strategy. We systematically analyze the data ecosystem fueling WAMs development, spanning robot teleoperation, portable human demonstrations, simulation, and internet-scale egocentric video, and synthesize emerging evaluation protocols organized around visual fidelity, physical commonsense, and action plausibility. Overall, this survey provides the first systematic account of the WAMs landscape, clarifies key architectural paradigms and their trade-offs, and identifies open challenges and future opportunities for this rapidly evolving field.

item.title: Sign Language Recognition and Translation for Low-Resource Languages: Challenges and Pathways Forward
item.author: Nigar Alishzade, Gulchin Abdullayeva
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文综述了低资源手语识别与翻译的研究现状，并以阿塞拜疆手语为案例，提出了从架构中心到数据中心的范式转变，并制定了技术路线图。

背景: 全球有超过300种手语，但由于文档有限、数据稀疏和计算工具不足，这些低资源手语面临严重挑战。

目的: 通过系统综述文献，提取可操作的教训，并针对阿塞拜疆手语提出技术路线图，以推动低资源手语的研究与应用。

方法: 以阿塞拜疆手语为案例研究，分析全球倡议，提取八条可操作的教训，并制定技术路线图，包括使用轻量级架构、社区验证的注释和离线优先部署。

主要发现: 从架构中心到数据中心的AI范式转变、从独立于手语者到适应手语者的系统转变、从基于参考到基于任务的评估指标转变；以及社区共同设计、方言多样性捕捉和隐私保护姿态表示等可操作教训。

结论: 需要持续以聋人社区为中心的跨学科合作，以确保文化真实性、伦理治理和实际交流效益。

翻译: 本文综述了低资源手语识别与翻译的文献，以阿塞拜疆手语为案例，提取了八条可操作的教训，包括社区共同设计、方言多样性捕捉和隐私保护姿态表示。特别关注突厥语系手语，因为语言邻近性使得迁移学习有效。提出了三个范式转变：从架构中心到数据中心的AI、从独立于手语者到适应手语者的系统、从基于参考到基于任务的评估指标。制定了阿塞拜疆手语的技术路线图，利用轻量级架构、社区验证的注释和离线优先部署。进展需要持续以聋人社区为中心的跨学科合作，以确保文化真实性、伦理治理和实际交流效益。

Abstract

Sign languages are natural, visual-gestural languages used by Deaf communities worldwide. Over 300 distinct sign languages remain severely low-resource due to limited documentation, sparse datasets, and insufficient computational tools. This systematic review synthesizes literature on sign language recognition and translation for under-resourced languages, using Azerbaijan Sign Language (AzSL) as a case study. Analysis of global initiatives extracts eight actionable lessons, including community co-design, dialectal diversity capture, and privacy-preserving pose-based representations. Turkic sign languages (Kazakh, Turkish, Azerbaijani) receive special attention, as linguistic proximity enables effective transfer learning. We propose three paradigm shifts: from architecture-centric to data-centric AI, from signer-independent to signer-adaptive systems, and from reference-based to task-specific evaluation metrics. A technical roadmap for AzSL leverages lightweight MediaPipe-based architectures, community-validated annotations, and offline-first deployment. Progress requires sustained interdisciplinary collaboration centered on Deaf communities to ensure cultural authenticity, ethical governance, and practical communication benefit.

item.title: MoCam: Unified Novel View Synthesis via Structured Denoising Dynamics
item.author: Haofeng Liu, Yang Zhou, Ziheng Wang, Zhengbo Xu, Zhan Peng, Jie Ma, Jun Liang, Shengfeng He, Jing Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MoCam通过结构化去噪动力学在扩散过程中协调几何先验和外观先验的进展，实现了从几何到外观的协调转换，从而统一了静态和动态视图合成。

背景: 生成式新颖视图合成面临一个根本性困境：几何先验提供空间对齐但在视图变化下变得稀疏和不准确，而外观先验提供视觉保真度但缺乏几何对应关系。现有方法要么在整个生成过程中传播几何误差，要么在融合两者时遭受信号冲突。

目的: 引入MoCam方法，通过结构化去噪动力学在扩散过程中协调几何先验和外观先验的进展，以解决几何误差传播和信号冲突问题。

方法: MoCam采用结构化去噪动力学在扩散过程中协调几何先验和外观先验的进展。首先在早期阶段利用几何先验锚定粗糙结构并容忍其不完整性，然后在后期阶段切换到外观先验以主动纠正几何误差并细化细节。

主要发现: 实验表明MoCam显著优于先前方法，特别是在点云包含严重孔洞或扭曲时，实现了鲁棒的几何-外观解耦。

结论: MoCam通过在扩散过程中时间上解耦几何对齐和外观细化，自然地统一了静态和动态视图合成。

翻译: 生成式新颖视图合成面临一个根本性困境：几何先验提供空间对齐但在视图变化下变得稀疏和不准确，而外观先验提供视觉保真度但缺乏几何对应关系。现有方法要么在整个生成过程中传播几何误差，要么在融合两者时遭受信号冲突。我们引入了MoCam，它采用结构化去噪动力学在扩散过程中协调几何先验和外观先验的进展。MoCam首先在早期阶段利用几何先验锚定粗糙结构并容忍其不完整性，然后在后期阶段切换到外观先验以主动纠正几何误差并细化细节。这种设计通过在扩散过程中时间上解耦几何对齐和外观细化，自然地统一了静态和动态视图合成。实验表明MoCam显著优于先前方法，特别是在点云包含严重孔洞或扭曲时，实现了鲁棒的几何-外观解耦。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Generative novel view synthesis faces a fundamental dilemma: geometric priors provide spatial alignment but become sparse and inaccurate under view changes, while appearance priors offer visual fidelity but lack geometric correspondence. Existing methods either propagate geometric errors throughout generation or suffer from signal conflicts when fusing both statically. We introduce MoCam, which employs structured denoising dynamics to orchestrate a coordinated progression from geometry to appearance within the diffusion process.MoCam first leverages geometric priors in early stages to anchor coarse structures and tolerate their incompleteness, then switches to appearance priors in later stages to actively correct geometric errors and refine details. This design naturally unifies static and dynamic view synthesis by temporally decoupling geometric alignment and appearance refinement within the diffusion process.Experiments demonstrate that MoCam significantly outperforms prior methods, particularly when point clouds contain severe holes or distortions, achieving robust geometry-appearance disentanglement.

item.title: EchoTracker2: Enhancing Myocardial Point Tracking by Modeling Local Motion
item.author: Md Abulkalam Azad, Vegard Holmstrøm, John Nyberg, Lasse Lovstakken, Håvard Dalen, Bjørnar Grenne, Andreas Østvik
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种仅包含精炼阶段的架构 EchoTracker2，用于心肌点追踪，通过融合像素级特征和时空上下文来提高追踪精度。

背景: 心肌点追踪是超声心动图运动估计的新兴方向。心肌运动源于生理约束的变形，具有空间和时间上的连续性，轨迹通常保持局部受限。

目的: 鉴于心肌运动的特性，作者重新审视了 MPT 的架构设计，发现常用的两阶段粗到细架构中的粗初始化可能是不必要的，旨在提出一种仅包含精炼阶段的架构。

方法: 提出了一种仅包含精炼阶段的架构 EchoTracker2。该方法利用像素级特征，结合局部时空上下文，并集成长距离联合时间推理以实现鲁棒追踪。

主要发现: 实验表明，与领域特定的 SOTA 模型相比，位置精度提高了 6.5 percent，中位轨迹误差降低了 12.2 percent。与最佳通用点追踪方法相比，分别提高了 2.0 percent 和 5.3 percent。EchoTracker2 与专家推导的全局纵向应变 GLS 更一致，并增强了测试-休息的可重复性。

结论: EchoTracker2 在追踪精度和轨迹误差方面优于现有方法，且与专家评估结果一致，具有更好的测试-休息可重复性。

翻译: 心肌点追踪 (MPT) 最近作为超声心动图运动估计的一个有前景的方向而出现，这得益于通用点追踪方法的进步。然而，心肌运动从根本上不同于自然视频中遇到的运动，因为它源于生理约束的变形，在整个心脏周期内具有空间和时间上的连续性。因此，尽管组织变形显著，运动轨迹通常仍然局部受限。受这些性质的启发，我们重新审视了 MPT 的架构设计，发现常用的两阶段粗到细架构中的粗初始化在这个领域可能是不必要的。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种仅包含精炼阶段的架构，EchoTracker2，它利用像素级特征丰富局部时空上下文，并将其与长距离联合时间推理相结合，以实现鲁棒追踪。在分布内、分布外和公共合成数据集上的实验结果表明，与领域特定的最先进 (SOTA) 模型相比，我们的模型位置精度提高了 6.5 percent，中位轨迹误差降低了 12.2 percent。与最佳通用点追踪方法相比，改进分别为 2.0 percent 和 5.3 percent。此外，EchoTracker2 与专家推导的全局纵向应变 (GLS) 更一致，并增强了测试-休息的可重复性。源代码将在：https://github.com/riponazad/ptecho 上提供。

Abstract

Myocardial point tracking (MPT) has recently emerged as a promising direction for motion estimation in echocardiography, driven by advances in general-purpose point tracking methods. However, myocardial motion fundamentally differs from motion encountered in natural videos, as it arises from physiologically constrained deformation that is spatially and temporally continuous throughout the cardiac cycle. Consequently, motion trajectories typically remain locally confined despite substantial tissue deformation. Motivated by these properties, we revisit the architectural design for MPT and find that coarse initialization in commonly used two-stage coarse-to-fine architectures may be unnecessary in this domain. In this work, we propose a fine-stage-only architecture, \textbf{EchoTracker2}, which enriches pixel-precise features with local spatiotemporal context and integrates them with long-range joint temporal reasoning for robust tracking. Experimental results across in-distribution, out-of-distribution (OOD), and public synthetic datasets show that our model improves position accuracy by $6.5\%$ and reduces median trajectory error by $12.2\%$ relative to a domain-specific state-of-the-art (SOTA) model. Compared to the best general-purpose point tracking method, the improvements are $2.0\%$ and $5.3\%$, respectively. Moreover, EchoTracker2 shows better agreement with expert-derived global longitudinal strain (GLS) and enhances test-rest reproducibility. Source code will be available at: https://github.com/riponazad/ptecho.

item.title: Cross-Modal-Domain Generalization Through Semantically Aligned Discrete Representations
item.author: Souptik Sen, Raneen Younis, Zahra Ahmadi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CoDAAR框架通过跨模态离散对齐与重建，在统一离散空间中平衡了跨模态泛化能力与模态特定结构，实现了无竞争的统一表示空间。

背景: 当前多模态学习方法难以平衡跨模态泛化能力与模态特定结构，连续方法难以泛化，离散方法牺牲模态特异性。

目的: 引入CoDAAR框架，解决跨模态泛化与模态特定结构之间的长期权衡问题，在统一离散空间中保持模态独特结构并实现可泛化的跨模态表示。

方法: CoDAAR包含离散时间对齐（DTA）和级联语义对齐（CSA）两种互补机制，通过索引级对齐建立语义共识，结合自监督重建目标进行训练。

主要发现: CoDAAR在跨模态泛化基准测试中达到最先进性能，包括事件分类、定位、视频分割和跨数据集迁移，展现出鲁棒的跨模态和跨域泛化能力。

结论: CoDAAR建立了一种离散和可泛化多模态表示学习的新范式。

翻译: 多模态学习寻求整合来自不同感官来源的信息，然而当前方法难以平衡跨模态泛化能力与模态特定结构。连续（隐式）方法保留了细粒度先验但使泛化具有挑战性，而离散（显式）方法以牺牲模态特异性为代价强制共享原型。我们引入了CoDAAR（跨模态离散对齐与重建），这是一个新颖的框架，通过索引级对齐在模态特定代码本之间建立语义共识，解决了这一长期权衡问题。这种设计独特地允许CoDAAR在统一离散空间内保持模态独特结构并实现可泛化的跨模态表示。CoDAAR结合了两种互补机制：离散时间对齐（DTA），它实现了细粒度的时间量化，以及级联语义对齐（CSA），它促进了渐进式跨模态语义一致性。它们共同建立了一个无竞争的统一表示空间。CoDAAR在配对多模态序列上使用自监督重建目标进行训练，展示了鲁棒的跨模态和跨域泛化能力。在跨模态泛化基准测试中，包括事件分类、定位、视频分割和跨数据集迁移，CoDAAR达到了最先进的性能，为离散和可泛化的多模态表示学习建立了一种新范式。

Abstract

Multimodal learning seeks to integrate information across diverse sensory sources, yet current approaches struggle to balance cross-modal generalizability with modality-specific structure. Continuous (implicit) methods preserve fine-grained priors but render generalization challenging, while discrete (explicit) approaches enforce shared prototypes at the expense of modality specificity. We introduce CoDAAR (Cross-modal Discrete Alignment And Reconstruction), a novel framework that resolves this long-standing trade-off by establishing semantic consensus across modality-specific codebooks through index-level alignment. This design uniquely allows CoDAAR to preserve modality-unique structures while achieving generalizable cross-modal representations within a unified discrete space. CoDAAR combines two complementary mechanisms: Discrete Temporal Alignment (DTA), which enables fine-grained temporal quantization, and Cascading Semantic Alignment (CSA), which promotes progressive cross-modal semantic agreement. Together, they establish a competition-free unified representation space. Trained with self-supervised reconstruction objectives on paired multimodal sequences, CoDAAR demonstrates robust cross-modal and cross-domain generalization. Across Cross-Modal Generalization benchmarks, including event classification, localization, video segmentation, and cross-dataset transfer, CoDAAR achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new paradigm for discrete and generalizable multimodal representation learning.

item.title: Do Enterprise Systems Need Learned World Models? The Importance of Context to Infer Dynamics
item.author: Nair, Jishnu Sethumadhavan, Bechard, Patrice, Maheshwary, Rishabh, Dasgupta, Surajit, Ramachandran, Sravan, Bhagat, Aakash, Radhakrishna, Shruthan, Pattnaik, Pulkit, Obando-Ceron, Johan, Malay, Shiva Krishna Reddy, Davasam, Sagar, Subramanian, Seganrasan, Mittal, Vipul, Nemala, Sridhar Krishna, Pal, Christopher, Sunkara, Srinivas, Rajeswar, Sai
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了在企业系统中，当规则可以在推理时读取时，智能体是否仍需要学习它们的问题，并提出了企业发现代理和CascadeBench基准测试来验证发现机制在动态环境中的鲁棒性。

背景: 在企业系统中，环境动力学通常由租户特定的业务逻辑定义，这些逻辑在不同部署间变化且随时间演变，导致基于历史转换训练的模型在部署变更时变得脆弱。

目的: 探讨当规则可以在推理时读取时，智能体是否仍需要学习这些规则，并验证运行时发现是否能补充离线训练。

方法: 提出了企业发现代理，通过读取系统配置而非仅依赖内部表示来恢复相关的转换动力学；引入了CascadeBench基准测试，采用World of Workflows的评估方法，并结合部署变更评估来比较离线训练的世界模型和发现代理的性能。

主要发现: 离线训练的世界模型在分布内表现良好，但在动力学变化时性能下降；而基于发现的代理通过将预测建立在当前实例上，在部署变更下表现出更强的鲁棒性。

结论: 在可配置的企业环境中，智能体不应仅依赖固定的内部动力学，而应结合在运行时发现相关转换逻辑的机制。

翻译: World models enable agents to anticipate the effects of their actions by internalizing environment dynamics. In enterprise systems, however, these dynamics are often defined by tenant-specific business logic that varies across deployments and evolves over time, making models trained on historical transitions brittle under deployment shift. We ask a question the world-models literature has not addressed: when the rules can be read at inference time, does an agent still need to learn them? We argue, and demonstrate empirically, that in settings where transition dynamics are configurable and readable, runtime discovery complements offline training by grounding predictions in the active system instance. We propose enterprise discovery agents, which recover relevant transition dynamics at runtime by reading the system's configuration rather than relying solely on internalized representations. We introduce CascadeBench, a reasoning-focused benchmark for enterprise cascade prediction that adopts the evaluation methodology of World of Workflows on diverse synthetic environments, and use it together with deployment-shift evaluation to show that offline-trained world models can perform well in-distribution but degrade as dynamics change, whereas discovery-based agents are more robust under shift by grounding their predictions in the current instance. Our findings suggest that, in configurable enterprise environments, agents should not rely solely on fixed internalized dynamics, but should incorporate mechanisms for discovering relevant transition logic at runtime.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要探讨企业系统是否需要学习到的世界模型，以及上下文在推断系统动态性中的重要性。文中未明确说明该问题在现实或研究中的重要性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

World models enable agents to anticipate the effects of their actions by internalizing environment dynamics. In enterprise systems, however, these dynamics are often defined by tenant-specific business logic that varies across deployments and evolves over time, making models trained on historical transitions brittle under deployment shift. We ask a question the world-models literature has not addressed: when the rules can be read at inference time, does an agent still need to learn them? We argue, and demonstrate empirically, that in settings where transition dynamics are configurable and readable, runtime discovery complements offline training by grounding predictions in the active system instance. We propose enterprise discovery agents, which recover relevant transition dynamics at runtime by reading the system's configuration rather than relying solely on internalized representations. We introduce CascadeBench, a reasoning-focused benchmark for enterprise cascade prediction that adopts the evaluation methodology of World of Workflows on diverse synthetic environments, and use it together with deployment-shift evaluation to show that offline-trained world models can perform well in-distribution but degrade as dynamics change, whereas discovery-based agents are more robust under shift by grounding their predictions in the current instance. Our findings suggest that, in configurable enterprise environments, agents should not rely solely on fixed internalized dynamics, but should incorporate mechanisms for discovering relevant transition logic at runtime.

item.title: Investigating simple target-covariate relationships for Chronos-2 and TabPFN-TS
item.author: Gaspard Berthelier, Mariia Baranova, Andrei-Tiberiu Pantea, Etienne Le Naour, Adrien Petralia, Tahar Nabil, Themis Palpanas
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Chronos-2 和 TabPFN-TS 是两种时间序列基础模型，TabPFN-TS 在简单目标-协变量关系的建模上比 Chronos-2 更有效，尤其是对于短预测期。

背景: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在零样本设置中通常优于监督模型，Chronos-2 和 TabPFN-TS 等架构旨在整合协变量。

目的: 设计基于简单目标-协变量关系的受控实验来评估这些模型整合协变量的能力。

方法: 基于简单目标-协变量关系设计受控实验。

主要发现: TabPFN-TS 比 Chronos-2 更有效地捕捉这些关系，尤其是在短预测期。

结论: Chronos-2 的强大基准性能并不自动意味着其对简单协变量-目标依赖关系的最佳建模。

翻译: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）最近取得了最先进的性能，通常在零样本设置中优于监督模型。最近的 TSFM 架构，如 Chronos-2 和 TabPFN-TS，旨在整合协变量。在本文中，我们基于简单目标-协变量关系设计了受控实验来评估这种整合能力。我们的结果表明，TabPFN-TS 比 Chronos-2 更有效地捕捉这些关系，尤其是对于短预测期，这表明 Chronos-2 的强大基准性能并不自动意味着对简单协变量-目标依赖关系的最佳建模。

Abstract

Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have recently achieved state-of-the-art performance, often outperforming supervised models in zero-shot settings. Recent TSFM architectures, such as Chronos-2 and TabPFN-TS, aim to integrate covariates. In this paper, we design controlled experiments based on simple target-covariate relationships to assess this integration capability. Our results show that TabPFN-TS captures these relationships more effectively than Chronos-2, especially for short horizons, suggesting that the strong benchmark performance of Chronos-2 does not automatically translate into optimal modeling of simple covariate-target dependencies.

item.title: Learning Ego-Centric BEV Representations from a Perspective-Privileged View: Cross-View Supervision for Online HD Map Construction
item.author: Daniel Lengerer, Mathias Pechinger, Klaus Bogenberger, Carsten Markgraf
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为交叉视图监督（CVS）的新方法，通过从自车对齐的俯视视角转移几何和拓扑先验知识，来改进基于多相机输入的鸟瞰图表示学习，从而提升高清地图构建的性能。

背景: 现有的鸟瞰图表示方法主要依赖自车中心监督，在处理长距离、视角效应和空间稀疏性时，难以从不完整的观测、遮挡和 diminishing 信息密度中推断出大规模场景结构。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在长距离结构推理上的局限性，引入交叉视图监督（CVS）范式，以增强鸟瞰图表示的结构一致性。

方法: CVS 不依赖额外的语义损失，而是将表示对齐到共享的鸟瞰图特征空间，并将视角特权教师模型中全局一致的结构知识蒸馏到自车中心骨干网络中。

主要发现: 在 nuScenes 数据集上，使用 CVS 方法相比 StreamMapNet 在标准区域提升了 3.9 mAP，在扩展区域提升了 9.9 mAP，在长距离范围内实现了 44% 的相对增益。

结论: 视角特权的结构监督是改进高清地图构建中鸟瞰图表示学习的有前景的训练原则。

翻译: 该研究提出了一种名为交叉视图监督（CVS）的新方法，通过从自车对齐的俯视视角转移几何和拓扑先验知识，来改进基于多相机输入的鸟瞰图表示学习，从而提升高清地图构建的性能。

Abstract

Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations derived from multi-camera input have become a central interface for online high-definition (HD) map construction. However, most approaches rely solely on ego-centric supervision, requiring large-scale scene structure to be inferred from incomplete observations, occlusions, and diminishing information density at long range, where perspective effects and spatial sparsity hinder consistent structural reasoning. We introduce Cross-View Supervision (CVS), a representation learning paradigm that transfers geometric and topological priors from an ego-aligned overhead perspective into camera-based BEV encoders. Rather than adding auxiliary semantic losses, CVS aligns representations in a shared BEV feature space and distills globally consistent structural knowledge from a perspective-privileged teacher into the ego-centric backbone. This supervision enhances structural coherence without modifying the inference architecture or requiring overhead input at test time. Experiments on nuScenes using ego-aligned aerial imagery from the AID4AD cross-view extension demonstrate consistent improvements over StreamMapNet while maintaining identical camera-only inference. CVS yields +3.9\,mAP in the standard $60\times30\,\mathrm{m}$ region and +9.9\,mAP in the extended $100\times50\,\mathrm{m}$ setting, corresponding to a 44\% relative gain at long range. These results highlight perspective-privileged structural supervision as a promising training principle for improving BEV representation learning in HD map construction.

item.title: TriBand-BEV: Real-Time LiDAR-Only 3D Pedestrian Detection via Height-Aware BEV and High-Resolution Feature Fusion
item.author: Mohammad Khoshkdahan, Alexey Vinel
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种新的鸟瞰图编码方法，将3D激光雷达点云映射为轻量级2D鸟瞰图张量，通过单网络检测行人、车辆和自行车，并在KITTI数据集上实现了高帧率和优异的检测性能。

背景: 安全自主代理和移动机器人需要快速实时3D感知，特别是针对行人等易受伤害的道路使用者。

目的: 引入一种新的鸟瞰图编码方法，将3D检测重新表述为2D检测问题，并从鸟瞰图输出中重建3D框，以实现快速实时3D感知。

方法: 使用分层双向颈部网络融合上下文和细节，头部预测方向框；训练时应用垂直重分箱和反射抖动；使用四分位距过滤器去除噪声点；使用区域注意力机制。

主要发现: 在KITTI数据集上，TriBand-BEV在单张消费级GPU上以49 FPS的速度达到了58.7%、52.6%和47.2%的行人BEV AP(%)（易、中、难），超越了Complex-YOLO。

结论: 该管道紧凑，准备用于实时机器人部署，且在遮挡场景下检测稳定，源代码已公开。

翻译: 安全自主代理和移动机器人需要快速实时3D感知，特别是针对行人等易受伤害的道路使用者。我们引入了一种新的鸟瞰图编码方法，将完整的3D激光雷达点云映射为轻量级2D鸟瞰图张量，具有三个高度带。我们明确地将3D检测重新表述为2D检测问题，然后从鸟瞰图输出中重建3D框。单个网络在一次通过中检测汽车、行人和自行车。骨干网在深层阶段使用区域注意力，在P1到P4上使用分层双向颈部融合上下文和细节，头部预测方向框，并使用分布焦点学习来处理侧偏移和旋转IoU损失。训练应用了小的垂直重分箱和通道空间中的轻微反射抖动以抵抗记忆化。我们使用四分位距过滤器在3D重建期间去除噪声和离群激光雷达点。在KITTI数据集上，TriBand-BEV在单张消费级GPU上以49 FPS的速度达到了易、中和难难度的行人BEV AP(%)分别为58.7、52.6和47.2，超越了Complex-YOLO，增益分别为+12.6%、+7.5%和+3.1%。定性场景显示在遮挡下检测稳定。该管道紧凑，准备用于实时机器人部署。我们的源代码在GitHub上公开。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为 TriBand-BEV 的实时 LiDAR-only 3D 行人检测方法，通过高度感知的鸟瞰图和高分辨率特征融合来提升检测效果。

Abstract

Safe autonomous agents and mobile robots need fast real time 3D perception, especially for vulnerable road users (VRUs) such as pedestrians. We introduce a new bird's eye view (BEV) encoding, which maps the full 3D LiDAR point cloud into a light-weight 2D BEV tensor with three height bands. We explicitly reformulate 3D detection as a 2D detection problem and then reconstruct 3D boxes from the BEV outputs. A single network detects cars, pedestrians, and cyclists in one pass. The backbone uses area attention at deep stages, a hierarchical bidirectional neck over P1 to P4 fuses context and detail, and the head predicts oriented boxes with distribution focal learning for side offsets and a rotated IoU loss. Training applies a small vertical re bin and a mild reflectance jitter in channel space to resist memorization. We use an interquartile range (IQR) filter to remove noisy and outlier LiDAR points during 3D reconstruction. On KITTI dataset, TriBand-BEV attains 58.7/52.6/47.2 pedestrian BEV AP(%) for easy, moderate, and hard at 49 FPS on a single consumer GPU, surpassing Complex-YOLO, with gains of +12.6%, +7.5%, and +3.1%. Qualitative scenes show stable detection under occlusion. The pipeline is compact and ready for real time robotic deployment. Our source code is publicly available on GitHub.

item.title: Pretraining Strategies and Scaling for ECG Foundation Models: A Systematic Study
item.author: M A Al-Masud, Nils Strodthoff
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文评估了心电图 ECG 基础模型的预训练方法、数据规模扩展及模型架构。研究发现对比预测编码效果最佳，结构化状态空间模型优于 Transformer 和 CNN，且模型架构的归纳偏置比单纯的数据规模更重要。

背景: 医学各个子领域开始出现专用基础模型，但预训练方法和参数扩展与数据集大小的关系很少被系统且一致地评估。

目的: 专注于心电图 ECG 数据的基础模型研究，这是全球范围内最广泛采集的生理时间序列数据之一。

方法: 对预训练方法进行了全面评估，涵盖了五种不同的对比和非对比自监督学习目标，研究了数据集大小（最多 1100 万样本）对模型的影响，并比较了不同预训练方法下的模型架构。

主要发现: 预训练策略对下游性能有显著影响，对比预测编码在多样化临床任务中产生最具迁移性的表示；扩展预训练数据能带来有意义的提升；结构化状态空间模型在架构比较中明显优于 Transformer 和 CNN 模型。

结论: 结构化状态空间模型的强归纳偏置是有效 ECG 表示学习的主要驱动力，而非仅靠预训练规模，这对未来该领域及其他生理信号领域的基础模型开发具有重要意义。

翻译: 专用基础模型正开始在各个医学子领域出现，但预训练方法和参数扩展与预训练数据集大小的关系很少被系统且一致地评估。本文专注于心电图 ECG 数据的基础模型，这是全球范围内最广泛采集的生理时间序列数据之一。我们对预训练方法进行了全面评估，涵盖了五种不同的对比和非对比自监督学习目标，并研究了数据集大小（最多 1100 万样本）对模型的影响。预训练策略对下游性能有显著影响，对比预测编码在多样化临床任务中产生最具迁移性的表示。扩展预训练数据在大多数目标下能带来有意义的提升。结构化状态空间模型在架构比较中明显优于 Transformer 和 CNN 模型。我们假设结构化状态空间模型的强归纳偏置是有效 ECG 表示学习的主要驱动力，而非仅靠预训练规模，这对未来该领域及其他生理信号领域的基础模型开发具有重要意义。

Abstract

Specialized foundation models are beginning to emerge in various medical subdomains, but pretraining methodologies and parametric scaling with the size of the pretraining dataset are rarely assessed systematically and in a like-for-like manner. This work focuses on foundation models for electrocardiography (ECG) data, one of the most widely captured physiological time series world-wide. We present a comprehensive assessment of pretraining methodologies, covering five different contrastive and non-contrastive self-supervised learning objectives for ECG foundation models, and investigate their scaling behavior with pretraining dataset sizes up to 11M input samples, exclusively from publicly available sources. Pretraining strategy has a meaningful and consistent impact on downstream performance, with contrastive predictive coding (slightly ahead of JEPA) yielding the most transferable representations across diverse clinical tasks. Scaling pretraining data continues to yield meaningful improvements up to 11M samples for most objectives. We also compare model architectures across all pretraining methodologies and find evidence for a clear superiority of structured state space models compared to transformers and CNN models. We hypothesize that the strong inductive biases of structured state space models, rather than pretraining scale alone, are the primary driver of effective ECG representation learning, with important implications for future foundation model development in this and potentially other physiological signal domains.

item.title: Mind the Pause: Disfluency-Aware Objective Tuning for Multilingual Speech Correction with LLMs
item.author: Deepak Kumar, Baban Gain, Asif Ekbal
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结合序列标记、指令微调和对比学习的多语言非流利性修正方法，旨在提高ASR转录文本的流畅度和可靠性。

背景: ASR转录文本常包含填充词、重复和假启动等非流利性，降低了可读性并阻碍了下游应用。现有基于经典模型的检测策略往往破坏语法结构和语义连贯性。

目的: 提出一种能够全面修正非流利性的多语言管道，解决现有方法破坏语法和语义的问题，提高下游系统的可靠性。

方法: 提出了一个多语言修正管道。首先使用序列标记器标记非流利性标记，这些信号指导LLM进行指令微调以重写转录文本。此外，引入对比学习目标来惩罚非流利性标记的重现，鼓励模型在移除非流利性时保留语法和含义。

主要发现: 在印地语、孟加拉语和马拉地语上的实验表明，该方法在强基线（包括多语言序列到序列模型）上取得了持续改进。结果证明仅依赖检测策略是不够的。

结论: 结合标记级线索、指令微调和对比学习为语音驱动NLP系统中的多语言非流利性修正提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。代码已公开。

翻译: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) transcripts often contain disfluencies, such as fillers, repetitions, and false starts, which reduce readability and hinder downstream applications like chatbots and voice assistants. If left unaddressed, such disfluencies can significantly degrade the reliability of downstream systems. Most existing approaches rely on classical models that focus on identifying disfluent tokens for removal. While this strategy is effective to some extent, it often disrupts grammatical structure and semantic coherence, leading to incomplete or unnatural sentences. Recent literature explored the use of large language models (LLMs); however, these efforts have primarily focused on disfluency detection or data augmentation, rather than performing comprehensive correction. We propose a multilingual correction pipeline where a sequence tagger first marks disfluent tokens, and these signals guide instruction fine-tuning of an LLM to rewrite transcripts into fluent text. To further improve reliability, we add a contrastive learning objective that penalizes the reproduction of disfluent tokens, encouraging the model to preserve grammar and meaning while removing disfluent artifacts. Our experiments across three Indian languages, namely Hindi, Bengali, and Marathi show consistent improvements over strong baselines, including multilingual sequence-to-sequence models. These results highlight that detection-only strategies are insufficient. Combining token-level cues with instruction tuning and contrastive learning provides a practical and scalable solution for multilingual disfluency correction in speech-driven NLP systems. We make the codes publicly available at https://github.com/deepak-kumar-98/Mind-the-Pause.

Abstract

Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) transcripts often contain disfluencies, such as fillers, repetitions, and false starts, which reduce readability and hinder downstream applications like chatbots and voice assistants. If left unaddressed, such disfluencies can significantly degrade the reliability of downstream systems. Most existing approaches rely on classical models that focus on identifying disfluent tokens for removal. While this strategy is effective to some extent, it often disrupts grammatical structure and semantic coherence, leading to incomplete or unnatural sentences. Recent literature explored the use of large language models (LLMs); however, these efforts have primarily focused on disfluency detection or data augmentation, rather than performing comprehensive correction. We propose a multilingual correction pipeline where a sequence tagger first marks disfluent tokens, and these signals guide instruction fine-tuning of an LLM to rewrite transcripts into fluent text. To further improve reliability, we add a contrastive learning objective that penalizes the reproduction of disfluent tokens, encouraging the model to preserve grammar and meaning while removing disfluent artifacts. Our experiments across three Indian languages, namely Hindi, Bengali, and Marathi show consistent improvements over strong baselines, including multilingual sequence-to-sequence models. These results highlight that detection-only strategies are insufficient. Combining token-level cues with instruction tuning and contrastive learning provides a practical and scalable solution for multilingual disfluency correction in speech-driven NLP systems. We make the codes publicly available at https://github.com/deepak-kumar-98/Mind-the-Pause.

item.title: Why Conclusions Diverge from the Same Observations: Formalizing World-Model Non-Identifiability via an Inference
item.author: Toru Takahashi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文提出将认知分歧重新定义为推理和学习中的不可识别性，而非认知缺陷或恶意行为，并从两个层面分析了分歧的成因。

背景: 当人们共享相同文档和观察却得出不同结论时，分歧常被归咎于对方认知缺陷、非理性或恶意。论文认为这种分歧应被重新描述。

目的: 论证分歧本质上是推理和学习中固有的不可识别性形式，并构建一个框架来解释分歧的成因和表现。

方法: 将现象组织为两个层面：一是θ层面的不可识别性（相同世界模型下因推理设置不同导致结论分歧），二是W层面的不可识别性（重复使用推理设置导致世界模型本身分歧）。引入了包含参考、探索、稳定化和视界的推理配置。

主要发现: 输出可以因相同的观察和世界模型而分裂；分歧倾向于投射到少数几个基础维度上，如抽象与具体、外推性、顺序与自由，这是由于学习系统的计算、观察和协调约束。

结论: 该框架与深度表征学习相关，包括表征层级、潜在状态估计以及正则化与探索的权衡，并通过AI监管辩论的案例研究进行了说明。

翻译: 当人们分享相同的文档和观察却得出不同的结论时，分歧往往转变为对另一方认知缺陷、非理性或恶意行为的判断。本文论证这种分歧最好被描述为推理和学习中固有的不可识别性形式，而不是另一方的缺陷。我们将这种现象组织为两个层面：一是θ层面的不可识别性，即在相同世界模型下因推理设置不同导致结论分歧；二是W层面的不可识别性，即重复使用推理设置导致数据暴露和更新规则偏差，从而使学习到的世界模型本身分歧。我们引入了一个包含参考、探索、稳定化和视界的推理配置，并展示了即使对于相同的观察和世界模型，输出也可能分裂。我们进一步解释了为什么分歧倾向于投射到少数几个基础维度上——抽象与具体、外推性、顺序与自由——这是由于学习系统的计算、观察和协调约束的普遍结果。最后，我们将该框架与深度表征学习联系起来，包括表征层级、潜在状态估计以及正则化与探索的权衡，并通过AI监管辩论的案例研究说明了该框架。

Abstract

When people share the same documents and observations yet reach different conclusions, the disagreement often shifts into a judgment that the other party is cognitively defective, irrational, or acting in bad faith. This paper argues that such divergence is better described as a form of non-identifiability inherent in inference and learning, rather than as a defect of the other party. We organize the phenomenon into two levels: (i) $θ$-level non-identifiability, where conclusions diverge under the same world model $W$ because inference settings differ; and (ii) $W$-level non-identifiability, where repeated use of an inference setting $θ$ biases data exposure and update rules, causing the learned world model $W$ itself to diverge. We introduce an inference profile $θ= (R, E, S, D)$, consisting of Reference, Exploration, Stabilization, and Horizon, and show how outputs can split even for the same observation $o$ and the same $W$. We further explain why disagreements tend to project onto a small number of bases -- abstract versus concrete, externalizability, and order versus freedom -- as a consequence of general constraints on learning systems: computational, observational, and coordination constraints. Finally, we relate the framework to deep representation learning, including representation hierarchy, latent-state estimation, and regularization-exploration trade-offs, and illustrate the framework through a case study on AI regulation debates.

item.title: SEMIR: Semantic Minor-Induced Representation Learning on Graphs for Visual Segmentation
item.author: Luke James Miller, Yugyung Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文提出了一种名为 SEMIR 的表示学习框架，旨在解决大图像中小且稀疏结构的分割问题，通过将推理与原生网格解耦来提高效率。

背景: 在大图像中分割小且稀疏的结构受到体素级网格计算和极端类别不平衡的限制，传统的全分辨率推理计算成本高且会削弱边界证据。

目的: 引入 SEMIR 框架，将推理与原生网格解耦，学习任务适应的拓扑保持的潜在图表示，以解决计算成本与分辨率耦合的问题。

方法: SEMIN 将底层网格图转换为紧凑的边界对齐的图诱导子图，通过参数化的边收缩、节点删除和边删除实现。诱导子图构建被形式化为少样本结构学习问题，利用边界对齐目标学习参数，并使用图神经网络进行区域级推理。

主要发现: 在三个肿瘤分割数据集上，SEMIN 在实际运行时间内对少数结构 Dice 指标产生了持续改进。

结论: SEMIN 建立了一个用于学习具有精确解码的任务适应、拓扑保持的潜在表示的框架，适用于高分辨率结构化视觉数据。

翻译: 在大图像中分割小且稀疏的结构受到体素级网格计算和极端类别不平衡的根本限制——密集的全分辨率推理扩展性差，迫使大多数管道依赖固定的区域划分或下采样，将计算成本与图像分辨率耦合，并削弱了边界证据，而边界证据正是少数结构最有信息量的地方。我们介绍了 SEMIR（语义诱导表示学习），这是一种通过学习具有精确解码的任务适应、拓扑保持的潜在图表示来将推理与原生网格解耦的表示框架。SEMIN 通过参数化的边收缩、节点删除和边删除，将底层网格图转换为紧凑的、边界对齐的图诱导子图，同时保持从诱导子图预测到网格标签的精确提升映射。诱导子图构建被形式化为少样本结构学习问题，用边界对齐目标替换了手工调优的预处理：诱导子图参数通过在边界 Dice 准则下最大化预测边界元素与目标特定语义边缘的一致性来学习，诱导子图被标注了具有尺度和平移鲁棒性的几何和强度描述符，并通过具有关系边特征的图神经网络（GNN）上的消息传递支持高效的区域级推理。我们在三个肿瘤分割数据集上对 SEMIN 进行了基准测试——BraTS 2021、KiTS23 和 LiTS——在这些数据集中，目标表现出高结构变异性和分布不确定性。SEMIN 在实际运行时间内对少数结构 Dice 指标产生了持续改进。更广泛地说，SEMIN 建立了一个用于学习具有精确解码的任务适应、拓扑保持的潜在表示的框架，用于高分辨率结构化视觉数据。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Segmenting small and sparse structures in large-scale images is fundamentally constrained by voxel-level, lattice-bound computation and extreme class imbalance -- dense, full-resolution inference scales poorly and forces most pipelines to rely on fixed regionization or downsampling, coupling computational cost to image resolution and attenuating boundary evidence precisely where minority structures are most informative. We introduce SEMIR (Semantic Minor-Induced Representation Learning), a representation framework that decouples inference from the native grid by learning a task-adapted, topology-preserving latent graph representation with exact decoding. SEMIR transforms the underlying grid graph into a compact, boundary-aligned graph minor through parameterized edge contraction, node deletion, and edge deletion, while preserving an exact lifting map from minor predictions to lattice labels. Minor construction is formalized as a few-shot structure learning problem that replaces hand-tuned preprocessing with a boundary-alignment objective: minor parameters are learned by maximizing agreement between predicted boundary elements and target-specific semantic edges under a boundary Dice criterion, and the induced minor is annotated with scale- and rotation-robust geometric and intensity descriptors and supports efficient region-level inference via message passing on a graph neural network (GNN) with relational edge features. We benchmark SEMIR on three tumor segmentation datasets -- BraTS 2021, KiTS23, and LiTS -- where targets exhibit high structural variability and distributional uncertainty. SEMIR yields consistent improvements in minority-structure Dice at practical runtime. More broadly, SEMIR establishes a framework for learning task-adapted, topology-preserving latent representations with exact decoding for high-resolution structured visual data.

item.title: Predicting Decisions of AI Agents from Limited Interaction through Text-Tabular Modeling
item.author: Eilam Shapira, Moshe Tennenholtz, Roi Reichart
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AI 代理可以通过少量互动，利用目标自适应文本-表格预测模型来预测陌生对手的下一个决策。

背景: AI 代理在自然语言中与陌生对手进行谈判，对手的内部机制（如 LLM、提示和控制逻辑）是隐藏的，但每个决策都有经济后果。

目的: 研究在少量互动下，AI 代理能否预测陌生对手的下一个决策。

方法: 在受控的谈判游戏中，将问题定义为目标自适应文本-表格预测任务。模型基于表格基础模型，结合游戏状态特征和基于 LLM 的文本表示，并引入 LLM-as-Observer（冻结的小型 LLM）作为额外特征提取器，将 LLM 视为编码器而非直接预测器。

主要发现: 在 13 个前沿 LLM 代理上训练，91 个保留代理上测试，全模型优于直接提示和特征基线。观察者特征显著提升了性能，在 K=16 时，将响应预测 AUC 提高了约 4 个点，并将谈判提议预测误差减少了 14%。

结论: 将对手预测定义为目标自适应文本-表格任务可实现有效适应，且隐藏的 LLM 表示能揭示直接提示无法发现的决策相关信号。

翻译: AI 代理在与陌生对手进行自然语言谈判和交易：买家机器人面对未知的卖家，或采购助手与供应商谈判。在这种互动中，对手的 LLM、提示词、控制逻辑和基于规则的回退机制是隐藏的，而每个决策都可能产生经济后果。我们询问一个代理能否仅通过少量互动来预测陌生对手的下一个决策。为了避免现实世界日志的干扰，我们在受控的谈判和博弈游戏中研究了这个问题，将其定义为目标自适应文本-表格预测：每个决策点是一个表格行，结合了结构化的游戏状态、出价历史和对话，而提示中提供了 K 个相同目标代理（即被建模的对手）的先前游戏作为标记的适应示例。我们的模型建立在表格基础模型之上，使用游戏状态特征和基于 LLM 的文本表示来表示行，并添加了 LLM-as-Observer 作为额外的表示：一个小型的冻结 LLM 读取决策时的状态和对话；其答案被丢弃，其隐藏状态成为面向决策的特征，使 LLM 成为编码器而非直接的少样本预测器。在 13 个前沿 LLM 代理上训练，在 91 个保留的支架代理上测试，全模型优于直接 LLM-as-Predictor 提示和游戏+文本特征基线。在这个表格模型中，观察者特征优于其他特征方案：在 K=16 时，它们在两个任务上将响应预测 AUC 提高了约 4 个点，并将谈判提议预测误差减少了 14%。这些结果表明，将对手预测定义为目标自适应文本-表格任务可实现有效适应，且隐藏的 LLM 表示揭示了直接提示无法发现的决策相关信号。

Abstract

AI agents negotiate and transact in natural language with unfamiliar counterparts: a buyer bot facing an unknown seller, or a procurement assistant negotiating with a supplier. In such interactions, the counterpart's LLM, prompts, control logic, and rule-based fallbacks are hidden, while each decision can have monetary consequences. We ask whether an agent can predict an unfamiliar counterpart's next decision from a few interactions. To avoid real-world logging confounds, we study this problem in controlled bargaining and negotiation games, formulating it as target-adaptive text-tabular prediction: each decision point is a table row combining structured game state, offer history, and dialogue, while $K$ previous games of the same target agent, i.e., the counterpart being modeled, are provided in the prompt as labeled adaptation examples. Our model is built on a tabular foundation model that represents rows using game-state features and LLM-based text representations, and adds LLM-as-Observer as an additional representation: a small frozen LLM reads the decision-time state and dialogue; its answer is discarded, and its hidden state becomes a decision-oriented feature, making the LLM an encoder rather than a direct few-shot predictor. Training on 13 frontier-LLM agents and testing on 91 held-out scaffolded agents, the full model outperforms direct LLM-as-Predictor prompting and game+text features baselines. Within this tabular model, Observer features contribute beyond the other feature schemes: at $K=16$, they improve response-prediction AUC by about 4 points across both tasks and reduce bargaining offer-prediction error by 14%. These results show that formulating counterpart prediction as a target-adaptive text-tabular task enables effective adaptation, and that hidden LLM representations expose decision-relevant signals that direct prompting does not surface.

item.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Retrospective Dynamic Scene Novel View Synthesis with a Standardized Benchmark
item.author: Yunxiao Zhang, Suryansh Kumar
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种针对同步多视图动态场景的回顾性新视角合成方法，通过在初始时间点初始化SfM点云并随时间传播优化高斯，实现了无需显式时间变形约束的高效回顾性新视角合成。

背景: 回顾性新视角合成在体育等应用中至关重要。近期动态3D高斯泼溅方法引入了时间耦合公式以强制时间上的运动一致性。

目的: 作者认为在体育中典型的同步多视图设置下，每个时间步的动态场景已经受到强烈的几何约束，同步校准的视图提供了足够的空间一致性，因此显式的时间耦合或复杂的多体约束对于回顾性新视角合成似乎是不必要的。

方法: 提出了一种针对同步多视图动态场景的方法。通过在起始时间初始化SfM推导的点云，并随时间传播优化的高斯，实现了无需施加时间变形约束的高效回顾性新视角合成。此外，还引入了一个基于Blender的动态多视图数据集框架，用于生成高质量、同步的相机装置并导出标准格式的训练就绪数据集。

主要发现: 在同步多视图设置下，使用3D高斯可以高效实现回顾性动态场景新视角合成。该数据集生成框架能够实现动态新视角合成方法的可重复和原则性的基准测试。

结论: 在同步多视图设置下，无需显式时间耦合或复杂多体约束，即可利用3D高斯实现高效的回顾性动态场景新视角合成。

翻译: 动态场景的回顾性新视角合成是体育等应用的基础。近期的动态3D高斯泼溅方法引入了时间耦合公式以强制时间上的运动一致性。在本文中，我们论证了在体育中典型的同步多视图设置下，每个时间步的动态场景已经受到强烈的几何约束。我们认为，同步校准的视图提供了足够的空间一致性，因此，对于回顾性新视角合成而言，显式的时间耦合或复杂的多体约束似乎是不必要的。为此，我们提出了一种针对同步多视图动态场景的方法。通过在起始时间初始化SfM推导的点云，并随时间传播优化的高斯，我们表明无需施加时间变形约束即可实现高效的回顾性新视角合成。除了方法论贡献外，我们还引入了一个基于Blender的动态多视图数据集框架，用于可重复的NeRF和3D高斯研究。该框架生成高质量、同步的相机装置，并以标准格式导出训练就绪的数据集，消除了坐标约定和数据管道中的不一致性。利用该框架，我们构建了一个动态基准测试套件，并在受控条件下评估了代表性的NeRF和3D高斯方法。总的来说，我们在同步多视图设置下表明，使用3D高斯可以高效实现回顾性动态场景新视角合成。同时，数据集生成框架使得动态新视角合成方法的可重复和原则性的基准测试成为可能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Retrospective novel view synthesis (NVS) of dynamic scenes is fundamental to applications such as sports. Recent dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) approaches introduce temporally coupled formulations to enforce motion coherence across time. In this paper, we argue that, in a synchronized multi-view (MV) setting typical of sports, the dynamic scene at each time step is already strongly geometrically constrained. We posit that the availability of calibrated, synchronized viewpoints provides sufficient spatial consistency, and therefore, explicit temporal coupling, or complex multi-body constraints seems unnecessary for retrospective NVS. To this end, we propose an approach tailored for synchronized MV dynamic scene. By initializing the SfM-derived point cloud at the start time and propagating optimized Gaussians over time, we show that efficient retrospective NVS can be achieved without imposing a temporal deformation constraint. Complementing our methodological contribution, we introduce a Dynamic MV dataset framework built on Blender for reproducible NeRF and 3DGS research. The framework generates high-quality, synchronized camera rigs and exports training-ready datasets in standard formats, eliminating inconsistencies in coordinate conventions and data pipelines. Using the framework, we construct a dynamic benchmark suite and evaluate representative NeRF and 3DGS approaches under controlled conditions. Together, we show that, under a synchronized MV setup, efficient retrospective dynamic scene NVS can be achieved using 3DGS. At the same time, the dataset-generation framework enables reproducible and principled benchmarking of dynamic NVS methods.

item.title: Beyond GRPO and On-Policy Distillation: An Empirical Sparse-to-Dense Reward Principle for Language-Model Post-Training
item.author: Xu, Yuanda, Sang, Hejian, Zhou, Zhengze, He, Ran, Wang, Zhipeng, Geramifard, Alborz
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于奖励密度的分配规则，用于优化稀疏序列级奖励和密集令牌级教师监督在模型训练中的数据分配，以提升模型性能。

背景: 在标记的可验证训练数据稀缺的情况下，如何高效利用这些数据是关键问题。标准做法是将数据直接用于部署模型，但这往往效率低下。

目的: 提出一种基于奖励密度的分配原则，以优化稀疏强化学习和密集教师监督的使用方式，从而更有效地利用稀缺的标记训练数据。

方法: 通过在可验证数学问题上评估Qwen3和Llama模型，比较了直接GRPO、通过密集桥接蒸馏的RL改进教师、以及桥接前后的转移方法。具体方法包括在教师rollouts上进行前向KL预热，随后在学生rollouts上进行OPD。

主要发现: 在固定部署学生模型大小下，经过密集桥接蒸馏的RL改进教师优于直接在学生上运行的GRPO；桥接过程对于后续学生端稀疏RL的有效性至关重要；在MATH数据集上，经过桥接的GRPO比匹配的回放控制提高了2.8个百分点。

结论: 应避免在准备最不充分的策略上使用稀缺的标记数据。建议使用稀疏奖励进行教师端发现，使用密集转移进行学生压缩，并在桥接后仅使用学生端稀疏奖励。

翻译: 在标记的可验证训练数据是约束条件的情况下，每个检查过的示例都应该仔细分配。标准做法是直接将此数据用于将要部署的模型，例如通过在部署学生上运行GRPO。我们认为这往往是一种低效的分配，因为它忽略了奖励密度原则：稀疏的序列级奖励应该训练探索有效的模型，而密集的令牌级教师奖励应该用于将行为压缩到更小模型中的情况。在这个观点下，GRPO风格的稀疏RL和OPD风格的密集教师监督不是单独的配方；它们是不同的奖励密度制度。分配规则很简单：在最强的模型上使用稀缺的标记训练数据将其转化为奖励 shaped 行为，然后将该行为作为密集监督转移到下游。我们在可验证数学问题上评估了Qwen3和Llama模型的这一规则。在固定的Qwen3-1.7B部署学生大小下，通过密集桥接蒸馏的RL改进8B教师优于同一学生上的直接GRPO，而桥接前从同一教师的转移则表现不佳。桥接很重要：在教师rollouts上进行前向KL预热，随后在学生rollouts上进行OPD，在桥接后任何学生端稀疏RL之前，在MATH上始终是最强的，并且为标准的8B/14B教师提供了最好的前Stage 3 AIME端点。桥接也使后续的学生端稀疏RL变得有效：在冷学生上较弱的GRPO在桥接后将MATH从75.4%提升到78.5%，并比匹配的回放控制高出2.8点。操作原则是避免在准备最不充分的策略上使用稀缺的标记数据：使用稀疏奖励进行教师端发现，使用密集转移进行学生压缩，并在桥接后仅使用学生端稀疏奖励。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

In settings where labeled verifiable training data is the binding constraint, each checked example should be allocated carefully. The standard practice is to use this data directly on the model that will be deployed, for example by running GRPO on the deployment student. We argue that this is often an inefficient allocation because it overlooks a reward-density principle: sparse sequence-level reward should train models where exploration is productive, while dense token-level teacher reward should be used where the aim is to compress behavior into a smaller model. In this view, GRPO-style sparse RL and OPD-style dense teacher supervision are not separate recipes; they are different reward-density regimes. The allocation rule is simple: use scarce labeled training data upstream on the strongest model that can turn it into reward-shaped behavior, then transfer that behavior downstream as dense supervision. We evaluate this rule on verifiable math with Qwen3 and Llama models. At fixed Qwen3-1.7B deployment-student size, an RL-improved 8B teacher distilled through the dense bridge outperforms direct GRPO on the same student, while transfer from the same teacher before RL underperforms. The bridge is important: a forward-KL warmup on teacher rollouts followed by OPD on student rollouts is consistently strongest on MATH before any post-bridge student-side sparse RL, and also gives the best pre-Stage~3 AIME endpoints for the canonical 8B/14B teachers. The bridge also makes later student-side sparse RL effective: GRPO that is weak on a cold student lifts MATH from $75.4\%$ to $78.5\%$ after the bridge and outperforms a matched replay control by $2.8$ points. The operational principal is to avoid using scarce labeled data on the least prepared policy: use sparse reward for teacher-side discovery, dense transfer for student compression, and student-side sparse reward only after the bridge.

item.title: Elastic Attention Cores for Scalable Vision Transformers
item.author: Alan Z. Song, Yinjie Chen, Mu Nan, Rui Zhang, Jiahang Cao, Weijian Mai, Muquan Yu, Hossein Adeli, Deva Ramanan, Michael J. Tarr, Andrew F. Luo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种名为 VECA 的视觉 Transformer 架构，通过核心-周边结构注意力机制，在无需直接 patch 交互的情况下实现线性复杂度的视觉表示学习。

背景: 现有的 Vision Transformers (ViTs) 虽然性能强大，但利用全自注意力机制导致计算成本随图像分辨率呈二次方增长，限制了其在高分辨率领域的应用。

目的: 挑战‘成对 token 交互对于学习丰富视觉语义表示是必要的’这一假设，旨在证明无需直接 patch-to-patch 交互即可学习有效的视觉表示。

方法: 提出视觉弹性核心注意力（VECA）架构。该方法使用少量学习到的‘核心’作为通信接口，图像块仅通过核心交换信息。核心从零初始化并在层间传播。结合沿核心轴的嵌套训练，模型可在推理时灵活权衡计算量和精度。

主要发现: VECA 在分类和密集任务上取得了与最新视觉基础模型竞争的性能，同时显著降低了计算成本。它证明了弹性核心-周边注意力是 Vision Transformers 的可扩展替代构建块。

结论: 该研究确立了弹性核心-周边注意力作为一种可扩展的替代方案，能够有效解决 ViTs 的计算瓶颈问题。

翻译: Vision Transformers (ViTs) 通过利用全对全自注意力机制实现了强大的数据驱动扩展。然而，这种灵活性带来了随图像分辨率呈二次方增长的计算成本，限制了 ViTs 在高分辨率领域的应用。该方法背后的假设是成对 token 交互对于学习丰富的视觉语义表示是必要的。在这项工作中，我们挑战了这一假设，证明了无需任何直接 patch-to-patch 交互即可学习有效的视觉表示。我们提出了 VECA（Visual Elastic Core Attention），这是一种视觉 Transformer 架构，它使用由少量学习到的核心启用的高效线性时间核心-周边结构注意力。在 VECA 中，这些核心充当通信接口：patch token 仅通过核心 token 交换信息，这些核心从头初始化并跨层传播。由于 N 个图像 patch 仅与一组 C 个学习到的‘核心’嵌入（具有分辨率不变性）直接交互，这为预定的 C 产生了线性复杂度，从而绕过了二次方缩放。与先前的交叉注意力架构相比，VECA 保持并迭代更新完整的 N 个输入 token 集合，避免了小的 C 路瓶颈。结合沿核心轴的嵌套训练，我们的模型可以在推理期间灵活地权衡计算和精度。在分类和密集任务中，VECA 实现了与最新视觉基础模型竞争的性能，同时降低了计算成本。我们的结果确立了弹性核心-周边注意力作为 Vision Transformers 的可扩展替代构建块。

Abstract

Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong data-driven scaling by leveraging all-to-all self-attention. However, this flexibility incurs a computational cost that scales quadratically with image resolution, limiting ViTs in high-resolution domains. Underlying this approach is the assumption that pairwise token interactions are necessary for learning rich visual-semantic representations. In this work, we challenge this assumption, demonstrating that effective visual representations can be learned without any direct patch-to-patch interaction. We propose VECA (Visual Elastic Core Attention), a vision transformer architecture that uses efficient linear-time core-periphery structured attention enabled by a small set of learned cores. In VECA, these cores act as a communication interface: patch tokens exchange information exclusively through the core tokens, which are initialized from scratch and propagated across layers. Because the $N$ image patches only directly interact with a resolution invariant set of $C$ learned "core" embeddings, this yields linear complexity $O(N)$ for predetermined $C$, which bypasses quadratic scaling. Compared to prior cross-attention architectures, VECA maintains and iteratively updates the full set of $N$ input tokens, avoiding a small $C$-way bottleneck. Combined with nested training along the core axis, our model can elastically trade off compute and accuracy during inference. Across classification and dense tasks, VECA achieves performance competitive with the latest vision foundation models while reducing computational cost. Our results establish elastic core-periphery attention as a scalable alternative building block for Vision Transformers.

item.title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
item.author: Wu, Di, Ji, Zixiang, Kawatkar, Asmi, Kwan, Bryan, Gu, Jia-Chen, Peng, Nanyun, Chang, Kai-Wei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LongMemEval-V2是一个用于评估智能体在定制化环境中长期记忆能力的基准测试，包含451个精心策划的问题，涵盖五种核心记忆能力。

背景: 现有智能体记忆基准大多关注用户历史、短期轨迹或下游任务成功，缺乏直接评估记忆系统是否有效内化环境特定经验的手段。

目的: 引入LongMemEval-V2（LME-V2）基准，评估记忆系统是否能帮助智能体获得成为定制化环境中知识渊博同事所需的经验。

方法: LME-V2包含451个涵盖五种核心记忆能力的问题，与包含最多500条轨迹和1.15亿个令牌的历史轨迹配对。提出了两种记忆方法：基于RAG的AgentRunbook-R和基于代码代理的AgentRunbook-C。

主要发现: AgentRunbook-C在平均准确率上表现最佳，达到72.5%，优于最强的RAG基线（48.5%）和现成的代码代理基线（69.3%）。尽管性能提升显著，但基于代码代理的方法具有高延迟成本。

结论: LME-V2建立了一个具有挑战性的测试平台，用于开发环境经验的长期记忆系统。AgentRunbook-C推进了准确率-延迟帕累托前沿，但仍需改进。

翻译: 摘要：长期记忆对于专业网络环境中的智能体至关重要，其成功取决于回忆界面功能、状态动态、工作流程和重复出现的失败模式。然而，现有的智能体记忆基准大多关注用户历史、短期轨迹或下游任务成功，留下了如何直接评估记忆系统是否有效内化环境特定经验的问题。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍了LongMemEval-V2（LME-V2），这是一个用于评估记忆系统是否能帮助智能体获得成为定制化环境中知识渊博同事所需经验的基准。LME-V2包含451个精心策划的问题，涵盖智能体五种核心记忆能力：静态状态回忆、动态状态跟踪、工作流知识、环境陷阱和前提意识。问题与包含最多500条轨迹和1.15亿个令牌的历史轨迹配对。我们使用上下文收集公式：记忆系统消耗历史轨迹并为下游问答返回紧凑的证据。我们提出了一套两种记忆方法：AgentRunbook-R，一种基于RAG的高效记忆，具有原始状态观察、事件和策略笔记的知识池；以及AgentRunbook-C，它将轨迹存储为文件并调用代码代理在增强的沙箱中收集证据。实验表明，AgentRunbook-C取得了最好的性能，平均准确率为72.5%，优于最强的RAG基线（48.5%）和现成的代码代理基线（69.3%）。尽管性能提升显著，但基于代码代理的方法具有高延迟成本。虽然AgentRunbook-C推进了准确率-延迟帕累托前沿，但仍需改进。这些结果共同确立了LME-V2作为开发环境经验长期记忆系统的具有挑战性的测试平台。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要关注如何评估智能体在长期交互中记忆和利用信息的能力，特别是针对与“经验丰富的同事”进行协作的场景。在现实应用中，智能体需要记住过去的交互细节以提供连贯的服务，这对构建可靠的 AI 助手至关重要。在研究中，这有助于填补当前模型在长期记忆能力方面的空白。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一个名为 LongMemEval-V2 的框架，用于评估长期代理记忆。

Abstract

Long-term memory is crucial for agents in specialized web environments, where success depends on recalling interface affordances, state dynamics, workflows, and recurring failure modes. However, existing memory benchmarks for agents mostly focus on user histories, short traces, or downstream task success, leaving open how to directly evaluate whether memory systems effectively internalize environment-specific experience. To address this gap, we introduce LongMemEval-V2 (LME-V2), a benchmark for evaluating whether memory systems can help agents acquire the experience needed to become knowledgeable colleagues in customized environments. LME-V2 contains 451 manually curated questions covering five core memory abilities for web agents: static state recall, dynamic state tracking, workflow knowledge, environment gotchas, and premise awareness. Questions are paired with history trajectories containing up to 500 trajectories and 115M tokens. We use a context gathering formulation: memory systems consume history trajectories and return compact evidence for downstream question answering. We propose a suite of two memory methods: AgentRunbook-R, an efficient RAG-based memory with knowledge pools for raw state observations, events, and strategy notes, and AgentRunbook-C, which stores trajectories as files and invokes a coding agent to gather evidence in an augmented sandbox. Experiments show that AgentRunbook-C achieves the best performance with 72.5% average accuracy, outperforming the strongest RAG baseline (48.5%) and the off-the-shelf coding agent baseline (69.3%). Despite the strong performance gains, coding agent based methods have high latency costs. While AgentRunbook-C advances the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier, substantial room for improvement remains. Together, these results establish LME-V2 as a challenging testbed for developing long-term memory systems for environment experience.

item.title: CausalCine: Real-Time Autoregressive Generation for Multi-Shot Video Narratives
item.author: Meng, Yihao, Liu, Zichen, Ouyang, Hao, Wang, Qiuyu, Cheng, Ka Leong, Yu, Yue, Wang, Hanlin, Li, Haobo, Zhu, Jiapeng, Zeng, Yanhong, Zhu, Xing, Shen, Yujun, Chen, Qifeng, Qu, Huamin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CausalCine是一个交互式自回归框架，将多镜头视频生成转化为在线导演过程，通过内容感知内存路由（CAMR）动态检索历史KV条目，实现跨镜头连贯性和实时交互生成。

背景: 现有自回归模型主要针对短时域延续训练，在处理电影级叙事时，常将长序列视为单一镜头的延伸，导致运动停滞和语义漂移。

目的: 为了解决现有自回归模型在电影级叙事中的不足，CausalCine旨在将多镜头视频生成转化为在线导演过程，实现跨镜头连贯性和实时交互生成。

方法: 首先在原生多镜头序列上训练因果基础模型以学习复杂的镜头转换先验；提出内容感知内存路由（CAMR），根据基于注意力的相关性分数而非时间邻近度动态检索历史KV条目；最后将因果基础模型蒸馏为几步生成器以实现实时交互生成。

主要发现: 实验表明CausalCine显著优于自回归基线，并接近双向模型的能力，同时解锁了因果生成的流式交互性。

结论: CausalCine成功实现了跨镜头连贯性和实时交互生成，在电影级叙事视频生成方面取得了显著进展。

翻译: 自回归视频生成旨在实现实时、开放式的合成。然而，电影级叙事不仅仅是单一场景的无限延伸；它需要通过演变的事件、视角转换和离散的镜头边界来推进。现有的自回归模型在这种设置下经常遇到困难。主要针对短视距延续进行训练，它们将长序列视为扩展的单镜头，不可避免地在长滚动过程中遭受运动停滞和语义漂移。为了弥合这一差距，我们介绍了CausalCine，这是一个交互式自回归框架，将多镜头视频生成转化为在线导演过程。CausalCine跨镜头变化因果生成，接受动态提示，并在不重新生成先前镜头的情况下重用上下文。为了实现这一点，我们首先在原生多镜头序列上训练因果基础模型以在加速之前学习复杂的镜头转换先验。然后，我们提出了内容感知内存路由（CAMR），它根据基于注意力的相关性分数而非时间邻近度动态检索历史KV条目，在有限的活跃内存下保持跨镜头连贯性。最后，我们将因果基础模型蒸馏为几步生成器以实现实时交互生成。广泛的实验表明，CausalCine显著优于自回归基线，并接近双向模型的能力，同时解锁了因果生成的流式交互性。演示可用在此处链接。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为 CausalCine 的方法，用于实时生成多镜头视频叙事。

Abstract

Autoregressive video generation aims at real-time, open-ended synthesis. Yet, cinematic storytelling is not merely the endless extension of a single scene; it requires progressing through evolving events, viewpoint shifts, and discrete shot boundaries. Existing autoregressive models often struggle in this setting. Trained primarily for short-horizon continuation, they treat long sequences as extended single shots, inevitably suffering from motion stagnation and semantic drift during long rollouts. To bridge this gap, we introduce CausalCine, an interactive autoregressive framework that transforms multi-shot video generation into an online directing process. CausalCine generates causally across shot changes, accepts dynamic prompts on the fly, and reuses context without regenerating previous shots. To achieve this, we first train a causal base model on native multi-shot sequences to learn complex shot transitions prior to acceleration. We then propose Content-Aware Memory Routing (CAMR), which dynamically retrieves historical KV entries according to attention-based relevance scores rather than temporal proximity, preserving cross-shot coherence under bounded active memory. Finally, we distill the causal base model into a few-step generator for real-time interactive generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CausalCine significantly outperforms autoregressive baselines and approaches the capability of bidirectional models while unlocking the streaming interactivity of causal generation. Demo available at this https URL

item.title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture
item.author: Diao, Haiwen, Wu, Penghao, Deng, Hanming, Wang, Jiahao, Bai, Shihao, Wu, Silei, Fan, Weichen, Ye, Wenjie, Tong, Wenwen, Fan, Xiangyu, Li, Yan, Wang, Yubo, Cao, Zhijie, Lin, Zhiqian, Yang, Zhitao, Cai, Zhongang, Niu, Yuwei, Zhu, Yue, Liu, Bo, Lv, Chengguang, Yu, Haojia, Xie, Haozhe, Wang, Hongli, Fan, Jianan, Li, Jiaqi, Lu, Jiefan, Ni, Jingcheng, Xu, Junxiang, Liang, Kaihuan, Shi, Lianqiang, Dai, Linjun, Wang, Linyan, Qian, Oscar, Gao, Peng, Liu, Pengfei, Sun, Qingping, Shen, Rui, Wang, Ruisi, Ma, Shengnan, Yang, Shuang, Xie, Siyi, Li, Siying, Zhong, Tianbo, Kong, Xiangli, Shi, Xuanke, Gao, Yang, Yao, Yongqiang, Wang, Yves, Bai, Zhengqi, Lin, Zhengyu, Yin, Zixin, Sun, Wenxiu, Gong, Ruihao, Wang, Quan, Lu, Lewei, Yang, Lei, Liu, Ziwei, Lin, Dahua
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SenseNova-U1 是一种原生统一多模态范式，旨在解决大型视觉语言模型中理解与生成分离的问题，通过 NEO-unify 架构将两者视为单一过程的协同视图。

背景: 大型视觉语言模型存在理解与生成被视为不同问题的持久二分法，导致架构碎片化、级联管道和表示空间错位，阻碍了原生多模态智能的出现。

目的: 提出 SenseNova-U1，一种基于 NEO-unify 的原生统一多模态范式，旨在消除理解与生成之间的分离，促进原生多模态智能的涌现。

方法: 构建了 SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT 和 SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT 两个原生统一变体，分别基于稠密（8B）和混合专家（30B-A3B）理解基线，并详细介绍了模型设计、数据预处理、预/后训练及推理策略。

主要发现: 模型在文本理解、视觉语言感知、知识推理、代理决策和空间智能方面可与顶级仅理解 VLM 相媲美；在语义一致性和视觉保真度方面表现出色，特别是在文本丰富信息图生成和交错视觉语言生成方面；初步证据表明模型在视觉语言动作和世界模型场景中表现强劲。

结论: 多模态 AI 不再是连接独立系统，而是构建统一系统，并信任从内部涌现的必要能力。

翻译: 大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）仍然受到持久二分法的根本限制：理解和生成被视为不同问题，导致架构碎片化、级联管道和表示空间错位。我们认为这种分裂不仅仅是工程产物，而是一种阻碍原生多模态智能出现的结构性限制。因此，我们介绍了 SenseNova-U1，一种基于 NEO-unify 的原生统一多模态范式，其中理解和生成演变为单一底层过程的协同视图。我们推出了两个原生统一变体 SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT 和 SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT，分别基于稠密（8B）和混合专家（30B-A3B）理解基线。它们从第一性原理设计，在文本理解、视觉语言感知、知识推理、代理决策和空间智能方面可与顶级仅理解 VLM 相媲美。同时，它们在语义一致性和视觉保真度方面表现出色，在传统或知识密集型的任何到图像合成、复杂的文本丰富信息图生成以及有无思维模式的交错视觉语言生成方面表现出色。除了性能之外，我们展示了支持社区研究的详细模型设计、数据预处理、预/后训练和推理策略。最后但同样重要的是，初步证据表明我们的模型超越了感知和生成，在视觉语言动作和世界模型场景中表现强劲。这指向了一条更广泛的路线图，即模型不是在不同模态之间翻译，而是以原生方式在它们之间思考和行动。多模态 AI 不再是关于连接独立的系统，而是关于构建一个统一的系统，并信任从内部涌现的必要能力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决多模态模型中“理解”和“生成”能力不统一的问题。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为目前的模型通常需要分别训练，而统一架构能更高效地处理图像和文本，更接近人类同时感知和创造的能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) remain fundamentally constrained by a persistent dichotomy: understanding and generation are treated as distinct problems, leading to fragmented architectures, cascaded pipelines, and misaligned representation spaces. We argue that this divide is not merely an engineering artifact, but a structural limitation that hinders the emergence of native multimodal intelligence. Hence, we introduce SenseNova-U1, a native unified multimodal paradigm built upon NEO-unify, in which understanding and generation evolve as synergistic views of a single underlying process. We launch two native unified variants, SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT and SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT, built on dense (8B) and mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B) understanding baselines, respectively. Designed from first principles, they rival top-tier understanding-only VLMs across text understanding, vision-language perception, knowledge reasoning, agentic decision-making, and spatial intelligence. Meanwhile, they deliver strong semantic consistency and visual fidelity, excelling in conventional or knowledge-intensive any-to-image (X2I) synthesis, complex text-rich infographic generation, and interleaved vision-language generation, with or without think patterns. Beyond performance, we show detailed model design, data preprocessing, pre-/post-training, and inference strategies to support community research. Last but not least, preliminary evidence demonstrates that our models extend beyond perception and generation, performing strongly in vision-language-action (VLA) and world model (WM) scenarios. This points toward a broader roadmap where models do not translate between modalities, but think and act across them in a native manner. Multimodal AI is no longer about connecting separate systems, but about building a unified one and trusting the necessary capabilities to emerge from within.

item.title: M2Retinexformer: Multi-Modal Retinexformer for Low-Light Image Enhancement
item.author: Youssef Aboelwafa, Hicham G. Elmongui, Marwan Torki
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为M2Retinexformer的新框架，通过结合深度、亮度和语义特征来增强低光图像。

背景: 低光图像增强面临复杂退化问题，包括噪声放大、伪影和颜色失真。现有的基于Retinex的深度学习方法主要依赖单模态RGB信息。

目的: 为了解决现有方法主要依赖单模态RGB信息的问题，提出一种新的多模态框架来提升低光图像增强效果。

方法: 在Retinexformer基础上，引入深度线索、亮度先验和语义特征。通过渐进式细化管道，在多尺度上提取模态并通过交叉注意力进行融合。利用自适应门控机制根据辅助线索的可靠性动态平衡光照引导的自注意力与交叉注意力。

主要发现: 在LOL、SID、SMID和SDSD基准测试中，相比Retinexformer和最新的最先进方法，整体性能有所提升。

结论: 该方法在多个基准测试中表现优于现有方法，代码和预训练权重已开源。

翻译: 低光图像增强由于复杂的退化而具有挑战性，包括放大的噪声、伪影和颜色失真。虽然基于Retinex的深度学习方法取得了有希望的结果，但它们主要依赖单模态RGB信息。我们提出了M2Retinexformer，这是一个新颖的框架，通过在渐进式细化管道中结合深度线索、亮度先验和语义特征来扩展Retinexformer。深度提供了对光照变化不变的几何上下文，而亮度和语义特征提供了关于亮度分布和场景理解的明确指导。模态在多个尺度上被提取并通过交叉注意力融合，自适应门控根据辅助线索的可靠性动态平衡光照引导的自注意力和交叉注意力。在LOL、SID、SMID和SDSD基准测试上的评估表明，与Retinexformer和最新的最先进方法相比有整体改进。代码和预训练权重可在https://github.com/YoussefAboelwafa/M2Retinexformer获得。

Abstract

Low-light image enhancement is challenging due to complex degradations, including amplified noise, artifacts, and color distortion. While Retinex-based deep learning methods have achieved promising results, they primarily rely on single-modality RGB information. We propose M2Retinexformer (Multi-Modal Retinexformer), a novel framework that extends Retinexformer by incorporating depth cues, luminance priors, and semantic features within a progressive refinement pipeline. Depth provides geometric context that is invariant to lighting variations, while luminance and semantic features offer explicit guidance on brightness distribution and scene understanding. Modalities are extracted at multiple scales and fused through cross-attention, with adaptive gating dynamically balancing illumination-guided self-attention and cross-attention based on the reliability of auxiliary cues. Evaluations on the LOL, SID, SMID, and SDSD benchmarks demonstrate overall improvements over Retinexformer and recent state-of-the-art methods. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/YoussefAboelwafa/M2Retinexformer

item.title: Pyramid Self-contrastive Learning Framework for Test-time Ultrasound Image Denoising
item.author: Jiajing Zhang, Bingze Dai, Xi Zhang, Yue Xu, Wei-Ning Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种纯测试时训练框架，用于单次超声图像去噪，并将其应用于合成孔径超声（SAU）。

背景: 超声图像中存在固有的电子和散斑噪声，传统去噪方法依赖于显式的噪声假设，在复合噪声条件下有效性降低；基于学习的方法需要大量标注数据和模型参数，且在复杂体内环境中存在不可避免的域偏移，导致去噪效果受限且细节模糊。

目的: 提出一种纯测试时训练框架，实现单次超声图像去噪，消除域偏移和预训练成本，提高图像质量。

方法: 提出A2A框架，通过金字塔潜在空间中的自对比学习解耦解剖相似性和噪声随机性，从解剖空间解码干净图像并丢弃噪声空间；在测试时仅用单个噪声样本进行训练。

主要发现: 仿真实验显示A2A在电子噪声0至30dB及不同包含几何形状下，信噪比（SNR）提升69.3%，对比度噪声比（CNR）提升34.4%；体内实验在六种超声心动图视图、肝脏和肾脏中，仅使用两个孔径数据，SNR提升84.8%，CNR提升25.7%。

结论: A2A在多种成像目标和配置下均能提供清晰图像/信号，为更可靠的解剖可视化和功能评估铺平了道路。

翻译: 超声图像中固有的电子和散斑噪声使得临床解释变得复杂。传统的去噪方法依赖于显式的噪声假设，这些假设在复合噪声条件下有效性降低。基于学习的方法需要大量标注数据和模型参数。这些预定义和预训练的方式在复杂的体内环境中不可避免地导致域偏移，因此它们仅限于特定的噪声类型，并且经常模糊结构细节。在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于单次超声图像去噪的纯测试时训练框架，并将其应用于合成孔径超声（SAU），后者通过子孔径传输合成发射焦点。我们的孔径到孔径（A2A）框架通过金字塔潜在空间中的自对比学习，从打乱的子孔径中解耦解剖相似性和噪声随机性。然后从解剖空间解码干净图像，同时丢弃噪声空间。A2A在测试时在SAU信号的单个噪声样本上进行训练，因此从根本上消除了域偏移和预训练成本。包括0至30dB电子噪声水平和不同包含几何形状的仿真实验表明，A2A使SNR提高了69.3%，CNR提高了34.4%。体内结果显示，在六种超声心动图视图、肝脏和肾脏中，仅使用心脏的两个孔径数据，SNR提高了84.8%，CNR提高了25.7%。A2A在各种成像目标和配置下提供清晰的图像/信号，为通过超声进行更可靠的解剖可视化和功能评估铺平了道路。

Abstract

The inherent electronic and speckle noise complicates clinical interpretation of ultrasound images. Conventional denoising methods rely on explicit noise assumptions whose validity diminishes under composite noise conditions. Learning-based methods require massive labeled data and model parameters. These pre-defined and pre-trained manners entail an inevitable domain shift in complex in vivo environments, so they are limited to a specific noise type and often blur structural details. In this study, we propose a pure test-time training framework for one-shot ultrasound image denoising and apply it to synthetic aperture ultrasound (SAU), which synthesizes transmit focus from sub-aperture transmissions. Our Aperture-to-Aperture (A2A) framework disentangles anatomical similarity and noise randomness from shuffled sub-apertures through self-contrastive learning in pyramid latent spaces. The clean image is then decoded from the anatomy space, while discarding the noise space. A2A is trained at test time on one noisy sample of SAU signals, so it fundamentally eliminates the domain shift and pretraining costs. Simulation experiments, including electronic noise levels of 0 to 30 dB and different inclusion geometries, demonstrated an improvement of 69.3% SNR and 34.4% CNR by A2A. The in vivo results showed 84.8% SNR and 25.7% CNR gains using only two aperture data of the heart in six echocardiographic views, liver, and kidney. A2A delivers clear images/signals across diverse imaging targets and configurations, paving the way for more reliable anatomical visualization and functional assessment by ultrasound.

item.title: 3D Primitives are a Spatial Language for VLMs
item.author: Junze Liu, Kun Qian, Florian Dubost, Kai Zhong, Arvind Srinivasan, Nan Chen, Anping Wang, Sam Zhang, Alejandro Mottini, Qingjun Cui, Tian Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了视觉语言模型在空间推理方面的表现，发现几何原语代码作为强大的中间表示，提出了SpatialBabel基准、Code-CoT推理策略和S³-FT自监督微调方法，显著提升了模型的空间推理能力。

背景: 视觉语言模型在生成可执行代码重建3D场景时表现出色，但在处理简单的空间问题时却失败。3D几何原语（如立方体、球体、圆柱体）在代码中的表达被证明是空间理解的有力中间表示。

目的: 通过三个贡献来利用3D几何原语代码作为空间理解的有力中间表示：1. 引入SpatialBabel基准评估14个VLMs；2. 提出Code-CoT推理策略；3. 提出S³-FT自监督微调方法。

方法: 1. SpatialBabel：评估14个VLMs在基于原语的3D场景重建上的表现，涵盖6种场景代码语言；2. Code-CoT：一种无训练的推理策略，通过基于原语的代码生成进行空间推理；3. S³-FT：一种自监督微调方法，将模型自身的Three.js原语重建解析为结构化注释进行微调，无需人工标签或教师模型。

主要发现: 1. 单个模型的物体检测F1分数在不同语言间可相差高达5.7倍；2. Code-CoT在原语场景上提升SpatialBabel-QA-Score高达6.4%，在强编码能力的VLMs上提升CV-Bench-3D准确率5.0%；3. S³-FT在仅使用原语图像训练的情况下，显著提升了Qwen3-VL-8B在多个基准上的表现；4. 几何原语代码被确立为VLMs的诊断和可转移的空间词汇。

结论: 几何原语代码被确立为VLMs的诊断和可转移的空间词汇。本文提出的三个方法有效提升了视觉语言模型的空间推理能力。

翻译: 视觉语言模型表现出一个显著的悖论：它们可以生成可执行代码来重建3D场景，场景包含正确的物体数量、类别和近似位置，但在同一张图像上却无法回答更简单的空间问题。我们展示了3D几何原语（立方体、球体、圆柱体，以可执行代码形式表达）作为空间理解的有力中间表示，并利用这一点通过三个贡献来实现。首先，我们介绍了SpatialBabel，这是一个基准测试，评估了14个VLMs在基于原语的3D场景重建上的表现，涵盖了6种场景代码语言（3D原语场景的编程语言和声明式格式），发现单个模型的物体检测F1分数在不同语言间可相差高达5.7倍。其次，我们提出了Code-CoT（代码思维链），这是一种无训练的推理策略，通过基于原语的代码生成进行空间推理。Code-CoT在原语场景上提升了SpatialBabel-QA-Score高达6.4%，在具有强编码能力的VLMs上提升了CV-Bench-3D准确率5.0%。第三，我们提出了S³-FT（自监督空间微调），它通过将模型自身的Three.js原语重建解析为结构化注释并基于结果进行微调，将原语空间知识自监督地蒸馏到通用视觉推理中，无需人工标签和教师模型。仅在原语图像上训练，S³-FT在SpatialBabel-Primitive-QA上提升了Qwen3-VL-8B 4.6%到8.6%，在CV-Bench-2D上提升了9.7%，在HallusionBench上提升了17%；该配方在不同模型家族间可迁移。这些结果确立了代码中的几何原语作为VLMs的诊断和可转移的空间词汇。我们将在发表时发布所有工件。

Abstract

Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit a striking paradox: they can generate executable code that reconstructs a 3D scene from geometric primitives with correct object counts, classes, and approximate positions, yet the same models fail at simpler spatial questions on the same image. We show that 3D geometric primitives (cubes, spheres, cylinders, expressed in executable code) serve as a powerful intermediate representation for spatial understanding, and exploit this through three contributions. First, we introduce \textbf{\textsc{SpatialBabel}}, a benchmark evaluating fourteen VLMs on primitive-based 3D scene reconstruction across six \emph{scene-code languages} (programming languages and declarative formats for 3D primitive scenes), revealing that a single model's object-detection F1 can vary by up to $5.7\times$ across languages. Second, we propose \textbf{Code-CoT} (Code Chain-of-Thought), a training-free inference strategy that routes spatial reasoning through primitive-based code generation. Code-CoT lifts the SpatialBabel-QA-Score by up to $+6.4$\% on primitive scenes and real-photo CV-Bench-3D accuracy by $+5.0$\% for VLMs with strong coding capabilities. Third, we propose \textbf{S$^{3}$-FT} (Self-Supervised Spatial Fine-Tuning), which self-supervisedly distills primitive spatial knowledge into general visual reasoning by parsing the model's own Three.js primitive-reconstructions into structured annotations and fine-tuning on the result, with \emph{no human labels and no teacher model}. Training on primitive images alone, S$^3$-FT improves Qwen3-VL-8B by $+4.6$ to $+8.6$\% on SpatialBabel-Primitive-QA, $+9.7$\% on CV-Bench-2D, and $+17$\% on HallusionBench; the recipe transfers across model families. These results establish geometric primitives in code as both a diagnostic and a transferable spatial vocabulary for VLMs. We will release all artifacts upon publication.

item.title: TrackCraft3R: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Dense 3D Tracking
item.author: Jisu Nam, Jahyeok Koo, Soowon Son, Jaewoo Jung, Honggyu An, Junhwa Hur, Seungryong Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TrackCraft3R是一种将视频扩散Transformer转换为前馈密集3D跟踪器的方法，通过双潜在表示和时间RoPE对齐设计，在单次前向传递中预测参考锚定跟踪点图及其可见性，在标准稀疏和密集3D跟踪基准上实现了最先进的性能，同时比最强先前的运行速度快1.3倍，峰值内存使用量少4.6倍。

背景: 从单目视频进行密集3D跟踪是动态场景理解的基础。虽然最近的3D基础模型提供了可靠的逐帧几何信息，但从中恢复物体运动仍然具有挑战性，并且受益于从真实世界视频中学习的强运动先验。现有的3D跟踪器要么遵循在合成数据上从头训练的迭代范式，要么微调从静态多视图图像学习的3D重建模型，两者都缺乏真实世界的运动先验。

目的: 提出TrackCraft3R，这是第一个将视频DiT重新用作前馈密集3D跟踪器的方法。

方法: TrackCraft3R通过两个设计实现：1. 双潜在表示，使用逐帧几何潜在和参考锚定跟踪潜在作为密集查询；2. 时间RoPE对齐，指定每个跟踪潜在的目标时间戳。这些设计将视频DiT的逐帧生成范式转换为参考锚定跟踪公式，并使用LoRA微调。

主要发现: TrackCraft3R在标准稀疏和密集3D跟踪基准上实现了最先进的性能，同时比最强先前的运行速度快1.3倍，峰值内存使用量少4.6倍。

结论: TrackCraft3R对大运动和长视频表现出鲁棒性。

翻译: 从单目视频进行密集3D跟踪是动态场景理解的基础。虽然最近的3D基础模型提供了可靠的逐帧几何信息，但从中恢复物体运动仍然具有挑战性，并且受益于从真实世界视频中学习的强运动先验。现有的3D跟踪器要么遵循在合成数据上从头训练的迭代范式，要么微调从静态多视图图像学习的3D重建模型，两者都缺乏真实世界的运动先验。预训练的视频扩散Transformer（视频DiTs）从互联网规模的视频中提供了丰富的时空先验，使其成为3D跟踪的有前景的基础。然而，它们的帧锚定公式，即生成每一帧的内容，与参考锚定的密集3D跟踪根本不匹配，后者必须从参考帧跟随相同的物理点随时间变化。我们提出了TrackCraft3R，这是第一个将视频DiT重新用作前馈密集3D跟踪器的方法。给定单目视频及其帧锚定的重建点图，TrackCraft3R在单次前向传递中预测参考锚定的跟踪点图，该点图随时间跟随第一帧的每个像素，以及其可见性。我们通过两个设计实现了这一点：1. 双潜在表示，使用逐帧几何潜在和参考锚定跟踪潜在作为密集查询；2. 时间RoPE对齐，指定每个跟踪潜在的目标时间戳。这些设计将视频DiT的逐帧生成范式转换为参考锚定跟踪公式，并使用LoRA微调。TrackCraft3R在标准稀疏和密集3D跟踪基准上实现了最先进的性能，同时比最强先前的运行速度快1.3倍，峰值内存使用量少4.6倍。我们进一步证明了其对大运动和长视频的鲁棒性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种利用视频扩散 Transformer 进行密集 3D 跟踪的新方法。

Abstract

Dense 3D tracking from monocular video is fundamental to dynamic scene understanding. While recent 3D foundation models provide reliable per-frame geometry, recovering object motion in this geometry remains challenging and benefits from strong motion priors learned from real-world videos. Existing 3D trackers either follow iterative paradigms trained from scratch on synthetic data or fine-tune 3D reconstruction models learned from static multi-view images, both lacking real-world motion priors. Pre-trained video diffusion transformers (video DiTs) offer rich spatio-temporal priors from internet-scale videos, making them a promising foundation for 3D tracking. However, their frame-anchored formulation, which generates each frame's content, is fundamentally mismatched with reference-anchored dense 3D tracking, which must follow the same physical points from a reference frame across time. We present TrackCraft3R, the first method to repurpose a video DiT as a feed-forward dense 3D tracker. Given a monocular video and its frame-anchored reconstruction pointmap, TrackCraft3R predicts a reference-anchored tracking pointmap that follows every pixel of the first frame across time in a single forward pass, along with its visibility. We achieve this through two designs: (i) a dual-latent representation that uses per-frame geometry latents and reference-anchored track latents as dense queries, and (ii) temporal RoPE alignment, which specifies the target timestamp of each track latent. Together, these designs convert the per-frame generative paradigm of video DiTs into a reference-anchored tracking formulation with LoRA fine-tuning. TrackCraft3R achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard sparse and dense 3D tracking benchmarks, while running 1.3x faster and using 4.6x less peak memory than the strongest prior method. We further demonstrate robustness to large motions and long videos.

item.title: Action Emergence from Streaming Intent
item.author: Pengfei Jing, Victor Shea-Jay Huang, Hengtong Lu, Jifeng Dai, Xie Yan, Benjin Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Streaming Intent（SI）的方法，旨在实现端到端自动驾驶中的动作涌现，即通过场景条件推理生成物理可行、语义恰当且安全合规的动作。SI通过语义流式传递和时序流式传递机制，使驾驶意图从场景理解中因果推导，并在驾驶时间范围内保持连贯性。SI模型在Waymo基准测试中表现良好，并首次在端到端VLA模型中展示了意图忠实可控性。

背景: 现有的自动驾驶范式无法有效实现动作涌现：自回归轨迹解码器将多模态未来坍缩为单一平均输出，而扩散和流匹配生成器虽然表达多模态但无法由 reasoned intent 引导。

目的: 实现动作涌现作为端到端自动驾驶的目标能力，即通过场景条件推理而非检索或插值学习场景-动作映射来生成物理可行、语义恰当且安全合规的动作。

方法: 提出Streaming Intent（SI）机制，使驾驶意图通过连续的思维链从场景理解中因果推导，并在时间上流式传递以保持连贯性。SI模型自回归解码四步思维链并发出意图令牌，该意图驱动分类器无引导（CFG）在流匹配动作头上生成最终轨迹，仅需两个去噪步骤。

主要发现: SI在Waymo端到端基准测试中取得了有竞争力的整体性能，验证集RFS得分为7.96，测试集为7.74。SI首次在完全端到端VLA模型中展示了意图忠实可控性：对于固定场景，在推理时改变意图类别会产生定性上不同但始终高质量的计划。

结论: SI通过数据驱动学习实现了意图忠实可控性，无需预构建轨迹库或手工编码的后处理选择器。

翻译: We formalize action emergence as a target capability for end-to-end autonomous driving: the ability to generate physically feasible, semantically appropriate, and safety-compliant actions in arbitrary, long-tail traffic scenes through scene-conditioned reasoning rather than retrieval or interpolation of learned scene-action mappings. We show that previous paradigms cannot deliver action emergence: autoregressive trajectory decoders collapse the inherently multimodal future into a single averaged output, while diffusion and flow-matching generators express multimodality but are not steerable by reasoned intent. We propose Streaming Intent as a concrete way to approach action emergence: a mechanism that makes driving intent (i) semantically streamed through a continuous chain-of-thought that causally derives the intent from scene understanding, and (ii) temporally streamed across clips so that intent commitments remain coherent along the driving horizon. We realize Streaming Intent in a VLA model we call SI (Streaming Intent). SI autoregressively decodes a four-step chain-of-thought and emits an intent token; the decoded intent then drives classifier-free guidance (CFG) on a flow-matching action head, requiring only two denoising steps to generate the final trajectory. On the Waymo End-to-End benchmark, SI achieves competitive aggregate performance, with an RFS score of 7.96 on the validation set and 7.74 on the test set. Beyond aggregate metrics, the model demonstrates -- to our knowledge for the first time in a fully end-to-end VLA -- intent-faithful controllability: for a fixed scene, varying the intent class at inference yields qualitatively distinct yet consistently high-quality plans, arising purely from data-driven learning without any pre-built trajectory bank or hand-coded post-hoc selector.

We realize Streaming Intent in a VLA model we call SI (Streaming Intent). SI autoregressively decodes a four-step chain-of-thought and emits an intent token; the decoded intent then drives classifier-free guidance (CFG) on a flow-matching action head, requiring only two denoising steps to generate the final trajectory. On the Waymo End-to-End benchmark, SI achieves competitive aggregate performance, with an RFS score of 7.96 on the validation set and 7.74 on the test set.
