Across eight downstream EEG benchmarks, TRACE is evaluated in both settings: when downstream domains are seen only as unlabeled pre-training data and when downstream datasets are completely unseen during pre-training. It obtains the best results on several benchmarks while remaining competitive on motor imagery and clinical event classification tasks, with ablations supporting the importance of cross-channel temporal routing.

item.title: Kairos: A Scalable Serving System for Physical AI
item.author: Yinwei Dai, Ganesh Ananthanarayanan, Landon Cox, Xenofon Foukas, Bozidar Radunovic, Ravi Netravali
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Physical AI 任务具有多轮推理和异步执行的特性，现有数字 AI 服务系统不适用。本文提出 Kairos 系统，通过将生成-执行循环作为一等公民，显著降低了任务延迟。

背景: Physical AI 正在快速增长，其任务特性与数字 AI 不同，涉及多轮推理和异步交错。现有的数字 AI 服务系统不适合 Physical AI，限制了其广泛采用。

目的: 设计一个专门针对 Physical AI 的多机器人服务系统，以解决现有系统不适用的问题。

方法: 设计了 Kairos 系统，将生成-执行循环作为一等公民，并在执行阶段积极参与。

主要发现: Kairos 将平均端到端任务延迟降低了 31.8% 到 66.5%，且性能随机器人车队规模扩大而提升。

结论: Kairos 有效地解决了 Physical AI 的服务瓶颈，显著提升了系统性能。

翻译: Physical AI 正随着前沿基础模型在通用环境中能力的提升而迅速增长。Physical AI 任务具有与数字 AI 显著不同的推理特性。它们由多轮推理和动作执行组成，每轮生成一组动作，并异步交错推理和执行。这使得现有的数字 AI 服务系统不适合 Physical AI；考虑到其规模和必须服务的机器人车队规模，这一缺陷对于实现其广泛采用至关重要。为了填补这一空白，我们设计了 Kairos，这是第一个多机器人服务系统，它将生成-执行循环作为一等公民，并在执行阶段积极参与。在广泛的 Physical AI 模型和机器人上，Kairos 将平均端到端任务延迟比最先进的数字 AI 服务实践降低了 31.8% 到 66.5%，且收益随机器人车队规模的扩大而增加。

Abstract

Physical AI is experiencing rapid growth with frontier foundation models increasing its capabilities across general environments. Physical AI tasks are characterized by inference properties that are markedly different from digital AI. They consist of multiple rounds of inference and action execution, generating a chunk of actions in each inference round, and asynchronously interleaving inference and execution. This makes existing digital AI serving systems unsuited for physical AI; a shortcoming that is critical for enabling their wide adoption, considering their size and the scale of the robot fleets they have to serve. To fill this gap, we design Kairos, the first multi-robot serving system that makes the generate-execute loop a first-class citizen, with active involvement in the execution phase. Across a wide range of physical AI models and robots, Kairos reduces the average end-to-end task latency by 31.8--66.5% over state-of-the-art digital AI serving practices, with gains scaling with the robot fleet size.

item.title: Encore: Conditioning Trajectory Forecasting via Biased Ego Rehearsals
item.author: Conghao Wong, Ziqian Zou, Xinge You
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Encore 的轨迹预测模型，受心理学预想思维和戏剧概念启发，将主体性视为从排练到谢幕的连续过程，通过显式偏置的排练轨迹来模拟和预测代理的主体性。

背景: 在轨迹预测任务中，学习和表示代理的主体性是一个具有挑战性但至关重要的问题。主体性具有特定的空间或时间结构，且对所有交互参与者具有各向异性。尽管做出了巨大努力，但显式学习、预测这些主体性仍然困难，更不用说通过特定自我的主体性来调节模型的预测了。

目的: 为了解决显式学习、预测代理主体性以及通过特定自我的主体性调节模型预测的难题。

方法: 本文受心理学中的预想思维和戏剧概念的启发，将未来轨迹中的主体性解释为从排练到谢幕的连续过程。在排练阶段，提出的自我预测器专注于每个自我代理如何从短期观察中推导并引导一组显式偏置的排练轨迹。这些排练轨迹作为即时控制条件，为预测网络提供直接且独特的自我偏置，以模拟代理的各种主体性。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，所提出的 Encore 轨迹预测模型在多个数据集上性能一致提升，并且关于主体性作为偏置的自我排练提供了清晰的解释性。

结论: 该方法有效地模拟了代理的各种主体性，通过排练轨迹作为即时控制条件，显著提高了轨迹预测的性能，并提供了对主体性的可解释性。

翻译: 学习和表示代理的主体性已成为轨迹预测任务中一个具有挑战性但至关重要的问题。这种主体性不仅呈现特定的空间或时间结构，而且对所有交互参与者都是各向异性的。尽管做出了巨大努力，但显式学习和预测这些主体性仍然困难，更不用说通过特定自我的主体性进一步调节模型的预测了。受心理学中的预想思维和相关戏剧概念的启发，我们将未来轨迹中的这种主体性解释为从排练到谢幕的连续过程。在排练阶段，提出的自我预测器专注于每个自我代理如何从短期观察中推导并引导场景中所有参与者的显式偏置排练轨迹。然后，这些排练轨迹作为即时控制条件，为预测网络提供直接且独特的自我偏置，以模拟代理的各种主体性。跨数据集的实验不仅证明了所提出的 Encore 轨迹预测模型性能的一致提高，而且关于主体性作为偏置的自我排练提供了清晰的解释性。

Abstract

Learning and representing the subjectivities of agents has become a challenging but crucial problem in the trajectory prediction task. Such subjectivities not only present specific spatial or temporal structures, but also are anisotropic for all interaction participants. Despite great efforts, it remains difficult to explicitly learn and forecast these subjectivities, let alone further modulate models' predictions through a specific ego's subjectivity. Inspired by prefactual thoughts in psychology and relevant theatrical concepts, we interpret such subjectivities in future trajectories as the continuous process from rehearsal to encore. In the rehearsal phase, the proposed ego predictor focuses on how each ego agent learns to derive and direct a set of explicitly biased rehearsal trajectories for all participants in the scene from the short-term observations. Then, these rehearsal trajectories serve as immediate controls to condition final predictions, providing direct yet distinct ego biases for the prediction network to simulate agents' various subjectivities. Experiments across datasets not only demonstrate a consistent improvement in the performance of the proposed \emph{Encore} trajectory prediction model but also provide clear interpretability regarding subjectivities as biased ego rehearsals.

item.title: CAMPA: Efficient and Aligned Multimodal Graph Learning via Decoupled Propagation and Aggregation
item.author: Daohan Su, Hao Liu, Xunkai Li, Yinlin Zhu, Xiong Yongfu, Yi Liu, Hongchao Qin, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CAMPA的解耦多模态图学习框架，通过跨模态对齐机制解决模态冲突问题，在保持解耦效率的同时提升模型性能。

背景: 多模态图神经网络在多模态属性图学习中具有潜力，但现有方法多采用紧耦合架构，计算开销大。虽然解耦架构更高效，但存在模态冲突瓶颈，限制了有效表示学习。

目的: 为了解决现有解耦多模态图学习管道中存在的模态冲突瓶颈，提出一种新的框架以提升表示学习效果。

方法: 提出CAMPA框架，包含两个阶段：跨模态对齐的传播和轨迹对齐的聚合。传播阶段通过注入跨模态相似性先验来保持语义一致性；聚合阶段利用轨迹级自注意力和交叉注意力来捕获和对齐跨模态和跨跳的长期依赖。

主要发现: 解耦架构比紧耦合架构更高效且可扩展；CAMPA通过跨模态对齐机制有效解决了模态冲突问题，在多个基准数据集和任务上优于强基线。

结论: CAMPA在保持解耦架构效率优势的同时，显著提升了模型性能，在多种基准数据集和任务上表现优异。

翻译: Multimodal Graph Neural Networks (MGNNs) have shown strong potential for learning from multimodal attributed graphs, yet most existing approaches rely on tightly coupled architectures that suffer from prohibitive computational overhead. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical analysis showing that decoupled MGNNs are substantially more efficient and scalable for large-scale graph learning. However, we identify a critical bottleneck in existing decoupled pipelines, namely modal conflict, which arises in both the propagation and aggregation stages. Specifically, independent multi-hop diffusion causes cross-modal semantic divergence during propagation, while naive fusion fails to align multi-hop feature trajectories during aggregation, jointly limiting effective representation learning. To address this challenge, we propose CAMPA, a Cross-modal Aligned Multimodal Propagation & Aligment framework for decoupled multimodal graph learning. Concretely, CAMPA introduces a two-stage alignment mechanism: (1) cross-modal aligned propagation, which injects cross-modal similarity priors into message passing to preserve semantic consistency without additional parameter overhead; (2) trajectory aligned aggregation, which leverages trajectory-level self-attention and cross-attention to capture and align long-range dependencies across modalities and hops. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets and tasks demonstrate that CAMPA consistently outperforms strong coupled and decoupled baselines while preserving the efficiency advantages of the decoupled paradigm.

Abstract

Multimodal Graph Neural Networks (MGNNs) have shown strong potential for learning from multimodal attributed graphs, yet most existing approaches rely on tightly coupled architectures that suffer from prohibitive computational overhead. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical analysis showing that decoupled MGNNs are substantially more efficient and scalable for large-scale graph learning. However, we identify a critical bottleneck in existing decoupled pipelines, namely modal conflict, which arises in both the propagation and aggregation stages. Specifically, independent multi-hop diffusion causes cross-modal semantic divergence during propagation, while naive fusion fails to align multi-hop feature trajectories during aggregation, jointly limiting effective representation learning. To address this challenge, we propose CAMPA, a Cross-modal Aligned Multimodal Propagation & Aggregation framework for decoupled multimodal graph learning. Concretely, CAMPA introduces a two-stage alignment mechanism: (1) cross-modal aligned propagation, which injects cross-modal similarity priors into message passing to preserve semantic consistency without additional parameter overhead; (2) trajectory aligned aggregation, which leverages trajectory-level self-attention and cross-attention to capture and align long-range dependencies across modalities and hops. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets and tasks demonstrate that CAMPA consistently outperforms strong coupled and decoupled baselines while preserving the efficiency advantages of the decoupled paradigm.

item.title: Compositional Neural Operators for Multi-Dimensional Fluid Dynamics
item.author: Hamda Hmida, Hsiu-Wen Chang, Youssef Mesri
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种用于二维系统的组合神经算子框架，通过将复杂偏微分方程分解为基础块库，并利用带有聚合器的适配块组装专家，从而提高模型的可解释性和适应性。

背景: 偏微分方程控制物理现象，但高保真数值解计算昂贵，机器学习方法缺乏泛化能力。现有的科学基础模型虽然旨在提供通用替代品，但编码解码方法存在预训练成本高和可解释性有限的问题。

目的: 提出 Compositional Neural Operators (CompNO) 框架，以解决复杂偏微分方程求解问题，同时降低预训练成本并提高模型的可解释性。

方法: 该框架将复杂 PDE 分解为基础块库，包含对流、扩散、非线性对流块和泊松求解器。通过带有聚合器的适配块组装这些专家，聚合器通过最小化数据损失和基于物理的残差来学习非线性相互作用。

主要发现: 学习基础算子显著提高了模型的适应性，增强了模型的可解释性，并促进了在新物理系统中重用预训练块。

结论: 学习基础算子显著提高了适应性，增强了模型可解释性，并促进了预训练块在新物理系统中的重用。

翻译: 偏微分方程控制着各种物理现象，然而高保真数值解计算昂贵，且机器学习方法缺乏泛化能力。虽然科学基础模型旨在提供通用替代品，但典型的编码解码方法存在预训练成本高和可解释性有限的问题。在本文中，我们提出了用于二维系统的组合神经算子，该框架将复杂偏微分方程分解为基础块库。每个块都是在基础物理上预训练的专用神经算子。该模块化库包含对流、扩散和非线性对流块以及泊松求解器，使框架能够解决压力-速度耦合问题。这些专家通过带有聚合器的适配块组装在一起。该聚合器通过最小化数据损失和由控制方程驱动的基于物理的残差来学习非线性相互作用。该方法在对流-扩散方程、Burgers 方程和不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 方程上进行了评估。我们的结果表明，从基础算子学习显著提高了适应性，增强了模型可解释性，并促进了在适应新物理系统时重用预训练块。

Abstract

Partial differential equations (PDEs) govern diverse physical phenomena, yet high-fidelity numerical solutions are computationally expensive and Machine Learning approaches lack generalization. While Scientific Foundation Models (SFMs) aim to provide universal surrogates, typical encoding-decoding approaches suffer from high pretraining costs and limited interpretability. In this paper, we propose Compositional Neural Operators (CompNO) for 2D systems, a framework that decomposes complex PDEs into a library of Foundation Blocks. Each block is a specialized Neural Operator pretrained on elementary physics. This modular library contains convection, diffusion, and nonlinear convection blocks as well as a Poisson Solver, enabling the framework to address the pressure-velocity coupling. These experts are assembled via an Adaptation Block featuring an Aggregator. This aggregator learns nonlinear interactions by minimizing data loss and physics-based residuals driven from governing equations. The proposed approach has been evaluated on the Convection-Diffusion equation, the Burgers' equation, and the Incompressible Navier-Stokes equation. Our results demonstrate that learning from elementary operators significantly improves adaptability, enhances model interpretability and facilitates the reuse of pretrained blocks when adapting to new physical systems.

item.title: Quality-Aware Collaborative Multi-Positive Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
item.author: Wei Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 对比学习在序列推荐中的有效性取决于对比视图的构建，现有方法常因启发式增强导致语义漂移和误报问题。

背景: 对比学习的有效性依赖于对比视图的构建，理想情况下视图应既语义一致又多样。

目的: 提出质量感知协作多正样本对比学习方法，以解决视图质量差异未建模导致的误报问题。

方法: 1. 引入可学习的协作序列增强模块，在互补协作上下文下生成增强视图以提升多样性。2. 设计质量感知机制，根据增强操作置信度分配自适应权重，确保高置信度视图贡献更多监督。

主要发现: QCMP-CL 在三个真实数据集上优于最先进的基于对比学习的序列推荐基线。

结论: QCMP-CL 方法有效提升了序列推荐性能。

翻译: The effectiveness of contrastive learning in sequential recommendation hinges on the construction of contrastive views, which ideally should be both semantically consistent and diverse. However, most existing CL-based methods rely on heuristic augmentations that are prone to removing crucial items or disrupting transition patterns, leading to semantic drift. While a few studies have explored learnable augmentations to improve view quality, they often suffer from limited diversity and still necessitate heuristic aids. Furthermore, the quality differences across views are rarely modeled explicitly and adaptively, aggravating the false-positive issue. To address these issues, we propose Quality-aware Collaborative Multi-Positive Contrastive Learning for sequential recommendation. First, we introduce a learnable collaborative sequence augmentation module that generates two augmented views under two complementary collaborative contexts, one based on same-target sequences and the other on similar sequences, thereby enhancing view diversity while preserving intent consistency. Second, we design a quality-aware mechanism, tightly integrated into the model representations, which estimates each view's quality from the confidence of its augmentation operations and assigns adaptive weights to ensure that high-confidence views contribute more supervision while low-confidence ones contribute less. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that QCMP-CL outperforms state-of-the-art CL-based sequential recommendation baselines.

Abstract

The effectiveness of contrastive learning in sequential recommendation hinges on the construction of contrastive views, which ideally should be both semantically consistent and diverse. However, most existing CL-based methods rely on heuristic augmentations that are prone to removing crucial items or disrupting transition patterns, leading to semantic drift. While a few studies have explored learnable augmentations to improve view quality, they often suffer from limited diversity and still necessitate heuristic aids. Furthermore, the quality differences across views are rarely modeled explicitly and adaptively, aggravating the false-positive issue. To address these issues, we propose Quality-aware Collaborative Multi-Positive Contrastive Learning for sequential recommendation. First, we introduce a learnable collaborative sequence augmentation module that generates two augmented views under two complementary collaborative contexts, one based on same-target sequences and the other on similar sequences, thereby enhancing view diversity while preserving intent consistency.Second, we design a quality-aware mechanism, tightly integrated into the model representations, which estimates each view' s quality from the confidence of its augmentation operations and assigns adaptive weights to ensure that high-confidence views contribute more supervision while low-confidence ones contribute less.Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that QCMP-CL outperforms state-of-the-art CL-based sequential recommendation baselines.

item.title: U-STS-LLM A Unified Spatio-Temporal Steered Large Language Model for Traffic Prediction and Imputation
item.author: Yichen Zhang, Jun Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于时空引导大语言模型的统一框架 U-STS-LLM，用于解决蜂窝网络中的时空交通数据分析问题。

背景: 现代蜂窝网络需要分析时空交通数据以进行负载预测和缺失值填补。现有方法如 STGNN 计算量大且泛化能力有限，而 LLM 缺乏结构引导且收敛不稳定。

目的: 构建一个统一的框架，结合时空引导机制和参数高效微调技术，以同时实现高效的负载预测和缺失值填补。

方法: 提出动态时空注意力偏置生成器来引导 LLM 注意力；使用部分冻结的骨干网络配合低秩适应 LoRA 和门控自适应融合机制；在统一的多任务目标下进行训练。

主要发现: 在真实蜂窝网络数据集上，U-STS-LLM 在长时预测和高缺失率填补任务中均取得了新的最先进性能，同时保持了训练效率和稳定性。

结论: 该模型为在结构化非语言领域利用基础模型提供了新的蓝图。

翻译: 现代蜂窝网络的高效运行取决于对时空交通数据的准确分析。掌握这些模式对于核心网络功能至关重要，主要是预测未来负载以预防拥塞，以及填补传感器故障或传输错误导致的缺失值以确保数据连续性。虽然预测和填补紧密相关，但历史上它们作为独立的子领域发展。主导范式时空图神经网络 STGNN 虽然有效，但往往专业化、计算量大且泛化能力有限。同时，适应大型预训练语言模型 LLM 为序列建模提供了强大的替代方案，但现有方法提供的结构引导较弱，导致收敛不稳定且关注预测。为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了 U-STS-LLM，这是一个基于时空引导 LLM 的统一框架。我们的核心创新是一种动态时空注意力偏置生成器，它综合持久的功能图和瞬态节点状态，以明确引导 LLM 的注意力。结合通过低秩适应 LoRA 微调的部分冻结骨干网络和门控自适应融合机制，该模型实现了稳定、参数高效的适应。在统一的多任务目标下训练，U-STS-LLM 学习了整体的数据表示。在真实蜂窝网络数据集上的广泛实验表明，U-STS-LLM 在长时预测和高缺失率填补方面均建立了新的最先进性能，同时保持了惊人的训练效率和稳定性，为在结构化、非语言领域利用基础模型提供了新的蓝图。

Abstract

The efficient operation of modern cellular networks hinges on the accurate analysis of spatio-temporal traffic data. Mastering these patterns is essential for core network functions, chiefly forecasting future load to pre-empt congestion and imputing missing values caused by sensor failures or transmission errors to ensure data continuity. While deeply connected, forecasting and imputation have historically evolved as separate sub-fields. The dominant paradigm, Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (STGNNs), while effective, are often specialized, computationally intensive, and exhibit limited generalization. Concurrently, adapting large pre-trained language models (LLMs) offers a powerful alternative for sequence modeling, yet existing approaches provide weak structural guidance, leading to unstable convergence and a narrow focus on forecasting. To bridge these gaps, we propose U-STS-LLM, a unified framework built on a spatio-temporally steered LLM. Our core innovation is a Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Attention Bias Generator that synthesizes a persistent functional graph with transient nodal states to explicitly steer the LLM's attention. Coupled with a partially frozen backbone tuned via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and a Gated Adaptive Fusion mechanism, the model achieves stable, parameter-efficient adaptation. Trained under a unified multi-task objective, U-STS-LLM learns a holistic data representation. Extensive experiments on real-world cellular datasets demonstrate that U-STS-LLM establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both long-horizon forecasting and high-missing-rate imputation, while maintaining remarkable training efficiency and stability, offering a novel blueprint for harnessing foundation models in structured, non-linguistic domains.

item.title: M$^4$-SAM: Multi-Modal Mixture-of-Experts with Memory-Augmented SAM for RGB-D Video Salient Object Detection
item.author: Jiyuan Liu, Jia Lin, Xiaofei Zhou, Runmin Cong, Deyang Liu, Zhi Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 M4-SAM 的方法，通过引入模态感知专家、分层特征融合和提示无关的内存初始化，解决了 RGB-D 视频显著目标检测中的挑战。

背景: SAM2 是通用分割基础模型，但在应用于 RGB-D 视频显著目标检测时面临空间建模有限、多尺度特征利用不足以及初始化依赖显式提示等挑战。

目的: 为了解决上述挑战，提出 M4-SAM 模型，使其能够在无需手动提示的情况下进行零样本 RGB-D 视频显著目标检测。

方法: 1. 在编码器中注入模态感知 MoE-LORA，利用卷积专家编码局部空间先验并引入模态调度器进行多模态微调。2. 部署门控多级特征融合机制，通过自适应门控分层聚合多尺度编码器特征，平衡空间细节与语义上下文。3. 利用伪引导初始化，将粗略掩码视为伪先验来启动内存库。

主要发现: M4-SAM 在三个公开的 RGB-D VSOD 数据集的所有评估指标上均取得了最先进的性能。

结论: 该方法通过改进 SAM2 的架构和初始化策略，有效解决了 RGB-D 视频显著目标检测中的关键问题，并验证了其有效性。

翻译: SAM2 已成为通用分割的基础模型。由于其具有泛化的视觉表示，SAM2 已成功应用于各种下游任务。然而，将 SAM2 扩展到 RGB-D 视频显著目标检测任务面临三个挑战，包括线性 LoRA 的空间建模有限、SAM 多尺度特征的利用不足以及初始化对显式提示的依赖。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了多模态专家与内存增强 SAM (M4-SAM)，它为 SAM2 配备了模态相关的 PEFT、分层特征融合和提示无关的内存初始化。首先，我们将模态感知 MoE-LORA 注入 SAM2 的编码器中，该 LoRA 使用卷积专家编码局部空间先验，并引入模态调度器以实现高效的多模态微调。其次，我们部署门控多级特征融合，通过自适应门控机制分层聚合多尺度编码器特征，以平衡空间细节和语义上下文。最后，为了在不进行手动提示的情况下进行零样本 VSOD，我们使用伪引导初始化，其中粗略掩码被视为伪先验并用于启动内存库。大量实验表明，M4-SAM 在三个公共 RGB-D VSOD 数据集的所有评估指标上均实现了最先进的性能。

Abstract

The Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) has emerged as a foundation model for universal segmentation. Owing to its generalizable visual representations, SAM2 has been successfully applied to various downstream tasks. However, extending SAM2 to the RGB-D video salient object detection (RGB-D VSOD) task encounters three challenges including limited spatial modeling of linear LoRA, insufficient employment of SAM's multi-scale features, and dependence of initialization on explicit prompts. To address the issues, we present Multi-Modal Mixture-of-Experts with Memory-Augmented SAM (M$^4$-SAM), which equips SAM2 with modality-related PEFT, hierarchical feature fusion, and prompt-free memory initialization. Firstly, we inject Modality-Aware MoE-LORA, which employs convolutional experts to encode local spatial priors and introduces a modality dispatcher for efficient multi-modal fine-tuning, into SAM2's encoder. Secondly, we deploy Gated Multi-Level Feature Fusion, which hierarchically aggregates multi-scale encoder features with an adaptive gating mechanism, to balance spatial details and semantic context. Finally, to conduct zero-shot VSOD without manual prompts, we utilize a Pseudo-Guided Initialization, where a coarse mask is regarded as a pseudo prior and used to bootstrap the memory bank. Extensive experiments demonstrate that M$^4$-SAM achieves the state-of-the-art performance across all evaluation metrics on three public RGB-D VSOD datasets.

item.title: From Token to Token Pair: Efficient Prompt Compression for Large Language Models in Clinical Prediction
item.author: Mingcheng Zhu, Zhiyao Luo, Yu Liu, Tingting Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 通过处理电子健康记录，大语言模型在临床预测任务中展现出潜力，但长序列导致高计算成本。本文提出 MedTPE 方法以实现无损压缩并提升性能。

背景: 电子健康记录作为自然语言序列被大语言模型用于临床预测任务，但纵向或高频记录产生的过长序列会导致高计算成本甚至性能下降。

目的: 解决 EHR 序列过长问题，实现无损压缩，避免增加推理延迟或丢失临床信息。

方法: 提出医学 Token 对编码 MedTPE，通过依赖感知替换策略将频繁共现的医学 token 对合并为复合 token，仅微调极少量的新 token 嵌入。

主要发现: MedTPE 将输入 token 长度减少最多 31%，推理延迟减少 34-63%，且在多个大语言模型和四个临床预测任务中保持或提高了预测性能和输出格式合规性。

结论: MedTPE 具有鲁棒性，可泛化到科学和金融领域以及不同语言，且对输入上下文长度具有适应性。

翻译: 通过将电子健康记录作为自然语言序列处理，大语言模型在死亡预测和表型识别等临床预测任务中显示出潜力。然而，纵向或高频的电子健康记录往往产生过长的 token 序列，导致高计算成本甚至性能下降。现有的解决方案要么添加压缩模块，要么移除不重要的 token，这会增加推理延迟或丢失临床信息的风险。为了在不增加成本或损失性能的情况下实现 token 序列的无损压缩，我们提出了医学 Token 对编码 MedTPE，这是一种扩展 EHR 序列标准分词的分层方法。MedTPE 将频繁共现的医学 token 对合并为复合 token，通过依赖感知替换策略提供无损压缩，同时保持计算复杂度。仅通过自监督学习微调新引入 token 的嵌入，这些 token 仅占大语言模型参数的 0.5-1.0%。在两个临床场景的真实数据集上的实验表明，MedTPE 将输入 token 长度减少了多达 31%，推理延迟减少了 34-63%，同时在多个大语言模型和四个临床预测任务中保持或提高了预测性能和输出格式合规性。此外，MedTPE 在不同的输入上下文长度下表现出鲁棒性，并能泛化到科学和金融领域以及不同的语言。

Abstract

By processing electronic health records (EHRs) as natural language sequences, large language models (LLMs) have shown potential in clinical prediction tasks such as mortality prediction and phenotyping. However, longitudinal or highly frequent EHRs often yield excessively long token sequences that result in high computational costs and even reduced performance. Existing solutions either add modules for compression or remove less important tokens, which introduce additional inference latency or risk losing clinical information. To achieve lossless compression of token sequences without additional cost or loss of performance, we propose Medical Token-Pair Encoding (MedTPE), a layered method that extends standard tokenisation for EHR sequences. MedTPE merges frequently co-occurring medical token pairs into composite tokens, providing lossless compression while preserving the computational complexity through a dependency-aware replacement strategy. Only the embeddings of the newly introduced tokens of merely 0.5-1.0% of the LLM's parameters are fine-tuned via self-supervised learning. Experiments on real-world datasets for two clinical scenarios demonstrate that MedTPE reduces input token length by up to 31% and inference latency by 34-63%, while maintaining or even improving both predictive performance and output format compliance across multiple LLMs and four clinical prediction tasks. Furthermore, MedTPE demonstrates robustness across different input context lengths and generalisability to scientific and financial domains and different languages.

item.title: Urban Risk-Aware Navigation via VQA-Based Event Maps for People with Low Vision
item.author: Antoni Valls, Jordi Sanchez-Riera
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种基于视觉问答的事件图框架，利用多模态大语言模型实现视障人士的辅助导航。

背景: 视力受损影响全球数亿人，限制了其安全独立导航的能力；现有辅助设备缺乏灵活性和泛化能力。

目的: 开发一种灵活且通用的辅助导航系统，用于实时危险检测和场景描述。

方法: 使用三级分层查询结构实现细粒度场景理解，利用视觉语言模型进行行人场景描述和危险识别；构建包含20个城市、6大洲、800多张图片和18000个问答的地理多样化数据集；采用加权风险评分系统将街道段映射为四个离散的安全类别。

主要发现: 生成式多模态大语言模型显著优于基于分类的方法，Qwen-VL在精确率和召回率的平衡方面表现最佳。

结论: 多模态大语言模型作为辅助导航系统的基础具有可行性，且灵活通用。

翻译: 视力受损影响全球数亿人，严重限制了他们安全独立导航城市环境的能力。虽然可穿戴辅助设备为实时危险检测提供了有前景的平台，但现有方法依赖于缺乏灵活性和泛化能力的特定任务视觉管道。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于视觉问答的事件图框架，利用视觉语言模型在多样化的真实世界环境中进行行人场景描述和危险识别，使用三级分层查询结构实现细粒度场景理解，而无需任务特定重新训练。模型响应被聚合到一个加权风险评分系统中，将街道段映射为四个离散的安全类别，为路线规划产生可导航的风险感知事件图。为了支持评估和未来研究，我们引入了一个跨越六大洲20个城市的地理多样化数据集，包含超过800张标注图像和18000个回答的问题。我们基准测试了四种VQA架构——ViLT、LLaVA、InstructBLIP和Qwen-VL，发现生成式多模态大语言模型显著优于基于分类的方法，其中Qwen-VL在精确率和召回率的整体平衡方面表现最佳。这些结果证明了多模态大语言模型作为视障人士辅助导航系统灵活且通用基础的可行性。

Abstract

Visual impairment affects hundreds of millions of people worldwide, severely limiting their ability to navigate urban environments safely and independently. While wearable assistive devices offer a promising platform for real-time hazard detection, existing approaches rely on task-specific vision pipelines that lack flexibility and generalizability. In this work, we propose an event map framework based on visual question answering that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for pedestrian scene description and hazard identification across diverse real-world environments, using a three-level hierarchical query structure to enable fine-grained scene understanding without task-specific retraining. Model responses are aggregated into a weighted risk scoring system that maps street segments into four discrete safety categories, producing navigable risk-aware event maps for route planning. To support evaluation and future research, we introduce a geographically diverse dataset spanning 20 cities across six continents, comprising over 800 annotated images and 18,000 answered questions. We benchmark four VQA architectures -ViLT, LLaVA, InstructBLIP, and Qwen-VL- and find that generative Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) substantially outperform classification-based approaches, with Qwen-VL achieving the best overall balance of precision and recall. These results demonstrate the viability of MLLMs as a flexible and generalizable foundation for assistive navigation systems for visually impaired people.

item.title: SB-BEVFusion: Enhancing the Robustness against Sensor Malfunction and Corruptions
item.author: Markus Essl, Marta Moscati, Mubashir Noman, Muhammad Zaigham Zaheer, Usman Naseem, Shah Nawaz, Markus Schedl
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 多模态传感器融合在自动驾驶 3D 目标检测中优于单模态方法，但现有统一表示方法在数据缺失或损坏时性能下降。本文提出了一种框架无关的融合模块，在 BEVFusion 中实现，并在 MultiCorrupt 数据集上验证了其有效性。

背景: 现有方法通常将相机和激光雷达数据转换为统一的鸟瞰图表示以进行融合，虽然在理想条件下有效，但在数据缺失、损坏或嘈杂时性能会显著下降。

目的: 解决现有方法在数据缺失或损坏时的脆弱性，开发能够处理模态缺失或损坏情况的融合模块。

方法: 开发了一个框架无关的融合模块，并将其实例化在 BEVFusion 框架中，通过在 MultiCorrupt 数据集上进行定量实验来验证。

主要发现: 该模块在模态缺失和损坏的场景下实现了有利的性能提升，显著优于现有的统一表示方法，并在极端天气和传感器故障导致的模态损坏场景中达到了最先进的性能。

结论: 该模块在处理传感器数据损坏或缺失时表现出色，能够显著提升系统鲁棒性，达到 SOTA 性能。

翻译: 多模态传感器融合在自动驾驶 3D 目标检测中，相比单模态方法展示了显著的性能提升。通常，现有方法将来自独立传感器（如相机和激光雷达）的多模态数据转换为统一的鸟瞰图表示以进行融合。尽管在理想条件下有效，但当相机或激光雷达数据缺失、损坏或嘈杂时，该策略会遭受显著的性能下降。为了解决这一弱点，我们开发了一个框架无关的相机和激光雷达数据融合模块，允许处理其中一种模态缺失或损坏的情况。为了展示我们模块的有效性，我们在 BEVFusion [1] 中实例化了它，这是一个用于结合相机和激光雷达数据进行 3D 目标检测的成熟框架。通过在 MultiCorrupt 数据集上进行定量实验，我们证明了我们的模块在模态缺失和损坏的场景下实现了有利的性能提升，在广泛的传感器退化场景中显著优于现有的统一表示方法，并在由于极端天气条件和传感器故障导致的模态损坏场景中达到了最先进的性能。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决传感器故障和损坏的问题。这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Multimodal sensor fusion has demonstrated remarkable performance improvements over unimodal approaches in 3D object detection for autonomous vehicles. Typically, existing methods transform multimodal data from independent sensors, such as camera and LiDAR, into a unified bird's-eye view (BEV) representation for fusion. Although effective in ideal conditions, this strategy suffers from substantial performance deterioration when camera or LiDAR data are missing, corrupted, or noisy. To address this vulnerability, we develop a framework-agnostic fusion module for camera and LiDAR data that allows for handling cases when one of the two modalities is missing or corrupted. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our module, we instantiate it in BEVFusion [1], a well-established framework to combine camera and LiDAR data for 3D object detection. By means of quantitative experiments on the MultiCorrupt dataset, we demonstrate that our module achieves favorable performance improvements under scenarios of missing and corrupted modalities, substantially outperforming existing unified representation approaches across a wide range of sensor deterioration scenarios and reaching state-of-the-art performance in scenarios of corrupted modality due to extreme weather conditions and sensor failure.

item.title: PointNeRT: A Physics Aware Neural Ray Tracing Surrogate for Propagation Channel Modeling
item.author: Zhuoyin Li, Ruisi He, Mi Yang, Ziyi Qi, Zhengyu Zhang, Jiahui Han, Haoxiang Zhang, Bingcheng Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 PointNeRT 的物理感知神经射线追踪代理模型，用于解决传统方法在复杂场景中的可扩展性问题。

背景: 射线追踪是信道建模和网络规划的关键工具，但传统方法依赖基于网格的环境表示和材料属性，在真实环境中因几何形状有限和材料不确定性而难以扩展。

目的: 提出一种新的物理感知神经射线追踪代理模型，以解决传统方法在复杂场景中的可扩展性问题。

方法: 该模型直接使用点云作为环境输入，采用基于物理交互约束的逐跳建模策略，支持多径传播和功率衰减的顺序预测，无需显式构建网格模型或手动定义电磁交互规则。

主要发现: 实验结果表明该方法隐式捕获了表面法线特征和电磁材料效应，在移动场景中实现了鲁棒泛化，提供了物理引导的多径传播神经建模。

结论: PointNeRT 能够高效重建多径，支持顺序预测，并具备良好的泛化能力。

翻译: 射线追踪已成为传播信道建模和网络规划的关键工具。传统的射线追踪基于电磁波理论，其应用依赖于详细的基于网格的环境表示和材料属性。在真实环境中，有限的环境几何形状和材料不确定性阻碍了其在复杂场景中的可扩展性。本文提出了一种名为 PointNeRT 的新型物理感知神经射线追踪代理模型，以解决这些局限性。所提出的模型直接将点云作为环境输入，并无需显式构建网格模型或手动定义电磁交互规则，即可高效重建多径。PointNeRT 采用由物理交互约束引导的逐跳建模策略。它支持多径传播和功率衰减的顺序预测。数值结果和实验表明，所提出的方法隐式捕获了表面法线特征和电磁材料效应。它进一步在移动场景中实现了鲁棒泛化，并提供了物理引导的多径传播神经建模。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Ray tracing (RT) has emerged as a key tool for propagation channel modeling and network planning. Conventional RT is based on electromagnetic (EM) wave theory and its application relies on detailed mesh-based environment representations and material properties. In realistic environments, limited environmental geometry and material uncertainties hinder its scalability to complex scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel physics aware neural RT surrogate named PointNeRT to address these limitations. The proposed model directly takes point clouds as environmental input, and efficiently reconstruct multipath without explicitly constructing mesh models or manually defining EM interaction rules. PointNeRT adopts a hop-by-hop modeling strategy guided by physical interaction constraints. It supports sequential prediction of multipath propagation and power attenuation. Numerical results and experiments demonstrate that the proposed method implicitly captures surface normal characteristics and EM material effects. It further achieves robust generalization in mobility scenarios and provides a physics-guided neural modeling of multipath propagation.

item.title: Martingale-Consistent Self-Supervised Learning
item.author: Moritz Gögl, Hanwen Xing, Christopher Yau
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于鞅一致性的自监督学习框架，旨在解决信息变化环境下的预测一致性问题。

背景: 自监督学习常在信息变化（如历史变短、特征缺失、图像部分观察）的场景下部署，但标准目标函数未强制执行预测一致性原则。

目的: 为了解决标准自监督学习在信息变化时缺乏预测一致性的问题，引入鞅一致性来约束预测更新。

方法: 提出了鞅一致的自监督学习框架，包含预测空间和潜在空间变体，以及基于随机精细化的无偏蒙特卡洛估计器。

主要发现: 在合成和真实的时间序列、表格及图像数据集上，该框架在部分观测场景下提高了鲁棒性和校准度，并产生了更稳定的表示。

结论: 该框架通过鞅一致性约束，允许预测随信息揭示而更新，同时防止系统性漂移，从而提升了模型在部分观测环境下的性能。

翻译: 自监督学习（SSL）常在信息变化的环境下部署，例如历史记录变短、特征缺失或图像部分观察。在这些设置中，粗略视图和精细视图的预测应当是一致的：在精细化之前，粗略视图的预测应与精细化后预期的平均预测相匹配。鞅形式化了这一一致性原则，但标准SSL目标并未强制执行它。与将视图拉在一起的不变目标不同，鞅一致性仅约束期望的精细化预测，允许预测随信息的揭示而更新，同时防止系统性漂移。我们引入了一个鞅一致SSL框架来填补这一差距，具有实用的预测和潜在空间变体，以及基于随机精细化的无偏两样本蒙特卡洛估计器。我们在部分观测场景下的合成和真实时间序列、表格和图像基准上评估了该方法，包括半自监督和完全无标签设置。在这些实验中，我们的框架在部分观测下提高了鲁棒性和校准度，随着信息的揭示产生了更稳定的表示。

Abstract

Self-supervised learning (SSL) is often deployed under changing information, such as shorter histories, missing features, or partially observed images. In these settings, predictions from coarse and refined views should be coherent: before refinement, the coarse-view prediction should match the average prediction expected after refinement. Martingales formalize this coherence principle, but standard SSL objectives do not enforce it. Unlike invariance objectives that pull views together, martingale consistency constrains only the expected refined prediction, allowing predictions to update as information is revealed while preventing systematic drift. We introduce a martingale-consistent SSL framework that closes this gap, with practical prediction- and latent-space variants and an unbiased two-sample Monte Carlo estimator based on stochastic refinement. We evaluate the approach on synthetic and real time-series, tabular, and image benchmarks under partial-observation regimes, in both semi-self-supervised and fully label-free settings. Across these experiments, our framework improves robustness and calibration under partial observation, yielding more stable representations as information is revealed.

item.title: Beyond Parameter Aggregation: Semantic Consensus for Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs
item.author: Amr Abourayya, Jens Kleesiek, Michael Kamp
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于模型行为而非参数的联邦微调方法，通过交换生成输出来实现协作，显著降低了通信开销。

背景: 传统的联邦微调通常被视为参数聚合问题，需要传输大量权重，假设架构对齐，并依赖白盒访问。随着模型规模增长和部署环境异构，这些假设与实际约束不符。

目的: 为了解决传统方法在通信开销、异构架构兼容性和开放文本生成方面的局限性，提出一种新的协作形式。

方法: 客户端在私有数据上微调本地模型，并在共享的公共提示集上交换生成输出。服务器将这些输出映射到语义表示空间，形成每个提示的语义共识，并返回伪标签供进一步本地微调。

主要发现: 该方法将通信量仅取决于公共提示预算和通信行为的大小，与模型大小无关。实验表明，该方法在匹配强基线的同时，大幅减少了通信、运行时间和能源消耗。

结论: 对于生成式基础模型，基于行为的共识比参数聚合提供了更适合联邦适应的抽象。

翻译: 大语言模型的联邦微调通常被表述为参数聚合问题。然而，即使是参数高效的方法也需要传输大量的可训练权重集合，假设架构对齐，并依赖对模型参数的白盒访问。随着模型规模的持续增长和部署的日益异构，这些假设与实际约束越来越不匹配。我们考虑了一种替代表述，即通过模型行为而非参数来促进协作。客户端在私有数据上微调本地模型，并在共享的公共提示集上交换生成的输出。服务器将这些输出映射到语义表示空间，形成每个提示的语义共识，并返回伪标签以进行进一步的本地微调。这种表述从根本上改变了联邦 LLM 微调的通信扩展性。交换的信息量仅取决于公共提示预算和通信行为的大小，与模型大小无关。因此，该协议自然地支持异构架构，并直接适用于开放式的文本生成。我们提出了理论分析和实证结果，证明这种方法可以匹配强大的联邦微调基线，同时将通信量减少几个数量级，以及运行时间和能源消耗的减少。这些结果表明，对于生成式基础模型，基于行为的共识比参数聚合为联邦适应提供了更合适的抽象。

Abstract

Federated fine-tuning of large language models is commonly formulated as a parameter aggregation problem. However, even parameter-efficient methods require transmitting large collections of trainable weights, assume aligned architectures, and rely on white-box access to model parameters. As model sizes continue to grow and deployments become increasingly heterogeneous, these assumptions become progressively misaligned with practical constraints. We consider an alternative formulation in which collaboration is mediated through model behavior rather than parameters. Clients fine-tune local models on private data and exchange generated outputs on a shared, public prompt set. The server maps these outputs into a semantic representation space, forms a per-prompt semantic consensus, and returns pseudo-labels for further local fine-tuning. This formulation fundamentally changes the communication scaling of federated LLM fine-tuning. The amount of information exchanged depends only on the public prompt budget and the size of the communicated behaviors, independent of model size. As a consequence, the protocol naturally accommodates heterogeneous architectures and applies directly to open-ended text generation. We present a theoretical analysis and empirical results demonstrating that this approach can match strong federated fine-tuning baselines while substantially reducing communication by orders of magnitude (e.g., analytically by a factor of $1006$ for Llama3.1-405B), as well as reductions in runtime and energy consumption. These results suggest that, for generative foundation models, behavior-level consensus provides a more appropriate abstraction for federated adaptation than parameter aggregation.

item.title: Modulation Consistency-based Contrastive Learning for Self-Supervised Automatic Modulation Classification
item.author: Chenxu Wang, Shuang Wang, Lirong Han, Xinyu Hu, Hanlin Mo, Hantong Xing, Licheng Jiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出Mod-CL框架，利用调制一致性进行对比学习，以解决深度学习调制分类中标注数据成本高的问题。

背景: 深度学习AMC性能优异但依赖大量标注数据；现有SSL方法虽减少标签依赖，但使用与任务无关的目标，导致特征与符号、信道等干扰因素纠缠。

目的: 利用实例内调制一致性作为结构先验，设计任务对齐的自监督学习目标，以抑制干扰因素并降低对标注数据的依赖。

方法: 提出Mod-CL框架，从同一信号的不同时间片段构建正样本对，通过对比学习学习共享的调制信息。同时设计了结合时间分割和数据增强的对比目标。

主要发现: 在RadioML数据集上，Mod-CL在低标签条件下显著优于强基线，线性探测准确率大幅提升。

结论: Mod-CL能有效降低对标注数据的依赖，在低标签场景下仍保持高性能。

翻译: Deep learning-based AMC methods have achieved remarkable performance, but their practical deployment remains constrained by the high cost of labeled data. Although self-supervised learning (SSL) reduces the reliance on labels, existing SSL-based AMC methods often rely on task-agnostic pretext objectives misaligned with modulation classification, leading to representations entangled with nuisance factors such as symbol, channel, and noise. In this paper, we identify intra-instance modulation consistency as a task-aware structural prior, whereby different temporal segments of the same signal may differ in waveform while preserving the same modulation type, thus providing a principled cue for task-aligned self-supervision. Based on this prior, we propose Mod-CL, a Modulation consistency-based Contrastive Learning framework that constructs positive pairs from different temporal segments of the same signal instance, to encourage the model to learn shared modulation information while suppressing nuisance variations. We further develop a contrastive objective tailored to Mod-CL, which jointly exploits temporal segmentation and data augmentation to pull together views sharing the same modulation semantics while avoiding supervisory conflicts within each signal instance. Extensive experiments on RadioML datasets show that Mod-CL consistently outperforms strong baselines, especially in low-label regimes, achieving substantial improvements in linear probing accuracy.

Abstract

Deep learning-based AMC methods have achieved remarkable performance, but their practical deployment remains constrained by the high cost of labeled data. Although self-supervised learning (SSL) reduces the reliance on labels, existing SSL-based AMC methods often rely on task-agnostic pretext objectives misaligned with modulation classification, leading to representations entangled with nuisance factors such as symbol, channel, and noise. In this paper, we identify intra-instance modulation consistency as a task-aware structural prior, whereby different temporal segments of the same signal may differ in waveform while preserving the same modulation type, thus providing a principled cue for task-aligned self-supervision. Based on this prior, we propose Mod-CL, a Modulation consistency-based Contrastive Learning framework that constructs positive pairs from different temporal segments of the same signal instance, to encourage the model to learn shared modulation information while suppressing nuisance variations. We further develop a contrastive objective tailored to Mod-CL, which jointly exploits temporal segmentation and data augmentation to pull together views sharing the same modulation semantics while avoiding supervisory conflicts within each signal instance. Extensive experiments on RadioML datasets show that Mod-CL consistently outperforms strong baselines, especially in low-label regimes, achieving substantial improvements in linear probing accuracy.

item.title: Learning Subspace-Preserving Sparse Attention Graphs from Heterogeneous Multiview Data
item.author: Jie Chen, Yuanbiao Gou, Chuanbin Liu, Zhu Wang, Xi Peng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种稀疏注意力图学习方法（SAGL），用于从异构多视图数据中学习保持子空间结构的稀疏注意力图。

背景: 大规模无标记数据通过不同预训练模型提取的高维特征被称为异构多视图数据。

目的: 解决现有无监督迁移学习方法在利用多视图互补信息时无法忠实恢复内在子空间结构的问题，构建能保持子空间结构的稀疏相似性图以实现语义对齐。

方法: 提出稀疏注意力图学习（SAGL）方法。具体包括：引入双线性注意力分解方案捕获高维特征间的非对称相似性；使用动态稀疏门控机制自适应控制邻居的拓扑贡献；利用基于alpha-entmax的结构化稀疏投影生成视图特定的稀疏注意力图；并进行稀疏信息聚合以获得判别性表示；同时提供理论分析。

主要发现: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，SAGL 的一致性表现优于现有的最先进的无监督迁移学习方法。

结论: SAGL 是一种有效的方法。

翻译: 大规模无标记数据通过不同预训练模型提取的高维特征被称为异构多视图数据。大多数现有的无监督迁移学习方法在利用多视图互补信息时，无法忠实恢复内在子空间结构。因此，一个基本挑战在于构建能保持这些潜在子空间结构的稀疏相似性图，以实现异构视图间的语义对齐。本文提出了一种稀疏注意力图学习（SAGL）方法，用于从异构多视图数据中学习保持子空间结构的稀疏注意力图。具体而言，我们引入了一种双线性注意力分解方案来捕获高维特征之间的非对称相似性，打破了传统表示学习技术中固有的对称瓶颈。随后，动态稀疏门控机制预测特征特定的压缩因子，以自适应地控制邻居的拓扑贡献。此外，我们通过alpha-entmax采用结构化稀疏投影，为各个视图生成保持子空间结构的稀疏注意力图。SAGL 利用这些视图特定的图进行稀疏信息聚合，为多视图学习任务产生判别性表示。此外，我们提供了严谨的理论分析，将可微稀疏注意力和概率单纯形约束联系起来。在多个基准数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，SAGL 一致地优于最先进的无监督迁移学习方法。

Abstract

The high-dimensional features extracted from large-scale unlabeled data via various pretrained models with diverse architectures are referred to as heterogeneous multiview data. Most existing unsupervised transfer learning methods fail to faithfully recover intrinsic subspace structures when exploiting complementary information across multiple views. Therefore, a fundamental challenge involves constructing sparse similarity graphs that preserve these underlying subspace structures for achieving semantic alignment across heterogeneous views. In this paper, we propose a sparse attention graph learning (SAGL) method that learns subspace-preserving sparse attention graphs from heterogeneous multiview data. Specifically, we introduce a bilinear attention factorization scheme to capture asymmetric similarities among the high-dimensional features, which breaks the symmetry bottleneck that is inherent in the traditional representation learning techniques. A dynamic sparsity gating mechanism then predicts a feature-specific compression factor for adaptively controlling the topological contributions of neighbors. Furthermore, we employ a structured sparse projection via $α$-entmax to generate subspace-preserving sparse attention graphs for individual views. SAGL leverages these view-specific graphs to conduct sparse information aggregation, yielding discriminative representations for multiview learning tasks. In addition, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis that bridges differentiable sparse attention and probability simplex constraints. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that SAGL consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art unsupervised transfer learning approaches.

item.title: From Clever Hans to Scientific Discovery: Interpreting EEG Foundational Transformers with LRP
item.author: Justus Meyer zu Bexten, Nico Scherf, Bogdan Franczyk, Simon M. Hofmann
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究了用于 EEG 基础模型的注意力感知逐层相关性传播方法，旨在验证模型决策并发现生物学假设。

背景: EEG 基础模型虽然具有可扩展性，但其不透明的性质阻碍了更广泛的应用。

目的: 调查注意力感知的逐层相关性传播作为 EEG 基础模型的解释方法，以解决模型不透明的问题。

方法: 将 LRP 从基于卷积神经网络的方法扩展到当前基础模型所基于的 Transformer 架构。

主要发现: LRP 能够验证 EEG 基础模型的决策，并从中揭示新颖且生物学上合理的假设。具体包括：在运动想象任务中发现了模型优先关注眼部信号而非运动相关信号的“Clever Hans”行为；在情感预测的自然范式中，发现模型对中央电极簇的依赖，暗示了与唤醒度相关的感觉运动特征。

结论: LRP 是验证和探索 EEG 基础模型的工具，随着底层模型的成熟，其在重要性和发现潜力方面将不断增长。

翻译: EEG 领域的新兴基础模型虽然承诺通过深度学习在诊断和脑机接口领域实现规模化，尽管面临数据稀缺的挑战，但其不透明的性质仍然是更广泛采用的障碍。我们研究了注意力感知的逐层相关性传播作为 EEG 基础模型的事后归因方法，将 LRP 在基于卷积神经网络的 EEG 模型上的应用扩展到了当前基础模型所基于的 Transformer 架构。我们发现 LRP 既能验证 EEG 基础模型的决策，又能从中揭示新颖且生物学上合理的假设。在运动想象任务中，它揭示了模型优先关注与任务相关的眼部信号而非预期的运动相关信号的“Clever Hans”行为。在情感预测的自然范式中，它揭示了模型对中央电极簇的持续依赖，暗示了唤醒度的候选感觉运动特征。尽管热图解释在这个复杂的领域中仍然模糊，但研究结果将 LRP 定位为验证和探索 EEG 基础模型的工具，随着底层模型的成熟，这一角色的重要性及其发现潜力将不断增长。

Abstract

Emerging foundation models (FMs) in electroencephalography (EEG) promise a path to scale deep learning in diagnostics and brain-computer interfaces despite data scarcity, yet their opaque nature remains a barrier to wider adoption. We investigate attention-aware Layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) as a post-hoc attribution method for EEG-FMs, extending LRP's use on convolutional neural network (CNN)-based EEG models to the Transformer architectures that current FMs are based on. We find that LRP can both verify EEG-FM decisions and surface novel, biologically plausible hypotheses from them. In motor imagery, it unmasks 'Clever Hans' behavior where models prioritize task correlated ocular signals over the intended motor correlates. In a naturalistic paradigm for affect prediction, it reveals a recurring reliance on a central electrode cluster, suggesting a candidate sensorimotor signature of arousal. Though heatmap interpretation remains ambiguous in this complex domain, the results position LRP as a tool for both verification and exploration of EEG-FMs, a role that will grow in both importance and discovery potential as the underlying models mature.

item.title: From Trajectories to Phenotypes: Disease Progression as Structural Priors for Multi-organ Imaging Representation Learning
item.author: Zian Wang, Lizhen Lan, Guangming Wang, Haosen Zhang, Minxuan Xu, Qing Li, Tianxing He, Mo Yang, Wenyue Mao, Yajing Zhang, Yan Li, Chengyan Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出轨迹感知蒸馏框架，将疾病轨迹模型的结构知识迁移到成像衍生表型编码器中，以提升下游预测任务的性能。

背景: 成像衍生表型总结了多器官生理机能，但仅提供疾病的静态快照；而纵向电子健康记录通过诊断事件和合并症结构中的时间依赖性编码疾病轨迹。

目的: 假设成像衍生表型和疾病轨迹包含部分共享的疾病相关结构，旨在利用轨迹模型的结构知识来增强成像表型的表示学习。

方法: 提出轨迹感知蒸馏框架，将生成式疾病轨迹Transformer的结构知识转移到器官级IDP编码器中。利用大规模轨迹模型产生的受试者级嵌入，通过保持几何对齐来监督IDP表示学习。在下游预测中，轨迹和成像表示可以通过交叉注意力融合。

主要发现: 在英国生物银行队列的159种疾病中，轨迹感知预训练持续提高了判别能力和发病时间预测，且对低患病率疾病增益最大。IDP嵌入空间中的相似性关系与轨迹空间中的相似性关系一致，支持了部分对齐的表示几何结构。

结论: 大规模生成式疾病模型可以作为数据受限成像模态的结构先验，在现实队列约束下提高鲁棒性。

翻译: 成像衍生表型总结了多器官生理机能，但仅提供疾病的静态快照。相比之下，纵向电子健康记录通过过去诊断事件和合并症结构中的时间依赖性编码疾病轨迹。我们假设成像衍生表型和疾病轨迹包含部分共享的疾病相关结构。我们提出了一种轨迹感知蒸馏框架，将生成式疾病轨迹Transformer的结构知识转移到器官级IDP编码器中。利用在大规模轨迹模型上训练的纵向诊断序列产生的受试者级嵌入，通过保持几何对齐来监督IDP表示学习。在下游预测期间，轨迹和成像表示也可以通过交叉注意力融合。在英国生物银行队列的159种疾病中，轨迹感知预训练持续提高了判别能力和发病时间预测，且对低患病率疾病增益最大。IDP嵌入空间中的相似性关系也与轨迹空间中的相似性关系一致，为部分对齐的表示几何结构提供了支持性证据。这些结果表明，大规模生成式疾病模型可以作为数据受限成像模态的结构先验，在现实队列约束下提高鲁棒性。

Abstract

Imaging-derived phenotypes (IDPs) summarize multi-organ physiology but provide only static snapshots of diseases that evolve over time. In contrast, longitudinal electronic health records encode disease trajectories through temporal dependencies among past diagnosis events and comorbidity structure. We hypothesize that IDPs and disease trajectories contain partially shared disease-relevant structure. We propose a trajectory-aware distillation framework that transfers structural knowledge from a generative disease trajectory Transformer into an organ-wise IDP encoder. A population-scale trajectory model trained on longitudinal diagnosis sequences produces subject-level embeddings that supervise IDP representation learning via geometry-preserving alignment. During downstream prediction, trajectory and imaging representations can also be fused via cross-attention. Across 159 diseases in the UK Biobank cohort, trajectory-aware pretraining consistently improves both discrimination (AUC) and time-to-onset prediction (MAE), with the largest gains for low-prevalence diseases. Similarity relationships in IDP embedding space also align with those in trajectory space, providing supportive evidence for partially aligned representation geometry. These results suggest that population-scale generative disease models can serve as structural priors for data-limited imaging modalities, improving robustness under realistic cohort constraints.

item.title: H2G: Hierarchy-Aware Hyperbolic Grouping for 3D Scenes
item.author: ByungHa Ko, Youngmin Lee, Dong Hwan Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出H2G方法，利用双曲亲和场将2D基础模型线索转化为3D表示，实现语义分层分组。

背景: 分层3D分组旨在跨多个粒度恢复场景分组，从细粒度的物体部件到完整物体，且不依赖语义标签或固定词汇表。主要挑战在于将2D基础模型线索转化为连贯的层次监督并将其嵌入3D表示中。

目的: 提出H2G双曲亲和场，解决将2D基础模型线索转化为3D层次监督的挑战。

方法: 提出H2G双曲亲和场。通过Dasgupta目标解释基础模型亲和力，生成语义组织的树状监督。将监督蒸馏为洛伦兹双曲特征场，利用其适合树状结构的几何特性。使用层次感知目标对齐细粒度分配、粗粒度结构、特征簇和LCA排序。

主要发现: 该方法在一个特征空间中表示多个分组级别，实现了基于2D基础模型知识的语义分层分组。

结论: 该方法通过双曲特征场和层次感知目标，成功实现了语义分层3D分组。

翻译: 分层3D分组旨在跨多个粒度恢复场景分组，从细粒度的物体部件到完整物体，且不依赖语义标签或固定词汇表。主要挑战在于将2D基础模型线索转化为连贯的层次监督并将其嵌入3D表示中。我们提出了H2G，一种用于分层3D分组的双曲亲和场。我们的方法通过基于相似性的层次聚类目标解释基础模型亲和力，推导出语义组织的树状监督。将这种监督蒸馏为单个洛伦兹双曲特征场，其几何结构非常适合树状分支结构。一个层次感知目标将场与细粒度分配、粗粒度物体结构、紧凑特征簇和最近公共祖先排序对齐。这种公式在一个特征空间中表示多个分组级别，实现了基于2D基础模型知识的语义分层分组。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 未知

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Hierarchical 3D grouping aims to recover scene groups across multiple granularities, from fine object parts to complete objects, without relying on semantic labels or a fixed vocabulary. The main challenge is to transform 2D foundation-model cues into coherent hierarchy supervision and embed that hierarchy in a 3D representation. We propose H2G, a hyperbolic affinity field for hierarchical 3D grouping. Our method derives semantically organized tree supervision by interpreting foundation-model affinities through Dasgupta's objective for similarity-based hierarchical clustering. This supervision is distilled into a single Lorentz hyperbolic feature field, whose geometry is well suited for tree-like branching structures. A hierarchy-aware objective aligns the field with fine-level assignments, coarse object structure, compact feature clusters, and LCA (Lowest Common Ancestor) ordering. This formulation represents multiple grouping levels in one feature space, enabling semantic hierarchical grouping grounded in 2D foundation-model knowledge.

item.title: NOFE -- Neural Operator Function Embedding
item.author: Lars Uebbing, Harald L. Joakimsen, Siyan Chen, Georgios Leontidis, Kristoffer K. Wickstrøm, Michael C. Kampffmeyer, Sébastien Lefèvre, Arnt-Børre Salberg, Robert Jenssen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: NOFE是一种用于连续域降维的领域感知框架，通过图核算子学习函数到函数的映射，解决了离散点云方法忽略连续域结构的问题。

背景: 大多数降维方法将数据视为离散点云，忽略了现实世界中许多过程固有的连续域结构。

目的: 引入Neural Operator Function Embedding (NOFE)框架，以弥合离散降维方法与连续域结构之间的差距。

方法: NOFE通过图核算子学习函数到函数的映射，将其建立为丛到丛映射的近似，实现了无网格评估和采样独立性。

主要发现: NOFE在局部结构保持方面显著优于基线，并具有鲁棒的采样独立性，减少了拼接误差，确保了跨不连续域块的稳定性。

结论: NOFE在保持竞争力的全局结构保持能力的同时，解决了细粒度结构问题，生成了平滑且一致的嵌入，有效解决了离散降维方法的关键局限性。

翻译: Most dimensionality reduction methods treat data as discrete point clouds, ignoring the continuous domain structure inherent to many real-world processes. To bridge this gap, we introduce Neural Operator Function Embedding (NOFE), a domain-aware framework for continuous dimensionality reduction. NOFE learns function-to-function mappings via a Graph Kernel Operator, enabling mesh-free evaluation at arbitrary query locations independent of input discretization. We establish NOFE as approximation of sheaf-to-sheaf mappings, generalizing Sheaf Neural Networks to continuous domains. We evaluate NOFE across different datasets, comparing it against PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP. Our results demonstrate that NOFE significantly outperforms baselines in local structure preservation, achieving a local Stress of 0.111 compared to 0.398 for PCA, 0.773 for t-SNE, and 0.791 for UMAP for the ERA5 climate reanalysis dataset. NOFE also exhibits robust sampling independence, reducing the Patch Stitching Error by up to 20.0x relative to UMAP (59.0 vs. 267.6 under regional normalization) and ensuring consistency across disjoint domain patches. While maintaining competitive global structure preservation (Stress-1: 0.379 vs. PCA's 0.268), NOFE resolves fine-grained structures and produces smooth, consistent embeddings that generalize across varying sample densities, addressing key limitations of discrete reduction methods.

Abstract

Most dimensionality reduction methods treat data as discrete point clouds, ignoring the continuous domain structure inherent to many real-world processes. To bridge this gap, we introduce Neural Operator Function Embedding (NOFE), a domain-aware framework for continuous dimensionality reduction. NOFE learns function-to-function mappings via a Graph Kernel Operator, enabling mesh-free evaluation at arbitrary query locations independent of input discretization. We establish NOFE as approximation of sheaf-to-sheaf mappings, generalizing Sheaf Neural Networks to continuous domains. We evaluate NOFE across different datasets, comparing it against PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP. Our results demonstrate that NOFE significantly outperforms baselines in local structure preservation, achieving a local Stress of 0.111 compared to 0.398 for PCA, 0.773 for t-SNE, and 0.791 for UMAP for the ERA5 climate reanalysis dataset. NOFE also exhibits robust sampling independence, reducing the Patch Stitching Error by up to $20.0\times$ relative to UMAP (59.0 vs. 267.6 under regional normalization) and ensuring consistency across disjoint domain patches. While maintaining competitive global structure preservation (Stress-1: 0.379 vs. PCA's 0.268), NOFE resolves fine-grained structures and produces smooth, consistent embeddings that generalize across varying sample densities, addressing key limitations of discrete reduction methods.

item.title: On Predicting the Post-training Potential of Pre-trained LLMs
item.author: Xiaoyuan Li, Yubo Ma, Kexin Yang, Moxin Li, Keqin Bao, Wenie Wang, Fuli Feng, Dayiheng Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出 RuDE 框架，通过基于规则的对比评估预测基础模型的微调潜力，从而实现高效的模型选择。

背景: LLM 的下游任务表现受限于预训练能力，传统基准（如 MMLU）无法准确反映基础模型在复杂场景下的可塑性，导致模型选择效率低。

目的: 引入预测后训练潜力的任务，旨在预测基础模型在微调前的性能，以解决模型选择效率问题。

方法: 提出 RuDE 框架，利用响应区分能力绕过生成差距。在 4C 分类法指导下，通过细粒度规则违规构建受控对比对。

主要发现: RuDE 与后训练性能的相关性超过 90%。通过强化学习验证，RuDE 能有效识别出性能优于更大模型的潜力型小模型。

结论: RuDE 提供了一种计算高效的机制，能够有效识别高潜力模型，优化基础模型开发流程。

翻译: 大型语言模型在下游任务上的表现从根本上受到其在预训练期间获得的能力的限制。然而，像 MMLU 这样的传统基准往往无法反映基础模型在复杂开放场景下的可塑性，导致模型选择效率低下。我们通过引入预测后训练潜力的新任务——即预测基础模型在微调前的性能——来解决这个问题。我们提出了 RuDE（基于规则的区分性评估），这是一个统一框架，通过利用响应区分能力来绕过基础模型的生成差距。在我们的系统化 4C 分类法的指导下，RuDE 通过细粒度规则违规在各个领域构建受控对比对。大量实验表明，其与后训练性能的相关性超过 90%。至关重要的是，通过强化学习进行的验证证实，RuDE 有效地识别出性能优于更大对手的高潜力小模型，为基础模型开发提供了一种计算高效的机制。

Abstract

The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on downstream tasks is fundamentally constrained by the capabilities acquired during pre-training. However, traditional benchmarks like MMLU often fail to reflect a base model's plasticity in complex open-ended scenarios, leading to inefficient model selection. We address this by introducing a new task of predicting post-training potential - forecasting a base model's performance before post-training. We propose RuDE (Rubric-based Discriminative Evaluation), a unified framework that bypasses the generation gap of base models by leveraging response discrimination. Guided by our systematic 4C Taxonomy, RuDE constructs controlled contrastive pairs across diverse domains by fine-grained rubric violations. Extensive experiments demonstrate a correlation greater than 90% with post-training performance. Crucially, validation via Reinforcement Learning (RL) confirms that RuDE effectively identifies high-potential smaller models that outperform larger counterparts, offering a compute-efficient mechanism for foundation model development.

item.title: A Transfer Learning Evaluation of Deep Neural Networks for Image Classification
item.author: Nermeen Abou Baker, Nico Zengeler, Uwe Handmann
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 迁移学习利用源域知识提升目标域学习，具有高性能、节省时间和资源等优势。本文研究如何为图像分类任务选择最佳预训练模型。

背景: 迁移学习是一种利用源域知识通过重用权重来增强目标域学习的技术。该技术因能实现高性能并节省训练时间、内存和设计精力而广泛应用。

目的: 研究如何选择满足目标域要求的最佳预训练模型，用于图像分类任务。

方法: 研究者对输出层和通用网络参数进行了微调，将十一种在ImageNet上预训练的图像处理模型的知识应用到五个不同的目标域数据集上。通过单次训练和十次训练，测量了准确率、准确率密度、训练时间和模型大小。

主要发现: unknown

结论: unknown

翻译: 迁移学习是一种机器学习技术，它利用先前从源域获得的知识，通过重用学习到的权重来增强目标域的学习。由于在实现高性能的同时节省训练时间、内存和网络设计精力方面具有巨大优势，该技术无处不在。在本文中，我们研究了如何为图像分类任务选择满足目标域要求的最佳预训练模型。在我们的研究中，我们改进了输出层和通用网络参数，将十一种在ImageNet上预训练的图像处理模型的知识应用到五个不同的目标域数据集上。我们测量了准确率、准确率密度、训练时间和模型大小，以在单次训练会话和十次训练会话中评估预训练模型。

Abstract

Transfer learning is a machine learning technique that uses previously acquired knowledge from a source domain to enhance learning in a target domain by reusing learned weights. This technique is ubiquitous because of its great advantages in achieving high performance while saving training time, memory, and effort in network design. In this paper, we investigate how to select the best pre-trained model that meets the target domain requirements for image classification tasks. In our study, we refined the output layers and general network parameters to apply the knowledge of eleven image processing models, pre-trained on ImageNet, to five different target domain datasets. We measured the accuracy, accuracy density, training time, and model size to evaluate the pre-trained models both in training sessions in one episode and with ten episodes.

item.title: Efficient and Adaptive Human Activity Recognition via LLM Backbones
item.author: Aleksandr Bredikhin, Philippe Lalanda, German Vega
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出利用预训练大语言模型作为通用时间骨干来处理基于传感器的HAR任务，通过结构化卷积投影和LoRA技术降低训练成本并提高适应性。

背景: HAR是泛在计算系统的核心任务，现有基于Transformer的模型通常需要从头训练，导致训练成本高、数据需求大且对领域迁移适应性差。

目的: 为了解决传统方法的高成本和低适应性问题，提出重用预训练大语言模型作为HAR的通用时间骨干。

方法: 引入结构化卷积投影将惯性传感器信号映射到LLM的潜在空间；使用参数高效的低秩适应LoRA技术对冻结的预训练骨干进行适配。

主要发现: 该方法在标准基准测试中实现了快速收敛、强大的数据效率以及稳健的跨数据集迁移，特别是在低数据和少样本设置下表现良好；卷积前端和LLM在局部不变性和长程时间依赖性方面起到互补作用。

结论: LLM可以作为实用、节俭且可扩展的基础，为自适应HAR系统提供支持，开辟了在原始语言领域之外重用基础模型的新方向。

翻译: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) is a core task in pervasive computing systems, where models must operate under strict computational constraints while remaining robust to heterogeneous and evolving deployment conditions. Recent advances based on Transformer architectures have significantly improved recognition performance, but typically rely on task-specific models trained from scratch, resulting in high training cost, large data requirements, and limited adaptability to domain shifts. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift that reuses large pretrained language models (LLMs) as generic temporal backbones for sensor-based HAR, instead of designing domain-specific Transformers. To bridge the modality gap between inertial time series and language models, we introduce a structured convolutional projection that maps multivariate accelerometer and gyroscope signals into the latent space of the LLM. The pretrained backbone is kept frozen and adapted using parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters and the overall training cost. Through extensive experiments on standard HAR benchmarks, we show that this approach enables rapid convergence, strong data efficiency, and robust cross-dataset transfer, particularly in low-data and few-shot settings. At the same time, our results highlight the complementary roles of convolutional frontends and LLMs, where local invariances are handled at the signal level while long-range temporal dependencies are captured by the pretrained backbone. Overall, this work demonstrates that LLMs can serve as a practical, frugal, and scalable foundation for adaptive HAR systems, opening new directions for reusing foundation models beyond their original language domain.

Abstract

Human Activity Recognition (HAR) is a core task in pervasive computing systems, where models must operate under strict computational constraints while remaining robust to heterogeneous and evolving deployment conditions. Recent advances based on Transformer architectures have significantly improved recognition performance, but typically rely on task-specific models trained from scratch, resulting in high training cost, large data requirements, and limited adaptability to domain shifts. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift that reuses large pretrained language models (LLMs) as generic temporal backbones for sensor-based HAR, instead of designing domain-specific Transformers. To bridge the modality gap between inertial time series and language models, we introduce a structured convolutional projection that maps multivariate accelerometer and gyroscope signals into the latent space of the LLM. The pretrained backbone is kept frozen and adapted using parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters and the overall training cost. Through extensive experiments on standard HAR benchmarks, we show that this approach enables rapid convergence, strong data efficiency, and robust cross-dataset transfer, particularly in low-data and few-shot settings. At the same time, our results highlight the complementary roles of convolutional frontends and LLMs, where local invariances are handled at the signal level while long-range temporal dependencies are captured by the pretrained backbone. Overall, this work demonstrates that LLMs can serve as a practical, frugal, and scalable foundation for adaptive HAR systems, opening new directions for reusing foundation models beyond their original language domain.

item.title: Cross-Modal-Domain Generalization Through Semantically Aligned Discrete Representations
item.author: Souptik Sen, Raneen Younis, Zahra Ahmadi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出CoDAAR框架，通过跨模态离散对齐与重建，在保持模态特定结构的同时实现可泛化的跨模态表示。

背景: 现有方法难以平衡跨模态泛化能力与模态特定结构。连续方法难以泛化，离散方法牺牲了模态特异性。

目的: 解决跨模态泛化与模态特定结构之间的权衡问题，建立统一的离散空间以保留模态独特结构并实现可泛化的跨模态表示。

方法: 引入CoDAAR框架，通过索引级对齐在模态特定码本间建立语义共识。结合离散时间对齐和级联语义对齐两种互补机制，建立无竞争的统一表示空间。

主要发现: 在自监督重建目标下训练，在跨模态和跨域泛化上表现鲁棒。在事件分类、定位、视频分割和跨数据集迁移等基准测试中达到最先进性能。

结论: 建立了离散和可泛化多模态表示学习的新范式。

翻译: 多模态学习寻求整合来自不同感官来源的信息，但当前方法难以平衡跨模态泛化能力与模态特定结构。连续方法保留了细粒度先验但使泛化变得困难，而离散方法以牺牲模态特异性为代价强制执行共享原型。我们介绍了CoDAAR，这是一个新颖的框架，通过在模态特定码本之间通过索引级对齐建立语义共识，从而解决了这一长期存在的权衡问题。这种设计独特地允许CoDAAR在统一的离散空间内保持模态独特结构，同时实现可泛化的跨模态表示。CoDAAR结合了两种互补机制：离散时间对齐，它实现了细粒度的时间量化，以及级联语义对齐，它促进了渐进的跨模态语义一致性。它们共同建立了一个无竞争的统一表示空间。在配对多模态序列上使用自监督重建目标进行训练，CoDAAR展示了鲁棒的跨模态和跨域泛化。在跨模态泛化基准测试中，包括事件分类、定位、视频分割和跨数据集迁移，CoDAAR达到了最先进的性能，为离散和可泛化的多模态表示学习建立了新范式。

Abstract

Multimodal learning seeks to integrate information across diverse sensory sources, yet current approaches struggle to balance cross-modal generalizability with modality-specific structure. Continuous (implicit) methods preserve fine-grained priors but render generalization challenging, while discrete (explicit) approaches enforce shared prototypes at the expense of modality specificity. We introduce CoDAAR (Cross-modal Discrete Alignment And Reconstruction), a novel framework that resolves this long-standing trade-off by establishing semantic consensus across modality-specific codebooks through index-level alignment. This design uniquely allows CoDAAR to preserve modality-unique structures while achieving generalizable cross-modal representations within a unified discrete space. CoDAAR combines two complementary mechanisms: Discrete Temporal Alignment (DTA), which enables fine-grained temporal quantization, and Cascading Semantic Alignment (CSA), which promotes progressive cross-modal semantic agreement. Together, they establish a competition-free unified representation space. Trained with self-supervised reconstruction objectives on paired multimodal sequences, CoDAAR demonstrates robust cross-modal and cross-domain generalization. Across Cross-Modal Generalization benchmarks, including event classification, localization, video segmentation, and cross-dataset transfer, CoDAAR achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new paradigm for discrete and generalizable multimodal representation learning.

item.title: Multi-Task Representation Learning for Conservative Linear Bandits
item.author: Jiabin Lin, Shana Moothedath
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了用于保守线性带子的约束多任务表示学习框架，并设计了名为 Safe-AltGDmin 的算法。

背景: 研究 d 维空间中的 T 个线性带子任务，这些任务共享低维表示，且受到安全或性能约束。

目的: 恢复低秩特征矩阵，满足约束条件，并建立理论界限。

方法: Safe-Alternating projected Gradient Descent and minimization 算法。

主要发现: 建立了关于遗憾和样本复杂度的理论界限，并通过实验验证了算法性能。

结论: 该框架在保守线性带子场景下具有理论保证，且性能优于基准算法。

翻译: 本文提出了用于保守线性带子的约束多任务表示学习框架。我们考虑了 d 维空间中的 T 个线性带子任务，它们共享一个低维表示，且维度 r 远小于 d 和 T 的最小值。此外，任务受到约束，仅允许满足特定安全或性能要求的动作，称为保守带子。我们引入了一种新颖的算法，即安全交替投影梯度下降和最小化，用于在满足给定约束的同时恢复低秩特征矩阵。基于该算法，我们提出了一个保守线性带子的多任务表示学习框架，并为其遗憾和样本复杂度界限建立了理论保证。我们进行了实验，并将我们算法的性能与基准算法进行了比较。

Abstract

This paper presents the Constrained Multi-Task Representation Learning (CMTRL) framework for linear bandits. We consider T linear bandit tasks in a d dimensional space, which share a common low-dimensional representation of dimension r, where r is much smaller than the minimum of d and T. Furthermore, tasks are constrained so that only actions meeting specific safety or performance requirements are allowed, referred to as conservative (safe) bandits. We introduce a novel algorithm, Safe-Alternating projected Gradient Descent and minimization (Safe-AltGDmin), to recover a low-rank feature matrix while satisfying the given constraints. Building on this algorithm, we propose a multi-task representation learning framework for conservative linear bandits and establish theoretical guarantees for its regret and sample complexity bounds. We presented experiments and compared the performance of our algorithm with benchmark algorithms.

item.title: TMRL: Diffusion Timestep-Modulated Pretraining Enables Exploration for Efficient Policy Finetuning
item.author: Matthew M. Hong, Jesse Zhang, Anusha Nagabandi, Abhishek Gupta
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种统一框架，通过结合上下文平滑预训练和时间步调制强化学习，解决了预训练策略在RL微调中探索不足的问题。

背景: 使用强化学习微调预训练机器人策略时，往往继承了行为克隆产生的动作分布狭窄、缺乏探索覆盖范围的局限性。

目的: 建立一个统一框架，通过连接行为克隆预训练和强化学习微调，实现必要的探索，从而提高机器人策略微调的效率。

方法: 提出了上下文平滑预训练（CSP），在策略输入中注入扩散噪声；以及时间步调制强化学习（TMRL），通过调节扩散时间步来动态调整条件，实现对探索的显式控制。

主要发现: TMRL与任意策略输入无缝集成，提高了RL微调的样本效率；且能在不到一小时内成功完成复杂操作任务的现实世界微调。

结论: 该方法在复杂操作任务中实现了高效的现实世界微调，代码和视频已公开。

翻译: 使用强化学习微调预训练机器人策略通常会继承行为克隆预训练引入的瓶颈，行为克隆产生的动作分布狭窄，缺乏下游探索所需的覆盖范围。我们提出了一种统一框架，通过连接行为克隆预训练和强化学习微调，实现了必要的探索，从而能够高效地微调机器人策略。我们的预训练方法——上下文平滑预训练（CSP），在策略输入中注入前向扩散噪声，在精确模仿和广泛的动作覆盖之间建立了连续体。然后，我们通过时间步调制强化学习（TMRL）微调预训练策略，该方法训练智能体在微调期间通过调节扩散时间步来动态调整这种条件，从而获得对探索的显式控制。TMRL 与任意策略输入（如状态、3D 点云或基于图像的 VLA 策略）无缝集成，表明 TMRL 提高了 RL 微调的样本效率。值得注意的是，TMRL 允许在不到一小时内成功完成复杂操作任务的现实世界微调。视频和代码可在 https://weirdlabuw.github.io/tmrl/ 获取。

Abstract

Fine-tuning pre-trained robot policies with reinforcement learning (RL) often inherits the bottlenecks introduced by pre-training with behavioral cloning (BC), which produces narrow action distributions that lack the coverage necessary for downstream exploration. We present a unified framework that enables the exploration necessary to enable efficient robot policy finetuning by bridging BC pre-training and RL fine-tuning. Our pre-training method, Context-Smoothed Pre-training (CSP), injects forward-diffusion noise into policy inputs, creating a continuum between precise imitation and broad action coverage. We then fine-tune pre-trained policies via Timestep-Modulated Reinforcement Learning (TMRL), which trains the agent to dynamically adjust this conditioning during fine-tuning by modulating the diffusion timestep, granting explicit control over exploration. Integrating seamlessly with arbitrary policy inputs, e.g., states, 3D point clouds, or image-based VLA policies, we show that TMRL improves RL fine-tuning sample efficiency. Notably, TMRL enables successful real-world fine-tuning on complex manipulation tasks in under one hour. Videos and code available at https://weirdlabuw.github.io/tmrl/.

item.title: From Image Hashing to Scene Change Detection
item.author: Anh-Kiet Duong, Marie-Claire Iatrides, Petra Gomez-Krämer, Jean-Michel Carozza
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为HashSCD的哈希框架，用于场景变化检测，实现了高效的全局变化检测和局部变化识别。

背景: 图像哈希虽然提供紧凑表示以实现高效存储和检索，但仅限于全局比较，无法推理变化发生的位置。这一局限性阻碍了哈希方法直接应用于需要空间定位的场景变化检测。

目的: 从场景变化检测的角度重新审视哈希，提出一种名为HashSCD的哈希框架，以解决全局比较和空间定位的问题。

方法: HashSCD是一个分块哈希框架，将空间对齐的图像块编码为紧凑哈希码，并通过异或操作进行聚合。该方法允许在汉明空间中直接进行变化检测和定位，无需对先前图像进行重复推理。模型使用对比学习在图像块和全局层面进行无监督训练。

主要发现: HashSCD在性能上与最先进的无监督哈希和场景变化检测方法竞争，同时显著降低了计算成本和存储需求。

结论: HashSCD成功实现了高效的全局变化检测和局部变化识别，证明了其在场景变化检测任务中的有效性。

翻译: 图像哈希为高效存储和检索提供了紧凑表示，但本质上仅限于全局比较，无法推理变化发生的位置。这一局限性阻碍了哈希方法直接应用于需要空间定位的场景变化检测。在这项工作中，我们从场景变化检测的角度重新审视哈希，并提出HashSCD，一种分块哈希框架，能够实现高效的全局变化检测和局部变化识别。HashSCD将空间对齐的图像块编码为紧凑哈希码，并通过异或操作进行聚合，使得变化检测和定位可以直接在汉明空间中执行，而无需对先前图像进行重复推理。该模型使用对比学习在图像块和全局层面以无监督方式进行训练。实验表明，HashSCD在性能上与最先进的无监督哈希和场景变化检测方法竞争，同时显著降低了计算成本和存储需求。

Abstract

Image hashing provides compact representations for efficient storage and retrieval but is inherently limited to global comparison and cannot reason about where changes occur. This limitation prevents hashing from being directly applicable to scene change detection, where spatial localization is essential. In this work, we revisit hashing from a scene change detection perspective and propose HashSCD, a patch-wise hashing framework that enables both efficient global change detection and localized change identification. HashSCD encodes spatially aligned patches into compact hash codes and aggregates them through an XOR-like operation, allowing change detection and localization to be performed directly in the Hamming space without repeated inference on previous images. The model is trained in an unsupervised manner using contrastive learning at both patch and global levels. Experiments demonstrate that HashSCD achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art unsupervised hashing and scene change detection methods, while significantly reducing computational cost and storage requirements.

item.title: NARA: Anchor-Conditioned Relation-Aware Contextualization of Heterogeneous Geoentities
item.author: Jina Kim, Gengchen Mai, Lingyi Zhao, Khurram Shafique, Yao-Yi Chiang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 NARA 的自监督框架，用于矢量地理空间数据的表示学习，通过统一建模语义、几何和空间关系来捕获上下文相关的表示。

背景: 现有的地理空间基础模型主要关注卫星图像等栅格数据。矢量地理空间数据以离散的地理实体表示，具有明确的几何、语义和结构化的空间关系（如度量接近性和拓扑关系）。

目的: 解决现有表示学习方法碎片化的问题，限制了对异构地理实体统一空间上下文的捕获能力。

方法: 提出了一种名为 NARA 的自监督框架。它通过统一框架联合建模语义、几何和空间关系，捕获超越距离的空间结构，支持点、线、面等多种实体类型。

主要发现: 在建筑物功能分类、交通速度预测和下一个兴趣点推荐等任务上，相比 prior 方法有持续改进。

结论: 统一的关系建模对矢量地理空间数据具有显著益处。

翻译: 地理空间基础模型主要关注卫星图像等栅格数据，其中自监督学习得到了广泛研究。矢量地理空间数据则将世界表示为具有明确几何、语义和结构化空间关系的离散地理实体，包括度量接近性和拓扑关系。这些关系共同决定了实体在空间中的交互方式，然而现有的表示学习方法仍然支离破碎，通常局限于特定的几何类型或部分空间关系，限制了它们捕获异构地理实体间统一空间上下文的能力。我们提出了 NARA（神经锚点条件的关系感知表示学习），一种用于矢量地理实体的自监督框架。NARA 通过在统一框架内联合建模语义、几何和空间关系来学习上下文相关的表示，并捕获超越距离的空间关系结构，从而能够为点、线、面等异构地理实体提供丰富的上下文表示。在建筑物功能分类、交通速度预测和下一个兴趣点推荐等任务上的评估显示，与 prior 方法相比有持续改进，突显了统一关系建模对矢量地理空间数据的益处。

Abstract

Geospatial foundation models have primarily focused on raster data such as satellite imagery, where self-supervised learning has been widely studied. Vector geospatial data instead represent the world as discrete geoentities with explicit geometry, semantics, and structured spatial relations, including metric proximity and topological relationships. These relations jointly determine how entities interact within space, yet existing representation learning methods remain fragmented, often restricted to specific geometry types or partial spatial relations, limiting their ability to capture unified spatial context across heterogeneous geoentities. We propose NARA (Neural Anchor-conditioned Relation-Aware representation learning), a self-supervised framework for vector geoentities. NARA learns context-dependent representations by jointly modeling semantics, geometry, and spatial relations within a unified framework and captures relational spatial structure beyond proximity alone, enabling rich contextualized representations across heterogeneous geoentities of points, polylines, and polygons. Evaluation on building function classification, traffic speed prediction, and next point-of-interest recommendation shows consistent improvements over prior methods, highlighting the benefit of unified relational modeling for vector geospatial data.

item.title: Images in Sentences: Scaling Interleaved Instructions for Unified Visual Generation
item.author: Zhang, Yabo, Li, Kunchang, Zhou, Dewei, Huang, Xinyu, Wang, Xun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 INSET 的统一生成模型，通过将图像作为原生词汇嵌入文本指令中，实现了多图像一致性生成和文本对齐，并扩展了多模态图像编辑能力。

背景: 现有多模态语言模型在处理复杂的交错指令时性能不足，这是因为当前范式将图像和文本结构分离，导致模型难以建立长距离依赖关系来匹配描述与视觉目标。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在复杂交错指令下性能不足的问题，提出一种统一生成模型。

方法: 提出名为 INSET 的统一生成模型，将图像无缝嵌入文本指令中作为原生词汇；通过将视觉特征直接定位到对应的语义槽位，利用 Transformer 的上下文局部性进行精确对象绑定；同时引入可扩展的数据引擎，利用 VLMs 和 LLMs 合成了 1500 万个高质量交错样本。

主要发现: 在 InterleaveBench 上的评估结果表明，INSET 在多图像一致性和文本对齐方面显著优于最先进的方法，且随着输入复杂度的增加，性能差距会扩大。

结论: 该方法不仅适用于标准生成任务，还天然扩展到多模态图像编辑领域，通过将视觉内容整合到指令中，支持高度表达性和创造性的视觉操作。

翻译: 虽然最近多模态语言模型的进步使得从表达性多图像指令生成图像成为可能，但现有方法在处理复杂的交错指令时难以保持性能。这一局限性源于当前范式中将图像和文本结构分离，迫使模型建立困难的长距离依赖关系以匹配描述与视觉目标。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 Images iN Sentences（简称 INSET），这是一个统一生成模型，能够将图像无缝地作为原生词汇嵌入文本指令中。通过将视觉特征直接定位到其对应的语义槽位，INSET 利用 Transformer 的上下文局部性进行精确的对象绑定，有效地将图像视为密集的、表达丰富的语言标记。此外，我们引入了一个可扩展的数据引擎，利用 VLMs 和 LLMs 从标准图像和视频数据集中合成了 1500 万个高质量交错样本。在 InterleaveBench 上的评估结果表明，INSET 在多图像一致性和文本对齐方面显著优于最先进的方法，随着输入复杂度的增加，性能差距会扩大。除了标准生成之外，我们的方法还天然扩展到多模态图像编辑，将视觉内容作为指令的一部分进行整合，以促进高度表达性和创造性的视觉操作。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

While recent advancements in multimodal language models have enabled image generation from expressive multi-image instructions, existing methods struggle to maintain performance under complex interleaved instructions. This limitation stems from the structural separation of images and text in current paradigms, which forces models to bridge difficult long-range dependencies to match descriptions with visual targets. To address these challenges, we propose \texttt{I}mages i\texttt{N} \texttt{SE}n\texttt{T}ences (\textit{a.k.a}, INSET), a unified generation model that seamlessly embeds images as native vocabulary within textual instructions. By positioning visual features directly at their corresponding semantic slots, INSET leverages the contextual locality of transformers for precise object binding, effectively treating images as dense, expressive language tokens. Furthermore, we introduce a scalable data engine that synthesizes 15M high-quality interleaved samples from standard image and video datasets, utilizing VLMs and LLMs to construct rich, long-horizon sequences. Evaluation results on InterleaveBench demonstrate that INSET significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in multi-image consistency and text alignment, with performance gaps widening as input complexity increases. Beyond standard generation, our approach inherently extends to multimodal image editing, integrating visual content as part of the instruction to facilitate highly expressive and creative visual manipulations.

item.title: Contrastive Learning under Noisy Temporal Self-Supervision for Colonoscopy Videos
item.author: Luca Parolari, Pietro Gori, Lamberto Ballan, Carlo Biffi, Loic Le Folgoc
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于结肠镜检查时间结构自监督学习的方法，用于学习息肉轨迹的鲁棒表示，并通过噪声感知对比损失处理噪声关联，在多项下游任务中表现优异。

背景: 学习息肉轨迹的鲁棒表示对于AI辅助结肠镜检查应用至关重要。虽然监督对比学习有效，但需要正确的正负样本定义，这需要链接视频中的轨迹，成本高且需要专业知识。

目的: 利用结肠镜检查的顺序工作流程，从时间结构中推导出自监督关联，并引入噪声感知对比损失来处理噪声关联，从而学习鲁棒的表示。

方法: 利用结肠镜检查的时间结构推导自监督关联，并引入噪声感知对比损失来处理噪声关联。

主要发现: 在多项下游任务（息肉检索和重识别、大小估计、组织学分类）中证明了学习表示的有效性。该方法优于先前的自监督和监督基线，并匹配或超过了最近的基座模型，仅使用27个视频和一个轻量级编码器。

结论: 代码已开源。

翻译: Learning robust representations of polyp tracklets is key to enabling multiple AI-assisted colonoscopy applications, from polyp characterization to automated reporting and retrieval. Supervised contrastive learning is an effective approach for learning such representations, but it typically relies on correct positive and negative definitions. Collecting these labels requires linking tracklets that depict the same underlying polyp entity throughout the video, which is costly and demands specialized clinical expertise. In this work, we leverage the sequential workflow of colonoscopy procedures to derive self-supervised associations from temporal structure. Since temporally derived associations are not guaranteed to be correct, we introduce a noise-aware contrastive loss to account for noisy associations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned representations across multiple downstream tasks, including polyp retrieval and re-identification, size estimation, and histology classification. Our method outperforms prior self-supervised and supervised baselines, and matches or exceeds recent foundation models across all tasks, using a lightweight encoder trained on only 27 videos. Code is available at https://github.com/lparolari/ntssl.

Abstract

Learning robust representations of polyp tracklets is key to enabling multiple AI-assisted colonoscopy applications, from polyp characterization to automated reporting and retrieval. Supervised contrastive learning is an effective approach for learning such representations, but it typically relies on correct positive and negative definitions. Collecting these labels requires linking tracklets that depict the same underlying polyp entity throughout the video, which is costly and demands specialized clinical expertise. In this work, we leverage the sequential workflow of colonoscopy procedures to derive self-supervised associations from temporal structure. Since temporally derived associations are not guaranteed to be correct, we introduce a noise-aware contrastive loss to account for noisy associations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned representations across multiple downstream tasks, including polyp retrieval and re-identification, size estimation, and histology classification. Our method outperforms prior self-supervised and supervised baselines, and matches or exceeds recent foundation models across all tasks, using a lightweight encoder trained on only 27 videos. Code is available at https://github.com/lparolari/ntssl.

item.title: EHR-RAGp: Retrieval-Augmented Prototype-Guided Foundation Model for Electronic Health Records
item.author: Saeed Shurrab, Mariam Al-Omari, Dana El Samad, Farah E. Shamout
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为EHR-RAGp的检索增强基础模型，旨在通过动态整合患者历史信息来改善临床预测任务。

背景: 电子健康记录包含丰富的纵向患者信息，但在有效利用历史数据时面临轨迹长、事件异质、时间不规则等挑战。现有方法常使用固定窗口或均匀聚合，可能掩盖重要的临床信号。

目的: 提出一种能够动态整合最相关患者历史信息的检索增强基础模型。

方法: 引入EHR-RAGp模型，提出原型引导检索模块作为对齐机制，估计检索历史片段与预测任务的相关性，引导模型关注最 informative 的上下文。

主要发现: 在多个临床预测任务中，EHR-RAGp consistently outperforms state-of-the-art EHR foundation models and transformer-based baselines。此外，将其与现有临床基础模型集成能带来显著的性能提升。

结论: EHR-RAGp提供了一个可扩展且高效的框架，用于利用长程临床上下文来提高下游性能。

翻译: Electronic Health Records (EHR) contain rich longitudinal patient information and are widely used in predictive modeling applications. However, effectively leveraging historical data remains challenging due to long trajectories, heterogeneous events, temporal irregularity, and the varying relevance of past clinical context. Existing approaches often rely on fixed windows or uniform aggregation, which can obscure clinically important signals. In this work, we introduce EHR-RAGp, a retrieval-augmented foundation model that dynamically integrates the most relevant patient history across diverse clinical event types. We propose a prototype-guided retrieval module that acts as an alignment mechanism and estimates the relevance of retrieved historical chunks with respect to a given prediction task, guiding the model towards the most informative context. Across multiple clinical prediction tasks, EHR-RAGp consistently outperforms state-of-the-art EHR foundation models and transformer-based baselines. Furthermore, integrating EHR-RAGp with existing clinical foundation models yields substantial performance gains. Overall, EHR-RAGp provides a scalable and efficient framework for leveraging long-range clinical context to improve downstream performance.

Abstract

Electronic Health Records (EHR) contain rich longitudinal patient information and are widely used in predictive modeling applications. However, effectively leveraging historical data remains challenging due to long trajectories, heterogeneous events, temporal irregularity, and the varying relevance of past clinical context. Existing approaches often rely on fixed windows or uniform aggregation, which can obscure clinically important signals. In this work, we introduce EHR-RAGp, a retrieval-augmented foundation model that dynamically integrates the most relevant patient history across diverse clinical event types. We propose a prototype-guided retrieval module that acts as an alignment mechanism and estimates the relevance of retrieved historical chunks with respect to a given prediction task, guiding the model towards the most informative context. Across multiple clinical prediction tasks, EHR-RAGp consistently outperforms state-of-the-art EHR foundation models and transformer-based baselines. Furthermore, integrating EHR-RAGp with existing clinical foundation models yields substantial performance gains. Overall, EHR-RAGp provides a scalable and efficient framework for leveraging long-range clinical context to improve downstream performance.

item.title: $\delta$-mem: Efficient Online Memory for Large Language Models
item.author: Lei, Jingdi, Zhang, Di, Li, Junxian, Wang, Weida, Fan, Kaixuan, Liu, Xiang, Liu, Qihan, Ma, Xiaoteng, Chen, Baian, Poria, Soujanya
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要
