Abstract

Recent unified image generation models have achieved remarkable success by employing MLLMs for semantic understanding and diffusion backbones for image generation. However, these models remain fundamentally limited in spatially-aware tasks due to a lack of intrinsic spatial understanding and the absence of explicit geometric guidance during generation. In this paper, we propose SpatialFusion, a novel framework that internalizes 3D geometric awareness into unified image generation models. Specifically, we first employ a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture to augment the MLLM with a parallel spatial transformer to enhance 3D geometric modeling capability. By sharing self-attention with the MLLM, the spatial transformer learns to derive metric-depth maps of target images from rich semantic contexts. These explicit geometric scaffolds are then injected into the diffusion backbone through a specialized depth adapter, providing precise spatial constraints for spatially-coherent image generation. Through a progressive two-stage training strategy, SpatialFusion significantly enhances performance on spatially-aware benchmarks, notably outperforming leading models such as GPT-4o. Additionally, it achieves generalized performance gains across both text-to-image generation and image editing scenarios, all while maintaining negligible inference overhead.

item.title: ARMA approximation of a Non-separable Spatio-Temporal Model with Fractional Smoothnesses in Space and Time
item.author: Furset, S. Knutsen, Fuglstad, Geir-Arne, Jakobsen, Espen R.
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于扩散的时空非分离协方差模型，允许空间和时间上的分数平滑度，并提出了基于时间有理逼近的离散化方法来处理任意平滑度。

背景: Matérn 协方差模型在空间建模中很常见，但在时空建模中没有默认选择。

目的: 考虑将空间 Matérn 协方差模型扩展为时空非分离协方差模型，以允许分数平滑度。

方法: 提出一种基于时间有理逼近的离散化方法，将模型转化为向量自回归移动平均过程 VARMA。同时证明了协方差函数的收敛性并确定了收敛率。

主要发现: 1. VARMA 过程的低阶数具有小的点态误差。 2. 参数可以通过模拟研究进行估计。 3. 正确指定时间平滑度对预测尤为重要。 4. 该方法应用于法国大陆三个月的每日平均气温数据。

结论: 该方法能够有效处理任意时间平滑度，参数可估计，且正确设定时间平滑度对预测至关重要。

翻译: The Matérn covariance model is ubiquitous in spatial modelling, but there is no default choice for spatio-temporal modelling. In this paper, we consider the recently proposed ``diffusion-based'' extension of the spatial Matérn covariance model to a spatio-temporal non-separable covariance model that allows fractional smoothnesses in space and in time. The model is described in terms of a space-time fractional stochastic partial differential equation, but currently proposed computational approaches have strong restrictions on the possible smoothnesses in time. We propose a discretization method based on rational approximations in time to handle arbitrary smoothnesses, which leads to a vector autoregressive moving average process (VARMA). We prove that the covariance function of the approximation converges pointwise, determine explicit convergence rates as a function of spatial and temporal resolutions and the accuracy of the rational approximation, and conduct numerical verification to demonstrate small pointwise error for low orders of the VARMA process. Through a simulation study, we demonstrate that the parameters can be estimated back and that correctly specifying the temporal smoothness is especially important for forecasting. The approach is illustrated for three months of daily mean temperatures in mainland France.

Abstract

The Matérn covariance model is ubiquitous in spatial modelling, but there is no default choice for spatio-temporal modelling. In this paper, we consider the recently proposed ``diffusion-based'' extension of the spatial Matérn covariance model to a spatio-temporal non-separable covariance model that allows fractional smoothnesses in space and in time. The model is described in terms of a space-time fractional stochastic partial differential equation, but currently proposed computational approaches have strong restrictions on the possible smoothnesses in time. We propose a discretization method based on rational approximations in time to handle arbitrary smoothnesses, which leads to a vector autoregressive moving average process (VARMA). We prove that the covariance function of the approximation converges pointwise, determine explicit convergence rates as a function of spatial and temporal resolutions and the accuracy of the rational approximation, and conduct numerical verification to demonstrate small pointwise error for low orders of the VARMA process. Through a simulation study, we demonstrate that the parameters can be estimated back and that correctly specifying the temporal smoothness is especially important for forecasting. The approach is illustrated for three months of daily mean temperatures in mainland France.

item.title: DenseStep2M: A Scalable, Training-Free Pipeline for Dense Instructional Video Annotation
item.author: Ge, Mingji, Chen, Qirui, Li, Zeqian, Xie, Weidi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种自动化流程来提取高质量程序化注释，构建了包含约10万视频和200万步骤的数据集DenseStep2M，并验证了其在多种视频理解任务中的有效性。

背景: 长期视频理解需要解释复杂的时间事件和对程序性活动进行推理。现有的教学视频语料库虽然资源丰富，但存在ASR转录本嘈杂以及旁白与视觉内容时间对齐不一致的问题。

目的: 构建一个大规模、高质量的程序化注释数据集，以支持全面的长视频理解，并解决现有数据集的噪声和对齐问题。

方法: 该方法将视频分割为连贯镜头，过滤对齐不良内容，并利用多模态和大型语言模型生成结构化步骤。同时构建了DenseCaption100基准测试。

主要发现: 自动生成的步骤与人工注释高度一致。在密集视频描述、步骤定位和跨模态检索任务上表现优异。模型在DenseStep2M上微调后，在描述质量和时间定位上显著提升，且具备强大的零样本泛化能力。

结论: DenseStep2M能有效促进高级多模态对齐和长期活动推理，数据集已公开发布。

翻译: Long-term video understanding requires interpreting complex temporal events and reasoning over procedural activities. While instructional video corpora, like HowTo100M, offer rich resources for model training, they present significant challenges, including noisy ASR transcripts and inconsistent temporal alignments between narration and visual content. In this work, we introduce an automated, training-free pipeline to extract high-quality procedural annotations from in-the-wild instructional videos. Our approach segments videos into coherent shots, filters poorly aligned content, and leverages state-of-the-art multimodal and large language models (Qwen2.5-VL and DeepSeek-R1) to generate structured, temporally grounded procedural steps. This pipeline yields DenseStep2M, a large-scale dataset comprising approximately 100K videos and 2M detailed instructional steps, designed to support comprehensive long-form video understanding. To rigorously evaluate our pipeline, we curate DenseCaption100, a benchmark of high-quality, human-written captions. Evaluations demonstrate strong alignment between our auto-generated steps and human annotations. Furthermore, we validate the utility of DenseStep2M across three core downstream tasks: dense video captioning, procedural step grounding, and cross-modal retrieval. Models fine-tuned on DenseStep2M achieve substantial gains in captioning quality and temporal localization, while exhibiting robust zero-shot generalization across egocentric, exocentric, and mixed-perspective domains. These results underscore the effectiveness of DenseStep2M in facilitating advanced multimodal alignment and long-term activity reasoning. Our dataset is available at this https URL .

Abstract

Long-term video understanding requires interpreting complex temporal events and reasoning over procedural activities. While instructional video corpora, like HowTo100M, offer rich resources for model training, they present significant challenges, including noisy ASR transcripts and inconsistent temporal alignments between narration and visual content. In this work, we introduce an automated, training-free pipeline to extract high-quality procedural annotations from in-the-wild instructional videos. Our approach segments videos into coherent shots, filters poorly aligned content, and leverages state-of-the-art multimodal and large language models (Qwen2.5-VL and DeepSeek-R1) to generate structured, temporally grounded procedural steps. This pipeline yields DenseStep2M, a large-scale dataset comprising approximately 100K videos and 2M detailed instructional steps, designed to support comprehensive long-form video understanding. To rigorously evaluate our pipeline, we curate DenseCaption100, a benchmark of high-quality, human-written captions. Evaluations demonstrate strong alignment between our auto-generated steps and human annotations. Furthermore, we validate the utility of DenseStep2M across three core downstream tasks: dense video captioning, procedural step grounding, and cross-modal retrieval. Models fine-tuned on DenseStep2M achieve substantial gains in captioning quality and temporal localization, while exhibiting robust zero-shot generalization across egocentric, exocentric, and mixed-perspective domains. These results underscore the effectiveness of DenseStep2M in facilitating advanced multimodal alignment and long-term activity reasoning. Our dataset is available at this https URL .

item.title: Advancing multi-site emission control: A physics-informed transfer learning framework with mixture of experts for carbon-pollutant synergy
item.author: Ying, Yuxuan, Yang, Hanqing, Wang, Kaige, Hu, Yu, Zheng, Zhiming, Jiang, Yunliang, Lin, Xiaoqing, Li, Xiaodong, Chen, Jun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对垃圾焚烧发电中跨设施迁移学习控制碳排放和空气污染物的挑战，提出了一种基于物理信息的迁移学习框架。

背景: 垃圾焚烧发电对城市废物管理至关重要，但在高度异质运行条件下控制碳排放和多种空气污染物具有挑战性。现有数据驱动模型在单个工厂内准确，但在工厂间难以迁移。

目的: 研究多站点排放行为，开发可迁移的系统级结构，以支持可扩展的排放控制策略。

方法: 开发了一个基于碳-污染物混合专家模型的物理信息迁移学习框架。该框架结合了工况依赖的专家路由、基于守恒的规则化和碳-污染物协同指数。

主要发现: 在13个工厂的测试中，模型捕捉到了污染物特定排放和系统级风险。从参考设施迁移到12个目标工厂后，模型性能保持稳定。专家利用模式表明适应是通过运行工况的结构化重新加权实现的。

结论: 该框架通过可解释的数字孪生，实现了从排放预测到工况感知的操作导航，支持异质废物能源系统中的可扩展碳-污染物协同控制。

翻译: 垃圾焚烧发电在废物管理中日益重要，但其可持续性取决于在高度异质运行条件下控制碳排放和多种空气污染物。当前的数据驱动模型在单个工厂内准确，但在工厂间难以迁移。本文表明，通过联合考虑物理约束、运行工况异质性和碳-污染物耦合，多站点排放行为可以通过可迁移的系统级结构来表示。我们开发了一个基于碳-污染物混合专家模型的物理信息迁移学习框架，结合了工况依赖的专家路由、基于守恒的规则化和碳-污染物协同指数。在13个工厂中，模型捕捉到了污染物特定排放和系统级风险。从参考设施迁移到12个目标工厂后，平均污染物性能保持稳定。专家利用模式表明适应是通过运行工况的结构化重新加权实现的。通过将学习到的表示扩展为可解释的数字孪生，该框架提供了从排放预测到工况感知的操作导航的路径，支持异质废物能源系统中的可扩展碳-污染物协同控制。

Abstract

Municipal solid waste incineration is increasingly central to urban waste management, yet its sustainability benefit depends on controlling carbon emissions and multiple air pollutants under highly heterogeneous operating conditions. Current data-driven models are often accurate within individual plants but are difficult to transfer across facilities, limiting their value for scalable emission-control strategies. Here we show that multi-site emission behaviour can be represented through transferable system-level structures when physical constraints, operating-regime heterogeneity and carbon--pollutant coupling are jointly considered. We develop a physics-informed transfer learning framework built on a carbon--pollutant mixture-of-experts model, which combines regime-dependent expert routing with conservation-based regularization and a carbon--pollutant synergistic index for integrated risk evaluation. Across 13 municipal solid waste incineration plants, the model captured both pollutant-specific emissions and system-level risk, achieving source-domain average pollutant $R^2$ values of 0.668--0.904 and CPSI $R^2$ values of 0.666--0.970. After transfer from a reference facility to 12 target plants, average pollutant $R^2$ remained between 0.661 and 0.842, while CPSI retained comparable transferability ($R^2$ = 0.610--0.841). Expert-utilization patterns further indicate that adaptation occurs through structured re-weighting of operating regimes rather than complete model re-learning. By extending the learned representation into an interpretable digital twin, this framework provides a route from emission prediction to regime-aware operational navigation, supporting scalable carbon--pollutant synergistic control across heterogeneous waste-to-energy systems.

item.title: CurEvo: Curriculum-Guided Self-Evolution for Video Understanding
item.author: Zeng, Guiyi, Yu, Junqing, Chen, Yi-Ping Phoebe, Chen, Xu, Yang, Wei, Song, Zikai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出CurEvo框架，通过引入课程学习引导自我进化，实现结构化的视频理解模型改进。

背景: 自我进化视频理解框架虽展示了无标注自主学习的潜力，但现有方法缺乏结构化指导，导致优化控制弱且难度进展不可控。

目的: 为了解决缺乏结构化指导的问题，提出CurEvo框架，将课程学习引入自我进化，实现更结构化和渐进的模型改进。

方法: CurEvo动态调节任务难度、细化评估标准并平衡数据多样性，形成课程引导的反馈循环。在此基础上，开发了一个多维自适应问答框架，在感知、识别和理解维度上联合进化问答生成和评估。

主要发现: 在四个VideoQA基准测试上，CurEvo在七种骨干网络上持续提高了基准准确性和基于评估器的语义分数。

结论: CurEvo将弱控制的自进化转化为更结构化的自主学习过程，验证了课程引导的自进化在视频理解中的有效性。

翻译: 自我进化视频理解框架的近期进展展示了无人工标注自主学习的潜力。然而，现有方法通常受到优化控制较弱和难度进展不可控的影响，因为它们在迭代学习过程中缺乏结构化指导。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了CurEvo，一个课程引导的自我进化框架，将课程学习引入自我进化，以实现更结构化和渐进的模型改进。CurEvo根据模型能力动态调节任务难度、细化评估标准并平衡数据多样性，形成课程引导的反馈循环，使学习复杂性与模型能力相一致。基于这一原则，我们开发了一个多维自适应问答框架，在感知、识别和理解维度上联合进化问答生成和答案评估，确保连贯且可衡量的课程进展。通过这种整合，CurEvo将弱控制的自进化转化为更结构化的自主学习过程，用于自主视频理解。在四种VideoQA基准测试中，CurEvo在七种骨干网络上持续提高了基准准确性和基于评估器的语义分数，验证了课程引导的自进化在视频理解中的有效性。

Abstract

Recent advances in self-evolution video understanding frameworks have demonstrated the potential of autonomous learning without human annotations. However, existing methods often suffer from weakly controlled optimization and uncontrolled difficulty progression, as they lack structured guidance throughout the iterative learning process. To address these limitations, we propose CurEvo, a curriculum-guided self-evolution framework that introduces curriculum learning into self-evolution to achieve more structured and progressive model improvement. CurEvo dynamically regulates task difficulty, refines evaluation criteria, and balances data diversity according to model competence, forming a curriculum-guided feedback loop that aligns learning complexity with model capability. Built upon this principle, we develop a multi-dimensional adaptive QA framework that jointly evolves question generation and answer evaluation across perception, recognition, and understanding dimensions, ensuring coherent and measurable curriculum progression. Through this integration, CurEvo transforms weakly controlled self-evolution into a more structured learning process for autonomous video understanding. Across seven backbones, CurEvo consistently improves both benchmark accuracy and evaluator-based semantic score on four VideoQA benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of curriculum-guided self-evolution for video understanding.

item.title: Graph-based Semantic Calibration Network for Unaligned UAV RGBT Image Semantic Segmentation and A Large-scale Benchmark
item.author: Fangqiang Fan, Zhicheng Zhao, Xiaoliang Ma, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于图的语义校准网络GSCNet，用于解决无人机RGBT图像语义分割中的空间错位和语义混淆问题，并构建了URTF数据集。

背景: 全天候无人机场景理解需要细粒度RGBT图像语义分割，但面临跨模态空间错位和细粒度地物语义混淆两大挑战。

目的: 解决无人机RGBT图像语义分割中因传感器视差和平台振动导致的跨模态空间错位问题，以及俯视视角下细粒度地物之间的严重语义混淆问题。

方法: 提出了基于图的语义校准网络GSCNet。具体包括特征解耦与对齐模块FDAM，用于在共享子空间进行可变形对齐以校正空间；以及语义图校准模块SGCM，将地物类别的层级分类法和共现规律编码为结构化类别图，并通过图注意力推理校准预测结果。

主要发现: 在构建的URTF基准数据集上，GSCNet显著优于现有最先进的方法，特别是在细粒度类别上取得了显著提升。

结论: GSCNet能有效解决RGBT图像分割中的空间错位和语义混淆问题，性能优越。

翻译: Fine-grained RGBT image semantic segmentation is crucial for all-weather unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) scene understanding. However, UAV RGBT image semantic segmentation faces two coupled challenges: cross-modal spatial misalignment caused by sensor parallax and platform vibration, and severe semantic confusion among fine-grained ground objects under top-down aerial views. To address these issues, we propose a Graph-based Semantic Calibration Network (GSCNet) for unaligned UAV RGBT image semantic segmentation. Specifically, we design a Feature Decoupling and Alignment Module (FDAM) that decouples each modality into shared structural and private perceptual components and performs deformable alignment in the shared subspace, enabling robust spatial correction with reduced modality appearance interference. Moreover, we propose a Semantic Graph Calibration Module (SGCM) that explicitly encodes the hierarchical taxonomy and co-occurrence regularities among ground-object categories in UAV scenes into a structured category graph, and incorporates these priors into graph-attention reasoning to calibrate predictions of visually similar and rare categories. In addition, we construct the Unaligned RGB-Thermal Fine-grained (URTF) benchmark, to the best of our knowledge, the largest and most fine-grained benchmark for unaligned UAV RGBT image semantic segmentation, containing over 25,000 image pairs across 61 semantic categories with realistic cross-modal misalignment. Extensive experiments on URTF demonstrate that GSCNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with notable gains on fine-grained categories. The dataset is available at https://github.com/mmic-lcl/Datasets-and-benchmark-code.

Abstract

Fine-grained RGBT image semantic segmentation is crucial for all-weather unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) scene understanding. However, UAV RGBT image semantic segmentation faces two coupled challenges: cross-modal spatial misalignment caused by sensor parallax and platform vibration, and severe semantic confusion among fine-grained ground objects under top-down aerial views. To address these issues, we propose a Graph-based Semantic Calibration Network (GSCNet) for unaligned UAV RGBT image semantic segmentation. Specifically, we design a Feature Decoupling and Alignment Module (FDAM) that decouples each modality into shared structural and private perceptual components and performs deformable alignment in the shared subspace, enabling robust spatial correction with reduced modality appearance interference. Moreover, we propose a Semantic Graph Calibration Module (SGCM) that explicitly encodes the hierarchical taxonomy and co-occurrence regularities among ground-object categories in UAV scenes into a structured category graph, and incorporates these priors into graph-attention reasoning to calibrate predictions of visually similar and rare categories. In addition, we construct the Unaligned RGB-Thermal Fine-grained (URTF) benchmark, to the best of our knowledge, the largest and most fine-grained benchmark for unaligned UAV RGBT image semantic segmentation, containing over 25,000 image pairs across 61 semantic categories with realistic cross-modal misalignment. Extensive experiments on URTF demonstrate that GSCNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with notable gains on fine-grained categories. The dataset is available at https://github.com/mmic-lcl/Datasets-and-benchmark-code.

item.title: Anomaly Detection in Soil Heavy Metal Contamination Using Unsupervised Learning for Environmental Risk Assessment
item.author: Isaac Tettey Adjokatse, Samuel Senyo Koranteng, George Yamoah Afrifa, Theophilus Ansah-Narh, Marcellin Atemkeng, Joseph Bremang Tandoh, Kow Ahor Essel-Yorke, Richmond Opoku-Sarkodie, Rebecca Davis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究利用无监督机器学习框架，对加纳中部地区土壤中的重金属污染模式进行检测和特征分析，发现异常样本与健康风险指数存在关联。

背景: 加纳快速城市化地区，特别是无监管废物处置点，存在重金属污染问题，对环境和公众健康构成持续威胁。

目的: 应用无监督机器学习框架，检测和表征来自十二个废物处置点和住宅控制区的土壤中异常的重金属污染模式。

方法: 分析了八种金属的浓度，并结合标准健康风险指数。使用了孤立森林、PCA重建误差和DBSCAN算法来识别异常样本。

主要发现: 识别出六个稳健的异常样本，全部集中在单一地点S3。异常样本的危害指数比正常样本高出约70%至80%，且均超过危害指数阈值。PCA重建误差与危害指数呈强正相关。发现了三种异常类型：S3处极端的铜富集，S4/S5处异常低的镍，以及S9至S12处铅和锌的适度共同升高。

结论: 无监督机器学习提供了超越聚合指标的细粒度、客观的见解，能够实现有针对性的场地优先排序和风险导向的环境管理。

翻译: 加纳快速城市化地区，特别是无监管废物处置点，土壤重金属污染对环境和公众健康构成持续威胁。本研究应用无监督机器学习框架，对加纳中部地区十二个废物处置点和住宅控制区的土壤中异常重金属污染模式进行检测和表征。分析了八种金属的浓度，并结合危害指数HI和增量终生致癌风险ILCR等标准健康风险指数。孤立森林和PCA重建误差各识别出异常样本，而DBSCAN未检测到密度隔离的噪声点。共识方法隔离出六个稳健的异常样本，全部集中在单一地点S3。异常样本的危害指数比正常样本高出约70%至80%，且所有共识异常样本均超过危害指数阈值。PCA重建误差与危害指数呈强正相关，表明多维偏离与健康风险之间的一致性。识别出三种不同的异常类型：S3处极端的铜富集，S4/S5处异常低的镍，以及S9至S12处铅和锌的适度共同升高。结果表明，无监督机器学习提供了超越聚合指标的细粒度、客观的见解，能够实现有针对性的场地优先排序和风险导向的环境管理。

Abstract

Soil contamination by heavy metals poses a persistent environmental and public health concern in rapidly urbanising regions of Ghana, particularly at unregulated waste disposal sites. This study applies an unsupervised machine learning framework to detect and characterise anomalous heavy metal contamination patterns in soils from twelve waste sites and residential controls in the Central Region, of Ghana. Concentrations of eight metals (As, Cd, Cr, Cu, Hg, Ni, Pb, Zn) were analysed alongside standard health risk indices, including the Hazard Index (HI) and Incremental Lifetime Cancer Risk (ILCR). Isolation Forest and PCA reconstruction error each identified $12$ anomalous samples ($15.4\%$ of $78$ samples), while DBSCAN detected no density-isolated noise points. A consensus approach isolated six robust anomalies ($7.7\%)$, all spatially concentrated at a single site (S3). Anomalies exhibited approximately $70$--$80\%$ higher mean HI values than normal samples, with all consensus anomalies exceeding the HI$=1$ threshold. PCA reconstruction error showed a strong positive association with HI ($r \approx 0.8$), indicating consistency between multivariate deviation and health risk. Three distinct anomaly types were identified: extreme Cu enrichment at S3, anomalously low Ni at S4/S5, and moderate multi-metal (Pb--Zn) co-elevation at S9--S12. The results demonstrate that unsupervised machine learning provides granular, objective insight beyond aggregate indices, enabling targeted site prioritisation and risk-informed environmental management.

item.title: Learning Rate Engineering: From Coarse Single Parameter to Layered Evolution
item.author: Ming-Hong Yao, Di Wang, Jian Cui, Jin-Yan Chen, Zi-Hao Cui, Fa Wang, Chen Wei, Qiu-Ye Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文系统化了学习率调度从全局固定到层级自适应的演变，提出了DALS框架，并通过实验验证了其在不同任务中的有效性。

背景: 学习率调度已从早期的全局固定策略演变为复杂的层级自适应策略。为了解决迁移学习中的不可能三角问题，即底层需要小更新以保持通用知识，高层需要大更新以适应新任务。

目的: 系统化学习率调度的演变，提出一个统一的优化器框架DALS，以解决不同层级和任务的需求。

方法: 提出了DALS框架，集成了阶段自适应余弦调度、深度感知的Grokfast梯度过滤和LARS风格的信任比率。

主要发现: 在合成数据上DALS达到98%准确率，DALS-Fast在3个epoch达到90%。没有单一策略在所有情况下都有效。STLR+Discriminative在从头训练任务上表现很差，而DALS避免了极端情况。

结论: DALS在合成数据上表现最好，同时保持了竞争力的微调性能，避免了极端情况。

翻译: 学习率调度已从早期SGD的单个全局固定速率演变为复杂的层级自适应策略。我们将这种演变系统化为五代：第一代全局固定学习率，第二代全局调度，第三代参数级自适应，第四代层级级差异化，以及第五代联合层级时间调度。我们追溯了每次转变背后的根本动机，展示了从一刀切到按层级和时间量身定制的转变如何解决了迁移学习的“不可能三角”：底层需要小更新以保持通用知识，而高层需要大更新以适应新任务。基于这种分类法，我们提出了判别性自适应层级缩放DALS，这是一个统一的框架，将阶段自适应余弦调度、深度感知的Grokfast梯度过滤和LARS风格的信任比率整合到一个连贯的优化器中。我们在五个数据集上对包括三个DALS变体在内的18种策略进行了基准测试：合成数据、CIFAR-10（从头开始）、RTE、TREC-6和IMDb（微调）。在合成数据上，DALS达到98.0%的最佳准确率，而DALS-Fast在仅3个epoch内达到90%。跨数据集分析揭示了显著的依赖模式的规律——没有单一策略在所有规律中获胜。关键的是，STLR+Discriminative，ULMFiT的冠军，在从头训练任务上灾难性地失败（TREC-6从头训练为43.6%，而RAdam为96.8%），证实了在没有预训练特征的情况下，方向衰减偏差是有害的。DALS避免了任何极端情况，在合成数据上取得了最佳结果，同时保持了竞争力的微调性能。

Abstract

Learning rate scheduling has evolved from the single global fixed rate of early SGD to sophisticated layer-wise adaptive strategies. We systematize this evolution into five generations: (Gen1) global fixed learning rates, (Gen2) global scheduling, (Gen3) parameter-level adaptation, (Gen4) layer-level differentiation, and (Gen5) joint layer-time scheduling. We trace the fundamental motivation behind each transition, showing how the shift from one-size-fits-all to tailoring by layer and time addresses the impossible trinity of transfer learning: lower layers require small updates to preserve general knowledge while higher layers need large updates to adapt to new tasks. Building on this taxonomy, we propose Discriminative Adaptive Layer Scaling (DALS), a unified framework that integrates phase-adaptive cosine scheduling, depth-aware Grokfast gradient filtering, and LARS-style trust ratios into a single coherent optimizer. We benchmark 18 strategies including three DALS variants across all five generations on five datasets: synthetic, CIFAR-10 (from scratch), RTE, TREC-6, and IMDb (fine-tuning). On synthetic, DALS achieves the best accuracy at 98.0%, while DALS-Fast reaches 90% in just 3 epochs. The cross-dataset analysis reveals striking regime-dependent patterns -- no single strategy wins across all regimes. Critically, STLR+Discriminative, the ULMFiT champion, catastrophically fails on from-scratch tasks (43.6% on TREC-6 from scratch vs. 96.8% with RAdam), confirming that directional decay biases are harmful without pretrained features. DALS avoids either extreme, achieving the best synthetic result while maintaining competitive fine-tuning performance.

item.title: Uni-HOI:A Unified framework for Learning the Joint distribution of Text and Human-Object Interaction
item.author: Mengfei Zhang, Jinlu Zhang, Zhigang Tu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Uni-HOI 的统一框架，用于联合建模文本、人体运动和物体运动。

背景: 4D 人体-物体交互是计算机视觉的关键技术，但现有方法通常依赖特定任务的架构，缺乏处理多样化条件输入的统一框架。

目的: 构建一个能够处理文本、人体运动和物体运动三种模态的统一框架，以解决现有方法缺乏统一架构的问题。

方法: 利用大语言模型和两个运动特定的向量量化变分自编码器，将异构运动数据转换为兼容 LLM 输入的 token 序列。采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段在大规模数据集上进行多任务学习，第二阶段在特定任务上进行微调。

主要发现: Uni-HOI 在多个 HOI 相关任务上取得了显著性能，包括文本驱动的 HOI 生成、物体运动驱动的人体运动生成以及人体运动驱动的物体运动预测。

结论: 该框架成功实现了对三种模态的联合建模，并在统一框架内实现了多种 HOI 任务的高性能表现。

翻译: 在计算机视觉中，建模 4D 人体-物体交互是一个具有吸引力的挑战，也是推动虚拟和混合现实应用的关键技术。虽然现有工作在特定的 HOI 任务上取得了有希望的结果，例如文本条件化的 HOI 生成和从物体运动生成人体运动，但它们通常依赖于特定任务的架构，缺乏能够处理多样化条件输入的统一框架。在此基础上，我们提出了 Uni-HOI，这是一个统一框架，用于学习文本、人体运动和物体运动之间的联合分布。通过利用大语言模型和两个运动特定的向量量化变分自编码器，我们将异构运动数据转换为与 LLM 输入兼容的 token 序列，从而实现所有三种模态的无缝集成和联合建模。我们引入了一种两阶段训练策略：第一阶段在大规模 HOI 数据集上进行多任务学习，以捕获这三种模态之间的潜在相关性，而第二阶段在特定任务上微调模型以进一步提高性能。大量实验表明，Uni-HOI 在多个 HOI 相关任务上取得了显著性能，包括文本驱动的 HOI 生成、物体运动驱动的人体运动生成（可选带文本）以及人体运动驱动的物体运动预测，所有这些都在一个统一框架内。

Abstract

Modeling 4D human-object interaction (HOI) is a compelling challenge in computer vision and an essential technology powering virtual and mixed-reality applications. While existing works have achieved promising results on specific HOI tasks-such as text-conditioned HOI generation and human motion generation from object motion, they typically rely on task-specific architectures and lack a unified framework capable of handling diverse conditional inputs. Building on this, we propose Uni-HOI, a unified framework that learns the joint distribution among text, human motion, and object motion. By leveraging large language models (LLMs) and two motion-specific vector quantized variational autoencoders (VQ-VAEs), we convert heterogeneous motion data into token sequences compatible with LLM inputs, enabling seamless integration and joint modeling of all three modalities. We introduce a two-stage training strategy: the first stage performs multi-task learning on a large-scale HOI dataset to capture the underlying correlations among the three modalities, while the second stage fine-tunes the model on specific tasks to further enhance performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Uni-HOI achieves remarkable performances on multiple HOI-related tasks including text-driven HOI generation, object motion-driven human motion generation (optionally with text) and human motion-driven object motion prediction within a unified framework.

item.title: Action Motifs: Self-Supervised Hierarchical Representation of Human Body Movements
item.author: Genki Kinoshita, Shu Nakamura, Ryo Kawahara, Shohei Nobuhara, Yasutomo Kawanishi, Ko Nishino
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出A4Mer模型，利用嵌套潜在Transformer自监督学习人体运动的层次化表示，包括原子动作和动作模态。

背景: 有效的行为建模需要一种能够利用人体运动组合性的表示方法。

目的: 构建一种层次化表示，包含捕捉原子关节运动的Action Atoms和编码跨动作相似身体运动的Action Motifs。

方法: A4Mer将3D姿态序列分割为可变长度段并映射为潜在token，通过掩码token预测任务在潜在空间进行自底向上学习，从而自然涌现出Action Motifs。

主要发现: A4Mer能有效提取有意义的Action Motifs；AMD数据集通过脚部摄像头解决了遮挡问题，实现了多视角人体行为视频的标注。

结论: A4Mer显著提升了动作识别、运动预测和运动插值等任务的效果。

翻译: Effective human behavior modeling requires a representation of the human body movement that capitalizes on its compositionality. We propose a hierarchical representation consisting of Action Atoms that capture the atomic joint movements and Action Motifs that are formed by their temporal compositions and encode similar body movements found across different overall human actions. We derive A4Mer, a nested latent Transformer to learn this hierarchical representation from human pose data in a fully self-supervised manner. A4Mer splits a 3D pose sequence into variable-length segments and represents each segment as a single latent token (Action Atoms). Through bottom-up representation learning, temporal patterns composed of these Action Atoms, which capture meaningful temporal spans of reusable, semantic segments of body movements, naturally emerge (Action Motifs). A4Mer achieves this with a unified pretext task of masked token prediction in their respective latent spaces. We also introduce Action Motif Dataset (AMD), a large-scale dataset of multi-view human behavior videos with full SMPL annotations. We introduce a novel use of cameras by mounting them on the feet to achieve their frame-wise annotations despite frequent and heavy body occlusions. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of A4Mer for extracting meaningful Action Motifs, which significantly benefit human behavior modeling tasks including action recognition, motion prediction, and motion interpolation.

Abstract

Effective human behavior modeling requires a representation of the human body movement that capitalizes on its compositionality. We propose a hierarchical representation consisting of Action Atoms that capture the atomic joint movements and Action Motifs that are formed by their temporal compositions and encode similar body movements found across different overall human actions. We derive A4Mer, a nested latent Transformer to learn this hierarchical representation from human pose data in a fully self-supervised manner. A4Mer splits a 3D pose sequence into variable-length segments and represents each segment as a single latent token (Action Atoms). Through bottom-up representation learning, temporal patterns composed of these Action Atoms, which capture meaningful temporal spans of reusable, semantic segments of body movements, naturally emerge (Action Motifs). A4Mer achieves this with a unified pretext task of masked token prediction in their respective latent spaces. We also introduce Action Motif Dataset (AMD), a large-scale dataset of multi-view human behavior videos with full SMPL annotations. We introduce a novel use of cameras by mounting them on the feet to achieve their frame-wise annotations despite frequent and heavy body occlusions. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of A4Mer for extracting meaningful Action Motifs, which significantly benefit human behavior modeling tasks including action recognition, motion prediction, and motion interpolation.

item.title: HERMES++: Toward a Unified Driving World Model for 3D Scene Understanding and Generation
item.author: Xin Zhou, Dingkang Liang, Xiwu Chen, Feiyang Tan, Dingyuan Zhang, Hengshuang Zhao, Xiang Bai
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出HERMES++，一种统一驾驶世界模型，旨在结合3D场景理解和未来几何预测。

背景: 现有方法主要关注未来场景生成，往往忽略了全面的3D场景理解。同时，大语言模型虽然推理能力强，但缺乏预测未来几何演化的能力，导致语义解释与物理模拟之间存在显著差距。

目的: 弥合语义解释与物理模拟之间的差距，在单一框架内整合3D场景理解和未来几何预测。

方法: 1. 使用BEV表示将多视图空间信息整合为与LLM兼容的结构。2. 引入LLM增强的世界查询以促进从理解分支的知识转移。3. 设计Current-to-Future Link以桥接时间差距，将几何演化条件化于语义上下文。4. 采用联合几何优化策略，整合显式几何约束和隐式潜在正则化，以使内部表示与几何感知先验对齐。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试上验证了该方法的有效性。HERMES++在未来的点云预测和3D场景理解任务中均表现出色，优于专业方法。

结论: 模型和代码将在GitHub上公开发布。

翻译: 驾驶世界模型作为通过模拟环境动态来支持自动驾驶的关键技术。然而，现有方法主要关注未来场景生成，往往忽略了全面的3D场景理解。相反，虽然大语言模型展示了令人印象深刻的推理能力，但它们缺乏预测未来几何演化的能力，导致语义解释与物理模拟之间存在显著差距。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了HERMES++，一个统一驾驶世界模型，在单一框架内整合了3D场景理解和未来几何预测。我们的方法通过协同设计解决了这些任务的不同需求。首先，BEV表示将多视图空间信息整合为与LLM兼容的结构。其次，我们引入了LLM增强的世界查询，以促进从理解分支的知识转移。第三，设计了Current-to-Future Link以桥接时间差距，将几何演化条件化于语义上下文。最后，为了确保结构完整性，我们采用联合几何优化策略，整合显式几何约束和隐式潜在正则化，以使内部表示与几何感知先验对齐。在多个基准测试上的广泛评估验证了我们方法的有效性。HERMES++取得了强劲的性能，在未来的点云预测和3D场景理解任务中均优于专业方法。模型和代码将在 https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/HERMESV2 上公开发布。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Driving world models serve as a pivotal technology for autonomous driving by simulating environmental dynamics. However, existing approaches predominantly focus on future scene generation, often overlooking comprehensive 3D scene understanding. Conversely, while Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive reasoning capabilities, they lack the capacity to predict future geometric evolution, creating a significant disparity between semantic interpretation and physical simulation. To bridge this gap, we propose HERMES++, a unified driving world model that integrates 3D scene understanding and future geometry prediction within a single framework. Our approach addresses the distinct requirements of these tasks through synergistic designs. First, a BEV representation consolidates multi-view spatial information into a structure compatible with LLMs. Second, we introduce LLM-enhanced world queries to facilitate knowledge transfer from the understanding branch. Third, a Current-to-Future Link is designed to bridge the temporal gap, conditioning geometric evolution on semantic context. Finally, to enforce structural integrity, we employ a Joint Geometric Optimization strategy that integrates explicit geometric constraints with implicit latent regularization to align internal representations with geometry-aware priors. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method. HERMES++ achieves strong performance, outperforming specialist approaches in both future point cloud prediction and 3D scene understanding tasks. The model and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/HERMESV2.

item.title: Learning physically grounded traffic accident reconstruction from public accident reports
item.author: Yanchen Guan, Haicheng Liao, Chengyue Wang, Zhenning Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于公开报告和场景测量的交通事故重建方法，构建了CISS-REC数据集，并通过多模态学习框架实现了高保真的重建。

背景: 交通事故通常有文本报告，但物理层面的重建很难，因为详细的场景测量和专家重建稀缺、昂贵且难以扩展。

目的: 将基于公开报告和场景测量的交通事故重建形式化为参数化多模态学习问题。

方法: 构建了CISS-REC数据集，开发了重建框架，将报告语义映射到道路拓扑和参与者属性，重建车道一致的碰撞前运动，并通过局部几何推理和时间分配细化碰撞相关交互。

主要发现: 该方法在CISS-REC上优于代表性基线，实现了最强的整体重建保真度，包括提高了事故点准确性和碰撞一致性。

结论: 公开事故报告可以作为可量化的交通事故重建的可扩展计算基础，对交通安全分析、仿真和自动驾驶研究具有潜在价值。

翻译: 交通事故通常记录在文本报告中，但物理层面的交通事故重建仍然困难，因为详细的场景测量和专家重建稀缺、昂贵且难以扩展。在这里，我们将基于公开可访问的报告和场景测量的交通事故重建形式化为参数化多模态学习问题。我们构建了CISS-REC，这是一个包含6217个真实世界交通事故案例的数据集，这些案例来自NHTSA事故调查抽样系统，并开发了一个重建框架，将报告语义映射到道路拓扑和参与者属性，重建车道一致的碰撞前运动，并通过局部几何推理和时间分配来细化与碰撞相关的交互。我们的方法在CISS-REC上优于代表性基线，实现了最强的整体重建保真度，包括提高了事故点准确性和碰撞一致性。这些结果表明，公开事故报告可以作为可量化的交通事故重建的可扩展计算基础，对交通安全分析、仿真和自动驾驶研究具有潜在价值。

Abstract

Traffic accidents are routinely documented in textual reports, yet physically grounded accident reconstruction remains difficult because detailed scene measurements and expert reconstructions are scarce, costly and hard to scale. Here we formulate accident reconstruction from publicly accessible reports and scene measurements as a parameterized multimodal learning problem. We construct CISS-REC, a dataset of 6,217 real-world accident cases curated from the NHTSA Crash Investigation Sampling System, and develop a reconstruction framework that grounds report semantics to road topology and participant attributes, reconstructs lane consistent pre-impact motion, and refines collision relevant interactions through localized geometric reasoning and temporal allocation. Our method outperforms representative baselines on CISS-REC, achieving the strongest overall reconstruction fidelity, including improved accident point accuracy and collision consistency. These results show that public accident reports can serve as scalable computational substrates for quantitatively verifiable accident reconstruction, with potential value for traffic safety analysis, simulation and autonomous driving research.

item.title: Hyperspherical Forward-Forward with Prototypical Representations
item.author: Shalini Sarode, Brian Moser, Joachim Folz, Federico Raue, Tobias Nauen, Stanislav Frolov, Andreas Dengel
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Hyperspherical Forward-Forward (HFF) 的新算法，通过重构局部目标解决了原始 FF 算法推理速度慢的问题。

背景: Forward-Forward (FF) 算法虽然训练高效且具有生物启发性，但其推理过程计算成本过高，每次评估需要单独的前向传播。

目的: 旨在解决 Forward-Forward 算法推理过程中的计算瓶颈问题。

方法: 将每一层的局部目标从二分类任务重新框架化为超球面特征空间中的多分类问题。通过学习类特定的单位范数原型作为几何锚点和隐式负样本。

主要发现: 该方法能够在单次前向传播中完成权重更新和推理，速度比原始 FF 算法快 40 倍以上。在 ImageNet-1k 上实现了超过 25% 的 top-1 准确率，迁移学习下达到 65.96%。

结论: 该方法易于实现，能有效扩展到现代卷积架构，在标准图像分类基准上取得了优于原始 FF 的准确率，缩小了与反向传播的差距。

翻译: The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm presents a compelling, bio-inspired alternative to backpropagation. However, while efficient in training, it has a computationally prohibitive inference process that requires a separate forward pass for every class that is evaluated. In this work, we introduce the Hyperspherical Forward-Forward (HFF), a novel reformulation that resolves this critical bottleneck. Our core innovation is to reframe the local objective of each layer from a binary goodness-of-fit task to a direct multi-class classification problem within a hyperspherical feature space. We achieve this by learning a set of class-specific, unit-norm prototypes that act as geometric anchors and implicit negatives. This architectural innovation preserves the benefits of local training while enabling weight update and inference in a single forward pass, making it >40x faster than the original FF algorithm. Our method is simple to implement, scales effectively to modern convolutional architectures, and achieves superior accuracy on standard image classification benchmarks, closing the gap with backpropagation. Most notably, we are among the first greedy local-learning methods to report over 25% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1k, and 65.96% with transfer learning.

Abstract

The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm presents a compelling, bio-inspired alternative to backpropagation. However, while efficient in training, it has a computationally prohibitive inference process that requires a separate forward pass for every class that is evaluated. In this work, we introduce the Hyperspherical Forward-Forward (HFF), a novel reformulation that resolves this critical bottleneck. Our core innovation is to reframe the local objective of each layer from a binary goodness-of-fit task to a direct multi-class classification problem within a hyperspherical feature space. We achieve this by learning a set of class-specific, unit-norm prototypes that act as geometric anchors and implicit negatives. This architectural innovation preserves the benefits of local training while enabling weight update and inference in a single forward pass, making it >40x faster than the original FF algorithm. Our method is simple to implement, scales effectively to modern convolutional architectures, and achieves superior accuracy on standard image classification benchmarks, closing the gap with backpropagation. Most notably, we are among the first greedy local-learning methods to report over 25% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1k, and 65.96% with transfer learning.

item.title: Predictive Spatio-Temporal Scene Graphs for Semi-Static Scenes
item.author: Miguel Saavedra-Ruiz, Charlie Gauthier, Kumaraditya Gupta, Shima Shahfar, Kirsty Ellis, Steven Parkison, Liam Paull
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于 Perpetua* 滤波器和 PredictiveGraphs 结构的时空语义推理方法，用于预测环境状态。

背景: 尽管机器人构建时空语义表示的能力取得了进步，但大多数现有方法缺乏时间推理能力，无法处理环境实例的结构化变化。

目的: 使机器人能够学习环境中的循环行为（如物体位置的周期性移动），并利用这些信息预测未来的环境状态。

方法: 提出了一种方法，其核心是一个名为 Perpetua* 的滤波器，用于对随时间观察到的环境状态进行贝叶斯推理。该方法将滤波器集成在名为 PredictiveGraphs 的 3D 场景图结构中，节点代表物体，边作为滤波器编码时空语义关系。

主要发现: 在模拟和现实世界的动态导航任务中，该方法在预测未来环境状态方面优于基线方法，即使在存在分布偏移的情况下也是如此。

结论: 该方法能够有效地进行时空语义推理，并在预测环境状态方面表现出色。

翻译: 尽管我们在构建能够使机器人在几何和语义之间进行复杂推理的“时空语义”表示方面取得了巨大进步，但大多数这些方法缺乏任何进行跨时间推理的能力。在机器人重复观察环境且实例在观察之间发生变化（但以结构化方式）的情况下，这是一种理想的属性。考虑一个家庭环境的例子，其中杯子的位置通常每天从橱柜移动到台面，再到水槽，然后回到橱柜。我们应该能够学习这种循环行为并利用它来预测杯子未来的状态。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种能够执行这种类型的时空语义推理的方法。该方法的基础是一个名为 Perpetua* 的滤波器，它对随时间观察到的环境状态执行贝叶斯推理。该滤波器集成在我们称为 PredictiveGraphs 的 3D 场景图结构中，其中节点代表物体，边作为 Perpetua* 滤波器，编码时空语义关系。我们在模拟和现实世界的动态导航任务中验证了该方法，其中我们的现实世界实验包括一个每两周变化一次的环境，持续三周。在这两种设置中，我们证明了我们的方法在预测未来环境状态方面优于基线，即使在存在分布偏移的情况下也是如此。

Abstract

We have seen tremendous recent progress in our ability to build "spatio-semantic" representations that enable robots to perform complex reasoning across geometry and semantics. However, the vast majority of these methods lack any ability to perform reasoning across time. This is a desirable property in situations where a robot repeatedly observes an environment where instances may change in between observations, but in a structured way. Consider as an example a home environment where the location of a mug typically moves from the cupboard to a countertop to the sink and then back to the cupboard on a daily basis. We should be able to learn this cyclic behavior and use it to predict the state of the mug in the future. In this work, we propose a method that is able to perform this type of tempo-spatio-semantic reasoning. Underpinning the method is a filter, Perpetua$^*$, that performs Bayesian reasoning on the states of the environment that are observed over time. This filter is integrated within a 3D scene graph structure that we call PredictiveGraphs, where nodes represent objects and edges function as Perpetua$^*$ filters encoding spatio-semantic relationships. We validate the method in both simulation and real-world dynamic navigation tasks, where our real world experiments consist of an environment that is undergoing semi-static changes at a bi-hourly frequency over a period of three weeks. In both settings, we demonstrate that our method outperforms baselines in predicting future environment states, even in the presence of distributional shifts.

item.title: NLPOpt-Net: A Learning Method for Nonlinear Optimization with Feasibility Guarantees
item.author: Bimol Nath Roy, Rahul Golder, MM Faruque Hasan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: NLPOpt-Net 是一种无监督学习架构，通过结合神经网络与投影机制，用于求解约束非线性规划问题，并保证解的可行性与最优性。

背景: 针对约束非线性规划问题，传统的求解方法较为复杂，本文提出一种基于神经网络的架构来处理此类优化问题。

目的: 构建一个能够学习参数化解映射的架构，确保解满足约束条件，并提高求解大规模优化问题的效率。

方法: 架构包含骨干神经网络和多层投影。神经网络通过包含修改拉格朗日函数和一致性损失的损失函数驱动优化；投影利用局部二次近似将预测映射到约束流形上。前向传播使用修改的 Chambolle-Pock 算法，反向传播使用隐函数定理。

主要发现: 该方法在求解大规模凸二次规划、QCQP、NLP 和非凸问题时，能实现近零的最优性间隙和机器精度的约束违反。此外，它能准确预测主动集和对偶变量，且将投影编译为 C 语言可大幅提升推理速度。

结论: NLPOpt-Net 提供了一个可扩展的多参数规划方法，具有 GPU 支持，且训练完成后可将神经网络与投影解耦，是一个即用型的优化求解工具。

翻译: Nonlinear Parametric Optimization Network (NLPOpt-Net) 是一种无监督学习架构，用于求解约束非线性规划问题。给定 NLP 的结构，它学习参数化解映射并保证约束满足。架构由骨干神经网络和多层投影组成。NN 通过包含修改拉格朗日函数和一致性损失的损失函数驱动优化，投影通过将 NN 预测投影到原始约束流形上来确保可行性。投影利用局部二次近似而非典型距离最小化。在凸性等条件下，投影具有下降性质。NLPOpt-Net 使用无逆修改的 Chambolle-Pock 算法求解前向传播中的约束二次投影，并使用隐函数定理进行高效反向传播。投影的固定结构允许训练完成后解耦 NN 和投影。NLPOpt-Net 求解大规模凸 QP、QCQP、NLP 和非凸问题，具有近零最优性间隙和机器精度的约束违反。它还提供近准确的主动集和对偶变量预测，从而实现多参数规划的可扩展方法。将投影编译为 C 语言相比 JAX 提供数量级的推理时间改进。我们提供包含 GPU 支持的即用型代码包。

Abstract

Nonlinear Parametric Optimization Network (NLPOpt-Net) is an unsupervised learning architecture to solve constrained nonlinear programs (NLP). Given the structure of an NLP, it learns the parametric solution maps with guaranteed constraint satisfaction. The architecture consists of a backbone neural network (NN) followed by a multilayer ($k$-layered) projection. While the NN drives toward optimality through a loss function consisting of a modified Lagrangian augmented with a consistency loss, the projection ensures feasibility by projecting the NN predictions in the original constraint manifold. Instead of typical distance minimization, our projection exploits local quadratic approximations of the original NLP. Under certain conditions (such as convexity), the projection has a descent property, which improves the NN predictions further. NLPOpt-Net deploys an inversion-free, modified Chambolle-Pock algorithm to solve the constrained quadratic projections during the forward pass and uses the implicit function theorem for efficient backpropagation. The fixed structure of the projection further allows decoupling of the NN and the projection once the training is complete. NLPOpt-Net solves large-scale convex QP, QCQP, NLP, and nonconvex problems with near zero optimality gap and constraint violations reduced to machine precision. Additionally, it provides near accurate prediction of the active sets and corresponding dual variables, thereby enabling a scalable approach for multiparametric programming. Compiling the projection in C provides order of magnitude improvement in inference time compared to JAX. We provide the codes and NLPOpt-Net as a ready to use package that includes GPU support.

item.title: Time-series Meets Complex Motion Modeling: Robust and Computational-effective Motion Predictor for Multi-object Tracking
item.author: Nhat-Tan Do, Le-Huy Tu, Nhi Ngoc-Yen Nguyen, Dieu-Phuong Nguyen, Trong-Hop Do
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于多目标跟踪的高效运动预测框架，旨在解决复杂非线性运动预测问题，同时保持高性能和低计算成本。

背景: 多目标跟踪在监控、自动驾驶和机器人等领域至关重要。现有方法在处理现实世界中复杂的非线性运动时表现不佳，且依赖复杂的生成模型导致实用性受限。

目的: 本文挑战了依赖复杂生成模型的范式，主张通过更高效、专用的方法来处理运动预测问题，以提升实际应用中的性能。

方法: 提出了时序卷积运动预测器TCMP。该方法利用改进的时序卷积网络TCN，采用空洞卷积和回归头，能够有效处理任意时间上下文长度的运动预测。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，TCMP在多项关键指标上超越了之前的最佳方法，包括HOTA、IDF1和AssA的提升。同时，TCMP具有极高的效率，其参数量仅为最佳方法的零点零一四倍，计算成本仅为零点零五倍。

结论: 该方法证明了在复杂跟踪环境中，通过确保适应性、准确性和效率，可以显著提升多目标跟踪系统。

翻译: Multi-object tracking (MOT) is critical in numerous real-world applications, including surveillance, autonomous driving, and robotics. Accurately predicting object motion is fundamental to MOT, but current methods struggle with the complexities of real-world, non-linear motion (e.g., sudden stops, sharp turns). While recent research has gravitated towards increasingly complex and computationally expensive generative models to tackle this problem, their practical utility is often constrained. This paper challenges that paradigm, arguing that such complexity is not only unnecessary but can be outperformed by a more efficient, purpose-built approach. We introduce the Temporal Convolutional Motion Predictor (TCMP), a novel framework for MOT that leverages a modified Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) featuring dilated convolutions and a regression head. This design allows for effective motion prediction across arbitrary temporal context lengths. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, specifically improves upon the previous best method in several key metrics: HOTA (a measure of overall tracking accuracy) increases from 62.3% to 63.4%, IDF1 (a measure of identity preservation) rises from 63.0% to 65.0%, and AssA (a measure of association accuracy) improves from 47.2% to 49.1%. Significantly, TCMP achieves this performance while being highly efficient; it has only 0.014 times the parameters and requires only 0.05 times the computational cost (FLOPs) compared to the SOTA method. while is only 0.014 times the size (in terms of parameters) and requires only 0.05 times the computational cost (in terms of FLOPs). These findings highlight the robustness of our method to advance MOT systems by ensuring adaptability, accuracy, and efficiency in complex tracking environments.

Abstract

Multi-object tracking (MOT) is critical in numerous real-world applications, including surveillance, autonomous driving, and robotics. Accurately predicting object motion is fundamental to MOT, but current methods struggle with the complexities of real-world, non-linear motion (e.g., sudden stops, sharp turns). While recent research has gravitated towards increasingly complex and computationally expensive generative models to tackle this problem, their practical utility is often constrained. This paper challenges that paradigm, arguing that such complexity is not only unnecessary but can be outperformed by a more efficient, purpose-built approach. We introduce the Temporal Convolutional Motion Predictor (TCMP), a novel framework for MOT that leverages a modified Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) featuring dilated convolutions and a regression head. This design allows for effective motion prediction across arbitrary temporal context lengths. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, specifically improves upon the previous best method in several key metrics: HOTA (a measure of overall tracking accuracy) increases from 62.3% to 63.4%, IDF1 (a measure of identity preservation) rises from 63.0% to 65.0%, and AssA (a measure of association accuracy) improves from 47.2% to 49.1%. Significantly, TCMP achieves this performance while being highly efficient; it has only 0.014 times the parameters and requires only 0.05 times the computational cost (FLOPs) compared to the SOTA method. while is only 0.014 times the size (in terms of parameters) and requires only 0.05 times the computational cost (in terms of FLOPs). These findings highlight the robustness of our method to advance MOT systems by ensuring adaptability, accuracy, and efficiency in complex tracking environments.

item.title: AEM: Adaptive Entropy Modulation for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Zhao, Haotian, Zhou, Songlin, Zhang, Yuxin, Yau, Stephen S. -T., Zhang, Wenyu, Tian, Lun, Zhu, Tianshu, Huang, Yifeng, Zeng, Yucheng, Gu, Jingnan, Dong, Daxiang, Wu, Jianmin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 强化学习显著提升了大型语言模型代理与环境交互和解决多轮任务的能力，但有效的代理强化学习仍面临挑战。本文提出了一种名为AEM的无监督信用分配方法，通过自适应调节熵动力学来改善探索与利用的权衡。

背景: 强化学习已显著提升了大型语言模型代理与环境交互和解决多轮任务的能力。然而，现有的代理强化学习面临挑战，稀疏的仅结果奖励难以在长交互轨迹中为单个步骤分配信用。现有方法引入密集中间监督增加了复杂性并限制了跨任务和领域的泛化能力。

目的: 为了解决现有方法引入密集中间监督导致复杂性增加且限制泛化能力的问题，提出一种无需监督的信用分配方法，以改善探索与利用的权衡。

方法: 提出AEM方法，将熵动力学从token级别提升到响应级别，以匹配LLM代理的有效动作粒度。利用采样响应的优势与其相对惊讶度的交互关系，推导出实用的响应级不确定性代理，利用正负样本的平衡自然地从探索过渡到利用。

主要发现: 熵漂移受采样响应优势与其相对惊讶度交互作用的控制。将不确定性估计与LLM代理的有效动作粒度对齐，能减少对token级采样噪声的敏感性。

结论: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和SWE-bench-Verified等任务上，AEM在1.5B到32B的模型上持续改进了强基线，特别是在集成到最先进的软件工程强化学习训练框架时，实现了1.4%的性能提升。

翻译: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the ability of large language model (LLM) agents to interact with environments and solve multi-turn tasks. However, effective agentic RL remains challenging: sparse outcome-only rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual steps within long interaction trajectories. Existing approaches often introduce dense intermediate supervision, such as process reward models or auxiliary self-supervised signals, which increases supervision and tuning complexity and may limit generalization across tasks and domains. We present AEM, a supervision-free credit assignment method that adaptively modulates entropy dynamics during RL training to improve the exploration-exploitation trade-off. Since in agentic RL the environment is typically affected by a complete response, rather than an individual token, our analysis lifts entropy dynamics from the token level to the response level, aligning uncertainty estimation with the effective action granularity of LLM agents and reducing sensitivity to token-level sampling noise. We further show that entropy drift under natural-gradient updates is governed by the interaction between the sampled-response advantage and its relative surprisal. Motivated by this result, AEM derives a practical response-level uncertainty proxy and uses it to rescale advantages, leveraging the evolving balance between positive and negative samples to naturally transition from exploration to exploitation. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SWE-bench-Verified with models ranging from 1.5B to 32B demonstrate that AEM consistently improves strong RL baselines, including a +1.4% gain when integrated into a state-of-the-art software-engineering RL training framework.

Existing approaches often introduce dense intermediate supervision, such as process reward models or auxiliary self-supervised signals, which increases supervision and tuning complexity and may limit generalization across tasks and domains. We present AEM, a supervision-free credit assignment method that adaptively modulates entropy dynamics during RL training to improve the exploration-exploitation trade-off. Since in agentic RL the environment is typically affected by a complete response, rather than an individual token, our analysis lifts entropy dynamics from the token level to the response level, aligning uncertainty estimation with the effective action granularity of LLM agents and reducing sensitivity to token-level sampling noise. We further show that entropy drift under natural-gradient updates is governed by the interaction between the sampled-response advantage and its relative surprisal. Motivated by this result, AEM derives a practical response-level uncertainty proxy and uses it to rescale advantages, leveraging the evolving balance between positive and negative samples to naturally transition from exploration to exploitation. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SWE-bench-Verified with models ranging from 1.5B to 32B demonstrate that AEM consistently improves strong RL baselines, including a +1.4\% gain when integrated into a state-of-the-art software-engineering RL training framework.

item.title: Scaling Video Understanding via Compact Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration
item.author: Chen, Kerui, Wang, Jinglu, Zhang, Jianrong, Li, Ming, Lu, Yan, Fan, Hehe
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为MACF的端到端多智能体协作框架，用于解决长视频理解中的感知预算限制问题，通过解耦局部感知预算与全局视频复杂性，实现可扩展且保持视觉保真度的视频理解。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在推进视觉语言理解方面取得了进展，但由于感知上下文预算的限制，在长视频任务中面临固有局限。现有的基于规则的预处理方法通过智能体方法缓解了这一问题，但往往 suffer from 信息丢失、高成本以及对文本中介的依赖。

目的: 设计一种能够解耦单智能体感知预算与全局视频复杂性的框架，从而在不损失视觉信息的前提下实现可扩展的视频理解。

方法: 1. 将视频分割为片段，分配给具有局部预算的智能体；2. 利用智能体原生的潜在通信协议进行整体推理；3. 每个智能体将部分观察编码为共享嵌入空间中的紧凑令牌；4. 引入课程训练策略，逐步强化语义对齐、证据总结和跨智能体协调。

主要发现: 在相同的预算约束下，MACF 在多样化的视频理解基准测试中始终优于最先进的 MLLMs 和多智能体系统。

结论: 潜在协作机制对于实现可扩展的视频理解是有效的。

翻译: 多模态大语言模型在推进视觉语言理解方面取得了进展，但由于感知上下文预算的限制，在长视频任务中面临固有局限。现有的基于规则的预处理方法通过智能体方法缓解了这一问题，但往往 suffer from 信息丢失、高成本以及对文本中介的依赖。我们提出了 MACF，这是一个端到端的多智能体协作框架，它解耦了单智能体的感知预算与全局视频复杂性，从而在保持视觉保真度的同时实现了可扩展的视频理解。MACF 将视频分割为片段，分配给具有局部预算的智能体，并通过智能体原生的潜在通信协议实现整体推理。每个智能体将部分观察编码为共享嵌入空间中的紧凑、任务充足的令牌，允许中央协调器进行高效且保信息的协作。我们引入了一种课程训练策略，逐步强制执行语义对齐、证据总结和跨智能体协调。在多样化的视频理解基准测试上的广泛实验表明，在相同的预算约束下，MACF 始终优于最先进的 MLLMs 和多智能体系统，证明了我们的潜在协作对于可扩展的视频理解的有效性。

Abstract

Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) advance vision language understanding but face inherent limitations in long-video tasks due to bounded perception context budgets. Existing agentic methods mitigate this via rule-based preprocessing, yet often suffer from information loss, high cost, and reliance on textual intermediates. We propose MACF, an end-to-end Multi-Agent Collaboration Framework that decouples per-agent perception budgets from global video complexity, enabling scalable video understanding while preserving visual fidelity. MACF partitions videos into segments for locally budgeted agents and enables holistic reasoning via an agent-native latent communication protocol. Each agent encodes partial observations into compact, task-sufficient tokens in a shared embedding space, allowing efficient and information-preserving collaboration by a central coordinator. We introduce a curriculum training strategy that progressively enforces semantic alignment, evidence summarization, and cross-agent coordination. Extensive experiments on diverse video understanding benchmarks show that MACF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art MLLMs and multi-agent systems under identical budget constraints, demonstrating the effectiveness of our latent collaboration for scalable video understanding.

item.title: Stereo Multistage Spatial Attention for Real-Time Mobile Manipulation Under Visual Scale Variation and Disturbances
item.author: Cai, Xianbo, Ichiwara, Hideyuki, Hiruma, Hyogo, Yoshikawa, Masaki, Ito, Hiroshi, Ogata, Tetsuya
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于立体多阶段空间注意力的深度预测学习方法，用于解决视觉尺度变化问题，提升移动操作的鲁棒性。

背景: 机器人需要在开放、非结构化的真实环境中运行，依赖 onboard 视觉感知。相机视角的连续变化导致目标物体视觉尺度显著变化，影响基于视觉的运动生成。

目的: 解决视觉尺度变化对运动生成的影响，实现实时移动操作。

方法: 提出了一种基于立体多阶段空间注意力的深度预测学习方法。该方法从立体图像中提取与任务相关的空间注意力点，并通过分层循环架构将它们与机器人状态集成，以进行闭环动作预测。

主要发现: 在四个真实世界的移动操作任务上进行了评估。在随机初始位置和视觉干扰条件下，与代表性模仿学习和视觉-语言-动作基线相比，该系统表现出更高的鲁棒性和任务成功率。

结论: 结构化的立体空间注意力和预测性时间建模相结合，在评估的移动操作场景中提供了一种有效的解决方案。

翻译: 在开放、非结构化的真实世界环境中运行的机器人必须依赖 onboard 视觉感知，同时在不同位置之间自主移动。Onboard 相机视角的连续变化导致目标物体出现显著的视觉尺度变化，从而影响基于视觉的运动生成。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于实时移动操作的基于立体多阶段空间注意力的深度预测学习方法。所提出的方法从立体图像中提取与任务相关的空间注意力点，并通过分层循环架构将它们与机器人状态集成，以进行闭环动作预测。我们使用移动操作器在四个真实世界的移动操作任务上评估了该系统，包括刚性放置、关节物体操作和可变形物体交互。在随机初始位置和视觉干扰条件下的实验表明，与具有相同控制设置的代表性模仿学习和视觉-语言-动作基线相比，该系统表现出更高的鲁棒性和任务成功率。结果表明，结构化的立体空间注意力和预测性时间建模相结合，在评估的移动操作场景中提供了一种有效的解决方案。

Abstract

Robots operating in open, unstructured real-world environments must rely on onboard visual perception while autonomously moving across different locations. Continuous changes in onboard camera viewpoints cause significant visual scale variations in target objects, affecting vision-based motion generation. In this work, we present a stereo multistage spatial attention-based deep predictive learning method for real-time mobile manipulation. The proposed methods extracts task-relevant spatial attention points from stereo images and integrates them with robot states through a hierarchical recurrent architecture for closed-loop action prediction. We evaluate the system on four real-world mobile manipulation tasks using a mobile manipulator, including rigid placement, articulated object manipulation, and deformable object interaction. Experiments under randomized initial positions and visual disturbance conditions demonstrate improved robustness and task success rates compared to representative imitation learning and vision-language-action baselines under identical control settings. The results indicate that structured stereo spatial attention combined with predictive temporal modeling provides an effective solution within the evaluated mobile manipulation scenarios.

item.title: Recovering Hidden Reward in Diffusion-Based Policies
item.author: Ji, Yanbiao, Li, Qiuchang, Hu, Yuting, Wu, Shaokai, Xie, Wenyuan, Zhang, Guodong, He, Qicheng, Ji, Deyi, Ding, Yue, Lu, Hongtao
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了 EnergyFlow 框架，通过参数化标量能量函数统一了生成式动作建模与逆强化学习，实现了无需对抗训练的奖励提取。

背景: 逆强化学习通常需要对抗训练，且难以与生成式动作建模有效结合。

目的: 提出一种无需对抗训练即可提取奖励的方法，并提高策略泛化能力。

方法: 通过参数化标量能量函数，利用去噪评分匹配学习评分函数，并约束学习场为保守场以减少假设复杂度。

主要发现: 在最大熵最优性下，评分函数能恢复专家软 Q 函数的梯度；约束学习场为保守场可减少假设复杂度并收紧分布外泛化界限；实验表明该方法在各种操作任务上达到最先进的模仿性能。

结论: EnergyFlow 在各种操作任务上表现优异，且结构约束在实现有效奖励提取的同时，也作为有益的归纳偏置促进了策略泛化。

翻译: 本文介绍了 EnergyFlow，一个通过参数化标量能量函数（其梯度是去噪场）来统一生成式动作建模与逆强化学习的框架。我们证明在最大熵最优性下，通过去噪评分匹配学习的评分函数恢复了专家软 Q 函数的梯度，从而无需对抗训练即可提取奖励。形式上，我们证明了约束学习场为保守场可减少假设复杂度并收紧分布外泛化界限。我们进一步刻画了恢复奖励的可识别性，并界定了评分估计误差如何传播到动作偏好。实验上，EnergyFlow 在各种操作任务上实现了最先进的模仿性能，同时为下游强化学习提供了优于对抗性 IRL 方法和基于似然方法的有效奖励信号。这些结果表明，有效奖励提取所需的结构约束同时作为有益的归纳偏置促进了策略泛化。

Abstract

This paper introduces EnergyFlow, a framework that unifies generative action modeling with inverse reinforcement learning by parameterizing a scalar energy function whose gradient is the denoising field. We establish that under maximum-entropy optimality, the score function learned via denoising score matching recovers the gradient of the expert's soft Q-function, enabling reward extraction without adversarial training. Formally, we prove that constraining the learned field to be conservative reduces hypothesis complexity and tightens out-of-distribution generalization bounds. We further characterize the identifiability of recovered rewards and bound how score estimation errors propagate to action preferences. Empirically, EnergyFlow achieves state-of-the-art imitation performance on various manipulation tasks while providing an effective reward signal for downstream reinforcement learning that outperforms both adversarial IRL methods and likelihood-based alternatives. These results show that the structural constraints required for valid reward extraction simultaneously serve as beneficial inductive biases for policy generalization. The code is available at this https URL .

item.title: CMTA: Leveraging Cross-Modal Temporal Artifacts for Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection
item.author: Wang, Hang, Shen, Chao, Lin, Chenhao, Yang, Minghui, Zhang, Lei, Wang, Cong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种基于跨模态时间伪影的AI生成视频检测框架CMTA。

背景: 先进的AI视频合成技术对数字视频真实性构成挑战。现有检测方法多关注单模态或时空伪影，忽略了视觉-文本跨模态空间中的线索。

目的: 识别AI生成视频中的独特指纹，提出一种新的检测方法来捕获跨模态时间伪影。

方法: 提出CMTA框架，利用BLIP生成帧级图像标题，利用CLIP提取视觉-文本表示。通过粗粒度分支（使用GRU）和细粒度分支（使用Transformer编码器）进行多粒度时间建模。

主要发现: AI生成视频在跨模态语义对齐上表现出异常稳定的时间轨迹，而真实视频则因语义变化表现出自然的波动。

结论: 在多个大型数据集上验证了该方法设定了新的最先进水平，并表现出优越的跨生成器泛化能力。代码和模型将发布。

翻译: 先进的AI视频合成技术的激增对数字视频真实性构成了前所未有的挑战。现有的AI生成视频检测方法主要关注单模态或时空伪影，但忽略了视觉-文本跨模态空间中的丰富线索，特别是语义对齐的时间稳定性。在这项工作中，我们识别出AIGV中的一种独特指纹，称为跨模态时间伪影。与真实视频因语义变化而在跨模态对齐中表现出自然的 temporal 波动不同，AIGV 显示出由给定输入提示词控制的异常稳定的语义轨迹。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了CMTA框架，这是一种通过联合跨模态嵌入和多粒度时间建模来捕获这些独特时间伪影的跨模态检测方法。具体而言，CMTA 利用 BLIP 生成帧级图像标题，并利用 CLIP 提取相应的视觉-文本表示。然后设计了一个粗粒度时间建模分支，利用 GRU 来表征跨模态对齐中的时间波动。同时，构建了一个细粒度分支，利用 Transformer 编码器从集成视觉-文本特征中捕获复杂的帧间变化。在包括 GenVideo、EvalCrafter、VideoPhy 和 VidProM 在内的四个大型数据集的 40 个子集上进行的广泛实验验证了我们的方法设定了新的最先进水平，同时表现出优越的跨生成器泛化能力。CMTA 的代码和模型将在此处发布。

Abstract

The proliferation of advanced AI video synthesis techniques poses an unprecedented challenge to digital video authenticity. Existing AI-generated video (AIGV) detection methods primarily focus on uni-modal or spatiotemporal artifacts, but they overlook the rich cues within the visual-textual cross-modal space, especially the temporal stability of semantic alignment. In this work, we identify a distinctive fingerprint in AIGVs, termed cross-modal temporal artifact (CMTA). Unlike real videos that exhibit natural temporal fluctuations in cross-modal alignment due to semantic variations, AIGVs display unnaturally stable semantic trajectories governed by given input prompts. To bridge this gap, we propose the CMTA framework, a cross-modal detection approach that captures these unique temporal artifacts through joint cross-modal embedding and multi-grained temporal modeling. Specifically, CMTA leverages BLIP to generate frame-level image captions and utilizes CLIP to extract corresponding visual-textual representations. A coarse-grained temporal modeling branch is then designed to characterize temporal fluctuations in cross-modal alignment with a GRU. In parallel, a fine-grained branch is constructed to capture intricate inter-frame variations from integrated visual-textual features with a Transformer encoder. Extensive experiments on 40 subsets across four large-scale datasets, including GenVideo, EvalCrafter, VideoPhy, and VidProM, validate that our approach sets a new state-of-the-art while exhibiting superior cross-generator generalization. Code and models of CMTA will be released at this https URL

item.title: PhysEdit: Physically-Consistent Region-Aware Image Editing via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Reasoning
item.author: Li, Guandong, Ye, Mengxia
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PhysEdit 是一个基于时空自适应推理的图像编辑框架，通过两个推理模块实现条件计算，在保持编辑质量和身份保留的同时提升推理速度。

背景: 图像编辑指令具有异质性（如颜色交换、对象插入、物理动作编辑），现有基于推理的编辑器对所有指令应用单一固定的推理流程，缺乏时空适应性。

目的: 提出一种能够根据指令和参考图像自适应调整推理深度和空间覆盖的编辑框架，以解决现有方法缺乏灵活性的问题。

方法: PhysEdit 引入两个推理时模块：1. 复杂度自适应推理深度 CARD，根据指令和图像预测复杂度并分配推理步数和长度；2. 空间推理掩码 SRM，从交叉注意力中提取指令条件下的空间先验，将推理限制在语义需要的区域。该框架无需重新训练骨干网络。

主要发现: 在 ImgEdit Basic-Edit Suite 数据集上，PhysEdit 相比强推理基线实现了 1.18 倍的加速，外观级编辑甚至达到 1.52 倍加速。同时，指令遵循度略有提升，身份保留能力与基线相当。

结论: CARD 的自适应分配是效率提升的主要来源，验证了该方法在条件计算问题上的有效性。

翻译: 图像编辑指令是异质的：颜色交换、对象插入和物理动作编辑都要求不同的空间覆盖和不同的推理深度，然而现有的基于推理的编辑器对每条指令都应用单一固定的推理流程。我们认为沿空间和时间轴的自适应是缺失的自由度，并提出了围绕这一原则构建的 PhysEdit 编辑框架。PhysEdit 引入了两个无需重新训练骨干网络的推理时模块。其核心是，(1) 复杂度自适应推理深度 CARD 直接从指令和参考图像预测编辑复杂度，并为每个样本分配推理步数 N_r 和推理标记长度 r——将之前固定的推理计划转变为条件计算问题。CARD 由 (2) 空间推理掩码 SRM 支持，该掩码从交叉注意力中提取指令条件下的空间先验，将推理限制在语义上需要的区域。在完整的 737 个案例 ImgEdit Basic-Edit 套件上，PhysEdit 相比强推理基线提供了 1.18 倍的时钟速度提升（每个样本 64.3s 对比 76.1s），同时略微提高了指令遵循度（CLIP-T 0.2283 对比 0.2266，+0.7%）并在噪声内匹配身份保留（CLIP-I 0.8246 对比 0.8280）。加速效果取决于类别，在外观级编辑上达到 1.52 倍，验证了 CARD 的自适应分配是效率提升的主要来源。一项包含完整消融实验的 30 个样本试点研究隔离了每个模块的贡献。

Abstract

Image editing instructions are heterogeneous: a color swap, an object insertion, and a physical-action edit all demand different spatial coverage and different reasoning depth, yet existing reasoning-based editors apply a single fixed inference recipe to every instruction. We argue that adaptivity along both the spatial and temporal axes is the missing degree of freedom, and we present PhysEdit, an editing framework built around this principle. PhysEdit introduces two inference-time modules that compose without retraining the backbone. At its core, (1) Complexity-Adaptive Reasoning Depth (CARD) predicts edit complexity directly from the instruction and reference image and allocates the reasoning step count N_r and reasoning-token length r per sample -- turning a previously fixed inference schedule into a conditional-computation problem. CARD is supported by (2) a Spatial Reasoning Mask (SRM) that extracts an instruction-conditioned spatial prior from cross-attention to confine reasoning to regions that semantically require it. On the full 737-case ImgEdit Basic-Edit Suite, PhysEdit delivers a 1.18x wall-clock speedup (64.3s vs. 76.1s per sample) over a strong reasoning baseline while slightly improving instruction adherence (CLIP-T 0.2283 vs. 0.2266, +0.7%) and matching identity preservation within noise (CLIP-I 0.8246 vs. 0.8280). The speedup is category-dependent and reaches 1.52x on appearance-level edits, validating CARD's adaptive allocation as the principal source of efficiency gain. A 30-sample pilot with full ablations isolates the contribution of each module.

item.title: Modeling Subjective Urban Perception with Human Gaze
item.author: Lin Che, Xi Wang, Marc Pollefeys, Konrad Schindler, Martin Raubal, Peter Kiefer
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一个名为 Place Pulse-Gaze 的数据集和一个基于注视的框架，用于研究注视行为如何有助于建模主观的城市感知。

背景: 现有的计算方法主要从街景图像直接建模城市感知，但忽略了形成这些判断的人类感知过程。

目的: 研究注视行为如何有助于建模主观的城市感知，并探索注视与场景表示的融合。

方法: 引入 Place Pulse-Gaze 数据集（包含街景图像、同步眼动追踪记录和个体感知标签），提出 Gaze-Guided Urban Perception Framework，并系统研究了三种设置：仅注视建模、注视与显式语义场景表示融合、注视与隐式丰富视觉表示融合。

主要发现: 注视本身已经携带了有用的预测信号；将注视与场景表示结合能进一步改善预测。

结论: 强调了将人类感知过程纳入城市场景理解的重要性，并为注视引导的多模态城市计算开辟了方向。

翻译: 城市感知描述了人们如何主观评价城市环境，塑造了人们体验和理解城市的方式。现有的计算方法主要从街景图像直接建模城市感知，但很大程度上忽略了形成这些判断的人类感知过程。在本文中，我们介绍了 Place Pulse-Gaze，这是一个城市感知数据集，它通过同步的眼动追踪记录和个体感知标签增强了街景图像。基于该数据集，我们提出了一个注视引导的城市感知框架，以研究注视行为如何有助于建模主观的城市感知。该框架系统地研究了三种互补的设置：仅注视建模、注视与显式语义场景表示的融合，以及注视与隐式丰富视觉表示的融合。实验表明，仅注视就已经携带了有用的主观城市感知预测信号，并且将注视与场景表示结合在语义和丰富视觉表示下进一步提高了预测性能。总的来说，我们的发现强调了将人类感知过程纳入城市场景理解的重要性，并为注视引导的多模态城市计算开辟了方向。

Abstract

Urban perception describes how people subjectively evaluate urban environments, shaping how cities are experienced and understood. Existing computational approaches primarily model urban perception directly from street view images, but largely ignore the human perceptual process through which such judgments are formed. In this paper, we introduce Place Pulse-Gaze, an urban perception dataset that augments street view images with synchronized eye-tracking recordings and individual perception labels. Based on this dataset, we propose a Gaze-Guided Urban Perception Framework to study how gaze behavior contributes to the modeling of subjective urban perception. The framework systematically investigates three complementary settings: gaze-only modeling, gaze fusion with explicit semantic scene representations, and gaze fusion with implicit richer visual representations. Experiments show that gaze alone already carries useful predictive signals for subjective urban perception, and that integrating gaze with scene representations further improves prediction under both semantic and richer visual representations. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of incorporating human perceptual processes into urban scene understanding and open a direction for gaze-guided multimodal urban computing.

item.title: Unsupervised Learning of Quantum Phase Transitions for Bose-Hubbard lattice systems
item.author: Bihui Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 使用基于扩散映射的无监督学习方法来表征量子多体相结构。

背景: 量子模拟是研究量子多体相结构的主要目标。玻色子晶格系统可以在超冷原子等平台上实现。

目的: 学习玻色子晶格系统中的相变，无需预先知道序参量或手工制作的观测量。

方法: 基于扩散映射的无监督学习方法。

主要发现: 该方法能够识别不同设置下的相结构，包括涉及对称性保护拓扑相的基态转变，以及区分非平衡区域中的遍历和多体局域化行为。

结论: 该方法具有直接应用于实验可测量数据以学习当前量子模拟器中量子相的潜力。

翻译: 表征量子多体相结构是量子模拟的主要目标。在这里，我们采用一种基于扩散映射的无监督学习方法，来学习由玻色-哈伯德型模型描述的玻色子晶格系统中的相变，这可以在超冷原子和相关量子模拟平台上实现。我们证明，这种方法能够在没有序参量或手工制作观测量先验知识的情况下，识别不同设置下的相结构，包括涉及对称性保护拓扑相的基态转变，以及区分非平衡区域中的遍历行为和多体局域化行为。我们的结果表明，该方法具有直接应用于实验可测量数据，以学习当前量子模拟器中量子相的潜力。

Abstract

Characterizing quantum many-body phase structure is a major goal for quantum simulation. Here, we employ an unsupervised learning approach based on diffusion maps to learn phase transitions in bosonic lattice systems described by Bose-Hubbard type models, which can be realized in ultracold atoms and related quantum simulation platforms. We demonstrate that this approach identifies phase structure across distinct settings without prior knowledge of order parameters or handcrafted observables, including ground-state transitions involving symmetry-protected topological phases and nonequilibrium regimes distinguishing ergodic and many-body localized behavior. Our results indicate that the approach has the potential for direct application to experimentally accessible measurement data for learning quantum phases in current quantum simulators.

item.title: Unsupervised Denoising of Real Clinical Low Dose Liver CT with Perceptual Attention Networks
item.author: Jingxi Pu, Tonghua Liu, Zhilin Guan, Siqiao Li, Yang Ming, Zheng Cong, Wei Zhang, Fangwei Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的低剂量CT去噪方法。

背景: 随着深度学习的发展，医学图像处理被广泛用于辅助临床研究。低剂量CT虽然减少了患者辐射暴露，但也引入了更多噪声，可能干扰医生视觉解读并影响诊断结果。

目的: 解决低剂量CT图像噪声干扰诊断的问题，提出一种无监督的去噪框架。

方法: 受Cycle-GAN启发，提出端到端无监督低剂量CT去噪框架。该框架结合了U-Net结构进行多尺度特征提取、注意力机制进行特征融合、残差网络进行特征变换，并引入感知损失以适应医学图像特征。

主要发现: 相比经典方法，该方法解决了真实临床数据无法直接用于监督学习的限制，同时实现了优异的性能。实验结果经影像科医生专业评估，满足临床需求。

结论: 实验结果表明该方法有效，能够满足临床需求。

翻译: With the development of deep learning, medical image processing has been widely used to assist clinical research. This paper focuses on the denoising problem of low-dose computed tomography using deep learning. Although low-dose computed tomography reduces radiation exposure to patients, it also introduces more noise, which may interfere with visual interpretation by physicians and affect diagnostic results. To address this problem, inspired by Cycle-GAN for unsupervised learning, this paper proposes an end-to-end unsupervised low-dose computed tomography denoising framework. The proposed framework combines a U-Net structure for multi-scale feature extraction, an attention mechanism for feature fusion, and a residual network for feature transformation. It also introduces perceptual loss to improve the network for the characteristics of medical images. In addition, we construct a real low-dose computed tomography dataset and design a large number of comparative experiments to validate the proposed method, using both image-based evaluation metrics and medical evaluation criteria. Compared with classical methods, the main advantage of this paper is that it addresses the limitation that real clinical data cannot be directly used for supervised learning, while still achieving excellent performance. The experimental results are also professionally evaluated by imaging physicians and meet clinical needs.

Abstract

With the development of deep learning, medical image processing has been widely used to assist clinical research. This paper focuses on the denoising problem of low-dose computed tomography using deep learning. Although low-dose computed tomography reduces radiation exposure to patients, it also introduces more noise, which may interfere with visual interpretation by physicians and affect diagnostic results. To address this problem, inspired by Cycle-GAN for unsupervised learning, this paper proposes an end-to-end unsupervised low-dose computed tomography denoising framework. The proposed framework combines a U-Net structure for multi-scale feature extraction, an attention mechanism for feature fusion, and a residual network for feature transformation. It also introduces perceptual loss to improve the network for the characteristics of medical images. In addition, we construct a real low-dose computed tomography dataset and design a large number of comparative experiments to validate the proposed method, using both image-based evaluation metrics and medical evaluation criteria. Compared with classical methods, the main advantage of this paper is that it addresses the limitation that real clinical data cannot be directly used for supervised learning, while still achieving excellent performance. The experimental results are also professionally evaluated by imaging physicians and meet clinical needs.

item.title: Transfer Learning for Tonal Noise Prediction in VRF Units Using Thermodynamic and Vibration Signals
item.author: Su, ZhiWei, Wang, Ding, Guo, Yuan, Qiao, Yang, Cao, HongJun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于域不变偏最小二乘法的无监督迁移学习方法，用于利用不同信号准确预测双转子压缩机产生的二阶谐波噪声水平。

背景: 双转子压缩机产生的二阶谐波分量是变制冷剂流量室外机组的主要低频噪声源，其幅度随环境热负荷和阀门开启度波动，使得传统机理模型难以准确评估。

目的: 利用不同信号在新条件下准确预测二阶谐波噪声水平。

方法: 构建了分别基于热力学信号和加速度信号的预测模型，并将所提Di-PLS方法的泛化性能与传统PLS进行了系统比较。

主要发现: Di-PLS通过提取跨条件共同特征并最小化源域与目标域的分布差异，显著优于传统PLS。其中，基于加速度的Di-PLS模型表现最佳，所有测试案例的预测误差均保持在3dB以内。

结论: 基于加速度的模型优于基于热力学的模型，表明结构振动与声辐射之间存在更强且更直接的因果关系。

翻译: 双转子压缩机产生的二阶谐波分量是变制冷剂流量室外机组的主要低频噪声源，但其幅度随环境热负荷和阀门开启度剧烈波动，使得利用传统机理模型难以准确评估。本文提出了一种基于域不变偏最小二乘法的无监督迁移学习方法，利用不同信号在新条件下准确预测二阶谐波噪声水平。分别构建了利用热力学信号和加速度信号的预测模型，并系统比较了所提Di-PLS与传统PLS的泛化性能。结果表明，Di-PLS通过提取跨条件共同特征并最小化源域与目标域之间的分布差异，显著优于传统PLS。具体而言，基于加速度的Di-PLS模型表现最佳，所有测试案例的预测误差均保持在3dB以内。这种优于基于热力学模型的性能突显了一个物理见解：虽然热力学状态驱动动态变化，但结构振动与声辐射具有更强且更直接的因果关系。

Abstract

The second-order harmonic (2f) component generated by twin-rotary compressor is a dominant low-frequency noise source of variable refrigerant flow (VRF) outdoor units, yet its amplitude fluctuates strongly with environmental thermal load and valve opening, making it difficult to assess accurately using conventional mechanism-based models. This paper proposes an unsupervised transfer learning method based on Domain-invariant Partial Least Squares (Di-PLS) to accurately predict 2f noise levels under new conditions using different signals. Prediction models utilizing thermodynamic signals and acceleration signals are constructed respectively, and the generalization performance of the proposed Di-PLS is systematically compared with traditional Partial Least Squares (PLS). Results demonstrate that Di-PLS significantly outperforms PLS by extracting cross-condition common features and minimizing the distribution discrepancy between the source and target domains. Specifically, the acceleration-based Di-PLS model achieves the best performance, maintaining prediction errors within 3 dB for all test cases. This superiority over thermodynamic-based models highlights a physical insight: while thermodynamic states drive dynamic changes, structural vibration possesses a stronger and more direct causal link to acoustic radiation.

item.title: TRIP-Evaluate: An Open Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Large Models in Transportation
item.author: Han Gong, Zhen Zhou, Yunyang Shi, Yan Tan, Jinbiao Huo, Qi Hong, Zhiyuan Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TRIP-Evaluate 是一个用于交通领域大模型的多模态开放基准测试。

背景: LLMs 和 MLLMs 在交通任务中应用广泛，但现有基准在规则应用、工程计算和场景理解方面证据有限，且缺乏跨文本、图像和点云数据的细粒度诊断能力。

目的: 为了解决现有基准的局限性，提出 TRIP-Evaluate，以评估大模型在交通领域的表现。

方法: 该基准包含 837 个项目，采用角色-任务-知识分类法，涵盖车辆、交通管理、出行者和规划设计功能。数据集包含文本、图像和点云数据。同时标准化了项目构建、质量控制、提示、解码和评分流程。

主要发现: 模型在文本任务上的性能有所提升，但在多步骤工程计算、规则约束推理、多模态场景理解和点云理解方面仍存在显著弱点。

结论: TRIP-Evaluate 为模型选择、回归测试和交通应用的安全部署提供了一个可复现、可诊断且符合工程标准的评估基线。

翻译: Large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large models (MLLMs) are increasingly used for transportation tasks such as regulation question answering, traffic management support, engineering review, and autonomous-driving scene reasoning. Yet transportation workflows are rule-intensive, computation-intensive, safety-critical, and inherently multimodal. Existing general benchmarks provide limited evidence of whether a model can apply regulations correctly, perform verifiable engineering calculations, or interpret traffic scenes reliably, while the small number of public transportation benchmarks remain narrow in scope and rarely support fine-grained diagnosis across text, images, and point-cloud data. To address this gap, we present TRIP-Evaluate, an open multimodal benchmark for large models in transportation. The benchmark organizes 837 items using a role-task-knowledge taxonomy that covers vehicle, traffic-management, traveler, and planning-and-design functions. Each item is annotated with capability, modality, and difficulty labels, enabling diagnosis from overall accuracy down to specific failure modes. The current release includes 596 text items, 198 image items, and 43 point-cloud items. TRIP-Evaluate also standardizes item construction, quality control, prompting, decoding, and scoring to improve cross-model comparability. Results on a diverse panel of models show that text-based performance is improving, but substantial weaknesses remain in multi-step engineering calculation, rule-constrained reasoning, multimodal scene understanding, and point-cloud understanding. Overall, TRIP-Evaluate provides a reproducible, diagnosable, and engineering-aligned evaluation baseline for model selection, regression testing, and safer deployment in transportation applications.

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large models (MLLMs) are increasingly used for transportation tasks such as regulation question answering, traffic management support, engineering review, and autonomous-driving scene reasoning. Yet transportation workflows are rule-intensive, computation-intensive, safety-critical, and inherently multimodal. Existing general benchmarks provide limited evidence of whether a model can apply regulations correctly, perform verifiable engineering calculations, or interpret traffic scenes reliably, while the small number of public transportation benchmarks remain narrow in scope and rarely support fine-grained diagnosis across text, images, and point-cloud data. To address this gap, we present TRIP-Evaluate, an open multimodal benchmark for large models in transportation. The benchmark organizes 837 items using a role-task-knowledge taxonomy that covers vehicle, traffic-management, traveler, and planning-and-design functions. Each item is annotated with capability, modality, and difficulty labels, enabling diagnosis from overall accuracy down to specific failure modes. The current release includes 596 text items, 198 image items, and 43 point-cloud items. TRIP-Evaluate also standardizes item construction, quality control, prompting, decoding, and scoring to improve cross-model comparability. item.title: CADFit: Precise Mesh-to-CAD Program Generation with Hybrid Optimization
item.author: Ghadi Nehme, Eamon Whalen, Faez Ahmed
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CADFit 是一种基于混合优化的框架，用于从网格恢复复杂的参数化 CAD 构建序列。

背景: 现有 CAD 重建方法受限于难以编辑的格式或简单的管道和低复杂度数据集，从几何输入恢复参数化 CAD 构建序列仍面临挑战。

目的: 引入 CADFit，从网格中恢复复杂且可编辑的 CAD 构建序列。

方法: 采用增量拟合和验证参数化操作，将重建表述为基于交并比的优化，支持丰富的操作（拉伸、旋转、倒角和圆角），并提出了结合图像几何重建的多模态管道。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试中优于最先进的方法，显著降低了重建 CAD 程序的无效比率，特别是对于复杂设计。

结论: 为生成更丰富的数据集和推进未来的基于学习的方法提供了实用基础。

翻译: 尽管取得了最近的进展，但从几何输入（如网格或点云）恢复参数化 CAD 构建序列仍然是设计和制造的关键挑战，因为现有的 CAD 重建和生成方法在很大程度上受到难以编辑的格式（如网格或 B-reps）或可编辑的简单草图和拉伸管道以及低复杂度数据集的限制。我们介绍了 CADFit，这是一种基于混合优化的 CAD 重建框架，通过使用几何反馈增量拟合和验证参数化操作，从网格中恢复复杂、可编辑的 CAD 构建序列。我们的方法通过将重建表述为结构化 CAD 程序上的交并比驱动优化，并支持丰富的操作集（包括拉伸、旋转、倒角和圆角）而独具特色。在多个 CAD 基准测试上的实验表明，CADFit 在体积交并比和倒角距离方面优于最先进的网格到 CAD 方法，同时显著降低了重建 CAD 程序的无效比率，特别是对于复杂设计。我们进一步提出了一个多模态管道，通过结合基于图像的几何重建与 CADFit，实现了从图像到 CAD 构建序列的端到端重建。通过能够准确重建更高复杂度的 CAD 模型，CADFit 为生成更丰富的数据集和推进未来的基于学习的 CAD 逆向工程方法提供了实用基础。

深度解读
