Abstract

Detecting anomalies from 3D point clouds has received increasing attention in the field of computer vision, with some group-based or point-based methods achieving impressive results in recent years. However, learning accurate point-wise representations for 3D anomaly detection faces great challenges due to the large scale and sparsity of point clouds. In this study, a surface-based method is proposed for 3D anomaly detection, which learns a discriminative signed distance function using multi-scale level-of-detail features. We first present a Noisy Points Generation (NPG) module to generate different types of noise, thereby facilitating the learning of discriminative features by exposing abnormal points. Then, we introduce a Multi-scale Level-of-detail Feature (MLF) module to capture multi-scale information from a point cloud, which provides both fine-grained local and coarse-grained global feature information. Finally, we design an Implicit Surface Discrimination (ISD) module that leverages the extracted multi-scale features to learn an implicit surface representation of point clouds, which effectively trains a signed distance function to distinguish between abnormal and normal points. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an average object-level AUROC of 92.1\% and 85.9\% on the Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD datasets, outperforming the current best approach by 2.1\% and 3.6\%, respectively. Codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DLF-3AD-DA61.

item.title: Mantis: Mamba-native Tuning is Efficient for 3D Point Cloud Foundation Models
item.author: Zihao Guo, Jihua Zhu, Jian Liu, Ajmal Saeed Mian
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Mantis 是首个专为 3D 点云预训练模型设计的原生 Mamba 参数高效微调框架。它通过引入状态感知适配器和双重序列一致性蒸馏，在保持预训练骨干网络冻结的情况下，实现了高效的模型适配。

背景: 3D 点云预训练模型在下游任务中表现出强大的迁移能力，但全量微调计算成本高且存储需求大。现有的参数高效微调方法主要针对 Transformer 架构，而 Mamba 架构引入了令牌级适配与状态级序列动态之间的粒度不匹配问题，导致直接迁移时精度下降和优化不稳定。

目的: 为了解决现有 PEFT 方法难以直接应用于冻结的 Mamba 骨干网络的问题，提出一种原生支持 Mamba 的参数高效微调框架，以实现高效适配且保持模型性能。

方法: 提出了 Mantis 框架，包含两个核心组件：一是状态感知适配器，用于在选择性状态空间更新中注入轻量级任务条件控制信号；二是双重序列一致性蒸馏，用于规范不同的有效点云序列化方式，减少序列化引起的稳定性问题。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试中，Mantis 仅使用约 5% 的可训练参数就实现了具有竞争力的性能。

结论: Mantis 成功解决了 Mamba 骨干网络在参数高效微调中的粒度不匹配和优化不稳定问题，证明了其在 3D 点云任务中的有效性。

翻译: 预训练的 3D 点云基础模型在多种下游任务中表现出强大的迁移能力。然而，对这些模型进行全量微调计算成本高昂且存储需求大。参数高效微调提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但现有的 PEFT 方法主要针对基于 Transformer 的骨干网络，依赖于令牌级提示或特征变换。基于 Mamba 的骨干网络在令牌级适配和状态级序列动态之间引入了粒度不匹配。因此，将现有的 PEFT 方法直接迁移到冻结的 Mamba 骨干网络会导致显著的精度下降和优化不稳定。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Mantis，这是首个针对 3D PFMs 的原生 Mamba PEFT 框架。具体而言，引入了状态感知适配器，用于向选择性状态空间更新中注入轻量级任务条件控制信号，从而在保持预训练骨干网络冻结的同时实现状态级适配。此外，通过双重序列一致性蒸馏规范不同的有效点云序列化方式，从而减少序列化引起的稳定性问题。在多个基准测试中的广泛实验表明，我们的 Mantis 仅使用约 5% 的可训练参数就实现了具有竞争力的性能。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/gzhhhhhhh/Mantis 获取。

深度解读

Abstract

Pre-trained 3D point cloud foundation models (PFMs) have demonstrated strong transferability across diverse downstream tasks. However, full fine-tuning these models is computationally expensive and storage-intensive. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising alternative, but existing PEFT approaches are primarily designed for Transformer-based backbones and rely on token-level prompting or feature transformation. Mamba-based backbones introduce a granularity mismatch between token-level adaptation and state-level sequence dynamics. Consequently, straightforward transfer of existing PEFT approaches to frozen Mamba backbones leads to substantial accuracy degradation and unstable optimization. To address this issue, we propose Mantis, the first Mamba-native PEFT framework for 3D PFMs. Specifically, a State-Aware Adapter (SAA) is introduced to inject lightweight task-conditioned control signals into selective state-space updates, enabling state-level adaptation while keeping the pre-trained backbone frozen. Moreover, different valid point cloud serializations are regularized by Dual-Serialization Consistency Distillation (DSCD), thereby reducing serialization-induced instability. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our Mantis achieves competitive performance with only about 5% trainable parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/gzhhhhhhh/Mantis.

item.title: Learning Generalizable Action Representations via Pre-training AEMG
item.author: Huang, Zhenghao, Yao, Huilin, Wang, Kaikai, Shu, Lin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了Any Electromyography (AEMG)框架，旨在解决肌电信号在跨受试者、设备和任务时的泛化能力问题，通过自监督学习实现通用表示。

背景: 肌电信号在解码人类运动意图和人机交互中起基础作用，但其泛化能力受限于数据异质性、标签稀缺和缺乏统一表征框架。

目的: 提出Any Electromyography (AEMG)框架，以弥合现有方法的差距，实现跨不同设备和任务的通用肌电信号处理。

方法: AEMG采用自监督表示学习，利用神经肌肉收缩分词器将肌肉收缩转化为结构化单词，将时间激活模式转化为连贯句子，并汇编了跨设备肌电信号词汇表。

主要发现: 与六种最先进的基线相比，AEMG在零样本测试中提高了5.79到9.25的准确率，且仅使用目标用户5%的数据就实现了超过90%的少样本适应性能。

结论: 该工作提出了肌电信号作为跨设备生理语言的概念，从海量数据中学习了其语法，为单一训练、普遍适用的肌电基础模型奠定了基础。

翻译: 肌电信号在解码人类运动意图和实现直观的人机交互中发挥着基础作用。然而，其跨受试者、设备和任务的泛化能力在很大程度上受到数据异质性、标签稀缺以及缺乏统一表征框架的限制。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Any Electromyography (AEMG)，这是首个用于肌电信号的大规模自监督表示学习框架。AEMG以语言学方式重新构想神经肌肉动力学，利用新颖的神经肌肉收缩分词器将离散的肌肉收缩转化为结构化单词，将时间激活模式转化为连贯句子。此外，我们汇编了迄今为止最大的跨设备肌电信号词汇表，从而能够跨越任意通道拓扑结构和采样率实现无缝迁移。实验表明，与六种最先进的基线相比，AEMG将零样本留一受试者测试的准确率提高了5.79到9.25百分比，并且仅使用目标用户5%的数据就实现了超过90%的少样本适应性能。我们的工作提出了肌电信号作为跨设备生理语言的概念，从海量数据中学习了其语法，并为单一训练、普遍适用的肌电基础模型奠定了基础。

Abstract

A fundamental role in decoding human motor intent and enabling intuitive human-computer interaction is played by electromyography (EMG). However, its generalization capability across subjects, devices, and tasks remains substantially limited by data heterogeneity, label scarcity, and the lack of a unified representational framework. To bridge this gap, we propose Any Electromyography (AEMG), the first large-scale, self-supervised representation learning framework for EMG. AEMG reconceptualizes neuromuscular dynamics linguistically, utilizing a novel Neuromuscular Contraction Tokenizer (NCT) to translate discrete muscle contractions into structural words and temporal activation patterns into coherent sentences. Furthermore, we compile the largest cross-device EMG signal vocabulary to date, enabling seamless transfer across arbitrary channel topologies and sampling rates. Experiments demonstrate that AEMG improves the zero-shot leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) accuracy by 5.79-9.25% compared to six state-of-the-art baselines, and achieves more than 90% few-shot adaptation performance with only 5% of target user data. Our work has proposed the concept of EMG signals as a cross-device physiological language, learned their grammar from massive amounts of data, and laid the groundwork for a single-training, universally applicable EMG foundation model.

item.title: Understanding Self-Supervised Learning via Latent Distribution Matching
item.author: Fabian A Mikulasch, Friedemann Zenke
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为潜在分布匹配的新视角，旨在统一现有的自监督学习方法。

背景: 自监督学习擅长从复杂数据中发现通用潜在表示，但缺乏统一的理论框架来解释现有方法并指导新方法的设计。

目的: 建立统一的理论框架来解释现有的自监督学习方法，并指导新方法的设计。

方法: 将自监督学习重新定义为潜在分布匹配，即学习在假设的潜在模型下最大化对数概率，同时最大化潜在熵以防止崩溃。利用该方法推导出一种非线性、无采样的贝叶斯滤波模型。

主要发现: 该视角统一了独立成分分析与对比、非对比及预测性自监督方法。证明了预测性潜在分布匹配在温和假设下甚至使用非线性预测器时也能产生可识别的潜在表示。

结论: 潜在分布匹配阐明了现有自监督方法的假设，并为开发新方法提供了原则性指导。

翻译: Self-supervised learning (SSL) excels at finding general-purpose latent representations from complex data, yet lacks a unifying theoretical framework that explains the diverse existing methods and guides the design of new ones. We cast SSL as latent distribution matching (LDM): learning representations that maximize their log-probability under an assumed latent model (alignment), while maximizing latent entropy to prevent collapse (uniformity). This view unifies independent component analysis with contrastive, non-contrastive, and predictive SSL methods, including stop gradient approaches. Leveraging LDM, we derive a nonlinear, sampling-free Bayesian filtering model with a Kalman-based predictor for high-dimensional timeseries. We further prove that predictive LDM yields identifiable latent representations under mild assumptions, even with nonlinear predictors. Overall, LDM clarifies the assumptions behind established SSL methods and provides principled guidance for developing new approaches.

Abstract

Self-supervised learning (SSL) excels at finding general-purpose latent representations from complex data, yet lacks a unifying theoretical framework that explains the diverse existing methods and guides the design of new ones. We cast SSL as latent distribution matching (LDM): learning representations that maximize their log-probability under an assumed latent model (alignment), while maximizing latent entropy to prevent collapse (uniformity). This view unifies independent component analysis with contrastive, non-contrastive, and predictive SSL methods, including stop gradient approaches. Leveraging LDM, we derive a nonlinear, sampling-free Bayesian filtering model with a Kalman-based predictor for high-dimensional timeseries. We further prove that predictive LDM yields identifiable latent representations under mild assumptions, even with nonlinear predictors. Overall, LDM clarifies the assumptions behind established SSL methods and provides principled guidance for developing new approaches.

item.title: Disentangling Shared and Task-Specific Representations from Multi-Modal Clinical Data
item.author: Lyu, He, Zeng, Huolin, Wang, Junren, Yang, Huazhen, He, Linchao, Chen, Yong, Li, Zhirui, Maier, Andreas, Bayer, Siming, Song, Huan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于统一Transformer的多任务框架，结合正交任务分解技术，用于多模态临床数据的预测。

背景: 现实临床数据具有多模态特性，需要联合评估多个相关结果。现有多任务学习方法难以平衡共享表示学习与特定任务建模，硬参数共享易导致负迁移，灵活共享易混淆信号。

目的: 解决现有方法在平衡共享表示与特定任务建模方面的不足，提高多结果预测的准确性。

方法: 提出基于统一Transformer的多任务框架，引入正交任务分解技术，将患者表示分为共享和特定任务子空间，并施加几何正交约束以减少冗余并隔离特定任务信号。

主要发现: 在12,430名外科患者队列上预测四个结果，该方法在平均AUC和AUPRC上表现优异，优于先进的表格和多任务方法，特别是在识别不平衡数据中的罕见事件方面有显著提升。

结论: 强制执行非冗余的共享和特定任务表示能够改善多模态临床数据的多种结果预测。

翻译: 现实临床数据本质上是多模态的，提供了互补的证据，反映了联合评估多个相关结果的实践必要性。虽然多任务学习可以通过在结果之间共享信息来提高效率，但现有方法往往无法平衡共享表示学习与特定任务建模。硬参数共享在任务梯度冲突时会触发负迁移，而灵活共享仍可能纠缠共享和特定任务信号。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于统一Transformer的多任务框架，用于多模态融合，并增强了正交任务分解，将患者表示分为共享和特定任务子空间，并施加几何正交约束以减少冗余并隔离特定任务信号。我们在一个包含12,430名外科患者的真实队列上评估了OrthTD，用于预测四个结果。OrthTD实现了平均AUC为87.5%和平均AUPRC为37.2%，一致优于先进的表格和多任务方法。值得注意的是，OrthTD在AUPRC方面取得了显著收益，表明在不平衡的临床数据中识别罕见事件方面具有优越的性能。这些结果表明，强制执行非冗余的共享和特定任务表示可以从多模态临床数据中改善多结果预测。

Abstract

Real-world clinical data is inherently multimodal, providing complementary evidence that mirrors the practical necessity of jointly assessing multiple related outcomes. Although multi-task learning can improve efficiency by sharing information across outcomes, existing approaches often fail to balance shared representation learning with outcome-specific modeling. Hard parameter sharing can trigger negative transfer when task gradients conflict, while flexible sharing may still entangle shared and task-specific signals. To address this, we propose a multi-task framework built on a unified Transformer for multimodal fusion, augmented with Orthogonal Task Decomposition (OrthTD) to split patient representations into shared and task-specific subspaces and impose a geometric orthogonality constraint to reduce redundancy and isolate task-specific signals. We evaluated OrthTD on a real-world cohort of 12,430 surgical patients for predicting four outcomes. OrthTD achieved average AUC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve) of 87.5% and average AUPRC (area under the precision-recall curve) of 37.2%, consistently outperformed advanced tabular and multi-task methods. Notably, OrthTD achieves substantial gains in AUPRC, indicating superior performance in identifying rare events within imbalanced clinical data. These results suggest that enforcing non-redundant shared and task-specific representations can improve multi-outcome prediction from multimodal clinical data.

item.title: Uncertainty Estimation in Instance Segmentation of Affordances via Bayesian Visual Transformers
item.author: Lorenzo Mur-Labadia, Ruben Martinez-Cantina, Jose J. Guerrero
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯模型和注意力机制的视觉可及性实例分割方法，通过不确定性估计和概率掩码质量评估来提升分割精度和可解释性。

背景: 视觉可及性是场景理解的新范式，有助于机器人交互、增强现实和假肢视觉，但需要准确的局部预测而非通用的显著性图。

目的: 构建一个用于视觉可及性实例分割的模型，并引入不确定性估计和新的质量评估指标。

方法: 采用基于样本和集成的方法进行不确定性估计，扩展了基于注意力的架构，提取像素级认识论和认识论方差，并提出了基于概率的掩码质量指标。

主要发现: 贝叶斯模型的多个子网络全局共识优于确定性网络，注意力机制提取了更强特征；在IIT-Aff数据集上F_beta_w分数提升7.4个百分点；贝叶斯模型校准更好，不确定性估计更准确；定性结果显示认识论方差出现在物体轮廓，认识论方差出现在视觉挑战像素。

结论: 该方法通过贝叶斯模型和注意力机制显著提升了分割性能和泛化能力，且提供了更好的不确定性估计和模型可解释性。

翻译: Visual affordances identify regions in an image with potential interactions, offering a novel paradigm for scene understanding. Recognizing affordances allows autonomous robots to act more naturally, could enhance human-robot interactions, enrich augmented reality systems, and benefit prosthetic vision devices. Accurate and localized prediction of affordance regions, rather than general saliency maps is crucial for these applications. We present a model for instance segmentation of affordances by adopting sample-based and ensembles approaches for uncertainty estimation. We extend an attention-based architecture for our novel task, showing with detailed ablation experiments the effects of each component. By comparing the distribution of these different detections, we extract pixel-wise epistemic and aleatoric variances at both the semantic and spatial levels. In addition, we propose a novel measure called Probability-based Mask Quality, which enables a comprehensive analysis of semantic and spatial variations in a probabilistic instance segmentation model. Our results show that the global consensus of multiple sub-networks of Bayesian models improve deterministic networks due to a better mask refinement and generalization. This fact, joined with the more powerful features extracted by attention-based mechanisms, represent an improvement of +7.4 p.p on the F_beta_w score in the challenging IIT-Aff dataset. Bayesian models are also better calibrated, producing less overconfident probabilities and with a better uncertainty estimation. Qualitative results show that aleatoric variance appears in the contour of the objects, while the epistemic variance is observed in visual challenging pixels, adding interpretability to the neural network.

Abstract

Visual affordances identify regions in an image with potential interactions, offering a novel paradigm for scene understanding. Recognizing affordances allows autonomous robots to act more naturally, could enhance human-robot interactions, enrich augmented reality systems, and benefit prosthetic vision devices. Accurate and localized prediction of affordance regions, rather than general saliency maps is crucial for these applications. We present a model for instance segmentation of affordances by adopting sample-based and ensembles approaches for uncertainty estimation. We extend an attention-based architecture for our novel task, showing with detailed ablation experiments the effects of each component. By comparing the distribution of these different detections, we extract pixel-wise epistemic and aleatoric variances at both the semantic and spatial levels. In addition, we propose a novel measure called Probability-based Mask Quality, which enables a comprehensive analysis of semantic and spatial variations in a probabilistic instance segmentation model. Our results show that the global consensus of multiple sub-networks of Bayesian models improve deterministic networks due to a better mask refinement and generalization. This fact, joined with the more powerful features extracted by attention-based mechanisms, represent an improvement of +7.4 p.p on the $F_β^w$ score in the challenging IIT-Aff dataset. Bayesian models are also better calibrated, producing less overconfident probabilities and with a better uncertainty estimation. Qualitative results show that aleatoric variance appears in the contour of the objects, while the epistemic variance is observed in visual challenging pixels, adding interpretability to the neural network.

item.title: Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Dynamic Point Cloud
item.author: Zhuoyue Zhang, Jihua Zhu, Chaowei Fang, Jian Liu, Ajmal Saeed Mian
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Diffusion Masked Pretraining (DiMP) 的统一自监督框架，用于动态点云预训练。

背景: 动态点云预训练主要依赖掩码重建目标。现有方法存在两个关键限制：一是将真实管中心作为解码器位置嵌入，导致时空位置泄露；二是使用确定性代理目标监督帧间运动，导致多模态轨迹不确定性坍缩为条件均值，丢失分布结构。

目的: 为了解决现有方法中存在的时空位置泄露问题以及多模态运动分布结构丢失的问题。

方法: DiMP 引入扩散模型到位置推断和运动学习中。首先对掩码管中心应用前向扩散噪声，然后从可见的时空上下文中预测干净的中心，从而消除位置泄露。同时，将逐点帧间位移监督重新表述为基于解码表示的条件扩散噪声预测目标，使编码器能够针对全条件分布进行学习，而非坍缩到单一确定性估计。

主要发现: 大量实验表明，DiMP 比仅使用主干网络 consistently 提升了下游准确性，在离线动作分割任务上绝对增益为 11.21%，在因果约束的在线推理下绝对增益为 13.65%。

结论: DiMP 有效地解决了位置泄露和运动分布丢失问题，显著提升了下游任务的准确性。

翻译: Dynamic point cloud pretraining is still dominated by masked reconstruction objectives. However, these objectives inherit two key limitations. Existing methods inject ground-truth tube centers as decoder positional embeddings, causing spatio-temporal positional leakage. Moreover, they supervise inter-frame motion with deterministic proxy targets that systematically discard distributional structure by collapsing multimodal trajectory uncertainty into conditional means. To address these limitations, we propose Diffusion Masked Pretraining (DiMP), a unified self-supervised framework for dynamic point clouds. DiMP introduces diffusion modeling into both positional inference and motion learning. It first applies forward diffusion noise only to masked tube centers, then predicts clean centers from visible spatio-temporal context. This removes positional leakage while preserving visible coordinates as clean temporal anchors. DiMP also reformulates point-wise inter-frame displacement supervision as a DDPM noise-prediction objective conditioned on decoded representations. This design drives the encoder to target the full conditional distribution of plausible motions under a variational surrogate, rather than collapsing to a single deterministic estimate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiMP consistently improves downstream accuracy over the backbone alone, with absolute gains of 11.21% on offline action segmentation and 13.65% under causally constrained online inference.Codes are available at https://github.com/InitalZ/DiMP.git.

Dynamic point cloud pretraining is still dominated by masked reconstruction objectives. However, these objectives inherit two key limitations. Existing methods inject ground-truth tube centers as decoder positional embeddings, causing spatio-temporal positional leakage. Moreover, they supervise inter-frame motion with deterministic proxy targets that systematically discard distributional structure by collapsing multimodal trajectory uncertainty into conditional means. To address these limitations, we propose Diffusion Masked Pretraining (DiMP), a unified self-supervised framework for dynamic point clouds. DiMP introduces diffusion modeling into both positional inference and motion learning. It first applies forward diffusion noise only to masked tube centers, then predicts clean centers from visible spatio-temporal context. This removes positional leakage while preserving visible coordinates as clean temporal anchors. DiMP also reformulates point-wise inter-frame displacement supervision as a DDPM noise-prediction objective conditioned on decoded representations. This design drives the encoder to target the full conditional distribution of plausible motions under a variational surrogate, rather than collapsing to a single deterministic estimate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiMP consistently improves downstream accuracy over the backbone alone, with absolute gains of 11.21% on offline action segmentation and 13.65% under causally constrained online inference.Codes are available at https://github.com/InitalZ/DiMP.git.

item.title: Rethinking Temporal Consistency in Video Object-Centric Learning: From Prediction to Correspondence
item.author: Zhiyuan Li, Rongzhen Zhao, Wenyan Yang, Wenshuai Zhao, Pekka Marttinen, Joni Pajarinen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文提出了一种名为 Grounded Correspondence 的框架，通过利用现代视觉骨干网络中的特征和确定性匹配，消除了对学习到的时序预测模块的需求，实现了零参数的时序建模，并在多个数据集上取得了良好的效果。

背景: 视频对象中心学习的主流方法通过学习动力学模块来预测未来的对象表示以保持时间一致性。

目的: 证明预测器是离散对应问题的昂贵近似，并利用现代骨干网络的特征消除对学习时序预测的需求。

方法: 提出 Grounded Correspondence 框架，用确定性二分匹配替换学习到的转换函数，槽位从冻结骨干网络特征中的显著区域初始化，通过匈牙利匹配保持帧间身份。

主要发现: 该方法不需要用于时序建模的可学习参数，但在 MOVi-D、MOVi-E 和 YouTube-VIS 数据集上取得了具有竞争力的性能。

结论: 利用现代骨干网络中的特征可以消除对学习到的时序预测的需求，从而实现零参数的时序建模。

翻译: 视频对象中心学习中的主流方法通过学习到的动力学模块来预测未来的对象表示，称为槽位，以保持时间一致性。我们证明了这些预测器是离散对应问题的昂贵近似。现代自监督视觉骨干网络已经编码了能够可靠区分对象的实例判别性特征。利用这些特征消除了对学习到的时序预测的需求。我们介绍了 Grounded Correspondence，一个用确定性二分匹配替换学习到的转换函数的框架。槽位从冻结骨干网络特征中的显著区域初始化。帧间身份通过在槽位表示上进行匈牙利匹配来保持。该方法不需要用于时序建模的可学习参数，但在 MOVi-D、MOVi-E 和 YouTube-VIS 上取得了具有竞争力的性能。

Abstract

The de facto approach in video object-centric learning maintains temporal consistency through learned dynamics modules that predict future object representations, called slots. We demonstrate that these predictors function as expensive approximations of discrete correspondence problems. Modern self-supervised vision backbones already encode instance-discriminative features that distinguish objects reliably. Exploiting these features eliminates the need for learned temporal prediction. We introduce Grounded Correspondence, a framework that replaces learned transition functions with deterministic bipartite matching. Slots initialize from salient regions in frozen backbone features. Frame-to-frame identity is maintained through Hungarian matching on slot representations. The approach requires zero learnable parameters for temporal modeling yet achieves competitive performance on MOVi-D, MOVi-E, and YouTube-VIS. Project page: https://magenta-sherbet-85b101.netlify.app/

item.title: MEMTIER: Tiered Memory Architecture and Retrieval Bottleneck Analysis for Long-Running Autonomous AI Agents
item.author: Bronislav Sidik, Lior Rokach
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MEMTIER 是一种针对 OpenClaw 代理运行时的三部分记忆架构，旨在解决长运行自主 AI 代理的记忆连贯性问题。

背景: 长时间运行的自主 AI 代理存在记忆连贯性问题，在七十二小时的操作窗口内，由于现有扁平文件内存系统的四种失败模式，工具执行成功率下降了十四个百分点。

目的: 提出一种三部分记忆架构，通过引入结构化存储和检索机制，解决现有内存系统的失败模式并提升代理的长期记忆能力。

方法: 引入结构化情节 JSONL 存储、五信号加权检索引擎、注意力归因认知权重更新循环、将情节事实异步合并到语义层的守护进程，以及基于 PPO 的策略框架来调整检索权重。

主要发现: 在五百题的 LongMemEval-S 基准测试中，MEMTIER 在消费级六百兆显卡上实现了百分之三十八点二的准确率和百分之四十一点二的 F1 分数，比全上下文基线提高了三十三个百分点。使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 事实预填充后，单会话召回率达到百分之六十八点六到百分之七十一点四，超过了 RAG BM25 GPT-4o 基线。时间推理达到百分之三十二点三，多会话综合达到百分之十七点三。

结论: 结构化语义预填充从根本上改变了轻量级检索的能力，所有阶段均在配备六百兆显卡的消费级笔记本电脑上本地运行。

翻译: 长时间运行的自主 AI 代理存在已记录的记忆连贯性问题：由于现有扁平文件内存系统中的四种累积失败模式，工具执行成功率在七十二小时的操作窗口内下降了十四个百分点。我们提出了 MEMTIER，这是针对 OpenClaw 代理运行时的三部分记忆架构，它引入了结构化情节 JSONL 存储、五信号加权检索引擎、注意力归因认知权重更新循环、将情节事实异步合并到语义层的守护进程，以及用于调整检索权重的基于 PPO 的策略框架（基础设施已验证；性能提升待定）。在完整的五百题 LongMemEval-S 基准测试（Wu et al., 2025）上，MEMTIER 在消费级六百兆显卡上使用 Qwen2.5-7B 实现了百分之三十八点二的准确率和百分之四十一点二的 F1 分数——比全上下文基线提高了三十三个百分点（百分之五点零到百分之三十八点二）。使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 事实预填充，单会话召回率达到百分之六十八点六到百分之七十一点四，超过了该论文的 RAG BM25 GPT-4o 基线（百分之五十六点零）。时间推理上升到百分之三十二点三，多会话综合上升到百分之十七点三，表明结构化语义预填充从根本上改变了轻量级检索所能实现的效果。所有阶段均在配备六百兆显卡的消费级笔记本电脑上本地运行。

Abstract

Long-running autonomous AI agents suffer from a well-documented memory coherence problem: tool-execution success rates degrade 14 percentage points over 72-hour operation windows due to four compounding failure modes in existing flat-file memory systems. We present MEMTIER, a tripartite memory architecture for the OpenClaw agent runtime that introduces a structured episodic JSONL store, a five-signal weighted retrieval engine, an attention-attributed cognitive weight update loop, an asynchronous consolidation daemon promoting episodic facts to a semantic tier, and a PPO-based policy framework for adapting retrieval weights (infrastructure validated; performance gains pending camera-ready). On the full 500-question LongMemEval-S benchmark (Wu et al., 2025), MEMTIER achieves Acc=0.382, F1=0.412 with Qwen2.5-7B on a consumer 6GB GPU - a +33 percentage point improvement over the full-context baseline (0.050 -> 0.382, i.e., 5% -> 38%). With DeepSeek-V4-Flash fact pre-population, single-session recall reaches 0.686-0.714, exceeding the paper's RAG BM25 GPT-4o baseline (0.560) on those categories. Temporal reasoning rises to 0.323 and multi-session synthesis to 0.173, demonstrating that structured semantic pre-population qualitatively changes what lightweight retrieval can achieve. All phases run locally on a consumer laptop with a 6GB GPU.

item.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of Tokenization and Self-Supervised Learning in End-to-End Automatic Speech Recognition applied on French Language
item.author: Thibault Bañeras-Roux, Mickael Rouvier, Jane Wottawa, Richard Dufour
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文通过定性研究，探讨了法语 ASR 系统中子词分词算法和自监督学习模型的影响。

背景: ASR 系统应用日益广泛，超参数和模型的选择对性能至关重要。然而，传统的字符错误率和词错误率等指标往往不完整，无法充分描述自动转录文本的下游应用。

目的: 探究子词分词算法和自监督学习模型对 ASR 系统的影响。

方法: 对法语进行定性研究，从语言学和声学角度，使用综合评估指标来调查子词分词算法和自监督学习模型的影响。

主要发现: unknown

结论: unknown

翻译: 端到端自动语音识别系统的性能使其能够越来越多地集成到各种应用中。虽然此类语音转文本系统有许多好处，但超参数和模型的选择对其性能起着至关重要的作用。通常，这些选择仅通过考虑字符错误率和/或词错误率等指标来确定。然而，多项研究表明，这些指标在很大程度上是不完整的，无法充分描述自动转录文本的下游应用。在本文中，我们对法语进行了一项定性研究，调查了子词分词算法和自监督学习模型从不同语言学和声学角度的影响，并使用了一组综合评估指标。

Abstract

The performance of end-to-end automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems enables their increasing integration into numerous applications. While there are various benefits to such speech-to-text systems, the choice of hyperparameters and models plays a crucial role in their performance. Typically, these choices are determined by considering only the character (CER) and/or word error rate (WER) metrics. However, it has been shown in several studies that these metrics are largely incomplete and fail to adequately describe the downstream application of automatic transcripts. In this paper, we conduct a qualitative study on the French language that investigates the impact of subword tokenization algorithms and self-supervised learning models from different linguistic and acoustic perspectives, using a comprehensive set of evaluation metrics.

item.title: A Robust Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Framework for Medical Image Classification Using RKHS-MMD
item.author: Sapna Sachan, Rakesh Kumar Sanodiya, Amulya Kumar Mahto
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无监督域适应框架，通过结合迁移学习和特定损失函数，解决了医学图像标注困难及跨中心泛化问题。

背景: 医学图像标注需要专业知识，且受不同医疗中心和设备影响，导致域偏移和模态差异，限制了训练模型的泛化能力。

目的: 解决医学图像标注困难及模型泛化受限的问题，减少对人工标注的依赖。

方法: 提出一种无监督域适应框架，结合迁移学习与基于再生核希尔伯特空间的平均均值差异损失，以对齐源域和目标域。

主要发现: 在两个胸部X光数据集上的实验显示，该方法优于未进行适应训练的模型；RKHS-MMD比标准平均均值差异更能减少模态差距。

结论: 该方法增强了模型对未标注医学数据集的泛化能力，在医学图像分类和AI驱动诊断中表现出色。

翻译: 标注医学图像是医学影像领域的主要瓶颈，因为它需要特定领域的专业知识，并且由于不同医疗中心和不同成像设备的差异而变得更加复杂。这种异质性引入了域偏移和模态差异，限制了训练模型的泛化能力。为了解决这一重要挑战，我们提出了一种无监督域适应框架，该框架结合了迁移学习和基于再生核希尔伯特空间的平均均值差异损失，用于对齐源域和目标域。通过联合优化分类和RKHS-MMD损失，该方法增强了在未标注医学数据集上的泛化能力，同时减少了对人工标注的依赖。在两个来自不同医疗中心的胸部X光数据集上进行的实验评估显示，其表现优于未进行适应训练的模型。此外，我们还进行了一项比较研究，发现RKHS-MMD在减少模态差距方面优于标准平均均值差异，强调了其在医学图像分类中的有效性，以及在先进AI驱动医学诊断中的强大能力。

Abstract

Labeling medical images is a major bottleneck in the field of medical imaging, as it requires domain-specific expertise, and it gets further complicated due to variability across different medical centers and different imaging devices. Such heterogeneity introduces domain shifts and modality discrepancies, which limits the generalization of trained models. To address this important challenge, we propose an unsupervised domain adaptation framework that combines transfer learning with a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space based Maximum Mean Discrepancy loss for the alignment of source and target domains. By jointly optimizing classification and RKHS-MMD losses, the methodology enhances generalization to unannotated medical datasets while diminishing reliance on manual annotation. Experimental evaluations presented on two chest X-ray datasets, which are obtained from different medical centers, show outstanding improvements over models trained without adaptation. Furthermore, we perform a comparative study to see that RKHS-MMD performs better than the standard Maximum Mean Discrepancy in reducing modality gap, emphasizing its effectiveness for medical image classification and also its strong capability in advanced AI-driven medical diagnostics.

item.title: Mechanical Conscience: A Mathematical Framework for Dependability of Machine Intelligenc
item.author: Munkhdegerekh Batzorig, Purevbaatar Ganbold, Kyungbin Park, Pilkong Jeong, Kangbin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为机械 conscience (MC) 的新概念和框架，用于在分布式协作智能系统中进行轨迹级的规范性调节。

背景: 分布式协作智能系统（涵盖边缘到边缘架构、联邦学习等）存在结构性不可避免的涌现风险，即局部正确决策在不确定性下可能组合成全局不可接受的行为轨迹。现有方法多关注单个动作的可接受性，未能解决多参与者和不确定性问题。

目的: 引入机械 conscience (MC) 框架，旨在对单智能体和分布式智能系统进行轨迹级的规范性调节，以应对不确定性带来的全局风险。

方法: MC 被定义为一种监督过滤器，用于最小化纠正基线策略的动作，以减少累积偏差，同时考虑认识论不确定性。文中还引入了良心分、机械内疚和共振可靠性等概念。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，MC 调节后的智能体在传统控制器超出可接受边界时仍能保持轨迹级的规范性可接受性；该框架能够自然扩展以抑制多智能体 DCI 设置中交互引起的涌现风险。

结论: MC 提供了可解释的词汇和可计算的治理信号，并建立了核心理论性质（如可接受性等价、最优调节存在性和单调偏差减少），证明了其在确保轨迹级可接受性方面的有效性。

翻译: 分布式协作智能（DCI），涵盖了边缘到边缘架构、联邦学习、迁移学习和群集系统，创造了这样一种环境：涌现风险在结构上是不可避免的：在不确定性下，单个代理的局部正确决策组合成全局不可接受的行为轨迹。现有的方法，如约束优化、安全强化学习和运行时保证，在单个动作层面评估可接受性，而不是在行为轨迹层面，且没有解决 DCI 部署的多参与者和不确定性本质。本文介绍了机械 conscience (MC)，这是一个新颖的概念和简化的数学框架，用于对单智能体和分布式智能系统进行轨迹级的规范性调节。机械 conscience 被定义为一种监督过滤器，用于最小化纠正基线策略的动作，以减少对规范性可接受区域的累积偏差，同时考虑认识论不确定性。我们引入了相关的概念，良心分、机械内疚和共振可靠性，为这个新兴领域提供了可解释的词汇和可计算的治理信号。建立了核心理论性质：可接受性等价、最优调节的存在性和单调偏差减少。示例结果表明，MC 调节的智能体在传统控制器超出可接受边界的地方保持了轨迹级的规范性可接受性，并且该框架自然扩展到抑制多智能体 DCI 设置中的交互引起的涌现风险。

Abstract

Distributed collaborative intelligence (DCI), encompassing edge-to-edge architectures, federated learning, transfer learning, and swarm systems, creates environments in which emergent risk is structurally unavoidable: locally correct decisions by individual agents compose into globally unacceptable behavioral trajectories under uncertainty. Existing approaches such as constrained optimization, safe reinforcement learning, and runtime assurance evaluate acceptability at the level of individual actions rather than across behavioral trajectories, and none addresses the multi-participant, uncertainty-laden nature of DCI deployments. This paper introduces mechanical conscience (MC), a novel concept and simplified mathematical framework that operationalizes trajectory-level normative regulation for both single-agent and distributed intelligent systems. Mechanical conscience is defined as a supervisory filter that minimally corrects a baseline policy's actions to reduce cumulative deviation from a normatively admissible region, while accounting for epistemic uncertainty. We introduce associated constructs, conscience score, mechanical guilt, and resonant dependability, that provide an interpretable vocabulary and computable governance signals for this emerging field. Core theoretical properties are established: admissibility equivalence, existence of optimal regulation, and monotonic deviation reduction. Illustrative results demonstrate that MC-regulated agents maintain trajectory-level normative acceptability where conventional controllers drift outside admissible bounds, and that the framework naturally extends to suppress interaction-induced emergent risk in multi-agent DCI settings.

item.title: UniCorrn: Unified Correspondence Transformer Across 2D and 3D
item.author: Prajnan Goswami, Tianye Ding, Feng Liu, Huaizu Jiang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 UniCorrn 的统一模型，通过共享权重实现了跨图像到图像、图像到点云以及点云到点云三种几何匹配任务的统一。

背景: 视觉对应关系是许多 3D 视觉任务的基础。尽管不同模态组合具有相似的问题结构，但现有方法通常使用针对每种模态组合的特定设计和独立模型。

目的: 为了解决现有方法针对不同模态组合使用独立模型的问题，提出一种能够统一所有三种任务几何匹配的共享权重模型。

方法: 利用 Transformer 注意力机制捕捉跨模态特征相似性。提出双流解码器，分别保持外观和位置特征流。架构采用模态特定的骨干网络，随后是共享的编码器和解码器组件。通过堆叠层实现端到端学习，支持基于查询的跨异构模态对应关系估计。

主要发现: Transformer 注意力机制能够自然地捕捉跨模态特征相似性。双流解码器设计支持灵活的基于查询的对应关系估计。

结论: UniCorrn 在 2D-2D 匹配上表现具有竞争力，在 7Scenes (2D-3D) 数据集上注册召回率比之前的最先进方法高出 8%，在 3DLoMatch (3D-3D) 数据集上高出 10%。

翻译: 跨越图像到图像、图像到点云以及点云到点云的视觉对应关系构成了许多 3D 视觉任务的基础。尽管具有相似的问题结构，当前的方法使用针对每种模态组合的特定设计，并为每种组合使用单独的模型。我们提出了 UniCorrn，这是第一个具有共享权重的对应关系模型，统一了所有三种任务的几何匹配。我们的关键见解是 Transformer 注意力自然地捕捉跨模态特征相似性。我们提出了一种双流解码器，它保持独立的外观和位置特征流。这种设计通过可堆叠层实现了端到端学习，同时支持跨异构模态的灵活的基于查询的对应关系估计。我们的架构采用模态特定的骨干网络，随后是共享的编码器和解码器组件，在结合来自深度图的伪点云与真实 3D 对应关系注释的多样化数据上进行联合训练。UniCorrn 在 2D-2D 匹配上取得了具有竞争力的性能，并在 7Scenes (2D-3D) 和 3DLoMatch (3D-3D) 的注册召回率上超过了之前的最先进方法，分别高出 8% 和 10%。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Visual correspondence across image-to-image (2D-2D), image-to-point cloud (2D-3D), and point cloud-to-point cloud (3D-3D) geometric matching forms the foundation for numerous 3D vision tasks. Despite sharing a similar problem structure, current methods use task-specific designs with separate models for each modality combination. We present UniCorrn, the first correspondence model with shared weights that unifies geometric matching across all three tasks. Our key insight is that Transformer attention naturally captures cross-modal feature similarity. We propose a dual-stream decoder that maintains separate appearance and positional feature streams. This design enables end-to-end learning through stack-able layers while supporting flexible query-based correspondence estimation across heterogeneous modalities. Our architecture employs modality-specific backbones followed by shared encoder and decoder components, trained jointly on diverse data combining pseudo point clouds from depth maps with real 3D correspondence annotations. UniCorrn achieves competitive performance on 2D-2D matching and surpasses prior state-of-the-art by 8% on 7Scenes (2D-3D) and 10% on 3DLoMatch (3D-3D) in registration recall. Project website: https://neu-vi.github.io/UniCorrn

item.title: Balanced Aggregation: Understanding and Fixing Aggregation Bias in GRPO
item.author: Zeng, Zhiyuan, Huang, Jiameng, Yin, Zhangyue, Liu, Jiashuo, Li, Ziniu, Li, Bingrui, Wu, Yuhao, Zheng, Yining, Zhang, Ge, Huang, Wenhao, Qiu, Xipeng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）中组内策略梯度项的聚合方式，提出了一种平衡聚合方法以解决不同聚合规则带来的优化偏差问题。

背景: RLVR 是提升大语言模型推理和代码生成能力的重要范式，GRPO 风格的训练被广泛采用，但组内 token 级策略梯度项的聚合方式仍是一个未充分探索的设计选择。

目的: 为了解决标准 GRPO 的序列聚合与近期提倡的 token 聚合之间的优化偏差张力，提出一种新的聚合方法。

方法: 提出平衡聚合（BA）方法，分别计算正负子集内的 token 级均值，然后基于序列计数权重进行组合。

主要发现: BA 在多个基准测试中一致地提高了训练稳定性和最终性能；聚合方式的相对有效性主要受响应长度变化和正负长度差的影响。

结论: 聚合是 GRPO 风格 RLVR 的关键设计维度，BA 是一种简单且有效的替代方案。

翻译: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理和代码生成能力的主流范式，GRPO 风格的训练因其简单有效而被广泛采用。然而，一个重要的设计选择仍未得到充分探索：即在每个采样组内如何聚合 token 级策略梯度项。标准 GRPO 使用序列聚合，而近期的工作提倡使用 token 聚合作为更好的替代方案。我们表明，这两种规则会产生不同的优化偏差：token 聚合引入了符号-长度耦合，而序列聚合通过序列级等权重隐式地降低了较长响应的权重。为了解决这一张力，我们提出了平衡聚合（BA），这是一种简单的即插即用替代方案，它分别计算正负子集内的 token 级均值，然后使用基于序列计数的权重将它们组合起来。在 DAPO-17k 和 Polaris 上使用 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 和 Qwen3-1.7B 进行实验，并在六个推理和编码基准上进行了评估，结果表明 BA 在训练稳定性和最终性能方面均一致优于标准的 token 和序列聚合。我们的分析进一步表明，token 和序列聚合的相对有效性主要受响应长度变化和正负长度差的支配，这凸显了聚合是 GRPO 风格 RLVR 中的一个关键设计维度。

深度解读

Abstract

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a central paradigm for improving reasoning and code generation in large language models, and GRPO-style training is widely adopted for its simplicity and effectiveness. However, an important design choice remains underexplored: how token-level policy gradient terms are aggregated within each sampled group. Standard GRPO uses sequence aggregation, while recent work has advocated token aggregation as a better alternative. We show that these two rules induce different optimization biases: token aggregation introduces sign-length coupling, while sequence aggregation implicitly downweights longer responses through sequence-level equal weighting. To address this tension, we propose \textbf{Balanced Aggregation (BA)}, a simple drop-in replacement that computes token-level means separately within the positive and negative subsets and then combines them with sequence-count-based weights. Experiments with Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Qwen3-1.7B on DAPO-17k and Polaris, evaluated on six reasoning and coding benchmarks, show that BA consistently improves training stability and final performance over standard token and sequence aggregation. Our analysis further shows that the relative effectiveness of token and sequence aggregation is largely governed by response-length variation and the positive-negative length gap, highlighting aggregation as a critical design dimension in GRPO-style RLVR.

item.title: Disentangled Learning Improves Implicit Neural Representations for Medical Reconstruction
item.author: Qing Wu, Xuanyu Tian, Chenhe Du, Haonan Zhang, Xiao Wang, Le Lu, Yuyao Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DisINR 是一个用于医学成像的隐式神经表示框架，通过解耦共享和特定主体表示，从原始数据预训练并仅优化特定编码器，从而提升重建效率和准确性。

背景: 传统的 INR 针对每个主体从头训练效率低，现有的基于初始化的方法需要高质量图像且在微调时存在灾难性遗忘。

目的: 提出一种新的 INR 框架，解决传统方法效率低、质量差的问题，并避免对高质量图像的依赖以及微调时的遗忘问题。

方法: 引入共享编码器-解码器对和特定主体编码器，利用可微分前向模型从原始数据预训练，测试时仅优化特定主体编码器，共享模块保持冻结。

主要发现: 在三个代表性医学成像任务中，DisINR 在重建准确性和效率上显著优于最先进的 INR。

结论: DisINR 显著提升了重建准确性和训练效率，有效保留了学习到的先验知识。

翻译: 隐式神经表示通过物理信息无监督学习在医学成像中成为一种强大的范式。传统的 INR 针对每个主体从头开始优化整个网络，导致训练效率低下和成像质量次优。最近的基于初始化的方法尝试将群体先验注入预训练网络，但它们依赖于高质量图像，并且在微调期间经常遭受灾难性遗忘。我们提出了 DisINR，这是一个新颖的 INR 框架，明确解耦了共享和特定主体的表示。DisINR 引入了一对共享编码器-解码器和特定主体的编码器，其特征被联合解码用于图像重建。通过集成可微分前向模型，它直接从有限的原始测量值预训练共享模块，消除了对预先获取的高质量图像的需求。在测试时适应期间，仅优化特定主体的编码器，而共享对保持冻结，有效地保留了学习到的先验。在三个代表性医学成像任务上的广泛评估表明，DisINR 在重建准确性和效率方面显著优于最先进的 INR。

Abstract

Implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for medical imaging via physics-informed unsupervised learning. Classical INRs optimize an entire network from scratch for each subject, leading to inefficient training and suboptimal imaging quality. Recent initialization-based approaches attempt to inject population priors into pre-trained networks, yet they rely on high-quality images and often suffer from catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning. We present DisINR, a novel INR framework that explicitly disentangles shared and subject-specific representations. DisINR introduces a shared encoder-decoder pair and subject-specific encoders, whose features are jointly decoded for image reconstruction. By integrating differentiable forward models, it pre-trains the shared modules directly from limited raw measurements, removing the need for pre-acquired high-quality images. During test-time adaptation, only the subject-specific encoder is optimized, while the shared pair remains frozen, effectively preserving learned priors. Extensive evaluations on three representative medical imaging tasks show that DisINR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art INRs in both reconstruction accuracy and efficiency.

item.title: Beyond Fixed Thresholds and Domain-Specific Benchmarks for Explainable Multi-Task Classification in Autonomous Vehicles
item.author: Maryam Sadat Hosseini Azad, Shahriar Baradaran Shokouhi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种自适应置信度阈值选择方法，并引入了IUST-XAI-AD数据集，旨在提升自动驾驶系统的可解释性和跨文化适应性。

背景: 自动驾驶系统依赖深度学习模型进行场景理解，但这些模型缺乏透明度和安全性，难以建立人类信任。

目的: 为了解决深度学习模型的黑箱问题，实现可解释的自动驾驶感知系统，并设计准确且跨文化的系统。

方法: 引入了全面的置信度阈值敏感性分析，通过评估不同阈值值来识别最优决策边界；同时引入了包含958张图像的IUST-XAI-AD数据集。

主要发现: 传统固定阈值方法在多任务场景中表现不佳；自适应阈值选择方法提高了不同任务的性能；IUST-XAI-AD数据集揭示了跨文化驾驶行为模式。

结论: 该工作提供了方法论进展和实用评估工具，有助于加速开发更可靠、可解释且文化适应性强的自动驾驶系统。

翻译: Scene understanding is a vital part of autonomous driving systems, which requires the use of deep learning models. Deep learning methods are intrinsically black box models, which lack transparency and safety in autonomous driving. To make these systems transparent, multi-task visual understanding has become crucial for explainable autonomous driving perception systems, where simultaneous prediction of multiple driving behaviors and their underlying explanations is essential for safe navigation and human trust in autonomous vehicles. In order to design an accurate and cross-cultural explainable autonomous driving system, we introduce a comprehensive confidence threshold sensitivity analysis that evaluates various threshold values to identify optimal decision boundaries for different tasks. Our analysis demonstrates that traditional fixed threshold approaches are suboptimal for multi-task scenarios. Through extensive evaluation, we demonstrate that our adaptive threshold selection methodology improves F1-scores across different tasks. In addition, we introduce IUST-XAI-AD, a novel dataset consisting of 958 images with human annotations for driving decisions and corresponding reasoning. This dataset addresses the critical gap in domain-specific evaluation benchmarks for distinct driving contexts and provides a more challenging test environment compared to existing datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that confidence threshold sensitivity analysis can significantly improve model performance, while the introduction of the IUST-XAI-AD dataset reveals important insights about cross-cultural driving behavior patterns. The combined contributions of this work provide both methodological advances and practical evaluation tools that can accelerate the development of more reliable, explainable, and culturally-adaptive autonomous driving systems for global deployment.

Abstract

Scene understanding is a vital part of autonomous driving systems, which requires the use of deep learning models. Deep learning methods are intrinsically black box models, which lack transparency and safety in autonomous driving. To make these systems transparent, multi-task visual understanding has become crucial for explainable autonomous driving perception systems, where simultaneous prediction of multiple driving behaviors and their underlying explanations is essential for safe navigation and human trust in autonomous vehicles. In order to design an accurate and cross-cultural explainable autonomous driving system, we introduce a comprehensive confidence threshold sensitivity analysis that evaluates various threshold values to identify optimal decision boundaries for different tasks. Our analysis demonstrates that traditional fixed threshold approaches are suboptimal for multi-task scenarios. Through extensive evaluation, we demonstrate that our adaptive threshold selection methodology improves F1-scores across different tasks. In addition, we introduce IUST-XAI-AD, a novel dataset consisting of 958 images with human annotations for driving decisions and corresponding reasoning. This dataset addresses the critical gap in domain-specific evaluation benchmarks for distinct driving contexts and provides a more challenging test environment compared to existing datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that confidence threshold sensitivity analysis can significantly improve model performance, while the introduction of the IUST-XAI-AD dataset reveals important insights about cross-cultural driving behavior patterns. The combined contributions of this work provide both methodological advances and practical evaluation tools that can accelerate the development of more reliable, explainable, and culturally-adaptive autonomous driving systems for global deployment.

item.title: From Language to Logic: A Theoretical Architecture for VLM-Grounded Safe Navigation
item.author: Kristy Sakano, Kalonji Harrington, Mumu Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种架构，用于将人类提供的规则和偏好集成到非结构化户外环境中的自主机器人导航中。

背景: 非结构化户外环境下的自主机器人导航需要整合人类规则和偏好。

目的: 构建一个架构，将自然语言规则和语义偏好转化为可执行的规范，以指导导航。

方法: 将自然语言规则翻译为信号时序逻辑规范，将持久规则和地形偏好映射到二维成本地图，将动态需求表达为规范，假设使用视觉语言模型进行零样本场景理解，并构建满足规范的导航模型。

主要发现: unknown

结论: 该框架通过将人类指令转化为规范，并利用模型进行场景理解，实现了对导航的指导。

翻译: We propose an architecture for integrating high-level, human-provided safety rules and operator-aligned semantic preferences into autonomous robot navigation in unstructured outdoor environments. In our approach, natural-language rules are translated into Signal Temporal Logic specifications that guide planning and navigation during runtime. Persistent, environment-centric rules and terrain preferences are grounded into a 2D cost map, while temporally dynamic requirements are expressed as STL specifications to be monitored during runtime. We hypothesize the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for zero-shot scene understanding, enabling mapping between human instructions, semantic features, and environmental constraints. Within this framework, we construct an illustrative navigation model that is designed to satisfy a set of STL-encoded specifications and soft operator preferences through formal satisfaction metrics embedded into environmental properties and runtime monitoring.

item.title: RemoteZero: Geospatial Reasoning with Zero Human Annotations
item.author: Yao, Liang, Liu, Fan, Xu, Shengxiang, Zhang, Chuanyi, Min, Rui, Di, Shimin, Zheng, Yuhui
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无需边界框监督的地理空间推理框架 RemoteZero，通过语义验证实现模型的自我进化。

背景: 地理空间推理需要将语义转化为精确位置。虽然推理路径已实现自动化，但模型仍依赖人工标注的地面真值坐标进行监督，这限制了模型在无标注数据上的自我进化能力。

目的: 为了打破这一瓶颈，提出一种无需边界框监督的框架，实现地理空间推理的自主进化。

方法: 利用多模态大语言模型在验证区域是否满足查询方面优于直接生成坐标的能力，用内在语义验证替代几何监督，并支持基于验证信号的迭代自我进化。

主要发现: RemoteZero 在无需边界框监督的情况下，取得了与强监督方法竞争性的性能表现。

结论: 自验证训练在地理空间推理定位中具有巨大潜力。

翻译: 地理空间推理需要模型将复杂的空间语义和用户意图解析为地球观测的精确目标位置。最近的进展解放了推理路径，允许模型生成自己的推理链。然而，仍然存在一个最终依赖：它们仍然由人工标注的地面真值坐标进行监督。这使得推理过程是自主的，但其空间终点不是，并且阻碍了在丰富的无标注遥感数据上进行真正的自我进化。为了打破这一瓶颈，我们介绍了 RemoteZero，这是一个用于地理空间推理的无边界框监督框架。RemoteZero 由一个简单的非对称性驱动：多模态大语言模型通常在验证一个区域是否满足查询方面比直接生成精确坐标更好。利用这种更强的判别能力，RemoteZero 用内在语义验证替代了几何监督，并支持无需边界框注释的强化学习训练。由此产生的框架进一步支持迭代自我进化，允许模型通过自己的验证信号从无标注遥感图像中改进。实验表明，RemoteZero 取得了与强监督方法竞争性的性能，证明了自验证训练在地理空间推理定位中的潜力。

Abstract

Geospatial reasoning requires models to resolve complex spatial semantics and user intent into precise target locations for Earth observation. Recent progress has liberated the reasoning path from manual curation, allowing models to generate their own inference chains. Yet a final dependency remains: they are still supervised by human-annotated ground-truth coordinates. This leaves the reasoning process autonomous, but not its spatial endpoint, and prevents true self-evolution on abundant unlabeled remote sensing data. To break this bottleneck, we introduce RemoteZero, a box-supervision-free framework for geospatial reasoning. RemoteZero is motivated by a simple asymmetry: an MLLM is typically better at verifying whether a region satisfies a query than at directly generating precise coordinates. Leveraging this stronger discriminative ability, RemoteZero replaces geometric supervision with intrinsic semantic verification and enables GRPO training without box annotations. The resulting framework further supports iterative self-evolution, allowing the model to improve from unlabeled remote sensing imagery through its own verification signal. Experiments show that RemoteZero achieves competitive performance against strong supervised methods, demonstrating the potential of self-verifying training for geospatial reasoning localization.

item.title: Ilov3Splat: Instance-Level Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding in Gaussian Splatting
item.author: Binh Long Nguyen, Kien Nguyen, Sridha Sridharan, Clinton Fookes, Peyman Moghadam
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Ilov3Splat 是一种基于 3D 高斯泼溅的实例级开放词汇 3D 场景理解框架。

背景: 现有方法依赖 2D 渲染匹配或点级语义关联，导致跨视图一致性差，缺乏连贯的实例级推理，限制了下游任务精度。

目的: 解决现有方法在跨视图一致性和实例级推理方面的局限性，实现基于自然语言描述的任意对象识别。

方法: 通过向高斯点云添加视图一致的特征场，利用多分辨率哈希嵌入编码语言对齐的 CLIP 特征，并使用对比损失在 SAM 掩码上训练实例特征场。推理时通过 CLIP 匹配和两阶段 3D 聚类检索相关高斯组。

主要发现: 在标准基准测试中，Ilov3Splat 在对象选择和实例分割方面优于先前的开放词汇 3D-GS 方法。

结论: 该框架无需类别监督或手动注释，能够灵活准确地识别 3D 场景中的任意对象，为语言驱动的 3D 场景理解提供了有效解决方案。

翻译: We introduce Ilov3Splat, a novel framework for instance-level open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding built on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS). Most prior work depends on 2D rendering-based matching or point-level semantic association, which undermines cross-view consistency, lacks coherent instance-level reasoning, and limits precision in downstream 3D tasks. To address these limitations, our method jointly optimizes scene geometry and semantic representations by augmenting Gaussian splats with view-consistent feature fields. Specifically, we leverage multi-resolution hash embedding to efficiently encode language-aligned CLIP features, enabling dense and coherent language grounding in 3D space. We further train an instance feature field using contrastive loss over SAM masks, supporting fine-grained object distinction across views. At inference time, CLIP-encoded queries are matched against the learned features, followed by two-stage 3D clustering to retrieve relevant Gaussian groups. This enables our framework to identify arbitrary objects in 3D scenes based on natural language descriptions, without requiring category supervision or manual annotations. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that Ilov3Splat outperforms prior open-vocabulary 3D-GS methods in both object selection and instance segmentation, offering a flexible and accurate solution for language-driven 3D scene understanding. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/Ilov3Splat.

We introduce Ilov3Splat, a novel framework for instance-level open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding built on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS). Most prior work depends on 2D rendering-based matching or point-level semantic association, which undermines cross-view consistency, lacks coherent instance-level reasoning, and limits precision in downstream 3D tasks. To address these limitations, our method jointly optimizes scene geometry and semantic representations by augmenting Gaussian splats with view-consistent feature fields. Specifically, we leverage multi-resolution hash embedding to efficiently encode language-aligned CLIP features, enabling dense and coherent language grounding in 3D space. We further train an instance feature field using contrastive loss over SAM masks, supporting fine-grained object distinction across views. At inference time, CLIP-encoded queries are matched against the learned features, followed by two-stage 3D clustering to retrieve relevant Gaussian groups. This enables our framework to identify arbitrary objects in 3D scenes based on natural language descriptions, without requiring category supervision or manual annotations. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that Ilov3Splat outperforms prior open-vocabulary 3D-GS methods in both object selection and instance segmentation, offering a flexible and accurate solution for language-driven 3D scene understanding. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/Ilov3Splat.

item.title: Velox: Learning Representations of 4D Geometry and Appearance
item.author: Anagh Malik, Dorian Chan, Xiaoming Zhao, David B. Lindell, Oncel Tuzel, Jen-Hao Rick Chang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Velox的框架，用于学习具有描述性、压缩性和易获取性的4D对象潜在表示。

背景: 为了解决4D对象表示在描述性、压缩性和易获取性方面的不足。

目的: 构建一个能够忠实地捕捉对象几何和外观、具有压缩效率且仅需非结构化动态点云即可构建的4D对象潜在表示框架。

方法: Velox通过训练编码器将时空彩色点云压缩为动态形状标记，并利用4D表面解码器和高斯解码器进行监督学习。

主要发现: 在视频到4D生成、3D跟踪以及通过图像到4D生成的布料模拟等三个下游任务中均表现出强劲的性能。

结论: 该框架在所有评估场景中均表现出强大的性能，证明了其表示的实用性。

翻译: 我们介绍了一个用于学习4D对象潜在表示的框架，这些表示具有描述性，忠实地捕捉对象几何和外观；具有压缩性，有助于下游效率；且具有易获取性，只需最少的输入，即非结构化动态点云，即可构建。具体而言，Velox训练一个编码器将时空彩色点云压缩为一组动态形状标记。这些标记使用两个互补的解码器进行监督：一个4D表面解码器，用于建模捕捉几何的时间变化表面分布；以及一个高斯解码器，用于将标记映射到3D高斯，有助于学习外观。为了证明我们表示的效用，我们在三个下游任务上评估了它——视频到4D生成、3D跟踪，以及通过图像到4D生成的布料模拟——并在所有设置中观察到强劲的性能。

Abstract

We introduce a framework for learning latent representations of 4D objects which are descriptive, faithfully capturing object geometry and appearance; compressive, aiding in downstream efficiency; and accessible, requiring minimal input, i.e., an unstructured dynamic point cloud, to construct. Specifically, Velox trains an encoder to compress spatiotemporal color point clouds into a set of dynamic shape tokens. These tokens are supervised using two complementary decoders: a 4D surface decoder, which models the time-varying surface distribution capturing the geometry; and a Gaussian decoder, which maps the tokens to 3D Gaussians, helping learn appearance. To demonstrate the utility of our representation, we evaluate it across three downstream tasks -- video-to-4D generation, 3D tracking, and cloth simulation via image-to-4D generation -- and observe strong performances in all settings.

item.title: Angle-I2P: Angle-Consistent-Aware Hierarchical Attention for Cross-Modality Outlier Rejection
item.author: Muyao Peng, Shun Zou, Pei An, You Yang, Qiong Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Image-to-point-cloud registration (I2P) 是机器人技术中的基础任务。现有深度学习方法表现良好，但在初始匹配对内点比例低时，传统 PnP 方法效果不佳。本文提出 Angle-I2P 方法，通过角度一致几何约束和分层注意力机制解决此问题，并在多个数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

背景: I2P 是机器人操作、抓取和定位等应用中的基础任务。现有的深度学习方法通过在特征空间对齐图像和点云特征来建立对应关系，已取得良好效果。

目的: 解决当初始匹配对的内点比例较低时，传统 Perspective-n-Points (PnP) 方法难以获得准确结果的问题。

方法: 提出了一种名为 Angle-I2P 的离群点拒绝网络。该方法利用基于角度一致性的尺度不变跨模态几何约束来区分内点和离群点，并采用全局到局部的分层注意力机制来过滤刚性变换下的不一致匹配。

主要发现: 在 7Scenes、RGBD Scenes V2 和自收集数据集上实现了最先进的性能，且在所有基准测试中均有持续改进。

结论: 实验结果表明，Angle-I2P 方法有效提升了内点比例和配准召回率，在多个数据集上取得了最佳性能。

翻译: Image-to-point-cloud registration (I2P) is a fundamental task in robotic applications such as manipulation, grasping, and localization. Existing deep learning-based I2P methods seek to align image and point cloud features in a learned representation space to establish correspondences, and have achieved promising results. However, when the inlier ratio of the initial matching pairs is low, conventional Perspective-n-Points (PnP) methods may struggle to achieve accurate results. To address this limitation, we propose Angle-I2P, an outlier rejection network that leverages angle-consistent geometric constraints and hierarchical attention. First, we design a scale-invariant, crossmodality geometric constraint based on angular consistency. This explicit geometric constraint guides the model in distinguishing inliers from outliers. Furthermore, we propose a global-tolocal hierarchical attention mechanism that effectively filters out geometrically inconsistent matches under rigid transformation, thereby improving the Inlier Ratio (IR) and Registration Recall (RR). Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the 7Scenes, RGBD Scenes V2, and a self-collected dataset, with consistent improvements across all benchmarks.

Abstract

Image-to-point-cloud registration (I2P) is a fundamental task in robotic applications such as manipulation,grasping, and localization. Existing deep learning-based I2P methods seek to align image and point cloud features in a learned representation space to establish correspondences, and have achieved promising results. However, when the inlier ratio of the initial matching pairs is low, conventional Perspective-n-Points (PnP) methods may struggle to achieve accurate results. To address this limitation, we propose Angle-I2P, an outlier rejection network that leverages angle-consistent geometric constraints and hierarchical attention. First, we design a scale-invariant, crossmodality geometric constraint based on angular consistency. This explicit geometric constraint guides the model in distinguishing inliers from outliers. Furthermore, we propose a global-tolocal hierarchical attention mechanism that effectively filters out geometrically inconsistent matches under rigid transformation, thereby improving the Inlier Ratio (IR) and Registration Recall (RR). Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the 7Scenes, RGBD Scenes V2, and a self-collected dataset, with consistent improvements across all benchmarks.

item.title: Open-Source Image Editing Models Are Zero-Shot Vision Learners
item.author: Wei Liu, Jiaxin Lin, Rui Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究评估了三个开源图像编辑模型在密集视觉预测任务上的零样本视觉理解能力，发现它们无需微调即可表现出非平凡的视觉理解能力。

背景: 现有研究表明大型生成模型具备零样本视觉能力，但证据多依赖闭源模型或需要微调，开源编辑模型是否具备此能力尚不明确。

目的: 探究公开可用的图像编辑模型是否具备开箱即用的零样本视觉能力，以及这种能力是否是图像编辑预训练的涌现属性。

方法: 选取三个开源图像编辑模型，在单目深度估计、表面法线估计和语义分割任务上进行系统评估，且未进行任何微调。

主要发现: 开源图像编辑模型表现出非平凡的零样本视觉理解能力。具体而言，FireRed在表面法线估计上表现优异，Qwen在语义分割上表现良好，且LongCat和Qwen在深度估计任务上也有不错表现。

结论: 零样本视觉能力可能是图像编辑预训练的涌现属性而非模型特定的产物。研究已公开代码和结果作为可复现基准。

翻译: 近期研究表明，大型生成模型能够解决它们未被明确训练过的视觉任务。然而，现有证据依赖于闭源模型或需要任务特定的指令微调，这留下了疑问：公开可用的图像编辑模型是否具备开箱即用的零样本视觉能力。我们对三个开源图像编辑模型——Qwen-Image-Edit、FireRed-Image-Edit 和 LongCat-Image-Edit——在密集视觉预测任务上进行了系统评估，且未进行任何微调。我们在 NYUv2 和 DIODE 上对单目深度估计进行了基准测试，在 NYUv2 上对表面法线估计进行了基准测试，在 Cityscapes 上对语义分割进行了基准测试，涵盖了几何和语义场景理解。结果表明，开源图像编辑模型表现出非平凡的零样本视觉理解能力。在 NYUv2 表面法线上，FireRed-Image-Edit 达到了 17.69 度的平均角度误差，超过了微调后的 Marigold（20.86 度），并在没有任何任务特定训练的情况下匹配了指令微调的 Vision Banana（17.78 度）。在 NYUv2 深度估计上，LongCat-Image-Edit 在仿射对齐下获得了 0.822 的 delta1，Qwen-Image-Edit 在 DIODE Indoor 上领先（0.868）。在 Cityscapes 语义分割上，Qwen-Image-Edit 在 19 类级别上达到了 25.7 mIoU，在更粗粒度的 7 类级别上达到了 49.5 mIoU。通过比较三个独立训练的编辑器，我们测试零样本视觉能力是否是图像编辑预训练的涌现属性，而不是模型特定的产物。代码、评估脚本和所有结果均已公开发布，以作为未来工作的可复现基准。

Abstract

Recent studies have shown that large generative models can solve vision tasks they were not explicitly trained for. However, existing evidence relies on closed-source models~(Veo~3, Nano Banana Pro) or requires task-specific instruction tuning, leaving open whether publicly available image-editing models possess zero-shot vision abilities out of the box. We conduct a systematic evaluation of three open-source image-editing models -- Qwen-Image-Edit, FireRed-Image-Edit, and LongCat-Image-Edit -- on dense visual prediction tasks \emph{without any fine-tuning}. We benchmark monocular depth estimation on NYUv2 and DIODE, surface normal estimation on NYUv2, and semantic segmentation on Cityscapes, covering both geometric and semantic scene understanding. Results show that open-source image-editing models exhibit non-trivial zero-shot visual understanding. On NYUv2 surface normals, FireRed-Image-Edit achieves a mean angular error of $17.69^\circ$, surpassing the fine-tuned Marigold ($20.86^\circ$) and matching the instruction-tuned Vision Banana ($17.78^\circ$) without any task-specific training. On NYUv2 depth estimation, LongCat-Image-Edit obtains $δ_1{=}0.822$ with affine alignment, and Qwen-Image-Edit leads on DIODE Indoor ($δ_1{=}0.868$). On Cityscapes semantic segmentation, Qwen-Image-Edit reaches 25.7 mIoU at the 19-class level and 49.5 mIoU at a coarser 7-category level. By comparing three independently trained editors, we test whether zero-shot vision ability is an emergent property of image-editing pretraining rather than a model-specific artifact. Code, evaluation scripts, and all results are publicly released to serve as a reproducible baseline for future work.

item.title: HeterSEED: Semantics-Structure Decoupling for Heterogeneous Graph Learning under Heterophily
item.author: Li, Xinyi, Li, Ming, Bai, Lu, Cui, Lixin, Cao, Feilong, Lv, Ke, Jiang, Yunliang, Liò, Pietro
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为HeterSEED的框架，用于解决异构图中的异质性学习问题。

背景: 现实世界中的异构图常表现出显著的异质性，即连接的节点往往具有不同的标签或语义角色。传统的基于特征相似性的异构图神经网络可能会传播误导信息。

目的: 构建一个语义-结构解耦的框架，以准确捕获语义并减少误导性信息的传播。

方法: HeterSEED将表示学习解耦为异构语义通道（捕获类型和关系感知的局部语义）和结构感知的异质性通道（通过伪标签引导分区分离同配和异配邻居，并使用基于元路径的结构权重聚合），最后通过节点级自适应融合机制结合。

主要发现: 理论上证明HeterSEED比依赖特征相似性的标准模型表达能力更强，且能减少由异配邻居引入的预测偏差；实验在五个真实世界数据集上验证了其有效性，特别是在强异配场景下优于现有基线。

结论: HeterSEED在处理异质性异构图时表现优异，能有效提升模型性能。

翻译: 许多现实世界的异构图表现出显著的异质性，其中连接的节点通常具有不同的标签或扮演不同的语义角色。在这种设置下，主要基于特征相似性沿着元路径或元关系聚合消息的标准异构图神经网络可能会传播误导性信息，因为特征相似性可能与底层关系语义不一致。在本文中，我们提出了HeterSEED，这是一个用于异质性下异构图学习的语义-结构解耦框架。HeterSEED将表示学习解耦为异构语义通道，用于捕获类型和关系感知的局部语义，以及结构感知的异质性通道，该通道通过伪标签引导的分区分离同配和异配邻居，并使用基于元路径的结构权重聚合它们。随后，节点级自适应融合机制结合这两个通道以产生上下文相关的节点表示。理论上，我们证明了在异质性下的异构图上，HeterSEED比主要依赖特征相似性的标准异构图神经网络表达能力更强，并证明了能减少由异配邻居引入的预测偏差。在五个真实世界异构图上的实验，包括两个百万节点和一亿边的超大规模网络，表明HeterSEED始终优于代表性的异构图神经网络和最近的异质性感知基线，特别是在强异配情况下。

Abstract

Many real-world heterogeneous graphs exhibit pronounced heterophily, where connected nodes often have dissimilar labels or play different semantic roles. In such settings, standard heterogeneous graph neural networks that aggregate messages along metapaths or meta-relations primarily based on feature similarity can propagate misleading information, since feature similarity may be misaligned with underlying relational semantics. In this paper, we propose HeterSEED, a semantics-structure decoupling framework for heterogeneous graph learning under heterophily. HeterSEED decouples representation learning into a heterogeneous semantic channel that captures type- and relation-aware local semantics and a structure-aware heterophily channel that separates homophilic and heterophilic neighborhoods via pseudo-label-guided partitioning and aggregates them using metapath-based structural weights. A node-level adaptive fusion mechanism then combines the two channels to produce context-dependent node representations. Theoretically, we establish that, on heterogeneous graphs under heterophily, HeterSEED is strictly more expressive than standard heterogeneous graph neural networks that rely primarily on feature similarity and provably reduces the prediction bias introduced by heterophilic neighbors. Experiments on five real-world heterogeneous graphs, including two large-scale networks at the million-node and hundred-million-edge scale, demonstrate that HeterSEED consistently outperforms representative heterogeneous graph neural networks and recent heterophily-aware baselines, especially in strongly heterophilic regimes.

item.title: ReflectDrive-2: Reinforcement-Learning-Aligned Self-Editing for Discrete Diffusion Driving
item.author: Wang, Huimin, Wang, Yue, Cui, Bihao, Li, Pengxiang, Lu, Ben, Wang, Mingqian, Wang, Tong, Tang, Chuan, Zhang, Teng, Zhan, Kun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ReflectDrive-2 是一种用于自动驾驶的掩码离散扩散规划器，它将计划表示为离散轨迹标记，通过并行掩码解码生成，并支持原地轨迹修订。

背景: 现有的自动驾驶规划方法在轨迹生成和修正方面存在局限性，需要一种能够高效进行原地修订的规划器。

目的: 提出一种能够通过同一模型进行原地轨迹修订的规划方法，以提升自动驾驶决策质量。

方法: 使用掩码离散扩散规划器，将计划表示为离散轨迹标记。引入 AutoEdit 功能，利用同一模型重写选定标记，无需辅助网络。采用两阶段训练：第一阶段使用结构感知扰动监督恢复专家轨迹；第二阶段使用强化学习微调完整决策-草稿-反思流程。设计高效的反思解码堆栈，结合共享前缀 KV 重用、交替步解码和融合设备端去掩码。

主要发现: 完整的流程 RL 对于耦合草稿和编辑至关重要。仅监督训练时，AutoEdit 提升效果有限，最多提升 0.3。引入 RL 后，AutoEdit 的增益提升至 1.9。在 NAVSIM 数据集上，仅使用摄像头输入达到 91.0 PDMS，最佳设置下达到 94.8 PDMS。平均延迟为 31.8 毫秒。

结论: ReflectDrive-2 通过结合强化学习和高效解码堆栈，显著提升了自动驾驶规划的性能和效率。

翻译: 我们介绍了 ReflectDrive-2，这是一种用于自动驾驶的掩码离散扩散规划器，具有独立的动作专家，它将计划表示为离散轨迹标记，并通过并行掩码解码生成。这种离散标记空间支持原地轨迹修订：AutoEdit 使用同一模型重写选定的标记，而无需辅助细化网络。为了训练这一能力，我们使用了两阶段程序。首先，我们沿着纵向进度和横向航向方向构建专家轨迹的结构感知扰动，并监督模型恢复原始专家轨迹。然后，我们使用强化学习微调完整的决策-草稿-反思流程，将终端驾驶奖励分配给最终的后编辑轨迹，并通过完整流程转换传播策略梯度信用。完整的流程 RL 证明对于耦合草稿和编辑至关重要：在仅监督训练的情况下，推理时的 AutoEdit 最多将 PDMS 提高了 0.3，而 RL 将其增益提高到 1.9。我们还为决策-草稿-反思流程共同设计了一个高效的反思解码堆栈，结合共享前缀 KV 重用、交替步解码和融合的设备端去掩码。在 NAVSIM 上，ReflectDrive-2 使用仅摄像头输入实现了 91.0 PDMS，在最佳设置下实现了 94.8 PDMS，同时在 NVIDIA Thor 上以 31.8 毫秒的平均延迟运行。

Abstract

We introduce ReflectDrive-2, a masked discrete diffusion planner with separate action expert for autonomous driving that represents plans as discrete trajectory tokens and generates them through parallel masked decoding. This discrete token space enables in-place trajectory revision: AutoEdit rewrites selected tokens using the same model, without requiring an auxiliary refinement network. To train this capability, we use a two-stage procedure. First, we construct structure-aware perturbations of expert trajectories along longitudinal progress and lateral heading directions and supervise the model to recover the original expert trajectory. We then fine-tune the full decision--draft--reflect rollout with reinforcement learning (RL), assigning terminal driving reward to the final post-edit trajectory and propagating policy-gradient credit through full-rollout transitions. Full-rollout RL proves crucial for coupling drafting and editing: under supervised training alone, inference-time AutoEdit improves PDMS by at most $0.3$, whereas RL increases its gain to $1.9$. We also co-design an efficient reflective decoding stack for the decision--draft--reflect pipeline, combining shared-prefix KV reuse, Alternating Step Decode, and fused on-device unmasking. On NAVSIM, ReflectDrive-2 achieves $91.0$ PDMS with camera-only input and $94.8$ PDMS in a best-of-6 oracle setting, while running at $31.8$ ms average latency on NVIDIA Thor.

item.title: Multi-Level Bidirectional Biomimetic Learning for EEG-Based Visual Decoding
item.author: Jingtao Liu, Peiliang Gong, Chuhang Zheng, Yiheng Liu, Qi Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 MB2L 的多级双向仿生学习框架，用于解决 EEG 与视觉刺激之间的跨模态对齐问题。

背景: EEG 视觉神经解码旨在对齐神经响应与视觉刺激，但受限于配对数据不足，且数字图像与生物视觉感知之间存在根本性不匹配（受视网膜映射和个体神经解剖结构影响）。

目的: 解决跨模态对齐问题，提高 EEG 到图像检索的准确率。

方法: 提出了 MB2L 框架，包含带有视觉先验的自适应模糊（根据视网膜先验重新加权视觉输入）、仿生视觉特征提取（学习与皮层分层处理一致的多级视觉表征），以及多级双向对比学习（在共享语义空间中对齐 EEG 和视觉特征）。

主要发现: 在零样本 EEG 到图像检索任务上，Top-1 准确率达到 80.5%，Top-5 准确率达到 97.6%，显著优于 prior 方法，且在跨被试和实验设置中表现出强大的泛化能力。

结论: MB2L 方法有效解决了感知结构不匹配问题，显著提升了神经解码的性能。

翻译: 基于脑电的视觉神经解码旨在对齐神经响应与视觉刺激，以进行图像检索等任务。然而，有限的配对数据以及高保真数字图像与生物视觉感知之间的根本性不匹配——由于视网膜映射和个体特定的神经解剖结构而扭曲——严重阻碍了跨模态对齐。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 MB2L，一种多级双向仿生学习框架，将结构化的生理归纳偏置纳入表征学习。具体而言，我们提出了带有视觉先验的自适应模糊，通过根据视网膜先验重新加权视觉输入来减轻感知结构不匹配。我们进一步提出了仿生视觉特征提取，以学习与皮层分层处理一致的多级视觉表征，增强被试不变的编码。这些模块通过多级双向对比学习进行联合优化，通过双向对比目标在共享语义空间中对齐 EEG 和视觉特征。实验表明，MB2L 在零样本 EEG 到图像检索上实现了 80.5% 的 Top-1 和 97.6% 的 Top-5 准确率，显著优于 prior 方法，并展示了在跨被试和实验设置中的强大泛化能力。

Abstract

EEG-based visual neural decoding aims to align neural responses with visual stimuli for tasks such as image retrieval. However, limited paired data and a fundamental mismatch between high-fidelity digital images and biological visual perception - distorted by retinotopic mapping and subject-specific neuroanatomy - severely impede cross-modal alignment. To address this, we propose MB2L, a Multi-Level Bidirectional Biomimetic Learning framework that incorporates structured physiological inductive biases into representation learning. Specifically, we propose Adaptive Blur with Visual Priors to mitigate perceptual-structural mismatch by reweighting visual inputs according to retinotopic priors. We further propose Biomimetic Visual Feature Extraction to learn multi-level visual representations consistent with hierarchical cortical processing, enhancing subject-invariant encoding. These modules are jointly optimized via Multi-level Bidirectional Contrastive Learning, which aligns EEG and visual features in a shared semantic space through bidirectional contrastive objectives. Experiments show MB2L achieves 80.5% Top-1 and 97.6% Top-5 accuracy on zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval, significantly outperforming prior methods and demonstrating strong generalization across subjects and experimental settings.

item.title: Vol-Mark: A Watermark for 3D Medical Volume Data Via Cubic Difference Expansion and Contrastive Learning
item.author: Jiangnan Zhu, Yuntao Wang, Shengli Pan, Yujie Gu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Vol-Mark 的可逆零水印方法，用于保护医学3D数据的所有权和真实性。

背景: 医学技术广泛使用3D体积数据进行诊断，但在远程医疗网络共享时存在数据篡改和未经授权复制的安全风险。

目的: 解决远程医疗中数据共享的安全问题，保护医学体积数据的所有权和真实性。

方法: 1. 利用对比学习提取特征的特征提取器。2. 引入立方体差分扩展技术，利用3D整数小波变换嵌入水印。3. 使用多数投票机制增强可靠性。4. 通过假设检验进行所有权验证。

主要发现: 该方法在常规、几何和混合攻击下表现出色，在大多数攻击场景下ACC超过0.90，显著优于现有方法。

结论: Vol-Mark 方法能有效验证数据完整性和所有权，在保持低失真和诊断准确性的同时，具备优异的鲁棒性。

翻译: Today, advances in medical technology extensively utilize 3D volume data for accurate and efficient diagnostics. However, sharing these data across networks in telemedicine poses significant security risks of data tampering and unauthorized copying. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel reversible-zero watermarking approach, termed Vol-Mark, for medical volume data to protect their ownership and authenticity in telemedicine. The proposed Vol-Mark method offers two key benefits: 1) it designs a volume data feature extractor that leverages contrastive learning to efficiently extract discriminative and stable volumetric features, ensuring robustness against 3D attacks; 2) it introduces the cubic difference expansion (c-DE) technique, which leverages the 3D integer wavelet transform to embed watermark bits into neighboring voxels within cubes at low-frequency coefficients. The voxel differences within each cube are expanded to create embedding space, and a majority voting mechanism is employed during extraction to enhance reliability. The embedding process incurs low distortion and supports lossless removal, thereby preserving the integrity and diagnostic accuracy of medical volume data. Through these two benefits, Vol-Mark enables both integrity verification and ownership verification. Integrity verification is first performed, and ownership verification through hypothesis testing is further conducted to enhance reliability, particularly under data tampering or watermark removal attacks. Comprehensive experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method and its superior robustness against conventional, geometric, and hybrid attacks on medical volume data. In particular, through multiple tasks evaluations, Vol-Mark consistently achieves an ACC above 0.90 in most attack scenarios, outperforming existing methods by a clear margin.

Abstract

Today, advances in medical technology extensively utilize 3D volume data for accurate and efficient diagnostics. However, sharing these data across networks in telemedicine poses significant security risks of data tampering and unauthorized copying. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel reversible-zero watermarking approach, termed Vol-Mark, for medical volume data to protect their ownership and authenticity in telemedicine. The proposed Vol-Mark method offers two key benefits: 1) it designs a volume data feature extractor that leverages contrastive learning to efficiently extract discriminative and stable volumetric features, ensuring robustness against 3D attacks; 2) it introduces the cubic difference expansion (c-DE) technique, which leverages the 3D integer wavelet transform to embed watermark bits into neighboring voxels within cubes at low-frequency coefficients. The voxel differences within each cube are expanded to create embedding space, and a majority voting mechanism is employed during extraction to enhance reliability. The embedding process incurs low distortion and supports lossless removal, thereby preserving the integrity and diagnostic accuracy of medical volume data. Through these two benefits, Vol-Mark enables both integrity verification and ownership verification. Integrity verification is first performed, and ownership verification through hypothesis testing is further conducted to enhance reliability, particularly under data tampering or watermark removal attacks. Comprehensive experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method and its superior robustness against conventional, geometric, and hybrid attacks on medical volume data. In particular, through multiple tasks evaluations, Vol-Mark consistently achieves an ACC above 0.90 in most attack scenarios, outperforming existing methods by a clear margin.

item.title: Spatial-Magnifier: Spatial upsampling for multichannel speech enhancement
item.author: Lee, Dongheon, Pandey, Ashutosh, Parekh, Sanjeel, Wong, Daniel, Donley, Jacob, Xu, Buye, Azcarreta, Juan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Spatial-Magnifier 的神经网络和 SARL 框架，用于从少量真实麦克风信号生成虚拟麦克风信号以提升语音增强效果。

背景: 多麦克风语音增强算法的空间指向性随麦克风数量增加而提高，但将大型阵列放入边缘设备受物理限制。

目的: 克服边缘设备中麦克风数量受限的物理限制，提高语音提取性能。

方法: 提出神经网络 Spatial-Magnifier，从有限的真麦克风测量值生成虚拟麦克风信号；引入 SARL 框架，利用估计的虚拟麦克风信号和特征来调节下游语音增强系统。

主要发现: 该框架在各种语音提取系统（包括端到端多通道语音增强和神经波束成形）中优于现有的空间上采样基线；该方法几乎恢复了所有麦克风都可用时的预言机性能。

结论: 该方法在边缘设备上有效，能够通过虚拟麦克风信号接近全阵列的性能。

翻译: 虽然多麦克风语音增强算法的空间指向性随麦克风数量增加而提高，但在现实世界的边缘设备中，将大型拾音阵列放入受到物理限制。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了 Spatial-Magnifier，这是一种神经网络，旨在从有限的真麦克风测量值中生成虚拟麦克风信号。此外，我们引入了空间音频表示学习框架，利用估计的虚拟麦克风信号和特征来调节下游语音增强系统。实验结果表明，所提出的框架在各种语音提取系统（包括端到端多通道语音增强和神经波束成形）中优于现有的空间上采样基线。所提出的方法几乎恢复了所有麦克风都可用时的预言机性能。

Abstract

While the spatial directivity of multichannel speech enhancement algorithms improves with the number of microphones, fitting large capture arrays into real-world edge devices is typically limited by physical constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose Spatial-Magnifier, a neural network designed to generate virtual microphone (VM) signals from a limited set of real microphone (RM) measurements. Moreover, we introduce the Spatial Audio Representation Learning (SARL) framework, which leverages estimated VM signals and features to condition a downstream speech enhancement system. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms existing spatial upsampling baselines across various speech extraction systems, including end-to-end multichannel speech enhancement and neural beamforming. The proposed method nearly recovers the oracle performance achieved when all microphones are available.

item.title: OpenWatch: A Multimodal Benchmark for Hand Gesture Recognition on Smartwatches
item.author: Bonazzi, Pietro, Ahmed, Youssef, Eckert, Daniel, Ronco, Andrea, Zeng, Junjie, Dai, Dengxin, Magno, Michele
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了首个用于腕部手势识别的开放访问多模态基准 OpenWatch，包含超过 50 名参与者的 IMU 和 PPG 数据，并提出了 MixToken 和 NormWear-Lora 两种新方法。

背景: 尽管智能手表在全球范围内被广泛采用，但用于腕部手势识别的开放基准仍然非常有限。

目的: 介绍 OpenWatch 基准，提出独立于受试者的评估协议，并开发两种新的手势识别方法。

方法: 使用同步的惯性测量单元和光电容积描记法进行多模态数据采集；提出 MixToken 方法融合 IMU 特征；提出 NormWear-Lora 模块用于智能手表基础模型；包含传统和深度学习方法进行时间序列分类。

主要发现: PPG 信号为智能手表基础模型提供了显著的预测益处；特定任务架构在准确性和内存效率方面显著优于微调的基础模型。

结论: 为资源受限的可穿戴传感提供了关于架构设计、模态融合、数据增强和基础模型适应之间权衡的明确经验指导。

翻译: 尽管智能手表在全球范围内被广泛采用，但用于腕部手势识别的开放基准仍然非常有限。本文介绍了首个用于腕部手势识别的开放访问多模态基准 OpenWatch，该基准使用商业智能手表上的同步惯性测量单元和光电容积描记法。它包含超过 50 名参与者 10 小时的 IMU 和 PPG 数据，以及 59 个标记的手势序列。此外，本文提出了一个独立于受试者的评估协议，包括用于时间序列分类的传统和深度学习方法。在此基础上，开发了两种新的手势识别方法：MixToken 和 NormWear-Lora。基准测试结果表明，PPG 信号为智能手表基础模型提供了显著的预测益处。此外，特定任务架构在准确性和内存效率方面显著优于微调的智能手表基础模型。最后，还为资源受限的可穿戴传感提供了关于专用架构设计、模态融合、数据增强和基础模型适应之间权衡的明确经验指导。

Abstract

Despite widespread adoption of smartwatches worldwide, open-benchmarks for wrist-based gesture recognition remain surprisingly limited. In this work, we introduce the first open-access multi-modal benchmark, OpenWatch, for wrist-based gesture recognition using synchronized inertial and physiological sensing on a commercial smartwatch. It contains over 10 hours of Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and Photoplethysmography (PPG) data across 50 participants and a vocabulary of 59 labelled gesture sequences. Furthermore, we present a subject-independent evaluation protocol including traditional and deep learning methods for time-series classification. On top of this, we develop two novel methodologies for hand-gesture recognition: (i) MixToken, a task-specific mixture-of-experts that fuses per-channel IMU filterbank features with cross-channel statistical tokens through learned logit mixing, and (ii) NormWear-Lora, a low-rank adaptation module for smartwatch foundation models. Our benchmarking results reveal that PPG signals carries a substantial predictive benefit (+12.5% F1-score) for foundational smartwatch models. In addition, we show that task-specific architectures (i.e. MixToken) substantially outperforms finetuned smartwatch foundation models in terms of accuracy (F1-score=90% vs 66%) and memory efficiency (223k vs 136M parameters). Finally, we also provide clear empirical guidance on the trade-offs between specialized architecture design, modality fusion, data augmentations, and foundation-model adaptation for resource-constrained wearable sensing.

item.title: Dr-PoGO: Direct Radar Pose-Graph Optimization
item.author: Cedric Le Gentil, Weican Li, Leonardo Brizi, Timothy D. Barfoot
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种使用二维旋转雷达的SLAM方法Dr-PoGO，该方法利用直接配准技术进行里程计和回环检测。

背景: 相比相机或激光雷达，毫米波雷达不受视线限制，能够穿透灰尘、雨雪等天气条件，提供鲁棒的感知能力。

目的: 为了解决现有雷达SLAM方法通常依赖点云或特征提取进行自运动估计的问题，提出一种基于直接配准技术的SLAM方法。

方法: Dr-PoGO利用直接配准技术进行里程计和回环配准。利用RaPlace算法提供回环候选，通过结合视觉特征和描述符进行粗到精的配准以获得初始变换，最后通过位姿图优化得到全局轨迹。

主要发现: Dr-PoGO在各种真实汽车环境中，在超过300公里的数据集上表现出了最先进的性能。

结论: Dr-PoGO在真实场景中表现优异，且其实现代码已公开发布。

翻译: 本文介绍了Dr-PoGO，一种使用二维旋转雷达的SLAM方法。与需要视线的相机或激光雷达不同，毫米波雷达可以“看”穿灰尘、下雪、下雨等。因此，无论天气条件如何，它都是一种鲁棒感知的极佳模态。虽然现有的基于雷达的SLAM方法通常依赖点云或特征的提取来进行自运动估计，但Dr-PoGO利用直接配准技术进行里程计和回环配准。一个现成的雷达聚焦的场所识别算法RaPlace提供回环候选。由于RaPlace不提供相对变换，Dr-PoGO引入了一种粗到精的配准，使用视觉特征和描述符来获得直接变换精炼的初始猜测。全局轨迹在位姿图优化中进行优化。Dr-PoGO在各种真实汽车环境中超过300公里的数据上展示了最先进的性能。我们的实现是公开可用的：https://github.com/utiasASRL/dr_pogo。

深度解读
